analyzed: tatas ca cākṣuṣa tva ādayaḥ eva hetavaḥ syuḥ na kṛtaka tva ādayaḥ iti aniṣṭam eva syāt tasmāt upacāraḥ karttavyaḥ iti

original: kiṃ punaḥ kvacit tarkkaśāstre dṛṣṭa niyamārtham vacanam ity ata āha – sajātīya evetyādi | tatra yaḥ san sajātīye dvedhā cāsaṃstadatyaye sa hetur ity atrācāryī ye hetulakṣaṇe |
analyzed: kim punar kvacid tarkka śāstre dṛṣṭa niyama artham vacanam iti atas āha sajātīye eva ityādi tatra yaḥ san sajātīye dvedhā ca asān tad atyaye sa hetuḥ iti atra ācāryī ye hetu lakṣaṇe

original: sajātīya eva sattvam ity avadhāraṇena siddhe (')pi vijātīyād vipakṣāddhetor vyatireke yadetad asaṃs tadatyaya iti sādhyābhāve 'sattvavacanaṃ tanniyamārtham ācāryeṇa vyākhyātamasaty eva nāstitā yathā syān nānyatra na viruddha iti | tathehāpi dharmivacanam bhāvaniyamārtham āśaṃkyate |
analyzed: sajātīye eva sattvam iti avadhāraṇena siddhe vijātīyāt vipakṣāt hetoḥ vyatireke yat etat asan tat atyayaḥ iti sādhya abhāve sattva vacanam tat niyama artham ācāryeṇa vyākhyātam asatī eva nāstitā yathā syāt na anyatra na viruddhaḥ iti tathā iha api dharmi vacanam bhāva niyama artham āśaṃkyate

original: nanv apakṣadharmasyāhetutvān na niyamārthā śaṅkā | yato vyāptasya hetutvaṃ na cānyadharmisthena sādhyadharmeṇānyadharmisthaḥ sādhanadharmo vyāptas tasmāt tadaṃśavyāptahetuvacanasāmarthyād eva sādhyadharmiparigraho bhaviṣyatīty ata āha – sāmarthyād ityādi |
analyzed: nanu apakṣa dharmasya ahetu tvāt na niyama arthā śaṅkā yatas vyāptasya hetu tvam na ca anya dharmi sthena sādhya dharmeṇa anya dharmi sthaḥ sādhana dharmaḥ vyāptaḥ tasmāt tad aṃśa vyāpta hetu vacana sāmarthyāt eva sādhya dharmi parigrahaḥ bhaviṣyati iti atas āha sāmarthyāt ityādi

original: anantaroditāt sāmarthyād arthasya sādhyadharmiparigrahalakṣaṇasya bhavati pratītiḥ paṭudhiyāṃ śrotṝṇāṃ kintv aśabdakam arthaṃ svayamanusaratāṃ pratipattigauravaṃ syāt | ata upacāramātrāt svayam aśabdakārthābhyūharahitād dharmidharma ity anena pakṣadharma iti samānanirdeśāt pratipattigauravaṃ ca parihṛtam bhavati |
analyzed: anantara uditāt sāmarthyāt arthasya sādhya dharmi parigraha lakṣaṇasya bhavati pratītiḥ paṭu dhiyām śrotṝṇām kintu aśabdakam artham svayam anusaratām pratipatti gauravam syāt atas upacāra mātrāt svayam aśabdaka artha abhyūha rahitāt dharmi dharmaḥ iti anena pakṣa dharmaḥ iti samāna nirdeśāt pratipatti gauravam ca parihṛtam bhavati

original: ca śabdenaitad āha – ye paropadeśam ākāṃkṣanti tair ayam artho lakṣaṇavacanād boddhavya iti |
analyzed: ca śabdena etat āha ye para upadeśam ākāṃkṣanti taiḥ ayam arthaḥ lakṣaṇa vacanāt boddhavyaḥ iti

original: yathālakṣaṇaṃ pratīter apakṣadharmo na hetur iti kuta iyam āśaṅkā | tatas teṣāṃ lakṣaṇānusāriṇāṃ niyamāśaṃkāparihārārthañ copacārakaraṇam iti | iha vyavacchedaphalatvāc chabdaprayogasyāvaśyam evāvadhārayitavyaṃ (|) ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāc ca pakṣadharma iti nānyas samāsas sambhavati |
analyzed: yathālakṣaṇam pratīteḥ apakṣa dharmaḥ na hetuḥ iti kutas iyam āśaṅkā tatas teṣām lakṣaṇa anusāriṇām niyama āśaṃkā parihāra artham ca upacāra karaṇam iti iha vyavaccheda phala tvāt śabda prayogasya avaśyam eva avadhārayitavyam ṣaṣṭhī samāsāt ca pakṣa dharmaḥ iti na anyaḥ samāsaḥ sambhavati

original: tathā ca pakṣasyaiva dharmma ity evam avadhāraṇāt tadaṃśavyāptir virudhyata iti viruddhalakṣaṇatām udbhāvayann āha –
analyzed: tathā ca pakṣasya eva dharmmaḥ iti evam avadhāraṇāt tad aṃśa vyāptiḥ virudhyate iti viruddha lakṣaṇa tām udbhāvayan āha

original: pakṣasya dharmatve tampakṣaṃ viśeṣaṇam anyato vyavacchedam apekṣata iti | tadviśeṣaṇāpekṣasya dharmasyānyatra pakṣīkṛtād anyasmin sapakṣe 'nanuvṛttiḥ | tathā hi yaḥ [p.15] pakṣeṇa viśeṣyate sa pakṣasyaiva bhavati | yathā devadattasya putraḥ (|) tatonyatrānanuvṛtter asādhāraṇatā sādhāraṇatā na syāt | tadaṃśavyāptivirodha iti yāvat |
analyzed: pakṣasya dharma tve tam pakṣam viśeṣaṇam anyatas vyavacchedam apekṣate iti tad viśeṣaṇa apekṣasya dharmasya anyatra pakṣīkṛtāt anyasmin sapakṣe nanuvṛttiḥ tathā hi yaḥ pakṣeṇa viśeṣyate sa pakṣasya eva bhavati yathā devadattasya putraḥ tatonyatra ananuvṛtteḥ asādhāraṇa tā sādhāraṇa tā na syāt tad aṃśa vyāpti virodhaḥ iti yāvat

original: sādhāraṇatayā tadaṃśavyāptipratipādanāt | tato yadi pakṣadharmo na tadaṃśavyāptir atha tadaṃśavyāptir na pakṣadharma iti vyāhataṃ lakṣaṇam iti |
analyzed: sādhāraṇa tayā tad aṃśa vyāpti pratipādanāt tatas yadi pakṣa dharmaḥ na tad aṃśa vyāptiḥ atha tad aṃśa vyāptiḥ na pakṣa dharmaḥ iti vyāhatam lakṣaṇam iti

original: nanu yadi sādhyadharmiṇi sādhanadharmasya sādhyavyāptir na gṛhītā tadā hetor anaikāntikatvam atha gṛhītā kiṃ dṛṣṭānte heto(r anvayena kathañ ca pakṣadha)rmasya tadaṃśavyāptir virudhyate sādhyadharmiṇy api vyāpteḥ pratipannatvāt | sarvapadārthasya kṣaṇikatve sādhye sattvalakṣaṇasya vā hetoḥ ko dṛṣṭāntenvayaḥ |
analyzed: nanu yadi sādhya dharmiṇi sādhana dharmasya sādhya vyāptiḥ na gṛhītā tadā hetoḥ anaikāntika tvam atha gṛhītā kim dṛṣṭānte hetoḥ anvayena katham ca pakṣa dharmasya tad aṃśa vyāptiḥ virudhyate sādhya dharmiṇi api vyāpteḥ pratipanna tvāt sarva padārthasya kṣaṇika tve sādhye sattva lakṣaṇasya vā hetoḥ kaḥ dṛṣṭānta anvayaḥ

original: tasmāt svasādhyapratibandhād dhetus tena vyāptaḥ sidhyati (|) sa ca viparyaye bādhakapramāṇavṛttyā sādhyadharmiṇy api sidhyatīti na kiṃcid anyatrānvayāpekṣayā (|) tat kathaṃ idam āśaṃkitam anyatrānanavṛtter asādhāraṇateti |
analyzed: tasmāt sva sādhya pratibandhāt hetuḥ tena vyāptaḥ sidhyati sa ca viparyaye bādhaka pramāṇa vṛttyā sādhya dharmiṇī api sidhyati iti na kiṃcid anyatra anvaya apekṣayā tat katham idam āśaṃkitam anyatra ānana vṛtteḥ asādhāraṇa tā iti

original: (sattyaṃ yady api sādhyadharmiṇi hetoḥ ) sādhyavyāptim antareṇa nānumānasyotthānan tathāpi dṛṣṭānte sādhyasādhanayoḥ pratibandhagrāhakapramāṇam antareṇa na sādhyadharmiṇy api vyāptiḥ sidhyatīti tadarham idam āśaṃkitaṃ |
analyzed: sattyam yadi api sādhya dharmiṇi hetoḥ sādhya vyāptim antareṇa na anumānasya utthānan tathā api dṛṣṭānte sādhya sādhanayoḥ pratibandha grāhaka pramāṇam antareṇa na sādhya dharmiṇi api vyāptiḥ sidhyati iti tad arham idam āśaṃkitam

original: yat tūcyate kāryahetvapekṣayā svabhāvahetuviśeṣāpekṣayaitadāśaṃkitaṃ tat tu kṣaṇikatvānumāne sattvāpekṣayā | tasya hi vipakṣabādhakapramāṇavṛttyaiva gamakatvā(d iti tad etad uttaratra nirūpayiṣyā)maḥ | tasmāt pūrvagṛhītapratibandhasādhakapramāṇasmṛtaye hetor anyatra vṛttir apekṣaṇīyā |
analyzed: yat tu ucyate kārya hetu apekṣayā svabhāva hetu viśeṣa apekṣayā etat āśaṃkitam tat tu kṣaṇikatva anumāne sattva apekṣayā tasya hi vipakṣa bādhaka pramāṇa vṛttyā eva gamaka tvāt iti tat etat uttaratra nirūpayiṣyāmaḥ tasmāt pūrva gṛhīta pratibandha sādhaka pramāṇa smṛtaye hetoḥ anyatra vṛttiḥ apekṣaṇīyā

original: etat pariharati netyādinā (|) na anyatrānanuvṛttiḥ (|) kutaḥ | ayogo sambandhas tadvyavacchedena viśeṣaṇāt pakṣasya | na hyanyayogavyavacchedenaiva viśeṣaṇam bhavati kintvayogavyavacchedenāpi | yatra dharmiṇi dharmasya sadbhāvaḥ sandihyate tatrāyogavyavacchedasya nyāyaprāptatvāt |
analyzed: etat pariharati na ityādinā na anyatra ananuvṛttiḥ kutas ayogaḥ sambandhaḥ tad vyavacchedena viśeṣaṇāt pakṣasya na hi anya yoga vyavacchedena eva viśeṣaṇam bhavati kintu ayoga vyavacchedena api yatra dharmiṇi dharmasya sadbhāvaḥ sandihyate tatra ayoga vyavacchedasya nyāya prāpta tvāt

original: atra dṛṣṭānto yathā caitro dhanurdhara iti (|) caitre hi dhanurdharatvaṃ sandihyate kim asti nāstīti | tataścaitro dhanurdhara ity ukte pakṣāntaram adhanurddharatvaṃ śroturākāṃkṣopasthāpitaṃ nirākaroty ayogavyavacchedotra nyāyaprāptaḥ |
analyzed: atra dṛṣṭāntaḥ yathā caitraḥ dhanurdharaḥ iti caitre hi dhanurdhara tvam sandihyate kim asti na asti iti tatas caitraḥ dhanurdharaḥ iti ukte pakṣa antaram a dhanurddhara tvam śrotuḥ ākāṃkṣā upasthāpitam nirākaroti nyāya prāptaḥ

original: parābhimatavyavacchedaṃ nirācikīrṣannāha – nānyayogavyavacchedena viśeṣaṇād [p.16] anyatrānanuvṛtterasādhāraṇateti sambandhaḥ | atrāpi dṛṣṭānto yathā (pārtho dhanurddhara iti sāmānyaśabdopyayaṃ) dhanurddharaśabdaḥ prakaraṇasāmarthyādinā prakṛṣṭaguṇavṛttiriha pārthe hi dhanurddharatvaṃ siddhameveti nāyogāśaṅkā |
analyzed: para abhimata vyavacchedam nirācikīrṣan āha na anya yoga vyavacchedena viśeṣaṇāt anyatra ananuvṛtteḥ asādhāraṇa tā iti sambandhaḥ atra api dṛṣṭāntaḥ yathā pārthaḥ dhanurddharaḥ iti sāmānya śabdaḥ upyayam dhanurddhara śabdaḥ prakaraṇa sāmarthya ādinā prakṛṣṭa guṇa vṛttiḥ iha pārthe hi dhanurddhara tvam siddham eva iti na ayoga āśaṅkā

original: tādṛśantu sātiśayaṃ kimanyatrāpyasti nāstīty anyayogaśaṃkāyāṃ śroturyadā pārtho dhanurddhara ity ucyate tadā sātiśayaḥ pārtha eva dhanurddharo nānya iti pratīyate | tenātrānyayogavyavacchedo nyāyaprāptaḥ | tathā kiṃ pakṣestyayaṃ dharmo na (veti saṃśaye pakṣadharma) ity ukte pakṣasya dharma eva nādharmaḥ |
analyzed: tādṛśam tu sa atiśayam kim anyatra api asti na asti iti anya yoga śaṃkāyām śrotuḥ yadā pārthaḥ dhanurddharaḥ iti ucyate tadā sa atiśayaḥ pārthaḥ eva dhanurddharaḥ na anyaḥ iti pratīyate tena atra anya yoga vyavacchedaḥ nyāya prāptaḥ tathā kim pakṣesti ayam dharmaḥ na vā iti saṃśaye pakṣa dharmaḥ iti ukte pakṣasya dharmaḥ eva na adharmaḥ

original: dharmaścāśritatvād viśeṣaṇantenāyogo vyavacchidyate nānyayogaḥ | tadaṃśavyāptyānyayogasya pratipādanena dṛṣṭānte sandehābhāvāt | ākṣepsyāma iti nirdekṣyāmaścaturthe paricchede (4|160) |
analyzed: dharmaḥ ca āśrita tvāt viśeṣaṇa antena ayogaḥ vyavacchidyate na anya yogaḥ tad aṃśa vyāptyā anya yogasya pratipādanena dṛṣṭānte sandeha abhāvāt ākṣepsyāmaḥ iti nirdekṣyāmaḥ caturthe paricchede

original: tadaṃśastaddharma iti tacchabdena pakṣaḥ parāmṛśyate na dharmaḥ ? |) dharmasya dharmāsambhavāt | tasya pakṣasyāṃśastasyaiva sādhyo dharmaḥ | ekadeśe rūḍhoṃśaśabdaḥ kathaṃ dharmaṃ pratipādayatīti cedāha – vakturabhiprāyavaśād iti | na vastubalena śabdānāṃ vācakatvaṃ kintu vakturvivakṣāvaśānna tadekadeśastadaṃśa iti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ (|)
analyzed: tad aṃśaḥ tad dharmaḥ iti tad śabdena pakṣaḥ parāmṛśyate na dharmaḥ dharmasya dharma asambhavāt tasya pakṣasya aṃśaḥ tasya eva sādhyaḥ dharmaḥ eka deśe rūḍhaḥ oṃśa śabdaḥ katham dharmam pratipādayati iti ced āha vaktuḥ abhiprāya vaśāt iti na vastu balena śabdānām vācaka tvam kintu vaktuḥ vivakṣā vaśāt na tad eka deśaḥ tad aṃśaḥ iti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ

original: kiṃ punar evam iti cedāha – pakṣaśabdena samudāyāvacanād iti | yadi pakṣaśabdena samudāyobhihitaḥ syāt tadā dharmadharmisamudāyātmakasya pakṣasyaikadeśo dharmātmakoṅśo bhavati | upacaritena tu pakṣaśabdena dharmyevābhidhīyate (|) tasya caikātmakasya kuta ekadeśaḥ |
analyzed: kim punar evam iti ced āha pakṣa śabdena samudāya avacanāt iti yadi pakṣa śabdena samudāyaḥ abhihitaḥ syāt tadā dharma dharmi samudāya ātmakasya pakṣasya eka deśaḥ dharma ātmaka oṅśaḥ bhavati upacaritena tu pakṣa śabdena dharmī eva abhidhīyate tasya ca eka ātmakasya kutas eka deśaḥ

original: vyāptaṃ padam vyāptir ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | tasya pakṣadharmasya sato vyāptir yo vyāpnoti yaś ca vyāpyate vyāpyavyāpakadharmatayā pratīteḥ | yadā vyāpakadharmatayā vivakṣyate tadā vyāpakasya gamyasya bhāva eveti sambandhaḥ | tatreti saptamyarthapradhānam etan nādhārārthapradhānaṃ dharmāṇāṃ dharmāntaratvābhāvāt |
analyzed: vyāptam padam vyāptiḥ ityādinā vyācaṣṭe tasya pakṣa dharmasya sataḥ vyāptiḥ yaḥ vyāpnoti yaḥ ca vyāpyate vyāpya vyāpaka dharma tayā pratīteḥ yadā vyāpaka dharma tayā vivakṣyate tadā vyāpakasya gamyasya bhāvaḥ eva iti sambandhaḥ tatra iti saptamī artha pradhānam etat na ādhāra artha pradhānam dharmāṇām dharma antara tva abhāvāt

original: tenāyam arthaḥ (|) yatra dharmiṇi vyāpyam asti tatra sarvatra vyāpakasya bhāva eveti vyāpakadharmo vyāptiḥ | na tv evam avadhāryate vyāpakasyaiva tatra bhāva iti | hetvabhāvaprasaṅgāt | avyāpakasyāpi mūrttatvādes tatra bhāvāt | nāpi tatraivety avadhāryate | prayatnānantarīyakatvāder ahetutvāpatteḥ |
analyzed: tena ayam arthaḥ yatra dharmiṇi vyāpyam asti tatra sarvatra vyāpakasya bhāvaḥ eva iti vyāpaka dharmaḥ vyāptiḥ na tu evam avadhāryate vyāpakasya eva tatra bhāvaḥ iti hetu abhāva prasaṅgāt avyāpakasya api mūrtta tva ādeḥ tatra bhāvāt na api tatra eva iti avadhāryate prayatna ānantarīyaka tva ādeḥ ahetu tva āpatteḥ

original: sādhāraṇaś ca hetuḥ syān nityatvasya prameyeṣv eva bhāvāt | yadā tu vyāpyadharmatā [p.17] vyāpter vivakṣitā tadā yatra dharmiṇi vyāpako (')sti tatraiva vyāpyasya bhāvo nānyatra | atrāpi vyāpyasyaiva | tatra bhāva ity avadhāraṇaṃ hetvabhāvaprasakter eva nāśritam avyāpyasyāpi tatra bhāvāt | nāpi vyāpyasya tatra bhāva evety avadhāryate |
analyzed: sādhāraṇaḥ ca hetuḥ syāt nitya tvasya prameyeṣu eva bhāvāt yadā tu vyāpya dharma tā vyāpteḥ vivakṣitā tadā yatra dharmiṇi tatra eva vyāpyasya bhāvaḥ na anyatra atra api vyāpyasya eva tatra bhāvaḥ iti avadhāraṇam hetu abhāva prasakteḥ eva na āśritam avyāpyasya api tatra bhāvāt na api vyāpyasya tatra bhāvaḥ eva iti avadhāryate

original: sapakṣaikadeśavṛtter ahetutvaprāpteḥ | sādhāraṇasya ca hetutvaṃ syāt prameyatvasya nityeṣv avaṃśyam bhāvād iti | vyāpakasya tatra bhāva ity anena cānvaya ākṣipto vyāpyasya vā tatraiva bhāva ity anena vyatireka ākṣiptaḥ |
analyzed: sapakṣa eka deśa vṛtteḥ ahetu tva prāpteḥ sādhāraṇasya ca hetu tvam syāt prameya tvasya nityeṣu bhāvāt iti vyāpakasya tatra bhāvaḥ iti anena ca anvayaḥ ākṣiptaḥ vyāpyasya vā tatra eva bhāvaḥ iti anena vyatirekaḥ ākṣiptaḥ

original: yad vā vyāpter vyāpyavyāpakadharmmasamvarṇṇanaṃ niyatāniyatatvakhyāpanārthaṃ | tena vyāpto hetur bhavati na tu vyāpako 'niyatatvāt |
analyzed: yat vā vyāpteḥ vyāpya vyāpaka dharmma samvarṇṇanam niyata aniyata tva khyāpana artham tena vyāptaḥ hetuḥ bhavati na tu vyāpakaḥ niyata tvāt

original: nanu yo dharmo vyāpyam antareṇa bhavati sa kathaṃ vyāpako vyāpyāsambandhenāvyāpakatvāt |
analyzed: nanu yaḥ dharmaḥ vyāpyam antareṇa bhavati sa katham vyāpakaḥ vyāpya asambandhena a vyāpaka tvāt

original: satyaṃ | kevalan dharmayoḥ sāmānyena vyāpyavyāpakabhāvo niścīyate | yac cānityatvasāmānyaṃ prayatnānantarīyakatvavyāpakaṃ niścitan tadaprayatnānantarīyake (')pi dṛśyata iti vyāpako 'niyata ucyate | atha prayatnānantarīyakasvabhāvam evānityatvaṃ niścetum pāryate tadānayoḥ parasparaṃ vyāpyatvam iti vyāpta eva hetur bhavati |
analyzed: dharmayoḥ sāmānyena vyāpya vyāpaka bhāvaḥ niścīyate yat ca anitya tva sāmānyam prayatna ānantarīyaka tva vyāpakam tat aprayatna ānantarīyake dṛśyate iti vyāpakaḥ niyataḥ ucyate atha prayatna ānantarīyaka svabhāvam eva anitya tvam niścetum pāryate tadā anayoḥ parasparam vyāpya tvam iti vyāptaḥ eva hetuḥ bhavati

original: kathan tarhy avyabhicāra ity āha – taduptatter ity anumeyābhyāṃ svabhāvakāraṇābhyāṃ pāramparyeṇotpatteḥ | tadavyabhicāriṇāv ity anumeyāvyabhicāriṇau | iti hetoḥ pramāṇaṃ pratyakṣavat |

original: tena yad ucyate 'viddhakarṇena – anadhigatārthaparicchittiḥ pramāṇam. ato nānumānam pramāṇam, arthaparicchedakatvābhāvād iti tadapāstaṃ | yataḥ sarva eva prekṣāvān pravṛttikāmaḥ pramāṇam anveṣate pravṛttiviṣayārthopadarśakatvena pravṛttiviṣayaś cārtho 'rthakriyāsamartha eva |
analyzed: tena yat ucyate viddhakarṇena anadhigata artha paricchittiḥ pramāṇam atas na anumānam pramāṇam artha paricchedaka tva abhāvāt iti tat apāstam yatas sarvaḥ eva prekṣāvān pravṛtti kāmaḥ pramāṇam anveṣate pravṛtti viṣaya artha upadarśaka tvena pravṛtti viṣayaḥ ca arthaḥ rthakriyā samarthaḥ eva

original: na cānāgataṃ pravṛttisādhyārthakriyā sāmarthyam vastunaḥ pratyakṣam paricchinattīty uktamataḥ katham asyārthaparicchedamātrātprāmāṇyaṃ | tasmāt svaviṣaye tadutpattyā pratyakṣaṃ yanmayā pūrvapratipannaṃ prabandhenārthakriyākāri tad evedam iti niścayaṃ kurvat pravarttakatvāt pramāṇantathānumānam api |
analyzed: na ca anāgatam pravṛtti sādhya arthakriyā sāmarthyam vastunaḥ pratyakṣam paricchinatti iti uktam atas katham asya artha pariccheda mātrāt prāmāṇyam tasmāt sva viṣaye tad utpattyā pratyakṣam yat mayā pūrva pratipannam prabandhena artha kriyā kāri tat eva idam iti niścayam kurvat pravarttaka tvāt pramāṇam tathā anumānam api

original: pratyakṣasyāpītyādinā vyāptim āha – arthāvyabhicāra eveti | pūrvam abhimatārthakāritvena niścitasyārthasya sambhave sati bhāva eva pratyakṣasya prāmāṇyam anyathā tadabhāve arthābhāve bhāvinaḥ pratyakṣasya tadvipralambhān niścitārthāsamvādāt | etad uktam bhavati | yadārthakriyāsamartham vastu pratyakṣaṃ na paricchinatti |
analyzed: pratyakṣasya api ityādinā vyāptim āha artha avyabhicāre eva iti pūrvam abhimata artha kāri tvena niścitasya arthasya sambhave sati bhāvaḥ eva pratyakṣasya prāmāṇyam anyathā tad abhāve artha abhāve bhāvinaḥ pratyakṣasya tad vipralambhāt niścita artha asamvādāt etat uktam bhavati yadā artha kriyā samartham vastu pratyakṣam na paricchinatti

original: yadi ca tathābhūtam api vastu vyabhicaret pramāṇam api na syāt | avyabhicāraś cānyasya ko (')nyas tadutpatter ity anyasyārthāntarabhūtasya yo (')nyena sahāvyabhicāraḥ sa tadutpatteḥ ko (')nyo naivānyaḥ | tadutpattir evāvyabhicāra ity arthaḥ |
analyzed: yadi ca tathābhūtam api vastu vyabhicaret pramāṇam api na syāt avyabhicāraḥ ca anyasya kaḥ nyaḥ tad utpatteḥ iti anyasya artha antara bhūtasya yaḥ nyena saha avyabhicāraḥ sa tad utpatteḥ kaḥ nyaḥ na eva anyaḥ tad utpattiḥ eva avyabhicāraḥ iti arthaḥ

original: kasmād (|) anāyattarūpāṇām apratibaddhasvabhāvānāṃ sahabhāvaniyamābhāvād avyabhicāraniyamābhāvāt | tasmād arthakriyākāritvena niścitād arthād utpatter eva pratyakṣasyāvyabhicāra iti prāmāṇyan tac cānumāne (')py astīti samaṃ dvayam iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: kasmāt anāyatta rūpāṇām apratibaddha svabhāvānām sahabhāva niyama abhāvāt avyabhicāra niyama abhāvāt tasmāt artha kriyā kāri tvena niścitāt arthāt utpatteḥ eva pratyakṣasya avyabhicāraḥ iti tat ca anumāne pi asti iti samam dvayam iti bhāvaḥ

original: etenaitad (')pi nirasta – pramāṇasyāgauṇatvād anumānād arthaniścayo durlabha iti. yady agauṇatvam anupacaritatvam ucyate, tadānumānam apy anupacaritam evāskhaladbuddhirūpatvāt.
analyzed: pramāṇasya agauṇa tvāt anumānāt artha niścayaḥ durlabhaḥ iti yadi agauṇa tvam anupacarita tvam ucyate tadā anumānam api anupacaritam eva askhalat buddhi rūpatvāt

original: atha dharmadharmisamudāyasya sādhyatve hetoḥ pakṣadharmatvamanvayo vā na sambhavati tena pakṣadharmatvaprasiddhyarthaṃ dharmiṇaḥ sādhyatvam upacaritavyamanvayasiddhyarthañ ca dharmasyetyevam upacaritaviṣayatvād anumānam upacaritaṃ |
analyzed: atha dharma dharmi samudāyasya sādhya tve hetoḥ pakṣa dharma tvam anvayaḥ vā na sambhavati tena pakṣa dharma tva prasiddhi artham dharmiṇaḥ sādhya tvam upacaritavyam anvaya siddhi artham ca dharmasya iti evam upacarita viṣaya tvāt anumānam upacaritam

original: [p.26] tad ayuktaṃ yato loke dhūmamātram agnimātravyāptaṃ yatra dharmiṇi dṛśyate tatraivāgnipratītir bhavatīti kasyātropacāra evaṃ ca samudāyasyāpi sādhaytvaṃ sidhyati | yad āha – "kevala eva dharmo dharmiṇi sādhyastatheṣṭasamudāyasya siddhiḥ kṛtā bhavatī"ti (|) na cānumānaviṣaye sādhyaśabdopacāre saty anumānam upacaritan nāma |
analyzed: tat ayuktam yatas loke dhūma mātram agni mātra vyāptam yatra dharmiṇi dṛśyate tatra eva agni pratītiḥ bhavati iti kasya atra upacāraḥ evam ca samudāyasya api sādhay tvam sidhyati yat āha kevalaḥ eva dharmaḥ dharmiṇi sādhyaḥ tathā iṣṭa samudāyasya siddhiḥ kṛtā bhavati iti na ca anumāna viṣaye sādhya śabda upacāre sati anumānam upacaritat nāma

original: atha pramāṇasyāgauṇatvād abhrāntatvād anumānasya tu bhrāntatvād aprāmāṇyam ity ucyate |

original: tad ayuktaṃ (|) bhrāntasyāpy agnyanumānasya tadutpattyā bāhyāgnyadhyavasāyena loke prāmāṇyadarśanāt pratyakṣavat | atha pratyakṣam api pramāṇan neṣyate tadā lokapratītibādhā | pratyakṣānumānayoḥ pramāṇayor lokapratītatvāt |
analyzed: tat ayuktam bhrāntasya api agni anumānasya tad utpattyā bāhya agni adhyavasāyena loke prāmāṇya darśanāt pratyakṣa vat atha pratyakṣam api pramāṇat na iṣyate tadā loka pratīti bādhā pratyakṣa anumānayoḥ pramāṇayoḥ loka pratīta tvāt

original: atha naiva pratyakṣānumānayoḥ pramāṇatvaṃ pratiṣidhyate | kin tu liṅgantrilakṣaṇaṃ caturlakṣaṇaṃ vā na kenacit pramāṇena siddham iti paryanuyoge yady anumānam ucyate sādhakaṃ | punastatrāpi sa eva paryanuyoga ity evaṃ sarvatra paryanuyogaparāṇy eva sūtrāṇi | tathā ca sūtraṃ (|)
analyzed: atha nā eva pratyakṣa anumānayoḥ pramāṇa tvam pratiṣidhyate kin tu liṅgam tri lakṣaṇam catur lakṣaṇam vā na kenacid pramāṇena siddham iti paryanuyoge yadi anumānam ucyate sādhakam punar tatra api saḥ eva paryanuyogaḥ iti evam sarvatra paryanuyoga parāṇi eva sūtrāṇi tathā ca sūtram

original: yaḥ sarvathā gamyagamakabhāvaprasaṅga ācārya dignāgenākṣiptaṃ paraṃ prati tad ihāpi kārya(hetau āśaṅkate yadītyādinā)2* sādhyād utpatteḥ kāraṇāt kāryaṅ gamakaṅ kāraṇasyety [p.27] adhyāhāraḥ sarvathā gamyagamakabhāvaḥ prāptaḥ | agneḥ sāmānyadharmavad viśeṣadharmā api tārṇapārṇṇādayo gamyāḥ syuḥ |
analyzed: yaḥ sarvathā gamya gamaka bhāva prasaṅgaḥ ācārya dignāgena ākṣiptam param prati tat iha api kārya hetau āśaṅkate yadi ityādinā sādhyāt utpatteḥ kāraṇāt kāryam gamakam kāraṇasya iti adhyāhāraḥ sarvathā gamya gamaka bhāvaḥ prāptaḥ agneḥ sāmānya dharma vat viśeṣa dharmāḥ api tārṇa pārṇṇa ādayaḥ gamyāḥ syuḥ

original: dhūmasyāpi viśeṣadharmavad dravyatvapārthivatvādayopi sāmānyadharmā gamakā bhaveyuḥ | kutaḥ | sarvathā janyajanakabhāvāt (|) tathā hi yathāgnir agnitvadravyatvasattvādibhiḥ (sāmānyadharmmair janakaḥ tathā tārṇṇapārṇṇādibhi)1*r viśeṣair api |
analyzed: dhūmasya api viśeṣa dharma vat dravya tva pārthiva tva ādayaḥ api sāmānya dharmāḥ gamakāḥ bhaveyuḥ kutas sarvathā janya janaka bhāvāt tathā hi yathā agniḥ agni tva dravya tva sattva ādibhiḥ sāmānya dharmaiḥ janakaḥ tathā tārṇṇa pārṇṇa ādibhiḥ viśeṣaiḥ api

original: yathā ca dhūmo dhūmatvapāṇḍutvādibhiḥ svaniyatair viśeṣadharmair yukto janyas tathā sāmānyadharmair api sattvadravyatvādibhis tataś ca yathānayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvas tathaiva gamyagamakabhāvaḥ syād ity ata āha –
analyzed: yathā ca dhūmaḥ dhūma tva pāṇḍu tva ādibhiḥ sva niyataiḥ viśeṣa dharmaiḥ yuktaḥ janyaḥ tathā sāmānya dharmaiḥ api sattva dravya tva ādibhiḥ tatas ca yathā anayoḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ tathā eva gamya gamaka bhāvaḥ syāt iti atas āha

original: netyādi | na sarvathā janyajanakabhāvas tataś ca kutas tathā gamyagamakabhāvaḥ syāt | kasmād iti cet | tadabhāve teṣān tārṇṇa(pārṇṇatvādīnāṃ viśeṣadharmmāṇām abhāve)1* bhavato dhūmamātrasya tebhya eva viśeṣadharmebhyo bhavatīty evamātmanas tadutpattiniyamasyābhāvāt |
analyzed: na ityādi na sarvathā janya janaka bhāvaḥ tatas ca kutas tathā gamya gamaka bhāvaḥ syāt kasmāt iti ced tad abhāve teṣām tārṇṇa pārṇṇa tva ādīnām viśeṣa dharmmāṇām abhāve bhavataḥ dhūma mātrasya tebhyaḥ eva viśeṣa dharmebhyaḥ bhavati iti evam ātmanaḥ tad utpatti niyamasya abhāvāt

original: tathā tadabhāve 'gnyabhāve bhavato dravyatvādeḥ sāmānyadharmasyāgner evāyaṃ bhavatīty evaṃrūpasya tadutpattiniyamasyābhāvāt | kutaḥ sarvathā janyajanakabhāvo yataḥ sarvathā gamyagamakabhāvaḥ syāt ||
analyzed: tathā tad abhāve gni abhāve bhavataḥ dravya tva ādeḥ sāmānya dharmasya agneḥ eva ayam bhavati iti evaṃrūpasya tad utpatti niyamasya abhāvāt kutas sarvathā janya janaka bhāvaḥ yatas sarvathā gamya gamaka bhāvaḥ syāt

original: yata evaṃ tasmāt kāryaṃ dhūmādikaṃ svabhāvair yā(vadbhir dhūmatvādibhiḥ svagatai)1*r itthaṃbhūtalakṣaṇā tṛtīyā | avinābhāvi | vinā na bhavati | kvāvinābhāvi (|) kāraṇe | kāraṇaviṣaye | yad vā kāraṇe ity ādhārasaptamī | kāraṇasthaiḥ svabhāvair yāvadbhir agnitvadravyatvādibhir avinābhāvi |
analyzed: yatas evam tasmāt kāryam dhūma ādikam svabhāvaiḥ yāvadbhiḥ dhūma tva ādibhiḥ svagataiḥ itthaṃbhūta lakṣaṇā tṛtīyā avinābhāvi vinā na bhavati kva avinābhāvi kāraṇe kāraṇa viṣaye yat vā kāraṇe iti ādhāra saptamī kāraṇa sthaiḥ svabhāvaiḥ yāvadbhiḥ agni tva dravya tva ādibhiḥ avinābhāvi

original: teṣāṃ kāraṇagatānāṃ sāmānyadharmāṇāṃ hetuḥ kāryaṃ gamakam ity arthaḥ | kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) tatkāryatvaniyamāt | teṣām eva kāraṇagatānāṃ sāmānyadharmāṇān tatkāryam ity e(vaṃrūpasya niya)1*masya sadbhāvāt | na hi tatsāmānyadharmāt kadācid api kāryaṃ vyabhicarati | evaṃ tāvat kāraṇagatāḥ sāmānyadhrmā gamyā ity ākhyātaṃ |
analyzed: teṣām kāraṇa gatānām sāmānya dharmāṇām hetuḥ kāryam gamakam iti arthaḥ kiṅkāraṇam tad kārya tva niyamāt teṣām eva kāraṇa gatānām sāmānya dharmāṇām tat kāryam iti evaṃrūpasya niyamasya sadbhāvāt na hi tad sāmānya dharmāt kadācid api kāryam vyabhicarati evam tāvat kāraṇa gatāḥ sāmānya dhrmāḥ gamyāḥ iti ākhyātam

original: kāryagatās tu viśeṣadharmā gamakā iti darśayann āha – tair evetyādi | kāryam api tair eva dharmaiḥ svagataiḥ kāraṇagatānāṃ dharmāṇāṃ gamakāḥ | ye (')rthāntarāsambhavino dhūmatvapāṇḍutvādayo [p.28] viśeṣarūpās taiḥ kāraṇagataiḥ sāmānyadharmair vinā na bhavanti | atrāpi tatkāryatvaniyamād ity apekṣyate |
analyzed: kārya gatāḥ tu viśeṣa dharmāḥ gamakāḥ iti darśayan āha taiḥ eva ityādi kāryam api taiḥ eva dharmaiḥ svagataiḥ kāraṇa gatānām dharmāṇām gamakāḥ ye ṛtha antara asambhavinaḥ dhūma tva pāṇḍu tva ādayaḥ viśeṣa rūpāḥ taiḥ kāraṇa gataiḥ sāmānya dharmaiḥ vinā na bhavanti atra api tad kāryatva niyamāt iti apekṣyate

original: teṣām eva kāryagatānāṃ viśeṣadharmāṇāṃ kāraṇagatasāmānyadharmāpekṣayā kāryatvaniyamāt |
analyzed: teṣām eva kārya gatānām viśeṣa dharmāṇām kāraṇa gata sāmānya dharma apekṣayā kārya tva niyamāt

original: yadi sāmānyadharmāṇāṃ kāraṇagatānāṃ kāryagatair viśeṣadharmair evāvinābhāvād gamyagamakabhāvas tadāṃśena janyajanakabhāvaḥ syāt | agneḥ sāmānyadharmā eva janakāḥ (|) dhūmasya ca viśeṣadharmā eva janyāḥ syuḥ | sarvathā ca janyajanakabhāvobhimata ity abhyupagamavirodhaḥ | etat pariharati (|) nāṃśena janyajanakabhāvaprasaṅgaḥ |
analyzed: yadi sāmānya dharmāṇām kāraṇa gatānām kārya gataiḥ viśeṣa dharmaiḥ eva avinābhāvāt gamya gamaka bhāvaḥ tadā aṃśena janya janaka bhāvaḥ syāt agneḥ sāmānya dharmāḥ eva janakāḥ dhūmasya ca viśeṣa dharmāḥ eva janyāḥ syuḥ sarvathā ca janya janaka bhāvaḥ abhimataḥ iti abhyupagama virodhaḥ etat pariharati na aṃśena janya janaka bhāva prasaṅgaḥ

original: niraṃśatvena vastunaḥ sarvathā janyajanakatvābhyupagamāt | gamyagamakabhāvasyāpi sarvathābhimatatvāt | tad āha – tajjanyetyādi | yadi hi kāryasya taiḥ kāraṇagatair viśeṣadharmair janyo yo viśeṣaḥ sa grahītuṃ śakyate jñāpakahetvadhikārāt | tadā tajjanyaviśeṣagrahaṇe 'bhimatatvāt kāraṇagataviśeṣadharmāṇāṃ gamyatvasya |
analyzed: niraṃśa tvena vastunaḥ sarvathā janya janaka tva abhyupagamāt gamya gamaka bhāvasya api sarvathā abhimata tvāt tat āha tad janya ityādi yadi hi kāryasya taiḥ kāraṇa gataiḥ viśeṣa dharmaiḥ janyaḥ yaḥ viśeṣaḥ sa grahītum śakyate jñāpaka hetu adhikārāt tadā tad janya viśeṣa grahaṇe bhimata tvāt kāraṇa gata viśeṣa dharmāṇām gamya tvasya

original: tathā hy agurudhūmagrahaṇe bhavaty eva tadagner anumānaṃ | tathā liṅgaviśeṣo liṅgam eva viśeṣo dhūmalakṣaṇaḥ sa upādhir viśeṣaṇaṃ yeṣāṃ dravyatvādīnān teṣāṃ grahaṇe 'bhimatatvād gamakatvasya | na hi dhūmena viśeṣitā dravyatvādayo 'gniṃ vyabhicaranti |
analyzed: tathā hi aguru dhūma grahaṇe bhavati eva tad agneḥ anumānam tathā liṅga viśeṣaḥ liṅgam eva viśeṣaḥ dhūma lakṣaṇaḥ saḥ upādhiḥ viśeṣaṇam yeṣām dravya tva ādīnām teṣām grahaṇe bhimata tvāt gamaka tvasya na hi dhūmena viśeṣitāḥ dravya tva ādayaḥ gnim vyabhicaranti

original: nanu dhūma eva tatra gamako na tu tadviśiṣṭā dravyatvādayaḥ | yathā kṛtakatve sati prameyatvād ity atra kṛtakatvam eva gamakaṃ na prameyatvaṃ |
analyzed: nanu dhūmaḥ eva tatra gamakaḥ na tu tad viśiṣṭāḥ dravya tva ādayaḥ yathā kṛtaka tve sati prameya tvāt iti atra kṛtaka tvam eva gamakam na prameya tvam

original: satyam etad | avyabhicāramātrapradarśanārthan tv evam abhidhānam ity eke | anyas tv āha – na dhūmasya vyabhicārād iha sāmānyopādānam, kiṃ tarhi sarveṣāṃ pratipattṝṇāṃ dṛṣṭe vastuni sāmānyākāre pratipattir bhavati paścād viśeṣāvasāyaḥ. tatra ca yad upāttaṃ sāmānyam, tad aparityaktam eva.
analyzed: satyam etat avyabhicāra mātra pradarśana arthan tu evam abhidhānam iti eke anyaḥ tu āha na dhūmasya vyabhicārāt iha sāmānya upādānam kim tarhi sarveṣām pratipattṝṇām dṛṣṭe vastuni sāmānya ākāre pratipattiḥ bhavati paścāt viśeṣa avasāyaḥ tatra ca yat upāttam sāmānyam tat aparityaktam eva

original: tasmāt pratipattur adhyavasāyavaśād viśeṣopahitaṃ sāmānyaṅ gamakam bhavati na viśeṣasya vyabhicārād iti |
analyzed: tasmāt pratipattuḥ adhyavasāya vaśāt viśeṣa upahitam sāmānyam gamakam bhavati na viśeṣasya vyabhicārāt iti

original: yuktam etat | kevalaṃ yady eṣa niyamaḥ sāmānyapratipattipurassaraiva viśeṣapratipattiḥ (|) kathan tarhi dhūmamātrasya dravyatvādirahitasya pratītiḥ | pūrvoktaṃ ca codyan tadavastham eva | tasmād idam atra sādhu (|) liṅgaviśeṣasya sāmānyaviśeṣaṇatvenaivopādānā(d) ahetutvaṃ hetutvopādāne hi hetutvaṃ syān nānyathā |
analyzed: yuktam etat kevalam yadi eṣa niyamaḥ sāmānya pratipatti purassarā eva viśeṣa pratipattiḥ kathan tarhi dhūma mātrasya dravya tva ādi rahitasya pratītiḥ pūrva uktam ca codyan tad avastham eva tasmāt idam atra sādhu liṅga viśeṣasya sāmānya viśeṣaṇa tvena eva upādānāt ahetu tvam hetu tva upādāne hi hetu tvam syāt na anyathā

original: kadā tarhi liṅgagatānāṃ sāmānyadharmāṇām agamakatvam ity āha – aviśiṣṭetyādi | yadā dravyatvādīny aviśiṣṭāni vivakṣitāni tadā teṣāṃ vyabhicārād [p.29] gamakatvan neṣyate |
analyzed: kadā tarhi liṅga gatānām sāmānya dharmāṇām agamaka tvam iti āha aviśiṣṭa ityādi yadā dravya tva ādīni aviśiṣṭāni vivakṣitāni tadā teṣām vyabhicārāt na iṣyate

original: svabhāvahetum adhikṛtyāha – svabhāva ityādi | hetur iti vartata iti teṣāṃ hetur ity ataḥ | svabhāve sādhye kimbhūte bhāvamātrānurodhini hetusadbhāvamātrānurodhini (bhāvo hetuḥ)1* svabhāvo hetuḥ | mātragrahaṇam arthāntarānapekṣāsandarśanārthaṃ | kasmāt tanmātrānurodhiny eva svabhāvo hetur ity āha – tādātmyaṃ hy arthasya tanmātrānurodhiny eveti |
analyzed: svabhāva hetum adhikṛtya āha svabhāvaḥ ityādi hetuḥ iti vartate iti teṣām hetuḥ iti atas svabhāve sādhye kimbhūte bhāva mātra anurodhini hetu sadbhāva mātra anurodhini bhāvaḥ hetuḥ svabhāvaḥ hetuḥ mātra grahaṇam artha antara anapekṣā sandarśana artham kasmāt tad mātra anurodhinī eva svabhāvaḥ hetuḥ iti āha tādātmyam hi arthasya tad mātra anurodhinī eva iti

original: yo (')sāv arthasya sādhanasyātmā tadbhāviny eva | nānyāyatte | na kāraṇāntarapratibaddhe paścādbhāvini tādātmyaṃ | kasmād iti ced āha – tadbhāva ityādi | tasya hetor bhāve abhūtasya [Sāṃkṛtyāyana:bhāvi(ni) bhūtasya] kāra(ṇāntarāyattasya dharmasya paścād yo bhā)1*vas tasya niyamābhāvāt |
analyzed: arthasya sādhanasya ātmā tad bhāvini eva na anya āyatte na kāraṇa antara pratibaddhe paścāt bhāvini tādātmyam kasmāt iti ced āha tad bhāve ityādi tasya hetoḥ bhāve abhūtasya bhūtasya kāraṇa antara āyattasya dharmasya paścāt yaḥ bhāvaḥ tasya niyama abhāvāt

original: na hi kāraṇāntarapratibaddhena paścād bhāvināvaśyaṃ bhavitavyaṃ | kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) kāraṇānāṃ kāryavyabhicārāt | sambhavatpratibandhatvāt kāraṇānāṃ kutas tebhyo 'vaśyam bhāvaḥ kāryasya ||
analyzed: na hi kāraṇa antara pratibaddhena paścāt bhāvinā avaśyam bhavitavyam kiṅkāraṇam kāraṇānām kārya vyabhicārāt sambhavat pratibandha tvāt kāraṇānām kutas tebhyaḥ vaśyam bhāvaḥ kāryasya

original: nanu ca sādhyasvabhāvatā sādhanasya na kenacid iṣṭaṃ tatkatham ucyate tadbhāvamātrānurodhiny eva tādātmyam iti | evam manyate – vyati(riktāv api kṛtakatvānityatvākhyau)1* dharmāv apy upagacchadbhir avaśyam abhūtvā bhavanaṃ bhūtvā cābhavanam abhyupagantavyam anyathātmāder iva kṛtakatvānityatve paṭāder na syātāṃ |
analyzed: nanu ca sādhya svabhāva tā sādhanasya na kenacid iṣṭam tat katham ucyate tad bhāva mātra anurodhinī eva tādātmyam iti evam manyate vyatiriktau api kṛtaka tva anitya tva ākhyau dharmau api upagacchadbhiḥ avaśyam a bhūtvā bhavanam bhūtvā ca abhavanam abhyupagantavyam anyathā ātma ādeḥ iva kṛtaka tva anitya tve paṭa ādeḥ na syātām

original: tasmād yad evābhūtvā bhavanam bhāvasya tad eva kṛtakatvaṃ yad eva ca bhūtvā'bhavanam anavasthāyitvan tad evānityatvam astu kim anyena sāmānyena kalpiteneti | anupala .......... ity āha –
analyzed: tasmāt yat eva a bhūtvā bhavanam bhāvasya tat eva kṛtaka tvam yat eva ca bhūtvā bhavanam tat eva anitya tvam astu kim anyena sāmānyena kalpitena iti anupalaḥ iti āha

original: [p.30]  apravṛ(ttir ityādi | keṣāmapravṛttiḥ pramā)1*ṇānām (|) vahuvacanaṃ vyaktibhedena pramāṇānām bahutvāt | āgamāpekṣa.........2*
analyzed: apravṛttiḥ ityādi keṣām apravṛttiḥ pramāṇānām vahuvacanam vyakti bhedena pramāṇānām bahu tvāt āgama apekṣa

original: fn. 1*: In the margin. 2*: 12th leaf is missing.
analyzed: ro-0 fl-1 fl-2 fl-3 fl-4 fl-5 fl-6 fl-7 fl-8 fl-9 fl-10 fl-11 fl-12 fl-13

original: Ÿ Ÿ Ÿ
analyzed: ś ś ś

original: sidhyatīty ucyata iti |
analyzed: sidhyati iti ucyate iti

original: evam manyate | jñānajñeyayor bādhā bodharūpatvena viśeṣād bodharūpaṃ pratyakṣādikaṃ pramāṇaṃ svata eva sidhyati (|) jñeyan tu ghaṭādikaṃ jaḍarūpatvāt pramāṇam apekṣate | jñānajñeyābhāvayos tu nīrūpatvena viśeṣābhāvāt kathaṃ jñā(nābhāvasya svataḥsiddhir jñeyābhāvasya ca)3* jñānābhāvāt siddhir ucyate | atha jñānābhāvo nānyena sidhyati |
analyzed: evam manyate jñāna jñeyayoḥ bādhā bodha rūpa tvena viśeṣāt bodha rūpam pratyakṣa ādikam pramāṇam svatas eva sidhyati jñeyan tu ghaṭa ādikam jaḍa rūpa tvāt pramāṇam apekṣate jñāna jñeya abhāvayoḥ tu nīrūpa tvena viśeṣa abhāvāt katham jñāna abhāvasya svatas siddhiḥ jñeya abhāvasya ca jñāna abhāvāt siddhiḥ ucyate atha jñāna abhāvaḥ na anyena sidhyati

original: tathā hi jñānānāṃ svasamviditarūpatvenaikajñānasaṃsargitvābhāvāt | kevalaṃ yadi svasantāne jñānaṃ syād upalabhyetānupalambhād asad eva tad iti svata eva jñānābhāvaḥ siddha iṣyate |
analyzed: tathā hi jñānānām sva samvidita rūpa tvena eka jñāna saṃsargi tva abhāvāt kevalam yadi sva santāne jñānam syāt upalabhyeta anupalambhāt asat eva tat iti svatas eva jñāna abhāvaḥ siddhaḥ iṣyate

original: fn. 3*: none
analyzed: ns

original: tathā sattābhāvo (')pi siddhaḥ syāt | tatrāpi hi yadi sattā syād upalabhyetānupa(lambhān nāstīti niścīyate tataś cā)3*pārthikānupalabdhir abhāvasiddhau | vijñānaṃ vānyavastunīti pakṣaṃ dūṣayitum āha – athetyādi | anyasya ghaṭādiviviktasya bhūtalasyopalabdhyā ghaṭānupalabdhisiddhir iti pratyakṣasiddhānupalabdhiḥ |
analyzed: tathā sattā bhāvaḥ pi siddhaḥ syāt tatra api hi yadi sattā syāt upalabhyeta anupalambhāt na asti iti niścīyate tatas ca apārthikā anupalabdhiḥ abhāva siddhau vijñānam vā anya vastuni iti pakṣam dūṣayitum āha atha ityādi anyasya ghaṭa ādi viviktasya bhū talasya upalabdhyā ghaṭa anupalabdhi siddhiḥ iti pratyakṣa siddha anupalabdhiḥ

original: etad uktam bhavati | ghaṭagrāhakatvasya bhūtalagrāhakasya caikajñānasaṃsargitvād yadā bhūtalagrāhakam eva tajjñānam bhavati | tadā ghaṭāgrāhakatvābhāvaṃ (niścāyayatīti pratītipra)tyakṣasiddhaiva ghaṭānupalabdhiḥ |
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati ghaṭa grāhaka tvasya bhū tala grāhakasya ca eka jñāna saṃsargi tvāt yadā bhū tala grāhakam eva tat jñānam bhavati tadā ghaṭa a grāhaka tva abhāvam niścāyayati iti pratīti pratyakṣa siddhā eva ghaṭa anupalabdhiḥ

original: [p.31]  tathānyasattayāsattā kin na sidhyati | tathety anupalabdhivat | dvayor api ghaṭapradeśayor ekajñānasaṃsargitvād ity abhiprāyaḥ | anyasya ghaṭaviviktasya bhūtalādeḥ sattayā siddhyā niṣedhyasyārthasya sattā kin na sidhyati |
analyzed: tathā anya sattayā asattā kin na sidhyati tathā iti anupalabdhi vat dvayoḥ api ghaṭa pradeśayoḥ eka jñāna saṃsargi tvāt iti abhiprāyaḥ anyasya ghaṭa viviktasya bhū tala ādeḥ sattayā siddhyā niṣedhyasya arthasya sattā kin na sidhyati

original: nanu bhāvanivṛttirūpo 'bhāvaḥ sa kathaṃ pratyakṣasiddha ity ucyate |
analyzed: nanu bhāva nivṛtti rūpaḥ bhāvaḥ sa katham pratyakṣa siddhaḥ iti ucyate

original: evam manyate | abhāvo nāma nāsty eva kevalaṃ mūḍhasya bhāvaviṣayam eva pratyakṣam anyābhāvaṃ vyavahārayati | tena yad uktam arthāpattyā'bhāvaḥ pratīyata iti tad ayuktaṃ | yato na tāvad ghaṭādīnām anyonyābhāvo 'bhinnaḥ ghṭavināśe paṭādyutpattiprasaṅgāt | paṭādyabhāvasya vinaṣṭatvāt | atha bhinno 'bhāvas tadā ghaṭādīnāṃ parasparaṃ bhedo na syāt |
analyzed: evam manyate abhāvaḥ nāma na asti eva kevalam mūḍhasya bhāva viṣayam eva pratyakṣam anya abhāvam vyavahārayati tena yat uktam arthāpattyā abhāvaḥ pratīyate iti tat ayuktam yatas na tāvat ghaṭa ādīnām anyonya abhāvaḥ bhinnaḥ ghṭa vināśe paṭa ādi utpatti prasaṅgāt paṭa ādi abhāvasya vinaṣṭa tvāt atha bhinnaḥ bhāvaḥ tadā ghaṭa ādīnām parasparam bhedaḥ na syāt

original: yadā hi ghaṭābhāvarūpaḥ paṭo na bhavati tadā paṭo ghaṭa eva syāt | yathā vā ghaṭasya paṭābhāvād bhinnatvād ghaṭarūpatā tathā paṭāder api syāt | ghaṭābhāvād bhinnatvād eva |
analyzed: yadā hi ghaṭa abhāva rūpaḥ paṭaḥ na bhavati tadā paṭaḥ ghaṭaḥ eva syāt yathā vā ghaṭasya paṭa abhāvāt bhinna tvāt ghaṭa rūpa tā tathā paṭa ādeḥ api syāt ghaṭa abhāvāt bhinna tvāt eva

original: nāpy eṣāṃ parasparābhinnānām abhāve na bhedaḥ śakyate karttuṃ | tasya bhinnābhinnabhedakaraṇe 'kiṃcitkaratvāt | na cābhinnānām anyonyābhāvaḥ sambhavati | nāpi parasparabhinnānām abhāvena bhedaḥ kriyate svahetubhya eva bhinnānām utpatteḥ | nāpi bhedavyavahāraḥ kriyate |
analyzed: nā api eṣām paraspara abhinnānām abhāve na bhedaḥ śakyate karttum tasya bhinna abhinna bheda karaṇe kiṃcitkara tvāt na ca abhinnānām anyonya abhāvaḥ sambhavati nā api paraspara bhinnānām abhāvena bhedaḥ kriyate sva hetubhyaḥ eva bhinnānām utpatteḥ nā api bheda vyavahāraḥ kriyate

original: yato bhāvānām ātmīyātmīya (?) rūpeṇotpattir eva svato bhedaḥ (|) sa ca pratyakṣapratibhāsanād eva bhedavyavahārahetuḥ |
analyzed: yatas bhāvānām rūpeṇa utpattiḥ eva svatas bhedaḥ sa ca pratyakṣa pratibhāsanāt eva bheda vyavahāra hetuḥ

original: tena yad ucyate "vastvasaṃkarasiddhiś cābhāvapramāṇāśrite"ti tad apāstaṃ kiñca (|) bhāvābhāvayor bhedo nābhāvanibandhano 'navasthāprasaṅgāt | atha svarūpeṇa bhedas tathābhāvānām api sa syād iti kim abhāvena kalpitena (|) nāpi prāgabhāvābhāve kāryasyānāditvaṃ prasajyate | hetvabhāvenānutpatteḥ |
analyzed: tena yat ucyate vastu asaṃkara siddhiḥ ca abhāva pramāṇa āśritā iti tat apāstam kiñca bhāva abhāvayoḥ bhedaḥ na abhāva nibandhanaḥ navasthā prasaṅgāt atha svarūpeṇa bhedaḥ tathā abhāvānām api sa syāt iti kim abhāvena kalpitena nā api prāgabhāva abhāve kāryasya anādi tvam prasajyate hetu abhāvena anutpatteḥ

original: nanu prāgabhāve sati hetoḥ sakāśād utpattiḥ syān nāsati prāgabhāve vidyamānatvāt |
analyzed: nanu prāgabhāve sati hetoḥ sakāśāt utpattiḥ syāt na asati prāgabhāve vidyamāna tvāt

original: yady evan na kadācanāpi kāryotpattiḥ syād virodhinaḥ prāgabhāvasya sannihitatvāt | na ca tadvināśāt kāryotpattiḥ prāgabhāvam antareṇa kāryotpattyabhyupagamaprasaṅgāt | nāpi kāryotpattir eva prāgabhāvavināśas tadutpatter eva virodhisannidhānenāsambhavāt | kāraṇasattākāle prāgabhāvasyāvināśāt | kāryotpattikāle ca tadvināśāt kāraṇavināśavat |
analyzed: yadi evat na kadācana api kārya utpattiḥ syāt virodhinaḥ prāgabhāvasya sannihita tvāt na ca tad vināśāt kārya utpattiḥ prāgabhāvam antareṇa kārya utpatti abhyupagama prasaṅgāt nā api kārya utpattiḥ eva prāgabhāva vināśaḥ tad utpatteḥ eva virodhi sannidhānena asambhavāt kāraṇa sattā kāle prāgabhāvasya avināśāt kārya utpatti kāle ca tad vināśāt kāraṇa vināśa vat

original: tasmād utpatteḥ pūrvaṃ kāryasya na bhāvo nāpy abhāvo dharmo (')sattvāt | niraṃśatvāc ca vastunaḥ | kin tu yadotpadyate tadā sattvam asyānyadā nāstīti vyavahriyate | tenāsadutpadyata ity ucyate |
analyzed: tasmāt utpatteḥ pūrvam kāryasya na bhāvaḥ nā api abhāvaḥ sattvāt niraṃśa tvāt ca vastunaḥ kin tu yadā utpadyate tadā sattvam asya anyadā na asti iti vyavahriyate tena asat utpadyate iti ucyate

original: pradhvaṃsābhāvasya cāsattvaṃ svayam evācāryobhidhāsyate | yac ca yasmād utpadyate [p.32] tat tasya kārya kāraṇaṃ cocyate | teṣāṃ caikakṣaṇasthāyitvenotpatter nāśitvaṃ svasvarūpeṇaivotpatteḥ parasparabhinnatā ca sidhyati | tena prāgabhāvādyabhāvepi kāraṇādivibhāgato vyavahāro bhavaty eva | na ca prāgabhāvadīnāmparasparambhedaḥ pratibhāsate |
analyzed: pradhvaṃsa abhāvasya ca asattvam svayam eva ācāryaḥ abhidhāsyate yat ca yasmāt utpadyate tat tasya kārya kāraṇam ca ucyate teṣām ca eka kṣaṇa sthāyi tvena utpatteḥ nāśi tvam sva svarūpeṇa eva utpatteḥ paraspara bhinna tā ca sidhyati tena prāgabhāva ādi abhāve pi kāraṇa ādi vibhāgataḥ vyavahāraḥ bhavati eva na ca prāgabhāva dīnām parasparam bhedaḥ pratibhāsate

original: yasmād ghaṭādeḥ pūrvampaścādanyatra ca nivṛttimātram abhinnaṃ pratibhāsate | yadi nāma kālabhedaḥ pratīyate | na hi gotvam anekakālādisambandhitvena pratīyamānam anekam bhavati | nivṛtter nīrūpatvāc ca katham abhāvasya nānātvaṃ bhāvanivṛttirūpatvāc cābhāvasya |
analyzed: yasmāt ghaṭa ādeḥ pūrvam paścāt anyatra ca nivṛtti mātram abhinnam pratibhāsate yadi nāma kāla bhedaḥ pratīyate na hi go tvam aneka kāla ādi sambandhi tvena pratīyamānam anekam bhavati nivṛtteḥ nīrūpa tvāt ca katham abhāvasya nānātvam bhāva nivṛtti rūpatvāt ca abhāvasya

original: kevalaṃ yo mūḍha utpatterḥ pūrvaṃ paścād anyatra ca kāryasya bhāvam icchati taṃ pratīdam ucyate (|) kāryasya pūrvam paścād anyatra cābhāva iti bhāvāropaniṣedhamātraṃ kriyate |
analyzed: kevalam yaḥ mūḍhaḥ utpatteḥ pūrvam paścāt anyatra ca kāryasya bhāvam icchati tam prati idam ucyate kāryasya pūrvam paścāt anyatra ca abhāvaḥ iti bhāva āropa niṣedha mātram kriyate

original: tena | na cāvastuna ete syurākārā ityādi yaduktan tannirastaṃ |
analyzed: tena na ca avastunaḥ ete syuḥ ākārāḥ ityādi yat uktan tat nirastam

original: itaś caitan nirastaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ yato na prākpradhvaṃsābhāvābhyām bhāvasya kaścit tadutpattilakṣaṇo virodhalakṣaṇo vā sambandho 'sahabhāvitvenād viṣṭhatvāt | ata eva na viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ sambandhaḥ | nāpi viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo 'sahabhāvitvād eva | viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyarūpatāyāś ca vastuno 'bhāvāt | kevala(m anyasambandhadvāreṇā)1*yaṃ kalpyate |
analyzed: itas ca etat nirastam draṣṭavyam yatas na prāc pradhvaṃsa abhāvābhyām bhāvasya kaścid tad utpatti lakṣaṇaḥ virodha lakṣaṇaḥ vā sambandhaḥ viṣṭha tvāt atas eva na viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvaḥ sambandhaḥ nā api viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvaḥ sahabhāvi tvāt eva viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya rūpa tāyāḥ ca vastunaḥ bhāvāt kevalam anya sambandha dvāreṇa ayam kalpyate

original: daṇḍadaṇḍinor iva | yadi ca viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvasambandhabalena bhāvasya prāgabhāva iti pratītis tathā prāgabhāvāder bhāva ity api pratītiḥ syāt sambandhasyāviśeṣāt | tasmāt prāgabhāvāder asambandhino bhāvasambandhitvena pratītir bhrāntir eva |
analyzed: daṇḍa daṇḍinoḥ iva yadi ca viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāva sambandha balena bhāvasya prāgabhāvaḥ iti pratītiḥ tathā prāgabhāva ādeḥ bhāvaḥ iti api pratītiḥ syāt sambandhasya aviśeṣāt tasmāt prāgabhāva ādeḥ asambandhinaḥ bhāva sambandhi tvena pratītiḥ bhrāntiḥ eva

original: na cānyonyābhāvo bhāvānām asti | na hi ghaṭasya nivṛttiḥ paṭasya nivṛttir bhava(tyapratīter na ca paṭe 'vasthānātsā)1*tatsambandhinī yuktā | evaṃ hi prāgabhāvādy apy anyonyābhāvaḥ syāt kāraṇādāv avasthānāt | tasmād anyābhāva evāsti nānyonyābhāvas tenānyābhāvāt prāgabhāvādīnāṃ na bheda iti kathaṃ caturvidho 'bhāva ucyate |
analyzed: na ca anyonya abhāvaḥ bhāvānām asti na hi ghaṭasya nivṛttiḥ paṭasya nivṛttiḥ bhavati apratīteḥ na ca paṭe vasthānāt sā tad sambandhinī yuktā evam hi prāgabhāva ādi api anyonya abhāvaḥ syāt kāraṇa ādau avasthānāt tasmāt anya abhāvaḥ eva asti na anyonya abhāvaḥ tena anya abhāvāt prāgabhāva ādīnām na bhedaḥ iti katham caturvidhaḥ bhāvaḥ ucyate

original: na tvabhāvasyāsattvenānubhūtatvāt (kathaṃ pratyakṣeṇa niścayaḥ | naiṣa doṣo ya)1*smād ekajñānasaṃsargiṇoḥ pratyakṣeṇaikasya grahaṇam evānyasyāgrahaṇan tadagrahaṇam eva ca tasyābhāvagrahaṇam bhāve hi tasyāgrahaṇāyogād (|) yadāhānyahetusākalye tadavyabhicārāc copalambhaḥ sattā | tadabhāvonupalabdhir asattānyopalabdhiś cānupalabdhir iti |
analyzed: na tu abhāvasya asattvena anubhūta tvāt katham pratyakṣeṇa niścayaḥ na eṣa doṣaḥ yasmāt eka jñāna saṃsargiṇoḥ pratyakṣeṇa ekasya grahaṇam eva anyasya agrahaṇan tad agrahaṇam eva ca tasya abhāva grahaṇam bhāve hi tasya agrahaṇa ayogāt yat āha anya hetu sākalye tad avyabhicārāt ca upalambhaḥ sattā tad abhāvaḥ unupalabdhiḥ asattā anya upalabdhiḥ ca anupalabdhiḥ iti

original: tenāyam arthaḥ (|) pratyakṣam abhāvan niścāyayatīti tāvan na niścāya(yatīty arthaḥ | sa ca dṛśyasya bhāvāniśca)1*yo 'bhāvaniścaya eva | evaṃ pratyakṣapṛṣṭhabhāvino vikalpasya pratyakṣaviṣayānusāritvaṃ samarthitam bhavati | tad evam upalabdhyabhāvavyavahāravad arthābhāvavyavahārasyāpi pratyakṣasiddhatvān na liṅgenāsau sādhyate |
analyzed: tena ayam arthaḥ pratyakṣam abhāvat niścāyayati iti tāvat na niścāyayati iti arthaḥ sa ca dṛśyasya bhāva aniścayaḥ bhāva niścayaḥ eva evam pratyakṣa pṛṣṭhabhāvinaḥ vikalpasya pratyakṣa viṣaya anusāri tvam samarthitam bhavati tat evam upalabdhi abhāva vyavahāra vat artha abhāva vyavahārasya api pratyakṣa siddha tvāt na liṅgena asau sādhyate

original: evaṃ tāvad amūḍhaṃ [p.33] prati dṛśyānupalmbho nābhāvaṃ vyabhicaratītyabhāvavyavahāraḥ pratyakṣasiddhaḥ |
analyzed: evam tāvat amūḍham prati dṛśya anupalmbhaḥ na abhāvam vyabhicarati iti abhāva vyavahāraḥ pratyakṣa siddhaḥ

original: na cāpy abhāvonupalabdhānām api (sattvān nityaṃ śakyamānānupa)1*laṃbhavyabhicāra iti kṛtvā vyavaharttum aśakya iti vaktuṃ yuktaṃ | evaṃ hy abhāvasya niścāyakam api pratyakṣan na syāt | sandehān na cānyanniścāyakam anyad vyavahārāṅgaṃ yuktaṃ | tasmāt pratyakṣaniścāyakatvād bhāvavad dṛśyasyābhāvam api vyavahārayati |
analyzed: na ca api abhāvaḥ ūnupalabdhānām api sattvāt nityam śakyamāna anupalaṃbha vyabhicāraḥ iti kṛtvā vyavaharttum aśakyaḥ iti vaktum yuktam evam hi abhāvasya niścāyakam api na syāt sandehāt na ca anyat niścāyakam anyat vyavahāra aṅgam yuktam tasmāt pratyakṣa niścāyaka tvāt bhāvavat dṛśyasya abhāvam api vyavahārayati

original: kathan tarhy asadvyavahārasya sādhyatvam ity āha – yadā punar ityādi | evaṃvidhe hy upalambhayogyānu(palabdhir evāsatāṃ padā)2*rthānām asattā nānyā | tadā siddhe (')pi pratyakṣeṇābhāvavyavahārasya viṣaye | mohād viṣayiṇo ['sato (')vidyamānasya]2* jñānaṃ | nāstīty evamākāraṃ |
analyzed: kathan tarhi asat vyavahārasya sādhya tvam iti āha yadā punar ityādi evaṃvidhe hi upalambha yogya anupalabdhiḥ eva asatām pada arthānām asattā na anyā tadā siddhe pratyakṣeṇa abhāva vyavahārasya viṣaye mohāt sataḥ vidyamānasya jñānam na asti iti evamākāram

original: nāstīty evambhūtaś ca śabadaḥ niḥśaṅkāvagamanāgamanalakṣaṇā puruṣasya pravṛttir vyavahāraḥ | tān apratipadyamānaḥ pumān | viṣayapradarśanenāsadvyavahāraviṣayasya ghaṭaviviktapradeśasyopalambhamānasya pradarśanena | samaye 'bhāvavyavahāre pravarttyate | dṛṣṭāntam āha – yathetyādi | sāsnādisamudāyātmaka eva gauḥ |
analyzed: na asti iti evambhūtaḥ ca śabadaḥ niḥśaṅka avagamana āgamana lakṣaṇā puruṣasya pravṛttiḥ vyavahāraḥ tān apratipadyamānaḥ pumān viṣaya pradarśanena asat vyavahāra viṣayasya ghaṭa vivikta pradeśasya upalambhamānasya pradarśanena samaye bhāva vyavahāre pravarttyate dṛṣṭāntam āha yathā ityādi sāsnā ādi samudāya ātmakaḥ eva gauḥ

original: tato na tatra gotvaṃ sādhyate kin tu govyavahāraḥ | yadāyaṃ mūḍhamatiḥ śāvaleye pravarttitagovyavahāro bāhuleye śāvaleyarūpaśūnyatvād govyavahāraṃ na pravarttayati sa nimittapradarśanena govyavahāre pravarttyate | sāsnādisamudāyanimittako hi govyavahāro na śāvaleyarūpanimittikaḥ | bāhuleye 'pi tannimittam astīti katham asau na pravarttyate |
analyzed: tatas na tatra go tvam sādhyate kin tu go vyavahāraḥ yadā ayam mūḍha matiḥ śāvaleye pravarttita go vyavahāraḥ bāhuleye śāvaleya rūpa śūnya tvāt go vyavahāram na pravarttayati sa nimitta pradarśanena go vyavahāre pravarttyate sāsnā ādi samudāya nimittakaḥ hi go vyavahāraḥ na śāvaleya rūpa nimittikaḥ bāhuleye pi tat nimittam asti iti katham asau na pravarttyate

original: tathā ceti yenaivaṃ vyavahāraḥ sādhyate tena dṛṣṭāntāsiddhicodanāpi prativyūḍhā pratikṣiptā | anupalabdher liṅgād abhāve sādhye yenaiva liṅgo na sādhyadharmiṇy abhāvaḥ sādhyas tenaiva dṛṣṭāntadharmiṇy api tatrāpy aparo dṛṣṭānta ity anavasthā syāt (|) vyavahāre tu sādhye nānavasthā | pravarttitavyavahārasyaiva punaḥ samaye pravarttanāt |
analyzed: tathā ca iti yena evam vyavahāraḥ sādhyate tena dṛṣṭānta asiddhi codanā api prativyūḍhā pratikṣiptā anupalabdheḥ liṅgāt abhāve sādhye yena eva liṅgaḥ na sādhya dharmiṇī abhāvaḥ sādhyaḥ tena eva dṛṣṭānta dharmiṇī api tatra api aparaḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ iti anavasthā syāt vyavahāre tu sādhye nā anavasthā pravarttita vyavahārasya eva punar samaye pravarttanāt

original: nanu yo hi viṣayaṃ pratipadyate sa viṣayiṇam api pratipadyata iti kathaṃ vyavahārasyāpi sādhyatvam ity āha – viṣayetyādi | dṛṣyante hi loke tathāvidhā ye viṣayapratipattāv apy apratipannaviṣayiṇaḥ |

original: yathā sāṃkhyaḥ sattve rajo nāstīti pravarttitāsadvyavahāro [p.34] (')pi nimittaniścayābhāvān mṛtpiṇḍe na pravarttayaty anupalambhanimittapradarśane ghaṭābhāvavyavahāre pravarttyate |
analyzed: yathā sāṃkhyaḥ sattve rajaḥ na asti iti pravarttita asat vyavahāraḥ pi nimitta niścaya abhāvāt mṛd piṇḍe na pravarttayati anupalambha nimitta pradarśane ghaṭa abhāva vyavahāre pravarttyate

original: evam ityādinopasaṃhāraḥ | evam uktena prakāreṇānayor anupalabdhyor dṛśyādṛśyayoḥ sadvyavahārapratiṣedhaphalatvan tulyaṃ |
analyzed: evam ityādinā upasaṃhāraḥ evam uktena prakāreṇa anayoḥ anupalabdhyoḥ dṛśya adṛśyayoḥ sat vyavahāra pratiṣedha phalatvan tulyam

original: kathaṃ svaviparyayahetvabhāvabhāvābhyāṃ svaśabdena sadvyavahārasya svarūpaṃ gṛhyate viparyayaśabdena sadvyavahāraviruddho (')sadvyavahāro gṛhyate | tayor hetū | svaviparyayahetū | tatra svahetur upalabdhir viparyayahetur dṛśyānupalabdhiḥ | tayor abhāvabhāvau | svaviparyayahetvabhāvabhāvau | tābhyāṃ |
analyzed: katham sva viparyaya hetu abhāva bhāvābhyām sva śabdena sat vyavahārasya sva rūpam gṛhyate viparyaya śabdena sat vyavahāra viruddhaḥ sat vyavahāraḥ gṛhyate tayoḥ hetū sva viparyaya hetū tatra sva hetuḥ upalabdhiḥ viparyaya hetuḥ dṛśya anupalabdhiḥ tayoḥ abhāva bhāvau sva viparyaya hetu abhāva bhāvau tābhyām

original: etad uktam bhavati (|) adṛśyānupalabdhau sadvyavahāranimittāyā upalabdheḥ pratyakṣānumānanivṛttāv abhāvāt sadvyavahāranivṛttiḥ | dṛśyānupalambhe tu sadvyavahāraviruddhasyāsadvyavahārasya nimittasadbhāvāt pravṛttis tena sadvyavahārasya nivṛttir iti sadvyavahārapratiṣedhaphalatvan tulyaṃ |
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati adṛśya anupalabdhau sat vyavahāra nimittāyāḥ upalabdheḥ pratyakṣa anumāna nivṛttau abhāvāt sat vyavahāra nivṛttiḥ dṛśya anupalambhe tu sat vyavahāra viruddhasya asat vyavahārasya nimitta sadbhāvāt pravṛttiḥ tena sat vyavahārasya nivṛttiḥ iti sat vyavahāra pratiṣedha phalatvan tulyam

original: nanūpalambhanivṛttāv apy arthasya sandehāt kathaṃ sadvyavahāro nivartata ity āha – ekatrety adṛśyaviṣayāyām anupalabdhau sattvasya saṃśayāt tato niścayātmakaḥ sattvavyavahāro nivartata eva | sandigdhas tu sattvavyavahāro na nivartate | anyatra tu dṛśyānupalabdhau viparyayād iti saṃśayaviparyayo niścayas tasmāt | asattvasya niścayād ity arthaḥ |
analyzed: nanu upalambha nivṛttau api arthasya sandehāt katham sat vyavahāraḥ nivartate iti āha ekatra iti adṛśya viṣayāyām anupalabdhau sattvasya saṃśayāt tatas niścaya ātmakaḥ sattva vyavahāraḥ nivartate eva sandigdhaḥ tu sattva vyavahāraḥ na nivartate anyatra tu dṛśya anupalabdhau viparyayāt iti saṃśaya viparyayaḥ niścayaḥ tasmāt asattvasya niścayāt iti arthaḥ

original: yady adṛśyānupalabdhau saṃśayaḥ kathaṃ sā pramāṇam ity āha – tatrādyetyādi | tatra dvayor anupalabdhyor madhye ādyādṛśyānupalabdhiḥ pramāṇam uktā sadvyavahāraniṣedhe upayogād vyāpārāt |
analyzed: yadi adṛśya anupalabdhau saṃśayaḥ katham sā pramāṇam iti āha tatra ādya ityādi tatra dvayoḥ anupalabdhyoḥ madhye ādya adṛśya anupalabdhiḥ pramāṇam uktā sat vyavahāra niṣedhe upayogāt vyāpārāt

original: kva tarhi tasyā aprāmāṇyam ity āha – na tv ityādi | vyatirekasyābhāvasya darśanan niścayaḥ | ādigrahaṇāc chabdo vyavahāraś ca gṛhyate | saṃśayād yato nābhāvaniścaya utpadyate | tasmān na pramāṇaṃ | dvitīyā tv iti | dṛśyaviṣayānupalabdhiḥ | atreti vyatirekadarśanādau niścayaphalatvān niśyaca(niścaya??) eva phalam asyā iti kṛtvā |
analyzed: kva tarhi tasyāḥ aprāmāṇyam iti āha na tu ityādi vyatirekasya abhāvasya darśanat niścayaḥ ādi grahaṇāt śabdaḥ vyavahāraḥ ca gṛhyate saṃśayāt yatas na abhāva niścayaḥ utpadyate tasmāt na pramāṇam dvitīyā tu iti dṛśya viṣaya anupalabdhiḥ atra iti vyatireka darśana ādau niścaya phalatvāt eva phalam asyāḥ iti kṛtvā

original: sā ca dṛśyaviṣayānupalabdhiḥ prayogabhedāc caturvidheti sambandhaḥ | viruddhaś ca viruddhakārya ceti virūpaikaśeṣaḥ | siddhir u(palabdhir dṛśyātmano)1*r ity atrāpi sambandhanīyaṃ |
analyzed: sā ca dṛśya viṣaya anupalabdhiḥ prayoga bhedāt caturvidhā iti sambandhaḥ viruddhaḥ ca viruddha kārya ca iti virūpa ekaśeṣaḥ siddhiḥ upalabdhiḥ dṛśya ātmanoḥ iti atra api sambandhanīyam

analyzed: nanu cira vinaṣṭe pi agnau vāsagṛha ādau dhūmasya sadbhāvāt katham viruddha kārya upalabdheḥ na vyabhicāraḥ iti atas āha

original: tatretyādi | tatra viruddhakārye [']pīṣṭaṃ deśakālādyapekṣaṇaṃ | nātra śītaḥ kasmiṃś cit kāle yadāgnir vartamānībhūta iti kālāpekṣaṇaṃ vyomni dhūmāt kutra cid deśe nāsti śīto yatra sannihito vahnir yato [']yaṃ dhūma utthita iti deśāpekṣaṇaṃ |
analyzed: tatra ityādi tatra viruddha kārye pi iṣṭam deśa kāla ādi apekṣaṇam na atra śītaḥ kasmin cit kāle yadā agniḥ vartamānībhūtaḥ iti kāla apekṣaṇam vyomni dhūmāt kutra cit deśe na asti śītaḥ yatra sannihitaḥ vahniḥ yatas yam dhūmaḥ utthitaḥ iti deśa apekṣaṇam

original: ādiśabdād avasthāviśeṣāpekṣaṇaṃ (|) yo [']vasthāviśeṣo dhūmasya sannihitāgner dṛṣṭas tam apekṣya varttamāne [']pi kāle śītābhāvo [']numīyate | agnir atra dhūmād iti kāryahetāv api deśakālādyapekṣaṇam iṣṭaṃ | asyaivārthasya samuccayārtho 'piśabdaḥ |
analyzed: ādi śabdāt avasthā viśeṣa apekṣaṇam yaḥ vasthā viśeṣaḥ dhūmasya sannihita agneḥ dṛṣṭaḥ tam apekṣya varttamāne pi kāle śīta abhāvaḥ numīyate agniḥ atra dhūmāt iti kārya hetau api deśa kāla ādi apekṣaṇam iṣṭam asya eva arthasya samuccaya arthaḥ upiśabdaḥ

original: nanu deśakālādyapekṣitvasya kāryahetuviśeṣaṇatve 'siddho hetuḥ syād dharmiṇo 'bhāvād iti cet (|) na | pradeśa eva dharmiṇi deśakālādyapekṣitvena gamakatvād ity uktatvāt |
analyzed: nanu deśa kāla ādi apekṣi tvasya kārya hetu viśeṣaṇa tve siddhaḥ hetuḥ syāt dharmiṇaḥ bhāvāt iti ced na pradeśe eva dharmiṇi deśa kāla ādi apekṣi tvena gamaka tvāt iti ukta tvāt

original: [p.43] anyatheti yadi na deśādyapekṣaṇan tadā vyabhicāri viruddhakāryaṃ syāt | yathā bhasmān apekṣitadeśakālaṃ aśītasādhane śītābhāve sādhye vyabhicāri | tadvat evaṃ tāvad viruddhādyupalabdhir anupalabdhir iti pratipāditaṃ |
analyzed: anyathā iti yadi na deśa ādi apekṣaṇan tadā vyabhicāri viruddha kāryam syāt yathā bhasmān apekṣita deśa kālam aśīta sādhane śīta abhāve sādhye vyabhicāri tadvat evam tāvat viruddha ādi upalabdhiḥ anupalabdhiḥ iti pratipāditam

original: yas tarhītyādi paraḥ | samaguṇeti sannihitānupahitena yathā kṣitivījodakādikāraṇakalāpaṃ dṛṣṭvāṃkuraḥ kāryo [']numīyate | sa kathaṃ kāraṇākhyo hetus trividhe svabhāvakāryānupalambhākhye hetāv antarbhavati | na tāvad anupalabdhau vidhisādhanatvāt | kāraṇasvabhāvatvān na kāryahetau | arthāntareṇārthāntarasyānumānān na svabhāvahetau ||
analyzed: yaḥ tarhi ityādi paraḥ sama guṇa iti sannihita anupahitena yathā kṣiti vīja udaka ādi kāraṇa kalāpam dṛṣṭvā aṃkuraḥ kāryaḥ numīyate sa katham kāraṇa ākhyaḥ hetuḥ trividhe svabhāva kārya anupalambha ākhye hetau antarbhavati na tāvat anupalabdhau vidhi sādhana tvāt kāraṇa svabhāva tvāt na kārya hetau artha antareṇa artha antarasya anumānāt na svabhāva hetau

original: antarbhāvam āha –
analyzed: antarbhāvam āha

original: hetunetyādi | samagreṇeti yāvataḥ kāraṇakalāpāt kāryam utpadyamānaṃ dṛṣṭan tāvatā nāntyāvasthāprāptena tatra liṅgigrahaṇāt prāg eva kāryasya pratyakṣatvāt | apratyakṣatve vāntyāvasthāniścayāyogād anumānaṃ | na ca yas tān niścetuṃ śakṣyati tasyānumānam antyakṣaṇānām arvāg darśanenāniścayāt | yaḥ kāryotpādo [']numīyate sa hetoḥ svabhāvo varṇitaḥ |
analyzed: hetunā ityādi samagreṇa iti yāvataḥ kāraṇa kalāpāt kāryam utpadyamānam tāvatā na antya avasthā prāptena tatra liṅgi grahaṇāt prāk eva kāryasya pratyakṣa tvāt apratyakṣa tve vā antya avasthā niścaya ayogāt anumānam na ca yaḥ tān niścetum śakṣyati tasya anumānam antya kṣaṇānām arvāk darśanena aniścayāt yaḥ kārya utpādaḥ numīyate sa hetoḥ svabhāvaḥ varṇitaḥ

original: kuto [']rthāntarānapekṣatvāt | tenāyam arthaḥ kāryotpādanayogyatāmātrānubandhitvāt svabhāvabhūtā ||
analyzed: kutas ṛtha antara anapekṣa tvāt tena ayam arthaḥ kārya utpādana yogya tā mātra anubandhi tvāt svabhāva bhūtā

original: nanu yadāntyāvasthāpekṣaḥ kāryotpādas tadā katham anyānapekṣa ity āha – asāv apīti kāryotpādaḥ | yathāsannihito yādṛśaḥ sannihitaḥ | kāraṇakalāpaḥ | tādṛśāt sannihitān nānyam artham apekṣata iti tādṛgmātrānubandhī svabhāvaḥ | (kasya bhāvaḥ) | samagrasya kāraṇakalāpasya (|) santānāpekṣayaitad ucayte na kṣaṇāpekṣayā |
analyzed: nanu yadā antya avasthā apekṣaḥ kārya utpādaḥ tadā katham anya anapekṣaḥ iti āha asau api iti kārya utpādaḥ yathā sannihitaḥ yādṛśaḥ sannihitaḥ kāraṇa kalāpaḥ tādṛśāt sannihitāt na anyam artham apekṣate iti tādṛś mātra anubandhī svabhāvaḥ kasya bhāvaḥ samagrasya kāraṇa kalāpasya santāna apekṣayā etat ucayte na kṣaṇa apekṣayā

original: janakaḥ kāraṇakalāpasantāno [']napekṣa ity arthaḥ |
analyzed: janakaḥ kāraṇa kalāpa santānaḥ napekṣaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: yady apy anapekṣaḥ kāryotpādas tathāpy arthāntaratvāt kathaṃ svabhāva ity āha – tatretyādi | yasmāt tatra samagreṣu kāraṇeṣu samagrāt kāraṇāl liṅgāt kāryotpatti(sambhava)s tathānumīyate | sambhavaty asmād iti sambhavaḥ | kāryotpādanayogyatānumīyata ity arthaḥ | etad eva vyanakti | samagrāṇāṃ kāryotpādanayogyatānumānād iti |
analyzed: yadi api anapekṣaḥ kārya utpādaḥ tathā api artha antara tvāt katham svabhāvaḥ iti āha tatra ityādi yasmāt tatra samagreṣu kāraṇeṣu samagrāt kāraṇāt liṅgāt kārya utpatti sambhavaḥ tathā anumīyate sambhavati asmāt iti sambhavaḥ kārya utpādana yogyatā anumīyate iti arthaḥ etat eva vyanakti samagrāṇām kārya utpādana yogyatā anumānāt iti

original: yogyatā ca [p.44] sāmagrīmātrānubandhinī kāraṇāntarānapekṣatvāt |
analyzed: yogyatā ca sāmagrī mātra anubandhinī kāraṇa antara anapekṣa tvāt

original: yadi tarhi kāryotpādanaśaktis tanmātrānubandhinī niyatas tarhi kāryotpāda iti sa eva kasmān nānumīyata iti paraḥ pṛcchati | kiṃ punaḥ sāmagryāḥ sakāśāt kāryam evānumīyata ity atrāha – sāmagrītyādi | sāmagryāḥ phalaṇ ca tāḥ śaktayaś ceti sāmagrīphalaśaktayaḥ |
analyzed: yadi tarhi kārya utpādana śaktiḥ tanmātra anubandhinī niyataḥ tarhi kārya utpādaḥ iti saḥ eva kasmāt na anumīyate iti paraḥ pṛcchati kim punar sāmagryāḥ sakāśāt kāryam eva anumīyate iti atra āha sāmagrī ityādi sāmagryāḥ ca tāḥ śaktayaḥ ca iti sāmagrī phala śaktayaḥ

original: tathā hi pūrvasmāt samagrād uttarasya samarthasya kṣaṇasyotpattis tasay cātmātiśayaḥ śaktir iti sāmagrī phalaṃ śaktis tāsāṃ pariṇāmaḥ | uttarottaraprabandhenotpattis tadanubandhini tadapekṣiṇi kārye | kāraṇenānumātavye 'naikāntikatā | kiṅ kāraṇaṃ (|) pratibanadha(sya)[pratibandha(sya)?] sambhavāt |
analyzed: tathā hi pūrvasmāt samagrāt uttarasya samarthasya kṣaṇasya utpattiḥ ca ātma atiśayaḥ śaktiḥ iti sāmagrī phalam śaktiḥ tāsām pariṇāmaḥ uttara uttara prabandhena utpattiḥ tad anubandhini tad apekṣiṇi kārye kāraṇena anumātavye na aikāntika tā kim kāraṇam sambhavāt

original: tad vyācaṣṭe – na hītyādi. samagrāṇīty eva sannihitānīty eva kāraṇadravyāṇi svakāryaṃ janayanti | kiṅ kāraṇaṃ | sāmagrītyādi | sāmagryāḥ sakāśāj janma yāsāṃ śaktīnān tāsām uttarottarapariṇāmaḥ | pūrvvapūrvvakṣaṇād uttarottaraviśiṣṭakṣaṇotpādo yas tadapekṣatvāt kāryotpādasya | atrāntare ceti santānapariṇāmakāle | pratibandhasambhavāt |
analyzed: tat vyācaṣṭe na hi ityādi samagrāṇi iti eva sannihitāni iti eva kāraṇa dravyāṇi sva kāryam janayanti kim kāraṇam sāmagrī ityādi sāmagryāḥ sakāśāt janma yāsām śaktīnām tāsām uttara uttara pariṇāmaḥ pūrva pūrva kṣaṇāt uttara uttara viśiṣṭa kṣaṇa utpādaḥ yaḥ tad apekṣa tvāt kārya utpādasya atra antare ca iti santāna pariṇāma kāle pratibandha sambhavāt

original: nanu yogyatāpy uttarottarakṣaṇaparināmapratibaddhā tatrāpi ca pratibandhasambhavāt kathan tadanumānam apīty āha – yogyatāyās tv ityādi | dravyāntarānapekṣatvāt sannihitakāraṇakalāpavyatirekeṇa kāraṇāntarānapekṣatvān na virudhyate 'numānaṃ |
analyzed: nanu yogyatā api uttara uttara kṣaṇa parināma pratibaddhā tatra api ca pratibandha sambhavāt kathan tad anumānam api iti āha yogyatāyāḥ tu ityādi dravya antara anapekṣa tvāt sannihita kāraṇa kalāpa vyatirekeṇa kāraṇa antara anapekṣa tvāt na virudhyate numānam

original: tad evānumānam āha – uttarottaretyādi pūrvapūrvakṣaṇam upādāyottarasamarthakṣaṇotpāda uttarottaraśaktipariṇāmaḥ | tena hetubhūtena kāryotpādanasamartheti sādhyanirdeśaḥ | iyaṃ kāraṇasāmagrīti dharmī | śaktipariṇāmapratyayasyānyasyāpekṣaṇīyasyābhāvād iti hetuḥ śakteḥ pariṇāmasya yo 'paraḥ sahakāripratyayas tasyāpekṣaṇīyasyābhāvāt |
analyzed: tat eva anumānam āha uttara uttara ityādi pūrva pūrva kṣaṇam upādāya uttara samartha kṣaṇa utpādaḥ uttara uttara śakti pariṇāmaḥ tena hetu bhūtena kārya utpādana samarthā iti sādhya nirdeśaḥ iyam kāraṇa sāmagrī iti dharmī śakti pariṇāma pratyayasya anyasya apekṣaṇīyasya abhāvāt iti hetuḥ śakteḥ pariṇāmasya paraḥ sahakāri pratyayaḥ tasya apekṣaṇīyasya abhāvāt

original: [p.45]  kutas tarhi śakteḥ prasava ity āha – pūrvetyādi | pūrvasajātiḥ sadṛśaḥ pūrvaḥ kāraṇakalāpas tāvan mātraṃ hetur yasyāḥ śaktiprasūteḥ sā tathā | tadbhāvas tasmāt | ataḥ kāraṇāt sā yogyatān anyāpekṣiṇīty ucyate ||
analyzed: kutas tarhi śakteḥ prasavaḥ iti āha pūrva ityādi pūrva sajātiḥ sadṛśaḥ pūrvaḥ kāraṇa kalāpaḥ tāvat mātram hetuḥ yasyāḥ śakti prasūteḥ sā tathā tad bhāvaḥ tasmāt atas kāraṇāt sā yogyatān anya apekṣiṇī iti ucyate

original: nanu kāryaṃ prati kāraṇasya yogyatā yadi śaktir ucyate tadā kāryavyabhicāre yogyatāyā api vyabhicāra iti katham etad anumānaṃ | atha yogyatāsambhava ucyate tadāyam arthaḥ syāt kāryaṃ syād vā na veti | tathāpi katham asyānumānaṃ sandehād iti |
analyzed: nanu kāryam prati kāraṇasya yogyatā yadi śaktiḥ ucyate tadā kārya vyabhicāre yogyatāyāḥ api vyabhicāraḥ iti katham etat anumānam atha yogyatā sambhavaḥ ucyate tadā ayam arthaḥ syāt kāryam syāt vā na vā iti tathā api katham asya anumānam sandehāt iti

original: atrocyate | pareṇa hi katham etad anumānan trividhahetujanyam iti codyate | yady etad anumānam pareṇa samarthyate tadā trividhaliṅgajam evety ācāryeṇa pratipādyate | na tv etat paramārthatānumānam ity evam param etad ity eke | atha vā yady ekāntena kāryotpādanayogyatānumīyate | tadā vyabhicārād anumānaṃ na syāt |
analyzed: atrā ucyate pareṇa hi katham etat trividha hetu janyam iti codyate yadi etat anumānam pareṇa samarthyate tadā trividha liṅga jam eva iti ācāryeṇa pratipādyate na tu etat parama artha tā anumānam iti evam param etat iti eke atha vā yadi ekāntena kārya utpādana yogyatā anumīyate tadā vyabhicārāt anumānam na syāt

original: yadā tu kadācit kāryaṃ syād ity evaṃrūpaḥ sambhavo [']numīyate tadā katham asya vyabhicāraḥ | tenāyam artha uttarottarapariṇāme yadi prabandhābhāvas tadā kāryaṃ syād anyadā tu nāstīti | parokte tv ekāntenakāryānumāne vyabhicāra eva |
analyzed: yadā tu kadācid kāryam syāt iti evaṃrūpaḥ sambhavaḥ numīyate tadā katham asya vyabhicāraḥ tena ayam arthaḥ uttara uttara pariṇāme yadi prabandha abhāvaḥ tadā kāryam syāt anyadā tu na asti iti para ukte tu ekāntena kārya anumāne vyabhicāraḥ eva

original: anye tu pariṇāmavat yāṃ sāmagryāṃ pratibandhakābhāve saty ekāntena kāryotpādanayogyatā bhavatīti saivānumīyate | kāryotpādanayogyatāpratītiś ca kāryam api viśeṣaṇatvenākṣipatīti na pṛthak kāryānumānaṃ kriyata iti manyante | kevalaṃ sāmagrīmātrāt kāryānumāne vyabhicāra ucyate pratibandhakābhāvaḥ katham pratipanna iti cet (|) satyaṃ |
analyzed: anye tu pariṇāma vat yām sāmagryām pratibandhaka abhāve sati ekāntena kārya utpādana yogyatā bhavati iti sā eva anumīyate kārya utpādana yogyatā pratītiḥ ca kāryam api viśeṣaṇa tvena ākṣipati iti na pṛthak kārya anumānam kriyate iti manyante kevalam sāmagrī mātrāt kārya anumāne vyabhicāraḥ ucyate pratibandhaka abhāvaḥ katham pratipannaḥ iti ced satyam

original: yo hi taṃ jñātuṃ śaknoti tasyaitad anumānaṃ yo hi dhūmasyāgnijanyatvaṃ jñātuṃ śaknoti tasya dhūmād agnyanumānaṃ nānyasya tadvat |
analyzed: yaḥ hi tam jñātum śaknoti tasya etat anumānam yaḥ hi dhūmasya agni janya tvam jñātum śaknoti tasya dhūmāt agni anumānam na anyasya tadvat

original: yā tarhītyādinā punar api tridhaiva sa ity asya vyāghātam āha – akāryakāraṇabhūtena | anumeyād arthād anyenāsvabhāvena rasādinā | ādiśabdād gandhādinā rūpādigatiḥ | atrāpy ādiśabdāt sparśādigrahaṇaṃ | andhakāre hi mātuluṅgādirasam āsvādya | campakagandham āghrāya | vahneś ca sparśam anubhūya |
analyzed: yā tarhi ityādinā punar api tridhā eva saḥ iti asya vyāghātam āha akārya kāraṇa bhūtena anumeyāt arthāt anyena asvabhāvena rasa ādinā ādi śabdāt gandha ādinā rūpa ādi gatiḥ atra api ādi śabdāt sparśa ādi grahaṇam andhakāre hi mātuluṅga ādi rasam āsvādya campaka gandham āghrāya vahneḥ ca sparśam anubhūya

original: teṣāṃ rūpasāmānyam anumīyate tathā vahnirūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā tatsparśaḥ | sā kathan trividhe hetāv antarbhavatīti prakṛte |
analyzed: teṣām rūpa sāmānyam anumīyate tathā vahni rūpam dṛṣṭvā tad sparśaḥ sā kathan trividhe hetau antarbhavati iti prakṛte

original: [p.46]  na cāpramāṇam iyan tato liṅgāntaraprasaṅga ity āha – sāpītyādi sāpi gatir iti saṃbandhaḥ | rūpādeḥ kim iva śiṣṭasyaiksāmagryadhīnasya | rasasya janikā yā sāgagrī tasyām eva sāgagryāmāyattasya rasato liṅgādyā gatiḥ (|) sā hedharmānumānena | rasasya yo hetuḥ pūrvam apādānantasya yo dharmo rūpajanakatvantarsyānumānena |
analyzed: na ca apramāṇam iyan tatas liṅga antara prasaṅgaḥ iti āha sā api ityādi sā api gatiḥ iti saṃbandhaḥ rūpa ādeḥ kim iva śiṣṭasya eka sāmagrī adhīnasya rasasya janikā yā sāgagrī tasyām eva sāgagryām āyattasya rasataḥ liṅga ādyā gatiḥ sā hedharma anumānena rasasya yaḥ hetuḥ pūrvam apādāna antasya yaḥ dharmaḥ rūpa janakatva antarsya anumānena

original: tenāyam artho rasāt sakaśāt taddhetor asasamānakālabhāvi rūpajanakatvan niścīyate | evaṃ hi tasya rasasamānakālabhāvi rūpajanakatvaṃ niścīyate | yadi samānakālabhāvino rūpasyāpi niśayaḥ syāt tenātītaikakālānām ekaiva gatiḥ kāryaliṅgajā |
analyzed: tena ayam arthaḥ rasāt sakaśāt tad hetoḥ asa samāna kāla bhāvi rūpa janaka tvat niścīyate evam hi tasya rasa samāna kāla bhāvi rūpa janaka tvam niścīyate yadi samāna kāla bhāvinaḥ rūpasya api niśayaḥ syāt tena atīta eka kālānām ekā eva gatiḥ kārya liṅga jā

original: nanv anabhihitād rasahetoḥ sakāśāt paścātsamānakālasya rūpasyānumānaṃ hetoḥ kāryānumāne vyabhicārāt | kāryotpādanayogyatānumāne ca na rasasamānakālasya rūpasyānumānaṃ syāt | anumitānumānaprtīter abhāvāc ca |
analyzed: nanu anabhihitāt rasa hetoḥ sakāśāt paścāt samāna kālasya rūpasya anumānam hetoḥ kārya anumāne vyabhicārāt kārya utpādana yogyatā anumāne ca na rasa samāna kālasya rūpasya anumānam syāt anumita anumāna prtīteḥ abhāvāt ca

original: tena yad ucyate (|) yadtītānāṃ gatis tadā kāryaś ca talliṅgaś a (|) tasmāj jāteti kāryliṅgajā (|) yadā tu samānakālānāṅgatis tadā kāryaṃ liṅgaṃ yasy hetudharmānumānasya tatkāryaliṅgant tasmāj jātā kāryaliṅgajeti tadapāstaṃ | [tatra pare mā...] cāvayavidradvye rūpādayo guṇā vyavasthiāstena tatra rūpāder asato gatir yuktā |
analyzed: tena yat ucyate yad atītānām gatiḥ tadā kāryaḥ ca tad liṅgaḥ tasmāt jātā iti kāri liṅga jā yadā tu tadā kāryam liṅgam hetu dharma anumānasya tad kārya liṅgam tasmāt jātā kārya liṅga jā iti tat apāstam tatra pare mā rūpa ādayaḥ guṇāḥ tena tatra rūpa ādeḥ asataḥ gatiḥ yuktā

original: na bauddhānāṃ rūpādivyatirekeṇāvayavino 'nabhupagamāt na dharmiṇo 'bhāvāt | dharmiṇam antareṇa cānumāne rasato rūpādeḥ sarvatrānumānaprasaṅgāt | asamudāyaś c sādhyaḥ syāt | avpakṣadharmaś ca hetuḥ syāt | nāpi hetudharmānumānaṃ yujyate rūpādikāryatvena rsādr apratipannatvāt | na c kṣaṇikapakṣamaniścityaivam ucyate |
analyzed: na bauddhānām rūpa ādi vyatirekeṇa avayavinaḥ na abhupagamāt na dharmiṇaḥ bhāvāt dharmiṇam antareṇa ca anumāne rasataḥ rūpa ādeḥ sarvatra anumāna prasaṅgāt asamudāyaḥ c sādhyaḥ syāt a vpakṣa dharmaḥ ca hetuḥ syāt na api hetu dharma anumānam yujyate rūpa ādi kārya tvena apratipanna tvāt na c kṣaṇika pakṣam a niścitya evam ucyate

original: kṣaṇikatve hi rūpādeḥ samānajātīyakāryatvaṃ syān na rasadikāryatvaṃ pratibandhagrāhakābhāvāt | na kṣaṇānām anumānānumeyavavahāraḥ sambandhāniścayāt | santānāśrayeṇa tv anumānādivyavahāre rūpādisantānānāṃ na parasparaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ pratipanna iti katham anumānānumeyavyavahāra iti |
analyzed: kṣaṇika tve hi rūpa ādeḥ samāna jātīya kāryatvam syāt na rasa di kāryatvam pratibandha grāhaka abhāvāt na kṣaṇānām anumāna anumeya vavahāraḥ sambandha aniścayāt santāna āśrayeṇa tu anumāna ādi vyavahāre rūpa ādi santānānām na parasparam kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ pratipannaḥ iti katham anumāna anumeya vyavahāraḥ iti

original: evam manyate (|) na sarvatrasāde rūpādyanumānam api tvāmrādau dharmiṇi | tatra ca rūpādīnāṃ parasparāvinirbhāgarbhāga (?) niyamaḥ pratīyata eva (|) sa ca pratibandhahetuko 'nyathā ghaṭapaṭādīnām api parasparāvinirbhāganiyamaḥ syāt | pratibandhaś ca teṣāṃ na tādātmyaṃ bhedena pratīter (|) nāpi tadutpattiḥ samānakālatvāt |
analyzed: evam manyate na sarvatrasāde rūpa ādi anumānam api tu āmra ādau dharmiṇi tatra ca rūpa ādīnām niyamaḥ pratīyate eva sa ca pratibandha hetukaḥ nyathā ghaṭa paṭa ādīnām api paraspara avinirbhāga niyamaḥ syāt pratibandhaḥ ca teṣām na tādātmyam bhedena pratīteḥ nā api tad utpattiḥ samāna kāla tvāt

original: na caikārthasamavāyasteṣāṃ yato na tāvadasamavetānāṃ samavāyabalādekārthasamavāyaḥ samavāyasthaivābhāvāt | atiprasaṅgāc ca samavetānām api kiṃ samavāyena svahetubhya eva tathā niṣpatteḥ | tathā niṣpattyaiva vācyābhidhānād gamakatvam (|) tasmād ekasāmagryadhīnatvaṃ pratibndhaḥ | niścitapratibandhasya cānyasmin kālenumānaṃ |
analyzed: na ca eka artha samavāyaḥ teṣām yatas na tāvat asamavetānām samavāya balāt ekārtha samavāyaḥ samavāya sthā eva abhāvāt atiprasaṅgāt ca samavetānām api kim samavāyena sva hetubhyaḥ eva tathā niṣpatteḥ tathā niṣpattyā eva vācya abhidhānāt gamaka tvam tasmāt eka sāmagrī adhīna tvam pratibndhaḥ niścita pratibandhasya ca anyasmin kāle inumānam

original: yady api cātrāvayavī na vidyate tathāpy āmrādipratyayaviṣayasya dharmitvantena tatra rasato rūpādigatiḥ |
analyzed: yadi api ca atra avayavī na vidyate tathā api āmra ādi pratyaya viṣayasya dharmi tva antena tatra rasataḥ rūpa ādi gatiḥ

original: nanu tathāpi katham eṣām ekasāmagryadhīnatvaṃ | yato yai(?yenai)va svabhāvena rūpaṃ (p.47) rūpaṃ janayati na tenaiva rasādikaṃ janayati teṣām parasparābhedaprasaṅgāt | nāpyanyenānyaṃ janayati tasya svabhāvabhedaprasaṅgāt |
analyzed: nanu tathā api katham eṣām eka sāmagrī adhīna tvam yatas yaiyena eva svabhāvena rūpam rūpam janayati na tena eva rasa ādikam janayati teṣām paraspara abheda prasaṅgāt na api anyena anyam janayati tasya svabhāva bheda prasaṅgāt

original: naiṣa doṣo yasmāt | na tratra rūpasya pūrvvvam ekakāryajanakatvaṃ yenāyan doṣaḥ syāt | kin tv ekakālam anekakāryajanakatvam eva | tatas tasyaivotpattidarśanāt | na ca kāraṇasya kāryābhāva ev kāraṇavaṃ yenānekam ekas mādutpadyamānam ekaṃ prasajyeta kin tu kāryotpattau prāgbhāva eva tasya kāraṇatvaṃ loke |
analyzed: na eṣa doṣaḥ yasmāt na rūpasya pūrvvam eka kārya janaka tvam yena ayan doṣaḥ syāt kin tu eka kālam aneka kārya janaka tvam eva tatas tasya eva utpatti darśanāt na ca kāraṇasya kārya abhāve eva kāraṇa tvam yena anekam ekaḥ māt utpadyamānam ekam prasajyeta kin tu kārya utpattau prāgbhāve eva tasya kāraṇa tvam loke

original: yathā caikakāryotpattau tasya prāgbhāvakāraṇatvan tathā kalāpotpattāv api dṛṣṭatvāt | yad vā yenaiv vabhāvena rūpaṃ rūpaṃ janayati tenaiva rasādikam api svarūpabheds tv eṣām upānabhedakṛto na sahakārikṛtaḥ | tathā hi vāyau sparśasadbhāvepi rūpādyabhāvād rūpādyanutpattiḥ | agnau ca rūpādisadbhāvepi rasābhāvād rasābhāvād rasānutpattiḥ |
analyzed: yathā ca eka kārya utpattau tasya tathā kalāpa utpattau api dṛṣṭa tvāt yat vā yena eva tathā bhāvena rūpam rūpam janayati tena eva rasa ādikam api svarūpa bhedaḥ tu eṣām upāna bheda kṛtaḥ na sahakāri kṛtaḥ tathā hi vāyau sparśa sadbhāve api rūpa ādi abhāvāt rūpa ādi anutpattiḥ agnau ca rūpa ādi sadbhāve api rasa abhāvāt rasa abhāvāt rasa anutpattiḥ

original: apsu rasādibhāvepi gandhābhāvād gandhānutpattis tena rasāder niyataṃ kāraṇaṃ rasādir evāvsīyate | niyataṃ ca kāraṇam upādānakāraṇaṃ samānajātīyam abhinnasantānavartti vā | asmād upādānakāraṇabhedād rūpād īnāṃ svabhāvabhedaḥ |
analyzed: apsu rasa ādi bhāve pi gandha abhāvāt gandha anutpattiḥ tena rasa ādeḥ niyatam kāraṇam rasa ādiḥ eva avsīyate niyatam ca kāraṇam upādānakāraṇam samāna jātīyam abhinna santāna vartti vā asmāt upādānakāraṇa bhedāt rūpāt īnām svabhāva bhedaḥ

original: yat punar ucyate | tatrānekaśaktīnāṃ samucayaḥ | tena rūpam ekayā śaktyā rūpaṃ janayatyanyānyayā rasādikam iti |
analyzed: yat punar ucyate tatra aneka śaktīnām samucayaḥ tena rūpam ekayā śaktyā rūpam janayati anya anyayā rasa ādikam iti

original: tad ayuktam (|) anekaśaktidvāreṇāpy ekasyānekakāryakāraṇābhupagme 'nekatvaprasaṅgo 'nivārita eva bhāvas yānekaśaktīnām evānekasvabhāvatvāt | abhinnatvāc ca śaktīnāṃ śaktibhede rūpasya bhedprsaṅgaḥ | bhede vā śaktīnāṃ rūpasyākārakatvaprasaṅāt | na ca śaktiyogāt kārakatvam aśaktasya śaktiyogābhāvāt |
analyzed: tat ayuktam aneka śakti dvāreṇa api ekasya aneka kārya kāraṇa abhupagme nekatva prasaṅgaḥ nivāritaḥ eva bhāvaḥ yā aneka śaktīnām eva aneka svabhāva tvāt abhinna tvāt ca śaktīnām śakti bhede rūpasya bheda prsaṅgaḥ bhede vā śaktīnām rūpasya akāraka tva prasaṅāt na ca śakti yogāt kāraka tvam aśaktasya śakti yoga abhāvāt

original: śaktasyāpi kiṃ śaktiyogena svarūpeṇaiva kārkatvāc chakteś ca kraktvaṃ na syāc chaktiyogābhāvāt | atha śaktitvān na sā śaktim apekṣate (|) bhāvo 'pi tarhi śakta(i)tvāt kim iti śaktim apekṣate |
analyzed: śaktasya api kim śakti yogena sva rūpeṇa eva śakteḥ ca krak tvam na syāt śakti yoga abhāvāt atha śakti tvāt na sā śaktim apekṣate tarhi śaktā etvāt kim iti śaktim apekṣate

original: yo 'pi mīmāṃsako manyate | bhāvasya svarūpātiśaya eva śaktiḥ sā ca bhinnābhinnā | yato bhāve gṛhyamāṇe śaktir na gṛhyate :to bhāvād bhinnā | kāryānyathānupapattyā tu sā bhāvayābhinnā 'nyathā bhāvasya kārakatvan na syāt | tad uktaṃ (|)
analyzed: mīmāṃsakaḥ manyate bhāvasya svarūpa atiśayaḥ eva śaktiḥ sā ca bhinna abhinnā yatas bhāve gṛhyamāṇe śaktiḥ na gṛhyate bhāvāt bhinnā kārya anyathā anupapattyā tu sā nyathā bhāvasya kāraka tvat na syāt tat uktam

original: "śaktayaḥ sarvabhāvānāṃ kāryārthapattikalpitā" iti (|)
analyzed: śaktayaḥ sarva bhāvānām kārya arthapatti kalpitāḥ iti

original: so 'pi nirastaḥ | ekasyāḥ śakter bhinnābhinnarūpatvavirodhāt | kiṃ cārthāpattyā kāryāt prāgbhāvina eva bhāvasyābhinnā śśaktiḥ kalpyatāṃ iti prāgbhāva eva śaktitaḥ (|) sa ca pratyakṣasiddha iti kathaṃ na śaktitḥ pratyakṣā | kevalaṃ sā kāryadarśanān niścīyate | tasmāt kāryād rasādeḥ kāraṇadharmānumānād asya kāryahetāv antarbhāvaḥ |
analyzed: saḥ u pi nirastaḥ ekasyāḥ śakteḥ bhinna abhinna rūpatva virodhāt kim ca arthāpattyā kāryāt prāk bhāvinaḥ eva bhāvasya abhinnā śaktiḥ kalpyatām iti prāk bhāvaḥ eva śaktitaḥ sa ca pratyakṣa siddhaḥ iti katham na śaktitḥ pratyakṣā kevalam sā kārya darśanāt niścīyate tasmāt kāryāt rasa ādeḥ kāraṇa dharma anumānāt asya kārya hetau antarbhāvaḥ

original: dhūmes dhanavikāravad iti | yathā dhūmād agnyādisāmagryanumitau bhasmāṅgārādīndhanavikārānumitiḥ (p.48) tadvat ||
analyzed: dhūmeḥ dhana vikāra vat iti yathā dhūmāt agni ādi sāmagrī anumitau bhasma aṅgāra ādi indhana vikāra anumitiḥ tadvat

original: nanu ca rsakāryeṇānumitāt kāraṇāt sakāśāt samānakālinaḥ kāryasyānumānam idaṃ na tu hetudharmānumānam ity ata āha – tatreti (|) rasād rūpe pratipattau hetur eva tathābhūta iti rūpajananasambandhonumīyate (|) yasminn anumīyamāne kāryāntaram api tadviśeṣaṇan niścitam bhavati | na tv anumitāt kāraṇāt paścāt kāryāntaram anumeyaṃ |
analyzed: nanu ca rsa kāryeṇa anumitāt kāraṇāt sakāśāt samāna kālinaḥ kāryasya anumānam idam na tu hetu dharma anumānam iti atas āha tatra iti rasāt rūpe pratipattau hetuḥ eva tathābhūtaḥ iti rūpa janana sambandhaḥ anumīyate yasmin anumīyamāne kārya antaram api tad viśeṣaṇat niścitam bhavati na tu anumitāt kāraṇāt paścāt kārya antaram anumeyam

original: kuta ity āha – hi yasmāt | pravṛttā na pratibaddhā śaktir yasya tat pravṛttaśakti | tathābhūtaṃ ca tadrūpopādānakāraṇaṃ ceti tathouktaṃ | tasya sahakāripratyayaḥ san | rasahetū rasaṃ janayati | tathābhūte ca hetāv anumite 'rthād rūpānumānaṃ rūparasayor ekasāmagryadhīnatvāt | indhanavikāraviśeṣo bhasmāṅgārādiḥ |
analyzed: kutas iti āha hi yasmāt pravṛttā na pratibaddhā śaktiḥ yasya tat pravṛtta śakti tathābhūtam ca tad rūpa upādānakāraṇam ca iti tathā uuktam tasya sahakāri pratyayaḥ san rasa hetuḥ rasam janayati tathābhūte ca hetau anumite rthāt rūpa anumānam rūpa rasayoḥ eka sāmagrī adhīna tvāt indhana vikāra viśeṣaḥ bhasma aṅgāra ādiḥ

original: tasyopādānaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ tasya sahakāripratyayogniḥ | tasya yathā dhūmajananan tena tulyan tadvad rūparasayor ekasāmagryadhīnatvaṃ |
analyzed: tasya upādānam kāṣṭham tasya sahakāri pratyayaḥ ugniḥ tasya yathā dhūma jananam tena tulya tadvat rūpa rasayoḥ eka sāmagrī adhīna tvam

original: rūpasya ya upādānahetavaḥ pūrvalakṣaṇasaṅgṛhītā rūpaparamāṇavasteṣāṃ rūpajananampratyābihmukhyaṃ pravṛttis asyāḥ kāraṇaṃ | rasahetunaiva sahakāriṇā rūpopādānasya svakāryaṃ pratyabhimukhyāt sāpi rasopādnakāraṇapravṛttī rūpopādānakāraṇasya rūpajananamprati yā pravṛttis tayā saha karttuṃ śīlaṃ yasyā rasopādānakāraṇapravṛtterḥ sā tathoktā |
analyzed: rūpasya ye upādāna hetavaḥ pūrva lakṣaṇa saṅgṛhītāḥ rūpa paramāṇavaḥ teṣām rūpa jananam prati ābihmukhyam pravṛttiḥ asyāḥ kāraṇam rasa hetunā eva sahakāriṇā rūpa upādānasya sva kāryam pratyabhimukhyāt sā api rasa upādna kāraṇa pravṛttiḥ rūpa upādāna kāraṇasya rūpa jananam prati yā pravṛttiḥ tayā saha karttum śīlam yasyāḥ rasa upādāna kāraṇa pravṛtteḥ sā tathā uktā

original: yata evaṃ tasmād yathābhūtād dhetor iti pravṛttaśaktirūpopādānakraṇasahitāt pūrvakṣaṇasaṅgṛhītād rasāl (p.49) liṅgatvenābhimato rasa uttnas tathābhūtam eva hetum anumāpayan gamayan samānakālaṃ rūpaṃ gamayati | tenāyam artho hetuniścya evevṛśo nānyaḥ |
analyzed: yatas evam tasmāt yathābhūtāt hetoḥ iti pravṛtta śakti rūpa upādāna kraṇa sahitāt pūrva kṣaṇa saṅgṛhītāt rasāt liṅga tvena abhimataḥ rasaḥ uttnaḥ tathābhūtam eva hetum anumāpayan gamayan samāna kālam rūpam gamayati tena ayam arthaḥ hetu niścyaḥ eva īvṛśaḥ na anyaḥ

original: na punar anumitāt kāraṇāt paścāt kāryānumānaṃ yataś ca kryajanakatvenaiva hetudharmaniścayo nānyathā tenaivāha – iti tatrāpītyādi | iti anena dvāreṇa | tatrāpi rasāde rūpādyanumāne 'tītānām ekakālānāṃ ca gitiḥ | rasopādānasamānakālabhāvino 'tītāḥ | liṅgabhūtarasasahabhāvina ekakālās teṣāṅ gatiḥ |
analyzed: na punar anumitāt kāraṇāt paścāt kārya anumānam yatas ca krya janaka tvena eva hetu dharma niścayaḥ na anyathā tena eva āha iti tatra api ityādi iti anena dvāreṇa tatra api rasa ādeḥ rūpa ādi anumāne tītānām eka kālānām ca gitiḥ tītāḥ liṅga bhūta rasa sahabhāvinaḥ eka kālāḥ teṣām gatiḥ

original: nā 'nāgatānām varttamānena liṅgenānumānaṃ vyavbhicāt | anāgataṃ hi kāraṇāntarapratibaddhantatra pratibandhavaikalyasambhavān na bhaved api | yac cādyodayāt śvaḥ sūryodayādyanumānan na tadanumānaṃ niyāmakaliṅgābhāvāt | adya gardabhavarśanāt śvaḥ sūryodayānumānavat | tasmād ityam api rasāde rūpādigatiḥ kāryaliṅgajetyanumānaṃ |
analyzed: nā nāgatānām varttamānena liṅgena anumānam vyavbhicāt anāgatam hi kāraṇa antara pratibaddham tatra pratibandha vaikalya sambhavāt na bhavet api yat ca adya udayāt śvas sūrya udaya ādi anumānan na tat anumānam niyāmaka liṅga abhāvāt adya gardabha varśanāt śvas sūrya udaya anumāna vat tasmāt api rasa ādeḥ rūpa ādi gatiḥ kārya liṅga jā iti anumānam

original: yatś ca sādhyāyattatvena hetur gamakas tena kāraṇena trividhād dhetor nānyo hetuḥ saṃyogyādir gamako 'sti | kasmāt tādātmyatadutpattibhyāṃ liṅginyapratibaddhasvabhāvasyāvinābhāvaniyamābhāvāt |
analyzed: yatas ca sādhya āyatta tvena hetuḥ gamakaḥ tena kāraṇena trividhāt hetoḥ na anyaḥ hetuḥ saṃyogi ādiḥ gamakaḥ sti kasmāt tādātmya tad utpattibhyām liṅginī apratibaddha svabhāvasya avinābhāva niyama abhāvāt

original: etad uktam bhavati | na tāvad aśliṣṣṭānāṃ saṃyogo 'sti | śliṣṭānām api kiṃ saṃyogena svahetubhyaḥ eva śliṣṭānām utpatteḥ | tasmān na saṃyogavaśād gamakatvamapratibaddhatvāt | ghaṭaghaṭayor iva | tathā pṛthaksiddhānān na samavāyaḥ |
