original: nanu duḥkhiviśeṣadarśanamātreṇābhyāsabalotpādinīty anataram evāyam arthaḥ uktaḥ |
analyzed: nanu duḥkhi viśeṣa darśana mātreṇa abhyāsa bala utpādinī iti anataram eva ayam arthaḥ uktaḥ

original: satyaṃ | karuṇām evāśrityādhunā sarvāṇyeveti viśerṣaḥ | ātmadarśananivṛttāv api tarhi karuṇāvadabhyāsād rāgādayaḥ pravarttanta ity āha – naivaṃ rāgādayas sajātīyābhyāsavṛttayo yenātmadṛṣṭinivṛttāv api pravartteran | ātmādiviparyāsābhāve 'bhāvāt |
analyzed: satyam karuṇām eva āśritya adhunā sarvāṇi eva iti viśerṣaḥ ātma darśana nivṛttau api tarhi karuṇā vat abhyāsāt rāga ādayaḥ pravarttante iti āha na evam rāga ādayaḥ sajātīya abhyāsa vṛttayaḥ yena ātma dṛṣṭi nivṛttau api pravartteran ātma ādi viparyāsa abhāve bhāvāt

original: kāruṇikasya niṣphalaḥ parārtha ārambho 'viparyāsādātmādyabhiniveśābhāvena svārthasyaivābhāvāt | nāyan doṣaḥ parārthasyaiva phalatveneṣṭatvāt | iṣṭo nāma parārthas tathāpi kathaṃ phalatvam iti cet | āha – icchetyādi | icchyā lakṣyata itīcchālakṣaṇam icchāviṣayatvād ity arthaḥ | yadiṣṭantatphalam iti yāvat |
analyzed: kāruṇikasya niṣphalaḥ parārthe ārambhaḥ viparyāsāt ātma ādi abhiniveśa abhāvena svārthasya eva abhāvāt na āyan doṣaḥ parārthasya eva phala tvena iṣṭa tvāt iṣṭaḥ nāma parārthaḥ tathā api katham phala tvam iti ced āha icchā ityādi icchyā lakṣyate iti icchā lakṣaṇam icchā viṣaya tvāt iti arthaḥ yat iṣṭam tat phalam iti yāvat

original: nanv aham iti buddhirahitasya kathaṃ parārthāpi pravṛttir iti cet (|) na (|) akliṣṭā jñānasadbhāvāt pravṛttir ity eke | yogabalena śuddhalaukikacittasammukhīkaraṇād ity apare | vineyānāṃ tathā pratibhāsanād ity anye |
analyzed: nanu aham iti buddhi rahitasya katham parārthā api pravṛttiḥ iti ced na akliṣṭā jñāna sadbhāvāt pravṛttiḥ iti eke yoga balena śuddha laukika citta sammukhīkaraṇāt iti apare vineyānām tathā pratibhāsanāt iti anye

original: sarvathetyupasaṃhāraḥ | yadi vacanād vītarāgasya vaktukāmatā sādhyate atha karuṇā tena sarāga ity ucyate | sarvathā 'bhūtāsamāropād vītarāgādir nirdoṣaḥ | doṣasvabhāvasya rāgāder avaśyabhāvāt | tad anyena rāgādibhyonyena vaktukāmatādinā vītarāgasya (p.54) doṣavattvasādhane na kiṃcid aniṣṭaṃ |
analyzed: sarvathā iti upasaṃhāraḥ yadi vacanāt vīta rāgasya vaktukāma tā sādhyate atha karuṇā tena sa rāgaḥ iti ucyate sarvathā bhūta asamāropāt vīta rāga ādiḥ nirdoṣaḥ doṣa svabhāvasya rāga ādeḥ avaśya bhāvāt tat anyena rāga ādibhyaḥ anyena vaktukāma tā ādinā vīta rāgasya doṣavat tva sādhane na kiṃcid aniṣṭam

original: syān matiḥ (|) vaktaryātmani rāgādir dṛṣṭas tataḥ sapakṣe sattvadarśanamāreṇa vītarāgābhimateṣv apy anumānam bhaviṣyatītyāha – vaktaryātmanītyādi | anyatra tadanumāna iti vītarāgābhimate rāgādyanumāne 'tiprasaṅgaḥ | vaktaryātmani yāvān kaścid viśeṣo dṛṣṭas tasya sarvasyānyatrānumānaprasaṅgaḥ |
analyzed: syāt matiḥ vaktari ātmani rāga ādiḥ dṛṣṭaḥ tatas sapakṣe sattva darśana māreṇa vīta rāga abhimateṣu api anumānam bhaviṣyati iti āha vaktari ātmani ityādi anyatra tad anumāne iti vīta rāga abhimate rāga ādi anumāne tiprasaṅgaḥ vaktari ātmani yāvān kaścid viśeṣaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ tasya sarvasya anyatra anumāna prasaṅgaḥ

original: ātmani dṛṣṭasya śyāmagauratādilakṣaṇasya viśeṣasya vyabhicārāt | ananyānumāna iti rāgādanyasyātmagatasya viśeṣasyānumāne | iheti sādhyābhimate rāgādāv apy avyabhicāra iti ko niścayaḥ | naiva kaścit | pratibandhābhāvād rāgavacanayoḥ | yasmād ātmanirdarśanān nānumānan tasmāt karaṇaguṇavaktukāmate vacanam anumāpayet |
analyzed: ātmani dṛṣṭasya śyāma gaura tā ādi lakṣaṇasya viśeṣasya vyabhicārāt ananya anumāne iti rāgāt anyasya ātma gatasya viśeṣasya anumāne iha iti sādhya abhimate rāga ādau api avyabhicāraḥ iti kaḥ niścayaḥ na eva kaścid pratibandha abhāvāt rāga vacanayoḥ yasmāt ātma nirdarśanāt tasmāt karaṇa guṇa vaktu kāmate vacanam anumāpayet

original: karṇaguṇas tālvādīnām pāṭavādiḥ sa ca vaktukāmatā ceti dvandvaḥ | dvitīyādvivacanam evaitat | rāgotpādanayogyatārahite pāṣāṇādau vacanādarśanāt | saiva vacanādavasīyata ity āha – rāgetyādi | tadanumāna iti yogyatānumāne 'tiprasaṅgaḥ |
analyzed: karṇa guṇaḥ tālu ādīnām pāṭava ādiḥ sa ca vaktu kāma tā ca iti dvandvaḥ dvitīyā dvivacanam eva etat rāga utpādana yogyatā rahite pāṣāṇa ādau vacana adarśanāt sā eva vacanāt avasīyate iti āha rāga ityādi tad anumāne iti yogyatā anumāne tiprasaṅgaḥ

original: tathā hi yathā pāṣāṇādau rāgotpādanayogyatāvirahas tathā sarvapuruṣadharmair api tatas tathābhūte vacanādarśanād yadi rāgotpādanayogyatānumānam evaṃ sarvapuruṣadharmasya |
analyzed: tathā hi yathā pāṣāṇa ādau rāga utpādana yogyatā virahaḥ tathā sarva puruṣa dharmaiḥ api tatas tathābhūte vacana adarśanāt yadi rāga utpādana yogyatā anumānam evam sarva puruṣa dharmasya

original: atha mataṃ (|) rāgotpādanayogyatā hi rāgavacanayor ekaṅkāraṇantadanumāne ca rāgopy arthatonumito bhavati tena yogyatā evānumānaṃ na sarveṣāṃ pruṣadharmāṇām ity atrāha (|) rāgasyetyādi | rāgasyānupayoge vacanaṃ prati tālvādivyāpārād eva śabdaniṣpateḥ | kathan tacchaktiḥ rāgaśakti(r) vacanaṃ pratyupayujyate |
analyzed: atha matam rāga utpādana yogyatā hi rāga vacanayoḥ ekam kāraṇam tad anumāne ca rāgaḥ upī arthataḥ numitaḥ bhavati tena yogyatā eva anumānam na sarveṣām iti atra āha rāgasya ityādi rāgasya anupayoge vacanam prati tālu ādi vyāpārāt eva śabda niṣpateḥ katham tad śaktiḥ rāga śaktiḥ vacanam pratyupayujyate

original: atha tālvādivyāpārakāle rāgaśakter api vacanampratyupayoga iṣyate (|) tataś cādyavarṇṇaniṣpattikāle rāgasyāpi niṣpattir ekasāmagrayadhīnatvāt (|) tasya ca rāgasya santānavāhitvan tathā ca dvitīyādivarṇṇaniṣpatau rāga evopayuktas syāt | tad āha (|) śaktyupayoge hi sa evopayuktaḥ syād iti | na ca rāgasyopayogo 'stīty uktaṃ prāk |
analyzed: atha tālu ādi vyāpāra kāle rāga śakteḥ api vacanam pratyupayogaḥ iṣyate tatas ca ādya varṇṇa niṣpatti kāle rāgasya api niṣpattiḥ eka sāmagray adhīna tvāt tasya ca rāgasya tathā ca dvitīya ādi varṇṇa niṣpatau rāgaḥ eva upayuktaḥ syāt tat āha śakti upayoge hi saḥ eva upayuktaḥ syāt iti na ca rāgasya upayogaḥ u sti iti uktam prāk

original: atha vātmātmīyābhiniveśarahitānāṃ rāgasyānupayoge vacanaṃ prati | kathaṃ tacchaktī rāgaśaktir vāsanākhyātmātmīyābhiniveśalakṣaṇā vacanam pratyupayujyate | vītarāgāṇām (p.55) ātmādyabhiniveśasyābhāvāt | śaktyupayoge hi vacanaṃ prati | sa eva rāga upayuktaḥ syād ātmādyabhiniveśavatāṃ sarveṣām eva rāgitvāt |
analyzed: atha vā ātma ātmīya abhiniveśa rahitānām rāgasya anupayoge vacanam prati katham tad śaktiḥ rāga śaktiḥ vāsanā ākhyā ātma ātmīya abhiniveśa lakṣaṇā vacanam pratyupayujyate vīta rāgāṇām ātma ādi abhiniveśasya abhāvāt śakti upayoge hi vacanam prati saḥ eva rāgaḥ upayuktaḥ syāt ātma ādi abhiniveśavatām sarveṣām eva rāgi tvāt

original: tac ca rāgasya vacanaṃ pratyupayogitvan nāstīty uktaṃ | vaktukāmatā sāmānyahetutvād ity atrāntare |
analyzed: tat ca rāgasya vacanam pratyupayogi tvat nā asti iti uktam vaktu kāma tā sāmānya hetu tvāt iti atra antare

original: tasmād ityādi nigamanam. nāntarīyakam eveti kāraṇenāvinābhāvy eva, tatpratibandhāt tatra kāraṇe āyattatvāt. nānyad apratibaddhaṃ vipakṣe hetor adarśane 'pi, arvāgdarśanasyādarśanamātreṇāniścayāt. sarvadarśinas tu darśananivṛttyā syān niścayaḥ. tasya hi sarvajñeyavyāpi jñānam. etad evāha – sarvadarśana ityādi.
analyzed: tasmāt ityādi nigamanam nāntarīyakam eva iti kāraṇena avinābhāvi eva tad pratibandhāt tatra kāraṇe āyatta tvāt na anyat apratibaddham vipakṣe hetoḥ adarśane arvāk darśanasya adarśana mātreṇa aniścayāt sarva darśinaḥ tu darśana nivṛttyā syāt niścayaḥ tasya hi sarvajñeya vyāpi jñānam etat eva āha sarva darśanaḥ ityādi

original: kim punar adarśanamātrān nābhāvaniścaya ity āha – kvacit tathetyādi. tena prakāreṇa dṛṣṭānāṃ prāk | punar deśakālasaṃskārabhedeneti bhedaśabdasya pratyekaṃ sambandhaḥ. saṃskāraḥ kṣīrāvasekādiḥ. pūrvadṛṣṭaprakārād anyathā syāt. kim ivetyāha – yathāmalakya iti saṃskārabhedasyaitad udāharaṇam.
analyzed: kim punar adarśana mātrāt na abhāva niścayaḥ iti āha kvacid tathā ityādi tena prakāreṇa dṛṣṭānām prāk punar deśa kāla saṃskāra bhedena iti bheda śabdasya pratyekam sambandhaḥ saṃskāraḥ kṣīra avaseka ādiḥ pūrva dṛṣṭa prakārāt anyathā syāt kim iva iti āha yathā āmalakyaḥ iti saṃskāra bhedasya etat udāharaṇam

original: na caivam bahulam iti na madhuraphalā bahulaṃ dṛśyante, kaṣāyaphalānāṃ bāhulyena darśanāt. na cedānīṃ bahulaṃ madhuraphalānām adarśanāt | kvacit sambhavati no madhuraphalasya pratikṣepaḥ. tathā deśabhedena piṇḍakharjjūrasya sambhavaḥ | kālabhedena puṣpādeḥ |
analyzed: na ca evam bahulam iti na madhura phalāḥ bahulam dṛśyante kaṣāya phalānām bāhulyena darśanāt na ca idānīm bahulam madhura phalānām adarśanāt kvacid sambhavati no madhura phalasya pratikṣepaḥ tathā deśa bhedena piṇḍakharjjūrasya sambhavaḥ kāla bhedena puṣpa ādeḥ

original: āmalakīdṛṣṭāntena caitad āha – yathāmalakyaḥ kṣīrādisaṃskārād anyathā bhavanti, tathā rāgādiyogyaś cittasantānas tattvābhyāsābhisaṃskārād yogyo bhavati. abhyāsāc ca nairātmyālambanam eva vijñānaṃ spaṣṭābham vairārāgyam ucyate. nairātmyadarśanād ātmādyabhiniveśavigamena rāgādyanutpatteḥ.
analyzed: āmalakī dṛṣṭāntena ca etat āha yathā āmalakyaḥ kṣīra ādi saṃskārāt anyathā bhavanti tathā rāga ādi yogyaḥ citta santānaḥ tattva abhyāsa abhisaṃskārāt yogyaḥ bhavati abhyāsāt ca nairātmya ālambanam eva vijñānam spaṣṭa ābham vairārāgyam ucyate nairātmya darśanāt ātma ādi abhiniveśa vigamena rāga ādi anutpatteḥ

original: sarvadharmakṣaṇikatvādyālambanaṃ ca jñānaṃ spaṣṭābhaṃ sarvajñatvaṃ cocyate, sarvājñānivigamāt. tasmāt tattvābhyāsanimittā sphuṭābhatvavṛddhir eva tattvasākṣātkaraṇena pratyakṣatvakāriṇī rāgādiyogyasvabhāvatāṃ jñānasya bādhate. tataś cānyathādṛṣṭam api hetubalād anyathā bhaved api.
analyzed: sarva dharma kṣaṇika tva ādi ālambanam ca jñānam spaṣṭa ābham sarvajñatvam ca ucyate sarva ajñāni vigamāt tasmāt tattva abhyāsa nimittā sphuṭa ābha tva vṛddhiḥ eva tattva sākṣātkaraṇena pratyakṣa tva kāriṇī rāga ādi yogya svabhāva tām jñānasya bādhate tatas ca anyathā dṛṣṭam api hetu balāt anyathā bhavet api

original: tena yadi nāma rāgārahite kvacid vacanaṃ na dṛṣṭantāvatā sarvatra vītarāge vacanena na bhāvyam iti nāsit niścayaḥ. tataś cāniścitavyatirekād vacanamātrān na rāgadyanumānam, yat evaṃ tena kāraṇenaitad yuktaṃ vaktuṃ mādṛśo vaktā | yo 'ham ivāyoniśomanaskārān. tad evāha – rāgotpattītyādi. kaḥ punar asāv ity āha – ātmetyādi.
analyzed: tena yadi nāma rāga arahite kvacid vacanam na dṛṣṭa ntāvatā sarvatra vīta rāge vacanena na bhāvyam iti na asit niścayaḥ tatas ca aniścita vyatirekāt vacana mātrāt na rāga ādi anumānam yat evam tena kāraṇena etat yuktam vaktum mādṛśaḥ vaktā yaḥ ham iva a yoniśaḥ manaskārān tat eva āha rāga utpatti ityādi kaḥ punar asau iti āha ātmā ityādi

original: ātmadarśanaṃ satkāyadṛṣṭiḥ. nityasukhādiviparyāso 'yoniśo manaskāraḥ. dvandvasamāsaś cāyam. ātmadarśanam evāyoniśomanaskāra iti viśeṣaṇasamāso (p.56) vā. tadeti mādṛśo vakteti viśeṣaṇe 'py apārthako vacanodāhāraḥ. vacanād ity asya hetor udāharaṇam anarthakam ity arthaḥ. tadā hi yo mādṛśo rāgotpattipratyayaviśeṣṇa yuktaḥ, sa rāgī.
analyzed: ātma darśanam sat kāya dṛṣṭiḥ nitya sukha ādi viparyāsaḥ yoniśas manaskāraḥ dvandva samāsaḥ ca ayam ātma darśanam eva a yoniśas manaskāraḥ iti viśeṣaṇa samāsaḥ vā tadā iti mādṛśaḥ vaktā iti viśeṣaṇe pi apārthakaḥ vacana udāhāraḥ vacanāt iti asya hetoḥ udāharaṇam anarthakam iti arthaḥ tadā hi yaḥ mādṛśaḥ rāga utpatti pratyaya viśeṣṇa yuktaḥ sa rāgī

original: yathāham ity ayam eva hetuḥ syāt, yata evam adarśanamātrān nāsti niścayas. tasmād vipakṣe 'dṛṣṭo 'dṛṣṭavipakṣe hetor adarśanam ahetur liṅgasya vyatirekaniścayaṃ prati ||
analyzed: yathā aham iti ayam eva hetuḥ syāt yatas evam adarśana mātrāt na asti niścayaḥ tasmāt vipakṣe dṛṣṭaḥ dṛṣṭa vipakṣe hetoḥ adarśanam ahetuḥ liṅgasya vyatireka niścayam prati

original: on PV(SV) 1.13
analyzed: or

original: syān matiḥ – vipakṣadṛṣṭyā hetor vyabhicāraḥ. na ca vītarāge vacanaṃ dṛṣṭam. tasmād adarśanāt sādhyābhāve vyatirekaḥ siddha ity ata āha – na cādarśanamātreṇeti vipakṣe hetor avyabhicāritā. kasmāt? sambhāvyavyabhicāratvāt sambhāvyovyabhicāratvāt. sambhāvyo vyabhicāro yasya, sa tathā tadbhāvaḥ, tasmāt.
analyzed: syāt matiḥ vipakṣa dṛṣṭyā hetoḥ vyabhicāraḥ na ca vīta rāge vacanam dṛṣṭam tasmāt adarśanāt sādhya abhāve vyatirekaḥ siddhaḥ iti atas āha na ca adarśana mātreṇa iti vipakṣe hetoḥ avyabhicāri tā kasmāt sambhāvya vyabhicāra tvāt sambhāvyaḥ vyabhicāra tvāt sambhāvyaḥ vyabhicāraḥ yasya sa tathā tad bhāvaḥ tasmāt

original: yady api na dṛṣṭo vipakṣe, tathāpi tatra sambhavo na viruddha it sambhāvyate vyabhicāraḥ. sthālyantargatās taṇḍulāḥ sthālītaṇḍulāḥ, teṣāṃ pākavat.
analyzed: yadi api na dṛṣṭaḥ vipakṣe tathā api tatra sambhavaḥ na viruddhaḥ sambhāvyate vyabhicāraḥ sthālī antargatāḥ taṇḍulāḥ sthālī taṇḍulāḥ teṣām pāka vat

original: etam eva dṛṣṭāntaṃ samarthayitum āha – na hītyādi. bāhulyena sthālyantargatānāṃ pakvānāndarśane 'pi na sthālyantargatatvena kevalena pākaḥ sidhyati. mātragrahaṇan tu viśeṣanirāsārtham, yad vakṣyati – evaṃ tu syād iti. kuto 'siddhiḥ? vyabhicārasya darśanāt. evaṃsvabhāvā iti ye pakvā dṛṣṭāḥ, tais tulyasvabhāvāḥ.
analyzed: etam eva dṛṣṭāntam samarthayitum āha na hi ityādi bāhulyena sthālī antargatānām pakvānām darśane na sthālī antargata tvena kevalena pākaḥ sidhyati mātra grahaṇam tu viśeṣa nirāsa artham yat vakṣyati evam tu syāt iti siddhiḥ vyabhicārasya darśanāt evaṃsvabhāvāḥ iti ye pakvāḥ dṛṣṭāḥ taiḥ tulya svabhāvāḥ

original: etair eva pakvaiḥ samānaḥ pākahetuḥ, yeṣāṃ te pakvā iti. anyathā tv ity asaty tasmin viśeṣaṇe śeṣo 'stīti, śeṣavad anirṇīto viṣayo 'stīti yāvat. tac ca vyabhicāri.
analyzed: etaiḥ eva pakvaiḥ samānaḥ pāka hetuḥ yeṣām te pakvāḥ iti anyathā tu iti asati tasmin viśeṣaṇe śeṣaḥ sti iti śeṣa vat anirṇītaḥ viṣayaḥ sti iti yāvat tat ca vyabhicāri

original: kva punar ācāryeṇa pratijñātam ity āha – yad etyādi | nyāyamukhe caitad uktaṃ | yad ubhayaṃ vaktavyam iti sādharmyaṃ vaidharmyaṃ ca | kasya pratipakṣeṇa kim uktam ity āha – viruddhetyādi | sādhanasya vacanaṃ viruddhapratipakṣeṇa vaikdharmyavacanam anakāntikapratipakṣeṇa | yady adṛṣṭiphalantac ca | adarśanamātraphalan tac ceti vaidharmyavacanaṃ |
analyzed: kva punar ācāryeṇa pratijñātam iti āha yat ā ityādi nyāya mukhe ca etat uktam yat ubhayam vaktavyam iti sādharmyam vaidharmyam ca kasya pratipakṣeṇa kim uktam iti āha viruddha ityādi sādhanasya vacanam viruddha pratipakṣeṇa vaikdharmya vacanam anakāntika pratipakṣeṇa yadi adṛṣṭi phalat tat ca adarśana mātra phalat tat ca iti vaidharmya vacanam

original: (p.59) etad eva vyācaṣṭe – yadītyādi | teneti vaidharmyavacanena vipakṣe hetor adarśanaṃ khyāpyate | tad ity adarśnam anukte 'pi vaidharmye gamyate | darśnābhāvalakṣaṇasyādarśnasya vaidharmyavacanāt prāg api siddhatvāt | tasmād apārthakamvaidharmyavacanaṃ |
analyzed: etat eva vyācaṣṭe yadi ityādi tena iti vaidharmya vacanena vipakṣe hetoḥ adarśanam khyāpyate tat iti adarśnam anukte vaidharmye gamyate darśna abhāva lakṣaṇasya adarśnasya vaidharmya vacanāt prāk api siddha tvāt tasmāt apārthakam vaidharmya vacanam

original: hetor darśanabhrāntir vipakṣe 'sti tannivṛtyartham vaidharmyavacanam iti ced āha – na hītyādi | tasyeti pratipādyasya vaidharmyavacanāt prāk | htor vipakṣe darśanabhrāntir asti yāvaidharmyavananena vivarttyate | tasmād etad yathā sapakṣe hetor darśane na bhrāntiḥ kin tu tadvismṛtim iti sādharmyavacanena smaryate |
analyzed: hetoḥ darśana bhrāntiḥ vipakṣe sti tad nivṛti artham vaidharmya vacanam iti ced āha na hi ityādi tasya iti pratipādyasya vaidharmya vacanāt prāk vipakṣe darśana bhrāntiḥ asti yā a vaidharmya vananena vivarttyate tasmāt etat yathā sapakṣe hetoḥ darśane na bhrāntiḥ kin tu tad vismṛtim iti sādharmya vacanena smaryate

original: tathā smṛtir vācā vaidharmyavananenādarśane kriyata iti cet | dṛṣṭāntam eva vighaṭayium āha – darśanam ityādi | darśanam apratīyamānam asmaryamāṇaṃ na sādhyapratipattyaṅgim iti yuktan tatreti darśane vācā smaraṇādhānaṃ smṛtijananaṃ | adarśanārthan tu na yuktaṃ | yasmād adarśanan tu darśanābhāvo hetor vipakṣe | sa darśanena bādhyate |
analyzed: tathā smṛtiḥ vācā vaidharmya vananena adarśane kriyate iti ced dṛṣṭāntam eva vighaṭayium āha darśanam ityādi darśanam apratīyamānam asmaryamāṇam na sādhya pratipatti aṅgim iti yuktan tatra iti darśane vācā smaraṇa ādhānam smṛti jananam adarśana arthan tu na yuktam yasmāt adarśanam tu darśana abhāvaḥ hetoḥ vipakṣe sa darśanena bādhyate

original: tadabhāve vipakṣadarśanābhāve sidda eva darśanābhāva ity apārthakantatsiddhye darśanābhāvasiddhaye vaidharmyavacanaṃ | ayam abhiprāyo darśanam parokṣatvād vismaryeteti tatsmaraṇārtham vacanaṃ yuktaṃ | darśanābhāvas tu darśananivṛttirūpaḥ sa ca darśanānubhavābhāvād eva pratibhāsate (|) pratibhāsamānasya ca kiṃ smaraṇena |
analyzed: tad abhāve vipakṣa darśana abhāve siddaḥ eva darśana abhāvaḥ iti apārthakam tad siddhye darśana abhāva siddhaye vaidharmya vacanam ayam abhiprāyaḥ darśanam parokṣa tvāt vismaryeta iti tad smaraṇa artham vacanam yuktam darśana abhāvaḥ tu darśana nivṛtti rūpaḥ sa ca darśana anubhava abhāvāt eva pratibhāsate pratibhāsamānasya ca kim smaraṇena

original: tatsiddhaye 'pārthakamvacanaṃ ||

original: na vai anupalabhamānasya puṃsastāvatety adarśanamātreṇa vipakṣe hetur nāstīty evaṃ niścayo bhavati deśādiviprakṛṣṭānām anupalambhe 'pi sattvāt | tadarthan nāstīti niścayotpādanārtham vaidharmyavacanam iti cet tan na | yasmān na ca nāstīti vacanād apramāṇakāt tatpratikṣipyamāṇaṃ nāsty eva | kathan tarhi nāstīti gamyata ity āha – yathetyādi |

original: etad uktam bhavati | hetoḥ svasādhye pratibandhagrāhakam eva pramāṇaṃ sādhyāyattatāgrāhakan tac ceha darśanam abhipretaṃ yac ca sādhya eva hetor darśanam idam eva sarvatra vipakṣe 'darśanaṃ |

original: tena yasy asādhyasādhanayoḥ pratibandhagrāhakaṃ darśanaṃ pravṛttam iva smṛtaṃ ca tasyaiva puṃsaḥ darśanād adarśanayoḥ pratītayoḥ sādharmyavaidharmyavacanābhyāṃ smaraṇaṃ kriyate nāny asyety arthaḥ | yad āha (|) pramāṇaṃ dṛṣṭāntābhyām upadarśyata iti | yathā yadi nāsti sa khyāpyata (p.60) iti |

original: yathā yena prakāreṇa svasādhyapratibandhena vipakṣe hetur nāsti yadi sa nyāya iti pratibandhagrāhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ khyāpyate smaryate tadā nāstīti gamyate | na tu pratibandhamantareṇa (|)

analyzed: nanu ityādi paraḥ tad abhāve sādhya abhāve nupalambhāt asiddhā vyāvṛttiḥ hetoḥ ayam eva nyāyaḥ iti manyate yadi adṛṣṭyāḥ hetoḥ vipakṣāt nivṛttiḥ syāt tadā śeṣavat anumānam vyabhicāri kim na eva vyabhicāri syāt kīdṛśam punar tat iti āha yathā ityādi etāni phalāni iti upayuktāt anyāni

original: ayaṃ ca dharminirddeḥaḥ pakvānyevaṃ rasāmni ceti sādhyadharmaḥ | evaṃ rasāni madhurāṇyamlāni vā | rūpāviśeṣād iti hetuḥ | upayuktasya phalasya yadrūpaṃ raktatādi | tena tulyatvāt | ekaśākhāprabhavād veti hetuḥ | upayuktavad iti dṛṣṭāntaḥ | kasmād adarśanamātrād vyatireka iṣyamāṇe śeṣavatovyabhicāritvaṃ syād ity āha – atrāpītyādi |
analyzed: ayam ca pakvāni evam rasa āmni ca iti sādhya dharmaḥ evam rasāni madhurāṇi amlāni vā rūpa aviśeṣāt iti hetuḥ upayuktasya phalasya yat rūpam rakta tā ādi tena tulya tvāt eka śākhā prabhavāt vā iti hetuḥ upayukta vat iti dṛṣṭāntaḥ kasmāt adarśana mātrāt vyatireke iṣyamāṇe śeṣavataḥ vyabhicāri tvam syāt iti āha atra api ityādi

original: atra śeṣavad anumāne vivakṣitaṃ rūpaviśeṣādiyuktam upabhuktād anyatphalantasyāśeṣasya pakṣīkaraṇe | heto rūpādiśeṣādikasya sādhyābhāvenupalaṃbho 'stīti vipakṣāvyāvṛttir ataś cāvyabhicāritā syāt | tathā hi yat pakṣīkṛtaṃ phalaṃ yac copayuktaṃ sapakṣatvenopāttan tad vyatirekeṇa vipakṣabhūte tṛtīye rāśau nāsti yathoktasya hetor vṛttiḥ |
analyzed: atra śeṣavat anumāne vivakṣitam rūpa viśeṣa ādi yuktam upabhuktāt anyat phalam tasya aśeṣasya pakṣīkaraṇe hetoḥ rūpa ādi śeṣa ādikasya sti iti vipakṣa avyāvṛttiḥ atas ca avyabhicāri tā syāt tathā hi yat pakṣīkṛtam phalam yat ca upayuktam sapakṣa tvena upāttam tat vyatirekeṇa vipakṣa bhūte tṛtīye rāśau na asti yathā uktasya hetoḥ vṛttiḥ

original: pratyakṣabādhetyādi | kadācid ekaśākhāprabhavasyāpi phalasyāpakvasyāt adrasasya vā pratyakṣṇānubhavasambhavāt pratyakṣabādhāśaṅkā eva śeṣavato vyabhicra ity eke īśavarasena prabhṛtayaḥ | tad ayam artho na kevalābhyāmanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ hetur gamakaḥ (,a)pi tv abādhitaviṣayatve satīti | netyādinā pariharati |
analyzed: pratyakṣa bādhā ityādi kadācid eka śākhā prabhavasya api phalasya apakva syāt adrasasya vā pratyakṣṇā anubhava sambhavāt pratyakṣa bādhā āśaṅkā eva śeṣavataḥ iti eke īśava rasena prabhṛtayaḥ tat ayam arthaḥ na kevalābhyām anvaya vyatirekābhyām hetuḥ gamakaḥ api tu abādhita viṣaya tve sati iti na ityādinā pariharati

original: pakṣīkṛto yoviṣayaḥ parokṣas tatra pratyakṣabādhāyā abhāvāt | na pravṛttena pratyakṣeṇa bādhāśaṅkā kin tu kadācid gandhapratyakṣabādhāpakṣa iti ced āha – tathetyādi tathā kadācit pratyakṣabādhā bhaved ity āśaṅkāyām atiprasaṅgaḥ | yasmād anyatrābhimate hetau pratyakṣabādhāyā abhāvaniyamābhāvāt |
analyzed: pakṣīkṛtaḥ yaḥ viṣayaḥ parokṣaḥ tatra pratyakṣa bādhāyāḥ abhāvāt na pravṛttena pratyakṣeṇa bādhā śaṅkā kin tu kadācid gandha pratyakṣa bādhā pakṣe iti ced āha tathā ityādi tathā kadācid pratyakṣa bādhā bhavet iti āśaṅkāyām atiprasaṅgaḥ yasmāt anyatra abhimate hetau pratyakṣa bādhāyāḥ abhāva niyama abhāvāt

original: na hi sambandhābhyupagame parsya bādhāśaṅkā nivartata iti bhāvaḥ | tasmāt pratibandhānabhyupagamavādinā vṛttaṃ pramāṇaṃ bādhakam eṣṭavyaṃ | avṛttabādhane 'pravṛttenaiva pramāṇena bādhane sarvatrānāśvāsaḥ sarvatra hetau na syād āśvāso gamakatvaniścayaḥ | bādhakasya śaṃkyamānatvāt |
analyzed: na hi sambandha abhyupagame bādhā śaṅkā nivartate iti bhāvaḥ tasmāt pratibandha anabhyupagama vādinā vṛttam pramāṇam bādhakam eṣṭavyam avṛtta bādhane pravṛttena eva pramāṇena bādhane sarvatra anāśvāsaḥ sarvatra hetau na syāt āśvāsaḥ gamaka tva niścayaḥ bādhakasya śaṃkyamāna tvāt

original: naivaṃ pratibandhavādinaḥ sarvatra hetāv anāśvāsaḥ sādhyapratibaddhe hetau bādhāśaṃkāyā apy abhāvāt | hetuprayogāt tu pūrvaṃ syād bādhāśaṃkā (|) ata eva sandigdhe hetuvacanam ucyate (|) naca vṛttaṃ pramāṇaṃ śeṣavato bādhakam asti | tasmāt sthitam etad adarśanamātrad vyatireke śeṣavato 'py avyavhicāritvaṃ (p.62) syād iti |
analyzed: na evam pratibandha vādinaḥ sarvatra hetau anāśvāsaḥ sādhya pratibaddhe hetau bādhā śaṃkāyāḥ api abhāvāt hetu prayogāt tu pūrvam syāt bādhā śaṃkā atas eva sandigdhe hetu vacanam ucyate na ca vṛttam pramāṇam śeṣavataḥ bādhakam asti tasmāt sthitam etat vyatireke śeṣavataḥ pi avyavhicāri tvam syāt iti

original: nanu pratibandhabalāt sādhyābhāve hetor vyatireke sati sattāmātreṇa vyatireko gamakaḥ syād ity ata āha – vyatirekas tv ityādi | hetor yo vipakṣād vyatirekaḥ sa siddha eva niścita eva sādhanaṃ | iti hetos tathābhāvaniścayaṃ sādhyābhāve yo hetv abhvas tanniścayam apekṣate | retad āha (|) nāsmākam bhavatām iva darśanābhāvamātrād vyatirekaḥ |
analyzed: nanu pratibandha balāt sādhya abhāve hetoḥ vyatireke sati sattā mātreṇa vyatirekaḥ gamakaḥ syāt iti atas āha vyatirekaḥ tu ityādi hetoḥ yaḥ vipakṣāt vyatirekaḥ sa siddhaḥ eva niścitaḥ eva sādhanam iti hetoḥ tathābhāva niścayam sādhya abhāve yaḥ hetu abhvaḥ tad niścayam apekṣate āha na asmākam bhavatām iva darśana abhāva mātrāt vyatirekaḥ

original: kin tu sādhyasādhanayoḥ sati pratibandhe sādhyābhāve hetor vipakṣādvyāvṛttatvaṃ svagato dharmaḥ | hetoś ca yadūpan tad avaśyaṃ svaniścayam apekṣate jñāpakatvād iti | kathaṃ tv anmatena śeṣavato vyabhicāritvam iti ced āha – anupalambhāt tv ityādi | kvacid vipakṣaikadeśo hetor abhāvasiddhāv apy apratibaddhasya hetoḥ sādhye |
analyzed: kin tu sādhya sādhanayoḥ sati pratibandhe sādhya abhāve hetoḥ vipakṣāt vyāvṛtta tvam svagataḥ dharmaḥ hetoḥ ca tat avaśyam sva niścayam apekṣate jñāpaka tvāt iti katham tu anmatena śeṣavataḥ vyabhicāri tvam iti ced āha anupalambhāt tu ityādi kvacid vipakṣa eka deśaḥ hetoḥ abhāva siddhau api apratibaddhasya hetoḥ sādhye

original: tadabhāve sādhyābhāve sarvatra vipakṣ 'bhāvāsiddheḥ kārtaṇāt saṃśayas tato vipakṣād avyatireko yaḥ sa eva vyabhicāraḥ śeṣavataḥ (|)
analyzed: tad abhāve sādhya abhāve sarvatra vipakṣ bhāva asiddheḥ kārtaṇāt saṃśayaḥ tatas vipakṣāt avyatirekaḥ yaḥ saḥ eva vyabhicāraḥ śeṣavataḥ

original: kiṃceti doṣāntarasamuccayaḥ | yady adarśanād vyatirekas tadā vyatirekyapi hetuḥ syāt | kīdṛśaṃ nedaṃ nirātmakam ityādi | prasaṅgamukhena cedam uktam aprāṇādimattvaprasaṅgāt | prāṇādimatvāc ca sātmakaṃ ayaṃ ca hetuḥ sātmake kvacin na dṛṣṭo nirātmakebhyaś ca vyāvṛtta iti sādhyanivṛttau nivṛttidharmāvyatirekī kathyate |
analyzed: kiṃca iti doṣa antara samuccayaḥ yadi adarśanāt vyatirekaḥ tadā vyatirekī api hetuḥ syāt kīdṛśam na idam nirātmakam ityādi prasaṅga mukhena ca idam uktam aprāṇa ādimattva prasaṅgāt prāṇa ādima tvāt ca sātmakam ayam ca hetuḥ sātmake kvacid na dṛṣṭaḥ nirātmakebhyaḥ ca vyāvṛttaḥ iti sādhya nivṛttau nivṛtti dharma avyatirekī kathyate

original: tathā hi nirātmakeṣv ātmarahiteṣu ghaṭādiṣu dṛṣṭādṛṣṭeṣu prāṇādyadarśanāt prāṇāpānonmeṣanimeṣādarśanāt | dṛṣṭeṣu svabhāvānupalambhenaivādarśanaṃ prāṇādīnām upalabdhilakṣaṇa prāptatvāt | adṛṣṭeṣv api tajjātīyatayā | tena nairātmyaṃ prāṇādyabhāvena vyāptaṃ |
analyzed: tathā hi nirātmakeṣu ātma rahiteṣu ghaṭa ādiṣu dṛṣṭa adṛṣṭeṣu prāṇa ādi adarśanāt prāṇa apāna unmeṣa nimeṣa adarśanāt dṛṣṭeṣu svabhāva anupalambhena eva adarśanam prāṇa ādīnām upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptatvāt adṛṣṭeṣu api tad jātīya tayā tena nairātmyam prāṇa ādi abhāvena vyāptam

original: jīvaccharīre tu tannivṛttyā prāṇādimattvābhāvanivṛttyā nairātmyasya nivṛtter ātmagatiḥ syāt | tava tarhi kathaṃ saṃśayahetur iti ced āha – adṛśyetyādi | adṛśyasyātmano 'nupalambhād ghaṭādisva(?ṣva)bhāvāprasiddhau ghaṭādī(nā)n nairātmyāsiddheḥ kāraṇān nirātmakāt prāṇāder anivṛttiḥ |
analyzed: jīvat śarīre tu tad nivṛttyā prāṇa ādimattva abhāva nivṛttyā nairātmyasya nivṛtteḥ ātma gatiḥ syāt tava tarhi katham saṃśaya hetuḥ iti ced āha adṛśya ityādi adṛśyasya ātmanaḥ nupalambhāt ghaṭa ādi sva svabhāva aprasiddhau nairātmya asiddheḥ kāraṇāt nirātmakāt prāṇa ādeḥ anivṛttiḥ

original: prāṇādyabhāvena sandigdhasya nairātmyasyāpy asiddhir (p.63) iti yāvat |
analyzed: prāṇa ādi abhāvena sandigdhasya nairātmyasya api asiddhiḥ iti yāvat

original: bauddhena nairātmyamabhyugatamato 'byupagamān nirātmakatvaṃ ghaṭādeḥ siddam iti cet | yadi bauddhābhyupagamaḥ pramāṇaṃ kathim idānīm ātmasiddhir jīvaccharīre | tad api bauddhena nirātmakam iṣṭaṃ | jīvaccharīre nairātmyābhyupagama 'pramāṇakas tato 'syātmā sādhyata iti |
analyzed: bauddhena nairātmyam abhyugatam atas byupagamāt nirātmaka tvam ghaṭa ādeḥ siddam iti ced yadi bauddha abhyupagamaḥ pramāṇam idānīm ātma siddhiḥ jīvat śarīre tat api bauddhena nirātmakam iṣṭam jīvat śarīre nairātmya abhyupagama pramāṇakaḥ sādhyate iti

original: yady evaṃ parasyāpi jīvaccharīrād anyasyāpi ghaṭāder apramāṇikā kathaṃ nairātmyasiddhiḥ | na hi bauddhasyābhyupagamaḥ kvacit pramāṇaṃ kvacin neti | kiṃ cābhyupagamena kevalena sātmakānātmakau vibhajya ghaṭādyaḥ pareṇāsmābhiś cānātmakā abhyupagatāḥ | tenānātmakāḥ |
analyzed: yadi evam parasya api jīvat śarīrāt anyasya api ghaṭa ādeḥ apramāṇikā katham nairātmya siddhiḥ na hi bauddhasya abhyupagamaḥ kvacid pramāṇam kvacid na iti kim ca abhyupagamena kevalena sātmaka anātmakau vibhajya ghaṭa ādyaḥ pareṇa asmābhiḥ ca anātmakāḥ abhyupagatāḥ tena anātmakāḥ

original: jīvaccharīraṃ sātmakam asmābhir abhyupagatan tvayā tu nirātmakam evam ivabhajya tatranirātmakeṣu prāṇādīnāmabhāve nātmaviṣaye gamakatvaṃ kathayatā pareṇāgamikatvamātmani pratipannaṃ nānumeyatvaṃ | tasmād ātmano ghaṭādāv adarśanepy adṛśyasvabhāvasyātmano nivṛtty asiddher nāsi kutaścin nirātmakāt prāṇāder nnivṛttir ity agamakatvaṃ |
analyzed: jīvat śarīram sātmakam asmābhiḥ tvayā tu nirātmakam evam iva bhajya tatra nirātmakeṣu prāṇa ādīnām abhāve na ātma viṣaye gamaka tvam kathayatā pareṇa āgamika tvam ātmani pratipannam na anumeya tvam tasmāt ātmanaḥ ghaṭa ādau adarśane ipi adṛśya svabhāvasya ātmanaḥ nivṛttī asiddheḥ na asi kutaścid nirātmakāt prāṇa ādeḥ iti agamaka tvam

original: etat tāvan naivātmanaḥ kutaś cin nivṛttiḥ siddhā | abhyupagamya tūcyate | tannivṛttāv apy ātmanivṛttāv api kvacid iti dṛṣṭe ghaṭādau nivṛttāv api prāṇādīnām apratibandhādātmanā saha sambandhābhāvāt | sarvatrādṛṣṭeṣv api ghaṭādiṣv ātmanivṛttyā prāṇādīnāṃ nivṛttyasiddheḥ sandigdhavyatirekitvād (na) gamakatvaṃ |
analyzed: etat tāvat na eva ātmanaḥ kutas cit nivṛttiḥ siddhā abhyupagamya tu ucyate tad nivṛttau api ātma nivṛttau api kvacid iti dṛṣṭe ghaṭa ādau nivṛttau api prāṇa ādīnām apratibandhāt ātmanā saha sambandha abhāvāt sarvatra adṛṣṭeṣu api ghaṭa ādiṣu ātma nivṛttyā prāṇa ādīnām nivṛtti asiddheḥ sandigdha vyatireki tvāt na gamaka tvam

original: adarśanamātrād vyatirekābhyupagame saty ayam aparo doṣa ity āha – yāpītyādi | kā punḥ sety āha – tathā sapakṣe sann ityādi | ācāryasya cāyaṅgranthaḥ tatra sandihyuktam pakṣadharmo vādiprativādiniścito gṛhyate | tenobhayor anyatarasya cāsiddhasya gdhasyāśrayāsiddhasya ca vyudāsaḥ |
analyzed: adarśana mātrāt vyatireka abhyupagame sati ayam aparaḥ doṣaḥ iti āha yā api ityādi kā punar sā iti āha tathā sapakṣe san ityādi ācāryasya ca ayaṅgranthaḥ tatra sandihi uktam pakṣa dharmaḥ vādi prativādi niścitaḥ gṛhyate tena ubhayoḥ anyatarasya ca asiddhasya āśraya asiddhasya ca vyudāsaḥ

original: yathā ca pakṣadharmaniścayena caturvidhasyāsiddhasya vyudāsas tathā sapakṣ sannasannityevam ādiṣv apy anvayavyatirekaniścayena nirastam asiddhajātamanyatarāsiddhādīnāṃ sapakṣādiṣv asambhvāt | yathāyogam udāhāryam ity āha – sāpi na vācyā asiddhiyojanā | (p.64) tad vyācaṣṭe – anupalambha evetyādi.
analyzed: yathā ca pakṣa dharma niścayena caturvidhasya asiddhasya vyudāsaḥ tathā sapakṣ san asan iti evam ādiṣu api anvaya vyatireka niścayena nirastam asiddha jātam anyatara asiddha ādīnām sapakṣa ādiṣu asambhvāt yathāyogam udāhāryam iti āha sā api na vācyā asiddhi yojanā tat vyācaṣṭe anupalambhaḥ eva ityādi

original: apramāṇakenupalambha eva sati hetor vipakṣe saṃśayāt (|) katham upalambhe tad asambhavāt | vipakṣe hetor upalambhe sati tasya saṃśayasyābhāvāt | tasmād anupalambhād dhetoḥ vipakṣād vyatireka ity arthāt sandigdhavyatireko hetur iṣṭa eva | tasmāt saṃśayito 'nivāryaḥ | saṃśayena viṣayīkṛtaḥ saṃśayito vyatireko na vāryaḥ syāt |
analyzed: eva sati hetoḥ vipakṣe saṃśayāt katham upalambhe tat asambhavāt vipakṣe hetoḥ upalambhe sati tasya saṃśayasya abhāvāt tasmāt anupalambhāt hetoḥ vipakṣāt vyatirekaḥ iti arthāt sandigdha vyatirekaḥ hetuḥ iṣṭaḥ eva tasmāt saṃśayitaḥ nivāryaḥ saṃśayena viṣayīkṛtaḥ saṃśayitaḥ vyatirekaḥ na vāryaḥ syāt

original: yathāyogam udāhāryam ity ato yathāyogavacanāt saṃśayito 'nivārita eveti cet | naitad evaṃ | tadanantaram eva "ya eva tūbhayaniścayavācī"tyādi vacanāt | ya eva śabda ubhayaniścitasya trairūpyasyāsiddhatvād er vācakaḥ sa eva sādhanaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ "na cānyataraprasiddhasandigdhavācī punaḥ sādhanāpekṣaṇādi"ty ayaṃ grantha ihodāharaṇaṃ |
analyzed: yathāyogam udāhāryam iti atas yathāyoga vacanāt saṃśayitaḥ nivāritaḥ eva iti ced na etat evam tad anantaram eva yaḥ eva tu ubhaya niścaya vāci ityādi vacanāt yaḥ eva śabdaḥ ubhaya niścitasya trairūpyasya asiddha tvāt vācakaḥ saḥ eva sādhanam dūṣaṇam na ca anyatara prasiddha sandigdha vācī punar sādhana apekṣaṇāt iti ayam granthaḥ iha udāharaṇam

original: anayatarasya vādinaḥ prativādino vā (|) yosiddhaṃ sandigdham vā vakti na sa sādhanaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ vā (|) sandigdhavyatirekaniścayahetur ubhayor api vipakṣe sandigdhas tasmāt tadabhidhānam asādhanam |
analyzed: anayatarasya vādinaḥ prativādinaḥ vā yaḥ siddham sandigdham vā vakti na sa sādhanam dūṣaṇam vā sandigdha vyatireka niścaya hetuḥ ubhayoḥ api vipakṣe sandigdhaḥ tasmāt tat abhidhānam asādhanam

original: yasmād ubhayaniścita eva hetur uktas tenānupalambhe 'pi sati nivṛttisaṃśayād vipakṣād dhetor anivṛttiṃ manyamānas tasya sandigdhavyatirekasya hetutvapratiṣedham āha asiddhiyojanayā ||
analyzed: yasmāt ubhaya niścitaḥ eva hetuḥ uktaḥ tena anupalambhe sati nivṛtti saṃśayāt vipakṣāt hetoḥ anivṛttim manyamānaḥ tasya sandigdha vyatirekasya hetu tva pratiṣedham āha asiddhi yojanayā

original: kiñ ca | yady adṛṣṭyā nivṛttir iṣyate tadā viśeṣasyāsādhāraṇasya śrāvaṇatvāder vyavacchedahetutā syāt | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) nityānityayor adarśanāt | tad vyācaṣṭe – śrāvaṇatvasyāpītyādi | tathā hy adarśanamātdrād vyāvṛttir iṣṭā ( | a)sti ca nityānityayor adarśanaṃ śrāvaṇatvasya tadvyavacchedahetutā syāt | nityānityapratiṣedhahetutvam bhavet |
analyzed: kim ca yadi adṛṣṭyāḥ nivṛttiḥ iṣyate tadā viśeṣasya asādhāraṇasya śrāvaṇa tva ādeḥ vyavaccheda hetutā syāt kim kāraṇam nitya anityayoḥ adarśanāt tat vyācaṣṭe śrāvaṇa tvasya api ityādi tathā hi adarśana mātdrāt vyāvṛttiḥ iṣṭā asti ca nitya anityayoḥ adarśanam śrāvaṇa tvasya tad vyavaccheda hetutā syāt nitya anitya pratiṣedha hetutvam bhavet

original: yadi nāmādarśanāt tato vyāvartteta śrāvaṇatvan tadvyavacchedahetutvan tu kuta ity āha – na hīti | na tadvyāvṛtter anyad vyavacchedanannityānityavyavacchedanam (|) tavāpi kathaṃ śrāvaṇatvan na vyavacchedahetur iti ced āha – avyavacchedas (p.65) tv ityādi | kutaś cin nityād anityāc cādarśanamātreṇa vyāvṛtter evāniścayāt |
analyzed: yadi nāma adarśanāt tatas vyāvartteta śrāvaṇa tvan tad vyavaccheda hetutvan tu kutas iti āha na hi iti na tad vyāvṛtteḥ anyat vyavacchedanam nitya anitya vyavacchedanam tava api katham śrāvaṇa tvan na vyavaccheda hetuḥ iti ced āha avyavacchedaḥ tu ityādi kutas cit nityāt anityāt ca adarśana mātreṇa vyāvṛtteḥ eva aniścayāt

original: aniścayaś cānyataratra pratibandhāniścayāt | avaśyaṃ caitad evam anyathā yo hi dharmo yatra nāstīti niśvitaḥ sa bhavan kvacid dharmiṇi kathan tadbhāvaṃ yatra nāstīti niścitas tasyābhāśvaṃ kathaṃ na gamayet |
analyzed: aniścayaḥ ca anyataratra pratibandha aniścayāt avaśyam ca etat evam anyathā yaḥ hi dharmaḥ yatra na asti iti niśvitaḥ sa bhavan kvacid dharmiṇi kathan tad bhāvam yatra na asti iti niścitaḥ katham na gamayet

original: nityānityād vyāvṛttasyāpi śrāvaṇatvasyobhayavyavacchede sādhye pramāṇāntarabādhā cec chaṃkyeta | athāpītyādyasyeaiva vyākhyānaṃ | śrāvaṇatvenobhayavyavacchede nityānityavyavacchede sādhye pramāṇāntaraṃ bādhakam asti | tad āha – anyonyetyādi | anyonyavyavacchedo rūpaṃ yeṣānte tathā |
analyzed: nitya anityāt vyāvṛttasya api śrāvaṇa tvasya ubhaya vyavacchede sādhye pramāṇa antara bādhā ced śaṃkyeta atha api ityādi asya eva vyākhyānam śrāvaṇa tvena ubhaya vyavacchede nitya anitya vyavacchede sādhye pramāṇa antaram bādhakam asti tat āha anyonya ityādi anyonya vyavacchedaḥ rūpam yeṣām te tathā

original: tathā hi nityavyavaccheda evānityatvantadvyavaccheda eva ca nityatvan tathā bhāvavyavaccheda evābhāvo 'bhāvavyavaccheda eva ca bhāvaḥ | teṣām ekasya vyavacchedenānyavidhānāt | dvitīyasya viruddhasya vidhānādapratiṣedhaḥ |
analyzed: tathā hi nitya vyavacchedaḥ eva anitya tvan tad vyavacchedaḥ eva ca tathā bhāva vyavacchedaḥ eva abhāvaḥ bhāva vyavacchedaḥ eva ca bhāvaḥ teṣām ekasya vyavacchedena anya vidhānāt dvitīyasya viruddhasya vidhānāt apratiṣedhaḥ

original: etad uktam bhavati | yadā hi śrāvaṇatvaṃ nityād vyāvṛttam iti tad vyavacchidyāt | tad evānityatvam iva dadhyāt | tad eva ca tad anityād vyāvṛttam ity anityaṃ vyavacchidyāt | nityaṃ ca vidhatta ity ekasyaikadaiva vidhipratiṣedhau syātāṃ tac cāyuktam iti vidhipratiṣedhayor yugapadvirodhān na kasyacid api pratiṣedhaḥ |
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati yadā hi śrāvaṇa tvam nityāt vyāvṛttam iti tat vyavacchidyāt tat eva anitya tvam iva dadhyāt tat eva ca tat anityāt vyāvṛttam iti anityam vyavacchidyāt nityam ca vidhatte iti ekasya ekadā eva vidhi pratiṣedhau syātām tat ca ayuktam iti vidhi pratiṣedhayoḥ yugapad virodhāt na kasyacid api pratiṣedhaḥ

original: pratiṣedhavinivṛttilakṣaṇo hi vidhiḥ | vidhinivṛttir eva ca pratiṣedhas tau ca parasparaviruddhau yugpad ekasya kathaṃ syātām (|) ato na kutaś cid api vyāvṛttiniścayaḥ śrāvaṇatvāt | nedānīm iti siddhāntavādī | idānīm iti bādhāsambhave sati | adṛśo 'darśanād vipakṣe hetor nāstitā | tasmād evaṃ saty adarśanan na pramāṇam bādhāsambhavāt |
analyzed: pratiṣedha vinivṛtti lakṣaṇaḥ hi vidhiḥ vidhi nivṛttiḥ eva ca pratiṣedhaḥ tau ca paraspara viruddhau yugpad ekasya katham syātām atas na kutas cit api vyāvṛtti niścayaḥ śrāvaṇa tvāt na idānīm iti siddhāntavādī idānīm iti bādhā sambhave sati adṛśaḥ darśanāt vipakṣe hetoḥ na astitā tasmāt evam sati adarśanat na pramāṇam bādhā sambhavāt

original: śrāvaṇatva evāpramāṇaṃ bhavatu nānyatra bādhābhāvād iti ced āha – tathetyādi | anyatrāpi hetor vyatirekasādhanasyādarśanasya sambhāvyaṃ pramāṇāntarabādhanaṃ | kutaḥ | lakṣaṇetyādi |
analyzed: śrāvaṇa tve evā apramāṇam bhavatu na anyatra bādhā abhāvāt iti ced āha tathā ityādi anyatra api hetoḥ vyatireka sādhanasya adarśanasya sambhāvyam pramāṇa antara bādhanam kutas lakṣaṇa ityādi

original: hetor vipakṣādarśanavyāvṛttinibandhanam iti yallakṣaṇan tena yuktaṃ śrāvaṇatvasya (p.66) yadadarśanan tasmin bādhāsambhave sati tallakṣaṇam eva tasya vyatirekasādhanasyādarśanasya sarvaviṣayam eva lakṣaṇaṃ svarūpaṃ dūṣitaṃ syād iti sarvatrādarśane vyatirekasādhanenāśvāsaḥ | na gamakatvaniścayaḥ ||
analyzed: hetoḥ vipakṣa adarśana vyāvṛtti nibandhanam iti yat lakṣaṇan tena yuktam śrāvaṇa tvasya yat adarśanan tasmin bādhā sambhave sati tat lakṣaṇam eva tasya vyatireka sādhanasya adarśanasya sarva viṣayam eva lakṣaṇam svarūpam dūṣitam syāt iti sarvatra adarśane vyatireka sādhanena āśvāsaḥ na gamaka tva niścayaḥ

original: yady evam anumānaviṣayepi kvacit pratyakṣānumānavirodhadarśant (|) tathā hi nityaḥ śabdaḥ śrāvaṇatvāc chabdatvavid iti kṛte nityatvam anumānena bādhyate | evam aśrāvaṇaḥ śabdaḥ sattvād ghaṭavid iti pratyakṣeṇa | tataś ca ssarvatra tadaviśiṣṭalakṣaṇenānumānepy anāśvāsaprasaṅga iti cet |
analyzed: yadi evam anumāna viṣaye api kvacid tathā hi nityaḥ śabdaḥ śrāvaṇa tvāt śabda tva vid iti kṛte nitya tvam anumānena bādhyate evam aśrāvaṇaḥ śabdaḥ sattvāt ghaṭa vid iti pratyakṣeṇa tatas ca tad aviśiṣṭa lakṣaṇena anumāne api anāśvāsa prasaṅgaḥ iti ced

original: naitad evaṃ yathokta iti kāryasvabhāvānupalambhajeṅgajenumāne pratyakṣānumānavirodhasyābhāvāt | pratyakṣād ivirodhasambhavinaś cātallakṣaṇatvāt tadanumānālakṣaṇatvāt |
analyzed: na etat evam yathā ukte iti kārya svabhāva anupalambha ja iṅga ja inumāne pratyakṣa anumāna virodhasya abhāvāt pratyakṣāt ca a tad lakṣaṇa tvāt tad anumāna alakṣaṇa tvāt

original: yidi yathoktalakṣane 'numāne nāsti bādhā tadā hetulakṣaṇayuktaṃ parasparaviruddhārthasādhakaṃ hetudvayam ekasmin dharmiṇyavatīrṇṇam ivaruddhāvyabhicāry uktam ācāryeṇa tasyāvacanam iti cet | anenābhyukpetahānim āha – anumānaviṣaye viruddhavyabhicāryavacanād iṣṭam etreti kutobhyupatahānaṃ | kva tarhy ācāryeṇokta ity āha – viṣayaṃ cetyādi |
analyzed: yathā ukta lakṣane numāne na asti bādhā tadā hetu lakṣaṇa yuktam paraspara viruddha artha sādhakam hetu dvayam ekasmin dharmiṇi avatīrṇṇam uktam ācāryeṇa tasya avacanam iti ced anena abhyukpetahānim āha anumāna viṣaye viruddha vyabhicāri avacanāt iṣṭam kutobhyupata hānam kva tarhi ācāryeṇa uktaḥ iti āha viṣayam ca ityādi

original: asya viruddhāvyabhicāriṇaḥ | kiṃ cetyādi | iha vaiśeṣikeṇa vāyoḥ sattvasādhanārthaṃ sparśaś ca na ca dṛṣṭānām NOTEREF _Ref57086871 \f \h  \* MERGEFORMAT H iti sūtram uktam. asyāyam arthaḥ – yo guṇaḥ, sa dravyāśrayī. tad yathā rūpādiḥ. apākajānuṣṇāśītasparśaś ca guṇas. tasmāt tasyāśrayabhūtena dravyeṇa bhavitavyam.
analyzed: asya viruddha avyabhicāriṇaḥ kim ca ityādi iha vaiśeṣikeṇa vāyoḥ sattva sādhana artham sparśaḥ ca na ca dṛṣṭānām iti sūtram uktam asya ayam arthaḥ yaḥ guṇaḥ sa dravya āśrayī tat yathā rūpa ādiḥ ca guṇaḥ tasmāt tasya āśraya bhūtena dravyeṇa bhavitavyam

original: na cāyaṃ dṛṣṭānāṃ pṛthivyādīnāṃ guṇaḥ, teṣāṃ pākajānuṣṇāśītasparśādiguṇatvāt. tato yasyāyaṃ guṇaḥ, sa vāyur bhaviṣyatīty ukte vaiśeṣikeṇa, tatrācāryadiṅnāgenoktaṃ – yady adarśanamātreṇa dṛṣṭebhyaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate na ca so 'pi yukta NOTEREF _Ref57114206 \f \h I iti. yad etad uktam, tad virudhyata iti vārttikakāro darśayann āha – dṛṣṭetyādi.
analyzed: na ca ayam dṛṣṭānām pṛthivī ādīnām guṇaḥ teṣām tatas yasya ayam guṇaḥ sa vāyuḥ bhaviṣyati iti ukte vaiśeṣikeṇa tatra ācārya diṅnāgena uktam yadi adarśana mātreṇa dṛṣṭebhyaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate na ca iti yat etad uktam tat virudhyate iti vārttikakāraḥ darśayan āha dṛṣṭa ityādi

original: yady dṛṣṭyā nivṛttiḥ syāt tathā 'dṛṣṭer adarśanāt kāraṇād (p.67) apākajasyānuṣṇāśītasparśasya dṛṣṭā 'yuktiḥ | dṛṣṭeṣu pṛthivyādiṣvasaṅgatir yā varṇitā vaiśeṣikair yasyā ācāryeṇāyuktatvam uktaṃ sā syād avirodhinī yuktaiva syād ity arthaḥ |
analyzed: yadi dṛṣṭyāḥ nivṛttiḥ syāt tathā dṛṣṭeḥ adarśanāt kāraṇāt apāka jasya anuṣṇa aśīta sparśasya dṛṣṭā yuktiḥ dṛṣṭeṣu pṛthivī ādiṣu asaṅgatiḥ yā varṇitā vaiśeṣikaiḥ yasyāḥ ācāryeṇa ayukta tvam uktam sā syāt avirodhinī yuktā eva syāt iti arthaḥ

original: tad vyācaṣṭe – yadītyādi. yad āhācāryaḥ – vāyuprakaraṇe yady adarśanamātreṇa dṛṣṭebhyaḥ pṛthivyādibhyaḥ sparśasya pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate vaiśeṣikeṇa na ca so 'pi yukta iti | yady ācāryasyāpy adarśanamātreṇa vyatireko 'bhimataḥ, tadā katham ayuktaḥ, sparśasya pratiṣdho yukta eva syāt. kiṃ kāraṇam? atrāpi hetor anupalambhād abhāvasiddher abhyupagamāt.
analyzed: tat vyācaṣṭe yadi ityādi yat āha ācāryaḥ vāyuprakaraṇe yadi adarśana mātreṇa dṛṣṭebhyaḥ pṛthivī ādibhyaḥ sparśasya pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate vaiśeṣikeṇa na ca saḥ yuktaḥ iti yadi ācāryasya api adarśana mātreṇa vyatirekaḥ bhimataḥ tadā katham ayuktaḥ sparśasya yuktaḥ eva syāt kim kāraṇam atra api hetoḥ anupalambhāt abhāva siddheḥ abhyupagamāt

original: nanv ityādi paraḥ. upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāpteḥ kāraṇād apākajasyānuṣṇāśītasparśasyānupalabhyamānasya pṛthivyādiṣu yukta eva pratiṣdhaḥ. na yukta iti sidhāntavādī. kiṃ kāraṇaṃ? yaḥ pṛthivyādir anuṣṇāśītād anyena sparśena yuktaḥ pratyakṣaḥ, sa dṛśyaḥ. anyatra ca deśādāv apratyakṣo 'pi tathābhūtasparśayukta eva pṛthivyādis tatsvabhāvaḥ.
analyzed: nanu ityādi paraḥ upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāpteḥ kāraṇāt apāka jasya anuṣṇa aśīta sparśasya anupalabhyamānasya pṛthivī ādiṣu yuktaḥ eva na yuktaḥ iti sidhāntavādī kim kāraṇam yaḥ pṛthivī ādiḥ anuṣṇa aśītāt anyena sparśena yuktaḥ pratyakṣaḥ sa dṛśyaḥ anyatra ca deśa ādau tathābhūta sparśa yuktaḥ eva pṛthivī ādiḥ tad svabhāvaḥ

original: dṛśyaś ca tatsvabhāvaś ceti dvandvaḥ. tad eva viṣayaḥ sa eva tanmātraṃ "supsupeti" samāsaḥ. tasminn apratiṣedhāt sparśasya. tatra hi pratiṣdhe syād eva niścayaḥ yāvatāś pṛthivyādidharmibhūtaṃ sāmānyenāviśeṣeṇaiva gṛhītvāyam vaiśeṣikaḥ sparśasya pratiṣedham āha.
analyzed: dṛśyaḥ ca tad svabhāvaḥ ca iti dvandvaḥ tat eva viṣayaḥ saḥ eva tanmātram sup supā iti samāsaḥ tasmin apratiṣedhāt sparśasya tatra hi syāt eva niścayaḥ yāvatā pṛthivī ādi dharmi bhūtam sāmānyena aviśeṣeṇa eva gṛhītvā ayam vaiśeṣikaḥ sparśasya pratiṣedham āha

original: yat kiṃcit pṛthivyādi, tat sarvam anuṣṇāśītasparśarahitam iti .na ca pṛthivyādimātre sparśasyopalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptir asti. na caikasparśaniyamaḥ pṛthivyādīnām, yatas tatra pṛthivyādisāmānye tūlopalapallavādiṣu bhedeṣu pṛthivyādibhāve 'pi sparśabhedadarśanāt. tathā hi tūlasyānyaḥ sparśaḥ ślakṣṇatvalakṣaṇonyaścopalādeḥ karkaśatvādilakṣaṇaḥ |
analyzed: yat kiṃcid pṛthivī ādi tat sarvam an uṣṇa aśīta sparśa rahitam iti na ca pṛthivī ādi mātre sparśasya upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptiḥ asti na ca eka sparśa niyamaḥ pṛthivī ādīnām yatas tatra pṛthivī ādi sāmānye tūla upala pallava ādiṣu bhedeṣu pṛthivī ādi bhāve pi sparśa bheda darśanāt tathā hi tūlasya anyaḥ sparśaḥ ślakṣṇa tva lakṣaṇaḥ nyaḥ ca upala ādeḥ karkaśa tva ādi lakṣaṇaḥ

original: asyāpīty anuṣṇāśītasparśasya kvacit pārthivadravyaviśeṣe sambhavāśaṃkayā bhavitavyam iti kṛtvā sarvatra pṛthivyādāv (p.68) adarśanamātreṇāṇuṣṇāśītasparśasyāyuktaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ |
analyzed: asya api iti an uṣṇa aśīta sparśasya kvacid pārthiva dravya viśeṣe sambhava āśaṃkayā bhavitavyam iti kṛtvā sarvatra pṛthivī ādau adarśana mātreṇa aṇu uṣṇa aśīta sparśasya ayuktaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ

original: yat tūcyate | (|) sarvatra pṛthivyādes tulyatvāttulya evānuyṣṇāśītasparśo yas tu pṛthivyādibhāvepi ślakṣaṇatvādibhedaḥ sa pṛthivyādiparamāṇusaṃyogasya niviḍāniviḍakṛtatvād iti |
analyzed: yat tu ucyate sarvatra pṛthivī ādeḥ tulya tvāt tulyaḥ eva anu yṣṇā śīta sparśaḥ yaḥ tu pṛthivī ādi bhāve pi ślakṣaṇa tva ādi bhedaḥ sa pṛthivī ādi paramāṇu saṃyogasya nibiḍa a nibiḍa kṛta tvāt iti

original: tad ayuktam (|) aniviḍānāṃ hi nairantaryābhāvāt saṃyogābhāvaḥ | tena yathopalaparamāṇūnāṃ saṃyogasya niviḍatvan tathā tūlaparamānūnām iti kathaṃ ślakṣṇatvādibhedaḥ syāt | tasmād saty api saṃyoge svarūpeṇānyādṛśā evopalaparamāṇavonyādṛśāś ca tūlaparamāṇavastatkṛta eva ca ślakṣṇatvādibhedaḥ | na saṃyoganiviḍāniviḍakṛtaḥ |
analyzed: tat ayuktam a nibiḍānām hi nairantarya abhāvāt saṃyoga abhāvaḥ tena yathā upala paramāṇūnām saṃyogasya tathā tūla paramānūnām iti katham ślakṣṇa tva ādi bhedaḥ syāt tasmāt sati api saṃyoge sva rūpeṇa anyādṛśāḥ eva upala paramāṇavaḥ nyādṛśāḥ ca tūla paramāṇavaḥ tad kṛtaḥ eva ca ślakṣṇa tva ādi bhedaḥ na saṃyoga nibiḍa a nibiḍa kṛtaḥ

original: tathā ca yathā pṛthivyādibhedāt sparśasya ślakṣṇatvādibhedas tathā nuṣṇāśītabhedopi sambhāvyeta |
analyzed: tathā ca yathā pṛthivī ādi bhedāt sparśasya ślakṣṇa tva ādi bhedaḥ tathā sambhāvyeta

original: nanu mābhūd adṛṣṭaviṣaye vāyvanumānaṃ dṛṣṭaviṣaye tv anuṣṇāśītasparśasya dṛśyasya pathivyādisambandhitvenānupalabhyamānatvāt tato vyāyvanumānaṃ syāt |
analyzed: nanu mā abhūt adṛṣṭa viṣaye vāyu anumānam dṛṣṭa viṣaye tu an uṣṇa aśīta sparśasya dṛśyasya pathivī ādi sambandhi tvena anupalabhyamāna tvāt tatas vyāyu anumānam syāt

original: evam manyate | yadi sparśāder guṇarūpatā siddhā syāt tato vāyudravyānumānaṃ syāt saiva tv asiddhā | svatantryeṇa pratītaeḥ sparśaviśeṣa eva cāsmākam vāyur ucyate | ācārya dignāge na tu sparśavyatiriktaṃ vāyumabhyupagamya tatra parakīyam anumānam ayuktam uktam ity adoṣaḥ |
analyzed: evam manyate yadi sparśa ādeḥ guṇa rūpa tā siddhā syāt tatas vāyu dravya anumānam syāt sā eva tu asiddhā svatantryeṇa pratītaiḥ sparśa viśeṣaḥ eva ca asmākam vāyuḥ ucyate ācārya dignāge na tu sparśa vyatiriktam vāyum abhyupagamya tatra parakīyam anumānam ayuktam uktam iti adoṣaḥ

original: tasmāt sthitam evad (|) anvayavyatirekayor niścayam adarśanamātrāc ca pratiṣedhābhāvaṃ bruvatācāryeṇeṣṭaḥ pratibandha iti ||
analyzed: tasmāt sthitam evat anvaya vyatirekayoḥ niścayam adarśana mātrāt ca pratiṣedha abhāvam bruvatā ācāryeṇa iṣṭaḥ pratibandhaḥ iti

original: kas tarhy evamupālabdha iti ced āha – evam ityādi | evam ity anantaroktābhr upapattibhiḥ | ācāryasya śiṣya ācāryī yaḥ kaścid ācāryagranthānabhijṇnaḥ anupalambhād abhāvaṃ bruvāṇa upālabdhaḥ |
analyzed: kaḥ tarhi evam upālabdhaḥ iti ced āha evam ityādi evam iti upapattibhiḥ ācāryasya śiṣyaḥ ācāryī yaḥ kaścid ācārya grantha anabhijṇnaḥ anupalambhāt abhāvam bruvāṇaḥ upālabdhaḥ

original: api cetyadarśanamātreṇābhāvābhyupagame pratyakṣabādhāṃ darśayitum āha – deśādibhedāt | ādiśabdāt kālasaṃskārabhedāt | bhinnā nānārūpā dṛśyante dravyeṣvekajātīyeṣv api śaktayo rasavīryavipākādilakṣaṇāḥ | tatrety anekaśaktitaṣu dravyeṣv ekadṛṣṭvā | ekasvabhāvasya dravyasya kvacid darśanān nānyatrāpi deśādau yuktas tadbhāvaniścayaḥ |
analyzed: api ca iti adarśana mātreṇa abhāva abhyupagame pratyakṣa bādhām darśayitum āha deśa ādi bhedāt ādi śabdāt kāla saṃskāra bhedāt bhinnāḥ nānā rūpāḥ dṛśyante dravyeṣu eka jātīyeṣu api śaktayaḥ rasa vīrya vipāka ādi lakṣaṇāḥ tatra iti aneka śaktitaṣu dravyeṣu eka dṛṣṭvā eka svabhāvasya dravyasya kvacid darśanāt na anyatra api deśa ādau yuktaḥ tad bhāva niścayaḥ

original: (p.69) yathāparidṛṣṭadravyasvabhāvaniścayaḥ |
analyzed: yathā paridṛṣṭa dravya svabhāva niścayaḥ

original: na cedaṃ yuktam, yasmāt kvacid deśe kānicid dravyāṇi kathaṃ cid dṛṣṭāni pratiniyatarasāditvena | punar anyatheti yathādṛṣṭākāravaiparīty enān yatra deśe dṛśyante | yathetyādinā viṣayam āha – vīryandoṣāpanayanaśaktiḥ (|) pariṇāmo vipākaḥ | viśiṣṭā rasavīryavipākā yāsām iti vigrahaḥ | nānyatreti kṣetraviśeṣād anyatra |
analyzed: na ca idam yuktam yasmāt kvacid deśe kānicid dravyāṇi katham cit dṛṣṭāni pratiniyata rasa ādi tvena punar anyathā iti yathā dṛṣṭa ākāra vaiparītī enān yatra deśe dṛśyante yathā ityādinā viṣayam āha vīryan doṣa apanayana śaktiḥ pariṇāmaḥ vipākaḥ viśiṣṭāḥ rasa vīrya vipākāḥ yāsām iti vigrahaḥ na anyatra iti kṣetra viśeṣāt anyatra

original: yathā deśa viśeṣāt tathā kālasaṃskārabhedād viśiṣṭarasavīryavipākā bhavanti | saṃskāraḥ kṣīrādyavasekaḥ | sa ca taddeśair iti pradeśo yeṣāṃ puruṣāṇāntarais tathā viśiṣṭarasādiyuktā dṛṣṭā iti kṛtvā sarvā atadeśā api tattvena tulyarūpāditvena tthābhūtā yathāgṛhītasvabhāvatulyāḥ sidhyanti |
analyzed: yathā deśa viśeṣāt tathā kāla saṃskāra bhedāt viśiṣṭa rasa vīrya vipākāḥ bhavanti saṃskāraḥ kṣīra ādi avasekaḥ sa ca tad deśaiḥ iti pradeśaḥ yeṣām puruṣāṇā antaraiḥ tathā viśiṣṭa rasa ādi yuktāḥ dṛṣṭāḥ iti kṛtvā sarvāḥ a tad deśāḥ api tattvena tulya rūpa ādi tvena tthābhūtāḥ yathā gṛhīta svabhāva tulyāḥ sidhyanti

original: kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) guṇāntarāṇāṃ rasādiviśeṣāṇāṃ kāraṇāntarāpekṣatvāt | viśeṣahetvabhāve tu syād ekasvabhāvatānumānaṃ | adṣṭaḥ krttā yasya vaidikasya tat tathā | tad api puruṣasaṃskārapūrvakaṃ puruṣaprayatnahetukaṃ | etac ca sādhyaphalaṃ | vākyeṣu pauruṣeyāpauruṣeyatvenabhimateṣu viśeṣābhāvād anena hetuḥ kathitaḥ |
analyzed: kim kāraṇam guṇa antarāṇām rasa ādi viśeṣāṇām kāraṇa antara apekṣa tvāt viśeṣa hetu abhāve tu syāt eka svabhāva tā anumānam adṛṣṭaḥ krttā yasya vaidikasya tat tathā tat api puruṣa saṃskāra pūrvakam puruṣa prayatna hetukam etat ca sādhya phalam vākyeṣu pauruṣeya apauruṣeya tvena abhimateṣu viśeṣa abhāvāt anena hetuḥ kathitaḥ

original: prayogā punar yadvastu yadabhinnasvabhāvanta(tta)tsamānahetukaṃ (|) yathaiko dhūmo dhūmāntarasamānajātīyaḥ | pauruṣeyavākyābhinnasvabhāvāni cāpauruṣeyābhimatāni vākyānīti svabhāvahetuḥ | na cāsiddho hetuḥ | tathā hi yaiḥ prakārair viṣādyapanayanād iti vaidikānāṃ viśeṣa iṣyate | teṣāṃ sarvaprakārāṇāṃ puruṣaiḥ kāraṇadarśanāt |
analyzed: prayogā punar yat vastu yat abhinna svabhāvan tat tat samāna hetukam yathā ekaḥ dhūmaḥ dhūma antara samāna jātīyaḥ pauruṣeya vākya abhinna svabhāvāni ca apauruṣeya abhimatāni vākyāni iti svabhāva hetuḥ na ca asiddhaḥ hetuḥ tathā hi yaiḥ prakāraiḥ viṣa ādi apanayanāt iti vaidikānām viśeṣaḥ iṣyate teṣām sarva prakārāṇām puruṣaiḥ kāraṇa darśanāt

original: tathā hi śabarādimantrāṇām api viṣādyapanayanādayo dṛśyante |
analyzed: tathā hi śabara ādi mantrāṇām api viṣa ādi apanayana ādayaḥ dṛśyante

original: yadi śabdasvabhāvasāmyād adṛṣṭakarttṛ kasyāpi pauruṣeyatvam anumīyate | evaṃ tarhi svacittasantatidarśanāt sarve cittadharmā jñātāḥ (|) tena yāvad bodharūpan tāvat (p.70) pañcendriyāśritaṃ savikalpakaṃ ca sarvaṃ ca rāgādijananavāsanāgarbhaṃ yathedānīn tathānāgatāvasthāyām api yathā ca mama tathā pareṣām api (|) tena cittatvenendriyāśritatvena
analyzed: yadi śabda svabhāva sāmyāt adṛṣṭa karttṛ kasya api pauruṣeya tvam anumīyate evam tarhi sva citta santati darśanāt sarve citta dharmāḥ jñātāḥ tena yāvat tāvat pañca indriya āśritam sa vikalpakam ca sarvam ca rāga ādi janana vāsanā garbham yathā idānīn tathā anāgata avasthāyām api yathā ca mama tathā pareṣām api tena citta tvena indriya āśrita tvena

original: vacanādihetutvena ca sarvasya puṃsaścittaṃ sarvadā rāgādiyuktan niyatavastugrāhitvād asarvaviṣayaṃ kin nānumīyata ity āśaṃkyāha – naivam ityādi | yathā vākyānyasambhavadviśeṣahetūni naivaṃ sambhavadviśeṣahetavaḥ puruṣāḥ yena viśeṣahetv asambhavena | vacanāder ādigrahaṇenendriyāśritatvacittatvādigrahṇaṃ |
analyzed: vacana ādi hetu tvena ca sarvasya puṃsaḥ cittam sarvadā rāga ādi yuktat niyata vastu grāhi tvāt asarva viṣayam kin na anumīyate iti āśaṃkya āha na evam ityādi yathā vākyāni asambhavat viśeṣa hetūni na evam sambhavat viśeṣa hetavaḥ puruṣāḥ yena viśeṣa hetu asambhavena vacana ādeḥ ādi grahaṇena indriya āśrita tva citta tva ādi grahṇam

original: vacanāder eva kiṃ cin mātreṇaikadeśena sādharmyāttasmālliṅgāt puṃsāṃ rāgādimatvena niyataviṣayatvenānyena vā sarvākāreṇa sāmyam anumīyeta |
analyzed: vacana ādeḥ eva kim cit mātreṇa eka deśena sādharmyāt tasmāt liṅgāt puṃsām rāga ādima tvena niyata viṣaya tvena anyena vā sarva ākāreṇa sāmyam anumīyeta

original: viśeṣahetusambhava eva kuta ityāha – srveṣv eva cetoguṇeṣu viśeṣasaya darśanāt | rāgaprajñādayo hi svaviṣayagrahaṇaṃ prati mandamandavṛttayopi kālāntareṇa puṭutarā bhavanti | svaviṣayaś caiṣāṃ spaṣṭataro bhavatīti viśeṣo dṛśyate | sapunaḥ kuto bhavatīty āha – saṃskārobhyāsan tasya viśeṣeṇa prajñādīnāṃ viśeṣapratīteḥ |
analyzed: viśeṣa hetu sambhavaḥ eva kutas iti āha srveṣu eva cetaḥ guṇeṣu darśanāt rāga prajñā ādayaḥ hi sva viṣaya grahaṇam prati manda manda vṛttayaḥ api kāla antareṇa puṭutarāḥ bhavanti sva viṣayaḥ ca eṣām spaṣṭataraḥ bhavati iti viśeṣaḥ dṛśyate sa punar kutas bhavati iti āha tasya viśeṣeṇa prajñā ādīnām viśeṣa pratīteḥ

original: bhavatu prajñādīnāṃ manoguṇānām abhyāsāt prakarṣo dṛṣṭatvāt sarvajñādayas tu na dṛṣṭā iti kathan teṣām bhāva ity ata āha – tadvad ityādi | anyasyāpi sarvajñatvāder viśeṣasya sambhavāt | abhyāsavaśāc ca nairātmyākārasya sarvapadārthagrāhiṇaś ca sāmānyavikalpasya yatas phuṭābhatvan tad eva vairāgyaṃ sārvajñaṃ ca padaṃ |
analyzed: bhavatu prajñā ādīnām manaḥ guṇānām abhyāsāt prakarṣaḥ dṛṣṭa tvāt sarvajña ādayaḥ tu na dṛṣṭāḥ iti kathan teṣām bhāvaḥ iti atas āha tadvat ityādi anyasya api sarvajña tva ādeḥ viśeṣasya sambhavāt abhyāsa vaśāt ca nairātmya ākārasya sarva padārtha grāhiṇaḥ ca sāmānya vikalpasya yatas tat eva vairāgyam sārvajñam ca padam

original: tena tribhiḥ prakārair vairāgyasarvajñatvaviśeṣāsambhavānumānaṃ syāt | yadi nairātmyaviṣayasya sarvaviṣayasya vā vikalpasyāsambhavaḥ | sambhave vā yadi manoguṇānāṃ na viśeṣaḥ syāt | sati vā viśeṣe viśeṣahetur yadi na jñātaḥ syāt | yāvatā nairātmyādiviṣayasya vikalpasya sambhvo 'sti viśeṣahetuś cābhyāso vijñātaḥ |
analyzed: tena tribhiḥ prakāraiḥ vairāgya sarvajña tva viśeṣa asambhava anumānam syāt yadi nairātmya viṣayasya sarva viṣayasya vā vikalpasya asambhavaḥ sambhave vā yadi manaḥ guṇānām na viśeṣaḥ syāt sati vā viśeṣe viśeṣa hetuḥ yadi na jñātaḥ syāt yāvatā nairātmya ādi viṣayasya vikalpasya sti viśeṣa hetuḥ ca abhyāsaḥ vijñātaḥ

original: tasmād yathā 'sati pratibandhavikalye samartheyaṃ bījakāraṇasāmagrī aṅkurotpādāyeti sāmarthyānumānaṃ | tadvad asati pratibandhavikalye cirakālān nairantaryavataś cābhyāsaviśeṣāc ca nairātmyaviṣayasya sarvapddārthaviṣayasya ca jñānasya sphuṭābhavatvaṃ sambhavatīti vairāgyasarvajñatvayoḥ sambhavānumānaṃ | evaṃ tāvat sambhavānumānam asmākaṃ |
analyzed: tasmāt yathā sati pratibandha vikalye samarthā iyam bīja kāraṇa sāmagrī aṅkura utpādāya iti sāmarthya anumānam tadvat asati pratibandha vikalye cira kālāt nairantaryavataḥ ca abhyāsa viśeṣāt ca nairātmya viṣayasya sarva pddārtha viṣayasya ca jñānasya sphuṭa ābhava tvam sambhavati iti vairāgya sarvajña tvayoḥ sambhava anumānam evam tāvat sambhava anumānam asmākam

original: asambhave tv anumātavye bhavatāṃ na tasya dharmasya bādhakaḥ kaścid dhetur vidyate | tadabhāvān nāsaṃbhavadviśeṣahetavaḥ pumāṃsa iti sambandhaḥ | kathaṃ punar bādhakasyābhāva ity āha – vairāgyasyādṛṣṭatvād (|) upalakṣaṇaṃ caitatsarvajñasyāpy adṛṣṭatvāt | adṛṣṭena ca vairāgyeṇa (p.71) saha hetor bādhyabādhakabhāvāsiddheḥ |
analyzed: asambhave tu anumātavye bhavatām na tasya dharmasya bādhakaḥ kaścid hetuḥ vidyate tad abhāvāt na asaṃbhavat viśeṣa hetavaḥ pumāṃsaḥ iti sambandhaḥ katham punar bādhakasya abhāvaḥ iti āha vairāgyasya adṛṣṭa tvāt upalakṣaṇam ca etat sarvajñasya api adṛṣṭa tvāt adṛṣṭena ca vairāgyeṇa saha hetoḥ bādhya bādhaka bhāva asiddheḥ

original: syān mataṃ – na vacanāder vairāgyādīnāṃ sākṣād asambhavo 'numīyate, yena bādhako hetur mṛgyate, | kin tu vītarāgābhimateṣu rāgādayo 'numīyante.) teṣv anumiteṣv artho vītarāgādipratiṣiddhamadṛṣṭenāpi vairāgyena(?ṇa) rāgitvasya virodhād ity ata āha – rāgetyādi | na hi rāgādīnāmavyabhicār kāryam asti | ādigrahaṇād asarvajñparigrahaḥ |
analyzed: syāt matam na vacana ādeḥ vairāgya ādīnām sākṣāt asambhavaḥ numīyate yena bādhakaḥ hetuḥ mṛgyate kin tu vīta rāga abhimateṣu rāga ādayaḥ numīyante teṣu anumiteṣu arthaḥ vīta rāga ādi pratiṣiddham adṛṣṭena api rāgi tvasya virodhāt iti atas āha rāga ityādi na hi rāga ādīnām avyabhicār kāryam asti ādi grahaṇāt a sarvajñ parigrahaḥ

original: tathā hi vyavahāravyutpattim ārabhya yathā yathārthaparijñānan tathā tathā tadviṣayam vaktṛtvam bhavatīti tena yadi sarvaviṣayaṃ kasyacid vijñānaṃ syāt tadviṣayam api vaktṛtvaṃ kena vāryate |
analyzed: tathā hi vyavahāra vyutpattim ārabhya yathā tathā tad viṣayam vaktṛ tvam bhavati iti tena yadi sarva viṣayam kasyacid vijñānam syāt tad viṣayam api vaktṛ tvam kena vāryate

original: syād etad (|) yadi vairāgyādilakṣaṇan tasya viśeṣo 'sit katham asmābhir nopalabhyata ity āha – sambhavepi teṣāṃ vairāgyādilakṣaṇānāṃ viśeṣāṇāṃ parasantāne draṣṭum aśakyatvāt | na ca tthābhūtānām anupalambhāt pratikṣepa ity āha – tādṛśo ca viprakarṣiṇām apratikṣepārhatvāt |
analyzed: syāt etat yadi tasya viśeṣaḥ sidh katham asmābhiḥ na upalabhyate iti āha teṣām vairāgya ādi lakṣaṇānām viśeṣāṇām para santāne draṣṭum aśakya tvāt na ca tthābhūtānām anupalambhāt pratikṣepaḥ iti āha ca viprakarṣiṇām a pratikṣepa arha tvāt

original: syād etad (|) yathā puruṣā apratikṣepārhās tadvad vākyānīty āha – naivam ityādi | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ | dṛśyaviśeṣatvāt | tathā hi vaidikānāṃ vākyānām viśeṣo dṛśya eveṣyate | atha neṣyate | evam adṛśyatve 'pi viśeṣasyābhyupagamyamāne | tenānupalabdhena viśeṣaṇādṛṣṭaviśe4ṣāṇāṃ viadikavākyānāṃ laukikavākyebhyo vijātīyatvopagamavirodhāt |
analyzed: syāt etat yathā puruṣāḥ a pratikṣepa arhāḥ tadvat vākyāni iti āha na evam ityādi kim kāraṇam dṛśya viśeṣa tvāt tathā hi vaidikānām vākyānām viśeṣaḥ dṛśyaḥ eva iṣyate atha na iṣyate evam adṛśya tve pi viśeṣasya abhyupagamyamāne tena anupalabdhena viśeṣaṇa adṛṣṭa viśeṣāṇām viadika vākyānām laukika vākyebhyaḥ vijātīya tva upagama virodhāt

original: syān mataṃ (|) dṛśyā eva viśeṣā vaidikānāṃ duḥśravaṇatvadurbhaṇatvādayas taiḥ pauruṣeyebhyo bhinnāni bhaviṣyantīty ata āha – tadviśeṣāṇām ityādi | anyatreti puruṣeyeṣu | na kevalam adṛṣṭaviśeṣāṇāṃ vijātīyatvopagamavirodhād adṛśyatvaṃ viśeṣāṇām ayuktam itaś ca pratyakṣāṇām apratyakṣasvabhāvavirodhāt | na hy ekasya svabhāvadvayaṃ viruddhaṃ ghaṭte |
analyzed: syāt matam dṛśyāḥ eva viśeṣāḥ vaidikānām duḥśravaṇa tva durbhaṇa tva ādayaḥ taiḥ pauruṣeyebhyaḥ bhinnāni bhaviṣyanti iti atas āha tad viśeṣāṇām ityādi anyatra iti puruṣeyeṣu na kevalam adṛṣṭa viśeṣāṇām vijātīya tva upagama virodhāt adṛśya tvam viśeṣāṇām ayuktam itas ca pratyakṣāṇām apratyakṣa svabhāva virodhāt na hi ekasya svabhāva dvayam viruddham ghaṭte

original: viśeṣāḥ pratyakā eva kevalaṃ bhrāntinimittasadbhāvāt | viṣādiśaktivan nāvadhāryanta iti ced āha – bhrāntinimittābhāvād iti | rūpasādharmyadarśanaṃ hi bhrāntinimittaṃ viṣādiṣu | navaṃ vaidikeṣu | kathaṅgamyata iti ced āha – bādhakābhāvāt bhrāntyasiddher iti |
analyzed: viśeṣāḥ pratyakāḥ eva kevalam bhrānti nimitta sadbhāvāt viṣa ādi śakti vat na avadhāryante iti ced āha bhrānti nimitta abhāvāt iti rūpa sādharmya darśanam hi bhrānti nimittam viṣa ādiṣu navam vaidikeṣu katham gamyate iti ced āha bādhaka abhāvāt bhrānti asiddheḥ iti

original: yadi vaidikānāṃ viśeṣe bhrāntyānapalakṣyamāṇe punar viśeṣāvalamvipramāṇam (p.72) utpadyate bhrānter bādhakan tadā bhrāntes tannimittasya ca bhavati niścayas tac ca nāsit | tasmāl laukikaiḥ śabdaiḥ vaidikānām aviśeṣe sādhye nāsti sādhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ |
analyzed: yadi vaidikānām viśeṣe bhrāntyā anapalakṣyamāṇe punar viśeṣa avalamvi pramāṇam utpadyate bhrānteḥ tadā bhrānteḥ tad nimittasya ca bhavati niścayaḥ tat ca tasmāt laukikaiḥ śabdaiḥ vaidikānām aviśeṣe sādhye na asti sādhakam pramāṇam

original: puruṣeṣu tarhi kiṃ bādhakaṃ yena sarvākāraguṇasāmyasādhane doṣa ity āha – puruṣeṣv ityādi | prajñādiviṣayasyātiśayasyābhyāsapūrvakasya yad darśanan tad eva bādhakaṃ | yady asambhavadvairāgyaṃ puruṣasya cittam bhavet | nābhyāsādheyaviśeṣam bhaved (|) bhavati ca (|) tato viśeṣadarśanasya bādhakatvād asamānaṃ |
analyzed: puruṣeṣu tarhi kim bādhakam yena sarva ākāra guṇa sāmya sādhane doṣaḥ iti āha puruṣeṣu ityādi prajñā ādi viṣayasya atiśayasya abhyāsa pūrvakasya yat tat eva bādhakam yadi asambhavat vairāgyam puruṣasya cittam bhavet na abhyāsa ādheya viśeṣam bhavet bhavati ca tatas viśeṣa darśanasya bādhaka tvāt asamānam

original: vedavākyānumāne yad uktaṃ pratyakṣāṇāṃ śabdānām apratyakṣasvabhāvābhāvād iti (|) syād ayandoṣo yadi viśeṣaḥ svabhāvabhūtaḥ syāt | kin tu parabhāvabhūta ity āha – parabhāvabhūtasyeti | parabhāvaṅgataḥ prabhāvabhūtaḥ | anyasvabhāva ity arthaḥ | atadviśeṣatvād ity avākyaviśeṣatvāt |
analyzed: veda vākya anumāne yat uktam pratyakṣāṇām śabdānām apratyakṣa svabhāva abhāvāt iti syāt ayan doṣaḥ yadi viśeṣaḥ svabhāva bhūtaḥ syāt kin tu para bhāva bhūtaḥ iti āha para bhāva bhūtasya iti para bhāvaṅgataḥ prabhāva bhūtaḥ anya svabhāvaḥ iti arthaḥ a tad viśeṣa tvāt iti a vākya viśeṣa tvāt

original: yato nāsit viśeṣo vākyānān tat tasmād abhinnasvabhāvānāṃ sarveṣāṃ pauruṣeyāpauruṣeyābhimatānāṃ puruṣakriyā | puruṣaiḥ karaṇaṃ | na vā kasya cid laukikasyāpi na puruṣakriyety arthaḥ ||
analyzed: yatas na asit viśeṣaḥ tat tasmāt abhinna svabhāvānām sarveṣām pauruṣeya apauruṣeya abhimatānām puruṣa kriyā puruṣaiḥ karaṇam na vā kasya cit laukikasya api na puruṣa kriyā iti arthaḥ

original: evam ācāryīyasyādarśanamātreṇa vipakṣāddhetor vyatirekam icchataḥ granthavirodhaṃ pramāṇavirodhaṃ cokttvātīrthikānāṃ parasparavyādhātam āha – kiṃ cetyādi | mṛdaś cetanā etac ca lokāyata darśanaṃ | ātmā ca mṛcchetanā ceti dvandvaḥ | ādiśabdāt kṣīrādiṣu dravyādi |
analyzed: evam ācāryīyasya adarśana mātreṇa vipakṣāt hetoḥ vyatirekam icchataḥ grantha virodham pramāṇa virodham ca ukttvā atīrthikānām paraspara vyādhātam āha kim ca ityādi mṛdaḥ cetanā etat ca lokāyata darśanam ātmā ca mṛd śetanā ca iti dvandvaḥ ādi śabdāt kṣīra ādiṣu dravya ādi

original: teṣām abhāvasya sādhanāyānupalambhaḥ pareṇokto 'pi yas tasyābhāvasyāprasādhaka iṣṭa ātmādivādibhir anupalambhamātrasyāpramāṇatvād iti | sa evānupalambha ātmādiniṣedhe pramāṇatvenāniṣṭaḥ kiṃ hetvabhāvasya hetovipakṣād vyatirekasya sādhakaḥ | hetvabhāve cānupalambhaṃ cāsya vaiśeṣkādeḥ pramāṇayataḥ ātmavādo nirālambo nirāśrayaḥ syāt |
analyzed: teṣām abhāvasya sādhanāya anupalambhaḥ yaḥ tasya abhāvasya a prasādhakaḥ iṣṭaḥ ātma ādi vādibhiḥ anupalambha mātrasya apramāṇa tvāt iti saḥ eva anupalambhaḥ ātma ādi niṣedhe pramāṇa tvena aniṣṭaḥ kim hetu abhāvasya hetoḥ vipakṣāt vyatirekasya sādhakaḥ hetu abhāve ca anupalambham ca asya vaiśeṣka ādeḥ pramāṇayataḥ ātma vādaḥ nirālambaḥ nirāśrayaḥ syāt

original: tatrānupalambhavsyābhāvasādhanasya sambhavāt | tathā hi na pratyakṣeṇātmana upalambho nityaparokṣatvābhyupagamāt | atha syād ātmanonumānam evopalambhostyevetyata āha – tatkāryetyādi | apratyakṣatvādevātmanas tatkāryasvabhāvarūpasya liṅgasyāniścayān nānumānam upalambhaḥ |
analyzed: tatra anupalambha vsya abhāva sādhanasya sambhavāt tathā hi na pratyakṣeṇa ātmanaḥ upalambhaḥ nitya parokṣa tva abhyupagamāt atha syāt ātmanaḥ anumānam eva upalambhaḥ usti eva iti atas āha tad kārya ityādi apratyakṣa tvāt eva ātmanaḥ tad kārya svabhāva rūpasya liṅgasya aniścayāt na anumānam upalambhaḥ

original: (p.73)  yathā nityaparokṣāṇām apīndriyādīnām anumānan tathātmano bhaviṣyatīti ced āha – indriyāṇām ityādi | ādiśabdāt smṛtibījādīnāṃ | vijñānam eva kāryan tasya kādā cit katvāt | tathā hi satsv api rūpālokamanaskāreṣu nimīlitalocanādyavasthāsu vijñānasyābhāvāt | punaś conmīlitalocanāvasthāsu bhāvāt |
analyzed: yathā nitya parokṣāṇām api indriya ādīnām tathā ātmanaḥ bhaviṣyati iti ced āha indriyāṇām ityādi ādi śabdāt smṛti bīja ādīnām vijñānam eva tasya cit ka tvāt tathā hi satsu api rūpa āloka manaskāreṣu nimīlita locana ādi avasthāsu vijñānasya abhāvāt punar ca unmīlita locana avasthāsu bhāvāt

original: vijñānakāryaṃ kāraṇāntarasāpikṣaṃ sidhyati tato 'sya sāpekṣyasiddhyā indriyādīnām prasiddhir ucyate |
analyzed: vijñāna kāryam kāraṇa antara sāpikṣam sidhyati indriya ādīnām prasiddhiḥ ucyate

original: etad uktam bhavati | yatsāpekṣam idaṅ kādācit kaṃ | vijñānantatkam apy asya vijñānasya kāraṇam astīty anumīyate tad eva cendriyam iti vyavahriyate | na tv evaṃbhūtam iti na rūpaviśeṣeṇa mūrttatvādinā yuktam indriyamanumīyata ity arthaḥ | evam iti yathā kādācitkavijñānakāryānyathān upapattyendriyānumānaṃ |
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati yat sāpekṣam api asya vijñānasya kāraṇam asti iti anumīyate tat eva ca indriyam iti vyavahriyate na tu evaṃbhūtam iti na rūpa viśeṣeṇa mūrtta tva ādinā yuktam indriyam anumīyate iti arthaḥ evam iti yathā kādācitka vijñāna kārya anyathā upapattyā indriya anumānam

original: tathā sukhādikāryaṃ yasya sukhādikāryantatkim apy astīty anumānena tac cātmasvarūpam iti prasādhitaṃ kañcid arthaṃmātmavādino na puṣṇāti | yena kenacidanirdiṣṭaviśeṣeṇa kāraṇena kāraṇavattvābhyupagamāt sukhādīnāṃ | na caivaṃbhūta ātmā nityakrttṛbhoktṛtvādilakṣaṇatvenābhyupagamāt | yataś ca yathābhyupagatasyātmano nāsti kāryaliṅgaṃ |
analyzed: tathā sukha ādi kāryam yasya sukha ādi kāryan tat kim api asti iti anumānena tat ca ātma svarūpam iti prasādhitam kañcid artham ātmavādinaḥ na puṣṇāti yena kenacid anirdiṣṭa viśeṣeṇa kāraṇena kāraṇavat tva abhyupagamāt sukha ādīnām na ca evaṃbhūtaḥ ātmā nitya krttṛ bhoktṛ tva ādi lakṣaṇa tvena abhyupagamāt yatas ca yathā abhyupagatasya ātmanaḥ na asti kārya liṅgam

original: tathā ca satyanupalabbha evātmanaḥ syāt | tasmāt tamātmānantenānupalambhena pratyakṣānumānanivṛttilakṣaṇena pratyācakṣāṇaḥ kim iti prativyūḍhaḥ pratikṣīpta ātmavādinā | anupalambhamātrān nāsty asattvam ātmana iti katham asādhanaṃ sad vipakṣād dhetīḥ prāṇādimatvāder vyatirekaṃ sādhayet |
analyzed: tathā ca sati anupalabbhaḥ eva ātmanaḥ syāt tasmāt tam ātmā anantena anupalambhena pratyakṣa anumāna nivṛtti lakṣaṇena pratyācakṣāṇaḥ kim iti prativyūḍhaḥ pratikṣīptaḥ ātmavādinā anupalambha mātrāt na asti asattvam ātmanaḥ iti katham asādhanam sat vipakṣāt hetīḥ prāṇa ādima tva ādeḥ vyatirekam sādhayet

original: bhūtānām eva śaktiścaitanyamiṣyate cārvākaiḥ (|) bhūtasbhavāvā ca mṛdityevaṃ mṛdaḥ khalv api caitanyamanupalabhyamānam apīcchan lokāyatikaḥ | yad āha (|) "tebhyo bhūtebhyaś catanyammadaśaktivadvijñānam" iti | punas tata evāpramāṇakād anupalambhāt |
analyzed: bhūtānām eva śaktiḥ caitanyam iṣyate cārvākaiḥ ca mṛd iti evam mṛdaḥ khalu api caitanyam anupalabhyamānam api icchan lokāyatikaḥ yat āha tebhyaḥ bhūtebhyaḥ iti punar tatas eva apramāṇakāt anupalambhāt

original: adarśanād vacanāder asarvajñatvādisādhanāya liṅgatvenopanītasya vipakṣād vyāvṛttim āha – dadhyādikaṃ kṣīrādiṣv anupalabhyamānam apīcchan | (p.74)  apara iti sāṃkhyaḥ punaḥ sa eva | parārthāś cakṣurādayaḥ saṅdhātatvād ity abhidāyāparārtheṣu śaśaviṣāṇādiṣu saṅdhātatvasyādarśanād vyatirekam āha – evaṃ tāvad asya parasparavyādhātaḥ |
analyzed: adarśanāt vacana ādeḥ asarvajña tva ādi sādhanāya liṅga tvena upanītasya vipakṣāt vyāvṛttim āha dadhi ādikam kṣīra ādiṣu anupalabhyamānam api icchan apare iti sāṃkhyaḥ punar saḥ eva para arthāḥ cakṣuḥ ādayaḥ saṅdhāta tvāt iti abhidāya apara artheṣu śaśaviṣāṇa ādiṣu saṅdhāta tvasya adarśanāt vyatirekam āha evam tāvat asya paraspara vyādhātaḥ

original: na cādarśanamātreṇāsya hetor vyāptiḥ sidhyati | ko hy atra niyamaḥ saṅdhātair avaśyaṃ parārthair bhavitavyaṃ yataḥ saṃdhātatvāc cakṣurādīnāṃ pārārthyasiddhyātmārthatvaṃ sāṃkhyasyasidhyet | yad uktaṃ dadhyādikaṃ kṣīrādiṣv apy anupalabhyamānam apīti (|) tan na | yasmād asty evopalambho dadhyādīnāṃ kṣīrādiṣu (|) kosāvity āhānumānam iti |
analyzed: na ca adarśana mātreṇa asya hetoḥ vyāptiḥ sidhyati kaḥ hi atra niyamaḥ saṅdhātaiḥ avaśyam parārthaiḥ bhavitavyam yatas saṃdhāta tvāt cakṣuḥ ādīnām pārārthya siddhyā ātmārtha tvam sāṃkhyasya sidhyet yat uktam dadhi ādikam kṣīra ādiṣu api anupalabhyamānam api iti tat na yasmāt asti eva upalambhaḥ dadhi ādīnām kṣīra ādiṣu kaḥ asau iti āha anumānam iti

original: anumānaṃ cāhāśaktād anutpatter iti | yadi hi kṣīrādau dadhyādiśaktir na syāt tato śaktāt kṣīrāder dadhyādi notpadyata | prayogas tu yadyajjanane na śaktaṃ na tasya tata utpattir yathā śālivījād yavāṅkurasya (|) utpadyate ca dadhyādiḥ kṣīrādibhyas tasmād asti dadhyādiśaktitaḥ kṣīrādāv iti kāryahetupratirūpako vaidharmyaprayogaḥ |
analyzed: anumānam ca āha aśaktāt anutpatteḥ iti yadi hi kṣīra ādau dadhi ādi śaktiḥ na syāt śaktāt kṣīra ādeḥ dadhi ādi na utpadyata prayogaḥ tu yat yat janane na śaktam na tasya tatas utpattiḥ yathā śāli vījāt yava aṅkurasya utpadyate ca dadhi ādiḥ kṣīra ādibhyaḥ tasmāt asti dadhi ādi śaktitaḥ kṣīra ādau iti kārya hetu pratirūpakaḥ vaidharmya prayogaḥ

original: śakter eva ca dadhyādiḥ kāryakāraṇayor abhedād iti manyate |
analyzed: śakteḥ eva ca dadhi ādiḥ kārya kāraṇayoḥ abhedāt iti manyate

original: athetyādi siddhāntavādī | yo 'sau dadhyādiko bhāvaḥ paścād upalabhyate kiṃ sa eva bhāvaḥ śaktir utānyad eva kiñcid dadhyāder arthāntaraṃ | tathaiveti niṣpannarūpadadhyādivat kṣīrāv asthāyām upalabhyeta viśeṣābhāvāt | anyac ced iti | dadhyādibhyorthāntaraṃ cecchaktiḥ | tadā katham anyabhāvenyasya śaktyākhyāsya bhāve | taddadhyādikam asti |
analyzed: atha ityādi siddhānta vādī sau dadhi ādikaḥ bhāvaḥ paścāt upalabhyate kim saḥ eva bhāvaḥ śaktiḥ uta anyat eva kiñcid dadhi ādeḥ artha antaram tathā eva iti niṣpanna rūpa dadhi ādi vat kṣīrau asthāyām upalabhyeta viśeṣa abhāvāt anyat ced iti dadhi ādibhyaḥ artha antaram ced śaktiḥ tadā katham anya bhāvena asya bhāve tat dadhi ādikam asti

original: naivety abhiprāyaḥ | dadhyādijananasāmarthyāt kṣīrādau dadhyādīty upacāramātraṃ syāt | anupalambhamapramāṇīkṛtya punas tasyaiva pramāṇīkaraṇamayam parasparavyādhāta eṣām ātmādivādinām ity upasaṃhāraḥ ||
analyzed: na eva iti abhiprāyaḥ dadhi ādi janana sāmarthyāt kṣīra ādau dadhi ādi iti upacāra mātram syāt anupalambham a pramāṇīkṛtya punar tasya eva pramāṇīkaraṇam ayam paraspara vyādhātaḥ eṣām ātma ādi vādinām iti upasaṃhāraḥ

original: yataś cādarśanamātrān nāsti vyatierkas tasmāt tanmātramambandhaḥ | hetusattāmātrasambaddhasvabhāvaḥ sādhyatvenābhimataḥ svayannivartamāno bhāvam evaṃ svabhāvabhūtam eva hetutvenopanītaṃ nivartayet | vāśabdo vakṣyamāṇavikalpāpekṣī | yathā vṛkṣo nivartamānaḥ śīṃśapān nivartayati |
analyzed: yatas ca adarśana mātrāt na asti vyatierkaḥ tasmāt tad mātra sambandhaḥ hetu sattā mātra sambaddha svabhāvaḥ sādhya tvena abhimataḥ svayat nivartamānaḥ bhāvam evam svabhāva bhūtam eva hetu tvena upanītam nivartayet vā śabdaḥ vakṣyamāṇa vikalpa apekṣī yathā vṛkṣaḥ nivartamānaḥ śīṃśapān nivartayati

original: kasmāc chākhādimadviśeṣasyaiva tathā śiṃśapeti prasiddheḥ sa (p.75) vṛkṣas tasya śiṃśapākhyasya svabhāvaḥ | svañca svabhāvaṃ vṛkṣaṃ parityajya kathaṃ śiṃśapākhyo bhāvo bhavet | kiṅ kāraṇaṃ (|) svabhāvasyaiva vṛkṣasvātmana eva bhāvatvāc chaṃśapārūpatvāt |
analyzed: kasmāt śākhā ādimat viśeṣasya eva tathā śiṃśapā iti prasiddheḥ sa prasiddheḥ sa vṛkṣaḥ tasya śiṃśapā ākhyasya svabhāvaḥ svam ca svabhāvam vṛkṣam parityajya katham śiṃśapā ākhyaḥ bhāvaḥ bhavet kim kāraṇam svabhāvasya eva vṛkṣa sva ātmanaḥ eva bhāva tvāt śaṃśapā rūpa tvāt

original: iti hetos tasyātmabhūtasya sādhanasya śiṃśapādeḥ svabhāvapratibandhād eva svabhāve sādhyābhimate vṛkṣādau yathoktena prakāreṇa pratibandhād evāvyabhicāraḥ | kāraṇaṃ vā nivartamānam ity adhyāhāraḥ | kāryan nivartayed iti prakṛtaṃ | kasmād (|) avyabhicārataḥ kāryasya kāraṇāvyabhicārād ity arthaḥ | kāraṇam ityādinā vyācaṣṭe |
analyzed: iti hetoḥ tasya ātma bhūtasya sādhanasya śiṃśapā ādeḥ svabhāva pratibandhāt eva svabhāve sādhya abhimate vṛkṣa ādau yathā uktena prakāreṇa pratibandhāt eva avyabhicāraḥ kāraṇam vā nivartamānam iti adhyāhāraḥ kāryan nivartayet iti prakṛtam kasmāt avyabhicārataḥ kāryasya kāraṇa avyabhicārāt iti arthaḥ kāraṇam ityādinā vyācaṣṭe

original: anyatheti | yadi kāraṇe nivartamāne kāryaṃ na vivartteta | tadā tatkāryābhimataṃ tasya kāraṇasya kāryam eva na syāt | tasmāt kāraṇaṃ nivartamānaṃ kāryam avaśyaṃ nivartayati | yady api vāsagṛhādāv agnikāraṇanivṛttāv api na dhūmasya nivṛttis tathāpi dṛṣṭakāraṇavyatirekeṇa nānyasmādasyotpattir abhipretety arthaḥ | ata evāha – siddhas tv ityādi |
analyzed: anyathā iti yadi kāraṇe nivartamāne kāryam na vivarteta tadā tad kārya abhimatam tasya kāraṇasya kāryam eva na syāt tasmāt kāraṇam nivartamānam kāryam avaśyam nivartayati yadi api vāsagṛha ādau agni kāraṇa nivṛttau api na dhūmasya nivṛttiḥ tathā api dṛṣṭa kāraṇa vyatirekeṇa na anyasmāt asya utpattiḥ abhipretā iti arthaḥ atas eva āha siddhaḥ tu ityādi

original: siddhas tu kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ kāryasya svabhāvaṃ kāraṇe niyamayati (|) sati tasmin bhavaty asati na bhavatīty evaṃ tadavyabhicāriṇaṃ karoti | ubhayatheti tādātmyena tadutpattyā vā yaḥ svabhāvapratibandhas tasmād eva | sādhyānivṛttyā hetor nivṛttiḥ |
analyzed: siddhaḥ tu kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ kāryasya svabhāvam kāraṇe niyamayati sati tasmin bhavati asati na bhavati iti evam tad avyabhicāriṇam karoti ubhayathā iti tādātmyena tad utpattyā vā yaḥ svabhāva pratibandhaḥ tasmāt eva sādhya anivṛttyāḥ hetoḥ nivṛttiḥ

original: anyatheti yadi pratibandho niṣyate | ekasyāpratibandhakasya sādhyasya nivṛttyānyanivṛttiḥ | apratibaddhasya sādhanadharmasya nivṛtiḥ katham bhavet (|) naiva | yasmān nāśvavānityaśvarahita iti kṛtvā marttyena manuṣyeṇa na bhāvyaṃ gomatāpi kiṃ |

original: tasmād vaidharmyadṛṣṭānte | tadviṣaye 'vaśyaṃ niyamena iha hetau kāryasvabhāvalakṣaṇa āśrayo vastubhūto dharmī neṣṭaḥ svabhāvānupalambhe tv iṣṭa eva |

analyzed: tatra hi viparyayeṇa upalambhaḥ khyāpanīyaḥ kim kāraṇam āśrayaḥ na iṣṭe iti āha tad abhāve ca ityādi tad abhāve vyāpaka kāraṇayoḥ abhāve tad vyāpya kārya ākhyam liṅgam na iti na bhavati iti evam vaidharmya vacanāt api āśraya rahitāt tad gateḥ vyatireka gateḥ

original: kiṅ kāraṇaṃ | yata ityādi | svabhāvahetau sādhyasya tadbhāvaḥ sādhanavyāpakatvaṃ | kāryahetau sādhyasya hetubhāvaḥ kāraṇatvaṃ khyāpyate | tadavedina iti tadbhāvahetubhāvāvedinaḥ puṃsaḥ |
analyzed: kim kāraṇam yatas ityādi svabhāva hetau sādhyasya tad bhāvaḥ sādhana vyāpaka tvam kārya hetau sādhyasya hetu bhāvaḥ kāraṇa tvam khyāpyate tad avedinaḥ iti tad bhāva hetu bhāva āvedinaḥ puṃsaḥ

original: tad vyācaṣṭe – dṛṣṭān te hītyādi | sādhyadarmasya tadbhāvaḥ sādhanasvabhāvatvaṃ khyāpyate tanmātrānubandhena | sādhanamātrānubandhena | kṛtaka(tva)niṣpattāv eva niṣpannasyānityatvasya kṛtakamātrānubandhena yā tatsvabhāvatā sādhanasvabhāvatā tayā | evaṃbhūtayā tadbhāvaḥ khyāpyate | na tu nimittāntarāt paścād utpadyamānenānityatvena (p.77) |

original: yathaike vipratipannā iti | tanmātravatvam eva darśayann āha – ya ityādi | yo hetuḥ kṛtakaṃ svabhāve janayait so 'nityarūpam eva santaṃ janayatīty arthaḥ | iti anena dvāreṇāvinābhāvaviṣayaṃ pramāṇaṃ dṛṣṭāntena khyāpyate | na tu darśanārśanamātraṃ | anyatheti yady evaṃ pramāṇaṃ nopadarśayate | tadaikadharmasadbhāvāt sādhanadharmasadbhāvāt |
analyzed: yathā eke vipratipannāḥ iti tad mātravatvam eva darśayan āha yaḥ ityādi yaḥ hetuḥ kṛtakam svabhāve janayait saḥ nitya rūpam eva santam janayati iti arthaḥ iti anena dvāreṇa avinābhāva viṣayam pramāṇam dṛṣṭāntena khyāpyate na tu darśana arśana mātram anyathā iti yadi evam pramāṇam na upadarśayate tadā eka dharma sadbhāvāt sādhana dharma sadbhāvāt

original: tadanyenāpi sādhyadharmeṇāpi bhavitavyam iti niyamābhāvāt sādhansya sādhyavyabhicārāśaṃkā syāt |
analyzed: tad anyena api sādhya dharmeṇa api bhavitavyam iti niyama abhāvāt sādhansya sādhya vyabhicāra āśaṃkā syāt

original: yadi nāma dṛṣṭāntena pramāṇam upadarśanīyantathāpi kiṃ siddham ity āha – tena ca pramāṇena tanmātrānubandha iti sādhanamātrānubandhaḥ | kathṃ khyāpyata ity āha – kṛtakasya yatkāraṇantasmād eva kṛtakas tathā jāto jāto yo naśvaraḥ kṣaṇasthitidharmā | kṣaṇikatvenaiva naśvaro na tu kālāntaraṃ sthitvety arthaḥ |
analyzed: yadi nāma dṛṣṭāntena pramāṇam upadarśanīyan tathā api kim siddham iti āha tena ca pramāṇena tanmātra anubandhaḥ iti sādhana mātra anubandhaḥ kathma khyāpyate iti āha kṛtakasya yat kāraṇam tasmāt eva kṛtakaḥ tathā jātaḥ jātaḥ yaḥ naśvaraḥ kṣaṇa sthiti dharmā kṣaṇika tvena eva naśvaraḥ na tu kāla antaram sthitvā iti arthaḥ

original: kathaṃ punaḥ svahetor eva tathotpanna ity āha – anyata iti svahetor anyasmād vināśahetoḥ | tasya kṛtkasya tadbhāvaniṣedhād anityatāsvabhāvaniṣedhād vakṣyamāṇakāt | hetubhāvo vā tna ca pramāṇena khyāpyata iti sambandhaḥ |
analyzed: katham punar sva hetoḥ eva tathā utpannaḥ iti āha anyatas iti sva hetoḥ anyasmāt vināśa hetoḥ tasya tad bhāva niṣedhāt anitya tā svabhāva niṣedhāt vakṣyamāṇakāt hetu bhāvaḥ vā ca pramāṇena khyāpyate iti sambandhaḥ

original: sādhyadharmasya sādhanaṃ prati hetu bhāvo vā kāraṇatvam vā khyāpyate tasmin saty eva sādhanasya bhāvād ity anena prakāreṇa pramāṇaṃ dṛṣṭāntena pradarśayate | kasya punaḥ sādhyasya hetubhāvaḥ pradarśyata ity āha (|) arthāntarasya sādhanād vyatiriktasya | tathā dṛṣṭāntopadarśitena pramāṇena prasiddhe tadbhāvahetubhāve |
analyzed: sādhya dharmasya sādhanam prati hetu bhāvaḥ vā kāraṇa tvam vā khyāpyate tasmin sati eva sādhanasya bhāvāt iti anena prakāreṇa pramāṇam dṛṣṭāntena pradarśayate kasya punar sādhyasya hetu bhāvaḥ pradarśyate iti āha artha antarasya sādhanāt vyatiriktasya tathā dṛṣṭānta upadarśitena pramāṇena prasiddhe tad bhāva hetu bhāve

original: svabhāvasya sādhyasya tadbhāve | sādhanasvabhāvatve | kāraṇasya hetubhāve prasiddhe sati | dahanābhāvve dhūmo na bhavatīti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ | sa ity anityasvabhāvo vahniś ca | tasyeit krtakatvasya dhūmasya ca yathākramaṃ svabhāvo hetur vā (|) śabdaḥ samucchaye |
analyzed: svabhāvasya sādhyasya tad bhāve sādhana svabhāva tve kāraṇasya hetu bhāve prasiddhe sati dhūmaḥ na bhavati iti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ saḥ iti anitya svabhāvaḥ vahniḥ ca dhūmasya ca yathākramam svabhāvaḥ hetuḥ vā śabdaḥ samucchaye

original: yata evaṃ katham asau kṛtako dhūmo vā svaṃ svabhāvam anityaṃ hetuṃ cāgnimantareṇa bhavet (|) naiva bhavedity evasm anuddiṣṭarūpe viṣaye vayatireke (p.78) kathyamāne āśrayamantareṇāpi vaidharmyadṛṣṭānte prasidhyati vyatirekaḥ |
analyzed: yatas evam katham asau kṛtakaḥ dhūmaḥ vā svam svabhāvam anityam hetum ca agnim antareṇa bhavet na eva bhavet iti anuddiṣṭa rūpe viṣaye kathyamāne āśrayam antareṇa api vaidharmya dṛṣṭānte prasidhyati vyatirekaḥ

original: yatkiñcit kṛtakan tadnityam evety ukte vyaktam avaśyam ayam anityatvākhyo dharmosya kṛtakasya svabhāvas tanmātrānubandhī kṛtakamātrānubandhī pramāṇadṛṣṭa iti pramāṇena niścitaḥ |

original: nanu kāryepi kāraṇam avaśyam bhavati | na ca tat tasya svabhāva ity ata āha – anarthāntara iti | kathn tanmātrānubandhīty āha – tadbhāvaniyamād iti | kṛtakabhāve 'vaśyam anityatābhāvād ity arthaḥ |

original: atha kramayagapadyābhyāṃ sāmarthyalakṣaṇaṃ sattvaṃ vyāptaṃ nityeṣu ca kramākramanivṛttau sattvaṃ nivartamānaṃ kṣaṇikeṣv evāvatiṣṭhata iti sattvāyuktasya kṛtakasya gamakatvaṃ |

analyzed: tat api ayuktam kṣaṇika tve sat krama apratipatteḥ yena hi jñāna kṣaṇena pūrvakam vastu pratipannam na tena uttaram yena uttaram na tena pūrvakam iti katham krama pratītiḥ yaḥ hi pūrva vastu pratipati anantaram aparasya grāhakaḥ sa krama grāhī syāt tathā vā kṣaṇika tvam asya syāt yasya ca kālaḥ eva na asti tasya katham krama grahaḥ

original: bhinnakālavastvagrahāt | kālābhāve cānekavasturūpa eva kramaḥ | tathā ca nityasyāpi kramakarttṛtvaṃ na virudhyate | yathā ca nityasya kramakarttṛtvās anekarūpatvan tathā kṣaṇasyāpi syāt | atha kṣaṇavad dvitīye kṣaṇe nityasyāpy abhāvaḥ syāt kāryābhāvāt |
