original: tadayuktaṃ kālābhāvāt | bhavatu vā kramagrahas tathāpi kathaṃ kramākramābhyāṃ sattvasya vyāptiḥ | kramayaugapadyavyatirekeṇānyena prakāreṇārthakriyāsam bhavāt | na ca prakārāntarasya dṛśyānupalambhād abhāvaniścayaḥ | evaṃ hi viśiṣṭadeśādāv evābhāvaniścayaḥ syān na sarvadā | nāpy adṛśyānupalambhād abhāvaniśvayaḥ sandehāt |
analyzed: tat ayuktam kāla abhāvāt bhavatu vā krama grahaḥ tathā api katham kramākramābhyām sattvasya vyāptiḥ krama yaugapadya vyatirekeṇa anyena prakāreṇa arthakriyā sam bhavāt na ca prakāra antarasya dṛśya anupalambhāt abhāva niścayaḥ evam hi viśiṣṭa deśa ādau eva abhāva niścayaḥ syāt na sarvadā nā api adṛśya anupalambhāt abhāva niśvayaḥ sandehāt

original: tasmān nityeṣu kramākramāyaugepi sattvānivṛtteḥ kathaṃ sattvasya kṣaṇikasvabhāvatvam iti śaṃkara prabhṛtayaḥ |
analyzed: tasmāt nityeṣu sattva anivṛtteḥ katham sattvasya kṣaṇika svabhāva tvam iti śaṃkara prabhṛtayaḥ

original: bhavatu vā prakārāntarābhāvāt kramayaugapadyābhyāṃ sattvasya vyāotis tathāpi nityeṣu na pratyakṣādinā kramākramāyogaḥ siddho nittyānāmatīndriyatvāt (|) tadasiddhau ca na teṣu sattvanivṛttisiddhis tadasiddhau ca na satvasya kṣaṇikasvabhāvatvasuddhiḥ |
analyzed: bhavatu vā prakāra antara abhāvāt krama yaugapadyābhyām sattvasya vyāotiḥ tathā api nityeṣu na pratyakṣa ādinā kramākrama ayogaḥ siddhaḥ nittyānām atīndriya tvāt tad asiddhau ca na teṣu sattva nivṛtti siddhiḥ tad asiddhau ca na satvasya kṣaṇika svabhāva tva suddhiḥ

original: kiñca (|) sattvāt kramayaugapadyānumānaṃ syāt tenaiva vyāptatvān na tu kṣaṇikatvānumānan tatra kramakarttṛtvāsambhavād iti |
analyzed: kiñca sattvāt krama yaugapadya anumānam syāt tena eva vyāpta tvāt na tu tatra krama karttṛ tva asambhavāt iti

original: atrocyate | kramayaugapadye pratyakṣasiddhe eva | sahabhāvo hi bhāvānāṃ yaugapadyaṃ kramas tu pūrvāparabhāvaḥ sa ca kramiṇāmabhinnas tatpratibhāsaś caikapratibhāsaḥ | sa tv ekapratibhāsan antaram aparasya pratibhāsaḥ | kramapratibhāso na tv ekasyasivātiprasaṅgāt |

original: satyaṃ (|) tatrāpi yadaikasya pratibhāso na tagāparasya tadbhāve hi yaugapadyapratibhāsaḥ syāt | tasmāt kramiṇoḥ pūrvottarābhyāṃ jñānābhyāṃ grahe kramo gṛhīta eva tato 'bhedāt | kevalaṃ pūrvānubhūtavastvāhitasaṃskāraprabodhenedam asmād anantaram ityānupūrvīvikalpotpattyā kramagtaho vyavasthāpyate |

original: kramiṇāṃ grahepi kathaṃ cid ānupūrvīvikalpānutpattau kramāgrahavyavasthāpanādata eva kramiṇām ekagrahepi na kramagraha ucyate |
analyzed: kramiṇām grahe api katham cit ānupūrvī vikalpa anutpattau krama agraha vyavasthāpanāt atas eva kramiṇām eka grahe api na krama grahaḥ ucyate

original: kiṃ ca kālābhyupagamavādinopi kathaṃ kramagrahaḥ | ekakālatvāt sarvakāryāṇāṃ | atha bhinnakālakāraṇopādhikramāt kāryakramas tadayuktaṃ kālasyaikatvāt | ata eva na nityasya bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: kim ca kāla abhyupagama vādinaḥ api katham krama grahaḥ eka kāla tvāt sarva kāryāṇām atha bhinna kāla kāraṇa upādhi kramāt kārya kramaḥ tat ayuktam kālasya eka tvāt atas eva na nityasya bhāvaḥ

original: atha pūrvāpararūpatvāt kramavān kālaḥ |
analyzed: atha pūrva apara rūpa tvāt kramavān kālaḥ

original: nanu tasyāpi kramo yadi aparakālāpekṣas tadānavasthā syāt | atha tasya svarūpeṇā kramas tathā sahāyarahitānāmbahūnāṃ kāryāṇām api kramaḥ syāt | asmākan tu pūrvādipratyayaviṣaye mahābhūtaviṣayaḥ kālo lokapratītostyeva | tasya ca bhedāt kramādipratītir yujyate eva | nāpi prakārāntareṇa nityasya kartatvaṃ sambhavati |
analyzed: nanu tasya api kramaḥ yadi apara kāla apekṣaḥ tadā anavasthā syāt atha tasya sva rūpeṇa kramaḥ tathā sahāya rahitānām bahūnām kāryāṇām api kramaḥ syāt asmākam tu pūrva ādi pratyaya viṣaye mahābhūta viṣayaḥ kālaḥ loka pratītaḥ usti eva tasya ca bhedāt krama ādi pratītiḥ yujyate eva nā api prakāra antareṇa nityasya karta tvam sambhavati

original: yataḥ (p.81) prakārāntareṇaikadaikakāryakaraṇe 'nekakaraṇe vānyadā 'vastutvaṃ syāt kāryābhāvāt | punaḥ punaḥ kāryakaraṇe ca eva na prakārāntarasambhavaḥ | atha prakārāntareṇa naikadā kāryaṃ karoti punaḥ punaś ca na karoti tadāsyāvastutvaṃ syat | sarvadā 'karttṛtvāt |
analyzed: yatas prakāra antareṇa ekadā eka kārya karaṇe neka karaṇe vā anyadā vastu tvam syāt kārya abhāvāt punar punar kārya karaṇe ca eva na prakāra antara sambhavaḥ atha prakāra antareṇa na ekadā kāryam karoti punar punar ca na karoti tadā asya avastu tvam syat sarvadā karttṛ tvāt

original: tasmāt kramākramābhyāṃ ghaṭādir arthakriyākārīpratyakṣasiddhaḥ sā evāyam iti jñānād akṣaṇikaś ca pratīyata eva | tasya ca yadaikakāryakaraṇaṃ prati sāmarthyantattadaiva na pūrvaṃ na paścāttatkāryābhāvāt | sāmarthyaṃ ca tadavyatiriktam evam uttarottarakāryotpattāv api draṣṭavyaṃ |
analyzed: tasmāt krama akramābhyām ghaṭa ādiḥ arthakriyā kārī pratyakṣa siddhaḥ sā eva ayam iti jñānāt akṣaṇikaḥ ca pratīyate eva tasya ca yadā eka kārya karaṇam prati sāmarthyam tat tadā eva na pūrvam na paścāt tad kārya abhāvāt sāmarthyam ca tad avyatiriktam evam uttara uttara kārya utpattau api draṣṭavyam

original: sāmathyabhedena ca padārthabhedāt kṣaṇika eva kramākramayor niyamaḥ | tena yatra sattvan tatra kramākramapratītāv api kṣaṇikatvapraītir eva | ya eva kṣaṇike kramākramayor niyamoyam eva nityeṣu tayor ayogaḥ | tasmād yad etad ghaṭādau nityatvaṃ pratītaṃ tat sattvaviruddham iti nityasya kramayaugapadyābhyām arthakriyāvirodhaḥ siddha ucyate |
analyzed: sāmathya bhedena ca padārtha bhedāt kṣaṇike eva kramākramayoḥ niyamaḥ tena yatra tatra kramākrama pratītau api kṣaṇika tva praītiḥ eva yaḥ eva kṣaṇike kramākramayoḥ niyamaḥ yam eva nityeṣu tayoḥ ayogaḥ tasmāt yat etat ghaṭa ādau nitya tvam pratītam tat sattva viruddham iti nityasya krama yaugapadyābhyām arthakriyā virodhaḥ siddhaḥ ucyate

original: yathā ca dṛṣṭe ghaṭādau sattvaṃ kṣaṇikatvavyāptaṃ tathā 'dṛṣṭeṣv apy aviśeṣād iti vyāptiṃ sarvopasaṃhāreṇa pratipadya yathā teṣu sattvaṃ niścīyate tathā tathā kṣaṇikatvānumānaṃ | sattvāniścaye tu śaśaviṣāṇvatteṣv asattāśaṃkayā kṣaṇikatvāpratītiḥ syāt (|) na ca tatrāpi bādhakapramāṇenaiva kṣaṇikatvasya siddhatvād anumānasya vaiyarthyaṃ |

original: gṛhītavyāptikasya puṃsaḥ sattvaniścayamātreṇaiva sādhyārthāvagater bādhakotthānavaiyarthyāt | vistaratastvayaṃ vyāptigrahaṇaprakāro nairātmyasiddāv abhihita iti tatraivāvadhāryaḥ |

original: ye tu sattvasya vipakṣād abhāvena sarvatra kṣaṇikatvavyāotiṃ pratipadya sattvāttatraiva kṣaṇikatvam anumāpayanti | teṣām anumānotthānam eva syāt | vyāptigrahaṇād eva pramāṇat sarvatra kṣaṇikatvasya siddhatvāt | na ca dharmī siddhaḥ sarvasya trailokyasya pratyakṣatvād dhetuś cāsiddhaḥ |
analyzed: ye tu sattvasya vipakṣāt abhāvena sarvatra kṣaṇikatva vyāotim pratipadya sattvāt tatra eva kṣaṇikatvam anumāpayanti teṣām anumāna utthānam eva syāt vyāpti grahaṇāt eva sarvatra kṣaṇikatvasya siddha tvāt na ca dharmī siddhaḥ sarvasya trailokyasya pratyakṣa tvāt hetuḥ ca asiddhaḥ

original: pakṣīkṛte ca sarvasmin dharmiṇi bādhakavaśād yadi vipakṣābhāvaḥ siddhas tadā sādhyasyāpi siddhatvān nānumānasyotthānaṃ syāt |

analyzed: na anyaḥ ca dharmi siddhaḥ iti katham bādhakasya pravṛttiḥ iti yat kiñcid etat tasmāt sthitam etat asya sattva viśiṣṭasya kṛtaka tvasya kṣaṇika tva ākhyaḥ dharmaḥ svabhāvaḥ tanmātra anubandhī asya vā kṣaṇika tvasya svabhāvaḥ tanmātra anubandhī kṛtaka mātra anubandhī pramāṇa dṛṣṭaḥ iti

original: yad vā sattvaviśeṣaṇarahitasyāpi kṛtakatvādeḥ kṣaṇikatve sādhye nānaikāntikatvaṃ | yatas tasya prathame kṣaṇe ya eva svabhāvaḥ sa eva cet dvitīye kṣaṇe tadā 'bhūtvā bhavanam eva syāt prathamakṣaṇavat | tataś ca kṣaṇikatvaṃ | atha prathamakṣaṇe kṛtakasya janmaiva na sthitir dvutīyr tu kṣaṇe sthitir eva na janma | evam api kṣaṇikatvaṃ syāt |
analyzed: yat vā sattva viśeṣaṇa rahitasya api kṛtaka tva ādeḥ kṣaṇika tve sādhye na anaikāntika tvam yatas tasya prathame kṣaṇe yaḥ eva svabhāvaḥ saḥ eva ced dvitīye kṣaṇe tadā bhūtvā bhavanam eva syāt prathama kṣaṇa vat tatas ca kṣaṇika tvam atha prathama kṣaṇe kṛtakasya janma eva na sthitiḥ dvutīyā tu kṣaṇe sthitiḥ eva na janma evam api kṣaṇika tvam syāt

original: janmajanminor abhedāt | sthitisthitimatoś ca | na ca dvitīye kṣaṇe janma vinā sthitir (p.82) yuktā | janma cen na tadā sthitis tasyādvitīyādikṣaṇabhāvitvāt | tatrāpy evam iti sarvatrotpattir eva na sthitir iti kṣaṇikatvam eva | utpattiś ca hetuk´teti tatraiva kṛtakatvaṃ | na sthitau | tasmāt kṛtakatvasyākṣaṇikatvavuruddhatvān nānaikāntikatvaṃ |
analyzed: janma janminoḥ abhedāt sthiti sthitimatoḥ ca na ca dvitīye kṣaṇe janma vinā sthitiḥ yuktā janma ced na tadā sthitiḥ tasya advitīya ādi kṣaṇa bhāvi tvāt tatra api evam iti sarvatra utpattiḥ eva na sthitiḥ iti kṣaṇika tvam eva utpattiḥ ca hetuktā iti tatra eva kṛtaka tvam na sthitau tasmāt kṛtaka tvasya a kṣaṇika tva vuruddha tvāt na anaikāntika tvam

original: fn. 1: Pramāṇavārtika  1.224.
analyzed: pa-1 nm-1

original: tasmāt sattvānantarbhūtasyāpi kṛtakatvasya vyāptiḥ pramāṇadṛṣṭā | tadāhāsya svabhāvas tanmātrānubandhī pramāṇadṛṣṭas tadbhāvaniyamāt | kṛtakabhāve 'vaśyam anityatābhāvaniyamād iti |

original: evaṃ jñātatadbhāvasyān ity asvabhāvaṃ kṛtakaṃ jñānavataḥ puṃsorthāpattyā sādhyasyān ity atvasyābhāve kṛtakan na bhavatīty evaṃ niścayo bhavatīti | yasmān nahi svasyātmabhūtasyān ity atvasyābhāve bhāve bhavati | tadātmabhūtaṃ kṛtakatvambhvati | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) abhedāt sādhyasādhanayoḥ | anyatheti yady anityatvābhāve kṛtakatvanbhavet |

original: tadā tadbhāve kṛtakatvābhāde 'vśyam anityatvambhavatīty eva na syāt | tatheti yathā sādharmyaprayoge vaidharmyagatis tathā vaidharmyaprayogenvayasmṛtir bhavātīti vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ | tadabhāva iti nityatvābhāve kṛtakatvan na bhavaty avaśyam ity ukte | tata eva vaidharmyaprayogāt tadbhāvatāvedinaḥ | sadhanasya sādhyasvabhātāvedinaḥ puṃsaḥ |
analyzed: tadā tad bhāve kṛtaka tva ābhāde anitya tvam bhavati iti eva na syāt tathā iti yathā sādharmya prayoge vaidharmya gatiḥ tathā vaidharmya prayoga invaya smṛtiḥ bhavāti iti vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ tad abhāve iti nitya tva abhāve kṛtaka tvat na bhavati avaśyam iti ukte tatas eva vaidharmya prayogāt tad bhāva tā vedinaḥ sa dhanasya sādhya svabhā tā vedinaḥ puṃsaḥ

original: kathan tadbhāvatāṃ dettīti ced āha – tathā hītyādi | ayam anityatvākhyo dharmosya kṛtakatvasya svabhāvo yena tadabhāve krtakatvan na bhavati | anyatheti (|) anityatvaṃ yadi kṛtakasya svabhāvo na bhavet | tadā tadabhāve k´takatvan na bhaved ity asyāyogāt | iti hetos tatsvabhāvatāpratipattyā kṛtakasyān ity asvabhāvato pratipattyānvayasmṛtie bhavati |
analyzed: kathan tad bhāva tām detti iti ced āha tathā hi ityādi ayam anitya tva ākhyaḥ dharmaḥ asya kṛtaka tvasya svabhāvaḥ yena tad abhāve na bhavati anyathā iti anitya tvam yadi kṛtakasya svabhāvaḥ na bhavet tadā tad abhāve na bhavet iti asya ayogāt iti hetoḥ tad svabhāva tā pratipattyā iti asvabhāva to bhavati

original: etad uktam bhavati | ya eva hetoḥ sādhya eva bhāvaḥ sa eva vipakṣe 'bhāva ityanvayavyatirekayos tādātmyamanyonyavyāptiś cāto hetāv anvayapratītyā vyatirekapratītir vyatirekapratītyā cānvayapratītir anumānam eva |
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati yaḥ eva hetoḥ sādhye eva bhāvaḥ saḥ eva vipakṣe bhāvaḥ iti anvaya vyatirekayoḥ tādātmyam anyonya vyāptiḥ ca atas hetau anvaya pratītyā vyatireka pratītiḥ vyatireka pratītyā ca anvaya pratītiḥ anumānam eva

original: tena yad ucyate |
analyzed: tena yat ucyate

original: (p.83)  "sāmarthyam icchataḥ kī rtte rna ṣṭaṃ dvitvāvadhāraṇam " iti (nyāyamṃjarī?) tadapās taṃ |
analyzed: sāmarthyam icchataḥ kim rtteḥ na ṣṭam dvi tva avadhāraṇam iti nyāyamṃjarī tad apāḥ tam

original: yad vā naivaitat pramāṇaṃ kevalaṃ saṃketavaśād anvayamukhena vyatirekamukheṇa (?na) vā prayuktam ekaṃ vākyam ubhayaṃ gamayatīyt adoṣaḥ |
analyzed: yat vā nā eva etat pramāṇam kevalam saṃketa vaśāt anvaya mukhena vyatireka mukheṇa na vā prayuktam ekam vākyam ubhayam gamayati iyt adoṣaḥ

original: svabhāvahetāvanyataraprayogād ubhayagatim uktvā kāryahetāv āha – tathetyādi | yatreti sarvanāmnā sarvopasaṃhāras tatrāgnir avaśyam ity ukte 'smād evānvayavacanāt kāryandhūmo dahanasyety evan niścayo bhavati | kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) yena dhūme 'vaśyam agnir bhavati | anyathā yadī na kāraṇam agnidhūrmasya tadārthāntarasyāgnes tadanubandhaniyamābhāvāt |
analyzed: svabhāva hetau anyatara prayogāt ubhaya gatim uktvā kārya hetau āha tathā ityādi yatra iti sarvanāmnā sarva upasaṃhāraḥ tatra agniḥ avaśyam iti ukte smāt eva anvaya vacanāt dahanasya iti evat niścayaḥ bhavati kiṅkāraṇam yena dhūme vaśyam agniḥ bhavati anyathā yadi na kāraṇam agni dhūrmasya tadā artha antarasya agneḥ tad anubandha niyama abhāvāt

original: dhūme yonubandho vyāpanatanniyamasyābhāvāt | tataś ca svātantryam bhāvasya dhūmasvabhāvasya syāt | ata iti svātantryāt tadabhāvepy agnyabhāvepi dhūmasvabhāvasya vaikalyān nābhāvaḥ syān na caivan tasmāt kāryo dhūma eṣṭavyaḥ | yataḥ kārye tu dhūmebhyupagate 'vaśyan tatra kāraṇam agnir bhavati | idam ity asyaiva samarthaṃ |
analyzed: dhūme yaḥ anubandhaḥ vyāpana tad niyamasya abhāvāt tatas ca svātantryam bhāvasya dhūma svabhāvasya syāt atas iti svātantryāt tad abhāve api agni abhāve api dhūma svabhāvasya vaikalyāt na abhāvaḥ syāt na ca evam tasmāt kāryaḥ dhūmaḥ eṣṭavyaḥ yatas kārye tu dhūma abhyupagate tatra kāraṇam agniḥ bhavati idam iti asya eva samartham agniḥ bhavati idam iti asya eva samartham agniḥ bhavati idam iti asya eva samartham agniḥ bhavati idam iti asya eva samartham agni

original: arthāntarabhāva iti kāryābhimatasya bhāve svabhāvopadhānaṃ svarūpapratyupasthānaṃ | kāryasyāpi tadbhāva eva kāraṇabhāva eva bhāvaḥ kāryatvaṃ | tac ca kāraṇabhāva eva bhāvitvam asti dhūme | tasmāt kāryaṃ dhūma ity evam anvayena viditatatkāryatvasya puṃso dahanābhāve dhūmo na bhavatīty arthād bhavati |
analyzed: artha antara bhāvaḥ iti kārya abhimatasya bhāve svabhāva upadhānam svarūpa pratyupasthānam kāryasya api tad bhāve eva kāraṇa bhāvaḥ eva bhāvaḥ kārya tvam tat ca kāraṇa bhāve eva bhāvi tvam asti dhūme tasmāt kāryam dhūmaḥ iti evam anvayena vidita tad kārya tvasya puṃsaḥ dahana abhāve dhūmaḥ na bhavati iti arthāt bhavati

original: adhunā vaidharmyeṇānvayagatim āha – tathetyādi | asatyagnau dhūmo na bhavatīty ukte 'smād vyatirekavacanād viditatatkāryatvasya dhūme 'vaśyam agnir bhavatīty evam arthād anvayapratipattir bhavati |
analyzed: adhunā vaidharmyeṇa anvaya gatim āha tathā ityādi asati agnau dhūmaḥ na bhavati iti ukte smāt vyatireka vacanāt vidita tad kāryatvasya dhūme vaśyam agniḥ bhavati iti evam arthāt anvaya pratipattiḥ bhavati

original: anyathā yadi vaidharmyavacanenāgneḥ kāryaṃ dhūma ity etan na kathyate tadabhāve 'gnyabhāve kin na bhaved dhūmo bhavedeveti vyatirekaniścaya eva na syāt | tasmāt sthitam etat (|) satyarthāntaratve yadabhāve yasvaśyan na bhavati tattasya kāryam ataś ca vyatirekakathanād anvayo gamyata iti |
analyzed: anyathā yadi vaidharmya vacanena agneḥ kāryam dhūmaḥ iti etat na kathyate tad abhāve gni abhāve kin na bhavet dhūmaḥ bhavet eva iti vyatireka niścayaḥ eva na syāt tasmāt sthitam etat sati artha antara tve yad abhāve na bhavati tat tasya kāryam atas ca vyatireka kathanāt anvayaḥ gamyate iti

original: (p.84) atra paro vyabhicāram āha – nanu cetyādi nityānityāethayoḥ kāryannityānityārthakāryantadbhāvastattvaṃ tasyābhāvepi | tathā hi śravaṇajñānaṃ śabdasyaiva dharmatvās asādhāraṇan tatra na jñāyate sataḥ śabdasya kāryaṃ śravaṇajñāṇamutānityasyeti |
analyzed: atra paraḥ vyabhicāram āha nanu ca ityādi nitya anitya aithayoḥ kāryam nitya anitya artha kāryam tad bhāvaḥ tattvam tasya abhāve pi tathā hi śravaṇa jñānam śabdasya eva dharma tvāt asādhāraṇam tatra na jñāyate sataḥ śabdasya kāryam śravaṇa jñāṇam uta anityasya iti

original: tataś ca na nityārthakāryatvaṃ śravaṇajñānasya nāpy anityārthakāryatvan tathāpi śravaṇajñānan na bhavati tadabhāvepi nityānityārthābhāve | tadvyatireke vyatiricyata iti yāvat | nityārthābhāve tāvan na bhavaty anityeṣu ghaṭādiṣv abhāvāt | anityābhāvepi na bhavati nityeṣvākāśādiṣv abhāvāt | na vai na bhavatīti si ddhā ntavādī |
analyzed: tatas ca na nitya artha kārya tvam śravaṇa jñānasya na api anitya artha kārya tvam tathā api śravaṇa jñānat na bhavati tad abhāve pi nitya anitya artha abhāve tad vyatireke vyatiricyate iti yāvat nitya artha abhāve tāvat na bhavati anityeṣu ghaṭa ādiṣu abhāvāt anitya abhāve api na bhavati nityeṣu ākāśa ādiṣu abhāvāt na vai na bhavati iti si ddhānta vādī

original: na vai tacchrāvaṇatvan nityābhave na bhavatīty evaṃ śakyam vijñātuṃ | yadi tu tadabhāvena bhavatīty evan niścayaḥ syāt tadā tatkāryatvaṃ nniyamena syāt kin tu tadabhāve na bhavatīty eva nāsti | kiṅkāraṇan tayor eva nityānityatvayos tataḥ śrāvaṇatvāt saṃśayāt |
analyzed: na vai tat śrāvaṇa tvat nitya abhave na bhavati iti evam śakyam vijñātum yadi tu tad abhāvena bhavati iti evat niścayaḥ syāt tadā tad kārya tvam syāt kim tu tad abhāve na bhavati iti eva na asti tayoḥ eva nitya anitya tvayoḥ tatas śrāvaṇa tvāt saṃśayāt

original: anyathā nityānitye vastunyabhāvena niścitāc chrāvaṇatvāt kathan tadbhāvaparāmarśena śabde saṃśayaḥ syāt | tasmān nityānityābhyāṃ vyāvattir eva nāsti śrāvaṇatvasya |
analyzed: anyathā nitya anitye vastuni abhāvena niścitāt śrāvaṇa tvāt kathan tad bhāva parāmarśena śabde saṃśayaḥ syāt tasmāt nitya anityābhyām vyāvattiḥ eva nā asti śrāvaṇa tvasya

original: kathan tarhy asādhāraṇatvāc chrāvaṇatvaṃ nityānityayor nāstīty ucyata ity āha – kevalantv ityādi | nityāniteṣu śrāvaṇatvasya bhāvaniścayābhāvāt | śrāvaṇatvaṃ nityānatyayor nāstīty ucyate |
analyzed: kathan tarhi asādhāraṇa tvāt śrāvaṇa tvam nitya anityayoḥ na asti iti ucyate iti āha kevalam tu ityādi nitya aniteṣu śrāvaṇa tvasya bhāva niścaya abhāvāt śrāvaṇa tvam nitya anatyayoḥ na asti iti ucyate

original: nanv anityādike sādhye yadi śrāvaṇatvaṃ sapakṣavipakṣayor dṛṣṭaṃ syāt | syāc chabde śrāvaṇatvāt sandehaḥ | prameyatvād iva | na caitat sapakṣāvipakṣayor dṛṣṭam ato 'pratipattir iti bhaṭṭodyotakarau | atha śabdavastu kadā cin nityam anityam vā vastu dharmaś ca śrāvaṇatvantenātaḥ sabdeha ucyate |
analyzed: nanu anitya ādike sādhye yadi śrāvaṇa tvam sapakṣa vipakṣayoḥ dṛṣṭam syāt syāt śabde śrāvaṇa tvāt sandehaḥ prameya tvāt iva na ca etat sapakṣa avipakṣayoḥ dṛṣṭam pratipattiḥ iti bhaṭṭa udyota karau atha śabda vastu kadā cid nityam anityam vā vastu dharmaḥ ca śrāvaṇa tva antena atas ucyate

original: tad ayuktaṃ | evaṃ hi vastudharmatvasyaiva sandehahetutvaṃ syān na śrāvaṇatvasyeti | atrocyate | yadi hi yatra yatra śrāvaṇatvan tatra tatra nityānityayor abhāva iti pratipannaṃ syāt tato nityānityayor apratipattiḥ syāt | na cānityādiyuktaṃ gjaṭādau śrāvaṇatvasyābhāva iti śabdaabhāvas tena śrāvaṇatvāt tatra sandeha eva |
analyzed: tat ayuktam evam hi vastu dharma tvasya eva sandeha hetu tvam syāt na śrāvaṇa tvasya iti atra ucyate yadi hi yatra yatra tatra tatra nitya anityayoḥ abhāvaḥ iti pratipannam syāt tatas nitya anityayoḥ apratipattiḥ syāt na ca anitya ādi yuktam gjaṭa ādau śrāvaṇa tvasya abhāvaḥ iti śabda abhāvaḥ tena śrāvaṇa tvāt tatra sandehaḥ eva

original: nanu śrāvaṇatvaṃ śravaṇajñānaṃ prati sāmarthyan na ca nityasya sāmarthyam asty arthakriyāvirodhāt (|) tatkatham ataḥ sandehaḥ (|) anityatvasyaiva niścayād iti |
analyzed: nanu śrāvaṇa tvam śravaṇa jñānam prati sāmarthyat na ca nityasya sāmarthyam asti arthakriyā virodhāt tat katham atas sandehaḥ anitya tvasya eva niścayāt iti

original: evam manyate | yadi sāmarthyamātraṃ hetus tadā sattvam eva tad iti na kācit kṣatiḥ (|) (|) tasya sapakṣasādhāraṇatvād evaṃ prameyatvādiṣv api draṣṭavyaṃ | atha śravaṇajñānaṃ prati yat sāmarthyan tad dhetus tac ca na kvacid anityatvavyāptaṃ siddham iti katham ato 'nityatvasiddhir asādhāraṇatvād ayaṃ śabda eva tadanityatvavyāptaṃ siddhaṃ |
analyzed: evam manyate yadi sāmarthya mātram hetuḥ tadā sattvam eva tat iti na kācid kṣatiḥ tasya sapakṣa sādhāraṇa tvāt evam prameya tva ādiṣu api draṣṭavyam atha śravaṇa jñānam prati yat tat hetuḥ tat ca na kvacid anitya tva vyāptam siddham iti katham atas nitya tva siddhiḥ asādhāraṇa tvāt ayam śabde eva tat anitya tva vyāptam siddham

original: tenaiva hi bādhakena (p.85) pramāṇenānityatvasya tatra siddhatvāc chrāvaṇatvasya vaiyarthyaṃ syāt | evaṃ sa cāsādhāraṇahetunāmagamakatvaṃ boddhavyaṃ |
analyzed: tena eva hi bādhakena pramāṇena anitya tvasya tatra siddha tvāt śrāvaṇa tvasya vaiyarthyam syāt evam sa ca asādhāraṇa hetunām agamaka tvam boddhavyam

original: tasmāt sthitam etat (|) kāryaheto dṛṣṭāntābhyāṃ sādhyasādhanayor hetuphalabhāvaḥ kathanīyo na tu darśanādarśanamātraṃ | evaṃ hy arthāpattyā 'nyatareṇa dvitīyapratītir bhavet | anyathā na syād ity āha – yadā punar ityādi | tadā yatra dhūmas tatrāgnir ity eva na syād ity anvaya eva na syāt pratibandhābhāvāt |
analyzed: tasmāt sthitam etat kārya hetoḥ dṛṣṭāntābhyām sādhya sādhanayoḥ hetu phala bhāvaḥ kathanīyaḥ na tu darśana adarśana mātram evam hi arthāpattyā nyatareṇa dvitīya pratītiḥ bhavet anyathā na syāt iti āha yadā punar ityādi tadā yatra dhūmaḥ tatra agniḥ iti eva na syāt iti anvayaḥ eva na syāt pratibandha abhāvāt

original: yadā cānvaya eva na siddhas tadā kutognyabhāve dhūmo nāstīty arthād vyatirekasiddhiḥ | tathā vaidharmyeṇādarśanamātrasya khyāpanāt sādhyābhāve hetvabhāvāsiddheḥ kutas tadvāreṇānvayasmṛtiḥ | yathokta iti tādātmyatadutpattilakṣaṇaḥ | ekasadbhāve kāryasvabhāvaliṅgasya sadbhāve 'nyaprasiddhy arthaṃ kāraṇasya svabhāvasya ca liṅganaḥ prasiddhy arthaṃ |
analyzed: yadā ca anvayaḥ eva na siddhaḥ tadā kutas agni abhāve dhūmaḥ na asti iti arthāt vyatireka siddhiḥ tathā vaidharmyeṇa adarśana mātrasya khyāpanāt sādhya abhāve hetu abhāva asiddheḥ kutas tad vāreṇa anvaya smṛtiḥ yathā uktaḥ iti tādātmya tad utpatti lakṣaṇaḥ eka sadbhāve kārya svabhāva liṅgasya sadbhāve nyaprasiddhi artham kāraṇasya svabhāvasya ca liṅganaḥ prasiddhi artham

original: tadabhāve yathoktapratibandhābhāve satyekasadbhāve 'nyaprasiddher asanbhavāt || (30)
analyzed: tad abhāve yathā ukta pratibandha abhāve sati eka sadbhāve nyaprasiddheḥ asanbhavāt

original: hetusvabhāvābhāva iti hetvabhāvo vyāpakasvabhāvābhāvaś ca | ata ity anantaroktāt kāraṇāt kasyā sit kāryasya vyāpi asya ca pratiṣedhe | cakārāt pratiṣedhavyavahāre ca sādhye | hetur liṅgaṃ |
analyzed: hetu svabhāva abhāvaḥ iti hetu abhāvaḥ vyāpaka svabhāva abhāvaḥ ca atas iti anantara uktāt kāraṇāt kāryasya vyāpi asya ca pratiṣedhe cakārāt pratiṣedha vyavahāre ca sādhye hetuḥ liṅgam

original: kiṅ kāraṇaṃ (|) yasmāt tāv eva hi kāraṇavyāpakauni varttamānau svapratibaddhaṃ kāryaṃ ca svabhāvaṃ nivartayata iti kasya cid arthasya kāryasya vyāpyasya vā pratiṣedham api sādhayitukāmena | apiśabdād vyavahāram api (|) hetoḥ kāraṇasya vyāpakasya nivṛttir hetutvenākhyeyā | kiṅkāraṇaṃ | apratibandhe hītyādi |
analyzed: kim kāraṇam yasmāt tau eva hi kāraṇa vyāpakauni varttamānau sva pratibaddham kāryam ca svabhāvam nivartayataḥ iti kasya cid arthasya kāryasya vyāpyasya vā pratiṣedham api sādhayitu kāmena apiśabdāt vyavahāram api hetoḥ kāraṇasya vyāpakasya nivṛttiḥ hetu tvena ākhyeyā kiṅkāraṇam apratibandhe hi ityādi

original: na ca tābhyām anyaḥ pratibandhostīti bhāvaḥ | yukto nyāyya upalmbho yasya sa tathādaśyasyety arthaḥ | tasya (p.86) ceti svabhāvasyānupalambhanaṃ pratiṣrdhahetuḥ | nacāyaṃ pratiṣedhasyaiva hetuḥ kintu pratiṣedhaviṣayo vyavahāras tasya hetur iti kṛtvā tad dhetuḥ pratiṣedhahetur ityuktaḥ |
analyzed: na ca tābhyām anyaḥ pratibandhaḥ usti iti bhāvaḥ yuktaḥ nyāyyaḥ upalmbhaḥ yasya sa tathādaśyasya iti arthaḥ tasya ca iti svabhāvasya anupalambhanam pratiṣrdha hetuḥ na ca ayam pratiṣedhasya eva hetuḥ kintu pratiṣedha viṣayaḥ vyavahāraḥ tasya hetuḥ iti kṛtvā tat hetuḥ pratiṣedha hetuḥ iti uktaḥ

original: kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) na pratiṣedhahetus tathābhūtānupalambhasya dṛśyāmupalambhasya svayaṃ pratiṣedharūpatvāt | hetur vyāpakānupalabdhir iti kāraṇānupalabdhir vyāpakānupalabdhiś ca | ubhayasyāpīti pratiṣedhasya pratiṣedhavyavahārasya ca || (31)
analyzed: kim kāraṇam na pratiṣedha hetuḥ tathābhūta anupalambhasya dṛśyām upalambhasya svayam pratiṣedha rūpa tvāt hetuḥ vyāpaka anupalabdhiḥ iti kāraṇa anupalabdhiḥ vyāpaka anupalabdhiḥ ca ubhayasya api iti pratiṣedhasya pratiṣedha vyavahārasya ca

original: iti evam iyam anupalabdhiḥ | saṃkṣipya tridhāpy uktā satī punar anekadhoktā | yathātraivā 'ṣṭadhā prāg vibhaktā | kena prakāreṇety āha – tattadviruddhetyādi | tacchabdena prakrāntaṃ svabhāvakāraṇavyāpakatrayaṃ gṛhyate | tena svabhāvaditrayeṇa viruddhanta dviruddhantrividham eva bhavati | svabhāvaviruddhakāraṇaviruddhavyāpakaviruddhabhedāḥ |
analyzed: iti evam iyam anupalabdhiḥ saṃkṣipya tridhā api uktā satī punar anekadhā uktā yathā atra eva ṣṭadhā prāk vibhaktā kena prakāreṇa iti āha tad tad viruddha ityādi tad śabdena prakrāntam svabhāva kāraṇa vyāpaka trayam gṛhyate tena eva bhavati svabhāva viruddha kāraṇa viruddha vyāpaka viruddha bhedāḥ

original: tadviruddham ādir yasya tattadviruddhādi | ādiśabdena viruddhakāryasya kāraṇaviruddhakāryasya ca parigrahaḥ | tav va tadviruddhādi | tayor agatigatī | tadagatis tadviruddhādigatiś cety arthaḥ | tayor bhedas tena prayogas tasmāt prayogabhedatonekadhoktā |

original: yuktam etat | kin tv idam atra nirūpyate (|) kiṃ idaṃ nīlam akṣaṇikamuta kṣaṇarūpam atha santānaḥ | tatra yady akṣaṇikantadā nīlapratibhāse kathāṃ kṣaṇikatvapratibhāsaḥ | atha kṣaṇrūpaṃ | nanv idam evāsiddham iti kathaṃ nīlapratibhāse kṣaṇapratibhāsa ucyate | (p.93) kṣaṇāpratibhāsanāc ca na santānarūpasya nīlasya pratibhāsaḥ |
analyzed: yuktam etat kim tu idam atra nirūpyate kim idam nīlam akṣaṇikam uta kṣaṇa rūpam atha santānaḥ tatra yadi akṣaṇikam tadā nīla pratibhāse kathām kṣaṇika tva pratibhāsaḥ atha kṣaṇ rūpam nanu idam eva asiddham iti katham nīla pratibhāse kṣaṇa pratibhāsaḥ ucyate kṣaṇa apratibhāsanāt ca na santāna rūpasya nīlasya pratibhāsaḥ

original: atha nīlamātrapratibhāse sati kṣaṇikatvapratibhāsaḥ | tad ayuktaṃ | pratibhāsāpratibhāsābhyāṃ hi pratyakṣasya grahaṇāgrahaṇe | nānyathā | tad āha – tad yad api gṛhṇāti tatpratibhāseneti | na ca kṣaṇānāṃ pratibhāsa ity uktaṃ |

original: yadi ca nīlādyavyatiriktaṃ kṣaṇikatvantadā kṣaṇikatvasya niścitatvād anumānasya vaiyarthyaṃ syāt | yas tv āha – ekajñānaviṣayatvam eva kṣaṇikatvaṃ pūrvottarajñānaviṣayyatvavyāvṛttasyaiva cedānīntanajñānaviṣayatvasya pratibhāsanāt (|) pūrvāparakṣaṇavilakṣaṇa eva kṣaṇaḥ |

analyzed: bhaṭṭa vāsudevaḥ tu āha pūrva uttara kṣaṇānām vināśena apratibhāsanam eva akṣaṇikatva pratibhāsanam atas kṣanikatva grāhakam eva sarvam pratyakṣam kevalam kṣaṇikatva anumānena bhrāntam sādhyate iti

original: etad apy ayuktaṃ | pratijñāyāḥ pratyakṣabādhitatvenānumānasyotthānābhābāt | nirvikalpakasyāpi pratyakṣasya bhrāntatve sambandhagrahaṇāc ca | paśyann apīti granthavirodhaś ca (|) tasmād ayuktam uktsṃ | paśyann api na vyavasyatīti |
analyzed: etat api ayuktam pratijñāyāḥ pratyakṣa bādhita tvena anumānasya utthāna abhāvāt nirvikalpakasya api pratyakṣasya bhrānta tve sambandha grahaṇāt ca paśyan api iti grantha virodhaḥ ca tasmāt ayuktam paśyan api na vyavasyati iti

original: atrocyate | yathā hy arthakṣaṇānāṃ paurvāparyantathā jñānakṣaṇānām api tena pūrvakeṇa jñānakṣaṇena pūrvaka evārthakṣaṇo gṛhyate nottaraḥ | uttareṇāpy uttara eva na pūrva iti (|) ekasmin jñāne tayor apratibhāsanāt katham pūrvasmādayam anya iti vibhāgena pratibhāsaḥ syād iti codyate |
analyzed: atrā ucyate yathā hi artha kṣaṇānām jñāna kṣaṇānām api tena pūrvakeṇa jñāna kṣaṇena pūrvakaḥ eva artha kṣaṇaḥ gṛhyate na uttaraḥ uttareṇa api uttaraḥ eva na pūrvaḥ iti ekasmin jñāne tayoḥ apratibhāsanāt katham pūrvasmāt ayam anyaḥ iti vibhāgena pratibhāsaḥ syāt iti codyate

original: svarūpapratibhāsa eva ca bhāvasyāny asmād vivekapratibhāsaḥ sumerubhinnnapratibhāsavat | sa ca kṣaṇasyāpyastye veti kathaṃ na vivekapratibhāsaḥ | dṛṣṭo dṛśyata iti pratīteś ca | anyo hi dṛṣṭaḥ svabhāvonyaś ca dṛāyamānaḥ | tathā hi prathamadarśī dṛśyamānam eva svabhāvambhāvasya paśyati na tu dṛṣṭam ity anayor bheda eva |
analyzed: sva rūpa pratibhāsaḥ eva ca asmāt viveka pratibhāsaḥ sumeru bhinna pratibhāsa vat sa ca kṣaṇasya api astye vā iti katham na viveka pratibhāsaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ dṛśyate iti pratīteḥ ca anyaḥ hi dṛṣṭaḥ svabhāvaḥ anyaḥ ca tathā hi prathama darśī dṛśyamānam eva paśyati na tu dṛṣṭam iti anayoḥ bhedaḥ eva

original: kevalam ekāntasadṛśayoḥ pūrvāparakṣaṇayor abhāvenāvyavadhānād ghaṭapaṭādivad vibhāgapratipattir na | nāpi vibhābenāpratibhāsād abhedopi (|) na hi śuktikāyān tad evedam asmadīyaṃ rajatam iti pravarttamānasya śuktikārajatayor vivekapratibhāsābhāvād abhedopi |
analyzed: kevalam ekānta sadṛśayoḥ pūrva apara kṣaṇayoḥ abhāvena avyavadhānāt ghaṭa paṭa ādi vat vibhāga pratipattiḥ na nā api vibhābena apratibhāsāt abhedaḥ upi na hi śuktikāyān tat eva idam asmadīyam rajatam iti pravarttamānasya śuktikā rajatayoḥ viveka pratibhāsa abhāvāt abhedaḥ upi

original: tasmād yathātra nirvikalpake jñāne śuktikāyāḥ svarūpapratibhāsa evānyamāda vivekapratibhāsaḥ | tathaikasyāpi kṣaṇasya syāt (|) kevalaṃ pūrvaḥ kṣaṇaḥ (p.94) kasmān na vibhāgena smaryata iti yadi paraṃ codyaṃ ayāt tatra coktam eva sadṛśāparotpattivipralabdhair na smaryata iti |
analyzed: tasmāt yathā atra nirvikalpake jñāne śuktikāyāḥ sva rūpa pratibhāsaḥ eva anyamāda viveka pratibhāsaḥ tathā ekasya api kṣaṇasya syāt kevalam pūrvaḥ kṣaṇaḥ kasmāt na vibhāgena smaryate iti yadi param codyam ayāt tatra ca uktam eva sadṛśa apara utpatti vipralabdhaiḥ na smaryate iti

original: nanu tathāpi kṣaṇo na pratibhāsate | ekāṇvatyayakālatvenaiva bhāvasyāpratīteḥ | na tu yady ekasmin kṣaṇesyāpratibhāsaḥ katham akṣaṇikasya pratibhāsaḥ pratikṣaṇam apratibhāsanāt | utpadyamānasya ca bhāvasya pūrvāpararūpaviviktasya pratyakṣeṇa grahaṇāt kathaṃ kṣaṇikatvagrahaḥ |
analyzed: nanu tathā api kṣaṇaḥ na pratibhāsate eka aṇu atyaya kāla tvena eva bhāvasya apratīteḥ na tu yadi ekasmin kṣaṇe sya apratibhāsaḥ katham akṣaṇikasya pratibhāsaḥ pratikṣaṇam apratibhāsanāt utpadyamānasya ca bhāvasya pūrva apara rūpa viviktasya pratyakṣeṇa grahaṇāt katham kṣaṇika tva grahaḥ

original: nāpy akṣaṇikaḥ pratīyate pūrvāparakālayor apratibhāsād eva tatsambandhitayedānīṃ pratyakṣe 'pratibhāsāt pūrvakālasambandhisvabhāvasyedānīmapratibhāsa eva vināśo 'nyasvabhāvasya pratibhāsa evotpāda iti katham ucyate pūrvottarakṣaṇānāṃ vināśotpādāpratibhāsanād akṣaṇika iti |
analyzed: na api akṣaṇikaḥ pratīyate pūrva apara kālayoḥ apratibhāsāt eva tad sambandhitayā idānīm pratyakṣe pratibhāsāt pūrva kāla sambandhi svabhāvasya idānīm apratibhāsaḥ eva vināśaḥ nya svabhāvasya pratibhāsaḥ eva utpādaḥ iti katham ucyate pūrva uttara kṣaṇānām vināśa utpāda apratibhāsanāt akṣaṇikaḥ iti

original: nāpy anekakṣaṇarūpa idānīntanaḥ kālonekakṣaṇasambhave gṛhītādirūpatā 'sya syāt na vyarthatā |
analyzed: nā api aneka kṣaṇa rūpaḥ idānīntanaḥ kālaḥ neka kṣaṇa sambhave gṛhīta ādi rūpa tā syāt na vyartha tā

original: na hi pratyakṣabhāvinā niścayenedānīm evedam astīti niścīyate (|) kin tarhīdānīm astīti | anumānena tvidānīm evāstīti sādhyate |
analyzed: na hi pratyakṣa bhāvinā niścayena idānīm eva idam asti iti niścīyate kin tarhi idānīm asti iti anumānena tu idānīm eva asti iti sādhyate

original: tasmāt sthitam etat (|) paśyann api na vyavasyatītyādi |
analyzed: tasmāt sthitam etat paśyan api na vyavasyati ityādi

original: nanu yadi nityaṃ sadṛśa iti pratyakṣeṇa niścayaḥ syāt sa evāyam iti buddhir bhrāntir yāvatā sarvadā sa evāyam iti pratītir dṛḍharūpotpadyata iti kathaṃ bhrāntis tad āha bhaṭṭaḥ1 ||
analyzed: nanu yadi nityam sadṛśaḥ iti pratyakṣeṇa niścayaḥ syāt saḥ eva ayam iti buddhiḥ bhrāntiḥ yāvatā sarvadā saḥ eva ayam iti pratītiḥ dṛḍha rūpā utpadyate iti katham bhrāntiḥ tat āha bhaṭṭaḥ

original: fn. 1: Ślokavārtika: śabdanittyatā 'dhikaraṇe 373,374 (tadā 'stitvā 'dhikatvāc ca sādhitaṃ |)
analyzed: śloka vārttika adhikaraṇe

original: nityaṃ sadṛśa eveti yatra rūḍhā matirbhiveta |
analyzed: nityam sadṛśaḥ evā iti yatra rūḍhā matiḥ bhiveta

original: sa iti pratyabhijñānaṃ bhrāntia tatrāvakalpate ||
analyzed: saḥ iti pratyabhijñānam tatra avakalpate

original: iha nityaṃ eveti vijñānaṃ jāyate dṛḍhaṃ |
analyzed: iha nityam eva iti vijñānam jāyate dṛḍham

original: tad astitvātir ekāc ca prāmāṇyantasya yujyate ||
analyzed: tat astitva atiḥ ekāt ca prāmāṇi antasya yujyate

original: deśakālādibhedena tatrāsty avasaro mitaḥ |
analyzed: deśa kāla ādi bhedena tatra asti avasaraḥ mitaḥ

original: idānīntanam astitvaṃ na hi pūrvadhiyo gataṃ ||
analyzed: idānīntanam astitvam na hi pūrva dhiyaḥ gatam

original: na ca sarvadānumānena sadṛśaniścayaḥ |       pratyakṣapratyabhijñābādhitatvāt pratyabhijñānayā anumānotthānābhāvāt | na ca pratyabhijñāyā aprāmāṇyam itaretarāśrayadoṣāt | yato na yāvad aprāmāṇyam asyās tāvan nānumānasyotthānaṃ yāvac ca nānumānotthānantāvan nāsyā aprāmāṇyamanyonyāśrayadoṣa iti |
analyzed: na ca sarvadā anumānena sadṛśa niścayaḥ pratyakṣa pratyabhijñā bādhita tvāt pratyabhijñānayāḥ anumāna utthāna abhāvāt na ca pratyabhijñāyāḥ aprāmāṇyam itaretara āśraya doṣāt yatas na yāvat aprāmāṇyam asyāḥ tāvat na anumānasya utthānam yāvat ca na anumāna utthānam tāvat na asyāḥ aprāmāṇyam anyonya āśraya doṣaḥ iti

original: atrocyate | sa ity anena pūrvakālasambandhī svabhāvo viṣayīkriyate | ayam ity anena ca varttamānakālasambandhī | aneyoś ca bhedo na ca kathaṃ cid abhedo varttamānakālabhāvirūpaikasvabhāvatvād (p.95) vastunaḥ | tasmād bheda eva pratyabhijñāne sati bhāsata iti katham anena kṣaṇikatvānumānabādhā |
analyzed: atrā ucyate saḥ iti anena pūrva kāla sambandhī svabhāvaḥ viṣayīkriyate ayam iti anena ca varttamāna kāla sambandhī aneyoḥ ca bhedaḥ na ca katham cit abhedaḥ varttamāna kāla bhāvi rūpa eka svabhāva tvāt vastunaḥ tasmāt bhedaḥ eva pratyabhijñāne sati bhāsate iti katham anena kṣaṇikatva anumāna bādhā

original: yad vā vastunaḥ pūrvakālasambandhitvam idānīm asad eva | pūrvakālābhāvāt | sattve vāsya varttamānakālasambandhitvam eva syān na pūrvakālasambandhitvaṃ virodhād ity ayuktaṃ | tasmāt pūrvakālasambandhitvasyāsato grāhakaḥ sa iti jñānāṃśo bhrānto 'nyathā vastunaḥ spaṣṭabālādyavasthā grāhakaḥ syān na ca bhavati |
analyzed: yat vā vastunaḥ pūrva kāla sambandhi tvam idānīm asat eva pūrva kāla abhāvāt sattve vā asya varttamāna kāla sambandhi tvam eva syāt na pūrva kāla sambandhi tvam virodhāt iti ayuktam tasmāt pūrva kāla sambandhi tvasya asataḥ grāhakaḥ saḥ iti jñāna aṃśaḥ bhrāntaḥ nyathā vastunaḥ spaṣṭa bāla ādi avasthāḥ grāhakaḥ syāt na ca bhavati

original: tasmāt bhrāntāt pūrvadṛṣṭarūpāropeṇa sa evāyam iti jñānāt katham anumānabādhā | yatra cākṣavyāpāras tadgrāhakaṃ pratyakṣam utpadyate | na ca pūrvakālāstitve 'dhunā kva vyāpāro 'san nihitatvāt | nāpi tad abhedena tatkathaṃ pūrvottarakālāstitvayor aikyagrāhakaṃ jñānaṃ pratyakṣaṃ syāt |
analyzed: tasmāt bhrāntāt pūrva dṛṣṭa rūpa āropeṇa saḥ eva ayam iti jñānāt katham anumāna bādhā yatra ca akṣa vyāpāraḥ tad grāhakam pratyakṣam utpadyate na ca pūrva kāla astitve kva san nihita tvāt na api tat abhedena tat katham pūrva uttara kāla astitvayoḥ aikya grāhakam jñānam pratyakṣam syāt

original: yadā ca bālādyavasthāyāṃ dṛṣṭaḥ vṛddhāvasthāyāṃ pratyakṣabhijñāyate | na tatra vā pratyabhijñāne nityatvaṃ pratibhāsate | kevalaṃ sa evāyam iti tattvan adhyavasīyate | na ca tattvan bālavṛddhāvasthayor bhedāt | nāpi tattvagrahaṇānyathānupapattyā nityatvādikalpanā | sadṛśāparotpattibhrāntinimittād apy utpattisambhavāt | lūnapunarjāteṣv iva keśeṣu |
analyzed: yadā ca bāla ādi avasthāyām dṛṣṭaḥ vṛddha avasthāyām na tatra vā pratyabhijñāne nitya tvam pratibhāsate kevalam saḥ eva ayam iti tattvan adhyavasīyate na ca tattvan bāla vṛddha avasthayoḥ bhedāt nā api tattva grahaṇa anyathā anupapattyā nitya tva ādi kalpanā sadṛśa apara utpatti bhrānti nimittāt api utpatti sambhavāt lūna punar jāteṣu iva keśeṣu

original: na cātra keśatvasāmānyād bhinnāt pratyabhijñānaṃ | tad iheti uddhyutpādaprasaṅgāt | nāpy abhinnād anyatrānugame vā 'nugatavyāvṛttarūpayoḥ | paramparāsaṃśleśeṇaikāntabhinnatvāt | tataś ca ta evāmī keśā iti pratyabhijñā sadśāparotpattinimittaivāt eva bhrāntiḥ | tathā ghaṭādiśv asyābhrāntatvāśaṃkayānumānasyotthānāṃ yujyata eva |
analyzed: na ca atra keśa tva sāmānyāt bhinnāt pratyabhijñānam tat iha iti uddhi utpāda prasaṅgāt nā api abhinnāt anyatra anugame vā nugata vyāvṛtta rūpayoḥ paramparā saṃśleśeṇa ekānta bhinna tvāt tatas ca te eva amī keśāḥ iti pratyabhijñā eva bhrāntiḥ tathā ghaṭa ādiṣu asya abhrānta tva āśaṃkayā anumānasya utthānām yujyate eva

original: nāpītaretarāśrayatvaṃ yato nānumānena pratyabhijñāyā aprāmāṇyaṃ kriyato 'pi tu jñāyate svahetuta evāpramāṇarūpāyā niṣyatteḥ | dṛśyata iti grahāt | dṛṣṭatvaṃ hi na pūrvambhāvasthāsti | tadā dṛśyamānaikarūpatvāt | nāpy adhunā 'eva | nāpi pūrvakālasambandhitvaṃ dṛśyamānasyedānīṃ pūrvam abhāvāt |
analyzed: na api itaretara āśraya tvam yatas na anumānena pratyabhijñāyāḥ aprāmāṇyam tu jñāyate sva hetutaḥ evā apramāṇa rūpāyāḥ niṣyatteḥ dṛśyate iti grahāt dṛṣṭa tvam hi na pūrvambhāva sthā asti tadā dṛśyamāna eka rūpa tvāt nā api adhunā eva nā api pūrva kāla sambandhi tvam dṛśyamānasya idānīm pūrvam abhāvāt

original: tasmād dṛṣṭatvamāropya grāhikā pratyabhijñā bhrāntatvād apramāṇaivotpadyate | nāpy asyā aprāmāṇyanimittam anumānasyotthānam api tu sādhyapratibanimittamataḥ pratyabhijñāyā bādhakaṃ | vistaras tvayaṃ pratyabhijñābhaṅgavicāro nairātmyasiddhau kṛta iti tatraivāvadhāryaḥ |
analyzed: tasmāt dṛṣṭa tvam āropya grāhikā pratyabhijñā bhrānta tvāt apramāṇā evā utpadyate nā api asyāḥ aprāmāṇya nimittam anumānasya utthānam api tu sādhya pratiba nimittam atas pratyabhijñāyāḥ bādhakam vistaraḥ tu ayam pratyabhijñā bhaṅga vicāraḥ nairātmya siddhau kṛtaḥ iti tatra eva avadhāryaḥ

original: tasmāt sthitam etat (|) tāṃ punaḥ kṣaṇasthitidharmatāṃ svabhāvampaśyann api sadṛśāparotpattivipralabdhaḥ pūrvakṣaṇavināśāviniścayān na vyavasyatīti |
analyzed: tasmāt sthitam etat tām punar kṣaṇa sthiti dharmatām svabhāvam paśyan api sadṛśa apara utpatti vipralabdhaḥ pūrva kṣaṇa vināśa aviniścayāt na vyavasyati iti

original: kathaṃ punar gamyate sadṛśāparotpattyā vipralabdho na vyavasytītyata āha – antyetyādi | sadṛśakṣaṇāntarāpratisandhāyī kṣaṇo 'ntyskṣaṇas taddarśinṇṃ naṣṭa iti niścayāt | (p.96) avagamyate prāg apy ayam pratikṣaṇam eva naśyati kevalaṃ yathoktād eva vipralambhahetor na niścīyate |
analyzed: katham punar gamyate sadṛśa apara utpattyā vipralabdhaḥ na vyavasyati iti atas āha antya ityādi sadṛśa kṣaṇa antara a pratisandhāyī kṣaṇaḥ naṣṭaḥ iti niścayāt avagamyate prāk api ayam pratikṣaṇam eva naśyati kevalam yathā uktāt eva vipralambha hetoḥ na niścīyate

original: nanvantyakṣaṇadarśinopi kathann aśvaratvaniścayo yāvatā tadāpi sattopalambho 'sti | na hi sattāyām evopalabhamānas tadabhāvamavaitīty āha – paścād ityādi | na brūmontyakṣaṇadarśanamātrānniścayo bhavatīti kintvantyaṃ kṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā paścād vi .........1 bhavati(|) tadā nopalabhyate tattasya kāryaṃ |
analyzed: nanu antya kṣaṇa darśinaḥ api kathan aśvara tva niścayaḥ yāvatā tadā api sattā upalambhaḥ sti na hi sattāyām eva upalabhamānaḥ tad abhāvam avaiti iti āha paścāt ityādi na brūmaḥ antya kṣaṇa darśana mātrāt niścayaḥ bhavati iti kintu antyam kṣaṇam dṛṣṭvā paścāt bhavati tadā na upalabhyate tat tasya kāryam

original: na cāgnikāṣṭādisannidhāne bhavato dhūmasyāpanīte 'śvādau anupalambhosti | agnyādau tvanīte bhavaty anupalambhaḥ | evam parasparasahitau pratyakṣānupalambhābabhimateṣv eva kāraṇeṣv asandigdhaṃ kāraṇatvaṃ sādhyata iti | tacceti yathoktaṃ kāryalakṣaṇaṃ dhūmesti tasmād agner eva dhūmo bhavati |
analyzed: na ca agni kāṣṭa ādi sannidhāne bhavataḥ dhūmasya apanīte śva ādau anupalambhaḥ usti agni ādau tu anīte bhavati anupalambhaḥ evam paraspara sahitau pratyakṣa anupalambhau abhimateṣu eva kāraṇeṣu asandigdham kāraṇa tvam sādhyate iti tat ca iti yathā uktam kārya lakṣaṇam dhūme asti tasmāt agneḥ eva dhūmaḥ bhavati

original: sarvakālaṃ cāgnisannidhāne bhavato dhūmasyān agnijanyatvaṃ kadācit sadasatorajanyatvād (p.97) ahetutvād adṛśyahetutvād vocyate | tatra na tāvat prathamaḥ pakṣā iti tṛtīyoparicchede aśaktaṃ sarvam iti ced ity atrāntare (pra.vā. 3|4) vakṣyāmaḥ | nāpy ahetutvam iti tatraiva vakṣyati | nāpy adṛśyahetutvaṃ dhūmasya |
analyzed: sarvakālam ca agni sannidhāne bhavataḥ dhūmasya an agni janya tvam kadācid sat asatoḥ ajanya tvāt ahetu tvāt adṛśya hetu tvāt vā ucyate tatra na tāvat prathamaḥ pakṣāḥ iti tṛtīya uparicchede aśaktam sarvam iti ced iti atra antare vakṣyāmaḥ na api ahetu tvam iti tatra eva vakṣyati na api adṛśya hetu tvam dhūmasya

original: agnyādisāmagryanvayavyatirekānuvidhānāt |
analyzed: agni ādi sāmagrī anvaya vyatireka anuvidhānāt

original: fn. 1: 37th leaf is missing.
analyzed: fn 1 37th leaf is missing

original: atha syād (|) adṛśyasyāyaṃ svabhāvo yad agnyādisannidhāna eva dhūmaṃ karpūrādidāhakāle sugndhādiyuktaṃ ca karoti nānyadeti | tat kim agnim antareṇa kadā cid dhūmotpattir daṣṭā yonaivam ucyate | neti cet | tat kathan nāgnikāryo dhūmas tadbhāve bhāvāt | dhūmotpattikāle cāgniḥ sarvadā pratīyamānopi kākatālīyanyāyenāvasthita ity alīkikoyaṃ vyapadeśaḥ |
analyzed: atha syāt adṛśyasya ayam svabhāvaḥ yat agni ādi sannidhāne eva dhūmam karpūra ādi dāha kāle sugndha ādi yuktam ca karoti na anyadā iti tat kim agnim antareṇa kadā cid dhūma utpattiḥ daṣṭā yonā evam ucyate na iti ced tat kathan nā agni kāryaḥ dhūmaḥ tad bhāve bhāvāt dhūma utpatti kāle ca agniḥ sarvadā pratīyamānaḥ api kākatālīya nyāyena avasthitaḥ iti alīkikaḥ ayam vyapadeśaḥ

original: atha vā sa evādṛśyasya svabhāvo yady agninā nopakriyate tat kim agnyādisannidhāna eva dhūmaṃ karoti na pūrvan na paścāt | tasmād agnyādisannidhāna evāsvabhāvo dhūmajanako bhavati nānyadeti tatrāpi pāramparyeṇa dhūmasyāgnijanyatvam eva syāt |
analyzed: atha vā saḥ eva adṛśyasya svabhāvaḥ yadi agninā na upakriyate tat kim agni ādi sannidhāne eva dhūmam karoti na pūrvat na paścāt tasmāt agni ādi sannidhāne eva asvabhāvaḥ dhūma janakaḥ bhavati na anyadā iti tatra api pāramparyeṇa dhūmasya agni janya tvam eva syāt

original: kiñ ca yathā deśakālādikam antareṇa dhūmasyānutpattes tadapekṣā pratīyate tathā sarvadāgnim antareṇānutpattidarśanād agnyapekṣā 'sya kena vāryeta | tadapekṣā ca tatkāryataiva | yathā cādṛśyabhāva eva dhūmasya bhāvāttajjanyatvam iṣyate tathā sarvakālam agnibhāve bhāvasarśanād agnijanyatvaṃ kin neṣyate |
analyzed: kim ca yathā deśa kāla ādikam antareṇa dhūmasya anutpatteḥ tad apekṣā pratīyate tathā sarvadā agnim antareṇa anutpatti darśanāt agni apekṣā kena vāryeta tad apekṣā ca tad kāryatā eva yathā ca adṛśya bhāve eva dhūmasya bhāvāt tad janya tvam iṣyate tathā sarvakālam agni bhāve bhāva sarśanāt agni janya tvam kin nā iṣyate

original: yāvatāṃ ca sannidhūna evotpadyamāno bhāvo dṛśyate tāvatām eva hetutvaṃ sarveṣāṃ prāgbhāvasya tulyatvāt | tathā cāgnyadṛśyādisāmagrījanyatvaṃ dhūmasyeti kutognivyabhicāraḥ |
analyzed: yāvatām ca sannidhūnaḥ evā utpadyamānaḥ bhāvaḥ dṛśyate tāvatām eva hetu tvam sarveṣām prāgbhāvasya tulya tvāt tathā ca agni adṛśya ādi sāmagrī janya tvam dhūmasya iti kutas agni vyabhicāraḥ

original: anyas tv āha – bhavatv agnidhūmayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvatas tathāpi na tayor ekena jñānena geahaṇam bhinnakālatvāt | nāpy anena pūrvakeṇa hi nirvikalpakena pūrvakam vastu mātraṃ gṛhītaṃ na tu kāraṇarūpaṃ kāryasya bhāvitvenāpratyakṣatvāt | uttareṇāpy uttaram vastumātraṃ gṛhyate na tu kāryarūpaṃ kāraṇasyātītatvenāgrahāt |
analyzed: anyaḥ tu āha bhavatu agni dhūmayoḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvataḥ tathā api na tayoḥ ekena jñānena bhinna kāla tvāt nā api anena pūrvakeṇa hi nirvikalpakena pūrvakam vastu mātram gṛhītam na tu kāraṇa rūpam kāryasya bhāvi tvena apratyakṣa tvāt uttareṇa api uttaram vastu mātram gṛhyate na tu kārya rūpam kāraṇasya atīta tvena agrahāt

original: nāpi savikalpakena tatrāpy asya codyasya tulyatvāt | tenedamasmād utpannam iti na kena cid g´hītam ata eva na smaraṇenāpi gṛhyatenubhavābhāvād iti |
analyzed: nā api savikalpakena tatra api asya codyasya tulya tvāt tena idam asmāt utpannam iti na kena cid ghītam atas eva na smaraṇena api gṛhyate anubhava abhāvāt iti

original: atrocyate | kāryasya tāvad anutpannāvasthāyāmasattvād eva na kāraṇasambandhitvaṃ niṣpannāvasthāyām apy evaṃ | nirapekṣatvāt (|) tathā kāryaniṣpattyaniṣpattyavasthāyāṃ kāryāsambandhy eva | nāpy anayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ sambandho bhinnakālatvāt | kevalam asyedaṃ kārya kāraṇaṃ ceti kalpitoyaṃ vyapadeśaḥ |
analyzed: atrā ucyate kāryasya tāvat anutpanna avasthāyām asattvāt eva na kāraṇa sambandhi tvam niṣpanna avasthāyām api evam nirapekṣa tvāt tathā kārya niṣpatti aniṣpatti avasthāyām kārya asambandhi eva nā api anayoḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ sambandhaḥ bhinna kāla tvāt kevalam asya idam kārya kāraṇam ca iti kalpitaḥ ayam vyapadeśaḥ

original: tena hetoḥ sakāśāt svarūpalābha eva kāryatvaṃ | kāraṇasyāpi kārya prati prāgbhāva eva kāraṇatvaṃ sa cātmalābhaḥ prāgbhāvaś ca bhāvasyābhinnatvāt pratyakṣagṛhīta eva ceti kathaṃ na pratyakṣagrāhyaḥ (p.98) kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ kevalaṃ kāryadarśane satīdam asya kāryakāraṇaṃ cati vyavahliyate | yato nākāryakāraṇayoḥ kāryakāraṇa bhāvaḥ sambhavati |
analyzed: tena hetoḥ sakāśāt svarūpa lābhaḥ eva kārya tvam kāraṇasya api kārya prati prāgbhāvaḥ eva kāraṇa tvam sa ca ātma lābhaḥ prāgbhāvaḥ ca bhāvasya abhinna tvāt pratyakṣa gṛhītaḥ eva ca iti katham na pratyakṣa grāhyaḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ kevalam kārya darśane sati idam asya kārya kāraṇam ca ti vyavahliyate yatas na akārya kāraṇayoḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ sambhavati

original: nāpi kāryakāraṇabhāvayogāttayoḥ kāryakāraṇatā 'bhannā karttuṃ śakyate virodhāt | nāpi bhinnā tayoḥ svarūpeṇākāryakāraṇatā prasaṅgāt | svarūpeṇa kāryakāraṇayor api kiṃ kārya kāraṇabhāvenārthāntareṇa kalpitena svarūpeṇaiva kāryakāraṇarūpatvāt (|) tasmāt pūrvottarabhāva eva tayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ |
analyzed: nā api kārya kāraṇa bhāva yogāt tayoḥ kārya kāraṇa tā bhannā karttum śakyate virodhāt nā api bhinnā tayoḥ sva rūpeṇa akārya kāraṇa tā prasaṅgāt sva rūpeṇa kārya kāraṇayoḥ api kim kārya kāraṇa bhāvena artha antareṇa kalpitena sva rūpeṇa eva kārya kāraṇa rūpa tvāt tasmāt pūrva uttara bhāvaḥ eva tayoḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ

original: tena pūrvake vastuni gṛhyamāṇe kāryapratyānantaryakāraṇātmakaṃ gṛhītam eva | uttareṇa ca jñānenottaram vastu kāraṇānanataraṃ gṛhyamāṇaṃ kāryātmakaṃ eva gṛhyate (|) tadānantaryasya tadabhinnasvabhāvatvāt | ata evāsmād anantaram idam bhavatīti smaraṇam api bhavatyānantaryasyānubhūtatvād iti |
analyzed: tena pūrvake vastuni gṛhyamāṇe kārya pratyānantarya kāraṇa ātmakam gṛhītam eva uttareṇa ca jñānena uttaram vastu kāraṇa ananataram gṛhyamāṇam kārya ātmakam eva gṛhyate tad ānantaryasya tad abhinna svabhāva tvāt atas eva asmāt anantaram idam bhavati iti smaraṇam api bhavati ānantaryasya anubhūta tvāt iti

original: aviddhakarṇṇas tv āha – avinābhāvitvaṃ ekaṃ dṛṣṭvā dvitīyādidarśane satisidhyati(|) na ca kṣaṇikavādino draśṭurara(?)vasthānam asti | na cāntenānubhūterthenyasyāvinābhāvitvasmaraṇam asty atiprasaṅgād iti (|)
analyzed: tu āha avinābhāvi tvam ekam dṛṣṭvā dvitīya ādi darśane sati sidhyati na ca kṣaṇika vādinaḥ asti na asti atiprasaṅgāt iti

original: tad ayuktaṃ | prathamāder arthakṣaṇasya prathamādijñānakṣaṇena grahaṇād ekasantatipatitānāṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvena smarṇasambhavāc ca | yathā ca kṣaṇikapakṣe kāryakāraṇabhāvas tathokta1m eva vakṣyati ca |
analyzed: tat ayuktam prathama ādeḥ artha kṣaṇasya prathama ādi jñāna kṣaṇena grahaṇāt eka santati patitānām kārya kāraṇa bhāvena smarṇa sambhavāt ca yathā ca kṣaṇika pakṣe kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ tathā uktam eva vakṣyati ca

original: fn. 1: Pramāṅavārtika 1.33.
analyzed: fl

original: nanv evam api kṣaṇānām aniścayena kathaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvaniścayo na ca santānena tanniścayas tasya santānibhyo bhinnasyābhāvāt kevalaṃ santānina eva pūrvāparakālabhāvinaḥ (|) tatra ca yadaikaḥ kṣaṇo na tadānya iti ekakṣaṇāvabhāsa eveti kathaṃ santānāvabhāsaḥ (|) tadabhāvāt kathaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāva iti (|)
analyzed: nanu evam api kṣaṇānām aniścayena katham kārya kāraṇa bhāva niścayaḥ na ca santānena tad niścayaḥ tasya santānibhyaḥ bhinnasya abhāvāt kevalam santāninaḥ eva pūrva apara kāla bhāvinaḥ tatra ca yadā ekaḥ kṣaṇaḥ na tadā anyaḥ iti eka kṣaṇa avabhāsaḥ eva iti katham santāna avabhāsaḥ tad abhāvāt katham kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ iti

original: tad ayuktaṃ (|) ekaparamāṇvātmakasya vastuno bhāvāt athūlātmanāṃ santānināṃ nairantaryapratibhāsa eva santānapratibhāsas tatra ca kṣaṇavivekānavadhāraṇena sādṛśyena caikatvādhyavasāyād ekasantativartināṃ kṣāṇāṃ na kāryakāraṇabhāvaniścayaḥ |
analyzed: tat ayuktam eka paramāṇu ātmakasya vastunaḥ bhāvāt athūla ātmanām santāninām nairantarya pratibhāsaḥ eva santāna pratibhāsaḥ tatra ca kṣaṇa viveka anavadhāraṇena sādṛśyena ca ekatva adhyavasāyāt eka santati vartinām kṣāṇām na kārya kāraṇa bhāva niścayaḥ

original: bhinnasantānavartināṃ tu santānapravṛttyā vijātīyatvād bhavati tanniścayas tenāgnisantānapūrvakasya dhūmasantānasya pratītet agnidhūmasantānayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaniścaya ucyate iti yat kiṅcid etat |
analyzed: bhinna santāna vartinām tu santāna pravṛttyā vijātīya tvāt bhavati tad niścayaḥ tena agni santāna pūrvakasya dhūma santānasya agni dhūma santānayoḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāva niścayaḥ ucyate iti yat kiṅcid etat

original: adhyayanas tu āha – svalakṣaṇayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvagrahaṇe sati kathaṃ sāmānyayor gamyagamakabhāvo bhinnatvād iti |
analyzed: adhyayanaḥ tu āha sva lakṣaṇayoḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāva grahaṇe sati katham sāmānyayoḥ gamya gamaka bhāvaḥ bhinna tvāt iti

original: tad apy ayuktaṃ (|) anekasvalaṅṣaṇātmakasya sāmānyasyābhyupagamāt | tad uktam (|)
analyzed: tat api ayuktam aneka sva laṅṣaṇa ātmakasya sāmānyasya abhyupagamāt tat uktam

original: (p.99) atadrūpaparāvṛttavastumātraprasādhanāt |
analyzed: a tad rūpa parāvṛtta vastu mātra prasādhanāt

original: sāmānyaviṣayaṃ praoktaṃ liṅgaṃ bhedāpratiṣṭhiter iti || (pra.sa.)
analyzed: sāmānya viṣayam liṅgam bheda apratiṣṭhiteḥ iti

original: tena svalakṣaṇānāṃ sambandhagraha eva sāmānyānāṃ sambandhagraho na tad anyaḥ |
analyzed: tena sva lakṣaṇānām sambandha grahaḥ eva sāmānyānām sambandha grahaḥ na tat anyaḥ

original: tanv anumānavādinā bauddhena yāvanti svalakṣaṇāni trailokye | tāni sarvāṇy agnivyāptāni gṛhītavyānyekasyāpy agrahīte naivānaikāntiko hetuḥ syāt (|) na caivaṃ pratyakṣaṃ karttuṃ śaknoti sannihitaviṣayatvāt | na vānyeṣāṃ svalakṣaṇānām anumānataḥ sādhyadharmeṇa vyāptigrahaṇam anavasthāprasaṅgād iti |
analyzed: tanu anumāna vādinā bauddhena yāvanti sva lakṣaṇāni trailokye tāni sarvāṇi agni vyāptāni gṛhītavyāni ekasya api a grahīte na eva anaikāntikaḥ hetuḥ syāt na ca evam pratyakṣam karttum śaknoti sannihita viṣaya tvāt na vā anyeṣām sva lakṣaṇānām anumānataḥ sādhya dharmeṇa vyāpti grahaṇam anavasthā prasaṅgāt iti

original: tad ayuktaṃ yataḥ (|) pratyakṣam agnibhedasannidhāna eva dhūmabhedāt pratipat | eṣvadhūmavyāvṛttaṃ rūpaṃ dhūmam anagnivyāvṛttāgnimātrakāryam evety avadhārayati (|) yathātra tathānyatrāpi deśā dāvetad rūpam agnijanyam eveti cāvadhārayatyanyathātrāgnisambandhitayā na pratyakṣeṇa gṛhyate |
analyzed: tat ayuktam yatas pratyakṣam agni bheda sannidhāne eva dhūma bhedāt pratipad eṣu adhūma vyāvṛttam rūpam dhūmam anagni vyāvṛtta agni mātra kāryam eva iti avadhārayati yathā atra tathā anyatra api deśāḥ dau etat rūpam agni janyam eva iti ca avadhārayati anyathā atra agni sambandhi tayā na pratyakṣeṇa gṛhyate

original: evam agnyanagnikāryatveayobhayasambandhitayā pratītiḥ syān nāgnisambatdhitayaiva | pratīyate ca (|) tasmād anyatrāpy etadrūpam agner eva bhavatīti niścayāt kuto dhūmasyāgnivyabhicāraḥ | yaś ca tadrūpam vāṣpādivilakṣaṇam avadhārayituṃ śaknoti tasyaivaitadanumānaṃ nānyasya |
analyzed: evam pratītiḥ syāt na agni sambatdhitayā eva pratīyate ca tasmāt anyatra api etad rūpam agneḥ eva bhavati iti niścayāt kutas dhūmasya agni vyabhicāraḥ yaḥ ca tad rūpam vāṣpa ādi vilakṣaṇam avadhārayitum śaknoti tasya eva etat anumānam na anyasya

original: sāmānyavyāptigrahaṇavādināpi gopālaghaṭaṭikādāv agnimantareṇa dhūmasāmānyadarśanāvyabhicāraśaṃkayāgniniyatadhūmasāmānyāvadhāraṇenaiva tadanumānaṃ (|) agniniyatadhūmasāmānyāvadhāraṇaṅ cāgnisaṃmbaddhadhūmāvyaktyavadhāpurassatam eva | na ca sarvatra deśādāvāgnisambaddhadhūmavyaktiviśiṣṭasya dhūmasāmānyasya grahaṇaṅkena cit pramāṇena sambhavati |
analyzed: sāmānya vyāpti grahaṇa vādinā api gopāla ghaṭa ṭikā ādau agnim antareṇa dhūma sāmānya darśana avyabhicāra śaṃkayā agni niyata dhūma sāmānya avadhāraṇena eva tat anumānam agni niyata dhūma sāmānya avadhāraṇam ca agni saṃmbaddha dhūma avyakti avadhā purassatam eva na ca sarvatra deśa ādau āgni sambaddha dhūma vyakti viśiṣṭasya dhūma sāmānyasya grahaṇam kena cit pramāṇena sambhavati

original: nāpi mahānasādāv agnisambaddhadhūmavyaktiviśiṣṭaṃ dhūmasāmānyaṃ pratipannam anyatrānuyāyivyakter ananvayāt | yac ca dhūmasāmānyam anuyāyi tan nāgnyavyabhicāri | tasmāt sāmānyavyāptigrhaṇavādinopi kathaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ dhūmasāmānyaṃ sarvatrāgninā vyāptaṃ pratipannam iti tulyaṃ codyaṃ |
analyzed: nā api mahānasa ādau agni sambaddha dhūma vyakti viśiṣṭam dhūma sāmānyam pratipannam anyatra anuyāyi vyakteḥ ananvayāt yat ca dhūma sāmānyam anuyāyi tat na agni avyabhicāri tasmāt sāmānya vyāpti grhaṇa vādinaḥ api katham viśiṣṭam dhūma sāmānyam sarvatra agninā vyāptam pratipannam iti tulyam codyam

original: atha dhūmasyānyatrāgnijanyatve na kiṃ cid bādhakam asti tad evedam iti ca pratītes tatsāmānyam pratipannam iṣyate 'smākam api tad evedam iti pratyayasyotpattes tatpratipannam iṣyata ity āvayoḥ kobheda iti (|)
analyzed: atha dhūmasya anyatra agni janya tve na kim cit bādhakam asti tat eva idam iti ca pratīteḥ tat sāmānyam pratipannam iṣyate smākam api tat eva idam iti pratyayasya utpatteḥ tat pratipannam iṣyate iti āvayoḥ kaḥ bhedaḥ iti

original: yat kiṅ cad etat | etam evārthan darśayann āha – sa dhūmo bhavaṃs tadabhāve 'gnyabhāve hetumattāmbilaṅghayedahetukaḥ syāt | yad vā sa dhūmognisambandhitayā pratītas tadabhāvegnyabhāve bhavan hetumattām agnisambandhitayā na pratyakṣaṇa pratīyate | pratīyate ca |
analyzed: yat kiṅ cat etat etam eva arthan darśayan āha sa dhūmaḥ bhavan tad abhāve gni abhāve hetumat tām bilaṅghayet ahetukaḥ syāt yat vā sa dhūmaḥ ugni sambandhi tayā pratītaḥ tad abhāve gni abhāve bhavan hetumat tām agni sambandhi tayā na pratyakṣaṇa pratīyate pratīyate ca

original: tasmāt sakṛd api na kevalaṃ bhūyas tathādarśanād ity anantaroktāt pratyakṣānupalambhāt | (p.100)
analyzed: tasmāt sakṛt api na kevalam bhūyas tathā darśanāt iti anantara uktāt pratyakṣa anupalambhāt

original: kiṅ kāraṇam (|) akāraṇād agneḥ sakṛd api na kevalaṃ bhūyo 'bhāvāt | na hi bālukābhyaḥ sakṛd api tailambhavati | kāryasyetyādinā kārikārtham āha – na hītyādy asyaiva samarthanaṃ |
analyzed: kim kāraṇam akāraṇāt agneḥ sakṛt api na kevalam bhūyas bhāvāt na hi vālukābhyaḥ sakṛt api tailam bhavati kāryasya ityādinā kārikā artham āha na hi ityādi asya eva samarthanam

original: etena vyāptiḥ kathitā bhavati ca dhūmognim antareṇa vyabhicāravādinaḥ | anena ca pakṣadharmaḥ kathitaḥ | tad iti tasmās agnim antareṇa bhāvān na tad dhetur nāgnihetus tathā cāhetuḥ syād iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: etena vyāptiḥ kathitā bhavati ca dhūma ugnim antareṇa vyabhicāra vādinaḥ anena ca pakṣa dharmaḥ kathitaḥ tat iti agnim antareṇa bhāvān na tat hetuḥ na agni hetuḥ tathā ca ahetuḥ syāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: kayam ityādi paraḥ | idānīm ity ekasya dhūmāder vijātīyād utpattyanabhyupagame | katham bhinnāt parasparavijātīyāt | sahakāriṇaḥ sakāśād ekasya kāryasyotpattiḥ | katham ity āha – yathetyādi | ādiśabdād ālokamanaskārādayaḥ | evañ ca sati cakṣuḥ svabhāvād apy utpadyate vijñānam acakṣuḥsvabhāvād api rūpamanaskārāder na cedam ahetukaṃ |
analyzed: ityādi paraḥ idānīm iti ekasya dhūma ādeḥ vijātīyāt utpatti anabhyupagame katham bhinnāt paraspara vijātīyāt sahakāriṇaḥ sakāśāt ekasya kāryasya utpattiḥ katham iti āha yathā ityādi ādi śabdāt āloka manaskāra ādayaḥ evam ca sati cakṣuḥ svabhāvāt api utpadyate vijñānam a cakṣuḥ svabhāvāt api rūpa manaskāra ādeḥ na ca idam ahetukam

original: evaṃ dhūmopy agner etpadyatām anagneś ca śakramūrdhnaḥ | na cāgetuko bhaviṣyatīti codako manyate |
analyzed: evam dhūmaḥ upi agneḥ anagneḥ ca śakra mūrdhnaḥ na ca a getukaḥ bhaviṣyati iti codakaḥ manyate

original: na vai kiṃ cid ityādinā pratividhatte | cakṣur ādiṣu tatsvabhāvaṃ janakasvabhāvaṃ sadekaikaṃ parasparānapekṣaṃ na vai janakaṃ (|) yadi hi syāt tadā pratyekaṃ kāraṇavyabhicārād ahetukaṃ syāt | kin tu sāmagrī janikā | tatsvabhāvā janakasvabhāvā |
analyzed: na vai kim cit ityādinā pratividhatte cakṣuḥ ādiṣu tad svabhāvam janaka svabhāvam sat ekaikam paraspara anapekṣam na vai janakam yadi hi syāt tadā pratyekam kāraṇa vyabhicārāt ahetukam syāt kin tu sāmagrī janikā tad svabhāvā janaka svabhāvā

original: sāmagrī janikety etān ataiva tatsvabhāvatvaṃ labdhamatatsvabhāvasyājanakatvāt tat kiṃ svabhāveti pṛthag ucyate | satyaṃ kintvavadhāraṇārtham uktaṃ | sāmagryavasthāyām eva tatsvabhāvatā | na pūrvan na paścān na pṛthag iti | svahetusāmarthyaniyatasannidhīty ekasmin kārye samastāv anye kāraṇāni hetur iti samudāyārthaḥ |
analyzed: sāmagrī janikā iti etān tad svabhāva tvam labdham atatsvabhāvasya ajanaka tvāt tat kim svabhāva iti pṛthak ucyate satyam kintu avadhāraṇa artham uktam sāmagrī avasthāyām eva tad svabhāva tā na pūrvat na paścāt na pṛthak iti sva hetu sāmarthya niyata sannidhi iti ekasmin kārye samastau anye kāraṇāni hetuḥ iti samudāya arthaḥ

original: kecit tu vā śabdaṃ paṭhanti (|) sānagrī janikā tatsvabhāvā veti | atra tu vāśabdasya na kiṃ sit prayojanam ity a(pa)pāṭha evāyaṃ | yadi sāmagrīty uktvā sāmagry antarād api cakṣur vijñānaṃ syāt tadā bhinnād utpāder ahetukatvam bhavet | saiva sāmgry anumīyate | kāryeṇa na pratyekaṃ kāraṇād anyato nāsti vyabhicāra iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: kecid tu vā śabdam paṭhanti sā anagrī janikā tad svabhāvā vā iti atra tu vā śabdasya na kim prayojanam iti apapāṭhaḥ eva ayam yadi sāmagrī iti uktvā sāmagrī antarāt api cakṣuḥ vijñānam syāt tadā bhinnāt ahetuka tvam bhavet sā eva sāmgrī anumīyate kāryeṇa na pratyekam kāraṇāt anyatas na asti vyabhicāraḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: syād etad agnyādisāmagryā ādya eva dhūmakṣaṇo janito na ca tasya liṅgatvantasyāniścayāt | (p.105) yaś ca dhūmapratibandho gṛhyate pūrvadhūmahetur eva (|) kathan tatognyādisāmagryā anumānam ity ata āha – saiva cetyādi kāryaprabandhasya svabhāvasthiteḥ | āśraya ādyaṃ kāraṇaṃ | sāmagrīm antareṇa dhūmasantānasyaivābhāvāt |
analyzed: syāt etat agni ādi sāmagryā ādyaḥ eva dhūma kṣaṇaḥ janitaḥ na ca tasya yaḥ ca dhūma pratibandhaḥ gṛhyate pūrva dhūma hetuḥ eva kathan tatas agni ādi sāmagryāḥ anumānam iti atas āha sā eva ca ityādi kārya prabandhasya svabhāva sthiteḥ āśraye ādyam kāraṇam sāmagrīm antareṇa dhūma santānasya eva abhāvāt

original: tato dhūmasantānam agnikāryatvenaikīkṛtya dahanādisantateḥ kāraṇabhūtāyā anumānaṃ | na hi kṣaṇavibhāgenārvāgdarśanasya |
analyzed: tatas dhūma santānam agni kārya tvena ekīkṛtya dahana ādi santateḥ kāraṇa bhūtāyāḥ anumānam na hi kṣaṇa vibhāgena arvāk darśanasya

original: syād etad (|) atīva eva vahnir anumīyate | na ca tenārthakriyārthinaḥ kiṃcit prayojanam ity etad api codyamānenaiva parihṛtaṃ | tadā cāyam arthaḥ (|) saiva ca sāmagrī prabandhena pravarttamānā kāryasvabhāvasthiteḥ kāryaprabandhavṛtter hetuḥ pūrvapūrvam agnyādikṣaṇaṃ pratītyottarottarasya dhūmakṣaṇasyotpatteḥ |
analyzed: syāt etat atīvaḥ eva vahniḥ anumīyate na ca tena artha kriyā arthinaḥ kiṃcid prayojanam iti etat api codyamānena eva parihṛtam tadā ca ayam arthaḥ sā eva ca sāmagrī prabandhena pravarttamānā kārya svabhāva sthiteḥ kārya prabandha vṛtteḥ hetuḥ pūrva pūrvam agni ādi kṣaṇam pratītya uttara uttarasya dhūma kṣaṇasya utpatteḥ

original: na hy ayaṃ niyamo yad eka eva dhūmakṣaṇogninā janyo nāpara iti | yāvadindhanasya na sarvathā bhasmībhavanantāvad dhūmakṣaṇānām utpattir viruddhā |
analyzed: na hi ayam niyamaḥ yat ekaḥ eva dhūma kṣaṇa ugninā janyaḥ na aparaḥ iti yāvat indhanasya na sarvathā dhūma kṣaṇānām utpattiḥ viruddhā

original: tasmād uttarottaradahanakṣaṇajananam arthenaprabandhapravṛttenāgninā yathābhūto dhūmaprabandho janitaḥ pratyakṣāvadhāritas tathābhūtam anyatrāvadhāryārthakriyāsam arthadahanasantānasyānumānan tadarthino na viruddham (|) anya eva ca svabhāvo vicchinnadahanasantānasya dhūmasyānya eva vicchinnadahanasantater vāsagṛhādisthasya |
analyzed: tasmāt uttara uttara dahana kṣaṇa jananam arthena prabandha pravṛttena agninā yathābhūtaḥ dhūma prabandhaḥ janitaḥ pratyakṣa avadhāritaḥ tathābhūtam anyatra avadhārya artha kriyā asam artha dahana santānasya tad arthinaḥ na viruddham anyaḥ eva ca svabhāvaḥ vicchinna dahana santānasya dhūmasya anyaḥ eva vicchinna dahana santateḥ vāsagṛha ādi sthasya

original: aphuṭaś ca tayor bhedamavadhārayati loka iti kuto vyabhicāraḥ |
analyzed: aphuṭaḥ ca tayoḥ bhedam avadhārayati lokaḥ iti kutas vyabhicāraḥ

original: athavā 'nyathā vyākhyāyate |
analyzed: athavā nyathā vyākhyāyate

original: nanu sāmagrī samagrebhyonyā | tasyāś caikatvād ekam eva kāryam utpadyate 'nyathā samagrāṇāṃ pratyekaṃ sāmarthyāt kāryabahutvam paryāyeṇa caikakāryajanakatvaṃ syān na ca bhavati | tasmāt katham ekajanakatvam ity āśaṃkyāha –
analyzed: nanu sāmagrī samagrebhyaḥ nyā tasyāḥ ca ekatvāt ekam eva kāryam utpadyate nyathā samagrāṇām pratyekam sāmarthyāt kārya bahutvam paryāyeṇa ca eka kārya janaka tvam syāt na ca bhavati tasmāt katham eka janaka tvam iti āśaṃkya āha

original: saiva cetyādi | saiva ca sāmagrīti samagrā eva sāmagrī śabdenocyante | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ | svabhāvasthityā svarūpasannidhānena kāryasyāśrayo bhavati yataḥ |
analyzed: sā eva ca ityādi sā eva ca sāmagrī iti samagrāḥ eva sāmagrī śabdena ucyante kim kāraṇam svabhāva sthityā sva rūpa sannidhānena kāryasya āśrayaḥ bhavati yatas

original: evam manyate | yadi sāmagryā eva kāryotpattis tadā samagrāṇām akārakatvaṃ syāt | tathā ca pratītibādhā | samagrāṇām api kārakatve sutarāṃ kāryabahutvaṃ syāt | paryāyeṇa caikakāryajanakatvaṃ syāt | na ca sāmagrībalāt teṣām ekarūpatā | sāmagryā evābhāvaprasaṅgāt | tasmāt te samgrāḥ svahetubhya evaikakāryakaraṇe niyatā utpannāḥ sāmagrīśabdenocyante |
analyzed: evam manyate yadi sāmagryāḥ eva kārya utpattiḥ tadā samagrāṇām akāraka tvam syāt tathā ca pratīti bādhā samagrāṇām api kāraka tve sutarām kārya bahutvam syāt paryāyeṇa ca eka kārya janaka tvam syāt na ca sāmagrī balāt teṣām eka rūpa tā sāmagryāḥ eva abhāva prasaṅgāt tasmāt te samgrāḥ sva hetubhyaḥ eva eka kārya karaṇe niyatāḥ utpannāḥ sāmagrī śabdena ucyante

original: na ca bahūnām ekakāryakaraṇe bādhakam asti | na cāsmākaṅ kāraṇam eva kāryo bhavatīti mataṃ yenānekasyaikakāryatvam virudhyeta | yathā caikakāryaṃ tyeprakasya prāgbhāva eva kāraṇatvan dṛṣṭatvāt tathānekasyāpi (|) yathā vā ta eva samagrāḥ saṃyogalakṣaṇām ekāṃ sāmagṛīñ janayanti | tathaikam api kāryaṃ kin na kurvantīti (|)
analyzed: na ca bahūnām eka kārya karaṇe bādhakam asti na ca asmākam kāraṇam eva kāryaḥ bhavati iti matam yena anekasya eka kārya tvam virudhyeta yathā ca eka kāryam tyeprakasya prāgbhāvaḥ eva dṛṣṭa tvāt tathā anekasya api yathā vā te eva samagrāḥ saṃyoga lakṣaṇām ekām sāmagṛīn janayanti tathā ekam api kāryam kin na kurvanti iti

original: (p.106) yat kiñcid etat | yataś ca sāmagrījanikā 'ta eva sahakāriṇām aparyāyeṇa jananaṃ | paripāṭyā jananaṃ nāstīty arthaḥ |
analyzed: yat kiñcid etat yatas ca sāmagrī janikā te eva sahakāriṇām aparyāyeṇa jananam paripāṭyā jananam na asti iti arthaḥ

original: yad apītyādinā vijātīyād utpattimāśaṃkya pariharati | nānyādṛśāttādṛ(śa)ntasyotpattir iti yad uktan tad evātra darśayatīty arthaḥ | ādiśabdād gauśṛṅgāccharo gosayād vṛścikaḥ (|) tatrāpīti vijātīyāt kāryotpattāv api |
analyzed: yat api ityādinā vijātīyāt utpattim āśaṃkya pariharati na anyādṛśāt tādṛśam tasya utpattiḥ iti yat uktan tat eva atra darśayati iti arthaḥ ādi śabdāt gau śṛṅgāt śaraḥ go sayāt vṛścikaḥ tatra api iti vijātīyāt kārya utpattau api

original: tathābhidhānepīti vjjātīyotpannasya śālūkādeḥ śālūkād ity abhidhānepi svavījācchālūkādilakṣaṇāt prabhava utpattir asya tasmāt svavījaprabhavācchālūkādeḥ sakaśād asty eva svabhāvabhedaḥ | bījāt kandāccodbhavo yasyāḥ kadalyāḥ sā tathā | sā ca hrtutvabhedāt parasparabhinnā |
analyzed: tathā abhidhāne api iti vjjātīya utpannasya śālūka ādeḥ śālūkāt iti abhidhāne api sva vījāt śālūka ādi lakṣaṇāt prabhavaḥ utpattiḥ asya tasmāt sva vīja prabhavāt śālūka ādeḥ sakaśāt asti eva svabhāva bhedaḥ bījāt kandāt ca udbhavaḥ yasyāḥ kadalyāḥ sā tathā sā ca hrtu tva bhedāt paraspara bhinnā

original: na cāyam bhedaḥ sādhanīya ity āha – sphuṭam ityādi | vivecayati bhede vā bhāvasyeti | suvicecitākāraṃ bhrāntir hetubhyaḥ sadṛśākārebhyo vibhāgena niścit ākāraṃ || (38,39)
analyzed: na ca ayam bhedaḥ sādhanīyaḥ iti āha sphuṭam ityādi vivecayati bhede vā bhāvasya iti su vicecita ākāram bhrāntiḥ hetubhyaḥ sadṛśa ākārebhyaḥ vibhāgena niścit ākāram

original: tadbhāva eva bhāvo 'nvayaḥ | tadabhāve cābhāva eva vyatirekaḥ | anvayo vyatirekaś cānvayavyatirekan tasmāt | yaḥ kāryasvabhāvo yasyānuvarttanīyasya kāraṇasyānuvarttako dṛṣṭas tasyānuvarttakasya svabhāvas tad dhetuḥ sonuvarttanīyaḥ kāraṇāt sā hetur yasyeti vigrahaḥ |
analyzed: tad bhāve eva bhāvaḥ nvayaḥ tad abhāve ca abhāvaḥ eva vyatirekaḥ anvayaḥ vyatirekaḥ tasmāt yaḥ kārya svabhāvaḥ yasya anuvarttanīyasya kāraṇasya anuvarttakaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ tasya anuvarttakasya svabhāvaḥ tat hetuḥ saḥ anuvarttanīyaḥ kāraṇāt sā hetuḥ yasya iti vigrahaḥ

original: yadā tu kāraṇāpekṣayocyate tadā svabhāvas tasyānuvarttanīyasyāgnyādes tad dhetus tasya kāryābhimatasya dhūmāder hetuḥ | yataś caivaṃ parasparāprkṣayā kāryakāraṇayo(ḥ) svabhāvaniyamaḥ | ataḥ kāraṇād bhinnād vijātīyān na sambhavaḥ |
analyzed: yadā tu kāraṇa apekṣayā ucyate tadā svabhāvaḥ tasya anuvarttanīyasya agni ādeḥ tat hetuḥ tasya kārya abhimatasya dhūma ādeḥ hetuḥ yatas ca evam paraspara āprkṣayā kārya kāraṇayoḥ svabhāva niyamaḥ atas kāraṇāt bhinnāt vijātīyāt na sambhavaḥ

original: tasmāt sakṛd api darśanādarśanābhyām iti yathoktābhyāṃ | pratyakṣānupalambhābhyāṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvasiddheḥ kāraṇād bhavati (|) tataḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvasiddhitaḥ tatpratipattir anvayaṃ vyatirekapratipattir nānyatheti kāryakāraṇabhāvaniścayanty aktvā kevalābhyān (p.107) darśanādarśanābhyāṃ nānvayavyatirekayoḥ pratipattiḥ |
analyzed: tasmāt sakṛt api darśana adarśanābhyām iti yathā uktābhyām pratyakṣa anupalambhābhyām kārya kāraṇa bhāva siddheḥ kāraṇāt bhavati tatas kārya kāraṇa bhāva siddhitaḥ tad pratipattiḥ anvayam vyatireka pratipattiḥ na anyathā iti kārya kāraṇa bhāva niścayanti aktvā kevalābhyām darśana adarśanābhyām na anvaya vyatirekayoḥ pratipattiḥ

original: kiṅ kāraṇaṃ (|) niḥśeṣidarśanādarśanāyattatvād darśanamātrapratibaddhāyā anvayavyatirekapratipatteḥ| evaṃ hi darśanam anvayaṃ sādhayati yadi niḥśeṣe sapakṣe hetor darśanaṃ syāt | evam adarśanam api vyatirekaṃ sādhayet | yadi niḥśeṣe sādhyavyatireke hetor adarśanaṃ syāt |
analyzed: kim kāraṇam niḥśeṣi darśana adarśana āyatta tvāt darśana mātra pratibaddhāyāḥ anvaya vyatireka pratipatteḥ evam hi darśanam anvayam sādhayati yadi niḥśeṣe sapakṣe hetoḥ darśanam syāt evam adarśanam api vyatirekam sādhayet yadi niḥśeṣe sādhya vyatireke hetoḥ adarśanam syāt

original: yathaikatra dhūmavyakto sakṛd api kāryatvasiddhyā sarvatra tathābhāvaḥ (|) eva kvacit sapakṣāsapakṣayor darśanād adarśanāt sarvatrānvayavyatirekaniścayo bhaviṣyatīty api mithyā (|) yasmāt kvacid amūrtatve ākāśādigate nityatvasya darśane | paraprasiddhyā caitad ucyate | anyatra sukhādau|
analyzed: yathā ekatra sakṛt api kāryatva siddhyā sarvatra tathābhāvaḥ eva kvacid sapakṣa asapakṣayoḥ darśanāt adarśanāt sarvatra anvaya vyatireka niścayaḥ bhaviṣyati iti api mithyā yasmāt kvacid amūrta tve ākāśa ādi gate nitya tvasya darśane para prasiddhyā ca etat ucyate anyatra sukha ādau

original: anyathety anityatve hetor amūrttatvasya dṛṣīeḥ kāraṇād ekatra darśanaṃ na sarvatra tathābhāvasādhanam ato darśanam avvaye vyabhicāri |
analyzed: anyathā iti anitya tve hetoḥ amūrtta tvasya kāraṇāt ekatra darśanam na sarvatra tathābhāva sādhanam atas darśanam avvaye vyabhicāri

original: tathā kvacid ghaṭādau nityatvābhāvepy adṛṣṭasyāmūrttatvasya punar nityatvābhāva eva sukhādao dṛṣṭer ato vipakṣaukadeśādarśanam asādhanaṃ vyatirekaniścaye tasmād dhetuphalabhāvaniścayād evānvayavyatirekayor niścayaḥ | (40)
analyzed: tathā kvacid ghaṭa ādau nitya tva abhāve api adṛṣṭasya amūrtta tvasya punar nitya tva abhāvaḥ eva sukha ādau dṛṣṭeḥ atas vipakṣa oka deśa adarśanam asādhanam vyatireka niścaye tasmāt hetu phala bhāva niścayāt eva anvaya vyatirekayoḥ niścayaḥ

original: svabhāva ityādi paraḥ | idānīm iti kāryahetāvavinābhāve sādhite saṃprati svabhāvahetau kathaṃ sādhyenāvinābhāvaḥ |
analyzed: svabhāvaḥ ityādi paraḥ idānīm iti kārya hetau avinābhāve sādhite saṃprati svabhāva hetau katham sādhyena avinābhāvaḥ

original: nanu svabhāve bhāvopi bhāvamātrānurodhini hetur ityādinā prāg eva svabhāvahetāvavinābhāvaḥ sādhitaḥ |
analyzed: nanu svabhāve bhāvaḥ api bhāva mātra anurodhini hetuḥ ityādinā prāk eva svabhāva hetau avinābhāvaḥ sādhitaḥ

original: satyaṃ | evaṃ tu manyate (|) yathābhūte svabhāve tanmātrabhāvinyavinābhāvo varṇṇitas tatra pratijñārthaikad eśatā prāptnotīti | siddhāntavādy apy anantareṇānyāpohaprasādhanena pratijñārthaikad eśatāparihāramm anyamānaḥ tanmātrānurodhint evāvinābhāvaṃ pūrvoktam anuvadati | svabhāvepy avinābhāva ityādi |
analyzed: evam tu manyate yathābhūte svabhāve tanmātra bhāvini avinābhāvaḥ varṇṇitaḥ tatra pratijñā artha ekat eśa tā prāptnoti iti siddhāntavādī api anantareṇa anya apoha prasādhanena pratijñā artha ekat eśa tā parihāram anyamānaḥ eva avinābhāvam pūrva uktam anuvadati svabhāve pi avinābhāvaḥ ityādi

original: svabhāvepi svabhāvahetāv apy avinābhāvaḥ (|) kasmin sādhye (|) bhāvamātrānurodhini | yo hītyādy asyaiva vyākhyānaṃ | avinābhāvo bhāvasyeti kṛtakatvādeḥ | yasmāt tadabhāve bhāvamātrānurodhisādhyadharmābhāve bhāvasya hetutvenopāttasyābhāvaḥ syāt  | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) (p.108) sādhyasādhanayor abhedataḥ | abhedam eva ya evetyādinā vyācaṣṭe |
analyzed: svabhāve api svabhāva hetau api avinābhāvaḥ kasmin sādhye bhāva mātra anurodhini yaḥ hi ityādi asya eva vyākhyānam avinābhāvaḥ bhāvasya iti kṛtaka tva ādeḥ yasmāt tad abhāve bhāva mātra anurodhi sādhya dharma abhāve bhāvasya hetu tvena upāttasya abhāvaḥ syāt kim kāraṇam sādhya sādhanayoḥ abhedataḥ abhedam eva yaḥ eva ityādinā vyācaṣṭe

original: tathā vikalpaviśayo 'tyantaṃ vāme visadṛāopi vāme 'vadhāryate 'nyanivṛttikṛtasārūpya grahaṇād iti (|)
analyzed: tathā vikalpa viśayaḥ tyantam vāme vāme grahaṇāt iti

original: tad apāstaṃ | svahetuta eva bāhyābhāsāyā vikalpabuddher utpatteḥ | na cāsadṛśānām anyanivṛttyā sādṛśyaṃ kriyate (|) tatra bhedābhedasādṛśyakaraṇe 'kiñ cit karatvāt | na cānyanivṛttiḥ sadṛśī vidyate | sadṛśānām api katham anyanivṛttyā sādṛśyaṃ kriyate svarūpeṇaiva sādṛśyāt |
analyzed: tat apāstam sva hetutaḥ eva bāhya ābhāsāyāḥ vikalpa buddheḥ utpatteḥ na ca asadṛśānām anya nivṛttyā sādṛśyam kriyate tatra bheda abheda sādṛśya karaṇe kiñ cit kara tvāt na ca anya nivṛttiḥ sadṛśī vidyate sadṛśānām api katham anya nivṛttyā sādṛśyam kriyate sva rūpeṇa eva sādṛśyāt

original: nāpi pūrvaṃ svākārapratibhāsaḥ paścāt tatrānyanivṛttikṛtasādṛśyagrahaṇaparo bāhyāropaḥ pratibhāsate | na hi marīcikāyāṃ pūrvaṃ svarūpāpratibhāse (p.113) sati sādṛāyagrahaṇahetuko jalāropaḥ sanbhavati (|) bāhyāripāc ca pūrvaṃ na svākāro grāhyāroposti | vikalpasyaivābhāvāt | bhāve bodhaikarūpa evāsāv iti na bāhyāsadṛsaḥ |
analyzed: nā api pūrvam sva ākāra pratibhāsaḥ paścāt tatra anya nivṛtti kṛta sādṛśya grahaṇa paraḥ bāhya āropaḥ pratibhāsate na hi marīcikāyām pūrvam sva rūpa apratibhāse sati sādṛāya grahaṇa hetukaḥ jala āropaḥ san bhavati ca pūrvam na sva ākāraḥ grāhya āropaḥ asti vikalpasya eva abhāvāt bhāve bodha eka rūpaḥ eva asau iti na bāhya asadṛsaḥ

original: tataś cānyanivṛttikṛtasādṛśyābhāvāt katham bāhyarūpaḥ pratīyate | anumānasya tu nānyanivṛttigrāhaṇapūrvikā pravṛttir liṅgasya tayā saha sambandhāt siddheḥ | yadā ca tadviśeṣāv agāhitvam vikalpānāṃ pratīyate tadā vidhirūpeṇaiva pravṛttir vastusvarūpasya vidhīyamānatvenādhyavasāyād arthād anyanivṛttiḥ pratīyate |
analyzed: tatas ca anya nivṛtti kṛta sādṛśya abhāvāt katham bāhya rūpaḥ pratīyate anumānasya tu na anya nivṛtti grāhaṇa pūrvikā pravṛttiḥ liṅgasya tayā saha sambandhāt siddheḥ yadā ca tad viśeṣau agāhi tvam vikalpānām pratīyate tadā vidhi rūpeṇa eva pravṛttiḥ vastu svarūpasya vidhīyamāna tvena adhyavasāyāt arthāt anya nivṛttiḥ pratīyate

original: tena vidhir eva śabdārthosmākam api | bāhyatayā 'ropitasya ca vaidhipratiṣedhābhyāṃ sambandhaḥ |
analyzed: tena vidhiḥ eva śabda arthaḥ asmākam api bāhya tayā ropitasya ca sambandhaḥ

original: nanu niyatarūpagrāhī vikalpaḥ pratibhāsate | tenetararūpaśūnyam eva vikalpayan niyatam arthaṃ vikalpayati | tasmād yan niyatarūpāvadhāraṇantadanyanivṛttiviṣayan tat katham ucyate vidhir eva śabdārthaṃ iti |
analyzed: nanu niyata rūpa grāhī vikalpaḥ pratibhāsate tena itara rūpa śūnyam eva vikalpayan niyatam artham vikalpayati tasmāt yat niyata rūpa avadhāraṇam tad anya nivṛtti viṣayan tat katham ucyate vidhiḥ eva śabda artham iti

original: tad ayuktaṃ | anyanivṛttim ahaṃ vikalpayāmīty apratīteḥ | na ca sa vikalpaviṣayo yo na vikalpya pratibhāsate | yadi cetararūpanivṛttim eva vikalpayan niyatam artham vikalpayati tadetaretarāśrayadoṣaḥ syāt | itararūpasyāpi niyatarūpatvenānyanivṛttidvāreṇa pratipattiprasaṅgāt |
analyzed: tat ayuktam anya nivṛttim aham vikalpayāmi iti apratīteḥ na ca sa vikalpa viṣayaḥ yaḥ na vikalpya pratibhāsate yadi ca itara rūpa nivṛttim eva vikalpayan niyatam artham vikalpayati tadā itaretara āśraya doṣaḥ syāt itara rūpasya api niyata rūpa tvena anya nivṛtti dvāreṇa pratipatti prasaṅgāt

original: atha vidhirūpeṇetararūpaṃ vikalpayati na tarhi tadanyanivṛttyavadhāraṇapūrvakan niyatarūpāvadhāraṇaṃ |
analyzed: atha vidhi rūpeṇa itara rūpam vikalpayati na tarhi tad anya nivṛtti avadhāraṇa pūrvakat niyata rūpa avadhāraṇam

original: na ca yathā sāmānyavantam artham paśyāmīti nāsti jātitadvator viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāve pratibhāsaḥ (|) atha ca viśiṣṭapratyayānurodhāt sāmānyaviśiṣṭavyaktidarśanan naiyāyikādayaḥ kalpitavantas tathā 'nye (?nyair) nivṛttim aham vikalpayāmīty apratītāv api bāhyasadṛśāropānyathānupapattyānyanivṛttiparaṃ vikalpākāre bāhyarūpam āropyata iti yuktaṃ |
analyzed: na ca yathā sāmānyavantam artham paśyāmi iti nā asti jāti tadvatoḥ viśeṣya viśeṣaṇa bhāve pratibhāsaḥ atha ca viśiṣṭa pratyaya anurodhāt sāmānya viśiṣṭa vyakti darśanat naiyāyika ādayaḥ kalpitavantaḥ tathā nye nyaiḥ nivṛttim aham vikalpayāmi iti apratītau api bāhya sadṛśa āropa anyathā anupapattyā anya nivṛtti param vikalpa ākāre bāhya rūpam āropyate iti yuktam

original: sādṛśyam antareṇa vāsanābalād evādhyavasitabāhyarūpasya vikalpasyotpatteḥ | yad āha – tadanubhavāhitavāsanāprabhavaprakrter adhyavasitatadbhāvasvarūpaṃ | tathā vikalpavāsanāyāś ca tādṛśī prakṛtir yad evam eṣā pratibhātīti |
analyzed: sādṛśyam antareṇa vāsanā balāt eva adhyavasita bāhya rūpasya vikalpasya utpatteḥ yat āha tad anubhava āhita vāsanā prabhava prakrteḥ adhyavasita tad bhāva svarūpam tathā vikalpa vāsanāyāḥ ca tādṛśī prakṛtiḥ yat evam eṣā pratibhāti iti

original: nāpi bāhyarūpāropakasya jñānasyānyavittikṛtasārūpyanimittatve 'py anyanivṛttiviṣayatvaṃ | na hi marīcikāyāṃ jalajñānasya sādṛśyaviṣayatvam āropitajalaviṣayatvāt | na ca niyataṃ rūpaṃ bhāvānām anyanivṛttyā kriyate | tasyā avastutvenākārakatvāt | svahetubhya eva ca tato (? tata u)tpatte |
analyzed: nā api bāhya rūpa āropakasya jñānasya anya vitti kṛta sārūpya nimitta tve pi anya nivṛtti viṣaya tvam na hi marīcikāyām jala jñānasya sādṛśya viṣaya tvam āropita jala viṣaya tvāt na ca niyatam rūpam bhāvānām anya nivṛttyā kriyate tasyāḥ avastu tvena akāraka tvāt sva hetubhyaḥ eva ca tatas utpatteḥ

original: nāpi niyatarūpāvadhāraṇan tadanyanivṛttiviṣayaṃ niyatarūpaviṣayatvād asya (|) ata eva na tad anyanivṛttipurassaram eva dhāryate pratyakṣeṇaiva |
analyzed: na api tad anya nivṛtti viṣayam niyata rūpa viṣaya tvāt asya atas eva na tat anya nivṛtti purassaram eva dhāryate pratyakṣeṇa eva

original: na ca tadanyanivṛttir arthāntarabhātā yujyata iti vakṣyati | nāpi sa (|) tattvānyatvābhyam avācyā yujyate (|) evaṃ hy abhāva evāsyāḥ syācchaśaviṣāṇavat | na ca syāta pratyakṣagamyā nīrūpatvāt | nāpy anumānagamyā | sambandhāvena liṅgasyāsiddheḥ | (p.114) nāpi niyatarūpānyathānupapattyā tatkalpanā | aniyatarūpāṇām anyanivṛtter abhāvāt |
analyzed: na ca tad anya nivṛttiḥ artha antara bhātā yujyate iti vakṣyati nā api sa avācyā yujyate evam hi abhāvaḥ eva asyāḥ syāt śaśaviṣāṇa vat na ca syāta pratyakṣa gamyā nīrūpa tvāt nā api anumāna gamyā liṅgasya asiddheḥ nā api niyata rūpa anyathā anupapattyā tad kalpanā aniyata rūpāṇām anya nivṛtteḥ abhāvāt

original: niyatarūpāṇāṃ ca katham anyanivṛttyā niyatarūpatvaṃ svahetubhya eva niyatarūpāṇām utpatteḥ | tasmān niyatarūpāvadhāraṇapurassaraivānyanivṛttiḥ pratīyate | tathā hi ghaṭa ity ukto 'ghaṭo na bhvatīti sāmārthyāt pratīyate 'to vikalpakavikalpataiveṣā na paramārthatosti |
analyzed: niyata rūpāṇām ca katham anya nivṛttyā niyata rūpa tvam sva hetubhyaḥ eva niyata rūpāṇām utpatteḥ tasmāt niyata rūpa avadhāraṇa purassarā eva anya nivṛttiḥ pratīyate tathā hi ghaṭaḥ iti uktaḥ ghaṭaḥ na sāmārthyāt pratīyate vikalpaka vikalpa tā eva eṣā na paramārthataḥ asti

original: tasmāt sthitam etac chadvaliṅgābhyām vidhirūpeṇa vastu pratipādyaterthādanyaniṣedhaḥ | tathā ca vakṣyati tadgatāv eva śabdebhyo gamyate 'nyanivartanam ityādi (1|128) |
analyzed: tasmāt sthitam etat chadva liṅgābhyām vidhi rūpeṇa vastu pratipādyate irthāt anya niṣedhaḥ tathā ca vakṣyati tad gatau eva śabdebhyaḥ gamyate ityādi

original: etat siddhaṃ | vidhirūpasyāpi śabdārthasyeṣṭatvāt (|) kathan tarhi paramatād bauddhamatasya bhedaḥ (|) kathaṃ vā śabdaliṅgayor apoho viṣaya ucyate || (43)
analyzed: etat siddham vidhi rūpasya api śabda arthasya iṣṭa tvāt kathan tarhi para matāt bauddha matasya bhedaḥ katham vā śabda liṅgayoḥ apohaḥ viṣayaḥ ucyate

original: nanv asty eva mahān bhedaḥ paraiḥ pāramārthikārthaviṣayatveneṣṭasya vikalpasya bauddhaiḥ kalpitaviṣayatvenaṣṭatvāt | alpitaś cākāro 'pohāśritatvād apoha ucyate | apohyate 'neneti vā | anyanivṛttimātraṃ tv arthādākṣiptam apohanam apoha ity ucyate (|) svalkṣaṇaṃ tv apohyatesminn ity apoha ucyate |
analyzed: nanu asti eva mahān bhedaḥ paraiḥ pāramārthika artha viṣaya tvena iṣṭasya vikalpasya bauddhaiḥ kalpita viṣaya tvena aṣṭa tvāt alpitaḥ ca ākāraḥ upoha āśrita tvāt apohaḥ ucyate apohyate nena iti vā anya nivṛtti mātram tu arthāt ākṣiptam apohanam apohaḥ iti ucyate tu apohyate ismin iti apohaḥ ucyate

original: tasmād anyānyavyāvarttyavastuvyapekṣayā dhrmaḥ kalpitabhedā vikalpair viṣayīkriyante (|) ato bhinnaviṣayā vikalpās tatsamānaviṣayāś ca śabdā apy aparyāyā iti darśayitum āha – tasmād ityādi | yataś caivaṃ dharmabhedāḥ kalpyante tasmād yaḥ svalakṣaṇaviśeṣo vyāvarttanīyanityavyapekṣayā vyavasthāpito 'nityalakṣaṇaḥ | yena dharmeṇa yena śabdena |

original: nanu viśeṣaṇatvepi tasya na viśeṣyeṇa sahaikyaṃ gaṇḍasyeva daṇḍinā tat katham abhedapratibhāsaḥ | abhedāṃśenāpy ekatvān na viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ | tasmāt sāmānyasya vyaktyabhedapratītir bhrāntir eva |

original: jalādibhrāntivat | bhrāntiś ceyam asaṃsṛṣṭān api bhāvān saṃsṛjantī buddhir atosyā nimittena bhavitavyaṃ (|) yat tannimittan tat sāmānyam ity atrāha – ta eva bhedās tatsāmānyajñānādy ekaṅkāryaṃ yeṣān te tadekāryā bījaṃ bhrānteḥ | etac ca pratipādayiṣyate |
