original: atha syāt (|) na sāmānyasya sādṛśyanimitto bhedeṣv āropopi tv ekāntena bhinneṣu sa evāyam ity ekatvāvasāyavibhramo brūmaḥ | yady evam ekena sambandhina ity eva vināpi bhrāntinimittena yady ekākārabhrāntiviṣayā bhavanti |
analyzed: atha syāt na sāmānyasya sādṛśya nimittaḥ bhedeṣu āropaḥ api tu ekāntena bhinneṣu saḥ eva ayam iti ekatva avasāya vibhramaḥ brūmaḥ yadi evam ekena sambandhinaḥ iti eva vinā api bhrānti nimittena yadi eka ākāra bhrānti viṣayāḥ bhavanti

original: tadā saṃkhyā ca saṃyogaś ca cādiśabdād vibhāgādi caikam vastu vidyate yeṣān te tadvantas teṣu caikaguṇena yukteṣu syād ekākārā bhrāntiḥ (|) na ca bhavati (|) ato vyaktīnām api naikatvanimittā bhrāntir iti | tad iti tasmād yathā vyaktibhyo bhedeneṣṭaqṃ sāmānyaṃ tathā sāmānyabuddhau niveśābhāvāt pratibhāsābhāvān na samānyam anyat |
analyzed: tadā saṃkhyā ca saṃyogaḥ ca ca ādi śabdāt vibhāga ādi ca ekam vastu vidyate yeṣān te tadvantaḥ teṣu ca ekaguṇena yukteṣu syāt eka ākārā bhrāntiḥ na ca bhavati atas vyaktīnām api na ekatva nimittā bhrāntiḥ iti tat iti tasmāt yathā vyaktibhyaḥ bhedena iṣṭa śm sāmānyam tathā sāmānya buddhau niveśa abhāvāt pratibhāsa abhāvāt na samānyam anyat

original: sati vā sāmānye tasyāpi sāmānyasya svātmani svasmin svabhāve 'vasthānād amiśraṇam anyena vyaktirūpeṇa | vyaktiṣv anavasthānān na dharmarūpatvan tasyety arthaḥ | tasmād iti svasvabhāvavyavasthānād ime bhāvā ghaṭāśyaḥ sajātīyābhimatāt tulyākāratvenābhimatād anyasmāc ceti vijātīyādivyatiriktāḥ pṛthagabhūtaḥ svabhāvena prakṛtyaikarūpatvāt |
analyzed: sati vā sāmānye tasya api sāmānyasya sva ātmani svasmin svabhāve avasthānāt amiśraṇam anyena vyakti rūpeṇa vyaktiṣu anavasthānāt na tasya iti arthaḥ tasmāt iti sva svabhāva vyavasthānāt ime bhāvāḥ ghaṭa āśyaḥ sajātīya abhimatāt tulya ākāra tvena abhimatāt anyasmāt ca iti vijātīya ādi vyatiriktāḥ pṛthak abhūtaḥ svabhāvena prakṛtyā eka rūpa tvāt

original: svasvabhāvavyavasthiter iti yāvat ||
analyzed: sva svabhāva vyavasthiteḥ iti yāvat

original: dvitīyakārikārtham āha – yato yato bhinnāste bhāvās tasmād bhedas tadbhedaḥ | tasmād bhinnāḥ svabhāvās tasya pratyāyanāya pratibhinnasvabhāvaṃ kṛtasanniveśaiḥ śabdaiḥ (p.119) kṛtasaṃketaiḥ śabdaiḥ karaṇabhūtair anekadharmānaḥ kṛtakatvādidharmmaṃ vantaḥ pratīyante svabhāvā bhedepi | na hy ekasya svalakṣaṇasya svabhāvanānātvam asti |
analyzed: dvitīya kārikā artham āha yatas yatas bhinnāḥ te bhāvāḥ tasmāt bhedaḥ tad bhedaḥ tasmāt bhinnāḥ svabhāvāḥ tasya pratyāyanāya pratibhinna svabhāvam kṛta sanniveśaiḥ śabdaiḥ kṛta saṃketaiḥ śabdaiḥ karaṇa bhūtaiḥ aneka dharmānaḥ kṛtaka tva ādi dharmam vantaḥ pratīyante svabhāvāḥ bhede pi na hi ekasya sva lakṣaṇasya svabhāva nānātvam asti

original: kathan tarhy anekadharmatvam ity āha – tatas tato bhedam upādāyeti (|) yato yato vyāvṛttās tatas tato bhedam upādāyāśritya tepi śabdā ye tasya tasya bhedasya bhinnaskbhāvasya khyāpanāya kṛtasaṃketās teṣv asmin bhinne svabhāve vācakatvena niyatāḥ (|) tato naikaḥ śabdaḥ sarvān bhinnasvabhāvānākṣipatyatas tepi śabdāḥ pratyekantaiḥ sarvabhedānākṣepepi
analyzed: kathan tarhi aneka dharma tvam iti āha tatas tatas bhedam upādāya iti yatas yatas vyāvṛttāḥ tatas tatas bhedam upādāya āśritya te api śabdāḥ ye tasya tasya bhedasya khyāpanāya kṛta saṃketāḥ teṣu asmin bhinne svabhāve vācaka tvena niyatāḥ tatas na ekaḥ śabdaḥ sarvān bhinna svabhāvān ākṣipati atas te api śabdāḥ sarva bhedān ākṣepe pi

original: | ekabhedacodanād ekaikasya bhinnasya svabhāvasya codanāt tatsvalakṣaṇaniṣṭhā eva bhavanti | yasya svalakṣaṇasya sa svabhāvonyasmād bhinno yaḥ śabdenādhyavasīyate | tac ca tatsvalakṣaṇaṃ ca | tanniṣṭhā eva tadviṣayā eva bhavanti |
analyzed: eka bheda codanāt ekaikasya bhinnasya svabhāvasya codanāt tad sva lakṣaṇa niṣṭhāḥ eva bhavanti yasya sva lakṣaṇasya sa svabhāvaḥ anyasmāt bhinnaḥ yaḥ śabdena adhyavasīyate tat ca tat sva lakṣaṇam ca tad niṣṭhāḥ eva tad viṣayāḥ eva bhavanti

original: nanu bāhyatayādhyavasitorthaḥ śabdapratibhāsī sādhāraṇonya evānyac ca sādhāraṇaṃ svalakṣaṇan tat kathan tanniṣṭhā ity atrāha – tadekasmād api yato yato vyāvṛttorthaḥ śabdair viṣayītriyate tasmāt tasmād atatkāraṇād atatkāryāc caikasmād api tasya svalakṣaṇasyānakavyāvṛttasya bhedostīti kṛtvā tadviṣayā ucyate na tu tadviṣayā eva |
analyzed: nanu bāhya tayā adhyavasita ūrthaḥ śabda pratibhāsī sādhāraṇaḥ anyaḥ eva anyat ca sādhāraṇam sva lakṣaṇan tat kathan tad niṣṭhāḥ iti atra āha tad ekasmāt api yatas yatas vyāvṛtta ūrthaḥ śabdaiḥ tasmāt tasmāt atatkāraṇāt atatkāryāt ca ekasmāt api tasya sva lakṣaṇasya anaka vyāvṛttasya bhedaḥ usti iti kṛtvā tad viṣayāḥ ucyate na tu tad viṣayāḥ eva

original: yad vā tasya vyāvṛttyāśrayasya dharmasya yat svalakṣaṇantanniṣṭhā eva tatprāptiparyavasānā eva bhavanti | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tadekasmād api tasya bhedostīti vyākhyātam eva |
analyzed: yat vā tasya vyāvṛtti āśrayasya dharmasya yat sva lakṣaṇam tad niṣṭhāḥ eva tad prāpti paryavasānāḥ eva bhavanti kim kāraṇam tat ekasmāt api tasya bhedaḥ usti iti vyākhyātam eva

original: upasaṃharann āha – tasmād iti yasmāt sajātīyavijātīyād vyāvṛttis tasmād ekasya bhāvasya yāvanti pararūpāṇi tāvat yas tadapekṣayā | pararūpapekṣayā | pararūpebhyo vyāvṛttayaḥ kalpitā dharmabhedāḥ |
analyzed: upasaṃharan āha tasmāt iti yasmāt sajātīya vijātīyāt vyāvṛttiḥ tasmāt ekasya bhāvasya yāvanti para rūpāṇi tāvat yaḥ tad apekṣayā para rūpa pekṣayā para rūpebhyaḥ vyāvṛttayaḥ kalpitāḥ dharma bhedāḥ

original: vyāvarttate vijātīyamebhir iti kṛtvā (|) kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tasmin vyāvarttye 'vidhibhūte dharmiṇyasambhavi kāryaṃ ca yasya vivakṣitasya dharmiṇaḥ sa tadasambhavikāryakāraṇas tasya tadbhedāt | tasmād atatkāryād atatkāraṇāc ca bhedād vyāvṛttatvāt | yāvat yaś ca vyāvṛttayas tāvatyaḥ śrutayo niveśitā (p.120) atatkāryakāraṇaparihāreṇa vyavahārārthāḥ |
analyzed: vyāvarttate vijātīyam ebhiḥ iti kṛtvā kim kāraṇam tasmin vyāvarttye vidhi bhūte dharmiṇi asambhavi kāryam ca yasya vivakṣitasya dharmiṇaḥ sa tad asambhavi kārya kāraṇaḥ tasya tad bhedāt tasmāt a tad kāryāt a tad kāraṇāt ca bhedāt vyāvṛtta tvāt yāvat yaḥ ca vyāvṛttayaḥ tāvatyaḥ śrutayaḥ niveśitā a tad kārya kāraṇa parihāreṇa vyavahāra arthāḥ

original: tadvivakṣitaṃ kāryaṃ kāraṇaṃ ca yasya sa tatkāryakāraṇaḥ | yathā śrotravijñānakāryaḥ śabdaḥ prayatnakāraṇaś ca sa tathā yo na bhavati so 'tatkāryakāraṇas tasya parihāreṇa vyavahārārthāḥ pravṛttinivṛttilakṣaṇo vyavahārorthaḥ phaṭaṃ yāsām iti vigrahaḥ |
analyzed: tat vivakṣitam kāryam kāraṇam ca yasya sa tad kārya kāraṇaḥ yathā śrotra vijñāna kāryaḥ śabdaḥ prayatna kāraṇaḥ ca sa tathā yaḥ na bhavati tad kārya kāraṇaḥ tasya parihāreṇa vyavahāra arthāḥ pravṛtti nivṛtti lakṣaṇaḥ vyavahāra ūrthaḥ phaṭam yāsām iti vigrahaḥ

original: viṣayam āha – prayatnaḥ kāraṇaṃ yasya sa prayatnānantarīyaka ucyate | tenā 'tatkāraṇasyā 'prayatnakāraṇasya vidyudādeḥ parihārārthaḥ prayatnānantarīyakadhvaniḥ | śrotrajñānaṃ kāryaṃ yasya tachrāvaṇantena śrāvaṇadhvanir atatkāryaparihārārthaḥ | sarvavyavahārāṇāṃ cārthakriyānimittatvāt |
analyzed: viṣayam āha prayatnaḥ kāraṇam yasya sa prayatna ānantarīyakaḥ ucyate tena tad kāraṇasya ā prayatna kāraṇasya vidyut ādeḥ parihāra arthaḥ prayatna ānantarīyaka dhvaniḥ śrotra jñānam kāryam yasya śrāvaṇa antena śrāvaṇa dhvaniḥ a tad kārya parihāra arthaḥ sarva vyavahārāṇām ca artha kriyā nimitta tvāt

original: hetuphalabhāvalakṣaṇatvāc cārthakriyāyā ghaṭādiśabdeṣv api tad atatkāryakāraṇaparihārthatvaṃ yojyaṃ ||
analyzed: hetu phala bhāva lakṣaṇa tvāt ca arthakriyāyāḥ ghaṭa ādi śabdeṣu api tat yojyam

original: tasmād ityādinā tṛtīyaślokaṃ vyācaṣṭe | yasmād bhinnā vyāvṛttibhedāḥ śrutayaś ca yathāsvambhede niyatās tasmād ekasya dharmiṇaḥ svabhāvā 'bhedepi | dharmiṇety asya vivaraṇaṃ nāmneti śabdenety arthaḥ | yo viśeṣa ity asyāethe bhedaḥ kṛtakādilakṣaṇo dharmaḥ kalpitaḥ pratīyate | na sa śakyas tatonyena |
analyzed: tasmāt ityādinā tṛtīya ślokam vyācaṣṭe yasmāt bhinnāḥ vyāvṛtti bhedāḥ śrutayaḥ ca yathāsvam bhede niyatāḥ tasmāt ekasya dharmiṇaḥ svabhāvāḥ bhede api dharmiṇā iti asya vivaraṇam nāmnā iti śabdena iti arthaḥ yaḥ viśeṣaḥ iti bhedaḥ kṛtaka ādi lakṣaṇaḥ dharmaḥ kalpitaḥ pratīyate na sa śakyaḥ tatonyena

original: tasmād vivakṣitāt kṛtakādiśabdād anyenān ityādiśabdena pratyāyayitun tasmān na pratijñārthaikadeśo hetur anityakṛtakaśabdayor bhinnārthatvāt || (44)
analyzed: tasmāt vivakṣitāt kṛtaka ādi śabdāt anyenān ityādi śabdena tasmāt na pratijñā artha eka deśaḥ hetuḥ anitya kṛtaka śabdayoḥ bhinna artha tvāt

original: katham ityādi paraḥ | śabdaś ca liṅgaś ca tābhyāṃ | yady apīha liṅgaṃ prakṛtantathāpi śabdasyoppādānaṃ liṅgavat nirviṣayatvakhyāpanārthan tena vedasya prāmānyaṃ nirākṛtam bhavati |
analyzed: katham ityādi paraḥ śabdaḥ ca liṅgaḥ ca tābhyām yadi api iha liṅgam prakṛtam tathā api śabdasya uppādānam liṅga vat tena vedasya prāmānyam nirākṛtam bhavati

original: nanu vidhirūpeṇa śabdaliṅge arthaḥ pratipādyata ity uktan tat katham idam āśaṃkitaṃ vyavacchedaḥ pratipādyata iti kathaṃ gamyata iti |
analyzed: nanu vidhi rūpeṇa śabda liṅge arthaḥ pratipādyate iti uktan tat katham idam āśaṃkitam vyavacchedaḥ pratipādyate iti katham gamyate iti

original: naitad asti | vyavacchidyateneneti vyavacchedo bāhyarūpatayāropita evākāra ucyate | tena sa eva śabdaliṅgābhyāṃ vidhinā pratipādyate na vasturūpam iti kuto gamyate | yad vā vyavacchidyatesminn iti vyavacchedaḥ | svalakṣaṇam ucyate |
analyzed: na etat asti vyavacchidyate inena iti vyavacchedaḥ bāhya rūpatayā āropitaḥ eva ākāraḥ ucyate tena saḥ eva śabda liṅgābhyām vidhinā pratipādyate na vastu rūpam iti kutas gamyate yat vā vyavacchidyate ismin iti vyavacchedaḥ sva lakṣaṇam ucyate

original: sa eva (p.121) śabdaliṅgābhyāṃ vidhinā vidhirūpeṇa pratipādyate 'dhyavasīyate na punar vastuno rūpaṃ pāramārthikadharmibhāvalakṣaṇaṃ pratipādyata iti kuto gamyate |
analyzed: saḥ eva śabda liṅgābhyām vidhinā vidhi rūpeṇa pratipādyate dhī avasīyate na punar vastunaḥ rūpam pāramārthika dharmi bhāva lakṣaṇam pratipādyate iti kutas gamyate

original: pramāṇāntarasyetyādi prativacanaṃ | tenāyam artho yadi tāvat pāramārthiko dharmadharmibhāvaḥ sarvātmanā 'bhinnas tadaikena vādhigaterthe sarvātmanā paricchedādanyasya pramāṇāntarasya śabdāntarasya vā pravṛttiḥ syād gṛhītagrāhitvenāprāmāṇyāt | bhavati ca śabdāntarādeḥ pravṛttir ataḥ kalpita eva dharmadharmibhāvaḥ |
analyzed: pramāṇa antarasya ityādi prativacanam tena ayam arthaḥ yadi tāvat pāramārthikaḥ dharma dharmi bhāvaḥ sarva ātmanā bhinnaḥ tadā ekena vā adhigata irthe sarva ātmanā paricchedāt anyasya pramāṇa antarasya śabda antarasya vā pravṛttiḥ syāt gṛhīta grāhi tvena aprāmāṇyāt bhavati ca śabda antara ādeḥ pravṛttiḥ atas kalpitaḥ eva dharma dharmi bhāvaḥ

original: yady api pūṛvasāmānyanirākaraṇād eva kalpito dharmadharmibhāvaḥ prasādhitas tathāpi prakārāntareṇānenāpi prasādhyata ity adoṣaḥ | etam eva pratipādayann āha – tathā hītyādi |
analyzed: yadi api eva kalpitaḥ dharma dharmi bhāvaḥ prasādhitaḥ tathā api prakāra antareṇa anena api prasādhyate iti adoṣaḥ etam eva pratipādayan āha tathā hi ityādi

original: ekasyeti dharmadharmivibhāgarahitatatvān niraṃśasyārthasvabhāvasyārthātmanaḥ svayaṃ svarūpeṇa pratyakṣasya sataḥ konyo na dṛṣṭo bhāgaḥ syāt pratyakṣadṛsṭāt svabhāvāt konyaḥ svabhāvo na dṛṣṭaḥ syād yaḥ pramāṇair anumānasaṃjñakaiḥ (|) parīkΩyate (|) vyaktibhedād bahuvacanaṃ |
analyzed: ekasya iti dharma dharmi vibhāga rahita tatvāt niraṃśasya artha svabhāvasya artha ātmanaḥ svayam sva rūpeṇa pratyakṣasya sataḥ kaḥ anyaḥ na dṛṣṭaḥ bhāgaḥ syāt pratyakṣa dṛsṭāt svabhāvāt kaḥ anyaḥ svabhāvaḥ na dṛṣṭaḥ syāt yaḥ pramāṇaiḥ anumāna saṃjñakaiḥ parīkṣyate vyakti bhedāt bahuvacanam

original: sarva eva dṛṣṭo niraṃśatvād bhāvasya tasmān na pramāṇāntaraparīkṣyaḥ syād iti | eka ityādi vivaraṇaṃ | eko hy arthātmā niraṃśaḥ sa tāvat pratyakṣobhyupagantavyaḥ yatrānumānaṃ pravartate | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) pramāṇena prāg asiddhe dharmiṇi sādhanāsambhavāt | āśrayāsiddhatvena liṅgasyāsambhavāt tasmāt prasiddhena dharmiṇā bhāvyaṃ ||
analyzed: sarvaḥ eva dṛṣṭaḥ niraṃśa tvāt bhāvasya tasmāt na pramāṇa antara parīkṣyaḥ syāt iti ekaḥ ityādi vivaraṇam ekaḥ hi artha ātmā niraṃśaḥ sa tāvat pratyakṣaḥ abhyupagantavyaḥ yatra anumānam pravartate kim kāraṇam pramāṇena prāk asiddhe dharmiṇi sādhana asambhavāt āśraya asiddha tvena liṅgasya asambhavāt tasmāt prasiddhena dharmiṇā bhāvyam

original: etad uktam bhavati | liṅgasyaiva pravṛttir na syāt kiṃ punar liṅginiścatā pramāṇāntarasya pravṛttir bhāviṣyati | yathā 'nitye sādhye śabdaḥ pratyakṣasiddhas tasya pratyakṣeṇaiva pramāṇena svarūpasiddheḥ kāraṇāt sarvākārasiddhiḥ | kasmāt tadanyasyāsiddhasya śabdasvabhāvād anyasya svabhāvasyāsiddhasyābhāvāt |
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati liṅgasya eva pravṛttiḥ na syāt kim punar pramāṇa antarasya pravṛttiḥ bhāviṣyati yathā nitye sādhye śabdaḥ pratyakṣa siddhaḥ tasya pratyakṣeṇa eva pramāṇena svarūpa siddheḥ kāraṇāt sarva ākāra siddhiḥ kasmāt tad anyasya asiddhasya śabda svabhāvāt anyasya svabhāvasya asiddhasya abhāvāt

original: bhāve vā 'siddhasya svabhāvasya atatsvabhāvatvam aśabdasvabhāvatvaṃ | siddhāsiddhayor ekasvabhāvatvavirodhāt |
analyzed: bhāve vā siddhasya svabhāvasya a tad svabhāva tvam a śabda svabhāva tvam siddha asiddhayoḥ eka svabhāva tva virodhāt

original: tad evāha – na hītyādi | alabdhadharmānuvṛttir yogaḥ | labdhadharmānuvṛttiḥ kṣemaḥ | eko yogaḥ kṣenaś ca yasya sa tathā | tulyadharmeti yāvat | yaḥ svabhāvo yena sadaikakayogakṣemī na bhavati sa bhinnatogakṣemaḥ | tatsvabhāvo yato bhinnayogakṣemas tasya (p.122) svabhāvo na yuktaḥ | tanmātranibandhanatvād bhedavyavahārasya nānātvaṃ vyavasthāyāḥ |
analyzed: tat eva āha na hi ityādi alabdha dharma anuvṛttiḥ yogaḥ labdha dharma anuvṛttiḥ kṣemaḥ ekaḥ yogaḥ ca yasya sa tathā tulya dharma iti yāvat yaḥ svabhāvaḥ yena sadā ekaka yogakṣemī na bhavati sa bhinna togakṣemaḥ tad svabhāvaḥ yatas bhinna yogakṣemaḥ tasya svabhāvaḥ na yuktaḥ tad mātra nibandhana tvāt bheda vyavahārasya nānātvam vyavasthāyāḥ

original: yad vā dharmo niścīyamānaḥ dharmyāśritatvād evāśrayasya pratītim ākṣipati sa cāśritānāṃ dharmāṇām iti sarvaniścayaḥ | tasmāc chabdapramāṇāntaravṛtteḥ kalpita eva dharmadharmibhāvaḥ (|) na cāsmin pakṣe dharmabhedābhedakalpanāyāṃ pramāṇāntaravaiyarthyam avastutvena teṣāṃ bhedābhedasya paramārthato 'bhāvāt |

original: tataś caikopādhidvāreṇāpi (p.134) grahe sarvātmanā grahaṇan tasmin sati ka evopādhibhedas tasyāniścitaḥ kintu sarva eva niścitaḥ syāt | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) sarvopādhyupakārakatvena grahaṇāt |
analyzed: tatas ca eka upādhi dvāreṇa api grahe sarva ātmanā tasmin sati kaḥ eva upādhi bhedaḥ tasya aniścitaḥ kintu sarvaḥ eva niścitaḥ syāt kim kāraṇam sarva upādhi upakāraka tvena grahaṇāt

original: ekopādhidvāreṇopādhimataḥ svarūpam eva grahītaṃ na tūpādhyupakārakatvam iti ced āha – na hītyādi | na hy upādhyupakārakatvam anyad evāgṛhītam ity anena sambandhaḥ | tasyety upādhimataḥ svena rūpeṇa gṛhyamāṇasya svarūpād upakārakatvasyābhedāt | yata evam ataḥ kāraṇād asyety upādhimataḥ |
analyzed: eka upādhi dvāreṇa upādhimataḥ svarūpam eva grahītam na tu upādhi upakāraka tvam iti ced āha na hi ityādi na hi upādhi upakāraka tvam anyat eva agṛhītam iti anena sambandhaḥ tasya iti upādhimataḥ svena rūpeṇa gṛhyamāṇasya svarūpāt upakāraka tvasya abhedāt yatas evam atas kāraṇāt asya iti upādhimataḥ

original: yad eva svabhāvena svarūpeṇa grahaṇan tad evopakārakatvenāpi grahaṇam iti |
analyzed: yat eva svabhāvena svarūpeṇa tat eva upakāraka tvena api grahaṇam iti

original: bhavatv ekopādhidvāreṇopādhimataḥ sarvopādhyupakārakatvasya svabhāvabhūtasya grahaḥ | upādhīnān tu tasmād vyatiriktānāṃ kathaṃ grahaṇam ity ata āha – tayor ityādi | upādhikalāpasyopādhimataś ca upakāryopakārakabhūtayor ātmani svabhāvenyonyasambandho sambandhād upakāryopakārakasambandhasyātmabhūtatvād iti yāvat |
analyzed: bhavatu eka upādhi dvāreṇa upādhimataḥ sarva upādhi upakāraka tvasya svabhāva bhūtasya grahaḥ upādhīnām tu tasmāt vyatiriktānām katham grahaṇam iti atas āha tayoḥ ityādi upādhi kalāpasya upādhimataḥ ca upakārya upakāraka bhūtayoḥ ātmani sambandhāt upakārya upakāraka sambandhasya ātma bhūta tvāt iti yāvat

original: tataś copakārakasvabhāvasyaikasya jñāne sati sambandhād dvayagrahaḥ | upādhyupādhimator grahaḥ |
analyzed: tatas ca upakāraka svabhāvasya ekasya jñāne sati sambandhāt dvaya grahaḥ upādhi upādhimatoḥ grahaḥ

original: stadvyācaśṭe | ātmabhūtasyetyādi | tathā hy upādhimati gṛhīte tasyātmabhūta upakārakabhāvas tāvad gṛhītas tasmin gṛhīte upādhīnām apy ukāryabhāva ātmabhūto gṛhītas tadgrahaṇanāntarīyakatvād upakārakabhāvagrahaṇasya (|) ataḥ kāraṇād ekajñāne dvayor apy upādhyupādhimator grahaṇam iti kṛtvā ekopādhiviśiṣṭe 'pi tasminn upādhimati gṛhyamāṇe
analyzed: ātma bhūtasya ityādi tathā hi upādhimati gṛhīte tasya ātma bhūtaḥ upakāraka bhāvaḥ tāvat gṛhītaḥ tasmin gṛhīte upādhīnām api ukāri abhāvaḥ ātma bhūtaḥ gṛhītaḥ tad grahaṇa nāntarīyaka tvāt upakāraka bhāva grahaṇasya atas kāraṇāt eka jñāne dvayoḥ api upādhi upādhimatoḥ grahaṇam iti kṛtvā eka upādhi viśiṣṭe tasmin upādhimati gṛhyamāṇe

original: sarvopādhīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ | tadgrahaṇanāntarīyakatvād ity upādhigrahaṇanāntarīyakatvāt | anyathety upādhīnām agrahe tathāpi na gṛhyeta | upādhīnām upakāraka upādhimān ity evam api na gṛhyeta |
analyzed: sarva upādhīnām grahaṇam tad grahaṇa nāntarīyaka tvāt iti upādhi grahaṇa nāntarīyaka tvāt anyathā iti upādhīnām agrahe tathā api na gṛhyeta upādhīnām upakārakaḥ upādhimān iti evam api na gṛhyeta

original: ya eva tadānīṃ jñānaśabdapravṛttinimittam upādhis taṃ pratyevopakārakatvam upādhimato gṛhītaṃ na tūpādhyantaropakārakatvam iti ced āha – na hy anya evetyādi | anyopakāraka ity anyasyopādher upakārakaḥ svabhāvo yo na gṛhītaḥ kintu sarva eva gṛhīto niraṃśatvād avastunaḥ |
analyzed: yaḥ eva tadānīm jñāna śabda pravṛtti nimittam upādhiḥ tam prati eva upakāraka tvam upādhimataḥ gṛhītam na tu upādhi antara upakāraka tvam iti ced āha na hi anyaḥ eva ityādi anya upakārakaḥ iti anyasya upādheḥ upakārakaḥ svabhāvaḥ yaḥ na gṛhītaḥ kintu sarvaḥ eva gṛhītaḥ niraṃśa tvāt avastunaḥ

original: (p.135) syān matam (|) upādhimatonapekṣitasambandhina upakāraka ity eva grahaṇaṃ na tv asyopakāraka iti tato nopādhīnāṃ grahaṇam ity ata āha – na cāpītyādi | tathā gṛhīta ity upakāraka ity evaṃ gṛhīte upakārakāryasyopādher agrahaṇaṃ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tasyāpy ukārakasya upakāraka ity evam agrahaṇa prasaṅgāt |
analyzed: syāt matam upādhi mataḥ unapekṣita sambandhinaḥ upakārakaḥ iti eva grahaṇam na tu asya upakārakaḥ iti tatas na upādhīnām grahaṇam iti atas āha na ca api ityādi tathā gṛhītaḥ iti upakārakaḥ iti evam gṛhīte upakāra kāryasya upādheḥ agrahaṇam kim kāraṇam tasya api ukārakasya upakārakaḥ iti evam agrahaṇa prasaṅgāt

original: etat kathayati (|) sambandhitvād upakārakasyāntareṇa dvitīyasambandhigrahaṇam upakāraka ity api grahaṇaṃ nāstīti |tathābhūtañ ca dṛṣṭāntam āha – svasvāmitvavad iti | na hi svagrahaṇam antareṇāsti svāmitvasya grahaṇaṃ | yata evam ekopādhidvāreṇa pravṛttepy ekasmin jñāne śabde ca sarvopādhīnāṃ grahaṇam upādhimataś ca sarvātmanā |
analyzed: etat kathayati sambandhi tvāt upakārakasya antareṇa dvitīya sambandhi grahaṇam upakārakaḥ iti api grahaṇam na asti iti tathābhūtam ca dṛṣṭāntam āha sva svāmi tva vat iti na hi sva grahaṇam antareṇa asti svāmi tvasya grahaṇam yatas evam eka upādhi dvāreṇa pravṛtte api ekasmin jñāne śabde ca sarva upādhīnām grahaṇam upādhimataḥ ca sarva ātmanā

original: tasmād arthāntaropādhivādepi arthāntarabhūtā upādhaya ity evaṃvādepi samānaḥ prasaṅgaḥ | śabdajñānāntarānāṃ paryāyatā prāpnotīti |(| 55 ||)
analyzed: tasmāt artha antara upādhi vāde api artha antara bhūtāḥ upādhayaḥ iti evam vāde api samānaḥ prasaṅgaḥ śabda jñāna antarānām paryāya tā prāpnoti iti

original: athāpītyādinā paramāśaṅkate | yābhiḥ śaktibhiḥ śaktimān upādhīn upakaroti tāḥ śaktayaḥ śaktimataḥ sakāśād bhinnāḥ | tata iti bhedāt | nāyaṃ prasaṅga iti | ekopādhyupakārakaśaktyabhedagrahe sarvaśaktīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ | tadgrahaṇāc ca sarvopādhīnām ity ayaṃ prasaṅgo nāsti |
analyzed: atha api ityādinā param āśaṅkate yābhiḥ śaktibhiḥ śaktimān upādhīn upakaroti tāḥ śaktayaḥ śaktimataḥ sakāśāt bhinnāḥ tatas iti bhedāt na ayam prasaṅgaḥ iti eka upādhi upakāraka śakti abheda grahe sarva śaktīnām grahaṇam tad grahaṇāt ca sarva upādhīnām iti ayam prasaṅgaḥ nā asti

original: uttaram āha – dharmopakāretyādi | dharmā upādḥayas teṣām upakārasya yāḥ śaktayas tāsāṃ śaktimataḥ sakāśād bhede 'bhyupagamyamāne tāḥ śaktayas tasya śaktimataḥ kim bhavanti | na kiṃcid bhavanti na tatsambandhinya ity arthaḥ | yadā yadi nopakāras tataḥ | śaktimatas tāsāṃ śaktīnāṃ | atha sambandhasiddhyartham upakāra iṣyate |
analyzed: uttaram āha dharma upakāra ityādi dharmāḥ upādḍayaḥ teṣām upakārasya yāḥ śaktayaḥ tāsām śaktimataḥ sakāśāt bhede bhyupagamyamāne tāḥ śaktayaḥ tasya śaktimataḥ kim bhavanti na kiṃcid bhavanti na tad sambandhinyaḥ iti arthaḥ yadā yadi na upakāraḥ tatas śaktimataḥ tāsām śaktīnām atha sambandha siddhi artham upakāraḥ iṣyate

original: tadā śaktyupakāriṇyo parā vyatiriktāḥ śaktayo 'ṅgīkarttavyāḥ | yābhiḥ śaktīr upakaroti (|) tāsāṃ ca sambandhatvasiddhyartham upakāraḥ kalpanīyaḥ | tatrāparā śaktikalpaneti tathā syād anavasthitiḥ |
analyzed: tadā parāḥ vyatiriktāḥ śaktayaḥ ṅgīkarttavyāḥ yābhiḥ śaktīḥ upakaroti tāsām ca sambandha tva siddhi artham upakāraḥ kalpanīyaḥ tatra aparā śakti kalpanā iti tathā syāt anavasthitiḥ

original: (p.136)  tad vyācaṣṭe – yadītyādi | upādhim upādhim prati pratyupādhi | upakārakatvāni śaktayas tasyopādhimataḥ na svātmabhūtāni | na svabhāvabhūtāni | kintu vyatiriktāni | nāpi tata upādhimataḥ upakāram anubhavanti | ātmasātkurvanti | kin tasya tā ucyante | upādhimataḥ śaktaya iti kasmād ucyante | sambandhābhāvāt |
analyzed: tat vyācaṣṭe yadi ityādi upādhim upādhim prati pratyupādhi upakāraka tvāni śaktayaḥ tasya upādhimataḥ na svātma bhūtāni na svabhāva bhūtāni kintu vyatiriktāni na api tatas upādhimataḥ upakāram anubhavanti ātmasāt kurvanti kim tasya tāḥ ucyante upādhimataḥ śaktayaḥ iti kasmāt ucyante sambandha abhāvāt

original: sambandhasiddhyartham upādhimataḥ sakāśāt tāsām upādhyupakāriṇīnāṃ śaktīnām upakārevāṅgīkriyamāṇe yābhiḥ śaktibhir upādhyupakāriṇīḥ śaktīr upakaroty ayam upādhimān | yadi tās tasyātmabhūtā iṣyante tadā svātmabhūtābhiḥ śaktibhir ayam upādhimān eka ity anaṃśaḥ | upādhyupakāriṇīḥ śaktīr upakurvan |
analyzed: sambandha siddhi artham upādhimataḥ sakāśāt tāsām upādhi upakāriṇīnām śaktīnām upakārā iva aṅgīkriyamāṇe yābhiḥ śaktibhiḥ upādhi upakāriṇīḥ śaktīḥ upakaroti ayam upādhimān yadi tāḥ tasya ātma bhūtāḥ iṣyante tadā sva ātma bhūtābhiḥ śaktibhiḥ ayam upādhimān ekaḥ iti an aṃśaḥ upādhi upakāriṇīḥ śaktīḥ upakurvan

original: tathā hītyādinā sarvātmanā grahaṇaṃ sādhayati | ekopādhigrahaṇe tadupakāriṇyo upādhyupakāriṇyo vyatiriktāyāḥ śakter grahaṇaṃ | tadgrahaṇa iti | upādhyupakāriśaktigrahe | tadupakārī upādhyupakāriśaktyupakārī |
analyzed: tathā hi ityādinā sarva ātmanā grahaṇam sādhayati eka upādhi grahaṇe tad upakāriṇyaḥ upādhi upakāriṇyaḥ vyatiriktāyāḥ śakteḥ grahaṇam tad grahaṇe iti upādhi upakāri śakti grahe tad upakārī upādhi upakāri śakti upakārī

original: kiṃbhūtaḥ svātmabhūtasakalaśaktyapakāraḥ svātmabhūtāḥ sakalā upādhyupakāriṇīnāṃ śaktīnām upakārāḥ śaktayo yasya sa tathābhūto bhāvo gṛhītaḥ sarvā upādhyupakārikāḥ śaktīr grāhayati | tāś cemāḥ śaktayo gṛhītāḥ svopakāryānupādhīn grāhayantīti tad avasthaḥ prasaṅgaḥ ko bhedaḥ syād aniścita iti ya uktaḥ ||
analyzed: kiṃbhūtaḥ sva ātma bhūta sakala śakti apakāraḥ sva ātma bhūtāḥ sakalāḥ upādhi upakāriṇīnām śaktīnām upakārāḥ śaktayaḥ yasya sa tathābhūtaḥ bhāvaḥ gṛhītaḥ sarvāḥ upādhi upakārikāḥ śaktīḥ grāhayati tāḥ ca imāḥ śaktayaḥ gṛhītāḥ sva upakāryān upādhīn grāhayanti iti tat avasthaḥ prasaṅgaḥ kaḥ bhedaḥ syāt aniścitaḥ iti yaḥ uktaḥ

original: atha mābhūd eṣa doṣa iti tā api śaktyupakāriṇyaḥ śaktayo bhinnā evopādhimato bhāvād iṣyante | tadā tadupakāriṇyo 'pi śaktayo vyatiriktāḥ kalpanīyās tathā tadupakāriṇya ity evam anavasthānāt | upādhīnāṃ tacchaktīnāṃ ca | upādhyupakāraśaktīnāṃ cāparāparāsv eva śaktiṣv aparyavasānenāniṣṭhayā yad ghaṭanantasyodghaṭanāt sambandhanāt |
analyzed: atha mā abhūt eṣa doṣaḥ iti tāḥ api śakti upakāriṇyaḥ śaktayaḥ bhinnāḥ eva upādhimataḥ bhāvāt iṣyante tadā tad upakāriṇyaḥ api śaktayaḥ vyatiriktāḥ kalpanīyāḥ tathā tad upakāriṇyaḥ iti evam anavasthānāt upādhīnām tad śaktīnām ca upādhi upakāra śaktīnām ca apara aparāsu eva śaktiṣu aparyavasānena aniṣṭhayā yat sambandhanāt

original: tathā hy upādhayo vyatiriktāsu śaktiṣu sambandhās tā api vyatiriktāsv eva | evam uttarottarā śaktiḥ pūrvapūrvāsu śaktiṣu vyatiriktāsv evānavasthānena sambaddhā | na tūpādhimati | tataś ca sa eka upādhimān | tābhir upādhyupakārikābhiḥ (p.137) śaktibhis saha kadācid apy agṛhītas tadupakārātmā | śaktyupakārātmā |
analyzed: tathā hi upādhayaḥ vyatiriktāsu śaktiṣu sambandhāḥ tāḥ api vyatiriktāsu eva evam uttarottarā śaktiḥ pūrva pūrvāsu śaktiṣu vyatiriktāsu eva anavasthānena sambaddhā na tu upādhimati tatas ca saḥ ekaḥ upādhimān tābhiḥ upādhi upakārikābhiḥ śaktibhiḥ saha kadācid api agṛhītaḥ tad upakāra ātmā śakti upakāra ātmā

original: upādhyupakārikāṇāṃ śaktīnāṃ yāḥ śaktayas tadātmeti yāvat | śaktīnān tato vyatirekāt | tadvattvena upādhyupakāraśaktimattvena | tadgrahād upādhimattvenāpy ato vyarthaivopādhikalpaneti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: upādhi upakārikāṇām śaktīnām yāḥ śaktayaḥ tad ātmā iti yāvat śaktīnām tatas vyatirekāt tadvattvena upādhi upakāra śaktimattvena tad grahāt upādhimattvena api atas vyarthā eva upādhi kalpanā iti bhāvaḥ

original: evan tāvad yadopādhimati jñānaśabdayor vṛttis tadokto doṣaḥ | yadopādhiṣv eva tadānyo doṣo vaktavyaḥ tadabhidhānāyopādhipakṣam upanyasyati | yadi punar ityādi | kevalānityāśrayarahitān upādhīn viśeṣaṇabhedān śabdajñānānyupalīyeran | pratyāyakatvena samāśrayeyuḥ | tasyopādhimataḥ śabdajñānair asamāveśād aviṣayīkaraṇāt |
analyzed: evam tāvat yadā upādhimati jñāna śabdayoḥ vṛttiḥ tadā uktaḥ doṣaḥ yadā upādhiṣu eva tadā anyaḥ doṣaḥ vaktavyaḥ tad abhidhānāya upādhi pakṣam upanyasyati yadi punar ityādi kevalān iti āśraya rahitān upādhīn viśeṣaṇa bhedān śabda jñānāni upalīyeran pratyāyaka tvena samāśrayeyuḥ tasya upādhimataḥ śabda jñānaiḥ asamāveśāt aviṣayīkaraṇāt

original: tatpratipattimukhenopādhimatpratipattimukhena | ekenāpi śabdajñānena sarvasyopādheḥ pratipattiḥ (|)
analyzed: tad pratipatti mukhena upādhimat pratipatti mukhena ekena api śabda jñānena sarvasya upādheḥ pratipattiḥ

original: atrāpi doṣam āha – tadāpītyādi | tasyopādhimataḥ | anākṣepād ity apratipādanāt | tatrety upādhimati (|) kathaṃ vyartha ity āha – arthakriyetyādi | arthakriyāṃ purodhāya pravṛtter arthakriyā āśraya ālambanaṃ yasya vyavahārasya sa tathā | sarvo yāvān kaścit prekṣāpūrvakāriṇāṃ vyavahāro hitāhitaviṣayaḥ |
analyzed: atra api doṣam āha tadā api ityādi tasya upādhimataḥ anākṣepāt iti apratipādanāt tatra iti upādhimati katham vyarthaḥ iti āha arthakriyā ityādi arthakriyām purodhāya pravṛtteḥ arthakriyā āśrayaḥ ālambanam yasya vyavahārasya sa tathā sarvaḥ yāvān kaścid prekṣā pūrva kāriṇām vyavahāraḥ hita ahita viṣayaḥ

original: sa ca dvābhyāṃ prakārābhyāṃ vidhipratiṣedhābhyāṃ tṛtīyaprakārābhāvāt | itthaṃbhūtalakṣaṇā (pāṇiniḥ) ceyaṃ tṛtīyā | upādhyo(?dhya)ś ca gotvādayas tatrārthakriyāyām asamarthāḥ | samarthaś ca vyaktibhedaḥ śabdenaivocyata iti kim phalaiḥ śabdaprayogaiḥ | yataś caivam arthakriyāsamartho vyaktibhedo na cocyate śabdaiḥ |
analyzed: sa ca dvābhyām prakārābhyām vidhi pratiṣedhābhyām tṛtīya prakāra abhāvāt itthaṃbhūta lakṣaṇā pāṇiniḥ ca iyam tṛtīyā ca go tva ādayaḥ tatra arthakriyāyām asamarthāḥ samarthaḥ ca vyakti bhedaḥ śabdena eva ucyate iti kim phalaiḥ śabda prayogaiḥ yatas ca evam arthakriyā samarthaḥ vyakti bhedaḥ na ca ucyate śabdaiḥ

original: tataś cābhimatā upādhayo gotvādaya upādhayo na syur na viśeṣaṇāni syuḥ | yasmāt kvacid upādhimatyupādhidvāreṇa śabdasya jñānasya vā pravṛttau satyāṃ | kasyacid upādhimataḥ | pradhānasyeti viśeṣyasyāṅgābhāvād viśeṣaṇabhāvāt tadapekṣayā pradhānāpekṣayā | tathocyante | upādhaya ity ucyante | iyaṃ nyāyopādhivyavasthā |

analyzed: ādi śabdāt arthi tva sāmarthya ādi parigrahaḥ ityādayaḥ iti evamādayaḥ anubhavāt pratyakṣāt upādāna kāraṇāt sakāśāt bheda niścayasya utpattau sahakāriṇaḥ yadā tarhi bahuṣu niścayeṣu yathā uktāni kāraṇāni na bhavanti tadā teṣām niścayānām katham krama bhāvaḥ iti āha teṣām eva ca ityādi teṣām iti niścaya kāraṇānām pratyāsatti tāratamya bhedāt

original: yasya niścayasya pratyāsannatamanniścayakāraṇan tat tāvadādāv utpadyate | ādiśabdād adhimātratāratamyasya bhedān niścayānāṃ paurvāparyaṃ | yathetyādinodāharaṇam āha – piteva yadopādhyāyo bhavati | tadaikasya puruṣasya janakatvādhyāpakatvāviśeṣe 'pi | pitaram āyāntaṃ dṛṣṭvā pitā me āgacchatīti niścinoti nopādhyāya iti |
analyzed: yasya niścayasya pratyāsannatamat niścaya kāraṇan tat tāvat ādau utpadyate ādi śabdāt adhimātra tāratamyasya bhedāt niścayānām paurvāparyam yathā ityādinā udāharaṇam āha pitā iva yadā upādhyāyaḥ bhavati tadā ekasya puruṣasya janaka tva adhyāpaka tva aviśeṣe pitaram āyāntam dṛṣṭvā pitā me āgacchati iti niścinoti na upādhyāyaḥ iti

original: pitṛtvaniścaye kāraṇasya pratyāsannatamatvāt ||
analyzed: pitṛ tva niścaye kāraṇasya pratyāsannatama tvāt

original: nanu saty api kṣaṇikatvanairātmyavikalpābhyāse sahakāriṇī tattvādarśināṃ na pratyakṣāt kṣaṇikatvādiniścayo bhavatīty ata āha – so 'pītyādi | asati bhrāntikāraṇe bhavati na tu niścayapratyayamātrāt | yata evam asati bhrāntikāraṇe sahakāripratyasākalye ca sati pratyakṣān niścaya utpadyate na kevalāt | tasmān nānubhūta ityādi |
analyzed: nanu sati api kṣaṇika tva nairātmya vikalpa abhyāse sahakāriṇī tattva adarśinām na pratyakṣāt kṣaṇika tva ādi niścayaḥ bhavati iti atas āha saḥ pi ityādi asati bhrānti kāraṇe bhavati na tu niścaya pratyaya mātrāt yatas evam asati bhrānti kāraṇe ca sati pratyakṣāt niścayaḥ utpadyate na kevalāt tasmāt na anubhūtaḥ ityādi

original: (p.143) tataś ca sthitam etad (|) anyavyavacchedaḥ śabdaliṅgābhyāṃ pratipadyata iti |
analyzed: tatas ca sthitam etat anya vyavacchedaḥ śabda liṅgābhyām pratipadyate iti

original: nanu vyavacchedo 'pi yadi padārthād abhinnas tadaikena pramāṇena śabdena vāsya viṣayīkaraṇe 'nyasya vaiyarthyaṃ syāt sarvātmanā niścitatvāt |
analyzed: nanu yadi padārthāt abhinnaḥ tadā ekena pramāṇena śabdena vā asya viṣayīkaraṇe nyasya vaiyarthyam syāt sarva ātmanā niścita tvāt

original: atha bhinnas tadāpi tasyāśritatvād ekavyavacchedopādhike padārthe pramāṇenaikena niścīyamāne pūrvoktena nyāyena sarveṣāṃ vyavacchedānāṃ niścitatvād anyeṣāṃ pramāṇādīnām apravṛttiḥ syād (|) ataḥ samānaḥ prasaṅga iti |
analyzed: atha bhinnaḥ tadā api tasya āśrita tvāt eka vyavaccheda upādhike padārthe pramāṇena ekena niścīyamāne pūrvoktena nyāyena sarveṣām vyavacchedānām niścita tvāt anyeṣām pramāṇa ādīnām apravṛttiḥ syāt atas samānaḥ prasaṅgaḥ iti

original: tan na | yato na bhāvānām anyonyavyavacchedo 'bhinno bhinno vāsti | kevalaṃ svahetubhya eva bhinnāḥ samutpannā ity uktam vakṣyati ca || (60 ||)
analyzed: tat na yatas na bhāvānām anyonya vyavacchedaḥ bhinnaḥ bhinnaḥ vā asti kevalam sva hetubhyaḥ eva bhinnāḥ samutpannāḥ iti uktam vakṣyati ca

original: kathan tarhy anyavyāvṛttir ityādi vyapadeśo buddhiś ca pravṛttata ity atrāha – tatrāpītyādi | tatrāpi cānyāpohe śabdārthe | anyasmād vyāvṛttir anyasmād vyāvṛtto 'yam ity api (|) ye śabdā dharmadharmivācanāḥ niścayāś cobhayaviṣayās te saṃketam anurundhate |
analyzed: kathan tarhi anya vyāvṛttiḥ ityādi vyapadeśaḥ buddhiḥ ca pravṛttataḥ iti atra āha tatra api ityādi tatra api ca anya apohe śabda arthe anyasmāt vyāvṛttiḥ anyasmāt vyāvṛttaḥ yam iti api ye śabdāḥ dharma dharmi vācanāḥ niścayāḥ ca ubhaya viṣayāḥ te saṃketam anurundhate

original: saṃketānuvidhānenaiṣāṃ dharmadharmiviṣayavibhāgaḥ kalpitaḥ paramārthatas tu vyāvṛttir eva nāstīty arthaḥ |
analyzed: saṃketa anuvidhānena eṣām dharma dharmi viṣaya vibhāgaḥ kalpitaḥ paramārthataḥ tu vyāvṛttiḥ eva na asti iti arthaḥ

original: tad vyācaṣṭe – tatrānyāpoha ityādinā. gor aśvād vyāvṛttir anyā dharmabhūtā anya evāśvād vyāvṛtto dharmī | vyāvṛttyā viśiṣṭo gaur ity etan nāsti | kin tu yaiva vyāvṛttiḥ sa eva vyāvṛtta iti vakṣyati |
analyzed: tat vyācaṣṭe tatra anya apohaḥ ityādinā goḥ aśvāt vyāvṛttiḥ anyā dharma bhūtā anyaḥ eva aśvāt vyāvṛttaḥ dharmī vyāvṛttyā viśiṣṭaḥ gauḥ iti etat na asti kin tu yā eva vyāvṛttiḥ saḥ eva vyāvṛttaḥ iti vakṣyati

original: yadi cāśvād vyāvṛttir anaśvatā godravyasyānyā syāt tadāśvavyāvṛtter api godravyeṇa nivarttitavyambhedāt | tataś ca tadvyāvṛtter anaśvatāyāḥ sakāśān nivartamānasya gos tadbhāvaprasaṅgāt | aśvabhāvaprasaṅgād aśvavat | evaṃ hy aśvavyāvṛtter anaśvatvalakṣaṇāyā gaur vyāvṛtto bhavati yady asyāśvatvaṃ syāt | tathā ca gor aśvabhāvāpatteḥ |
analyzed: yadi ca aśvāt vyāvṛttiḥ anaśvatā go dravyasya anyā syāt tadā aśva vyāvṛtteḥ api go dravyeṇa nivarttitavyam bhedāt tatas ca tad vyāvṛtteḥ anaśvatāyāḥ sakāśāt nivartamānasya goḥ tad bhāva prasaṅgāt aśva bhāva prasaṅgāt aśva vat evam hi aśva vyāvṛtteḥ anaśva tva lakṣaṇāyāḥ gauḥ vyāvṛttaḥ bhavati yadi asya aśva tvam syāt tathā ca goḥ aśva bhāva āpatteḥ

original: aśvād gor vyāvṛttis tasyā abhāvaḥ | gavāśvayor ekatvāt |
analyzed: aśvāt goḥ vyāvṛttiḥ tasyāḥ abhāvaḥ gava aśvayoḥ ekatvāt

original: tena yad uktañ jainajaiminīyaiḥ (|)
analyzed: tena yat uktan jaina jaiminīyaiḥ

original: "sarvātmakam ekaṃ syād anyāpohavyatikrama" iti |1*
analyzed: sarva ātmakam ekam syāt anya apoha vyatikramaḥ iti

original: tān pratīdam uktaṃ | yady anyavyāvṛttir arthāntaraṃ syād gavāśvādīnām ekatvaṃ syād iti |
analyzed: tān prati idam uktam yadi anya vyāvṛttiḥ artha antaram syāt gavāśva ādīnām eka tvam syāt iti

original: fn. 1*: Ślokavārttika.
analyzed: ślokavārttika

original: (p.144) nāpi gor abhinnāśvavyāvṛttir aśvavyāvṛttau gaur ity apratītiprasaṅgāt | govināśe cāśvasyotpattiprasaṅgād aśvanivṛtter vinaṣṭatvāt | tasmān nāsty eva vyāvṛttiḥ |
analyzed: nā api goḥ abhinna aśva vyāvṛttiḥ aśva vyāvṛttau gauḥ iti apratīti prasaṅgāt go vināśe ca aśvasya utpatti prasaṅgāt aśva nivṛtteḥ vinaṣṭa tvāt tasmāt na asti eva vyāvṛttiḥ

original: tena yad ucyate bhaṭṭodyotakarābhyāṃ | "yo 'yam agophaḥ sa kiṃ gavi bhinne 'rtho bhinnaḥ | yadi bhinnaḥ kimāśrito 'thānāśritaḥ (|) yady āśritas tadāśritatvād guṇa iti gośabdena tadā guṇyabhidhīyate na godravyam iti | gaus tiṣṭhatīti sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ syāt | athānāśritaḥ kenārthena ṣaṣṭhyarthaḥ | gor apoha iti |
analyzed: tena yat ucyate bhaṭṭa udyota karābhyām yaḥ yam agophaḥ sa kim gavi bhinne rthaḥ bhinnaḥ yadi bhinnaḥ kimāśritaḥ yadi āśritaḥ tad āśrita tvāt guṇaḥ iti go śabdena tadā guṇī abhidhīyate na go dravyam iti gauḥ tiṣṭhati iti sāmānādhikaraṇyam syāt atha anāśritaḥ kena arthena ṣaṣṭhī arthaḥ goḥ apohaḥ iti

original: athābhinno gaur eva syād iti na kiñcid aniṣṭhaṃ | ayaṃ cāpohaḥ prativastu yady eko 'nekasambandhī ca tad eva gotvam" iti (|)
analyzed: atha abhinnaḥ gauḥ eva syāt iti na kiñcid aniṣṭham ayam ca apohaḥ prativastu yadi ekaḥ neka sambandhī ca tat eva go tvam iti

original: tan nirastaṃ | anyavyāvṛtter evābhāvāt kevalaṃ svahetutaḥ svakīyena rūpeṇotpanno bhāvo 'nyasmād vyāvṛttas tasya cānyasmād vyāvṛttiḥ kalpyate | yataś ca na paramārthato vyāvṛttir asti | tasmād yaiva vyāvṛttiḥ sa eva vyāvṛttaḥ | dvābhyām aikasyaiva viṣayīkaraṇāt |
analyzed: tat nirastam anya vyāvṛtteḥ eva abhāvāt kevalam sva hetutaḥ svakīyena rūpeṇa utpannaḥ bhāvaḥ nyasmāt vyāvṛttaḥ tasya ca anyasmāt vyāvṛttiḥ kalpyate yatas ca na paramārthataḥ vyāvṛttiḥ asti tasmāt yā eva vyāvṛttiḥ saḥ eva vyāvṛttaḥ dvābhyām ā ekasya eva viṣayīkaraṇāt

original: tasyaiva cānyavyāvṛttasya liṅgatvaṃ liṅgitvaṃ sambandho vikalpaviṣayatvañ ca (|) vikalpo hy anyavyāvṛttaṃ svākārābhinnamadhyasya puruṣan tatra pravarttayatītyatyarthakāritvād (|) ataḥ sa eva bāhyaḥ śabdārtho 'nyavyāvṛttaḥ |
analyzed: tasya eva ca anya vyāvṛttasya liṅga tvam liṅgi tvam sambandhaḥ vikalpa viṣaya tvam ca vikalpaḥ hi anya vyāvṛttam sva ākāra abhinna madhyasya tatra pravarttayati iti atyartha kāri tvāt atas saḥ eva bāhyaḥ śabda arthaḥ

original: yad apy ucyate kumārilena (|) kadācid ekasmād eva bhāvasyāpohaḥ syāt | sarvāsmād vā | yady ekasmād eva tadā yathāśvāpohadvāreṇa godravyasya gaur ity abhidhānanantathā siṃhāder api syād aśvāpohasya gośabdapravṛttinimittasya bhāvāt | tad āha –
analyzed: yat api ucyate kumārilena kadācid ekasmāt eva bhāvasya apohaḥ syāt sarva asmāt vā yadi ekasmāt eva tadā yathā aśva apoha dvāreṇa go dravyasya gauḥ iti siṃha ādeḥ api syāt aśva apohasya go śabda pravṛtti nimittasya bhāvāt tat āha

original: "tato 'śvāpoharūpatvāt siṃhādiḥ sarva eva te |
analyzed: śva apoha rūpa tvāt siṃha ādiḥ sarvaḥ eva te

original: tannimittam agopohaṃ vibhrad ucyata gaur iti" iti |1*
analyzed: tad nimittam a ga upoham vibhrat ucyata gauḥ iti iti

original: atha sarvasmād apoho godravyasya | tatrāpi yadi pratyekam apohyaṃ aśvādayas tadāpohyānāmānantyād apoha eva na sidhyet | apohyānāṃ ca bhinnatvād apohabhedaḥ prasañyate | tathā caikasminn api piṇḍe jātibahutvāj jātyantarabuddhiḥ syāt | jātyantareṣv ivāśvādiṣu |
analyzed: atha sarvasmāt apohaḥ go dravyasya tatra api yadi pratyekam apohyam aśva ādayaḥ tadā apohyānām ānantyāt apohaḥ eva na sidhyet apohyānām ca bhinna tvāt apoha bhedaḥ prasañyate tathā ca ekasmin api piṇḍe jāti bahu tvāt jāti antara buddhiḥ syāt jāti antareṣu iva aśva ādiṣu

original: "tato gaur iti sāmānyaṃ vācyam ekaṃ na sidhyati |"2*
analyzed: tatas gauḥ iti sāmānyam vācyam ekam na sidhyati

original: nāpi te samudāyarūpeṇa sarve 'pohyāḥ sambhavanti | samudāyo hy ekadeśatvena vā syān na cāpohyānām ekadeśāditvaṃ sambhavati | nāpi teṣāṃ samudāyo vyatirikto 'sty avyatireke cānantyaṃ tadavasthaṃ | na cāpi sāmānyarūpeṇa te 'pohyāḥ sāmānyasyāvastutvāt (p.145) | apohyatve ca vastutvaṃ syād iti |
analyzed: nā api te samudāya rūpeṇa sarve pohyāḥ sambhavanti samudāyaḥ hi eka deśa tvena vā syāt na ca apohyānām eka deśa ādi tvam sambhavati nā api teṣām samudāyaḥ avyatireke ca ānantyam tad avastham na ca api sāmānya rūpeṇa te pohyāḥ sāmānyasya avastu tvāt apohya tve ca vastu tvam syāt iti

original: fn. 1*: Ślokavārttika 57. 2*: ibid. 60.
analyzed: ns-57 ro-0 se-5 ns-57

original: tad ayuktaṃ yataḥ (|) sarvabhāvānāṃ svenaiva svenaiva rūpeṇotpadyamānānāṃ sarvasmād apohaḥ svahetubhyaḥ siddha eva |
analyzed: tat ayuktam yatas sarva bhāvānām svena eva svena eva rūpeṇa utpadyamānānām sarvasmāt apohaḥ sva hetubhyaḥ siddhaḥ eva

original: atha katham asau jñāyata iti codyate | tat kiṅ gaur atītānāgatavarttamānāśvādisvabhāvaḥ pratyakṣe pratibhāsate | neti cet | kathaṃ na tatra sarvāpohaḥ pratyakṣasiddhaḥ | na hi pramāṇaṃ hastābhyāṅgṛhītvānyadapohaty api tu niyatarūpārthaprakāśanam evāsyānyāpohaṃ |tasmān niyatarūpārthapratibhāsa eva pratyakṣasya sarvasmād apohagrahaḥ |
analyzed: atha katham asau jñāyate iti codyate tat kim gauḥ atīta anāgata varttamāna aśva ādi svabhāvaḥ pratyakṣe pratibhāsate na iti ced katham na tatra sarva apohaḥ pratyakṣa siddhaḥ na hi pramāṇam hastābhyām gṛhītvā anyat apohati api tu niyata rūpa artha prakāśanam eva asya anya apoham tasmāt niyata rūpa artha pratibhāsaḥ eva pratyakṣasya sarvasmāt apoha grahaḥ

original: tac ca svaviṣayan niścāya yad yad evaṃ na bhavati tatsarvam anyatvena niścāyayaty ato yugapat sarvasyānyasya sāmānyenāviśeṣeṇa niṣedhaḥ kriyate | sāmānyasyānirddhāritaviśeṣarūpatvāt | tad uktam (|)
analyzed: tat ca sva viṣayan niścāya yat yat evam na bhavati tat sarvam anya tvena niścāyayati atas yugapad sarvasya anyasya sāmānyena aviśeṣeṇa niṣedhaḥ kriyate sāmānyasya a nirddhārita viśeṣa rūpa tvāt tat uktam

original: "atadrūpaparāvṛttavastumātraprasādhanāt (|)
analyzed: a tad rūpa parāvṛtta vastu mātra prasādhanāt

original: sāmānyaviṣayaṃ proktaṃ liṅgabhedāpratiṣṭhiter" iti | (pra. sa.)
analyzed: sāmānya viṣayam proktam liṅga bheda a pratiṣṭhiteḥ iti pra sa

original: tenāpohyasya kasyacid vastutvam iṣyata eva |
analyzed: tena apohyasya kasyacid vastu tvam iṣyate eva

original: na cāpohyatvād vastutvam ity atra kiñcid pramāṇam asty abhāvasyāpy apohyatvān na cāsya vastutvam ity uktaṃ | tasmād yugapat sarvāpohalakṣaṇenāgopohenaikasminn api piṇḍe gotvaṃ | pratyekāśvādyapohenānaśvatvāsiṃhatvāmahiṣatvādayo jātibhedāḥ kalpitās taddvāreṇa ca tadabhidhāyakāḥ pravarttanta iti yat kiñcid etat |
analyzed: na ca apohya tvāt vastu tvam iti atra kiñcid pramāṇam asti abhāvasya api apohya tvāt na ca asya vastu tvam iti uktam tasmāt yugapad sarva apoha lakṣaṇena aga upohena ekasmin api piṇḍe go tvam pratyeka aśva ādi apohena an aśva tva a siṃha tva a mahiṣa tva ādayaḥ jāti bhedāḥ kalpitāḥ tad dvāreṇa ca tad abhidhāyakāḥ pravarttante iti yat kiñcid etat

original: yadi vyavṛttivyāvṛttābhidheyārthasya na bhedaḥ | kathaṃ vyāvṛttivyāvṛtta iti śabdajñānabhedaḥ | tathā hi vyāvṛttir ity anyaḥ śabdo vyāvṛtta ity anya eva śabdaḥ | tathā jñānabhedo 'pi (|) vyāvṛttir ity ukte dharmamātram pratīyate | vyāvṛtta iti dharkīti | tata āha (|) śabdetyādi | śabdād dharmadharmivācino yā pratītiḥ | sā śabdapratipattiḥ |
analyzed: yadi vyavṛtti vyāvṛtta abhidheya arthasya na bhedaḥ katham vyāvṛtti vyāvṛttaḥ iti śabda jñāna bhedaḥ tathā hi vyāvṛttiḥ iti anyaḥ śabdaḥ vyāvṛttaḥ iti anyaḥ eva śabdaḥ tathā vyāvṛttiḥ iti ukte dharma mātram pratīyate vyāvṛttaḥ iti dharkī iti tatas āha śabda ityādi śabdāt dharma dharmi vācinaḥ yā pratītiḥ sā śabda pratipattiḥ

original: śabdaś ca śabdapratipattiś ceti virūpaikaśeṣaḥ | śabdabhedaḥ śabdāc ca yā pratipattis tasyābheda ity arthaḥ saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhikaraṇaṃ saṃketas tasya bhedāt | saṃketabhedaṃ cānantaram eva (1.63) bhedāntarapratikṣepetyādinā pratipādayiṣyate | na vācyabhedo 'sti dharmadharmiśabdayor vastuta ity adhyāhāraḥ || (61 ||)
analyzed: śabdaḥ ca śabda pratipattiḥ ca iti virūpa ekaśeṣaḥ śabda bhedaḥ śabdāt ca yā pratipattiḥ tasya abhedaḥ iti arthaḥ saṃjñā saṃjñi sambandhi karaṇam saṃketaḥ tasya bhedāt saṃketa bhedam ca anantaram eva bheda antara pratikṣepa ityādinā pratipādayiṣyate na dharma dharmi śabdayoḥ vastutas iti adhyāhāraḥ

original: nanu cetyādi paraḥ | kiṃ punar vācyāviśeṣe saṃketabhedo na yukta iti ced āha – dvayor ityādi | karttari ceyaṃ ṣaṣṭhī karttṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛtīti ubhayaprāptau karmaṇīti (p.146) niyamasya śeṣe vibhāṣeti1* vikalpanāt | dvābhyāṃ dharmadharmiśabdābhyām ekasyārthasyābhidhānād ity arthaḥ | ekaṃ ced dvābhyām abhidheyan tato vyarthaḥ saṃketaḥ |
analyzed: nanu ca ityādi paraḥ kim punar vācya aviśeṣe saṃketa bhedaḥ na yuktaḥ iti ced āha dvayoḥ ityādi karttari ca iyam ṣaṣṭhī karttṛ karmaṇoḥ kṛtī iti ubhaya prāptau karmaṇi iti niyamasya śeṣe vibhāṣā iti vikalpanāt dvābhyām dharma dharmi śabdābhyām ekasya arthasya abhidhānāt iti arthaḥ ekam ced dvābhyām tatas vyarthaḥ saṃketaḥ

original: tathā ceti dharmadharmiṇor abhede vyatirekiṇyā iti vyatirekābhidhāyinyā gor gotvam iti ṣaṣṭhyāḥ | tasyā iti vyatirekavibhakter bhedāśrayatvād vastubhedam āśritya pravṛtteḥ | yathā devadattasya kamaṇḍalur iti | evaṃ saṃketābhāve vyatirekavibhaktyabhāve ca codite |
analyzed: tathā ca iti dharma dharmiṇoḥ abhede vyatirekiṇyāḥ iti vyatireka abhidhāyinyāḥ goḥ go tvam iti ṣaṣṭhyāḥ tasyāḥ iti vyatireka vibhakteḥ bheda āśraya tvāt vastu bhedam āśritya pravṛtteḥ yathā devadattasya kamaṇḍaluḥ iti evam saṃketa abhāve vyatireka vibhakti abhāve ca codite

original: fn. 1*: Pāṇini2.3.65.

vibhaktyabhāvadoṣan tāvat pariharann āha – dvayor ityādi | dharmadharmivācinoḥ śabdayor ekasyārthasyābhidhāne 'pi vibhaktir vyatirekiṇī | vyatirekasya vācikā ṣaṣṭhī | iva śabdo bhinnakramaḥ | bhinnam ivārtham anveti darśayati | vācye saṃketabhedakṛtena leśena mātrayā yo viśeṣas tataḥ kāraṇān na tu paramārthato vastubhedāt |
analyzed: vibhakti abhāva doṣan tāvat pariharan āha dvayoḥ ityādi dharma dharmi vācinoḥ śabdayoḥ ekasya arthasya abhidhāne vibhaktiḥ vyatirekiṇī vyatirekasya vācikā ṣaṣṭhī iva śabdaḥ bhinna kramaḥ bhinnam iva artham anveti darśayati vācye saṃketa bheda kṛtena leśena mātrayā yaḥ viśeṣaḥ tatas kāraṇāt na tu paramārthataḥ vastu bhedāt

original: yad vyācaṣṭe | na vai śabdānām ityādinā | viṣayasvabhāvāyatteti | bāhyasvalakṣaṇāyattā (|) kiṃ kāraṇam (|) icchātaḥ puruṣecchāvaśād abhāveṣv api vṛttyabhāvaprasaṅgāt | ta iti | icchāpratibaddhavṛttayaḥ śabdā yathā yena prakāreṇa bhedapratipādanena vyatirikte yathā rājñaḥ puruṣa iti | avyatirikte yathātmaiva hy ātmano draṣṭeti |
analyzed: yat vyācaṣṭe na vai śabdānām ityādinā viṣaya svabhāva āyattā iti bāhya sva lakṣaṇa āyattā kim kāraṇam icchātaḥ puruṣa icchā vaśāt abhāveṣu api vṛtti abhāva prasaṅgāt te iti icchā pratibaddha vṛttayaḥ śabdāḥ yathā yena prakāreṇa bheda pratipādanena vyatirikte yathā rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ iti avyatirikte yathā ātmā eva hi ātmanaḥ draṣṭā iti

original: tathā niyuktā ity abhinne 'py arthe bhedam ivopādāya prayuktās tam artham apratibandhena bhinnam iva prakāśayanti | vastutaḥ svalakṣaṇasyābhede 'pi yata evaṃ tena kāraṇena | gaur iti dharmivācinam āha – gotvam iti dharmavācinaṃ | ābhyām ekābhidhāne 'py agovyāvṛttasya gor abhidhāne 'pi kasyacid viṣayasya pratyāyanārtham iti |
analyzed: tathā niyuktāḥ iti abhinne pi arthe bhedam iva upādāya prayuktāḥ tam artham apratibandhena bhinnam iva prakāśayanti vastutas sva lakṣaṇasya abhede pi yatas evam tena kāraṇena gauḥ iti dharmi vācinam āha go tvam iti dharma vācinam ābhyām eka abhidhāne pi a go vyāvṛttasya goḥ abhidhāne pi kasyacid viṣayasya pratyāyana artham iti

original: agovyāvṛttinimittasya gotvasya prakāśanārthaṃ | agovyāvṛttimātraṃ gotvaśabdena pratipādyam ity evaṃkṛte saṃkete bhede | vyatiriktārthā na vibhaktir asya gotvam iti bhavati ṣaṣṭhī | vyatirikto 'rtho 'syā iti vigrahaḥ | dharmiṇas sakāśād dharmam arthāntaram ivādarśayantī pratibhāti |
analyzed: a go vyāvṛtti nimittasya go tvasya prakāśana artham a go vyāvṛtti mātram go tva śabdena pratipādyam iti evaṃkṛte saṃkete bhede vyatirikta arthā na vibhaktiḥ asya go tvam iti bhavati ṣaṣṭhī vyatiriktaḥ iti vigrahaḥ dharmiṇaḥ sakāśāt dharmam artha antaram iva a darśayantī pratibhāti

original: anarthantare (p.147) 'pīty avyatirikte 'pi dharme (|) kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tathā prayogadarśanābhyāsāt | vastubhede sati ṣaṣṭhyāḥ prayogadarśanābhyāsād devadattasya kamaṇḍalur ityādau |
analyzed: anarthantare pi iti avyatirikte dharme kim kāraṇam tathā prayoga darśana abhyāsāt vastu bhede sati ṣaṣṭhyāḥ prayoga darśana abhyāsāt devadattasya kamaṇḍaluḥ ityādau

original: etad uktam bhavati | vastubhinnam bhavatu mā vā bhūt sarvathā vyatirekavibhaktir icchāmātrānurodhinī kevalaṃ prayogadarśanābhyāsāc chabdārtham bhinnam iva darśayatīti | tāvateti vibhaktiprayogamātrāt | sarvatrety arthābhede 'pi | gaur gotvam ityādau na dharmadharmiṇoḥ paramārthato bhedaḥ |
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati vastu bhinnam bhavatu mā vā bhūt sarvathā vyatireka vibhaktiḥ icchā mātra anurodhinī kevalam prayoga darśana abhyāsāt śabda artham bhinnam iva darśayati iti tāvatā iti vibhakti prayoga mātrāt sarvatra iti artha abhede pi gauḥ go tvam ityādau na dharma dharmiṇoḥ paramārthataḥ bhedaḥ

original: tasmād anyatrāpy arthābhede 'pi puruṣecchāvaśāāt pravṛttasya vyatirekābhidhāyinaḥ śabdasya pratibandhābhāvāt | dṛṣṭā ca puruṣecchāvaśāc chabdānāṃ pravṛttir asaty api tathābhūte bāhye vācya ity āha – yathetyādi | ekam vastu kvacit prakaraṇe ekavacanena khyāpyate | yathā tvam iti |
analyzed: tasmāt anyatra api artha abhede puruṣa icchā vaśāt pravṛttasya vyatireka abhidhāyinaḥ śabdasya pratibandha abhāvāt dṛṣṭā ca puruṣa icchā vaśāt śabdānām pravṛttiḥ asatī api tathābhūte bāhye vācye iti āha yathā ityādi ekam vastu kvacid prakaraṇe ekavacanena khyāpyate yathā tvam iti

original: tadaviśeṣe 'pi ekatvāviśeṣe 'pi tad eva vastu bahuvacanena yūyam iti | ataś caikasminn api bahuvacanadarśanān na yathāvastu śabdānām pravṛttir iti gamyate | yuṣmadi gurāv ekeṣām1* ity atideśavākyād ekasminn api bahuvacanam iti cet | cintyam etat |
analyzed: tad aviśeṣe pi ekatva aviśeṣe pi tat eva vastu bahuvacanena yūyam iti atas ca ekasmin api bahuvacana darśanāt na yathāvastu śabdānām pravṛttiḥ iti gamyate yuṣmadi gurau ekeṣām iti atideśa vākyāt ekasmin api bahuvacanam iti ced cintyam etat

original: kim atideśavākyenaikasya bahutvaṃ kriyate kim vā bahuvacanamātram aprāptaṃ vidhīyata iti (|) na tāvad ādyaḥ pakṣo vacanamātreṇa vastūnām vidhānāsambhavāt | dvitīye 'pi pakṣe siddhaivecchāmātreṇa śabdānāṃ pravṛttir iti | evaṃ tāvad vibhaktyabhāvadoṣaḥ parihṛtaḥ (|| 62 ||)
analyzed: kim atideśa vākyena ekasya bahu tvam kriyate kim vā bahuvacana mātram aprāptam vidhīyate iti na tāvat ādyaḥ pakṣaḥ vacana mātreṇa vastūnām vidhāna asambhavāt dvitīye pi pakṣe siddhā eva icchā mātreṇa śabdānām pravṛttiḥ iti evam tāvat vibhakti abhāva doṣaḥ parihṛtaḥ

original: fn. 1*: Pāṇini1.2.58.
analyzed: ro-0

original: saṃketābhāvadoṣan tu pariharttun tam evopanyasyati (|) prayojanābhāvāt tv ityādi | dharmidharmaśabdābhyām ekasyābhidhānāt prayojanābhāvaḥ | tad api prayojanam asty eva | gotvāpekṣayā bhedāntarāṇi dravyatvapārthivatvādīni | teṣāṃ pratikṣepo 'svīkāraḥ |
analyzed: saṃketa abhāva doṣan tu pariharttun tam eva upanyasyati prayojana abhāvāt tu ityādi dharmi dharma śabdābhyām ekasya abhidhānāt prayojana abhāvaḥ tat api prayojanam asti eva go tva apekṣayā bheda antarāṇi dravya tva pārthiva tva ādīni teṣām svīkāraḥ

original: tau pratikṣepāpratikṣepau yathākraman tayor dvayor dharmadharmivācinoḥ śabdayor yaḥ saṃketabhedas tasya (|) kim viśiṣṭasya jñātṛvāñchānurodhinaḥ pratipattricchānuvidhāyinaḥ padaṃ prayojanaṃ ||
analyzed: tau pratikṣepa apratikṣepau yathākraman tayoḥ dvayoḥ dharma dharmi vācinoḥ śabdayoḥ yaḥ saṃketa bhedaḥ tasya kim viśiṣṭasya jñātṛ vāñchā anurodhinaḥ pratipattṛ icchā anuvidhāyinaḥ padam prayojanam

original: etad uktam bhavati | yadānyavyāvattarūpanirākākṣaḥ pratipattāśvād evaikasmād (p.148) vyāvṛttaṃ gopiṇḍaṃ jijñāsate tadā yāvad aśvād vyāvṛttim arthāntarabhūtām āropya tathaiva saṃketapūrvakaṃ laukikena dharmavācakena śabdena na kathayati (|) tāvan na parasya jijñāsito 'rthaḥ pratipādayituṃ śakyate (|) atas taṃ praty anaśvatvam asyety ucyate |
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati pratipattā aśvāt eva ekasmāt vyāvṛttam go piṇḍam jijñāsate tadā yāvat aśvāt vyāvṛttim artha antara bhūtām āropya tathā eva saṃketa pūrvakam laukikena dharma vācakena śabdena na kathayati tāvat na parasya jijñāsitaḥ rthaḥ pratipādayitum śakyate atas tam prati an aśva tvam asya iti ucyate

original: evaṃ hi dharmiṇo 'prādhānyād anyavyāvṛttarūpānākṣepaḥ kṛto bhavaty aśvād evaikasmād vyāvṛttiś ca | na tadaivam ucyate 'naśva ity anena hy anyavyāvṛttasyāpi rūpasyākṣepaḥ kṛtaḥ syāt (|) na caivam pareṇa jijñāsitam ajijñāsitaṃ ca kathayan kathan nonmattaḥ syāt |
analyzed: evam hi prādhānyāt anya vyāvṛtta rūpa an ākṣepaḥ kṛtaḥ bhavati aśvāt eva ekasmāt vyāvṛttiḥ ca na tadā evam ucyate iti anena hi anya vyāvṛttasya api rūpasya ākṣepaḥ kṛtaḥ syāt na ca evam pareṇa jijñāsitam ajijñāsitam ca kathayan kathan nā unmattaḥ syāt

original: yadā punar anyavyāvṛttarūpasākāṃkṣe 'śvād vyāvṛttaṃ gopiṇḍaṃ jijñāsate | tadāpi yāvad aśvavyāvṛttiviśiṣṭaṃ piṇḍaṃ dharmisvabhāvatayā 'ropya tathaiva saṃketapūrvakaṃ laukikena dharmivācakena na kathayati tāvan na parasya jijñāsito 'rthaḥ pratipādayituṃ śakyate 'tas taṃ pratyanaśvo 'yam ity ucyate |
analyzed: yadā punar anya vyāvṛtta rūpa sākāṃkṣe śvāt vyāvṛttam go piṇḍam jijñāsate tadā api yāvat aśva vyāvṛtti viśiṣṭam piṇḍam dharmi svabhāva tayā ropya tathā eva saṃketa pūrvakam laukikena dharmi vācakena na kathayati tāvat na parasya jijñāsitaḥ rthaḥ pratipādayitum śakyate yam iti ucyate

original: evaṃ hi dharmiṇaḥ prādhānyād anyavyāvṛttarūpākṣepaḥ kṛto bhavaty aśvavyāvṛttaś ca gopiṇḍaḥ kathito bhavati | na tadaivaṃ khyāpyate 'naśvatvam asyeti parajijñāsitānyavyāvṛttarūpānākṣepaprasaṅgāt | ajijñāsitaṃ cārthaṃ kathayan kathan nonmattaḥ |
analyzed: evam hi dharmiṇaḥ prādhānyāt anya vyāvṛtta rūpa ākṣepaḥ kṛtaḥ bhavati aśva vyāvṛttaḥ ca go piṇḍaḥ kathitaḥ bhavati na tadā evam khyāpyate na aśva tvam asya iti para jijñāsita anya vyāvṛtta rūpa an ākṣepa prasaṅgāt ajijñāsitam ca artham kathayan kathan na unmattaḥ

original: sarvaś ca śābdo vyavahāraḥ saṃketapūrvakaḥ saṃketaś ca vikalpakalpitārthapūrvaka eveti vikalpair apy anenaiva dvāreṇa dharmadharmibhāvapratītir yuktā |
analyzed: sarvaḥ ca śābdaḥ vyavahāraḥ saṃketa pūrvakaḥ saṃketaḥ ca vikalpa kalpita artha pūrvakaḥ eva iti vikalpaiḥ api anena eva dvāreṇa dharma dharmi bhāva pratītiḥ yuktā

original: tena yad ucyate (|) bhavatu dharmadharmivācakānāṃ bhedāntarapratikṣepāpratikṣepārthapravṛttiḥ | dharmidharmavikalpānān tu kathaṃ pratipattir ity apāstaṃ |
analyzed: tena yat ucyate bhavatu dharma dharmi vācakānām bheda antara pratikṣepa a pratikṣepa artha pravṛttiḥ dharmi dharma vikalpānām tu katham pratipattiḥ iti apāstam

original: etad eva vṛttyā spaṣṭayann āha – yadāyam ityādi | pratipatteti śrotā | tasmād aśvādyo 'nyo mahiṣādis tasmād vyavacchedo mahiṣādivyāvṛttaḥ svabhāvas tasya bhāvānapekṣaḥ sattānapekṣaḥ | piṇḍaviśeṣe gavi | aśvavyavacchedamātraṃ jijñāsate | kim asyāśvād vyāvṛttaṃ rūpam astīti |
analyzed: etat eva vṛttyā spaṣṭayan āha yadā ayam ityādi pratipattā iti śrotā tasmāt aśva ādyaḥ nyaḥ mahiṣa ādiḥ tasmāt vyavacchedaḥ mahiṣa ādi vyāvṛttaḥ svabhāvaḥ tasya bhāva anapekṣaḥ sattā anapekṣaḥ piṇḍa viśeṣe gavi aśva vyavaccheda mātram jijñāsate kim asya aśvāt vyāvṛttam rūpam asti iti

original: tathābhūtajñāpanārtham iti yathā pratipattrā jñātum iṣṭan tadanurodhena tathābhūtasyāśvād bhedamātrasya jñāpanārthan tathākṛtasaṃketenety aśvavyavacchedamātre pratikṣiptabhedāntare kṛtasaṃketenānaśvatvaṃ śabdena prabodhyate prakāśyate 'naśatvam asya piṇḍasyāstīti | aśvādyo vyavacchedas tadapekṣayā mahiṣādibhyo vyāvṛttayo(r) vyavacchedāntarāṇi |
analyzed: tathābhūta jñāpana artham iti yathā pratipattrā jñātum tad anurodhena tathābhūtasya aśvāt bheda mātrasya tathā akṛta saṃketena iti aśva vyavaccheda mātre pratikṣipta bheda antare kṛta saṃketena an aśva tvam śabdena prabodhyate prakāśyate asya piṇḍasya asti iti aśva ādyaḥ vyavacchedaḥ tad apekṣayā mahiṣa ādibhyaḥ vyāvṛttayoḥ vyavaccheda antarāṇi

original: teṣv anirākāṃkṣaḥ pratipattā | tam iti piṇḍaṃ | apratikṣiptabhedāntareṇāśavyavacchedena yuktaṅ godravyaṃ jñātum icchatīti yāvat | aparityaktāni mahiṣādivyavacchedāntarāṇi yena | tasminn aparityaktabhedāntare | tatraiva vāśvavyavacchede | dharmivācinaṃ śabdaṃ prayuñjate vaktāro 'naśvo 'yam iti | kathaṃ prayuñjata ity āha – tathā prakāśanāyeti |
analyzed: teṣu a nirākāṃkṣaḥ pratipattā tam iti piṇḍam a pratikṣipta bheda antareṇa āśa vyavacchedena yuktaṅ go dravyam jñātum icchati iti yāvat a parityaktāni mahiṣa ādi vyavaccheda antarāṇi yena tasmin a parityakta bheda antare tatra eva vā āśu avyavacchede dharmi vācinam śabdam prayuñjate vaktāraḥ yam iti katham prayuñjate iti āha tathā prakāśanāya iti

original: apratikṣiptabhedāntarasyāśvavyavacchedasya (p.149) prakāśanāya | apratikṣiptabhedāntaram evāśvavyavacchedan tathā prakāśanāyety anye paṭhanti | tadāpy ayam arthaḥ | apratikṣiptabhedāntaran tam evāśvavyavacchedam aśvavyāvṛttirūpaṃ prayuñjate abhidadhaty anaśvo 'yam ity anena dharmivacanena śabdena |
analyzed: prakāśanāya apratikṣipta bheda antarasya aśva vyavacchedasya prakāśanāya apratikṣipta bheda antaram tathā prakāśanāya iti anye paṭhanti tadā api ayam arthaḥ tam eva aśva vyavacchedam aśva vyāvṛtti rūpam prayuñjate abhidadhati an aśvaḥ yam iti anena dharmi vacanena śabdena

original: kim artham (|) tathāprakāśanāyāpratikṣiptabhedāntarasya prakāśanāyeti | yenaiva dharmavācī śabdaḥ pratikṣiptabhedāntaraḥ | ata eva pūrvatreti dharmavācini śabde pratikṣiptam bhedāntaraṃ yeneti | sāmānyenānyapadārthaṃ kṛtvā bhāvapratyayaḥ karttavyaḥ | paścāc chabdavṛtter ity anena sambandhaḥ | anyathā pratikṣiptaṃ bhedāntaratvād iti syāt |
analyzed: kim artham tathā a prakāśanāya a pratikṣipta bheda antarasya prakāśanāya iti yena eva dharma vācī śabdaḥ pratikṣipta bheda antaraḥ atas eva pūrvatra iti dharma vācini śabde pratikṣiptam bheda antaram yena iti sāmānyena anya padārtham kṛtvā bhāva pratyayaḥ karttavyaḥ paścāt śabda vṛtteḥ iti anena sambandhaḥ anyathā pratikṣiptam bheda antara tvāt iti syāt

original: evam anyatrāpy evaṃjātīyeṣu śabdeṣu vyutpattir draṣṭavyā |
analyzed: evam anyatra api evaṃjātīyeṣu śabdeṣu vyutpattiḥ draṣṭavyā

original: bhinnanimittayoḥ śabdayor ekasminn adhikaraṇe vṛttiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ | viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvo vyavacchedyavyavacchedakabhāvaḥ | udāharaṇaṅ gotvam asya śuklam iti | guṇaśabdasyābhidheyavalliṅgavattvena napuṃsakatvaṃ (|) śukla ity anye paṭhanti |
analyzed: bhinna nimittayoḥ śabdayoḥ ekasmin adhikaraṇe vṛttiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyam viśeṣya viśeṣaṇa bhāvaḥ vyavacchedya vyavacchedaka bhāvaḥ udāharaṇam go tvam asya śuklam iti guṇa śabdasya abhidheya vat liṅgavat tvena napuṃsaka tvam śuklaḥ iti anye paṭhanti

original: evaṃ cācakṣate (|) guṇaśabdo hi pratikṣiptabhedāntareṇa guṇamātre varttamāna upātto guṇamātravṛttīnāṃ śuklādiśabdānāṃ pulliṅgatvaṃ | tadvati tu varttamānānām abhidheyavalliṅgatā | evaṃ cānayor dharmamātravṛttyor na sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ nāpi viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāva iti |
analyzed: evam ca ācakṣate guṇa śabdaḥ hi pratikṣipta bheda antareṇa guṇa mātre varttamānaḥ upāttaḥ guṇa mātra vṛttīnām śukla ādi śabdānām pulliṅga tvam tadvati tu varttamānānām abhidheya vat liṅga tā evam ca anayoḥ dharma mātra vṛttyoḥ na sāmānādhikaraṇyam na api viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvaḥ iti

original: kasmān na sāmānādhikaraṇyam ity āha – tanmātretyādi | etat kathayati buddhipratibhāsiny evārthasāmānādhikaraṇyādi | na bāhye svalakṣaṇe tasyāvācyatvāt (|) kevalam adhyavasāyād bāhye 'py ucyate | yadi ca dharmadvayayuktaikadharmipratibhāsinī śabdadvayajanitā buddhir ekārthotpadyata bhavet sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ |
analyzed: kasmāt na sāmānādhikaraṇyam iti āha tanmātra ityādi etat kathayati buddhi pratibhāsini eva artha sāmānādhikaraṇya ādi na bāhye sva lakṣaṇe tasya avācya tvāt kevalam adhyavasāyāt bāhye pi ucyate yadi ca dharma dvaya yukta eka dharmi pratibhāsinī śabda dvaya janitā buddhiḥ ekārthā utpadyata bhavet sāmānādhikaraṇyam

original: iha tu tanmātraviśeṣeṇa pratikṣiptabhedāntareṇa gotvamātraviśeṣaṇoparaktāyā buddhes tadāśrayabhūtāyā iti viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyāśrayabhūtāyā ekatvena dharmyabhedenāpratibhāsanāt | gotvaśuklatvābhyāṃ yuktam ekan dharmiṇaṃ gṛhītvā buddher apratibhāsanād ity arthaḥ |
analyzed: iha tu tad mātra viśeṣeṇa pratikṣipta bheda antareṇa go tva mātra viśeṣaṇa uparaktāyāḥ buddheḥ tad āśraya bhūtāyāḥ iti viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇya āśraya bhūtāyāḥ ekatvena dharmya bhedena apratibhāsanāt go tva śukla tvābhyām yuktam dharmiṇam gṛhītvā buddheḥ apratibhāsanāt iti arthaḥ

original: yad vā tadāśrayabhūtāyā iti tad eva gotvam āśrayabhūtaṃ yasyās tasyā buddhes tanmātraviśeṣeṇa pratikṣiptadharmāntareṇa gotvamātreṇa viṣe(?śe)ṣeṇa saha gopiṇḍasyaikatvenāpratibhāsanāt | tathā hy asya gotvam iti prayoge niṣkṛṣṭarūpaṃ dharmaṃ pratiyatī (p.150) buddhir utpadyate | tato na sāmānādhikaraṇyam iti |
analyzed: yat vā tad āśraya bhūtāyāḥ iti tat eva go tvam āśraya bhūtam yasyāḥ tasyāḥ buddheḥ tanmātra viśeṣeṇa pratikṣipta dharma antareṇa go tva mātreṇa saha go piṇḍasya ekatvena apratibhāsanāt tathā hi asya go tvam iti prayoge niṣkṛṣṭa rūpam dharmam pratiyatī buddhiḥ utpadyate tatas na sāmānādhikaraṇyam iti

original: dharmāntarapratikṣepād eva tadanyeṣu bhedeṣu nirākāṃkṣatvāc ca buddher na viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ |
analyzed: dharma antara pratikṣepāt eva tad anyeṣu bhedeṣu nirākāṃkṣa tvāt ca buddheḥ na viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvaḥ

original: dvitīye tu dharmivāciśabdapakṣe bhavati sāmānādhikaraṇyam viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo vā śuklo gaur iti | sāmānādhikaraṇye kāraṇam āha – tathetyādi. tathā saṃketānusāreṇety apratikṣiptabhedāntare vastuni dharmiśabdasya saṃketānusāreṇa hetunā | ekasmin dharmiṇi yojanaṃ saṃhāraḥ |
analyzed: dvitīye tu dharmi vāci śabda pakṣe bhavati sāmānādhikaraṇyam viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvaḥ vā śuklaḥ gauḥ iti sāmānādhikaraṇye kāraṇam āha tathā ityādi tathā saṃketa anusāreṇa iti apratikṣipta bheda antare vastuni dharmi śabdasya saṃketa anusāreṇa hetunā ekasmin dharmiṇi yojanam saṃhāraḥ

original: vyavacchedahetukā dharmā vyavacchedadharmāḥ saṃhṛtāś ca te sakalavyavacchedadharmāś ceti karmadhārayaḥ | tair dharmaiḥ karaṇabhūtair vibhāgavataḥ | vibhaktānekadharmavato dharmiṇa ekasyeva śabdasandarśanena pradarśanena buddheḥ pratibhāsanāt | anekadharmavantandhdarmiṇam ekam iva sandarśayantī buddhiḥ pratibhāsata iti yāvat |
analyzed: vyavaccheda hetukāḥ dharmāḥ vyavaccheda dharmāḥ saṃhṛtāḥ ca te sakala vyavaccheda dharmāḥ ca iti karmadhārayaḥ taiḥ dharmaiḥ karaṇa bhūtaiḥ vibhāgavataḥ vibhakta aneka dharmavataḥ dharmiṇaḥ ekasya iva śabda sandarśanena pradarśanena buddheḥ pratibhāsanāt aneka dharmavantam dharmiṇam ekam iva sandarśayantī buddhiḥ pratibhāsate iti yāvat

original: na tu buddhipratibhāsasandarśito dharmī vastuta ekaḥ (|) vikalpanirmitasya dharmadharmivibhāgasyālīkatvāt | ekasyaivety api paṭhanti | tatrāpi pratipattradhyavasāyavaśad eva yuktam iti boddhavyaṃ |
analyzed: na tu buddhi pratibhāsa sandarśitaḥ dharmī vastutas ekaḥ vikalpa nirmitasya dharma dharmi vibhāgasya alīka tvāt ekasya eva iti api paṭhanti tatra api eva yuktam iti boddhavyam

original: tataḥ siddhaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ (|) yataś ca bhedāntarāpratikṣepeṇa dharmmiśabdaḥ pravṛttas tata eva tajjanitāyā buddher apratikṣiptabhedāntarāpekṣatvād bhavati viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo yad gauḥ śuklo nīlo veti | caśabdaś ca pūrvavad atītahetvapekṣaḥ ||
analyzed: tatas siddham sāmānādhikaraṇyam yatas ca bheda antara apratikṣepeṇa dharmmi śabdaḥ pravṛttaḥ tatas eva tad janitāyāḥ buddheḥ a pratikṣipta bheda antara apekṣa tvāt bhavati viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvaḥ yat gauḥ śuklaḥ nīlaḥ vā iti caśabdaḥ ca pūrvavat atīta hetu apekṣaḥ

original: idam eva vyāpakaṃ sarvavyavahārasya nāparasparaparikalpitaṃ sāmānyaguṇādikāntasya pramāṇabādhitatvād ity āha – bhedo 'yam evetyādi | dravyabhāvābhidhāyinoḥ śabdayor ayam eva bhedo dharmāntarapratikṣepāpratikṣepalakṣaṇaḥ | sarvatreti | sāmānyasāmānyavati | guṇaguṇavati | kriyākriyāvati | sarvasmin viṣaye dharmivacano dravyābhidhāryā |
analyzed: idam eva vyāpakam sarva vyavahārasya na a paraspara parikalpitam sāmānya guṇa ādi kāntasya pramāṇa bādhita tvāt iti āha bhedaḥ yam eva ityādi dravya bhāva abhidhāyinoḥ śabdayoḥ ayam eva bhedaḥ dharma antara pratikṣepa a pratikṣepa lakṣaṇaḥ sarvatra iti sāmānya sāmānyavati guṇa guṇavati kriyā akriyāvati sarvasmin viṣaye dharmi vacanaḥ dravya abhidhāryā abhidhāryā abhidhāryā abhidhāryā abhidhāryā abhidhāryā abhidhāryā abhidhāryā abhidhāryā ab

original: dharmavacano bhāvābhidhāyī | yata evaṃ tena kāraṇena na tayor dravyabhāvaśabdayor vācye viśeṣaḥ paramārthataḥ kaścanāsti |
analyzed: dharma vacanaḥ bhāva abhidhāyī yatas evam tena kāraṇena na tayoḥ dravya bhāva śabdayoḥ vācye viśeṣaḥ paramārthataḥ kaścana asti

original: tadvyācaṣṭe | tasmād ityādi | niścayapratyayaviṣayatvena karaṇena | na kaścid viśeṣaḥ | tathā hi yathā gotvam ity ukte tatraivāgovyavacchede niścayas tathā gaur ity ukte yady apy apratikṣiptabhedāntarasyāgovyavacchinnasyābhidhānan tathāpy agovyavacchedamātre (p.151) niścayo 'nyeṣān tu bhedānām apratikṣepamātraṃ |
analyzed: tat vyācaṣṭe tasmāt ityādi niścaya pratyaya viṣaya tvena karaṇena na kaścid viśeṣaḥ tathā hi yathā go tvam iti ukte tatra eva a go vyavacchede niścayaḥ tathā gauḥ iti ukte yadi api a pratikṣipta bheda antarasya a go vyavacchinnasya abhidhānan tathā api a go vyavaccheda mātre niścayaḥ nyeṣām tu bhedānām a pratikṣepa mātram

original: sa eva ca śabdārtho yatra śābdo niścayo bhavatīti nāsti bhāvadravyābhidhāyiṇoḥ śabdayor vācye viśeṣo bhedāntarapratikṣepāpratikṣepamātran tu bhidyate | tad evāha – ekas tam evetyādi | eka iti dharmaśabdas tam ity agovyavacchinnaṃ | pratikṣiptaṃ bhedāntaraṃ yena dharmaśabdena sa tathoktaḥ |
analyzed: saḥ eva ca śabda arthaḥ yatra śābdaḥ niścayaḥ bhavati iti nā asti bhāva dravya abhidhāyiṇoḥ śabdayoḥ vācye viśeṣaḥ tu bhidyate tat eva āha ekaḥ tam eva ityādi ekaḥ iti dharma śabdaḥ tam iti ago vyavacchinnam pratikṣiptam bheda antaram yena dharma śabdena sa tathā uktaḥ

original: anya iti dharmiśabdo 'pratikṣepeṇa tam eva piṇḍaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyena gamyatīti nāsti dravyaniścayam prati bhedaḥ pratikṣepāpratikṣepamātran tu bhidyate | evaṃ gamanan devadattasya gacchati devadatta iti na kaścana bheda ity anyatrāpy evaṃ yojyaṃ || (63, 64 ||)
analyzed: anyaḥ iti pratikṣepeṇa tam eva piṇḍam sāmānādhikaraṇyena gamyati iti na asti dravya niścayam prati bhedaḥ tu bhidyate evam devadattasya gacchati devadattaḥ iti na kaścana bhedaḥ iti anyatra api evam yojyam 63 63

original: yāpi jātiguṇakriyāsambandhabhedena catuṣṭhayī śabdānāṃ vṛttiḥ sāpy anenaiva vastugatadharmabhedena saṅgṛhītety āha – jijñāpayiṣur ityādi | jñāpayitum icchurathantam bhedāntarapratikṣepāpratikṣepalakṣaṇaṃ | taddhitena taddhitapratyayāntena | kṛtāpi vā | kṛtsaṃjñakapratyayāntena vā |
analyzed: yā api jāti guṇa kriyā sambandha bhedena catuṣṭhayī śabdānām vṛttiḥ sā api anena eva vastu gata dharma bhedena saṅgṛhītā iti āha jijñāpayiṣuḥ ityādi jñāpayitum bheda antara pratikṣepa apratikṣepa lakṣaṇam taddhitena taddhita pratyaya antena kṛtā api vā kṛt saṃjñaka pratyaya antena vā

original: anyena vā kṛttaddhitavyatiriktena tiṅantenāvyutpannena vā śabdena śuklādinā yadi brūyāt | tato bhedāntarapratikṣepāpratikṣepalakṣaṇād viśeṣād aparo bhedo nāsti |
analyzed: anyena vā kṛt taddhita vyatiriktena tiṅ antena avyutpannena vā śabdena śukla ādinā yadi brūyāt tatas bheda antara pratikṣepa apratikṣepa lakṣaṇāt viśeṣāt aparaḥ bhedaḥ nā asti

original: tad vyācaṣṭe | etāvantam ityādinā | etāvantam iti pratikṣiptabhedāntaralakṣaṇaṃ | kṛtāpi vā | darśayed iti sambandhaḥ |
analyzed: tat vyācaṣṭe etāvantam ityādinā etāvantam iti pratikṣipta bheda antara lakṣaṇam kṛtā api vā darśayet iti sambandhaḥ

original: yadā vādhiśrayaṇādikriyāyāṃ karttṛsthāyām pacir varttate | tatraiva ca ghañpratyayas tadā pāakatvaśabdena kriyākārakayoḥ sambandhaḥ samavāyo 'bhidhīyata iti pācakatvaśabdena samānārthaḥ pākaśabdaḥ | dvāv apy etau pratikṣiptabhedāntaram apācakavyavacchhinnam arthaṃ pratipādayataḥ |
analyzed: yadā vā adhiśrayaṇa ādi kriyāyām karttṛ sthāyām paciḥ varttate tatra eva ca ghañ pratyayaḥ tadā kriyā kārakayoḥ sambandhaḥ samavāyaḥ bhidhīyate iti pācaka tva śabdena samāna arthaḥ pāka śabdaḥ dvau api etau pratikṣipta bheda antaram a pācaka vyavacchinnam artham pratipādayataḥ

original: yadā tu karmasthaiva kriyā vikĺttiḥ pacer arthas tadā pācakatvaśabdasya kathaṃ sambandhābhidhāyitvaṃ | pācakatvapākayor bhinnārthatvāt | anyena vā kṛttaddhitavyatiriktena tiṅādinā | tathābhūtajñāpanāya | pratikṣiptabhedāntarajñāpanāya (p.152) svayaṃ kṛtena samayena darśayed iti sambandhaḥ | yathā devadattena śayyate paṭasya śuklatvam iti |
analyzed: yadā tu karma sthā eva kriyā vikĺttiḥ paceḥ arthaḥ tadā pācaka tva śabdasya katham sambandha abhidhāyi tvam pācaka tva pākayoḥ bhinna artha tvāt anyena vā kṛt taddhita vyatiriktena tiṅ ādinā tathābhūta jñāpanāya pratikṣipta bheda antara jñāpanāya svayam kṛtena samayena darśayet iti sambandhaḥ yathā devadattena śayyate paṭasya śukla tvam iti

original: atrāpi śāyakaśabdasya ya evārthaḥ sa eva pratikṣiptabhedāntaraḥ | śayyata ity asyāpi | tathā śuklaḥ paṭa iti ya evācuklavyavacchinno pratikṣiptabhedāntaro 'rthaḥ sa eva pratikṣiptabhedāntaraḥ paṭasya śukla ity asyāpi |
analyzed: atra api śāyaka śabdasya yaḥ eva arthaḥ saḥ eva pratikṣipta bheda antaraḥ śayyate iti asya api tathā śuklaḥ paṭaḥ iti yaḥ eva a cukla vyavacchinnaḥ pratikṣipta bheda antaraḥ rthaḥ saḥ eva pratikṣipta bheda antaraḥ paṭasya śuklaḥ iti asya api

original: tathābhichānamātreṇeti pratikṣiptāpratikṣiptabhedāntarasyaikadharmigatasya vyavacchedasyābhidhānamātreṇa tad eva vastvarthāntaram eva paramārthato dharmadharmirūpeṇa vibhaktam eva | na punar bhavatīti sambandhaḥ | kiṅ kāraṇaṃ (|) tathābhūtasyaiva pratikṣiptāpratikṣiptabhedāntarasyaivaikasya jñāpanāya dharmadharmiśabdasya kṛtasaṃketatvāt |
analyzed: tathā abhichāna mātreṇa iti pratikṣipta a pratikṣipta bheda antarasya eka dharmi gatasya vyavacchedasya abhidhāna mātreṇa tat eva vastu artha antaram eva paramārthataḥ dharma dharmi rūpeṇa vibhaktam eva na punar bhavati iti sambandhaḥ kim kāraṇam tathābhūtasya eva pratikṣipta a pratikṣipta bheda antarasya eva ekasya jñāpanāya dharma dharmi śabdasya kṛta saṃketa tvāt

original: yad vā tathābhidhānamātreṇeti | arthāntarabhūtadharmābhidhānamātreṇa taddharmasvarūpam paramārthato 'rthāntaram eva bhavati | tathābhūtasyaiva bhedāntaranirapekṣasyaiva tasyaikavyāvṛttasya jñāpanāya dharmaśabdasya kṛtasaṃketatvāt ||
analyzed: yat vā tathā abhidhāna mātreṇa iti artha antara bhūta dharma abhidhāna mātreṇa tat dharma svarūpam paramārthataḥ rtha antaram eva bhavati tathābhūtasya eva bheda antara nirapekṣasya eva tasya eka vyāvṛttasya jñāpanāya dharma śabdasya kṛta saṃketa tvāt

original: nanu cetyādi paraḥ | sambandha ucyata iti pākakriyāyāḥ pācakasya ca karttuḥ sambandhaḥ samavāyalakṣaṇaḥ | tathā hi kṛdantād bhāvapratyayaḥ sambandhasyābhidhāyako 'dṛṣṭo yathāha – samāsakṛttaddhiteṣu sambandhābhidhānam iti | kṛdantaś ca pācakaśabdaḥ (|) na pāka eva kriyātmakaḥ pācakatvaśabdenocyate |
analyzed: nanu ca ityādi paraḥ sambandhaḥ ucyate iti pāka kriyāyāḥ pācakasya ca karttuḥ sambandhaḥ samavāya lakṣaṇaḥ tathā hi kṛt antāt bhāva pratyayaḥ sambandhasya abhidhāyakaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ yathā āha samāsa kṛt taddhiteṣu sambandha abhidhānam iti kṛt antaḥ ca pācaka śabdaḥ na pākaḥ eva kriyā ātmakaḥ pācaka tva śabdena ucyate

original: etad uktam bhavati (|) anyaiva karttṛvyatiriktā kriyānyaś ca tayoś ca sambandho 'nya eva | tataś ca karttṛsthakriyābhidhāne saty api pacater na pākapācakatvaśabdayos tulyo 'rtha iti | na vai pākenetyādinā pariharati |
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati anyā eva karttṛ vyatiriktā kriyā anyaḥ ca tayoḥ ca sambandhaḥ nyaḥ eva tatas ca karttṛ stha kriyā abhidhāne sati api pacateḥ na pāka pācaka tva śabdayoḥ tulyaḥ rthaḥ iti na vai pākena ityādinā pariharati

original: pākena kartṛsthena vastubhūtena vyāpāreṇa yukto 'nya eva pākakriyā vyatiriktaḥ pācako nāma karttābhidhīyate pācakaśabdena (|) yādṛśo varṇṇyate vaiśeṣikādibhiḥ kriyā vyatiriktaḥ svatantraḥ kartā yatra kriyākārakasambandho vastubhūtaḥ syāt | tasya svatantrasya kartuḥ kriyāvyatiriktasya niṣetsyamānatvāt |
analyzed: pākena kartṛ sthena vastu bhūtena vyāpāreṇa yuktaḥ nyaḥ eva pāka kriyāḥ vyatiriktaḥ pācakaḥ nāma karttā abhidhīyate pācaka śabdena yādṛśaḥ varṇṇyate vaiśeṣika ādibhiḥ kriyāḥ vyatiriktaḥ svatantraḥ kartā yatra kriyā kāraka sambandhaḥ vastu bhūtaḥ syāt tasya svatantrasya kartuḥ kriyā vyatiriktasya niṣetsyamāna tvāt

original: na ced vyatiriktā kriyā karttā vā kutas sambandhaḥ yasya bhāvapratyayenābhidhānam iti bhāvaḥ | yat punar asyeti pācakaśabdasyāsyābhidheyam apācake vyavacchinnam apratikṣiptabhedāntaraṃ vastumātran tad eva pācakaśabdābhidheyaṃ (p.153) pācakatvenāpy abhidhīyata ity adhyāhāryaḥ | tasyaiva pratikṣiptabhedāntarasyābhidhānāt |
analyzed: na ced vyatiriktā kriyā karttā vā kutas sambandhaḥ yasya bhāva pratyayena abhidhānam iti bhāvaḥ yat punar asya iti pācaka śabdasya asya abhidheyam apācake vyavacchinnam a pratikṣipta bheda antaram tat eva pācaka śabda abhidheyam pācaka tvena api abhidhīyate iti adhyāhāryaḥ tasya eva pratikṣipta bheda antarasya abhidhānāt

original: na tu sambandho 'bhidhīyate | tasyāsattvāt | tad eva yathoktaṃ pācakaśabdābhidheyaṃ pākaśabdenāpīty apiśabdāt |
analyzed: na tu sambandhaḥ bhidhīyate tasya asattvāt tat eva yathā uktam pācaka śabda abhidheyam pāka śabdena api iti apiśabdāt

original: aparaṃ vyākhyānaṃ | na vai pākeneti pākaśabdenānyāpohavādipakṣe anya eva vyatiriktaḥ kriyāśrayabhūtaḥ pācako 'bhidhīyate | yādṛśo varṇṇyate pareṇa (|) yaḥ kriyākārakasambandhasyāśrayaḥ syāt | tasyāsiddhatvāt (|) kin tv apācakavyāvṛttir bhedāntarapratikṣepeṇābhidhīyate | tad evāha – yat punar ityādi |
analyzed: aparam vyākhyānam na vai pākena iti pāka śabdena anya apoha vādi pakṣe anyaḥ eva vyatiriktaḥ kriyā āśraya bhūtaḥ pācakaḥ abhidhīyate yādṛśaḥ varṇṇyate pareṇa yaḥ kriyā kāraka sambandhasya āśrayaḥ syāt tasya asiddha tvāt kin tu a pācaka vyāvṛttiḥ bheda antara pratikṣepeṇa abhidhīyate tat eva āha yat punar ityādi

original: yad ity apācakavyāvṛttilakṣaṇaṃ pratikṣiptabhedāntaram abhidheyaṃ | asyeti pākaśabdasyānantaram eva karśitaṃ tad eva pākaśabdābhidheyam pācakatvaśabdenāpy abhidhīyate (|) na sambandhaḥ | tasyāsiddhatvāt | apratiṣṭhitair avastubalāyātair ata eva mithyāvikalpāḥ || (65 ||)
analyzed: yat iti apācaka vyāvṛtti lakṣaṇam pratikṣipta bheda antaram abhidheyam asya iti pāka śabdasya anantaram eva karśitam tat eva pāka śabda abhidheyam pācaka tva śabdena api abhidhīyate na sambandhaḥ tasya asiddha tvāt apratiṣṭhitaiḥ avastu bala āyātaiḥ atas eva mithyā vikalpāḥ

original: katham punar gamyate kriyā vyatiriktā nāsti tatsamavāyo vety ata āha – yathetyādi | tatsamavāyo veti kriyākārakasamavāyaḥ | yataś ca vyāvṛttivyāvṛttimator abhedas tena kāraṇenānyāpohaviṣayo jātimān śabdair abhidhīyata iti (|) tadvatpakṣas tatra yo doṣaḥ so 'nyāpohe 'pi syād iti tadvatpakṣopavarṇṇṇanaṃ pratyākhyātaṃ |
analyzed: katham punar gamyate kriyā vyatiriktā na asti tad samavāyaḥ vā iti atas āha yathā ityādi tad samavāyaḥ vā iti kriyā kāraka samavāyaḥ yatas ca vyāvṛtti vyāvṛttimatoḥ abhedaḥ tena kāraṇena anya apoha viṣayaḥ jātimān śabdaiḥ abhidhīyate iti tadvat pakṣaḥ tatra yaḥ doṣaḥ saḥ syāt iti tadvat pakṣa upavarṇṇanam pratyākhyātam

original: yasmāt pṛthaktve hi jātitadvator abhyupagamyamāne syāt tadvatpakṣodito doṣaḥ |
analyzed: yasmāt pṛthaktve hi jāti tadvatoḥ abhyupagamyamāne syāt tadvat pakṣa uditaḥ doṣaḥ

original: tadviśiṣṭasyety anyāpohaviśiṣṭasyārthasya śabdair abhidhānāt tadvatpakṣodita iti tadvatpakṣe ya uktaḥ | yathā kula sāmānyam abhidhāya tadvati varttamānaḥ śabdo 'svatantraḥ syāt tataś ca śabdapravṛttinimittabhūtena sāmānyena vaśīkṛtasya śabdasya vyaktigataparasparabhedānākṣepāt taiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na syāt |
analyzed: tad viśiṣṭasya iti anya apoha viśiṣṭasya arthasya śabdaiḥ abhidhānāt tadvat pakṣa uditaḥ iti tadvat pakṣe yaḥ uktaḥ yathā sāmānyam abhidhāya tadvati varttamānaḥ śabdaḥ svatantraḥ syāt tatas ca śabda pravṛtti nimitta bhūtena sāmānyena vaśīkṛtasya śabdasya vyakti gata paraspara bheda anākṣepāt taiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyam na syāt

original: upacaritā ca tadvati śabdapravṛttir ityādiko doṣa ity evaṃ vyāvṛttim abhidhāya tadvati varttamāno 'svatantro dhvanir iti sarvaḥ prasaṅgaḥ syāt | tad api tadvatpakṣopavarṇṇanaṃ | aneneti vyāvṛttivyāvṛttimator ananyatvena prativyūḍhaṃ pratyākhyātaṃ | yasmāt tatra hi tadvatpakṣe |
analyzed: upacaritā ca tadvati śabda pravṛttiḥ iti ādikaḥ doṣaḥ iti evam vyāvṛttim abhidhāya tadvati svatantraḥ dhvaniḥ iti sarvaḥ prasaṅgaḥ syāt tat api tadvat pakṣa upavarṇṇanam anena iti vyāvṛtti vyāvṛttimatoḥ ananyatvena prativyūḍham pratyākhyātam yasmāt tatra hi tadvat pakṣe

original: arthāntaram upādāyeti vastubhūtaṃ sāmānyam upādāyānyatrārthāntare tadvati | sākṣāt sāmānyavato 'nabhidhānād asvātantryaṃ | ādiśabdād asamānādhikaraṇyopacāradoṣaparigrahaḥ |
analyzed: artha antaram upādāya iti vastu bhūtam sāmānyam upādāya anyatra artha antare tadvati sākṣāt sāmānyavataḥ asvātantryam ādi śabdāt asamānādhikaraṇya upacāra doṣa parigrahaḥ

original: anyāpohapakṣe tu vyāvṛttivyāvṛttimator aikyān nārthāntaram upādāyārthāntare śabdapravṛttis (p.154) tato nāsty asvātantrā(?ntryā)didoṣa ity āha – na cetyādi | anyasmād vastunoryā vyāvṛttiḥ sā vyāvṛttān nānyā | dvayor dharmadharmivācinoḥ śabdayor ekasya vyāvṛttibhedasyābhidhānād ity uktam anantaram eva |
analyzed: anya apoha pakṣe tu vyāvṛtti vyāvṛttimatoḥ aikyāt na artha antaram upādāya artha antare śabda pravṛttiḥ tatas na asti asvātantra antrya ādi doṣaḥ iti āha na ca ityādi anyasmāt vastunoḥ yā vyāvṛttiḥ sā vyāvṛttāt na anyā dvayoḥ dharma dharmi vācinoḥ śabdayoḥ ekasya vyāvṛtti bhedasya abhidhānāt iti uktam anantaram eva

original: katham ityādi paraḥ | idānīm iti vyāvṛttitadvator aikye | ekasya vyāvṛttasya svalakṣaṇasyānanugamāt | arthāntarāsaṃsargāt | kathan tasya svalakṣaṇasyātmabhūtā vyāvṛttiḥ svalakṣaṇavad ananvayinī sāmānyaṃ syāt | naiva | dṛṣṭā ca sāmānyaṃ |
analyzed: katham ityādi paraḥ idānīm iti vyāvṛtti tadvatoḥ aikye ekasya vyāvṛttasya sva lakṣaṇasya ananugamāt artha antara asaṃsargāt kathan tasya sva lakṣaṇasya ātma bhūtā vyāvṛttiḥ sva lakṣaṇa vat ananvayinī sāmānyam syāt nā eva dṛṣṭā ca sāmānyam

original: tadbuddhāv ityādinā siddhāntavādī | sāmānyabuddhau vikalpakāyāṃ tathaikākāreṇa pratibhāsanād ekākāra eva vyāvartyate 'neneti vyāvṛttiḥ | sāmānyam ucyate | etad āha (|) na vyāvṛtteṣu svalakṣaṇeṣv ātmabhūtā vyāvṛttir ekā sāmānyaṃ kevalaṃ vyāvṛttasvalakṣaṇānubhavottarakālabhāvī vikalpaḥ prakṛtyā |
analyzed: tad buddhau ityādinā siddhānta vādī sāmānya buddhau vikalpakāyām tathā eka ākāreṇa pratibhāsanāt eka ākāraḥ eva vyāvartyate nena iti vyāvṛttiḥ sāmānyam ucyate etat āha na vyāvṛtteṣu sva lakṣaṇeṣu ātma bhūtā vyāvṛttiḥ ekā sāmānyam kevalam vyāvṛtta sva lakṣaṇa anubhava uttara kāla bhāvī vikalpaḥ prakṛtyā

original: ekakāryeṣu bhāveṣv ekam ākāram ādarśayann ivotpadyate | tadvikalpavaśāt sāmānyam āsthīyate (|) niḥsāmānyeṣv apy anena ca sākṣāc chabdādiviṣayo darśitaḥ |
analyzed: eka kāryeṣu bhāveṣu ekam ākāram ādarśayan iva utpadyate tad vikalpa vaśāt sāmānyam āsthīyate niḥsāmānyeṣu api anena ca sākṣāt śabda ādi viṣayaḥ darśitaḥ

original: etad eva sphuṭayann āha – na vai kiṃcid ityādi | vastubhūtam ity abhiprāyaḥ | kathan tarhi sāmānyasāmānādhikaraṇyādivyavahāra ity āha – śabdetyādi | śabda āśrayaḥ sahakārikāraṇatvena yasyāḥ sā vikalpikā buddhir anādivāsanāsāmarthyāt | dharmān asaṃsṛṣṭān api saṃsṛjantī ekākārān iva kurvāṇā jāyate | tasyā buddher ekākārapratibhāsavaśena sāmānyaṃ |
analyzed: etat eva sphuṭayan āha na vai kiṃcid ityādi vastu bhūtam iti abhiprāyaḥ kathan tarhi sāmānya sāmānādhikaraṇya ādi vyavahāraḥ iti āha śabda ityādi śabdaḥ āśrayaḥ sahakāri kāraṇa tvena yasyāḥ sā vikalpikā buddhiḥ anādi vāsanā sāmarthyāt dharmān asaṃsṛṣṭān api saṃsṛjantī eka ākārān iva kurvāṇā jāyate tasyāḥ buddheḥ eka ākāra pratibhāsa vaśena sāmānyam api saṃsṛjantī tasyāḥ buddheḥ eka ākāra pratibhāsa vaśena sāmāny

original: dharmadvayayuktaikadharmipratibhāsavaśena sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ca vyavasthāpyate | ayaṃ ca sāmānyādivyavahāro 'sadvyāpi vyavasthāpyate | katham asadartha ity āha – arthānām ityādi | svalakṣaṇānāṃ saṃsargābhāvāt sāmānyavyavahāro 'sadarthaḥ | ekasya ca svalakṣaṇasya bhedābhāvāt sāmānādhikaraṇyavyavahāro 'sadarthaḥ |
analyzed: dharma dvaya yukta eka dharmi pratibhāsa vaśena sāmānādhikaraṇyam ca vyavasthāpyate ayam ca sāmānya ādi vyavahāraḥ sat vyāpi vyavasthāpyate katham asat arthaḥ iti āha arthānām ityādi sva lakṣaṇānām saṃsarga abhāvāt sāmānya vyavahāraḥ sat arthaḥ ekasya ca sva lakṣaṇasya bheda abhāvāt sāmānādhikaraṇya vyavahāraḥ sat arthaḥ

original: nanu virūpatayāyaṃ sarvavyavahāraḥ pravṛtta iti katham anyāpohaviṣaya ity ata āha – tasya sarvasya sāmānyādivyavahārasyārthāḥ samāśraya ity anena sambandhaḥ | tatkāryan tacchakāraṇam (p.155) anurūpam yeṣān teṣām bhāvas tayā | karaṇabhūtayā |
analyzed: nanu virūpa tayā ayam sarva vyavahāraḥ pravṛttaḥ iti katham anya apoha viṣayaḥ iti atas āha tasya sarvasya sāmānya ādi vyavahārasya arthāḥ samāśrayaḥ iti anena sambandhaḥ anurūpam yeṣām teṣām bhāvaḥ tayā karaṇa bhūtayā

original: anyebhya ity atatkāryakāraṇebhyo bhidyamānā arthāḥ sarvasya sāmānyādivyavahārasyāśrayo bhavanty ataḥ kāraṇād anyāpohaviṣaya uktaḥ (|) na tv anyāpohas tatra pratibhāsate bāhyasyaivaikākārasya vidhirūpatayā pratibhāsanāt |
analyzed: anyebhyaḥ iti a tad kārya kāraṇebhyaḥ bhidyamānāḥ arthāḥ sarvasya sāmānya ādi vyavahārasya āśrayaḥ bhavanti atas kāraṇāt anya apoha viṣayaḥ uktaḥ na tu anya apohaḥ tatra pratibhāsate bāhyasya eva eka ākārasya vidhi rūpa tayā pratibhāsanāt
