original: yasmāc ca niścayaprayuktaḥ puruṣam aniṣṭaparihāreṇāniṣṭād vyāvṛtte svalakṣaṇe pravarttayat yato 'pi kāraṇād anyāpohaviṣaya ukto na tu pratibhāsāpekṣo vidheḥ pratibhāsanāt |
analyzed: yasmāt ca niścaya prayuktaḥ puruṣam aniṣṭa parihāreṇa aniṣṭāt vyāvṛtte sva lakṣaṇe pravarttayat yatas kāraṇāt anya apoha viṣayaḥ uktaḥ na tu pratibhāsa apekṣaḥ vidheḥ pratibhāsanāt

original: tena yad ucyate bhaṭṭodyotakārābhyāṃ (|)1* gośabdasyārthaḥ kim bhāvothābhāvaḥ | yadi bhāvo kiṃ gaur athāgauḥ | yadi gaur nāsti vivādaḥ | athāgaur gośabdasyāgaur artha iti atiśabdakauśalaṃ | athābhāvas tad ayuktaṃ | na hi gośabdaśravaṇād abhāve preṣyasaṃpratipattiḥ |
analyzed: tena yat ucyate bhaṭṭa udyota kārābhyām go śabdasya arthaḥ kim yadi gauḥ atha agauḥ yadi gauḥ na asti vivādaḥ atha agauḥ go śabdasya agauḥ arthaḥ iti ati śabda kauśalam atha abhāvaḥ tat ayuktam na hi go śabda śravaṇāt abhāve preṣya saṃpratipattiḥ

original: śabdārthaś ca pratipattyā pratīyate na ca gośabdād abhāvaṃ kaścit pratipadyate tathāgaur na bhavatīty ayam apohaḥ kiṃ goviṣayo 'thāgoviṣayaḥ | yadi goviṣayaḥ kathaṃ gor gavy evābhāvaḥ athāgoviṣayaḥ (|) katham anyaviṣayād apohād anyatra pratipattiḥ | na hi khadirecchidyamāne palāśecchidā bhavati | athā gaur gavi pratiṣedho 'gaur na bhavatīti |
analyzed: śabda arthaḥ ca pratipattyā pratīyate na ca go śabdāt abhāvam kaścid pratipadyate tathā agauḥ na bhavati iti ayam apohaḥ kim go viṣayaḥ yadi go viṣayaḥ katham goḥ gavi eva abhāvaḥ atha a go viṣayaḥ katham anya viṣayāt apohāt anyatra pratipattiḥ na hi khadira icchidyamāne palāśa icchidā bhavati athā gauḥ gavi pratiṣedhaḥ gauḥ na bhavati iti

original: kena gaur agotvaṃ prasaktaṃ yat pratiṣidhyata iti (|)
analyzed: kena gauḥ a go tvam prasaktam yat pratiṣidhyate iti

apāstaṃ (|) goviṣayatvād gośabdasya kevalaṃ kalpitaviṣayatvād vivādaḥ | yathā vā gopratiṣedho 'saty api samārope tathoktaṃ prāg iti yat kiñcid etat |
analyzed: apāstam go viṣaya tvāt go śabdasya kevalam kalpita viṣaya tvāt vivādaḥ yathā vā sati api samārope tathā uktam prāk iti yat kiñcid etat

original: tasmāt sthitam etad vidhir eva śabdārtha iti ||
analyzed: tasmāt sthitam etat vidhiḥ eva śabda arthaḥ iti

original: etad eva darśayann āha – tatretyādi | anapekṣitaṃ svarūpeṇa bāhyatattvaṃ yena vikalpabuddhipratibhāsinā dharmiṇā sa tathoktaḥ | buddhipratibhāsavaśād eko 'nekavyāvṛtta iti |anekasmād vyāvṛttasyaikasya dharmiṇaḥ sandarśanena buddheḥ pratibhāsanāt | tadvaśenaiko dharmī anekavyāvṛtto vyavasthāpyate |
analyzed: etat eva darśayan āha tatra ityādi anapekṣitam sva rūpeṇa bāhya tattvam yena vikalpa buddhi pratibhāsinā dharmiṇā sa tathā uktaḥ buddhi pratibhāsa vaśāt ekaḥ neka vyāvṛttaḥ iti anekasmāt vyāvṛttasya ekasya dharmiṇaḥ sandarśanena buddheḥ pratibhāsanāt tad vaśena ekaḥ dharmī aneka vyāvṛttaḥ vyavasthāpyate

original: yaś cānekasmād vyāvṛttas tasmāt tatra vyāvṛttayo dharmabhedāḥ kalpyanta iti bhāvaḥ | sa eva bhūto dharmī śabdair viṣayīkriyate | tathābhūtavikalpapratibhāsajananāya vaktṛbhiḥ śabdasyoccāraṇāt | yataś cānyavyāvṛtto vikalpapratibhāsaḥ śabdair viṣayīkriyate | tato vidhiviṣayatvaṃ siddham iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: yaḥ ca anekasmāt vyāvṛttaḥ tasmāt tatra vyāvṛttayaḥ dharma bhedāḥ kalpyante iti bhāvaḥ saḥ eva bhūtaḥ dharmī śabdaiḥ viṣayīkriyate tathābhūta vikalpa pratibhāsa jananāya vaktṛbhiḥ śabdasya uccāraṇāt yatas ca anya vyāvṛttaḥ vikalpa pratibhāsaḥ śabdaiḥ viṣayīkriyate tatas vidhi viṣaya tvam siddham iti bhāvaḥ

original: (p.156) na kevalaṃ śabdair vikalpair api viṣayīkriyata ity āha – tadanubhavetyādi | tasya tasya svalakṣaṇasyānubhavas tadanubhavas tenāhitā vāsanā śaktis tasyāḥ prabodhaḥ kāryotpādānugaṇyantato janma yeṣāṃ vikalpānāntair viṣayīkriyata iti sambandhaḥ | ki viśiṣṭair adhyavasitatadbhāvārthaḥ |
analyzed: na kevalam śabdaiḥ vikalpaiḥ api viṣayīkriyate iti āha tad anubhava ityādi tasya tasya sva lakṣaṇasya anubhavaḥ tad anubhavaḥ tena āhitā vāsanā śaktiḥ tasyāḥ prabodhaḥ janma yeṣām vikalpān ānāntaiḥ viṣayīkriyate iti sambandhaḥ ki viśiṣṭaiḥ adhyavasita tad bhāva arthaḥ

original: adhyavasitas tadbhāvo bāhyabhāvo yasmin vikalpapratibhāse sodhyasavitatadbhāva evaṃ bhūto 'rtho viṣayo yeṣām vikalpānān te tathā | dṛśyavikalpāv ekīkṛtya pravṛtter iti yāvat |
analyzed: adhyavasitaḥ tad bhāvaḥ bāhya bhāvaḥ yasmin vikalpa pratibhāse evam bhūtaḥ rthaḥ viṣayaḥ yeṣām te tathā dṛśya vikalpau ekīkṛtya pravṛtteḥ iti yāvat

original: adhyavasitatadbhāvārtha iti pāṭhāntaran tadādhyavasitatadbhāvaś cāsāv arthaś ceti karmadhārayaḥ | eko 'py anekavyāvṛtto 'dhyavasitatadbhāvārtha iti sambandhaḥ | tasmād buddhipratibhāsavaśāt | sāmānyādivyavahāraḥ | tatraiva ca buddhipratibhāse 'yam iti bhedāntarapratikṣepāpratikṣepalakṣaṇe | vyavahriyata iti vyavahāraḥ karmasādhanaḥ |
analyzed: adhyavasita tad bhāva arthaḥ iti tadā adhyavasita tad bhāvaḥ ca asau arthaḥ ca iti karmadhārayaḥ ekaḥ pi aneka vyāvṛttaḥ dhyavasita tad bhāva arthaḥ iti sambandhaḥ tasmāt buddhi pratibhāsa vaśāt sāmānya ādi vyavahāraḥ tatra eva ca buddhi pratibhāse yam iti bheda antara pratikṣepa apratikṣepa lakṣaṇe vyavahriyate iti vyavahāraḥ karma sādhanaḥ

original: dharmadharmiṇāv eva vyavahāraḥ |

original: na punar vāstavād eva dharmadharmiṇor vyatirekāt ṣaṣṭhīvastubhedād dravyatvādīnāṃ dharmāṇāṃ paramārthata eva bhedād bahuvacanam iti | kuta etat (|) tathetyādi prativacanaṃ | tathā vyavahārāyogād (p.159) iti | vyavahāraviṣayayor dharmadharmiṇor vāstave vyatireke | dharmāṇāṃ ca parasparaṃ paraparamārthato bhede sāmānyādivyavahārāyogāt |(| 68 ||)

original: bhede tattvarūpatve ceti pakṣadvaye 'pi doṣodbhāvanārtham anyathā pareṇa vyatirekavastubhedād iti bhedapakṣe 'valambite tattvapakṣopanyāso na prakaraṇānurūpaḥ syāt | tatsambaddha iti sāmānyatadvatoḥ sambandhaḥ | śabdānām vā yathāvastu pravṛttāv abhyupagamyamānāyāṃ sāmānyādayo yujyante | etac cāntaram eva vakṣyāmaḥ |

original: na hi svabhāva ity asminn arthe bhāvapratyayaḥ kin tarhi bhāvārtha | na ca taddhitavṛttipradarśanena kiñcit prayojanam asty anyatareṇa vyatirekapradarśanāt |

original: vijātīyānāṃ ca prāsādīdānāṃ dravyārambhānabhyupagamāt kutas tatsamudāyaḥ prāsādādisamudāyo nagaraṃ dravyaṃ syāt | yāvatā prāsādatoraṇapuruṣādīnāṃ samudāyo nagaram iṣyate | teṣāṃ prāsādādīnāṃ samastānām asaṃyogāc ca kāraṇān nagaran dravyaṃ | saṃyogasahāyānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ dravyārambhakatvam iṣyate | na prāsādapuruṣakuḍyādīnāṃ viśliṣṭānāṃ saṃyogo 'sti |
analyzed: vijātīyānām ca dravya ārambha an abhyupagamāt kutas tad samudāyaḥ prāsāda ādi samudāyaḥ nagaram dravyam syāt yāvatā prāsāda toraṇa puruṣa ādīnām samudāyaḥ nagaram iṣyate teṣām prāsāda ādīnām samastānām asaṃyogāt ca kāraṇāt dravyam saṃyoga sahāyānām dravyāṇām dravya ārambhaka tvam iṣyate na prāsāda puruṣa kuḍya ādīnām viśliṣṭānām saṃyogaḥ asti

original: syān mataṃ (|) yady api sākalyena prāsādādīnāṃ nāsti saṃyogas tathāpi yeṣāṃ tāvat prāsādapuruṣādīnāṃ parasparaṃ saṃyogas tatsaṃyogātmakaṃ nagaram bhaviṣyaty evam api (p.161) vastutvaṃ nagarasyāsiddhaṃ saṃyogasya guṇapadārthatvād ity ata āha – na saṃyoga ityādi | na saṃyogasvabhāvan nagaraṃ |
analyzed: syāt matam yadi api sākalyena prāsāda ādīnām na asti saṃyogaḥ tathā api yeṣām tāvat prāsāda puruṣa ādīnām parasparam saṃyogaḥ tad saṃyoga ātmakam nagaram bhaviṣyati evam api vastu tvam nagarasya asiddham saṃyogasya guṇa padārtha tvāt iti atas āha na saṃyoge ityādi na saṃyoga svabhāvan nagaram

original: tathā kāṣṭheṣṭakādīnām vijātīyānāṃ kāryadravyānārambhāt prāsādo 'pi na dravyātmakaḥ kintu saṃyogasvabhāva iṣyate (|) saṃyogaś ca guṇo nirguṇaś ca guṇā iti kutaḥ prāsādasya saṃyogo yena tatsaṃyogātmakaṃ nagaraṃ syāt |

original: etad evāha – prāsādasyetyādi | pareṇetyarthāntareṇāsaṃyogāc ca na saṃyogo nagaraṃ | cakāreṇānantaranirdiṣṭāt prāsādādīnāṃ viśliṣṭānām asaṃyogāc ca na saṃyogo nagaram ity etat samuccīyate | tad evaṃ prāsādādīnām ubhayathā saṃyogābhāvena | nagarasya saṃyogasvabhāvatā nirastā |
analyzed: etat eva āha prāsādasya ityādi pareṇa iti artha antareṇa asaṃyogāt ca na saṃyogaḥ nagaram cakāreṇa anantara nirdiṣṭāt prāsāda ādīnām viśliṣṭānām asaṃyogāt ca na saṃyogaḥ nagaram iti etat samuccīyate tat evam prāsāda ādīnām ubhayathā saṃyoga abhāvena nagarasya saṃyoga svabhāva tā nirastā

original: prāsādādīnāṃ yā saṃkhyā tadātmakaṃ nagaram bhaviṣyatīti ced āha – tata eva saṃkhyābhāva iti | yasmāt saṃyogātmakaprāsādas tata eva kāraṇāt prāsādasya saṃkhyāyā abhāvo nirguṇatvād guṇānāṃ | saṃkhyāpi hi guṇasvabhāvā | sa cāsau saṃyogaś ca tatsaṃyogaḥ | prāsādātmakaḥ saṃyoga ity arthaḥ | tatsaṃyogena puruṣaiś ca viśiṣṭā yā sattā sā nagaram iti cet |
analyzed: prāsāda ādīnām yā saṃkhyā tad ātmakam nagaram bhaviṣyati iti ced āha tatas eva saṃkhyā bhāvaḥ iti yasmāt saṃyoga ātmaka prāsādaḥ tatas eva kāraṇāt prāsādasya saṃkhyāyāḥ abhāvaḥ nirguṇa tvāt guṇānām saṃkhyā api hi guṇa svabhāvā sa ca asau saṃyogaḥ ca tad saṃyogaḥ prāsāda ātmakaḥ saṃyogaḥ iti arthaḥ tad saṃyogena puruṣaiḥ ca viśiṣṭā yā sattā sā nagaram iti ced

original: kim asyāḥ sattāyā ekatvān nityatvāc ca niratiśayāyā viśeṣaṇaṃ | na hi prāsādapuruṣādayas sattāṃ viśiṃṣanti | anādheyātiśayatvāt | tasmāt sattā nirviśeṣaṇā | tasyā nagaratve sarvatra nagaratvaṃ syād ity abhiprāyaḥ | sattāyāś caikatvād iti | dravyaguṇakarmasvekaiva sattā vyāpinī |
analyzed: kim asyāḥ sattāyāḥ eka tvāt nitya tvāt ca niratiśayāyāḥ viśeṣaṇam na hi prāsāda puruṣa ādayaḥ sattām viśiṃṣanti anādheya atiśaya tvāt tasmāt sattā nirviśeṣaṇā tasyāḥ nagara tve sarvatra nagara tvam syāt iti abhiprāyaḥ sattāyāḥ ca eka tvāt iti dravya guṇa karmasu ekā eva sattā vyāpinī

original: nagarabahutve 'pi nagaravyavasthāśrayāṇāṃ prāsādādisamudāyānāṃ bahutve 'pīty arthaḥ | anyathā sattātmake nagare prakṛte nagarabahutvaṃ kathaṃ syāt | dravyasyeti prāsādapuruṣādeḥ sattāyāś ca yā parasparasahitatā sā nagaram iti cet | evaṃ hi sati na sarvatra nagarabuddhiḥ | prāsādādīnāṃ sarvatrābhāvāt |

original: nāpi dvitīyo yasmād yathā sattā kevalā nagarabuddhijananaṃ pratyasamarthā tathā prāsādādisahitāpi sāmarthye vā kevalāpi janayet | yadi ca dvayasya parasparasahitatā nagaraṃ | tadaikam api nagaram anekātmakaṃ prāsādādyātmakatvāt | tataḥ puruṣasaṃyogasattānām bahutvāt | nagaram ity ekavacanaṃ syāt | saṃyogaśabdena prāsādātmakaḥ saṃyoga uktaḥ |

original: atha vā yathāyogaṃ sambandho granthacchedaś ca kāryaḥ (|) khatvam iti vyatirekāśrayā (p.163) na syāt tatthitotpattir ity adhyāhāraḥ | khasya svabhāva iti ṣaṣṭhī na syād iti | na hi khaśabdavācyād arthād anyaḥ svabhāvo 'sti bhāvo vā | yo yathākramaṃ vyatirekaṣaṣṭhyās taddhitasya vā nibandhanaṃ syāt |

original: khatvaṃ nāma sāmānyam asti tadvyatirekanibandhanam iti ced āha – na tatretyādi | ekātmakatvāt khasya nāsmin khatvasāmānyaṃ (|) yady api sattvaṃ dravyatvaṃ cākāśe 'sti | tathāpi na tat khasya svabhāvaḥ | ghaṭādisādhāraṇatvāt | nāpi sattvadravyatve khatvam ity atra bhāvapratyayasya nibandhanaṃ | tayoḥ śa (?) śabdapratyayākāraṇatvāt |

original: svānurūpajñānābhidhānanibandhanasvabhāvapratyayasya kāraṇam iṣṭaṃ | nāpi vibhutvādayo guṇā iti | ādiśabdād ekatvaparatvādiparigrahaḥ | tathocyata iti khasya svabhāva iti | dravyād arthāntarasya vibhūtvāder guṇasya tatsvabhāvatvāyogād ākāśasvabhāvatvāyogāt | na hy arthāntaram arthāntarasya svabhāvo yuktaḥ | yadi ca vibhutvādaya ākāśasvabhāvāḥ |
analyzed: sva anurūpa jñāna abhidhāna nibandhana svabhāva pratyayasya kāraṇam iṣṭam nā api vibhu tva ādayaḥ guṇāḥ iti ādi śabdāt ekatva paratva ādi parigrahaḥ tathā ucyate iti khasya svabhāvaḥ iti dravyāt artha antarasya vibhū tva ādeḥ guṇasya tad svabhāva tva ayogāt ākāśa svabhāva tva ayogāt na hi artha antaram artha antarasya svabhāvaḥ yuktaḥ yadi ca vibhu tva ādayaḥ ākāśa svabhāvāḥ

original: tadā teṣāṃ ca vibhutvādīnām ākāśasvabhāvatve niḥsvabhāvatvaprasaṅgāt | tathā hi yas teṣāṃ guṇasvabhāvaḥ saty ākāśam eva jātaṃ na cāparasvabhāvo 'stīti niḥsvabhāvatā syāt | teṣāṃ ca niḥsvabhāvatve ākāśasya vyatiriktaḥ svabhāvo na syād iti bhāvaḥ | vibhutvāder apy arthāntarasvabhāvatvam iti ced āha – tasyāpītyādi |
analyzed: tadā teṣām ca vibhu tva ādīnām ākāśa svabhāva tve niḥsvabhāva tva prasaṅgāt tathā hi yaḥ teṣām guṇa svabhāvaḥ sati ākāśam eva jātam na ca apara svabhāvaḥ asti iti niḥsvabhāvatā syāt teṣām ca niḥsvabhāva tve ākāśasya vyatiriktaḥ svabhāvaḥ na syāt iti bhāvaḥ vibhu tva ādeḥ api artha antara svabhāva tvam iti ced āha tasya api ityādi

original: tasyeti vibhutvāder arthāntaraṃ svabhāvo 'syeti vigrahaḥ | atiprasaṅga iti yattadarthāntaraṃ vibhatvādeḥ(sic.? vibhutvādeḥ) svabhāvatveneṣṭan tasyāpy arthāntarasvabhāvatvena bhāvyaṃ | anyathā tasyāpi vibhutvāvyatirekāt tadvad eva niḥsvabhāvatā syāt | tathā cāparāparasvabhāvaparimārgaṇenānavasthānād ekasyāpi pratiṣṭhitasvabhāvasyābhāvāt |

original: tataḥ svabhāvāntarapratikṣepāpratikṣepalakṣaṇena bhedaleśena khasyāyaṃ svabhāvaḥ kha(tva)m iti bhedena nirddiśyata iti tad etan nātiśliṣṭaṃ bhedāntarapratikṣepāpratipatteḥ |
analyzed: tatas svabhāva antara pratikṣepa apratikṣepa lakṣaṇena bheda leśena khasya ayam svabhāvaḥ kha tvam iti bhedena nirddiśyate iti tat etat na atiśliṣṭam bheda antara pratikṣepa apratipatteḥ

original: netyādi siddhāntavādī. yat sarvasmād vyāvṛttaṃ svalakṣaṇātmakam, tad eva rūpaṃ śabdotthāyāṃ buddhau śabdaiḥ samarpyate. neti sambandhaḥ. kasmāt tasya svalakṣaṇasyendriyabuddhāv iva | śābde vijñāne pratyavabhāsane saty anatīndriyatvaprasaṅgāt | pratyakṣatvaprasaṅgāt, kiṃ tarhi śabdena kriyata iti ced āha – kevalam ityādi. ayam iti pratipādakaḥ.
analyzed: na ityādi siddhāntavādī yat sarvasmāt vyāvṛttam sva lakṣaṇa ātmakam tat eva rūpam śabda utthāyām buddhau śabdaiḥ samarpyate na iti sambandhaḥ kasmāt tasya sva lakṣaṇasya indriya buddhau iva śābde vijñāne pratyavabhāsane sati an atīndriya tva prasaṅgāt pratyakṣa tva prasaṅgāt kim tarhi śabdena kriyate iti ced āha kevalam ityādi ayam iti pratipādakaḥ

original: dṛśyavikalpayor ekatvādhyavasāyavipralabdhas tathābhūtam asādhāraṇam arthaṃ pratyāyayiṣyāmīty evam abhiprāyaḥ śabdena karaṇabhūtena śrotari yo vikalpas tasya pratibimbabāhyatayādhyastam (p.165) ākāram arpayati (|) kiṃ bhūtam asaṃsṛṣṭatatsvabhāvaṃ | agṛhītavasturūpaṃ | ācāryadiṅnāgasyāpy etad abhimatam ity āha – yad āhetyādi |
analyzed: dṛśya vikalpayoḥ eka tva adhyavasāya vipralabdhaḥ tathābhūtam asādhāraṇam artham pratyāyayiṣyāmi iti evam abhiprāyaḥ śabdena karaṇa bhūtena śrotari yaḥ vikalpaḥ tasya pratibimba bāhya tayā adhyastam ākāram arpayati kim bhūtam asaṃsṛṣṭa tad svabhāvam agṛhīta vastu rūpam ācārya diṅnāgasya api etat abhimatam iti āha yat āha ityādi

original: adṛṣṭārthe svargādiśabde uccarite 'rthavikalpamātraṃ śrotur bhavaty adhyavasitabāhyārthasvabhāvo vikalpo bhavati na tu bāhyasvarūpagrāhakaṃ |
analyzed: adṛṣṭa arthe svarga ādi śabde uccarite rtha vikalpa mātram śrotuḥ bhavati adhyavasita bāhya artha svabhāvaḥ vikalpaḥ bhavati na tu bāhya svarūpa grāhakam

original: anena cācāryeṇāpi vidhyarthaḥ śabdārtho 'bhipreta iti darśayati | naivaṃ vikalpapratibimbe śabdena śrotari janite pratipādyapratipādakābhyāṃ yathāsaṃkhyaṃ svalakṣaṇaṃ pratipannaṃ pratipāditaṃ vā bhavati.
analyzed: anena ca ācāryeṇa api vidhi arthaḥ śabda arthaḥ bhipretaḥ iti darśayati na evam vikalpa pratibimbe śabdena śrotari janite pratipādya pratipādakābhyām yathāsaṃkhyam sva lakṣaṇam pratipannam pratipāditam vā bhavati

original: yadi hi śabdena svalakṣaṇaṃ pratipādyate, tadā svargādiśabdaśravaṇe 'pi | tadanubhavinām iva | svargādipratyakṣavedinām iva pratibhāsābhedaḥ syāt | śrotur api svargādisvalakṣaṇākārapratipattiḥ syāt |
analyzed: yadi hi śabdena sva lakṣaṇam pratipādyate tadā svarga ādi śabda śravaṇe tad anubhavinām iva svarga ādi pratyakṣa vedinām iva pratibhāsa abhedaḥ syāt śrotuḥ api svarga ādi sva lakṣaṇa ākāra pratipattiḥ syāt

original: yataś ca na śabdāt svalakṣaṇapratipattis tasmād ayaṃ śrotā śabdād apratipadyamāno 'pi bhāvasvabhāvaṃ tathābhūta evāsaṃsṛṣṭavastusvabhāva eva vikalpapratibimbe tadadhyavasāyī svalakṣaṇādhyavasāyī svalakṣaṇam eva mayā pratipannam iti santuṣyati (|) kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tathābhūtatvād eva.
analyzed: yatas ca na śabdāt sva lakṣaṇa pratipattiḥ tasmāt ayam śrotā śabdāt a pratipadyamānaḥ pi bhāva svabhāvam tathābhūtaḥ eva asaṃsṛṣṭa vastu svabhāvaḥ eva vikalpa pratibimbe tad adhyavasāyī sva lakṣaṇa adhyavasāyī sva lakṣaṇam eva mayā pratipannam iti santuṣyati kim kāraṇam tathābhūta tvāt eva

original: svalakṣaṇasyāgrahe 'py adhyavasitasvalakṣaṇarūpatvād eva śabdārthapratipatteḥ | yataś ca svalakṣaṇādhyavasāyena śabdārthasya pratītis tenaitad evam ucyate śabdaḥ svarūpam āheti | arthāntarasādhāraṇarūpāparāmarśena khaśabdapravṛttinibandham asādhāraṇaṃ rūpam ucyata iti vacanāt | na punaḥ svarūpapratibhāsasyaiva vijñānasya jananāt |
analyzed: sva lakṣaṇasya agrahe pi adhyavasita sva lakṣaṇa rūpa tvāt eva śabda artha pratipatteḥ yatas ca sva lakṣaṇa adhyavasāyena śabda arthasya pratītiḥ tena etat evam ucyate śabdaḥ sva rūpam āha iti artha antara sādhāraṇa rūpa a parāmarśena kha śabda pravṛtti nibandham asādhāraṇam rūpam ucyate iti vacanāt na punar sva rūpa pratibhāsasya eva vijñānasya jananāt

original: tasmāt sthitam etad vidhyarthaḥ śabdārtholīkatvāt paramatād bheda iti |
analyzed: tasmāt sthitam etat vidhi arthaḥ śabda artha ulīka tvāt paramatāt bhedaḥ iti

original: katham ityādi paraḥ. ekāntavyāvṛttaṃ rūpaṃ yeṣām iti vigrahaḥ | teṣām bhāvānām asaṃsargād anyasya ceti bhāvebhyo vyatiriktasya sāmānyasya |
analyzed: katham ityādi paraḥ ekānta vyāvṛttam rūpam yeṣām iti vigrahaḥ teṣām bhāvānām a saṃsargāt anyasya ca iti bhāvebhyaḥ vyatiriktasya sāmānyasya

original: uktam iti siddhāntavādī. kīdṛśam uktam ity āha – asaṃsṛṣṭānāṃ parasparavyāvṛttānām (p.166) ekena vijātīyenāsaṃsargaḥ | yathā govyaktīnām ekenāgosvabhāvenāsaṃsargaḥ sa evāsaṃsargaḥ | tadvyatirekiṇān tasmād agosvabhāvād vyāvṛttānāṃ gobhedānāṃ samānatā gotvaṃ | evam anyad api sāmānyaṃ boddhavyaṃ |
analyzed: uktam iti siddhāntavādī kīdṛśam uktam iti āha asaṃsṛṣṭānām paraspara vyāvṛttānām ekena vijātīyena a saṃsargaḥ yathā go vyaktīnām ekena a go svabhāvena a saṃsargaḥ saḥ eva a saṃsargaḥ tad vyatirekiṇān tasmāt a go svabhāvāt vyāvṛttānām go bhedānām samāna tā go tvam evam anyat api sāmānyam boddhavyam

original: etad uktam bhavati | samānām iti karttari ṣaṣṭhī tena samānānām bhāvaḥ sāmānyam iti vijātīyavyāvṛttāḥ samānākārotpannā bhāvāḥ sāmānyam ity arthaḥ | asyaiva ca sāmānyasya liṅgatvaṃ liṅgitvan tatsambandhaś ca vastutvāt | arthakriyākāritvāc ca pravṛttiviṣayatvaṃ vikalpaviṣayatvaṃ ca yathādhyavasāyaṃ na tu jñānākārasya | etadviparītatvāt ||( 69 ||)
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati samānām iti karttari ṣaṣṭhī tena samānānām bhāvaḥ sāmānyam iti vijātīya vyāvṛttāḥ samāna ākāra utpannāḥ bhāvāḥ sāmānyam iti arthaḥ asya eva ca sāmānyasya liṅga tvam tad sambandhaḥ ca vastu tvāt artha kriyā kāri tvāt ca pravṛtti viṣaya tvam vikalpa viṣaya tvam ca yathā adhyavasāyam na tu jñāna ākārasya etad viparīta tvāt

original: tad evaṃ samāropapakṣe parokṣaṃ dūṣaṇam parihṛtyānyavyāvṛttipakṣe parokṣaṃ dūṣaṇam anyavyāvṛttyanabhyupagamād eva nirasyānyavyāvṛttā eva bhāvā ekatvenādhyavasīyamānāḥ sāmānyam iti ca pratipādya buddhyākāre 'pi sāmānye paroktaṃ dūṣaṇam apanetum āha – api cetyādi |
analyzed: tat evam samāropa pakṣe parokṣam dūṣaṇam parihṛtya anya vyāvṛtti pakṣe parokṣam dūṣaṇam anya vyāvṛtti anabhyupagamāt eva nirasya anya vyāvṛttāḥ eva bhāvāḥ ekatvena adhyavasīyamānāḥ sāmānyam iti ca pratipādya buddhi ākāre sāmānye para uktam dūṣaṇam apanetum āha api ca ityādi

original: nanu yady abhinnaḥ pratibhāso 'bhyupagamyate | kathaṃ sāmānyam asad ity ucyate | na (|) vyaktibhyo bhinnasyābhimatasyābhedena pratibhāsanāt | sarvātmanā cābhede vyaktivad ananvayād anugatasya pratītir bhrāntir eva |

original: atha syād (|) yad ananugame yasyānugamas tat tato bhinnaṃ yathā nīlād anīlaṃ | śāvaleyānanugame ca gotvasyānugamo vyaktyantare (|) tasmāt tato bhinnaṃ śāvaleyābhinnagotvagrāhakan tarhi pratyakṣaṃ bhrāntaṃ syād bhinnasyānyapramāṇagṛhītasyābhedena grahaṇāt | na caikasya yenaiva rūpeṇa bhedas tenaivābhedo virodhāt |

original: nāpi vastūnāṃ viśeṣarūpatayā bhedaḥ | sāmānyarūpatayā 'bhedaḥ | evaṃ hi viśeṣānām ekadeśāditvaṃ syān na ca syāt | sāmānyaviśeṣayoś ca pratibhāsabhedo na syāt sarvātmanā 'bhinnatvād | bhede vānugatavyāvṛttarūpayoḥ parasparāsaṃśleṣeṇaikāntabhinnatvaprasaṅgāt |

original: yadi ca prativyakti tadabhinnan tadaikaṃ sāmānyam astīti kutaḥ | na ca tatra prathamavyaktitadarśane 'gṛhītam api dvitīyādivyaktau sa evāyam iti pratīter ekaṃ sāmānyam astīti yuktaṃ (|) sa iti smaraṇāṃśasyānubhūtasāmānyaviṣayābhāvenotpattyasambhavāt |
analyzed: yadi ca prativyakti tad abhinnan tadā ekam sāmānyam asti iti kutas na ca tatra prathama vyakti tad darśane gṛhītam api dvitīya ādi vyaktau saḥ eva ayam iti pratīteḥ ekam sāmānyam asti iti yuktam saḥ iti smaraṇa aṃśasya anubhūta sāmānya viṣaya abhāvena utpatti asambhavāt

original: tataś ca yathā prathamavyaktau na gṛhītan tathā dvitīyādivyaktāv api pratyekaṃ gṛhītam iti kathaṃ sa evāyam iti jñānasyotpattiḥ syāt | na ca sa iti smaraṇānyathānupapattyā prathamavyaktau nirvikalpakenānyena vā jñānena sāmānyagrahaṇakalpanā yuktānugatarūpapratibhāsābhāvāt |

original: nāpi dharmarūpatayā tatrāsya grahaṇaṃ yuktam anugataikarūpatvāt sāmānyasya | nāpi pūrvāparavyaktisambandhitayāsya pratibhijñāpratyakṣeṇa grahaṇam iti śakyate vaktuṃ | idam evety evaṃ pratyakṣasyotpattiprasaṅgāt | pūrvavyakter asannihitatvāc ca sannihitārthaniścayalakṣaṇaṃ ca pratyakṣam iṣyate |

original: tena vikalpaviṣayasya dṛśyātmatayādhyavasāyād dṛśyavikalpayor ekīkaraṇam ucyate (|) darśanārho dṛśyaḥ śakyate vā draṣṭum iti vikalpakadarśanasyāpi yo viṣayaḥ sa dṛśyas tenānāgatasyāpy arthasyāgamopadarśitasya dṛśyatvaṃ siddhantathā 'bhāvasyāpi |
analyzed: tena vikalpa viṣayasya dṛśya ātma tayā adhyavasāyāt dṛśya vikalpayoḥ ekīkaraṇam ucyate darśana arhaḥ dṛśyaḥ śakyate vā draṣṭum iti vikalpaka darśanasya api yaḥ viṣayaḥ sa dṛśyaḥ tena anāgatasya api arthasya āgama upadarśitasya dṛśya tvam siddham tathā bhāvasya api

original: ata evābhāvaḥ pratyayaḥ svākāram bhāvarūpam api padārthābhāvāvyatirekeṇādhyasya pratyetīty abhāvaviṣaya ucyate na tv abhāvaṃ gṛhṇāti (|) sarvavikalpānāṃ nirviṣayatvāt |
analyzed: atas eva abhāvaḥ pratyayaḥ sva ākāram bhāva rūpam api padārtha abhāva avyatirekeṇa adhyasya pratyeti iti abhāva viṣayaḥ ucyate na tu abhāvam gṛhṇāti sarva vikalpānām nirviṣaya tvāt

original: tatkāritayetyādi | na kevalan tadabhiprāyavaśād vikalpabuddhiḥ svalakṣaṇeṣu vivekeṣu bhavatīty ucyate | tathā tatkāritayā karaṇenātatkāribhyo bhinnānarthān śabdena vaktāraḥ pratipādayantīty ucyate | vyākhyātāro 'pi dṛśyavikalpayor aikyaṃ kim iti na pratipadyanta iti ced āha – pratibhāsabhedādibhya iti dṛśyasya hi spaṣṭaḥ pratibhāso na vikalpasya |
analyzed: tad kāri tayā ityādi na kevalan tad abhiprāya vaśāt vikalpa buddhiḥ sva lakṣaṇeṣu vivekeṣu bhavati iti ucyate tathā tad kāri tayā karaṇena atatkāribhyaḥ bhinnān arthān śabdena vaktāraḥ pratipādayanti iti ucyate vyākhyātāraḥ pi dṛśya vikalpayoḥ aikyam kim iti na pratipadyante iti ced āha pratibhāsa bheda ādibhyaḥ iti dṛśyasya hi spaṣṭaḥ pratibhāsaḥ na vikalpasya

original: vikalpānubaddhasya spaṣṭatvāyogāt | ādiśabdān niruddhe 'pi dṛśye vikalpasyānirodhāt | arthakriyāyāḥ karaṇād akaraṇāc ca | tattvacintakā nyāyānusāriṇaḥ vyākhyātāraḥ (|) śeṣaṣaṣṭhī ceyan tattvasya cintakā iti | tattvasya te cintakā nātattvasyeti sambandhyantaravyavacchedamātrāpekṣāyāṃ kriyākākarabhāvasyāvivakṣitatvāt |
analyzed: vikalpa anubaddhasya spaṣṭa tva ayogāt ādi śabdāt niruddhe pi dṛśye vikalpasya anirodhāt arthakriyāyāḥ karaṇāt akaraṇāt ca tattva cintakāḥ nyāya anusāriṇaḥ vyākhyātāraḥ śeṣaṣaṣṭhī ca iyān tattvasya cintakāḥ iti tattvasya te cintakāḥ na a tattvasya iti sambandhi antara vyavaccheda mātra apekṣāyām kriyākākara bhāvasya avivakṣita tvāt

original: (|) cintayater vā pacācyajantasya tattvaśabdena ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaṃ kṛtvā svārthikaḥ kanpratyayaḥ kṛtaḥ | tato 'tra tṛjakābhyām1* ityādinā ṣaṣṭhīsamāsapratiṣedho nāśaṃkyaḥ | nābhedam anusandhate | dṛśyavikalpayor iti prakṛte |
analyzed: cintayateḥ vā tattva śabdena ṣaṣṭhī samāsam kṛtvā svārthikaḥ kanpratyayaḥ kṛtaḥ ityādinā ṣaṣṭhī samāsa pratiṣedhaḥ na āśaṃkyaḥ na abhedam dṛśya vikalpayoḥ iti prakṛte

original: fn. 1*:Pāṇini2.2.15.
analyzed: pāṇini 2215

original: yadītyādi codakaḥ | pratipattrabhiprāyo 'nuvidhīyate bāhyeṣu sāmānyavyavasthānaṃ | tadānyāpoho 'pi sāmānyaṃ mā bhūt | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) na hy evam iti | anyāpohaḥ śabdena codyata ity evaṃ vyavaharttṛṇāṃ nāsti pratipattiḥ | ācāryo 'pi tulyatāṃ (p.172) khyāpayann āha – na vai kevalam ityādi | evam apratipattir ity anyāpoharūpeṇa |
analyzed: yadi ityādi codakaḥ pratipattṛ abhiprāyaḥ bāhyeṣu sāmānya vyavasthānam tadā anya apohaḥ pi sāmānyam mā bhūt kim kāraṇam na hi evam iti anya apohaḥ śabdena codyate iti evam vyavaharttṛṇām na asti pratipattiḥ ācāryaḥ u pi tulya tām khyāpayan āha na vai kevalam ityādi evam apratipattiḥ iti anya apoha rūpeṇa

original: tvayā yathā vyaktivyatiriktādibhir ākārair iṣṭaṃ sāmānyan tathāpi naiva pratipattiḥ | āśrayād vyatiriktaṃ vaiśeṣikādīnām avyatiriktaṃ sāṃkhyādīnām ādiśabdāt pratyekaparisamāptatvādiparigrahaḥ | tatra bhedas tāvat sāmānyasya na pratibhāsata eva | iha sāmānyam iti buddhyanutpatteḥ abhede 'pi vyaktīnām eva pratibhāsaḥ syān na sāmānyasya |
analyzed: tvayā yathā vyakti vyatirikta ādibhiḥ ākāraiḥ iṣṭam sāmānyan tathā api nā eva pratipattiḥ āśrayāt vyatiriktam vaiśeṣika ādīnām avyatiriktam sāṃkhya ādīnām ādi śabdāt pratyeka parisamāpta tva ādi parigrahaḥ tatra bhedaḥ tāvat sāmānyasya na pratibhāsate eva iha sāmānyam iti buddhi anutpatteḥ abhede pi vyaktīnām eva pratibhāsaḥ syāt na sāmānyasya

original: bhedābhede cobhayapakṣabhāvī doṣaḥ syāt | nāpi tatpratyekaparisamāptaṃ yujyate | yata ekavyaktāv ekasambandhy eva tat syān nānekasambandhi | na caivaṃ sāmānyam anekasambandhitvād asya samānānām bhāvaḥ sāmānyam iti vacanāt |
analyzed: bheda abhede ca ubhaya pakṣa bhāvī doṣaḥ syāt nā api tat pratyeka parisamāptam yujyate yatas eka vyaktau eka sambandhi eva tat syāt na aneka sambandhi na ca evam sāmānyam aneka sambandhi tvāt asya samānānām bhāvaḥ sāmānyam iti vacanāt

original: atha vyaktyantareṣu tasya pratyabhijñānāt tatsambandhitvam evam api bhūtaguṇavedakam anekasambandhi syān na pratyekaparisamāptaṃ | ekaikasyāṃ vyaktāv anekasambandhitvenāpratīteḥ | pratītau vā tatrānekavyaktipratibhāsaḥ syāt | atha vyaktyantarāle 'pratibhāsanāt pratyekaparisamāptan tad ucyate |
analyzed: atha vyakti antareṣu tasya pratyabhijñānāt tad sambandhi tvam evam api bhūta guṇa vedakam aneka sambandhi syāt na pratyeka parisamāptam ekaikasyām vyaktau aneka sambandhi tvena apratīteḥ pratītau vā tatra aneka vyakti pratibhāsaḥ syāt atha vyakti antarāle pratibhāsanāt pratyeka parisamāptan tat ucyate

original: tat kim etāvatā tasyānekasambandhitvam ekatra sidhyati | na ca sāmānye pratyabhijñānaṃ yujyata ity apy uktaṃ | tasmān na tasya pratyekaparisamāptir nāpi nityatvam ekatvaṃ vyāpitvaṃ ca pratibhāsata iti sthitaṃ |
analyzed: tat kim etāvatā tasya aneka sambandhi tvam ekatra sidhyati na ca sāmānye pratyabhijñānam yujyate iti api uktam tasmāt na tasya pratyeka parisamāptiḥ nā api nitya tvam eka tvam vyāpi tvam ca pratibhāsate iti sthitam

original: yadi vastubhūtasya sāmānyasyāpohasya ca tulyaḥ pratipattyabhāvo vyavahāre | kas tarhy asyā āśraya ity ata āha – kevalam ityādi | svalakṣaṇānāṃ vijātīyarahitatvam anyāpohaḥ so 'bhinnākārāyā buddher nimittatvenocyate |
analyzed: yadi vastu bhūtasya sāmānyasya apohasya ca tulyaḥ pratipatti abhāvaḥ vyavahāre kaḥ tarhi asyāḥ āśrayaḥ iti atas āha kevalam ityādi sva lakṣaṇānām vijātīya rahita tvam anya apohaḥ saḥ bhinna ākārāyāḥ buddheḥ nimitta tvena ucyate

original: kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tasya vijātīyavirahalakṣaṇasyānyāpohasya bhinneṣv api sarvatra vastuṣu bhāvāt tathābhūtasya cānyāpohasya sāmānyabuddhihetutvam pratyavirodhāt | tathā hi yathaikam vṛkṣam avṛkṣād vyāvṛttaṃ paśyaty evamanyam apy atas tatraikākārā buddhir utpadyate | na cātra bādhakaṃ pramāṇam asti |
analyzed: kim kāraṇam tasya vijātīya viraha lakṣaṇasya anya apohasya bhinneṣu api sarvatra vastuṣu bhāvāt tathābhūtasya ca anya apohasya sāmānya buddhi hetu tvam prati avirodhāt tathā hi yathā ekam vṛkṣam a vṛkṣāt vyāvṛttam paśyati evam anyam api atas tatra eka ākārā buddhiḥ utpadyate na ca atra bādhakam pramāṇam asti

original: tṛtīyakāraṇam āha – vyavahārasya cetyādi | tathā darśanād iti | anyāpohanibandhanatvena darśanāt | etac ca tadanyaparihāreṇa pravartate(?ta i)ti ca dhvanir ucyata ityādinā pratipādayiṣyate | yathety ekākārā iyaṃ vikalpabuddhiḥ pratibhāti (|) (p.173) tathā bāhyantatsāmānyan nāstīti vākyārthaḥ |
analyzed: tṛtīya kāraṇam āha vyavahārasya ca ityādi tathā darśanāt iti anya apoha nibandhana tvena darśanāt etat ca tad anya parihāreṇa pravartata itas iti ca dhvaniḥ ucyate ityādinā pratipādayiṣyate yathā iti eka ākārā iyam vikalpa buddhiḥ pratibhāti tathā bāhyam tat sāmānyan na asti iti vākya arthaḥ

original: tato na vastubhūtaṃ sāmānyaṃ vikalpadarśanāśraya ity abhiprāyaḥ ||
analyzed: tatas na vastu bhūtam sāmānyam vikalpa darśana āśrayaḥ iti abhiprāyaḥ

original: sāmānyābhāve ca kāraṇam āha – yasmād ityādi | vyaktayaḥ svalakṣaṇāni | nānuyanti na miśrībhavanti | etenāvyatiriktasāmānyābhyupagamo nirastaḥ |
analyzed: sāmānya abhāve ca kāraṇam āha yasmāt ityādi vyaktayaḥ sva lakṣaṇāni na anuyanti na miśrībhavanti etena avyatirikta sāmānya abhyupagamaḥ nirastaḥ

original: vyatiriktanirākaraṇārtham āha – anyad anuyāyīti | anuyāyi yad iṣṭaṃ bhedebhyo 'nyat sāmānyarūpantatpratyakṣabuddhau na bhāsate |
analyzed: vyatirikta nirākaraṇa artham āha anyat anuyāyi iti anuyāyi yat iṣṭam bhedebhyaḥ sāmānya rūpam tat pratyakṣa buddhau na bhāsate

original: nanu vikalpapratibhāse 'pi sāmānye bhedābhedapakṣayor ayam ananvayādidoṣas tulya eveti | kathaṃ sāmānyam iṣyate | sāmānākāras tāvat pratibhāsata eva | yāvad asau na budhyate bhedābhedarahita iti tāvad asyālaṅkāra evāvastutvapratipādanād (|) ata eva yathāpratibhāsaṃ tv asāv astīty ucyate |
analyzed: nanu vikalpa pratibhāse pi sāmānye bheda abheda pakṣayoḥ ayam ananvaya ādi doṣaḥ tulyaḥ eva iti katham sāmānyam iṣyate sāmāna ākāraḥ tāvat pratibhāsate eva yāvat asau na budhyate bheda abheda rahitaḥ iti tāvat asya alaṅkāraḥ evā avastu tva pratipādanāt atas eva yathā pratibhāsam tu asau asti iti ucyate

original: anvāviśanti miśrībhavanti | yadi parasparam anvāveśaḥ syāt tadaikarūpāpatter bhedābhāvaḥ | tena kāraṇena sāmānyasyaivābhāvaprasaṅgāt | tena bhedānāṃ samānānām ekākārapratyayanibandhanatvaṃ dharmaḥ sāmānyaṃ | tadbhedābhāvena bhaved ity arthaḥ | anyac ceti vyaktibhyaḥ anyad ity asya vivaraṇaṃ vyatiriktam iti |
analyzed: anvāviśanti miśrībhavanti yadi parasparam anvāveśaḥ syāt tadā eka rūpa āpatteḥ bheda abhāvaḥ tena kāraṇena sāmānyasya eva abhāva prasaṅgāt tena bhedānām samānānām eka ākāra pratyaya nibandhana tvam dharmaḥ sāmānyam tad bheda abhāvena bhavet iti arthaḥ anyat ca iti vyaktibhyaḥ anyat iti asya vivaraṇam vyatiriktam iti

original: tathā tena rūpeṇa sāmānyabuddhau (|) anenopalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptasya sāmānyasyābhāvavyavahāre sādhye svabhāvānupalambhauktaḥ | na cānupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptaṃ sāmānyam abhyupeyaṃ | yasmād apratibhāsamānaṃ ca sāmānyaṃ katham ātmanā svena sāmānyarūpeṇa | anyam iti sāmānyavantaṃ grāhayet | vyapadeśayed vā |
analyzed: tathā tena rūpeṇa sāmānya buddhau anena upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptasya sāmānyasya abhāva vyavahāre sādhye svabhāva anupalambha uktaḥ na ca anupalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptam sāmānyam abhyupeyam yasmāt apratibhāsamānam ca sāmānyam katham ātmanā svena sāmānya rūpeṇa anyam iti sāmānyavantam grāhayet vyapadeśayet vā

original: svena rūpeṇa katham anyam iti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ | sāmānyabalād vyaktiṣv abhinnābhidhānajñānavṛttir iṣṭā | tasmāt sāmānyam upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptam eveṣṭam iti samudāyārthaḥ | evaṃ tāvad grāhyalakṣaṇaprāptasyānupalambhān nāsty ekam anekasambandhi (|)
analyzed: svena rūpeṇa katham anyam iti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ sāmānya balāt vyaktiṣu abhinna abhidhāna jñāna vṛttiḥ iṣṭā tasmāt sāmānyam upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptam eva iṣṭam iti samudāya arthaḥ evam tāvat grāhya lakṣaṇa prāptasya anupalambhāt na asti ekam aneka sambandhi

original: bhavatu nāmaikam anekasambaddhan tathāpi sāmānyarūpatā na yuktety āha – na cetyādi | tair iti vyaktibhedaiḥ uktam iti dvitvādi | saṃyogakāryadravyeṣv api sāmānyasvabhāvatvaṃ prāpnotīty aprasaṅgasyoktatvāt | ekam anekasambaddham ity eva kṛtvā na sāmānyaṃ kin tv abhinnābhidhānapratyayanimittam (p.174) ekasāmānyaṃ na sarva dvitvādy api |
analyzed: bhavatu nāma ekam tathā api sāmānya rūpatā na yuktā iti āha na ca ityādi taiḥ iti vyakti bhedaiḥ uktam iti dvi tva ādi saṃyoga kārya dravyeṣu api sāmānya svabhāva tvam prāpnoti iti aprasaṅgasya ukta tvāt ekam aneka sambaddham iti eva kṛtvā na sāmānyam kin tu abhinna abhidhāna pratyaya nimittam eka sāmānyam na dvi tva ādi api

original: tasya yathoktaśabdajñānānimittatvād iti cet | katham anyataḥ sāmānyād anyatra vyaktibhede sāmānyenaikarūpatām anāpādite | pratyayavṛttir ekākārajñānavṛttiḥ |
analyzed: tasya yathā ukta śabda jñāna animitta tvāt iti ced katham anyatas sāmānyāt anyatra vyakti bhede sāmānyena eka rūpa tām an āpādite pratyaya vṛttiḥ eka ākāra jñāna vṛttiḥ

original: tatsambandhād iti paraḥ | tābhir vyaktibhiḥ sambandhād anyato 'pi sāmānyād anyatra pratyayavṛttiḥ |
analyzed: tad sambandhāt iti paraḥ tābhiḥ vyaktibhiḥ sambandhāt sāmānyāt anyatra pratyaya vṛttiḥ

original: saṃkhyety ācāryaḥ | bhāvalakṣaṇā ceyaṃ saptamī | saṃkhyāṃ satyāṃ kāryadravye 'vayavini sati | ādiśabdāt saṃyogādiṣu sannapratyayavṛttes te 'pi sāmānyaṃ prāpnuvantīti samudāyārthaḥ | asāmānyātmakatvāt saṃkhyādīnāntadvalena dravye naikākārapratyayavṛttir iti cet |
analyzed: saṃkhyā iti ācāryaḥ bhāva lakṣaṇā ca iyam saptamī saṃkhyām satyām kārya dravye vayavini sati ādi śabdāt saṃyoga ādiṣu sanna pratyaya vṛtteḥ te pi sāmānyam prāpnuvanti iti samudāya arthaḥ asāmānya ātmaka tvāt saṃkhyā ādīnām tad valena dravye na eka ākāra pratyaya vṛttiḥ iti ced

original: nanu sa evāyaṃ sāmānyātmā vicāryate (|) ko 'yaṃ sāmānyātmeti | saṃkhyādibhyo vivekena sāmānyalakṣaṇasyaivāpratītatvāt | naitad vyaktam iti yāvat | tad evāha – tatretyādi | tatra ko 'yaṃ sāmānyātmeti pṛṣṭe tvayoktam ekasyānekena sati sambandhe vyaktiṣv abhinnapratyayavṛttiḥ |
analyzed: nanu saḥ eva ayam sāmānya ātmā vicāryate kaḥ yam sāmānya ātmā iti saṃkhyā ādibhyaḥ vivekena sāmānya lakṣaṇasya eva apratīta tvāt na etat vyaktam iti yāvat tat eva āha tatra ityādi tatra kaḥ yam sāmānya ātmā iti pṛṣṭe tvayā uktam ekasya anekena sati sambandhe vyaktiṣu abhinna pratyaya vṛttiḥ

original: tata iti pratyayavṛtteḥ kāraṇād anekasambaddham ekaṃ sāmānyam iti sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ |
analyzed: tatas iti pratyaya vṛtteḥ kāraṇāt aneka sambaddham ekam sāmānyam iti sāmānya lakṣaṇam

original: atra sāmānyalakṣaṇe 'smābhir ucyate | anekasambandhino vidyante yeṣāṃ kāryadravyādīnāṃ | ādiśabdāt dvitvādiparigrahaḥ | tebhyo 'pi tadāśrayadravyeṣv ekākārapratyayotpattiḥ syāt | kiṅ kāraṇam (|) nimittasambhavāt |
analyzed: atra sāmānya lakṣaṇe smābhiḥ ucyate aneka sambandhinaḥ vidyante yeṣām kārya dravya ādīnām ādi śabdāt dvi tva ādi parigrahaḥ tebhyaḥ tad āśraya dravyeṣu eka ākāra pratyaya utpattiḥ syāt kim kāraṇam nimitta sambhavāt

original: tathā hy anekasambandhād eva nimittāt sāmānyād ekapratyayotpattir iṣyate (|) asti cānekasambandhitvam ekapratyayanimittandravyādiṣv api | tataś cety ekapratyayapravṛtteḥ saṃkhyādīnāṃ sāmānyātmatā | anyatheti | yathoktasāmānyalakṣaṇayoge 'pi saṃkhyādiṣu sāmānyātmatā yadi neṣyate | anyatrāpi sāmānyābhimate mā bhūt | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ | viśeṣābhāvāt |
analyzed: tathā hi aneka sambandhāt eva nimittāt sāmānyāt eka pratyaya utpattiḥ iṣyate asti ca aneka sambandhi tvam eka pratyaya nimittam dravya ādiṣu api tatas ca iti eka pratyaya pravṛtteḥ saṃkhyā ādīnām sāmānya ātma tā anyathā iti yathā ukta sāmānya lakṣaṇa yoge saṃkhyā ādiṣu sāmānya ātma tā yadi na iṣyate anyatra api sāmānya abhimate mā bhūt kim kāraṇam viśeṣa abhāvāt

original: tathā ca dravyādīnām api sāmānyarūpatāpattau dravyaguṇādīnāṃ rūpasaṃkaraḥ | buddher eva pratibhāsa (p.175) iti vikalpabuddher ekākārapratibhāsaḥ sāmānyam iti sambandhaḥ | sa ca jñānarūpatvāt | jñānavat sann eva | tad uktaṃ (|)
analyzed: tathā ca dravya ādīnām api sāmānya rūpa tā āpattau dravya guṇa ādīnām rūpa saṃkaraḥ buddheḥ eva iti vikalpa buddheḥ eka ākāra pratibhāsaḥ sāmānyam iti sambandhaḥ sa ca jñāna rūpa tvāt jñāna vat san eva tat uktam

original: "sāmānyaṃ vastu rūpaṃ hi buddhyākāro bhaviṣyati |
