original: ādiśabdāc cirataraśīghratarādiparigrahaḥ | kṣetrasaṃskārādibhinnānāṃ gūḍūcyādīnām upayogād dehe ārogyādilakṣaṇasya guṇasya tāratamyaṃ ca na syāt | sāmānyasyaikyāt | atha kṣetrādibhedena sāmānyasya viśeṣa iṣyate | tadā viśeṣe vā sāmānyasyeṣyamāṇe svabhāvabhedaḥ syād viśeṣalakṣaṇatvād bhedasya | tataś ca svarūpahānaṃ | sāmānyasvarūpam ekaṃ hīyate |
analyzed: ādi śabdāt ciratara śīghratara ādi parigrahaḥ kṣetra saṃskāra ādi bhinnānām gūḍūcī ādīnām upayogāt dehe ārogya ādi lakṣaṇasya guṇasya tāratamyam ca na syāt sāmānyasya aikyāt atha kṣetra ādi bhedena sāmānyasya viśeṣaḥ iṣyate tadā viśeṣe vā sāmānyasya iṣyamāṇe svabhāva bhedaḥ syāt viśeṣa lakṣaṇa tvāt bhedasya tatas ca svarūpa hānam sāmānya svarūpam ekam hīyate

original: ghrauvyāc ca kāraṇāt sāmānyasya vyaktibhyonupakārato na sāmānyaṃ kāryakṛd iti varttate | yadi hi sāmānyam upakuryāt tadā nityatvāt sahakāribhir anādheyaviśeṣasyānyānapekṣaṇatvāt sahakāryanapekṣaṇāt tat sāmānyaṃ svakāryaṃ sakṛjjanayet | atha na janayet tadā tajjananasvabhāvaṃ na bhavati | ajananāvasthāyā aviśeṣāt kāryakālepi na janayed iti yāvat |
analyzed: ghrauvyāt ca kāraṇāt sāmānyasya vyaktibhyaḥ nupakārataḥ na sāmānyam kārya kṛt iti varttate yadi hi sāmānyam upakuryāt tadā nitya tvāt sahakāribhiḥ anādheya viśeṣasya anya anapekṣaṇa tvāt sahakāri anapekṣaṇāt tat sāmānyam sva kāryam sakṛt janayet atha na janayet tadā tat janana svabhāvam na bhavati a janana avasthāyāḥ aviśeṣāt kārya kāle api na janayet iti yāvat

original: vyaktīnāṃ tv anityānāṃ kāryakṛttve nāyaṃ doṣa ity āha – vyaktayas tv ityādi (|) saṃskāro jalāvasekādi | viśiṣṭā utpattir yāṃsāntās tathā | viśeṣosyāstīti (p.180) viśeṣavat kāryaṃ jvarādiśamanalakṣaṇaṃ | na ca tāsu vyaktiṣu yacchīghrakāritvādilakṣaṇamavāntarasāmānyam avasthin tad eva viśeṣavat kāryakārīti yuktam vaktuṃ |
analyzed: vyaktīnām tu anityānām kārya kṛt tve na ayam doṣaḥ iti āha vyaktayaḥ tu ityādi saṃskāraḥ jala avaseka ādi viśiṣṭāḥ utpattiḥ tathā viśeṣaḥ usyāḥ asti iti viśeṣavat kāryam jvara ādi śamana lakṣaṇam na ca tāsu vyaktiṣu yat śīghrakāri tva ādi lakṣaṇam avāntarasāmānyam tat eva viśeṣavat kārya kāri iti yuktam vaktum

original: oṣadhyan upayogepi puṃsaḥ tatkāryodayaprasaṅgāt | tadvad iti viśiṣṭavyaktivat | kecid iti sajātīyā ekapratyabhijñānādikaṃ | ādiśabdād ekodakādyāharaṇādi | tadakāribhya iti | pratyabhijñānādykāribhyo bhedād abhinnā ity ucyante | na tv ekasāmānyayogāt |
analyzed: upayoge api puṃsaḥ tad kārya udaya prasaṅgāt tadvat iti viśiṣṭa vyakti vat kecid iti sajātīyāḥ eka pratyabhijñāna ādikam ādi śabdāt eka udaka ādi āharaṇa ādi tat akāribhyaḥ iti pratyabhijñāna ādi kāribhyaḥ bhedāt abhinnāḥ iti ucyante na tu eka sāmānya yogāt

original: kāryadvāreṇābhedaṃ pratipādya kāraṇadvāreṇāha – ekena vetyādi | yathā prayatnena ghaṭabhedā atajjanyebhya ity aprayatnajanyebhyo bhedād abhinnā ity ucyante | yady api pratighaṭaṃ prayatnasya bhedas tathāpy ekapratyabhijñānahetutvena tasyāpy ekatvaṃ | etac cottaratra niścāyayiṣyate |
analyzed: kārya dvāreṇa abhedam pratipādya kāraṇa dvāreṇa āha ekena vā ityādi yathā prayatnena ghaṭa bhedāḥ atajjanyebhyaḥ iti aprayatna janyebhyaḥ bhedāt abhinnāḥ iti ucyante yadi api pratighaṭam prayatnasya bhedaḥ tathā api eka pratyabhijñāna hetu tvena tasya api ekatvam etat ca uttaratra niścāyayiṣyate

original: kim punar ityādi paraḥ | bhedo vyāvṛttir lakṣaṇaṃ nimittaṃ yasya tena sāmānyenātatkāryebhyo 'tatkāraṇebhyaś ca vyāvṛttaṃ svalakṣaṇaṃ samānam iti pratyeyaṃ | anyathānyad eveti svalakṣaṇād anyad vikalpabuddhiparivarttirūpam anarthakriyākāri | tena bhedalakṣaṇena sāmānyena samānam iti pratyeyaṃ |
analyzed: kim punar ityādi paraḥ bhedaḥ vyāvṛttiḥ lakṣaṇam nimittam yasya tena sāmānyena a tatkāryebhyaḥ tad kāraṇebhyaḥ ca vyāvṛttam sva lakṣaṇam samānam iti pratyeyam anyathā anyat eva iti sva lakṣaṇāt anyat vikalpa buddhi parivartti rūpam anartha kriyā kāri tena bheda lakṣaṇena sāmānyena samānam iti pratyeyam

original: nanu tad eṣāṃ buddhipratibhāsam anurundhānair buddhiviparivarttinām eva bhāvānām ākāraviśeṣaparigrahād bahir eva parisphuratāṃ sāmānyam ucyata iti pūrvam uktatvāt sandehānuvṛttir eva |
analyzed: nanu tat eṣām buddhi pratibhāsam anurundhānaiḥ buddhi viparivarttinām eva bhāvānām ākāra viśeṣa parigrahāt bahis eva parisphuratām sāmānyam ucyate iti pūrvam ukta tvāt sandeha anuvṛttiḥ eva

original: satyaṃ | kin tv adhikasya doṣasya vidhānārthaṃ upanyāsaḥ | doṣavijñānārtham āha – kiṃcāta iti | itare yadītyādinā praśnābhiprāyam āha – yadi svalakṣaṇaṃ pratyeyaṃ kathaṃ vikalpaviṣayaḥ | tathā hi vikalpabuddhyabhiprāyavaśād bhedalakṣaṇaṃ sāmānyaṃ vyavasthāpyate tasyā abhiprāyavaśāt | sāmānyaṃ satprakīrtitam iti vacanāt |
analyzed: satyam kin tu adhikasya doṣasya vidhāna artham upanyāsaḥ doṣa vijñāna artham āha kiṃca atas iti itare yadi ityādinā praśna abhiprāyam āha yadi sva lakṣaṇam pratyeyam katham vikalpa viṣayaḥ tathā hi vikalpa buddhi abhiprāya vaśāt bheda lakṣaṇam sāmānyam vyavasthāpyate tasyāḥ abhiprāya vaśāt sāmānyam sat prakīrtitam iti vacanāt

original: tathābhūtena cet sāmānyena svalakṣaṇaṃ samānaṃ pratyeyaṃ | tadā vikalpasya viṣayaḥ syāt | na caitad yuktam athānyad eva buddhiparivartti rūpaṃ samānam iti pratyeyaṃ | atrāpi doṣam āha – anyato vā katham arthakriyā (|) na hi buddhipratibhāsirūpād arthakriyā sambhavati |
analyzed: tathābhūtena ced sāmānyena sva lakṣaṇam samānam pratyeyam tadā vikalpasya viṣayaḥ syāt na ca etat yuktam atha anyat eva buddhi parivartti rūpam samānam iti pratyeyam atra api doṣam āha anyatas vā katham arthakriyā na hi buddhi pratibhāsi rūpāt arthakriyā sambhavati

original: (p.181) tataś cātatkāribhyo bhedād abhinnā ity ucyanta iti kāryadvāreṇa sāmānyavyavasthā na ghaṭate | yataś ca buddhiparivartti rūpaṃ samānan tataḥ svalakṣaṇe cānityatvādisāmānyasyāpratīter atādrūpyam anityādirūpatvaṃ svalakṣaṇasya na bhavet | svalakṣaṇe cānityatvādīnām apratītes teṣāṃ cānityatvādīnām avastudharmatā |
analyzed: tatas ca atatkāribhyaḥ bhedāt abhinnāḥ iti ucyante iti kārya dvāreṇa sāmānya vyavasthā na ghaṭate yatas ca buddhi parivarti rūpam samānan tatas sva lakṣaṇe ca anitya tva ādi sāmānyasya apratīteḥ atādrūpyam anitya ādi rūpa tvam sva lakṣaṇasya na bhavet sva lakṣaṇe ca anitya tva ādīnām apratīteḥ teṣām ca anitya tva ādīnām avastu dharma tā

original: netyādinā pariharati | buddhipratibhāsiny eva rūpe sāmānyādivyavahāra ity ayaṃ pakṣo gṛhītaḥ | tad āha – jñānapratibhāsiny artha ityādi |
analyzed: na ityādinā pariharati buddhi pratibhāsini eva rūpe sāmānya ādi vyavahāraḥ iti ayam pakṣaḥ gṛhītaḥ tat āha jñāna pratibhāsini arthaḥ ityādi

original: etac ca grahaṇakavākyaṃ | asyaiva vyākhyānaṃ | yad etajjñānaṃ vikalpakam ity anena sambandhaḥ | atadviṣayam api vastusvabhāvaviṣayam api tadviṣayam iva svalakṣaṇaviṣayam iva | adhyavasitatadbhāvam āropitabāhyabhāvaṃ svarūpaṃ yasya tattathā | yataś cādhyavasitatadbhāvamataḥ svalakṣaṇaviṣayam eveti manyate |
analyzed: etat ca grahaṇaka vākyam asya eva vyākhyānam yat etat jñānam vikalpakam iti anena sambandhaḥ a tad viṣayam api vastu svabhāva viṣayam api tad viṣayam iva sva lakṣaṇa viṣayam iva adhyavasita tad bhāvam āropita bāhya bhāvam svarūpam yasya tat tathā yatas ca adhyavasita tad bhāvam atas sva lakṣaṇa viṣayam eva iti manyate

original: adhyavasitatadbhāvasvarūpatvam eva katham iti ced āha – tadanubhavāhitavāsanāprabhavaprakṛter iti (|) tasya svalakṣaṇasya yonubhavas tenāhitā vāsanā tataḥ prabhava utpādas tasya sāmānyasya sā prakṛtiḥ svabhāvo yenādhyavasitabhāvasvarūpam bhavatīty arthaḥ | abhinnakāryā ye padārthā ghaṭādayaḥ |
analyzed: adhyavasita tad bhāva svarūpa tvam eva katham iti ced āha tad anubhava āhita vāsanā prabhava prakṛteḥ iti tasya sva lakṣaṇasya yaḥ anubhavaḥ tena āhitā vāsanā tatas prabhavaḥ utpādaḥ tasya sāmānyasya sā prakṛtiḥ svabhāvaḥ yena adhyavasita bhāva svarūpam bhavati iti arthaḥ abhinna kāryāḥ ye padārthāḥ ghaṭa ādayaḥ

original: ekākārapratyayajñānahetavas tebhyaḥ paramparayā prasūter abhinnārthagrāhīva pratibhāti | na tu sāmānyavastubhūtaṃ kiṃcid vyatiriktam avyatiriktam vā 'sti yad tad gṛhṇīyāt | paramārthas tu tadanyabhedasamākāraṃ tebhyaḥ sajātīyābhimatebhyo 'nye vijātīyās tebhyo bhedaḥ bhinnaḥ svabhāvaḥ sa eva paramārthena samāna ākāro yasyeti vigrahaḥ |
analyzed: eka ākāra pratyaya jñāna hetavaḥ tebhyaḥ paramparayā prasūteḥ abhinna artha grāhi iva pratibhāti na tu sāmānya vastu bhūtam kiṃcid vyatiriktam a vyatiriktam vā sti yat tat gṛhṇīyāt paramārthaḥ tu tad anya bheda sama ākāram tebhyaḥ sajātīya abhimatebhyaḥ nye vijātīyāḥ tebhyaḥ bhedaḥ bhinnaḥ svabhāvaḥ saḥ eva paramārthena samānaḥ ākāraḥ yasya iti vigrahaḥ

original: tata eva tasyotpattes tannivartanatvāc ca tadanyabhedas tasya samāna ākāra ity ucyate |
analyzed: tatas eva tasya utpatteḥ tad nivartana tvāt ca tad anya bhedaḥ tasya samānaḥ ākāraḥ iti ucyate

original: tatrānantarokte jñāne eka iveti sarvavyaktyanugata iva | tatkārīvety arthakriyākārīva | kiṃ punas tathā pratibhātīti ced āha – vyavahāriṇām ityādi | tathādhyavasāyeti vikalpāṃśam eva bāhyatvenaikatvenārthakriyākāritvenādhyavasāyavyavahāriṇāṃ (p.182) pravṛtteḥ | vyavahāribhir ity anye paṭhanti |
analyzed: tatra anantara ukte jñāne ekaḥ iva iti sarva vyakti anugataḥ iva tad kārī iva iti arthakriyā kārī iva kim punar tathā pratibhāti iti ced āha vyavahāriṇām ityādi tathā adhyavasāya iti vikalpa aṃśam eva bāhya tvena ekatvena arthakriyā kāri tvena adhyavasāya vyavahāriṇām pravṛtteḥ vyavahāribhiḥ iti anye paṭhanti

original: vyavahāribhir ity adhyavasāyety anena pūrvasambandhāt tṛtīyaiva kṛtā | na tu ṣaṣṭhī | na lokāvyayaniṣṭhetiṣaṣṭhī pratiṣedhāt | anyatheti yadi vikalpāṃśe bāhyādhyavasāyo na bhavet tadā tathā bhūte vikalpe jātepy arthakriyākāriṇī pravṛttir na syāt | tad api vikalpapratibimbakaṃ vyavaharttṛpuruṣādhyavasāyavaśād arthakriyākāritayā pratibhāsate |
analyzed: vyavahāribhiḥ iti adhyavasāya iti anena pūrva sambandhāt tṛtīyā eva kṛtā na tu ṣaṣṭhī na loka avyaya niṣṭhā iti ṣaṣṭhī pratiṣedhāt anyathā iti yadi vikalpa aṃśe bāhya adhyavasāyaḥ na bhavet tadā tathā bhūte vikalpe jāte api arthakriyā kāriṇī pravṛttiḥ na syāt tat api vikalpa pratibimbakam vyavaharttṛ puruṣa adhyavasāya vaśāt arthakriyā kāritayā pratibhāsate

original: tataś ca tadatatkāribhyo bhinnam iva | vikalpaprativimbakam eva tattvaṃ kasmān neti ced āha – na cetyādi | tadvikalpaprativimbakan na tattvaṃ na vastu | kiṅ kāraṇaṃ (|) anarthakriyākāritvena parīkṣāyā vyabhicārasyānaṅgatvāt | etac cānantaram eva pratipādayiṣyāmaḥ |
analyzed: tatas ca tad atatkāribhyaḥ bhinnam iva vikalpa prativimbakam eva tattvam kasmāt na iti ced āha na ca ityādi tad vikalpa prativimbakan na tattvam na vastu kim kāraṇam anartha kriyā kāri tvena parīkṣāyāḥ vyabhicārasya anaṅga tvāt etat ca anantaram eva pratipādayiṣyāmaḥ

original: tatra ye svalakṣa(ṇa)dvārā yātā arthākārā vikalpabuddhau pratibhānti te 'rthā vikalpabuddhipratibhāsinas tena bhedalakṣaṇena sāmānyena samānā iti gṛhyante | kutaścid vyāvṛttā (i)ti vijātīyavyāvṛttyā | tathā hi (|) vikalpapratibhāsinopi vṛkṣabhedā adhyavasitabāhyarūpatvād avṛkṣebhyo vyāvṛttā iva bhāsante | tathānyeti |
analyzed: tatra ye sva lakṣaṇa dvārā yātāḥ artha ākārāḥ vikalpa buddhau pratibhānti te rthāḥ vikalpa buddhi pratibhāsinaḥ tena bheda lakṣaṇena sāmānyena samānāḥ iti gṛhyante kutaścid vyāvṛttāḥ iti vijātīya vyāvṛttyā tathā hi vikalpa pratibhāsinaḥ api vṛkṣa bhedāḥ adhyavasita bāhya rūpa tvāt a vṛkṣebhyaḥ vyāvṛttāḥ iva bhāsante tathā anyā iti

original: na svalakṣaṇan tena samānam iti gṛhyata iti liṅgavacana(vi)pariṇāmena sambandhaḥ | kiṅ kāraṇaṃ (|) tatra sāmānyapratibhāsini vikalpe svalakṣaṇāpratibhāsanāt |
analyzed: na tena samānam iti gṛhyate iti liṅga vacana vipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ kim kāraṇam tatra sāmānya pratibhāsini vikalpe sva lakṣaṇa a pratibhāsanāt

original: etan tāvad buddhipratibhāsiny arthe sāmānyavyavahāra uktaḥ | saṃprati sāmānādhikaraṇyavyavahāram āha – ta evetyādi | ta eva vikalpapratibhāsinorthāḥ |
analyzed: etat tāvat buddhi pratibhāsini arthe sāmānya vyavahāraḥ uktaḥ saṃprati sāmānādhikaraṇya vyavahāram āha te eva ityādi te eva vikalpa pratibhāsinā arthāḥ

original: kutaścid vyāvṛttā iva santo yathānutpalād vyāvṛttā utpalabhedās ta eva puanr anyatopy anīlād vyāvṛttimantaḥ pratibhānti (|) tataś ca vyāvṛttidvayānugatasyaikasyaiva dharmiṇaḥ pratibhāsanāt sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ |
analyzed: kutaścid vyāvṛttāḥ iva santaḥ yathā anutpalāt vyāvṛttāḥ utpala bhedāḥ te eva anyatas api anīlāt vyāvṛttimantaḥ pratibhānti tatas ca vyāvṛtti dvaya anugatasya ekasya eva dharmiṇaḥ pratibhāsanāt sāmānādhikaraṇyam

original: ayaṃ cānantarānukrānto buddhipratibhāsiṣvrtheṣu sāmānyasāmānādhikaraṇyavyavahāro mithyārtha eva kriyate | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) svayam asatām api vikalpākārāṇān tathā ekākārānugatatvena | vyāvṛttidvayānugatena dharmmasvarūpeṇa | vikalpabuddhyopadarśanāt | (p.183) ekākāreṇapratibhāsanāt sāmānyavyavahāraḥ |
analyzed: ayam ca anantara anukrāntaḥ buddhi pratibhāsiṣu ṛtheṣu sāmānya sāmānādhikaraṇya vyavahāraḥ mithyā arthaḥ eva kriyate kim kāraṇam svayam asatām api tathā eka ākāra anugata tvena vyāvṛtti dvaya anugatena dharmma svarūpeṇa vikalpa buddhyā upadarśanāt eka ākāreṇa pratibhāsanāt sāmānya vyavahāraḥ

original: anekākāreṇa caikasya pratibhāsanāt sāmānādhikaraṇyavyavahāraḥ |
analyzed: aneka ākāreṇa ca ekasya pratibhāsanāt sāmānādhikaraṇya vyavahāraḥ

original: yadi mithyārtha eva sarvo vikalpaḥ kasmāt kṛtakatvādidvārāyātā anityānātmādivikalpāḥ pramāṇaṃ nityā vikalpās tu nety ata āha – sarvaś cāyam ityādi | sarvo viplava iti sambandhaḥ | viplavo bhrāntiḥ | ayam iti sāmānyādirūpaḥ | svalakṣaṇānām eva yaddarśanan tenāhitā yā vāsanā tatkṛtaḥ | paramparayā sarvavikalpānām vastudarśanadvārāyātatvāt |
analyzed: yadi mithyārthaḥ eva sarvaḥ vikalpaḥ kasmāt kṛtaka tva ādi dvāra āyātāḥ anitya anātma ādi vikalpāḥ pramāṇam nityāḥ vikalpāḥ tu na iti atas āha sarvaḥ ca ayam ityādi sarvaḥ viplavaḥ iti sambandhaḥ viplavaḥ bhrāntiḥ ayam iti sāmānya ādi rūpaḥ sva lakṣaṇānām eva tena āhitā yā vāsanā tad kṛtaḥ paramparayā sarva vikalpānām vastu darśana dvāra āyāta tvāt

original: tathā hi nityādivikalpā api vastudarśanenaivotpannāḥ sadṛśāparāparotpattidarśanāyātatvāt | tatra tulye sarvavikalpānām vastudarśanadvārāyātatve | tatpratibaddhajanmanām anityādivikalpānām atatpratibhāsitvepi svalakṣaṇāpratibhāsitvepi vastuny avisamvādaḥ |
analyzed: tathā hi nitya ādi vikalpāḥ api vastu darśanena eva utpannāḥ sadṛśa apara apara utpatti darśana āyāta tvāt tatra tulye sarva vikalpānām vastu darśana dvāra āyāta tve tad pratibaddha janmanām anitya ādi vikalpānām a tad pratibhāsi tve pi sva lakṣaṇa a pratibhāsi tve pi vastuni avisamvādaḥ

original: adhyastasyānityādirūpasya vastuni vidyamānatvāt kevalaṃ svalakṣaṇarūpeṇa na pratibhāsata iti vikalpo vibhrama ucyate | maṇiprabhāyām iva maṇibhrānter maṇisvarūpāgrahepy avisamvādo maṇiprabhāyā maṇau pratibaddhatvāt | prabhāśrayeṇa ca maṇibhrānter utpatteḥ |
analyzed: adhyastasya anitya ādi rūpasya vastuni vidyamāna tvāt kevalam sva lakṣaṇa rūpeṇa na pratibhāsate iti vikalpaḥ vibhramaḥ ucyate maṇi prabhāyām iva maṇi bhrānteḥ maṇi svarūpa agrahe pi avisamvādaḥ maṇi prabhāyāḥ maṇau pratibaddha tvāt prabhā āśrayeṇa ca maṇi bhrānteḥ utpatteḥ

original: na tv evan nityādivikalpās teṣām vastudarśanadvārāyātatvepi vastuny avidyamānasyaivākārasya samāropāt | tad āha – nānyeṣām ityādi | anyeṣāṃ nityādivikalpānāṃ vastuni samvāda ity anena sambandhaḥ | tadbhedaprabhave saty apīti | arthābhedād utpādepi satīty arthaḥ |
analyzed: na tu evat nitya ādi vikalpāḥ teṣām vastu darśana dvāra āyāta tve pi vastuni avidyamānasya eva ākārasya samāropāt tat āha na anyeṣām ityādi anyeṣām nitya ādi vikalpānām vastuni samvādaḥ iti anena sambandhaḥ tad bheda prabhave sati api iti artha abhedāt utpāde api sati iti arthaḥ

original: yathā dṛṣṭo yo viśeṣaḥ kṣaṇikatvādilakṣaṇas tasyānusaraṇaṃ niścayaṃ parityajya kiñcitsāmānyam iti vyatiriktasyāvyatiriktasya vā sāmānyasya grahaṇena viśeṣāt tasya sthiratvādeḥ samāropāt | dīpaprabhāyām iva bhāsuratvādisāmyāt pravṛttāyā maṇibuddher na maṇivastusamvādaḥ | pāramparyeṇāpy adhyavasite maṇāvapratibaddhatvāt |
analyzed: yathā dṛṣṭaḥ yaḥ viśeṣaḥ kṣaṇika tva ādi lakṣaṇaḥ tasya anusaraṇam niścayam parityajya kiñcid sāmānyam iti vyatiriktasya avyatiriktasya vā sāmānyasya grahaṇena viśeṣāt tasya sthira tva ādeḥ samāropāt dīpa prabhāyām iva bhāsura tva ādi sāmyāt pravṛttāyāḥ maṇi buddheḥ na maṇi vastu samvādaḥ pāramparyeṇa api adhyavasite maṇau apratibaddha tvāt

original: yataś ca mithyārthā eva vikalpās tena na vikalpaviśayeṣv arthakriyākāritvaṃ (|) tataś ca yaduktam anyato vā katham arthakriyeti tatsiddhaṃ sādhyate |
analyzed: yatas ca mithyā arthāḥ eva vikalpāḥ tena na vikalpa viśayeṣu arthakriyā kāri tvam tatas ca yat uktam anyatas vā katham arthakriyā iti tat siddham sādhyate

original: kathan tarhy atatkārivyavacchedalakṣaṇaṃ sāmānyaṃ vikalpaviṣayeṣv artheṣu vyavasthāpyata iti cet | na | bahir iva parisphuratām ekārthakriyākāritayā tadakāribhyo bhinnānām iva (p.184) pratibhāsanāt | yac coktaṃ (|) svalakṣaṇe cānityatvādyapratīter atādrūpyam iti tatparihārārtham āha – nāpītyādi | calād vastuno yasmān nānityatvan nāma kiñcid asti |
analyzed: kathan tarhi atatkāri vyavaccheda lakṣaṇam sāmānyam vikalpa viṣayeṣu artheṣu vyavasthāpyate iti ced na bahis iva parisphuratām ekārtha kriyā kāri tayā tad akāribhyaḥ bhinnānām iva pratibhāsanāt yat ca uktam sva lakṣaṇe ca anitya tva ādi apratīteḥ atādrūpyam iti tad parihāra artham āha nā api ityādi calāt vastunaḥ yasmāt na anitya tvat nāma kiñcid asti

original: yenāsambaddhāt svalakṣaṇasyānityatvenāyogaḥ syāt | kin tu calam eva vastu nityaṃ svalakṣaṇasyaivānityarūpatvād evamanātmādy api draṣṭavyaṃ | tena pratyakṣeṇa svalakṣaṇe gṛhyamāṇe 'nityatvaṃ gṛhītam eva kevalaṃ bhrāntinimittasadbhāvād aniścitam (|) atas tanniścayamātre 'numānavyāpāras tena tanniścaya eva svalakṣaṇe 'nityatvapratītir iti siddhaṃ |
analyzed: yena asambaddhāt sva lakṣaṇasya anitya tvena ayogaḥ syāt kin tu calam eva vastu nityam sva lakṣaṇasya eva anitya rūpatvāt evam anātma ādi api draṣṭavyam tena pratyakṣeṇa sva lakṣaṇe gṛhyamāṇe nitya tvam gṛhītam eva kevalam bhrānti nimitta sadbhāvāt aniścitam atas tad niścaya mātre numāna vyāpāraḥ tena tad niścaye eva sva lakṣaṇe nitya tva pratītiḥ iti siddham

original: yadi svalakṣaṇam evānityaṃ katham anityoyam artho 'nityatvam asyeti vā dharmidharmarūpatayā pratītir ity ata āha – kṣaṇetyādi | svalakṣaṇasya tathābhūtasyeti calarūpasya kṣaṇāpratyupasthānatayā | ekakṣaṇasthāyitvena grahaṇād uttarakālamantyakṣaṇadarśinām etad evambhavaty anityoyam ityādi |
analyzed: yadi sva lakṣaṇam eva anityam katham anityaḥ ayam arthaḥ nitya tvam asya iti vā dharmi dharma rūpatayā pratītiḥ iti atas āha kṣaṇa ityādi sva lakṣaṇasya tathābhūtasya iti cala rūpasya kṣaṇa a pratyupasthāna tayā eka kṣaṇa sthāyi tvena grahaṇāt uttarakālam antya kṣaṇa darśinām etat evam bhavati anityaḥ yam ityādi

original: bhedāntarāpratikṣepavivakṣāyām anityoyam iti bhedāntarapratikṣepavivakṣāyām anityatvam asyetyevaṃ dharmidharmabhāvapratītir bhavati |
analyzed: bheda antara a pratikṣepa vivakṣāyām anityaḥ ayam iti bheda antara pratikṣepa vivakṣāyām anitya tvam asya iti evam dharmi dharma bhāva pratītiḥ bhavati

original: vikalpakalpitatvāt kathaṃ bāhye dharmadharmibhāva ity ata āha – taddharmatām ityādi | taddharmatāṃ svalakṣaṇadharmatām evāvatarantaḥ svalakṣaṇam adhyavasyanto vikalpā ity arthaḥ | vyāvṛttibhede kṛtasaṃketaśabdānusāreṇa nānārūpā ekarūpāś ca dharmās te ca vyatirekāś ceti dvandvaḥ | nānādharmān anityakṛtakatvādīn |
analyzed: vikalpa kalpita tvāt katham bāhye dharma dharmi bhāvaḥ iti atas āha tad dharma tām ityādi tad dharma tām sva lakṣaṇa dharma tām eva avatarantaḥ sva lakṣaṇam adhyavasyantaḥ vikalpāḥ iti arthaḥ vyāvṛtti bhede kṛta saṃketa śabda anusāreṇa nānā rūpāḥ eka rūpāḥ ca dharmāḥ te ca vyatirekāḥ ca iti dvandvaḥ nānā dharmān anitya kṛtaka tva ādīn

original: ekaṃ dharmaṃ bahūnāṃ ghaṭādīnām anityatvaṃ vyatirekaś ca ghaṭādīnām anityatvam iti darśayanti | vastunīty adhyāhāraḥ | na ca vikalpavyavasthāpitannānaikadharmādikan tattvam vikalpasyāvastugrāhitvād (|) ata evāha (|) darśayantīti |
analyzed: ekam dharmam bahūnām ghaṭa ādīnām anitya tvam vyatirekaḥ ca ghaṭa ādīnām anitya tvam iti darśayanti vastuni iti adhyāhāraḥ na ca tattvam vikalpasya avastu grāhi tvāt atas eva āha darśayanti iti

original: avastugrāhitvāt tarhi te nirāśrayāḥ prāpnuvantīti ced āha – na ca ta iti | na iti nānādharmādidarśakā vikalpavastubhedasyānityādirūpasya svalakṣaṇasya yad darśanam anubhavas tadāśrayatvād vikalpānāṃ | tathā hi paramārtho 'nityādirūpaṃ svalakṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā darśanasāmarthyabhāvino vikalpā dṛṣṭākārādhyavasāyena pravarttante |
analyzed: avastu grāhi tvāt tarhi te nirāśrayāḥ prāpnuvanti iti ced āha na ca te iti naḥ iti nānā dharma ādi darśakāḥ vikalpa vastu bhedasya anitya ādi rūpasya sva lakṣaṇasya yat darśanam anubhavaḥ tad āśraya tvāt vikalpānām tathā hi paramārthaḥ nitya ādi rūpam sva lakṣaṇam dṛṣṭvā darśana sāmarthya bhāvinaḥ vikalpāḥ dṛṣṭa ākāra adhyavasāyena pravarttante

original: yataś ca yathāḍṛṣṭasyaivābhilapanena pravarttante vikalpā anityākārā nārthāntaran nityatvādivikalpavad anusaranti | tato yad uktaṃ (|) teṣāṃ cāvastu dharmateti parihṛtam bhavatīty āha – neti | teṣām anityatvādīnāṃ nāvastudharmatā | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ | tatsvabhāvasyaiva tathānityādidharmatayā khyāteḥ pratibhāsanād adhyavasāyād iti yāvat |
analyzed: yatas ca yathā ḍṛṣṭasya eva abhilapanena pravarttante vikalpāḥ anitya ākārāḥ nitya tva ādi vikalpa vat anusaranti tatas yat uktam teṣām ca avastu dharma tā iti parihṛtam bhavati iti āha na iti teṣām anitya tva ādīnām na avastu dharma tā kim kāraṇam tad svabhāvasya eva tathā anitya ādi dharma tayā khyāteḥ pratibhāsanāt adhyavasāyāt iti yāvat

original: yadi (p.185) vastudharma evānityatvādikaṃ khyāti | kas tarhi vikalpakṛto vibhrama ity āha – vastunas tv ityādi | ekasya vastuno nānārūpeṇa grahaḥ | bahūnāṃ caikatvena | dharmadharmiṇoś ca vyatirekeṇa graho vibhramo bhrānta ity arthaḥ | kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇam ekatvādigraho vibhrama ity āha – tasyaikāneketyādi |
analyzed: yadi vastu dharmaḥ eva anitya tva ādikam khyāti kaḥ tarhi vikalpa kṛtaḥ vibhramaḥ iti āha vastunaḥ tu ityādi ekasya vastunaḥ nānā rūpeṇa grahaḥ bahūnām ca ekatvena dharma dharmiṇoḥ ca vyatirekeṇa grahaḥ vibhramaḥ bhrāntaḥ iti arthaḥ kim punar kāraṇam ekatva ādi grahaḥ vibhramaḥ iti āha tasya eka aneka ityādi

original: ekakāraykāriṇo ghaṭādibhedasyaikodakādyāharaṇādikāryakāriṇaḥ | tathā bhāvijijñāsāsu | ekakāryakarttṛtvajijñāsāsu | tathābhāvakhyāpanāyaikakāryakāritvakhyāpanāya | tathākṛtasthititvāt | ghaṭādinā ekarūpeṇa vyavahāralāghavārtham vyavasthāpitatvāt | tathakasyāpyanekāryakāriṇaḥ |
analyzed: eka kāraykāriṇaḥ ghaṭa ādi bhedasya eka udaka ādi āharaṇa ādi kārya kāriṇaḥ tathā bhāvi jijñāsāsu eka kārya karttṛ tva jijñāsāsu tathā bhāva khyāpanāya eka kārya kāri tva khyāpanāya tathā kṛta sthiti tvāt ghaṭa ādinā eka rūpeṇa vyavahāra lāghava artham vyavasthāpita tvāt tathakasya api aneka ārya kāriṇaḥ

original: yathā ghaṭasya cakṣurvijñānodakadhāraṇakādācitkajñānādikāryakāriṇas tathābhāvajijñāsāsu tathābhāvakhyāpanāya | anekakāryatvakhyāpanāya tathākṛtasthitatvāt | cākṣuṣapārthivānityādirūpeṇa vyavasthāpitatvāt | evam anyatrāpi yathāyogaṃ vācyaṃ | na vastubhedād ekasmin padārthe 'nekadharmavyavasthāpanaṃ |
analyzed: yathā ghaṭasya cakṣuḥ vijñāna udaka dhāraṇa kādācitka jñāna ādi kārya kāriṇaḥ tathābhāva jijñāsāsu tathābhāva khyāpanāya aneka kāryatva khyāpanāya tathākṛta sthita tvāt cākṣuṣa pārthiva anitya ādi rūpeṇa vyavasthāpita tvāt evam anyatra api yathāyogam vācyam na vastu bhedāt ekasmin padārthe neka dharma vyavasthāpanam

original: kiṅ kāraṇaṃ (|) tasyaivaikasya vastuno 'nekatvāyogāt (|) tataś caikasyānekatvagrāho vibhrama ity ākhyātaṃ | tathānekasyāpy ekatvavyavasthāpanan tadakāryavyāvṛttidvāreṇaiva na vastvabhedād ity āha – anekasya caikatvāyogād iti | tathā cānekasyaikatvagraho vibhramaḥ | evaṃ dharmadharmiṇor vyatirekagrahopi bhrānta eva |
analyzed: kim kāraṇam tasya eva ekasya vastunaḥ neka tva ayogāt tatas ca ekasya aneka tva grāhaḥ vibhramaḥ iti ākhyātam tathā anekasya api ekatva vyavasthāpanan tad akārya vyāvṛtti dvāreṇa eva na vastu abhedāt iti āha anekasya ca ekatva ayogāt iti tathā ca anekasya ekatva grahaḥ vibhramaḥ evam dharma dharmiṇoḥ vyatireka grahaḥ api bhrāntaḥ eva

original: kiṅ kāraṇaṃ (|) vyatiriktasya ca sāmānyasya prāg eva niṣedhāt | vyaktayo nānuyanty anyad ityādinā |
analyzed: kim kāraṇam vyatiriktasya ca sāmānyasya prāk eva niṣedhāt vyaktayaḥ na anuyanti anyat ityādinā

original: dharmiṇaḥ sakāśād vyatiriktā eva dharmās tataś ca yathāvastu śabdārtho bhaviṣyatīty āha – teṣām ityādi | teṣām anityatvādīnāṃ dharmāṇāṃ prakṛteḥ svabhāvasya bhedāt kāraṇād yathāvastu śabdārthābhyupagame nīlotpalam anityaḥ śabda ityādi sāmānādhikaraṇyāyogāt | nīlādiguṇānām utpalādijātīnāñ ca parasparaṃ svabhāvabhedāt |
analyzed: dharmiṇaḥ sakāśāt vyatiriktāḥ eva dharmāḥ tatas ca yathāvastu śabda arthaḥ bhaviṣyati iti āha teṣām ityādi teṣām anitya tva ādīnām dharmāṇām prakṛteḥ svabhāvasya bhedāt kāraṇāt yathāvastu śabda artha abhyupagame nīlotpalam anityaḥ śabdaḥ ityādi sāmānādhikaraṇya ayogāt nīla ādi guṇānām utpala ādi jātīnām ca parasparam svabhāva bhedāt

original: tadvācināṃ śabdānām ekasminn adhikaraṇe vṛttir nāstīti sāmānādhikaraṇyāyogaḥ | tasmān na yathāvastu śabdārthavyavastheti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: tad vācinām śabdānām ekasmin adhikaraṇe vṛttiḥ na asti iti sāmānādhikaraṇya ayogaḥ tasmāt na yathāvastu śabda artha vyavasthā iti bhāvaḥ

original: (p.186) tadupādher ityādinā parābhiprāyam āśaṃkate | te nīlādayo dharmā upādhir yasya dravyasya tasyaikasya dvābhyāṃ guṇajātibhyām abhidhānād adoṣaḥ | sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvadoṣo nāsti | uttaram āha (|) anupakāriṇītyādi | upādhitvenābhimatānāṃ nīlādīnāṃ dharmāṇām anupakārakandravyaṃ |
analyzed: tad upādheḥ ityādinā para abhiprāyam āśaṃkate te nīla ādayaḥ dharmāḥ upādhiḥ yasya dravyasya tasya ekasya dvābhyām guṇa jātibhyām abhidhānāt adoṣaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇya abhāva doṣaḥ na asti uttaram āha anupakāriṇī ityādi upādhi tvena abhimatānām nīla ādīnām dharmāṇām anupakārakam dravyam

original: na hi nīlaguṇasyotpalatvajāter vā dravyeṇopakāraḥ kaścid kriyate (|) tataś cānupakāriṇi dravye tadanādheyavṛttīnāṃ nīlādīnāṃ pāratantryāyogāt | nīlādayo dharmā anupādhiḥ | pāratantryābhāvāt | anyathāsyāyam upādhir ity eva na syāt |
analyzed: na hi nīla guṇasya utpala tva jāteḥ vā dravyeṇa upakāraḥ kaścid kriyate tatas ca anupakāriṇi dravye tad anādheya vṛttīnām nīla ādīnām pāratantrya ayogāt nīla ādayaḥ dharmāḥ anupādhiḥ pāratantrya abhāvāt anyathā asya ayam upādhiḥ iti eva na syāt

original: atheṣyate dravyaviṣayaṃ pāratantryaṃ dharmāṇān tadā pāratantryepi dravyajanyatvam aṅgīkarttavyam anyathā dravyapāratantryāyogāt | janakaṃ ca kṣaṇikam eṣṭavyam kṣaṇikasyārthakriyāyogāt | tataś ca kāryābhimatānām upādhīnāṃ kāraṇābhimatasya ca dravyasya sahānavasthiteḥ kāraṇāt |
analyzed: atha iṣyate dravya viṣayam pāratantryam tadā pāratantrye api dravya janya tvam aṅgīkarttavyam anyathā dravya pāratantrya ayogāt janakam ca kṣaṇikam eṣṭavyam kṣaṇikasya arthakriyā yogāt tatas ca kārya abhimatānām upādhīnām kāraṇa abhimatasya ca dravyasya saha anavasthiteḥ kāraṇāt

original: dvayor viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayor vasturūpayor yugapadanabhidhānaṃ (|) kāraṇābhimatasya viśeṣasya tadānīṃ nirodhāt | ekasyeti viśiṣṭasyāpy upādhimataḥ | adhyāhāra upadarśanan tadā na vastuviṣayaḥ śabdārthaḥ syāt | buddhyāropitasyaiva viśeṣasya śabdenābhidhānāt |
analyzed: dvayoḥ viśeṣaṇa viśeṣyayoḥ vastu rūpayoḥ yugapad anabhidhānam kāraṇa abhimatasya viśeṣasya tadānīm nirodhāt ekasya iti viśiṣṭasya api upādhimataḥ adhyāhāraḥ tadā na vastu viṣayaḥ śabda arthaḥ syāt buddhi āropitasya eva viśeṣasya śabdena abhidhānāt

original: syan mataṃ (|) yadvinaṣṭaṃ viśeṣyan tadviṣayasya śabdasya bhavatu buddhipratibhāsaviṣayatvaṃ (|) yaḥ punaḥ sann evopādhis tadācinaḥ śabdasya vastuviṣayatvam evāstv iti ced āha – buddhipratibhāsetyādi |
analyzed: matam yat vinaṣṭam viśeṣyan tad viṣayasya śabdasya bhavatu buddhi pratibhāsa viṣaya tvam yaḥ punar san eva upādhiḥ śabdasya vastu viṣaya tvam eva astu iti ced āha buddhi pratibhāsa ityādi

original: buddhipratibhāso viṣayo yasyābhidhānasya tat tathā (|) tadbhāvas tasmin sati sarvaṃ viśeṣaṇaviṣayābhimatam apy abhidhānan tathaiva vikalpabuddhipratibhāsaviṣayam evāstu | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tathā bhinnopādhimato nānāviśeṣaṇavata ekasya grahaṇe buddhāv abhāsanāt |
analyzed: buddhi pratibhāsaḥ viṣayaḥ yasya abhidhānasya tat tathā tad bhāvaḥ tasmin sati sarvam viśeṣaṇa viṣaya abhimatam api abhidhānan tathā eva vikalpa buddhi pratibhāsa viṣayam eva astu kim kāraṇam tathā bhinna upādhimataḥ nānā viśeṣaṇavataḥ ekasya grahaṇe buddhau abhāsanāt

original: tathā hy apādhimato vinaṣṭasyādhyāhārikā vikalpabuddhir aṅgīkarttavyā (|) tadā copādhimato 'bhāve upādher apy abhāvaḥ pāratantryābhāvāt (|) bhinnopādhimata ekasyāpratibhāsane kutaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ |
analyzed: tathā hi apādhimataḥ vinaṣṭasya ādhyāhārikā vikalpa buddhiḥ aṅgīkarttavyā tadā ca upādhimataḥ bhāve upādheḥ api abhāvaḥ pāratantrya abhāvāt bhinna upādhimataḥ ekasya apratibhāsane kutas sāmānādhikaraṇyam

original: yadā tu viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayor dvayor api vikalpabuddhipratibhāsitvam iṣṭan tadā kalpita dharmadvayagṛhītaikadharmipratibhāsiny ekaiva buddhir jāyata ity aviruddhaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ |
analyzed: yadā tu viśeṣaṇa viśeṣyayoḥ dvayoḥ api vikalpa buddhi pratibhāsi tvam tadā kalpita dharma dvaya gṛhīta eka dharmi pratibhāsinī ekā eva buddhiḥ jāyate iti aviruddham sāmānādhikaraṇyam

original: upakāryetyādinā parābhiprāyam āśaṃkate | adoṣo yoyam ekasya buddhyādhyāhāra ityādinoktaḥ | upādhimatā samakālasya niṣpannarūpasyopādheḥ pāratantryābhāvād anupādhitvaṃ | prāk pāratantryan tadevopādhitvam iti ced āha – netyādi |
analyzed: upakārya ityādinā para abhiprāyam āśaṃkate adoṣaḥ yaḥ yam ekasya buddhyā adhyāhāraḥ ityādinā uktaḥ upādhimatā sama kālasya niṣpanna rūpasya upādheḥ pāratantrya abhāvāt anupādhi tvam prāk tat eva upādhi tvam iti ced āha na ityādi

original: na hy aniṣpannasya (p.187) śaśaviṣāṇatulyasya pāratantryam upādhitvam vā (|) sarvathā sato 'sataś cāsatpāratantryam iti hetoḥ kalpanāropitam upādhīnām pāratantryaṃ kṛtvā pāratantryavyavahāre | sarvatheti sarveṇa prakāreṇa yathā pāratantryavyavahāre buddhir anuvidhīyate tathā viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyavyavahāre saivāropikā buddhiḥ kin nānuvidhīyate |
analyzed: na hi aniṣpannasya śaśaviṣāṇa tulyasya pāratantryam upādhi tvam vā sarvathā sataḥ sataḥ ca asat pāratantryam iti hetoḥ kalpanā āropitam upādhīnām pāratantryam kṛtvā pāratantrya vyavahāre sarvathā iti sarveṇa prakāreṇa yathā pāratantrya vyavahāre buddhiḥ anuvidhīyate tathā viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya vyavahāre sā eva āropikā buddhiḥ kin na anuvidhīyate

original: tadanuvidhānaṃ hi nyāyyaṃ buddhisandarśatārthapratibhāsamanāśritya vyavaharttum aśakyatvāt | vastuna ekena śabdena pramānena ca viṣayīkaraṇe vastubalād vastusvabhāvabhūtāśeṣadharmākṣepāt tadanyasya śabdāder vaiyarthya ca yatprāguktam ekasyārthasvabhāvasya pratyakṣasyetyādi |
analyzed: tad anuvidhānam hi nyāyyam buddhi sandarśa tārtha pratibhāsam an āśritya vyavaharttum aśakya tvāt vastunaḥ ekena śabdena pramānena ca viṣayīkaraṇe vastu balāt vastu svabhāva bhūta aśeṣa dharma ākṣepāt tad anyasya śabda ādeḥ vaiyarthya ca yat prāguktam ekasya artha svabhāvasya pratyakṣasya ityādi

original: vastuvādipakṣe tadbuddhipratibhāsānurodhena syāt | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) buddhipratibhāsasya nirvastukatvād vastusāmarthyabhāvinān doṣānām aprasaṅgaḥ | bahuvacanenaitad āha – na kevalaṃ tadanyavaiyarthyadoṣasyāprasaṅgas tathā vyatiriktasya sāmānyasyābhāva upādhīnāṃ ca paratantryāyogāt |
analyzed: vastuvādi pakṣe tad buddhi pratibhāsa anurodhena syāt kim kāraṇam buddhi pratibhāsasya nirvastuka tvāt vastu sāmarthya bhāvinān doṣānām aprasaṅgaḥ bahuvacanena etat āha na kevalam tad anya vaiyarthya doṣasya aprasaṅgaḥ tathā vyatiriktasya sāmānyasya abhāvaḥ upādhīnām ca paratantrya ayogāt

original: viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyatvābhāvaḥ bhinnotpādhimata ekasya buddhāv apratibhāsanāt (|) sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvaś ca ya uktas teṣām apy atra sambhavo nāstīti tad evāha – tadabhinnam ityādi | tathā hi tadbuddhipratibhāsi rūpam abhinnam pratibhāti | tasmāt sāmānyaṃ yathā pratītir na virudhyata iti vacanapariṇāmaṃ kṛtvā vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ |
analyzed: viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya tva abhāvaḥ ekasya buddhau apratibhāsanāt sāmānādhikaraṇya abhāvaḥ ca yaḥ uktaḥ teṣām api atra sambhavaḥ na asti iti tat eva āha tat abhinnam ityādi tathā hi tad buddhi pratibhāsi rūpam abhinnam pratibhāti tasmāt sāmānyam yathā pratītiḥ na virudhyate iti vacana pariṇāmam kṛtvā vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ

original: nīlam ity ukte 'nīlavyāvṛttyā nīlatvasyaikasyākārasya viṣayīkaraṇepi vikalpabuddhyā tatraiva nīlākāre saṃśayavyāvṛttir nākārāntare (|) tatas tadbuddhipratibhāsi rūpam aniścitādyākāram anutpalavyāvṛttotpalākārasyāniścayāt |
analyzed: nīlam iti ukte nīla vyāvṛttyā nīla tvasya ekasya ākārasya viṣayīkaraṇe api vikalpa buddhyā tatra eva nīla ākāre saṃśaya vyāvṛttiḥ na ākāra antare tatas tad buddhi pratibhāsi rūpam aniścita ādi ākāram anutpala vyāvṛtta utpala ākārasya aniścayāt

original: yasminn ākāre niścayo notpannas tadākārāntaran tatra sākāṃkṣayotpalaśabdaprayogād utpannayā buddhyā grāhyaṃ pratibhātīti sambandhaḥ |
analyzed: yasmin ākāre niścayaḥ na utpannaḥ tad ākāra antaran tatra sākāṃkṣayā utpala śabda prayogāt utpannayā buddhyā grāhyam pratibhāti iti sambandhaḥ

original: etena viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvasya nimittam uktaṃ (|) sāmānādhikaraṇasyāha – bhinnetyādi | bhinnasya śabdārthasya nīlotpalalakṣaṇasyopasaṃhāre pratipādanepi | (p.188) dharmadvayopagṛhītamabhinnam ekadharmitayā buddhipratibhāsarūpaṃ vikalpabuddhau pratibhātīti kṛtvā sāmānyādīni yathāpratīti na virudhyante |
analyzed: etena viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvasya nimittam uktam sāmānādhikaraṇasya āha bhinna ityādi bhinnasya śabda arthasya nīlotpala lakṣaṇasya upasaṃhāre pratipādane api dharma dvaya upagṛhītam abhinnam eka dharmitayā buddhi pratibhāsa rūpam vikalpa buddhau pratibhāti iti kṛtvā sāmānya ādīni yathāpratīti na virudhyante

original: tena yad ucyate bha ṭṭe na (|) anyanivṛttimātram apohaṃ gṛhītvā anīlādivyāvṛttāv anutpalādivyāvṛtter abhāvād anutpalādivyāvṛttau cānīlādivyāvṛtter abhāvāc ca na viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvas tayor dharmayos tadabhāvāc ca na tadābhidhāyakayoḥ śabdayoḥ śabdayor api viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ |
analyzed: tena yat ucyate bha ṭṭe na anya nivṛtti mātram apoham gṛhītvā anīla ādi vyāvṛttau anutpala ādi vyāvṛtteḥ abhāvāt anutpala ādi vyāvṛttau ca anīla ādi vyāvṛtteḥ abhāvāt ca na viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvaḥ tayoḥ dharmayoḥ tad abhāvāt ca na tad abhidhāyakayoḥ śabdayoḥ śabdayoḥ api viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvaḥ

original: nāpi sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ śabdavācyayor bhinnatvāt (|) nāpi yatrārthe 'pohayor bhāvas taddvārakaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyam avastutvenāpohasyādheyatvābhāvāt (|) na ca svalakṣaṇaṃ śabdaviṣayonyac cādhikaraṇaṃ neṣyate | na ca svalakṣaṇepohayor bhāvepi śabdayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyam ekaviṣayatvasyāpratīter ity apāstaṃ |
analyzed: nā api sāmānādhikaraṇyam śabda vācyayoḥ bhinna tvāt nā api yatra arthe pohayoḥ bhāvaḥ tad dvārakam sāmānādhikaraṇyam avastu tvena apohasya ādheya tva abhāvāt na ca sva lakṣaṇam śabda viṣayaḥ anyat ca adhikaraṇam na iṣyate na ca sva lakṣaṇa ipohayoḥ bhāve pi śabdayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyam eka viṣaya tvasya apratīteḥ iti apāstam

original: bāhyabhinnasya svākārasya śabdādiviṣayatveneṣṭatvāt tena nīlotpalādiśabdeṣu śabdārthābhidhāyitvam iṣyata eveti sarvaṃ susthaṃ |
analyzed: bāhya bhinnasya su ākārasya śabda ādi viṣaya tvena iṣṭatvāt tena nīlotpala ādi śabdeṣu śabda artha abhidhāyi tvam iṣyate eva iti sarvam sustham

original: dharmadharmibhedopy asya buddhipratibhāsasya yathā pratītir na virudhyata iti vacanapariṇāmena sambandhaḥ | tam evāneketyādināha – anekasmādarthād buddhipratibhāsasyālokatvāt | kutonekārthabhedaḥ kevalaṃ puruṣādhyavasāyavaśād evam ucyate | tasya buddhipratibhāsasyaikasmād arthād yo bhedas tasya vidhipratiṣedhajijñāsāyāṃ |
analyzed: dharma dharmi bhedaḥ upi asya buddhi pratibhāsasya yathā pratītiḥ na virudhyate iti vacana pariṇāmena sambandhaḥ tam eva aneka ityādinā āha anekasmāt arthāt buddhi pratibhāsasya āloka tvāt kutas aneka artha bhedaḥ kevalam puruṣa adhyavasāya vaśāt evam ucyate tasya buddhi pratibhāsasya ekasmāt arthāt yaḥ bhedaḥ tasya vidhi pratiṣedha jijñāsāyām

original: kimanityaḥ śabdo cākṣuṣo na bhavatīti tad eva buddhipratibhāsabhūtamvastu pradarśyata iti sambandhaḥ (|) kena prakāreṇety āha – pratikṣiptetyādi |
analyzed: kim anityaḥ cākṣuṣaḥ na bhavati iti tat eva buddhi pratibhāsa bhūtam vastu pradarśyate iti sambandhaḥ kena prakāreṇa iti āha pratikṣipta ityādi

original: yad vā dharmadharmibhedopy asya vastuno na virudhyata iti sambandhaḥ | kuta ity āha – anekasmād arthād bāhyasya bhedasambhave sati tasyaikasmād yo bhedas tasya vidhipratiṣedhajijñāsāyāṃ kimanityaḥ śabdo bhavati cākṣuṣo na bhavatīti tad eva bāhyamvastu pradarśyata iti sambandhaḥ | kena pradarśyata ity āha – pratikṣiptetyādi |
analyzed: yat vā asya vastunaḥ na virudhyate iti sambandhaḥ kutas iti āha anekasmāt arthāt bāhyasya bheda sambhave sati tasya ekasmāt yaḥ bhedaḥ tasya vidhi pratiṣedha jijñāsāyām kim anityaḥ śabdaḥ bhavati cākṣuṣaḥ na bhavati iti tat eva bāhyam vastu pradarśyate iti sambandhaḥ kena pradarśyate iti āha pratikṣipta ityādi

original: dharmaśabdena saṃcodya vyatiriktaṃ dharmam iva vyavasthāpyeti sambandhaḥ | tathā hy anityatvan na cākṣuṣatvam iti dharmaśabdena codane kṛte vyatirikta ivānityatvādiko dharmo vyavasthāpito bhavati | kiṅkāraṇam ity āha – tathā buddheḥ pratibhāsanāt | dharmaśabdena (p.189) codane vyatiriktasyaiva dharmasya grāhiṇyā buddheḥ pratibhāsanāt |
analyzed: dharma śabdena saṃcodya vyatiriktam dharmam iva vyavasthāpya iti sambandhaḥ tathā hi anitya tvat na cākṣuṣa tvam iti dharma śabdena codane kṛte vyatiriktaḥ iva anitya tva ādikaḥ dharmaḥ vyavasthāpitaḥ bhavati kiṅkāraṇam iti āha tathā buddheḥ pratibhāsanāt dharma śabdena codane vyatiriktasya eva dharmasya grāhiṇyāḥ buddheḥ pratibhāsanāt

original: aviśeṣeṇeti sarvabhedāpratikṣepeṇāparamasya bāhyasyāpratikṣiptabhedāntaraṃ svabhāvaṃ dharmitayā vyavasthāpya śabdena pradarśyate |
analyzed: aviśeṣeṇa iti sarva bheda a pratikṣepeṇa aparamasya bāhyasya a pratikṣipta bheda antaram svabhāvam dharmitayā vyavasthāpya śabdena pradarśyate

original: etad uktam bhavati | dharmaśabdena saṃcodya vyatiriktaṃ dharmam iva pradarśya punarddhamiśabdena saṃcodyāparaṃ svabhāvaṃ dharmitayā vyavasthāpya tad eva bāhyaṃ vastu pradarśyate | anityatvaṃ śabdasya na cākṣuṣatvam (|) anityo na cākṣuṣaḥ śabda iti | bhāvabhāvāṅśeneti |
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati dharma śabdena saṃcodya vyatiriktam dharmam iva pradarśya punar dhami śabdena saṃcodya aparam svabhāvam dharmi tayā vyavasthāpya tat eva bāhyam vastu pradarśyate anitya tvam śabdasya na cākṣuṣa tvam anityaḥ na cākṣuṣaḥ śabdaḥ iti bhāva bhāva aṅśena iti

original: bhedāntarapratikṣepāpratikṣepeṇa dharmar dharmiṇor bhedād bhedavatīva buddhir iva kalpikā pratibhāti bhinnākār eva | na tu vastuno bhedaḥ | na vastubhedād bhedavatī buddhiḥ (|) kutaḥ (|) yathoktadoṣād anupakāriṇi dharmiṇi dharmāṇāṃ pāratantryāyogāt |
analyzed: bheda antara pratikṣepa a pratikṣepeṇa dharmaḥ dharmiṇoḥ bhedāt bhedavatī iva buddhiḥ iva kalpikā pratibhāti bhinna ākār eva na tu vastunaḥ bhedaḥ na vastu bhedāt bhedavatī buddhiḥ kutas yathā ukta doṣāt anupakāriṇi dharmiṇi dharmāṇām pāratantrya ayogāt

original: tathā sādhyam anityatvaṃ sādhanaṃ kṛtakatvam iti (|) sādhyasādhanabhedaś cety ata āha – tathābhūtetyādi | tathābhūtānām pratikṣiptabhedāntarāṇāṃ dharmabhedānām bāhulyacodanayā vacanabhevaḥ sādhyasādhanabhedaś ca kriyata iti sambandhaḥ |
analyzed: tathā sādhyam anitya tvam sādhanam kṛtaka tvam iti sādhya sādhana bhedaḥ ca iti atas āha tathābhūta ityādi tathābhūtānām pratikṣipta bheda antarāṇām dharma bhedānām bāhulya codanayā vacana bhevaḥ sādhya sādhana bhedaḥ ca kriyate iti sambandhaḥ

original: tasya tatas tato vyāvṛttasya svabhāvaḥ samāśrayo yeṣān tair ddharmapratibhāsabhedair vikalpabuddhiprati(vi)mbair ddharmātmakaiḥ kimarthaṃ kriyata ity āha – tatsvabhāvetyādi | tasyaiva vyāvṛttasya vastusvabhāvasya pratipattaye prāptaye vā ||
analyzed: tasya tatas tatas vyāvṛttasya svabhāvaḥ samāśrayaḥ yeṣān taiḥ ddharma pratibhāsa bhedaiḥ vikalpa buddhi prativimbaiḥ ddharma ātmakaiḥ kimartham kriyate iti āha tad svabhāva ityādi tasya eva vyāvṛttasya vastu svabhāvasya pratipattaye prāptaye vā

original: praṇālikayā teṣām vastupratibandhāt prakṛtasyaivārthasya sukhagrahaṇārthaṃ saṅgrahaślokam āha – tatsvabhāvetyādi | tasya vastusvabhāvasyānubhavād ūrddhvaṃ yā dhīḥ prajñāyate vikalpikā | apiśabdo bhinnakramaḥ | anarthikāpi tadartheva | vastuviṣayeva adhyavasāyavaśādatatkāryebhyo yo bhedastanniṣṭhā |
analyzed: praṇālikayā teṣām vastu pratibandhāt prakṛtasya eva arthasya sukha grahaṇa artham saṅgraha ślokam āha tad svabhāva ityādi tasya vastu svabhāvasya anubhavāt ūrddhvam yā dhīḥ prajñāyate vikalpikā api śabdaḥ bhinnakramaḥ anarthikā api tad arthā iva vastu viṣayā iva adhyavasāya vaśāt a tad kāryebhyaḥ yaḥ bhedaḥ tad niṣṭhā

original: tadanubhavabalotpatter vyāvṛttasya ca vastunaḥ samvādāt tanniṣṭhety ucyate ||
analyzed: tad anubhava bala utpatteḥ vyāvṛttasya ca vastunaḥ samvādāt tad niṣṭhā iti ucyate

original: tasyām itthaṃ bhūtāyām buddhau yorthākāraḥ dṛśyavikalpayor ekīkaraṇād bāhyam iva | sajātīyāsu vyaktiṣu samampratibhāsamānam ekam ivānyato vijātīyād vyāvṛttim ivābhāti | tattu vyāvṛttam eva buddhirūpasyālokatvāt | tadbuddhirūpaṃ nistattvaṃ (p.190) niḥsvabhāvaṃ | kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) parīkṣānaṅgabhāvataḥ |
analyzed: tasyām ittham bhūtāyām buddhau yaḥ ṛthākāraḥ dṛśya vikalpayoḥ ekīkaraṇāt bāhyam iva sajātīyāsu vyaktiṣu samampratibhāsamānam ekam iva anyatas vijātīyāt vyāvṛttim iva ābhāti tat tu vyāvṛttam eva buddhi rūpasya āloka tvāt tat buddhi rūpam nistattvam niḥsvabhāvam kiṅkāraṇam parīkṣā anaṅga bhāvataḥ

original: arthakriyāsamartham eva parīkṣāṅgamataḥ parīkṣānaṅgabhāvenārthakriyāṃ pratyasamarthatvād ity uktam bhavati | yataś ca buddhipratibhāsi rūpannistattvam atas tadviṣayo vyavahāro mithyārtha eva pravartate ity āha –|
analyzed: arthakriyā samartham eva parīkṣā aṅgam atas parīkṣā anaṅga bhāvena arthakriyām prati asamartha tvāt iti uktam bhavati yatas ca buddhi pratibhāsi atas tad viṣayaḥ vyavahāraḥ mithyā arthe eva pravartate iti āha

original: arthā ityādi | jñānaviśiṣṭā iti vikalpabuddhyārūḍhāste jñānaviśiṣṭās santaḥ yato vijātīyād vyāvṛttirūpiṇo vyāvṛttirūpavantaḥ | yathānutpalād vyāvṛttirūpiṇa utpalārthāḥ | tenety antato vyāvṛttirūpeṇotpalatvenābhinnā ivābhānti na paramārthato buddhirūpasyālīkatvāt | etena sāmānyavyavahārasya nimittam uktaṃ |
analyzed: arthāḥ ityādi jñāna viśiṣṭāḥ iti vikalpa buddhi ārūḍhāḥ te jñāna viśiṣṭāḥ santaḥ yatas vijātīyāt vyāvṛtti rūpiṇaḥ vyāvṛtti rūpavantaḥ yathā anutpalāt vyāvṛtti rūpiṇaḥ utpala arthāḥ tena iti antatas vyāvṛtti rūpeṇa utpala tvena abhinnāḥ iva ābhānti na paramārthataḥ buddhi rūpasya alīka tvāt etena sāmānya vyavahārasya nimittam uktam

original: vyāvṛttāḥ punar anyatasta eveti (|) ta eva jñānaviśiṣṭā arthā anyato vyāvṛttirūpiṇaḥ santaḥ punar anyataḥ sajātīyād api vyāvṛttā bhānti | yathā ta eva nīlabhedā anīlāt | ataś ca vyāvṛttidvayopagṛhītasyaikasyārthasya bhāsanāt ||
analyzed: vyāvṛttāḥ punar anyatas te eva iti te eva jñāna viśiṣṭāḥ arthāḥ anyatas vyāvṛtti rūpiṇaḥ santaḥ punar anyatas sajātīyāt api vyāvṛttāḥ bhānti yathā te eva nīla bhedāḥ a nīlāt atas ca vyāvṛtti dvaya upagṛhītasya ekasya arthasya bhāsanāt

original: sāmānādhikaraṇyabījam uktaṃ | tad evāha – teṣām ityādi | teṣām iti buddhipratibhāsinām arthānāṃ vyavahāraḥ pratanyata iti sambandhaḥ | teṣām iti vyavahārāpekṣā karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī | kiṃviśiṣṭo mithyārthaḥ | karaṇabhūtair ity āha – sāmānyetyādi | samānādhāratvaṃ samānādhāraḥ | bhāvapradhānatvān nirdeśasya |
analyzed: sāmānādhikaraṇya bījam uktam tat eva āha teṣām ityādi teṣām iti buddhi pratibhāsinām arthānām vyavahāraḥ pratanyate iti sambandhaḥ teṣām iti vyavahāra apekṣā karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī kiṃviśiṣṭaḥ mithyārthaḥ karaṇa bhūtaiḥ iti āha sāmānya ityādi samāna ādhāra tvam samāna ādhāraḥ bhāva pradhāna tvāt nirdeśasya

original: sāmānyaviṣayaiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaviṣayaiś ca jñānābhidhānaiḥ sāmānyagocaraiḥ sāmānyavyavahāraḥ pratanyate | itaraiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyavahāraḥ ||
analyzed: sāmānya viṣayaiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇya viṣayaiḥ ca jñāna abhidhānaiḥ sāmānya gocaraiḥ sāmānya vyavahāraḥ pratanyate itaraiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇya vahāraḥ

original: yady api śabdajñānātmaka eveha vyavahāras tathāpi savyāpāratāmupādāya jñānaśabdayoḥ karaṇarūpatā | tayor evārthaprakāśalakṣaṇā kriyā vyavahāratvena vivakṣitety adoṣaḥ | yathā jñānasya pramāṇatvaṃ phalatvaṃ veti | sa ca sarvaḥ jñānābhidhānalakṣaṇo vyavahāraḥ padārthānāṃ svalakṣaṇānāṃ yonyonyābhāvaḥ parasparavyacchedas tatsaṃśrayaḥ |
analyzed: yadi api śabda jñāna ātmakaḥ eva iha vyavahāraḥ tathā api sa vyāpāra tām upādāya jñāna śabdayoḥ karaṇa rūpa tā tayoḥ eva artha prakāśa lakṣaṇā kriyā vyavahāra tvena vivakṣitā iti adoṣaḥ yathā jñānasya pramāṇa tvam phala tvam vā iti sa ca sarvaḥ jñāna abhidhāna lakṣaṇaḥ vyavahāraḥ padārthānām sva lakṣaṇānām yaḥ anyonya abhāvaḥ paraspara vyacchedaḥ tad saṃśrayaḥ

original: vyāvṛttapadārthān ubhavadvāreṇotpatteḥ | tenetyanyonyābhāvasaṃśrayatvena sa vyavahāronyāpohaviṣaya ucyate na tvanyavyāvṛttiviṣayatvāt | vidhiviṣayatvād asya vyavahārasya ||
analyzed: vyāvṛtta padārthān ubhava dvāreṇa utpatteḥ tena iti anyonya abhāva saṃśraya tvena sa vyavahāraḥ anya apoha viṣayaḥ ucyate na tu anya vyāvṛtti viṣaya tvāt vidhi viṣaya tvāt asya vyavahārasya

original: (p.191) vastulābhasya ca vastuprāpteś cāśrayo na bhavati vyavahāraḥ | na ca sarvaḥ kintu yatra vyavahāre 'sti pāramparyeṇa tathābhūtavastusambandhaḥ | udāharaṇam āha – yathoktānumitai yatheti | yathoktānumitiḥ pūrvoktānumānavikalpaḥ | nānyatra sthirādivikalpe tatra pāram paryeṇāpi vastusambandhābhāvāt | vastuno 'sthirādirūpatvāt |
analyzed: vastu lābhasya ca vastu prāptyāḥ ca āśrayaḥ na bhavati vyavahāraḥ na ca sarvaḥ kintu yatra vyavahāre sti pāramparyeṇa tathābhūta vastu sambandhaḥ udāharaṇam āha yathā ukta anumitai yathā iti yathā ukta anumitiḥ pūrva ukta anumāna vikalpaḥ na anyatra sthira ādi vikalpe tatra pāram paryeṇa api vastu sambandha abhāvāt vastunoḥ sthira ādi rūpa tvāt

original: anumānavikalpasyetarasya ca svapratibhāsenarthe 'rthādhyavasātad bhrāntisāmyepi | dīpatejo maṇai yatheti | yathā maṇitejasi maṇibuddhir bhrāntā | tathā dīpatejasyapitulyepi bhrāntatve maṇiprabhā maṇitvena gṛhītā maṇāvadhigantavye samvādikā | na tu dīpatejaḥ | tadvat sthirādivikalpo samvādaka ity arthaḥ ||
analyzed: anumāna vikalpasya itarasya ca sva pratibhāsena arthe rtha adhyavasā tat bhrānti sāmye pi dīpa tejaḥ yathā iti yathā maṇi tejasi maṇi buddhiḥ bhrāntā tathā dīpa tejasi api tulye api bhrānta tve maṇi prabhā maṇi tvena gṛhītā maṇau adhigantavye samvādikā na tu dīpa tejaḥ tadvat sthira ādi vikalpaḥ samvādakaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: yadi jñānaniviṣṭānām evārthānāṃ sāmānyādivyavahāraḥ bāhyeṣv artheṣu tarhi sāmānyādivyavahārābhāvāt pravṛttir na syād ity ata āha – tatretyādi | tatra śabdo vākyopanyāse | nirddhāraṇe vā | tatra vyaktiṣv ekakāryā vyaktayo nirddhāyante | anekopyekakāryo yathā ghaṭabhedā evodakāharaṇādikāryās tadakāryāya tathābhūtakāryanukurvate |
analyzed: yadi jñāna niviṣṭānām eva arthānām sāmānya ādi vyavahāraḥ bāhyeṣu artheṣu tarhi sāmānya ādi vyavahāra abhāvāt pravṛttiḥ na syāt iti atas āha tatra ityādi tatra śabdaḥ vākya upanyāse nirddhāraṇe vā tatra vyaktiṣu eka kāryāḥ vyaktayaḥ nirddhāyante anekaḥ upi eka kāryaḥ yathā ghaṭa bhedāḥ eva udaka āharaṇa ādi kāryāḥ tat akāryāya tathābhūta kāri anukurvate

original: tebhyonyatāvyāvṛttiḥ sā āśrayo yeṣāṃ jñānābhidhānāttair anekopi padārtha ekatvena vyavahāram pratāryate | sāmānyavyavahāraṃ prāpyata iti yāvat ||
analyzed: tebhyaḥ anya tā vyāvṛttiḥ sā āśrayaḥ yeṣām jñāna abhidhānāt taiḥ anekaḥ api padārthaḥ eka tvena vyavahāram pratāryate sāmānya vyavahāram prāpyate iti yāvat

original: tathetyanantarasāmānyavyapekṣayā | ekopy anekakāryakṛt | yathā ghaṭaś ca cakṣurvijñānodakāharaṇādikāryakṛt | tadbhāvadīpane | anekakāryakarttṛtvaprakāśane | atatkāryebhyo bhedena hetunā | nānādharmā ghaṭaś cākṣuṣaḥ pārthiva ityādi | tena sāmānādhikaraṇyaviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvavyavahāraś ca bāhyeṣv eva darśitaḥ ||
analyzed: tathā iti anantara sāmānya vyapekṣayā ekaḥ api aneka kārya kṛt yathā ghaṭaḥ ca cakṣuḥ vijñāna udaka āharaṇa ādi kārya kṛt tad bhāva dīpane aneka kārya karttṛ tva prakāśane a tad kāryebhyaḥ bhedena hetunā nānā dharmāḥ ghaṭaḥ cākṣuṣaḥ pārthivaḥ ityādi tena sāmānādhikaraṇya viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāva vyavahāraḥ ca bāhyeṣu eva darśitaḥ

original: yadi bāhyeṣu sāmānyādivyavahāraḥ pāramārthikastarhi prāpta ity āha – yathāpratītikathitaḥ iti | vikalpabuddhyanurodhena śabdārthaḥ sāmānyalakṣaṇaḥ paramārthatosāvasannapi yathāpratītikathitaṃ | yasmād vastunyasya śabdārthasya sāmānādhikaraṇyasya ca na sambhavaḥ ||
analyzed: yadi bāhyeṣu sāmānya ādi vyavahāraḥ pāramārthikaḥ tarhi prāptaḥ iti āha yathā pratīti kathitaḥ iti vikalpa buddhi anurodhena śabda arthaḥ sāmānya lakṣaṇaḥ asan api yathā pratīti kathitam yasmāt vastuni asya śabda arthasya sāmānādhikaraṇyasya ca na sambhavaḥ

original: (p.192) dharmadharmivyavahāraś ca jñānapratibhāsinyartha iti yat prakṛtantatsaṅgrahārtham āha – dharmetyādi | ayaṃ dharmo 'yaṃ dharmīti vyavasthānantayoś ca bhedo 'syāyaṃ dharmaḥ kṛtakatvādilakṣaṇaḥ | abhedaḥ kṛtakoyam iti yādṛṣaḥ | ayaṃ ca vikalpāropitatvāt | asamīkṣitatattvārthaḥ | anapekṣitastattvārtho vastvartho yeneti vigrahaḥ |
analyzed: dharma dharmi vyavahāraḥ ca jñāna pratibhāsinī arthaḥ iti yat prakṛtam tad saṅgraha artham āha dharma ityādi ayam dharmaḥ yam dharmī iti vyavasthānam tayoḥ ca sya ayam dharmaḥ kṛtaka tva ādi lakṣaṇaḥ abhedaḥ kṛtakaḥ ayam iti ayam ca vikalpa āropita tvāt asamīkṣita tattva arthaḥ anapekṣitaḥ tattvārthaḥ vastu arthaḥ yena iti vigrahaḥ

original: yathā loke buddhyārūḍhopyadhyavasitatadbhāvatayā pratīyate ||
analyzed: yathā loke buddhi ārūḍhaḥ api adhyavasita tad bhāva tayā pratīyate

original: taṃ dharmādivibhāgantathaiveti yathālokapratītiḥ sādhyasādhanasaṃsthitirvidvadibharavakalpyata iti sambandhaḥ | kimarthaṃ | paramārthāvatārāya | anityādivastusvabhāvasyāvagāhanāya ||
analyzed: tam dharma ādi vibhāgam tathā eva iti yathā loka pratītiḥ sādhya sādhana saṃsthitiḥ vidvas ibhaḥ avakalpyate iti sambandhaḥ kimartham paramārtha avatārāya anitya ādi vastu svabhāvasya avagāhanāya

original: kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇam ekatvādivyavahārasya vastunyasambhava ity āha – saṃsṛjyanta ityādi | pāramārthikā arthāḥ svato na saṃsṛjyante | tato na sāmānyavyavahāro vastuni | na bhidyante kṛtakatvād dharmaiḥ pratyekaṃ tasya vastunomekatvāyogāt |
analyzed: kim punar kāraṇam eka tva ādi vyavahārasya vastuni asambhavaḥ iti āha saṃsṛjyante ityādi pāramārthikāḥ arthāḥ svatas na saṃsṛjyante tatas na sāmānya vyavahāraḥ vastuni na bhidyante kṛtaka tvāt dharmaiḥ pratyekam tasya vastunaḥ umā eka tva ayogāt

original: ataś ca teṣv artheṣu bahṛṣu rūpam ekam ekasminn arthe 'nekaṃ rūpaṃ yadadhyavasīyate tadbuddher vikalpakāyā upaplavo bhrāntiḥ | yataś ca saṃsṛjyante na bhijyante na bhidyante pāramārthikā arthāḥ ||
analyzed: atas ca teṣu artheṣu bahṛṣu rūpam ekam ekasmin arthe na ikam rūpam yat adhyavasīyate tad buddheḥ vikalpa kāyāḥ upaplavaḥ bhrāntiḥ yatas ca saṃsṛjyante na bhijyante na bhidyante pāramārthikāḥ arthāḥ

original: tataḥ kāraṇāt sāmānyam idaṃ bahūnāṃ | tathā dharmāṇāṃ dharmiṇāṃ ca bheda ity api yoyambhedo nānātvavyavahāraḥ sa bauddherthe | na bāhye svalakṣaṇe | buddhipratibhāsasyālikatvāt (|) kathan tarhi tatra svalakṣaṇe kṛtakatvādidharmabheda iti ced āha – tasyaiva cetyādi | tasyaiva svalakṣaṇasyānyavyāvṛttyā dharmabhedaḥ prakalpyate ||
analyzed: tatas kāraṇāt sāmānyam idam bahūnām tathā dharmāṇām dharmiṇām ca bhedaḥ iti api yaḥ yam bhedaḥ nānātva vyavahāraḥ sa bauddha ṛthe na bāhye sva lakṣaṇe buddhi pratibhāsasya alika tvāt kathan tarhi tatra sva lakṣaṇe kṛtaka tva ādi dharma bhedaḥ iti ced āha tasya eva ca ityādi tasya eva sva lakṣaṇasya anya vyāvṛttyā dharma bhedaḥ prakalpyate

original: kasmāt kalpitadharmabhedadvāreṇa gamyagamakabhāvo na vastudarśanamātreṇety ata āha – sādhayetyādi | idaṃ sādhyam idaṃ sādhanam ity asmin saṃkalpe vastudarśanahānitaḥ | yadvā pratyakṣavadanumānena sāmānyaviśiṣṭaṃ svalakṣaṇam eva kasmān na gṛhyata ity ata āha – (p.193) sādhyetyādi | sādhyasādhanasaṃkalpe vastudarśanahānitaḥ |
analyzed: kasmāt kalpita dharma bheda dvāreṇa gamya gamaka bhāvaḥ na vastu darśana mātreṇa iti atas āha sādhaya ityādi idam sādhyam idam sādhanam iti asmin saṃkalpe vastu darśana hānitaḥ yat vā pratyakṣa vat anumānena sāmānya viśiṣṭam sva lakṣaṇam eva kasmāt na gṛhyate iti atas āha sādhya ityādi sādhya sādhana saṃkalpe vastu darśana hānitaḥ

original: kutaḥ svalakṣaṇasya sāmānyaviśiṣṭasya grahaṇaṃ | bhedaḥ sāmānyasamsṛṣṭo grāhya ity ācārya dignāga prabhṛtibhiḥ sāmānyasaṃsṛṣṭasya svalakṣaṇasya grahaṇaṃ pratijñātam ity āśaṅkāmapanayann āha – bheda ityādi bhedaḥ sāmānyasaṃsṛṣṭaḥ pratīyata ity atrāpi vacane grāhyaṃ na svalakṣaṇam eva nirdiṣṭam iti naivam boddhavyam ity arthaḥ |
analyzed: kutas sva lakṣaṇasya sāmānya viśiṣṭasya grahaṇam bhedaḥ sāmānya samsṛṣṭaḥ grāhyaḥ iti ācārya dignāga prabhṛtibhiḥ sāmānya saṃsṛṣṭasya sva lakṣaṇasya grahaṇam pratijñātam iti āśaṅkām apanayan āha bhedaḥ ityādi bhedaḥ sāmānya saṃsṛṣṭaḥ pratīyate iti atra api vacane grāhyam na sva lakṣaṇam eva nirdiṣṭam iti na evam boddhavyam iti arthaḥ

original: kintu bāhyā eva bhedāstenānyāpohalakṣaṇena sāmānyena saṃsṛṣṭā adhyavasīyante na tu gṛhyanta iti tatrāpi boddhavyaṃ |
analyzed: kintu bāhyāḥ eva bhedāḥ tena anya apoha lakṣaṇena sāmānyena saṃsṛṣṭāḥ adhyavasīyante na tu gṛhyante iti tatra api boddhavyam

original: anye tu bhedaḥ sāmānyasaṃsṛṣṭo grāhya iti pulliṅgena paṭhanti | tatrāyam artho bhedaḥ | sāmānyasaṃsṛṣṭo grāhya ity atrāpi vacane | na svalakṣaṇaṃ boddhavyaṃ ||
analyzed: anye tu bhedaḥ sāmānya saṃsṛṣṭaḥ grāhyaḥ iti pulliṅgena paṭhanti tatra ayam arthaḥ bhedaḥ sāmānya saṃsṛṣṭaḥ grāhyaḥ iti atra api vacane na sva lakṣaṇam boddhavyam

original: kimpunaḥ kāraṇantatraiva boddhavyam iti ced āha – samānetyādi | anekasminnekākāraḥ samānākāraḥ | ekasminn anekadharmatvam bhinnākāraḥ | ādiśabdād dharmadharmyākāraparigrahaḥ | na tat svalakṣaṇaṃ grāhyaṃ kathaṃ cana |
analyzed: kim punar kāraṇam tatra eva boddhavyam iti ced āha samāna ityādi anekasmin eka ākāraḥ samāna ākāraḥ ekasmin aneka dharma tvam bhinna ākāraḥ ādi śabdāt dharma dharmya ākāra parigrahaḥ na tat sva lakṣaṇam grāhyam katham cana

original: kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tatraikasmin svalakṣaṇe kṛtakatvānityatvādirūpeṇa bahubhedānāndharmāṇāṃ kim viśiṣṭānām bhedānām vasturūpāṇāntaraikasmin svalakṣaṇe 'yogāt | na hy ekasya vasturūpāṇi bahūni yujyante niraṃśatvāt svalakṣaṇasya ||
analyzed: kim kāraṇam tatra ekasmin sva lakṣaṇe kṛtaka tva anitya tva ādi rūpeṇa bahu bhedānām dharmāṇām kim viśiṣṭānām bhedānām vastu rūpāṇā antarā ekasmin sva lakṣaṇe yogāt na hi ekasya vastu rūpāṇi bahūni yujyante niraṃśa tvāt sva lakṣaṇasya

original: upasaṃharann āha – tadrūpam ityādi | tattasmād rūpaṃ svalakṣaṇaṃ sarvato bhinnamasādhāraṇantathā tenāsādhāraṇena tasya svalakṣaṇasya na pratipādikā śrutiḥ śabdo nāsti | kalpanā vāsti | neti prakṛtaṃ | asādhāraṇena svarūpeṇa svalakṣaṇasya grāhako nāstīty arthaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) sāmānyenaiva śabdasya kalpanāyāś ca vṛttitaḥ ||
analyzed: upasaṃharan āha tat rūpam ityādi tat tasmāt rūpam sva lakṣaṇam sarvatas bhinnam asādhāraṇan tathā tena asādhāraṇena tasya sva lakṣaṇasya na pratipādikā śrutiḥ śabdaḥ na asti kalpanā vā asti na iti prakṛtam asādhāraṇena sva rūpeṇa sva lakṣaṇasya grāhakaḥ na asti iti arthaḥ kim kāraṇam sāmānyena eva śabdasya kalpanāyāḥ ca vṛttitaḥ

original: tatpratipādikā na śrutir astīti bruvatā svalakṣaṇe śabdā na niyujyanta ity uktam ataś codayati |
analyzed: tad pratipādikā na śrutiḥ asti iti bruvatā sva lakṣaṇe śabdāḥ na niyujyante iti uktam atas codayati

original: kimpunar ityādi | saṃketena viṣayīkṛtāḥ saṃketinaḥ | tasmāhuḥ śabdā (ḥ |) vyavahārāya saṃketaḥ smṛtaḥ | tadā vyavahārakāle tatsvalakṣaṇannāsti yatra saṃketaḥ kṛtaḥ |
analyzed: kim punar ityādi saṃketena viṣayīkṛtāḥ saṃketinaḥ tasmā āhuḥ śabdāḥ vyavahārāya saṃketaḥ smṛtaḥ tadā vyavahāra kāle tad sva lakṣaṇat na asti yatra saṃketaḥ kṛtaḥ

original: (p.194) ekasyāpi svalakṣaṇasya kṣaṇikatvāt kālāntare tenaiva rūpeṇānugamo nāsty akṣaṇikatve vā saṃketaḥ jñānābhāvād eva tadviṣayatvasya kālāntarenugamo nāsti kimuta deśakālabhinneṣu svalakṣaṇeṣu | tena kāraṇena tatra svalakṣaṇe saṃketo na kriyata ity adhyāhāraḥ |
analyzed: ekasya api sva lakṣaṇasya kṣaṇika tvāt kāla antare tena eva rūpeṇa anugamaḥ na asti akṣaṇika tve vā saṃketaḥ jñāna abhāvāt eva tad viṣaya tvasya kāla antara inugamaḥ na asti kim uta deśa kāla bhinneṣu sva lakṣaṇeṣu tena kāraṇena tatra sva lakṣaṇe saṃketaḥ na kriyate iti adhyāhāraḥ

original: na hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe |
analyzed: na hi ityādinā vyācaṣṭe

original: api nāmeti kathannu nāma | prāg iti saṃketakālakṛtasambandhasya śabdasyeti sambandhaḥ | ekatraikassiman svalakṣaṇe paścād iti vyavahārakāle | kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) na yuktam ity āha – tasyetyādi | tasyeti saṃketakāladṛṣṭasya vyavahārāvasthānādiṣu deśakālabhedeṣvanāskandanāt | anugamāt | na hy ekatra dṛṣṭo bhedonyatra sambhavati ||(94)

original: yadetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | na tāviti sāmānyatadvantau | idam asya bhedasya sāmānyaṃ | tathā ceti sāmānyatadvatoḥ sambandhāpratipattau | tatpratipattyā sāmānyapratipattyā | tadvati sāmānyavati | arthāntaravaditi na hyaśvapratipattikāle tadrapeṇāgṛhīte (p.214) godravye 'śvapratipattyā pratipattir asti | ekavastusahāyā iti sāmānyasahāyāḥ |
analyzed: yadā ityādinā vyācaṣṭe na tau iti sāmānya tadvantau idam asya bhedasya sāmānyam tathā ca iti sāmānya tadvatoḥ sambandha apratipattau tad pratipattyā sāmānya pratipattyā tadvati sāmānyavati artha antara vat iti na hi aśva pratipatti kāle go dravye śva pratipattyā pratipattiḥ asti eka vastu sahāyāḥ iti sāmānya sahāyāḥ

original: syād etad ity etasyaiva vyākhyānaṃ | tasyeti jñānasya | ekaṃ sahakāryastīti sāmānyaṃ sahakāri bhavatīty arthaḥ | tadā tatsahitāḥ sāmānyasahitāḥ | evaṃ ca sāmānyatadvator dvayor grahaṇāt sāmānyapratipattyā tadvati pratipattiḥ siddheti bhāvaḥ ||
analyzed: syāt etat iti etasya eva vyākhyānam tasya iti jñānasya ekam sahakāri asti iti sāmānyam sahakāri bhavati iti arthaḥ tadā tad sahitāḥ sāmānya sahitāḥ evam ca sāmānya tadvatoḥ dvayoḥ grahaṇāt sāmānya pratipattyā tadvati pratipattiḥ siddhā iti bhāvaḥ

original: tad ity ācāryaḥ | ekamvastu sāmānyantāsāṃ vyaktīnāṃ nānātvaṃ samapohatyapanayati | kiṃ punas tāsāṃ nānātvāpoha iṣyata ity āha – nānātvāc cetyādi | hyarthaḥ ca śabdaḥ | tāsviti vyaktiṣu | kim ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | tenaikena sāmānyena | bhedeṣu yannānātvantadekavijñānākāraṇatve bhedānāṃ kāraṇam ucyate | nānātvādvyaktayo naikaṃ vijñānaṃ janayantīti |
analyzed: tat iti ācāryaḥ ekam vastu sāmānyan tāsām vyaktīnām nānātvam samapohati apanayati kim punar tāsām nānātva apohaḥ iṣyate iti āha nānātvāt ca ityādi hi arthaḥ ca śabdaḥ tāsu iti vyaktiṣu kim ityādinā vyācaṣṭe tena ekena sāmānyena bhedeṣu yat nānātvam tat eka vijñāna akāraṇa tve bhedānām kāraṇam ucyate nānātvāt vyaktayaḥ na ekam vijñānam janayanti iti

original: ekasāmānyasambandhepi yadi bhedānānnānātvādapracyutirna teṣvekākāraṃ vijñānam iti pūrvavadvyaktīnāmagrahaṇaṃ ||
analyzed: eka sāmānya sambandhe pi yadi bheda anāt nānātvāt apracyutiḥ na teṣu eka ākāram vijñānam iti pūrvavat vyaktīnām agrahaṇam

original: anekam api vyaktirūpaṃ | ekam iti sāmānyaṃ | netyādinā vyācaṣṭe | yadi bhedājananavirodhīsyāt tadā saty api sāmānye bhedān na janayaṃtyevaikaṃ vijñānaṃ |
analyzed: anekam api vyakti rūpam ekam iti sāmānyam na ityādinā vyācaṣṭe yadi tadā sati api sāmānye bhedān na janayaṃti eva ekam vijñānam

original: tābhir iti vyaktibhiḥ (|) kiṃ punaḥ samastābhir eva vinā | nety āha – pratyekam iti | tathā hi śāvaleyābhāve bāhuleye gobuddhis tathā tadabhāvenyatrāpyevampratyekaṃ sarvāsāṃ vyaktīnāmabhāvepi | tenaikena sāmānyena kriyamāṇāṃ dhiyaṃ (p.215) pratyabhijñānātmikāṃ prati sāmarthyantāsāṃ vyaktīnāṃ nāsti |
analyzed: tābhiḥ iti vyaktibhiḥ kim punar samastābhiḥ eva vinā na iti āha pratyekam iti tathā hi śāvaleya abhāve bāhuleye go buddhiḥ tathā tad abhāve nyatra api evam pratyekam sarvāsām vyaktīnām abhāve api tena ekena sāmānyena kriyamāṇām dhiyam pratyabhijñāna ātmikām prati sāmarthyam tāsām vyaktīnām na asti

original: iti hetor agraho dhiyā sāmānyajñānena tāsāṃ vyaktīnāṃ |
analyzed: iti hetoḥ agrahaḥ dhiyā sāmānya jñānena tāsām vyaktīnām

original: tad evāha (|) katham ityādi | tatra jñāne sāmānyākāre | tadbhāvād iti sāmānyapratyayasya bhāvāt | etena vyatirekābhāva uktaḥ | prayogas tu yo yadabhāvepi bhavati na tattannimittaṃ yathā śālibījābhāvepi bhavan yavāṅkuraḥ | bhavati ca pratyekaṃ śāvaleyādyabhāvepi bāhuleyādau gobuddhir iti vyāpakaviruddhaḥ | tannimittatāyāstadabhāvena vyāptatvāt |
analyzed: tat eva āha katham ityādi tatra jñāne sāmānya ākāre tad bhāvāt iti sāmānya pratyayasya bhāvāt etena vyatireka abhāvaḥ uktaḥ prayogaḥ tu yaḥ yad abhāve api bhavati na tat tad nimittam yathā śāli bīja abhāve api bhavan yava aṅkuraḥ bhavati ca pratyekam śāvaleya ādi abhāve api bāhuleya ādau go buddhiḥ iti vyāpaka viruddhaḥ tad nimitta tāyāḥ tad abhāvena vyāpta tvāt

original: sāmānyasya tu tatra śaktir ity āha – asatītyādi | asati sāmānye sāmānyabuddher abhāvāt | anena vyatir eka uktaḥ | itarathā ceti sati sāmānye sāmānyabuddher bhāvāt | anenānvaya uktaḥ ||
analyzed: sāmānyasya tu tatra śaktiḥ iti āha asati ityādi asati sāmānye sāmānya buddheḥ abhāvāt anena vyatiḥ ekaḥ uktaḥ itarathā ca iti sati sāmānye sāmānya buddheḥ bhāvāt anena anvayaḥ uktaḥ

original: yadi sāmānyasahitānām eva vyaktīnāṃ sāmānyabuddhiṃ prati sāmarthyamiṣyate | tadā tathoktanyāyena sāmānyasyaiva śaktir na vyaktīnām iti |
analyzed: yadi sāmānya sahitānām eva vyaktīnām sāmānya buddhim prati sāmarthyam iṣyate tadā tathā ukta nyāyena sāmānyasya eva śaktiḥ na vyaktīnām iti

original: naiṣa doṣa ity āha paraḥ | ekāpāyepītyekaikasyāpāyepīty arthaḥ | tathā hi yathā nīlādisamudāyālambanaṃ cakṣurvijñānam utpadyate | tatra caikaikasmin nīlādāvapanīte bhavaty eva pariśiṣṭe ca varṇṇasasamūhe cakṣurbuddhir na ceyatā nīlādīnāmasāmarthya samūhe kintu sāmarthyam eva | pratyekaṃ nīlādīnāṃ samūhajñāne |
analyzed: na eṣa doṣaḥ iti āha paraḥ eka apāye api iti ekaikasya apāye api iti arthaḥ tathā hi yathā nīla ādi samudāya ālambanam cakṣuḥ vijñānam utpadyate tatra ca ekaikasmin nīla ādau apanīte bhavati eva pariśiṣṭe ca varṇṇa sa samūhe cakṣuḥ buddhiḥ na ca iyatā nīla ādīnām asāmarthya samūhe kintu sāmarthyam eva pratyekam nīla ādīnām samūha jñāne

original: tathehāpi vyaktiṣvekaikāpāyepi bhavati sāmānyavijñānam iti | neyatā pratyekaṃ sarvadā vyaktīnāmasāmarthyam iti sambandhaḥ | tataś ca yo yadabhāvepi bhavatītyādi prayoge 'nekānta iti |
analyzed: tathā iha api vyaktiṣu ekaika apāye pi bhavati sāmānya vijñānam iti neyatā pratyekam sarvadā vyaktīnām asāmarthyam iti sambandhaḥ tatas ca yaḥ yad abhāve pi bhavati ityādi prayoge na ekāntaḥ iti

original: viṣama ity ācāryaḥ | upanyasyata ityupanyāso nīlādidṛṣṭāntas tasya prakrāntena sāmyannāstīty arthaḥ | naivaṃ vyakteḥ kathaṃcaneti | na pratyekaṃ samastānāṃ vyaktīnāṃ sāmarthyam ity arthaḥ |
analyzed: viṣamaḥ iti ācāryaḥ upanyasyate iti upanyāsaḥ nīla ādi dṛṣṭāntaḥ tasya prakrāntena sāmyat na asti iti arthaḥ na evam vyakteḥ kathaṃcana iti na pratyekam samastānām vyaktīnām sāmarthyam iti arthaḥ

original: (p.216) tadvyācaṣṭe | nīlādīnām ityādi | pratyekam api sāmarthyaṃ dṛṣṭam iti | nīlādayo hi yathā svena rūpeṇa bhinnāstadvaccakṣurvijñānāny api | svākārabheāt | tatra nīlasahitena samuhena yajjanyate cakṣurvijñānanna tattadvikalena yac ca tadvikalena na janyate tadanyad eva |
analyzed: tat vyācaṣṭe nīla ādīnām ityādi pratyekam api sāmarthyam dṛṣṭam iti nīla ādayaḥ hi yathā svena rūpeṇa bhinnāḥ tadvat cakṣuḥ vijñānāni api sva ākāra bheāt tatra nīla sahitena samuhena yat janyate cakṣuḥ vijñānat na tat tad vikalena yat ca tad vikalena na janyate tad anyat eva

original: tasmāt samūhākāroparaktasya vijñānasya pratyekanna nīlādīnpratyanvayavyatirekānuvidhānād gamyate teṣāṃ pratyekaṃ sāmarthyam iti samūhepi śaktiraviruddhā | tatheti nīlādivat | na kadācid iti pratyekaṃ saṃhatā vā |
analyzed: tasmāt samūha ākāra uparaktasya vijñānasya pratyekam na nīla ādīn prati anvaya vyatireka anuvidhānāt gamyate teṣām pratyekam sāmarthyam iti samūhe api śaktiḥ aviruddhā tathā iti nīla ādi vat na kadācid iti pratyekam saṃhatāḥ vā

original: etad āha – yadi śāvaleyasahitasāmānyajanyaṃ gojñānamanyadanyac ca bāhuleyasahāyajanyaṃ syāt (|) tadā vyaktīnāṃ pratyekaṃ svāśrayadvārabhāvijñāne śaktir gamyeta | kintvekameva sarvāsu vyaktiṣu pratyabhijñānantasya sarvatraikākāratvāt | pratyekaṃ vyaktīnāṃ cābhāvepi sāmānyādevāsyotpatteḥ | tasmādasamarthā eva vyaktayas tatra sāmānyajñāne |
analyzed: etat āha yadi śāvaleya sahita sāmānya janyam go jñānam anyat anyat ca bāhuleya sahāya janyam syāt tadā vyaktīnām pratyekam sva āśraya dvāra bhāvi jñāne śaktiḥ gamyeta kintu ekam eva sarvāsu vyaktiṣu pratyabhijñānam tasya sarvatra eka ākāra tvāt pratyekam vyaktīnām ca abhāve pi sāmānyāt eva asya utpatteḥ tasmāt asamarthāḥ eva vyaktayaḥ tatra sāmānya jñāne

original: iti hetos tena sāmānyajñānena na gṛhyeran ||
analyzed: iti hetoḥ tena sāmānya jñānena na gṛhyeran

original: tāsāmvyaktīnāmmadhye 'nyatamāpekṣam iti kāṃcid vyaktimapekṣyety arthaḥ | tad iti sāmānyaṃ kevalaṃ vyaktinirapekṣaṃ |
analyzed: tāsām vyaktīnām madhye nyatama apekṣam iti kāṃcid vyaktim apekṣya iti arthaḥ tat iti sāmānyam kevalam vyakti nirapekṣam

original: athetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | kuvindastantuvāyaḥ | bahūnāṃ vemānāmmadhye pratyekaṃ vemābhāvepyekenānyatamena paṭaṃ karotīti (|) yady api sarveṣāṃ vyabhicāras tathāpi na tata eva kuvindādeva vemarahitāt paṭotpattiḥ śakyā vaktuṃ | yasmān na vemarahitaḥ kuvindaḥ paṭaṃ karoti kevalasya paṭakaraṇāśakteḥ | tathā ca na sāmānyaṃ kevalantaddher tu vijñānahetuḥ |
analyzed: atha ityādinā vyācaṣṭe kuvindaḥ tantuvāyaḥ bahūnām vemānām madhye pratyekam vema abhāve pi ekena anyatamena paṭam karoti iti yadi api sarveṣām vyabhicāraḥ tathā api na tatas eva kuvindāt eva vema rahitāt paṭa utpattiḥ śakyā vaktum yasmāt na vema rahitaḥ kuvindaḥ paṭam karoti kevalasya paṭa karaṇa aśakteḥ tathā ca na sāmānyam kevalam tad dheḥ tu vijñāna hetuḥ

original: evam ity ācāryaḥ | tāsāmanyatamāpekṣaṃ sāmānyaṃ śaktam iti bravatā vyaktyupakāryaṃ sāmānyam iṣṭam anupakāriṇyapekṣāyogāt ||
analyzed: evam iti ācāryaḥ tāsām anyatama apekṣam sāmānyam śaktam iti bravatā vyakti upakāryam sāmānyam iṣṭam anupakāriṇī apekṣā yogāt

original: (p.217) evaṃ cettad ekaṃ sāmānyamuoakuryustā vyaktayaḥ katham ekāṃ dhiyaṃ ca na | evaśabdārthe caśabdaḥ | ekāṃ pratyabhijñānātmikāndhiyam eva kathaṃ nopakuryastām evopakuryur iti yāvat |
analyzed: evam ced tat ekam sāmānyam uoakuryuḥ tāḥ vyaktayaḥ katham ekām dhiyam ca na eva śabda arthe caśabdaḥ ekām pratyabhijñāna ātmikān dhiyam eva katham na upakuryaḥ tām eva upakuryuḥ iti yāvat

original: bhinnetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | bhinnānāṃ vilakṣaṇānām ekārthopakriyā | pratyabhijñādyekāryāvirodhinyasati sāmānya iti sarvoyaṃ sāmānyasiddhyarthaṃ ārambhaḥ | āsām iti vyaktīnāṃ vijñānena pratyabhijñānākhyenāparādhaḥ kṛtvo yat tadvijñānanna kurvanti (|) na kaścit kutas tasmāt tad eva kurvantīti bhāvaḥ | tathā ca kimatrāntargaḍunā |
analyzed: bhinna ityādinā vyācaṣṭe bhinnānām vilakṣaṇānām ekārtha upakriyā pratyabhijñā ādi eka ārya avirodhinī asati sāmānye iti sarvaḥ yam sāmānya siddhi artham ārambhaḥ āsām iti vyaktīnām vijñānena pratyabhijñāna ākhyena aparādhaḥ kṛtvas yat tat vijñānam na kurvanti na kaścid kutas tasmāt tat eva kurvanti iti bhāvaḥ tathā ca kim atra antargaḍunā

original: ghaṭāmastakayorantarālavarttī māmsapiṇḍontargaḍustena tulyas tathoktaḥ | tadvanniṣphalenety arthaḥ ||
analyzed: ghaṭāmastakayoḥ antarāla varttī tena tulyaḥ tathā uktaḥ tadvat niṣphalena iti arthaḥ

original: syān mataṃ (|) bhinnānāmekasāmānyopakāraśāktirastyataste sāmānyam eva sākṣādupakurvate na tu vijñānam ity ata āha – yathetyādi | evantadekam iti sāmānyajanyaṃ yadvijñānantad eva kurvantu | kiṃ sāmānyopakāreṇa niṣphalena | evam manyate (|) vijñāne vyaktayo na svākāropadhānena vyāpriyante (|) sāmānyajñāne svalakwaṇasyāpratibhāsanāt |
analyzed: syāt matam bhinnānām eka sāmānya upakāra śāktiḥ asti atas te sāmānyam eva sākṣāt upakurvate na tu vijñānam iti atas āha yathā ityādi evam tat ekam iti sāmānya janyam yat vijñānam tat eva kurvantu kim sāmānya upakāreṇa niṣphalena evam manyate vijñāne vyaktayaḥ na sva ākāra upadhānena vyāpriyante sāmānya jñāne sva lakwaṇasya apratibhāsanāt

original: kiṃtvādhipatyamātreṇa (|) tac ca yathā sāmānye tathā tadvijñānepi tulyam iti |
analyzed: kiṃtu ādhipatya mātreṇa tat ca yathā sāmānye tathā tad vijñāne api tulyam iti

original: kiṃ ca yadi vyaktayaḥ sāmānyam upakurvate tadā tāsāṃ vyaktīnāṃ kāryaś cāsau sāmānyātmā prāptaḥ | yasmāj jananamevopakriyā ||
analyzed: kim ca yadi vyaktayaḥ sāmānyam upakurvate tadā tāsām vyaktīnām kāryaḥ ca asau sāmānya ātmā prāptaḥ yasmāt jananam eva upakriyā

original: tad eva sphuṭayannāha – na hītyādi | atiśayo viśeṣas tadabhāvād anatiśayamātmānaṃ svabhāvam asya | sāmānyasyopakārakāsannidheḥ pūrvavadupakārakasannidhānepi (p.218) vibhrataḥ kaścidupakārako na hīti sambandhaḥ | atiprasaṅgāt | evaṃ hi sarvaḥ sarvasyopakārakaḥ syāt | tasmād upakāreṇaivopakāryasyātiśayo janyata ity abhyupeyaṃ |
analyzed: tat eva sphuṭayan āha na hi ityādi atiśayaḥ viśeṣaḥ tad abhāvāt anatiśayam ātmānam svabhāvam asya sāmānyasya upakāraka asannidheḥ pūrvavat upakāraka sannidhāne api vibhrataḥ kaścid upakārakaḥ na hi iti sambandhaḥ atiprasaṅgāt evam hi sarvaḥ sarvasya upakārakaḥ syāt tasmāt upakāreṇa eva upakāryasya atiśayaḥ janyate iti abhyupeyam

original: sa cātiśaya upakāryasyātmabhūta iti jananam evopakriyā | sāmānyādarthāntarabhūta evātiśayo vyaktibhirnānyata ity āha – arthāntaraityādi | tasyopakāryasya sāmānyasya kintenārthāntareṇopakāreṇa kriyate | tasya copakārasyārthāntarasya kintena sāmānyena yena tasya sāmānyasyāsāvupakārasambandhī syāt |
analyzed: sa ca atiśayaḥ upakāryasya ātma bhūtaḥ iti jananam eva upakriyā sāmānyāt artha antara bhūtaḥ eva atiśayaḥ vyaktibhiḥ na anyatas iti āha artha antara etyādi tasya upakāryasya sāmānyasya kim tena artha antareṇa upakāreṇa kriyate tasya ca upakārasya artha antarasya kim tena sāmānyena yena tasya sāmānyasya asau upakāra sambandhī syāt

original: sāmānyasya sambandhina upakārasya karaṇād vyaktayopy upakāriṇyaḥ syuḥ | upakārasya sāmānyam āśrayas tata āśrayāśrayibhāvalakṣaṇaḥ sambandhas tayor ity ata āha – tasyetyādi | tasyopakārasya tadāśrayatve | tatsāmānyamāśrayo yasyeti kṛtvā | tasya vā sāmānyasya tadāśrayatve | tasyopakārasyāśraya iti kṛtvā |
analyzed: sāmānyasya sambandhinaḥ upakārasya karaṇāt vyaktayaḥ api upakāriṇyaḥ syuḥ upakārasya sāmānyam āśrayaḥ tatas āśraya āśrayi bhāva lakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ tayoḥ iti atas āha tasya ityādi tasya upakārasya tad āśraya tve tat sāmānyam āśrayaḥ yasya iti kṛtvā tasya vā sāmānyasya tad āśraya tve tasya upakārasya āśrayaḥ iti kṛtvā

original: upakarotīty upakāro tadabhāvādanupakāri sāmānyam upakāraḥ sāmānyakṛto 'styasyopakārasyety upakārī | tatpratiṣedhād anupakārī | anupakārya ity arthaḥ | caitattantreṇopāttam (|) tenāyam arthaḥ (|) anupakārakasya sāmānyasyānupakāryasya copakārasya yathākramaṃ ka āśratāśrayibhāva iti | atiprasaṅgo veti |
analyzed: upakaroti iti tad abhāvāt anupakāri sāmānyam upakāraḥ sāmānya kṛtaḥ sti asya upakārasya iti upakārī tad pratiṣedhāt anupakārī anupakāryaḥ iti arthaḥ ca etat tantreṇa upāttam tena ayam arthaḥ anupakārakasya sāmānyasya anupakāryasya ca upakārasya yathākramam kaḥ āśrata āśrayi bhāvaḥ iti atiprasaṅgaḥ vā iti

original: anupakāriṇa āśrayāśrayibhāve sarvatra tatprasaṅgāt | upakāre vā sāmānyakṛte upakārasyābhyupagamyamāne | tatraiva sāmānye tasyopakārasya pratibandha iti kim anyo vyaktibhedas tasyopakārasya karaṇāt tasya sāmānyasyopakārī naiveti cet | tadapekṣasyeti vyaktyapekṣasyāśrayasyeti sāmānyasya | upakāraṃ pratyāśrayatvāt | tadupayoge tasminn upakāre |
analyzed: anupakāriṇaḥ āśraya āśrayi bhāve sarvatra tad prasaṅgāt upakāre vā sāmānya kṛte upakārasya abhyupagamyamāne tatra eva sāmānye tasya upakārasya pratibandhaḥ iti kim anyaḥ vyakti bhedaḥ tasya upakārasya karaṇāt tasya sāmānyasya upakārī na eva iti ced tad apekṣasya iti vyakti apekṣasya āśrayasya iti sāmānyasya upakāram prati āśraya tvāt tad upayoge tasmin upakāre
