original: ācāryas tu na nāma svahetubhyaḥ samānā utpannāstathāpi na sāmānyabalāt samānā iti pratītir iti darśayann āha – netyādi | taddarśana iti vyaktigrāhiṇi jñāne | sāmānyajñāne vā | bhinnābhinnayer iti viśeṣasāmānyayoḥ | ekakāryatāsādṛśyam iti | ekakāryataiva sādṛśyaṃ sāmyaṃ tenaiva samānā vyaktayaḥ pratīyanta ity arthaḥ |
analyzed: ācāryaḥ tu na nāma sva hetubhyaḥ samānāḥ utpannāḥ tathā api na sāmānya balāt samānāḥ iti pratītiḥ iti darśayan āha na ityādi tad darśane iti vyakti grāhiṇi jñāne sāmānya jñāne vā iti viśeṣa sāmānyayoḥ eka kāryatā sādṛśyam iti eka kāryatā eva sādṛśyam sāmyam tena eva samānāḥ vyaktayaḥ pratīyante iti arthaḥ

original: na tu pāramārthikena sāmānyena | tenaikakāryatā sādṛśyaṃ yeṣānta evāpohaviṣayā yeṣāṃ tvekakāryatā nāsti te 'pohyā iti siddhaṃ | yathā caikāntabhinnā apy ekakāryaṃ kurvanti tathoktaṃ prāk |
analyzed: na tu pāramārthikena sāmānyena tena eka kārya tā sādṛśyam yeṣām te eva apoha viṣayāḥ yeṣām tu eka kārya tā na asti te pohyāḥ iti siddham yathā ca ekānta bhinnāḥ api eka kāryam kurvanti tathā uktam prāk

original: kasmān na sāmānyena samānā pratīyanta ity āha – na hītyādi | arthajñāna ity anubhavajñāne dvāvākārau bhinnau | arthadvayakalpanena samānāsamānakalpena | kalpanāviṣayatām ity ekatvāropavikalpaviṣayatāṃ | tatheti samānarūpatayā | anayā vikalpabuddhyā |
analyzed: kasmāt na sāmānyena samānā pratīyante iti āha na hi ityādi artha jñāne iti anubhava jñāne dvau ākārau bhinnau artha dvaya kalpanena samāna asamāna kalpena kalpanā viṣaya tām iti eka tva āropa vikalpa viṣaya tām tathā iti samāna rūpatayā anayā vikalpa buddhyā

original: nanv ityādi paraḥ |
analyzed: nanu ityādi paraḥ

original: tāsāṃ vyaktīnāṃ dhīḥ kāryaṃ sā ca vibhidyata ity etāvān kārikābhāgaḥ | pratibhāvam ity etad apekṣya paṭhitaḥ | evambhāvaṃ prati | tadvad ityādi vivaraṇaṃ | tatpratibhāsinopi vyaktipratibhāsinopi jñānasya | tadvadvyaktibhedāt | katham ekakāryā vyaktayo naiva |(|110||)
analyzed: tāsām vyaktīnām dhīḥ kāryam sā ca vibhidyate iti etāvān kārikā bhāgaḥ pratibhāvam iti etat apekṣya paṭhitaḥ evambhāvam prati tadvat ityādi vivaraṇam tad pratibhāsinaḥ api vyakti pratibhāsinaḥ api jñānasya tadvat vyakti bhedāt katham eka kāryāḥ vyaktayaḥ na eva

original: syād etat (|) nānubhavajñānenaikakāryāḥ vyaktayaḥ kintu yattadvikalpakam ekarūpādhyāropeṇa (p.227) tadapekṣayety ata āha – taddhītyādi | taddhyanubhavajñānantāsāṃ vyaktīnāṃ kāryaṃ na vikalpavijñānantasya vyaktyabhāvepi bhāvāt | tasyaiva ca vikalpasya samānā ity ebam utpadyamānasya vyaktiṣu kiṃ sāmyaṃ |
analyzed: syāt etat na anubhava jñānena eka kāryāḥ vyaktayaḥ kintu yat tat vikalpakam eka rūpa adhyāropeṇa tad apekṣayā iti atas āha tat hi ityādi tat hi anubhava jñānam tāsām vyaktīnām kāryam na vikalpa vijñānam tasya vyakti abhāve api bhāvāt tasya eva ca vikalpasya samānāḥ iti ebam utpadyamānasya vyaktiṣu kim sāmyam

original: paṭādīnāṃ śītāpanayanam ity evamādiparigrahaḥ | pratidravyam ity avyayībhāvāt ṣaṣṭhyā ambhāvaḥ | dravyasya dravyasya yo bhedastasmād bhedāt kāraṇabhedād bhidyata iti yāvat |
analyzed: paṭa ādīnām śīta apanayanam iti evamādi parigrahaḥ pratidravyam iti avyayībhāvāt ṣaṣṭhyāḥ am bhāvaḥ dravyasya dravyasya yaḥ bhedaḥ tasmāt bhedāt kāraṇa bhedāt bhidyate iti yāvat

original: nety ācāryaḥ | ekapratyavamarśasyeti svaviṣayasyaikākārapratyayasya hetutvād dhīr nirvikalpikā vābhedinī bhāti | ekadhīhetubhāvenety adhyavasitaikarūpāyā buddher hetutvena vyaktīnāmabhinnatā bhāti |
analyzed: na iti ācāryaḥ eka pratyavamarśasya iti sva viṣayasya eka ākāra pratyayasya hetu tvāt dhīḥ nirvikalpikā vā abhedinī bhāti eka dhī hetu bhāvena iti adhyavasita eka rūpāyāḥ buddheḥ hetu tvena vyaktīnām abhinna tā bhāti

original: etad uktam bhavati | pratyekaṃ yady api vyaktisvarūpagrāhiṇyo dhiyo bhinnāstathāpi pratyabhijñayā tāsām ekatvam adhyavasīyate | anena caikakāryatāsādṛśyena vyaktīnām ekatvaṃ | na tvekaparāmarśahetutvenānubhavajñānānām ekatvam upacaryate | nāpi tathābhūtānubhavajñānahetutvena vyaktīnām ekatvam upacaryate |
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati pratyekam yadi api vyakti svarūpa grāhiṇyaḥ dhiyaḥ bhinnāḥ tathā api pratyabhijñayā tāsām eka tvam adhyavasīyate anena ca eka kāryatā sādṛśyena vyaktīnām eka tvam na tu eka parāmarśa hetu tvena anubhava jñānānām eka tvam upacaryate nā api tathābhūta anubhava jñāna hetu tvena vyaktīnām eka tvam upacaryate

original: skhalitapratyayaviṣayatvābhāvād upacaritopacārābhāvāc ca | vṛttyarthānurūpaś ca kārikārtho na vyākhyātaḥ syāt |(|111||)
analyzed: skhalita pratyaya viṣaya tva abhāvāt upacarita upacāra abhāvāt ca vṛtti artha anurūpaḥ ca kārikā arthaḥ na vyākhyātaḥ syāt

original: nanu yadyekakāryatāsādṛśyena vyaktīnām ekatvādhyavasāyaḥ kathantarhi buddhīnām ekatvādhyavasāyaḥ | ekakāryatvābhāvāt | atha tāḥ svabhāvata ekatvāvasāyaṃ janayanti vyaktayipyevambhaviṣyantīti kimekakāryatāsādṛśyena |
analyzed: nanu yadi eka kāryatā sādṛśyena vyaktīnām ekatva adhyavasāyaḥ katham tarhi buddhīnām ekatva adhyavasāyaḥ eka kārya tva abhāvāt atha tāḥ svabhāvataḥ ekatva avasāyam janayanti vyaktayipi evam bhaviṣyanti iti kim eka kāryatā sādṛśyena

original: sattyam (|) ācārya dignāgā bhiprāyeṇaivam uktam ity adoṣaḥ | tasmād ekatvādhyavasād ekatvam iṣyate | na paramārthata ity ata āha – niveditam ityādi | sarvabhāvāḥ svabhāvena vyāvṛttibhāgina (pra. vā. 1|42) ity atroktatvāt | tatretyasaṃsargiṣu bhedeṣu . ekākārā buddhiratasmiṃstadgrahād bhrāntir eva |
analyzed: sattyam ācārya dignāga abhiprāyeṇa evam uktam iti adoṣaḥ tasmāt ekatva adhyavasāt ekatvam iṣyate na paramārthataḥ iti atas āha niveditam ityādi sarva bhāvāḥ svabhāvena vyāvṛtti bhāginaḥ vā iti atra ukta tvāt tatra iti a saṃsargiṣu bhedeṣu eka ākārā buddhiḥ a tasmin tad grahāt bhrāntiḥ eva

original: atha syāt (|) sāmānyamantareṇa bhrāntarevāyoga ity ata āha – tāntv ityādi | tāmbhrāntimbhedinaḥ padārthā vyāvṛttāni svalakṣaṇāni krameṇa janayanti na sākṣāt | (p.228) svabhāva(ta) iti prakṛtyā | cakāro niveditam ity āsyānukarṣaṇārthaḥ | etad api tatraiva pastāve niveditaṃ | krameṇeti yaduktantasya vyākhyānaṃ nikalpahetavo bhavanta iti |
analyzed: atha syāt sāmānyam antareṇa bhrāntaḥ eva ayogaḥ iti atas āha tāntu ityādi tām bhrāntim bhedinaḥ padārthāḥ vyāvṛttāni sva lakṣaṇāni krameṇa janayanti na sākṣāt svabhāvataḥ iti prakṛtyā cakāraḥ niveditam iti āsya anukarṣaṇa arthaḥ etat api tatra eva pastāve niveditam krameṇa iti yat uktam tasya vyākhyānam nikalpa hetavaḥ bhavantaḥ iti

original: vikalpakāraṇatvād anubhavajñānamvikalpaḥ | vikalpahetor anubhavajñānasya hetavo bhavanta ity arthaḥ | vyaktayonubhavajñānaṃ yanayanti taccaikākārāṃ bhrāntimityayaṃ kramārthaḥ |
analyzed: vikalpa kāraṇa tvāt anubhava jñānam vikalpaḥ vikalpa hetoḥ anubhava jñānasya hetavaḥ bhavantaḥ iti arthaḥ vyaktayaḥ anubhava jñānam tat ca eka ākārām bhrāntim iti ayam krama arthaḥ

original: sa tveṣām ityādinā kārikārtham āha – sarveṣām bhāvānāmbhedonyāpohaḥ | kiṃ svabhāvo 'tatkārivivekaḥ sa eṣāmabhinna ity ucyate | kasmād (|) jñānāder arthasyendriyasyodakāharaṇādeś ca kasyacid ity ātmānurūpasyaikasya karaṇāt |
analyzed: sa tu eṣām ityādinā kārikā artham āha sarveṣām bhāvānām bhedaḥ nyā apohaḥ kim tad kāri vivekaḥ saḥ eṣām abhinnaḥ iti ucyate kasmāt jñāna ādeḥ arthasya indriyasya udaka āharaṇa ādeḥ ca kasyacid iti ātma anurūpasya ekasya karaṇāt

original: yadvā (|) nanu budder avāyamabhinnākāraḥ kathaṃ vyaktīnām ity ata āha – sa tvākāra eṣāṃ bāhyānāmabhinnastathaiva pratīteḥ (|) pratītir eva kutaḥ | jñānādeḥ kasyacid ekasya karaṇāt (|) sa cākāro bhedonyāpoha ity ucyate na sāmānyaṃ | kiṅkāraṇam (|) atatkāsisvabhāviveko yataḥ |
analyzed: yat vā nanu buddeḥ avāyam abhinna ākāraḥ katham vyaktīnām iti atas āha sa tu ākāraḥ eṣām bāhyānām abhinnaḥ tathā eva pratīteḥ pratītiḥ eva kutas jñāna ādeḥ kasyacid ekasya karaṇāt sa ca ākāraḥ bhedaḥ nyāpohaḥ iti ucyate na sāmānyam kiṅkāraṇam atatkāsi svabhāva vivekaḥ yatas

original: etad uktambhavati | prativyaktir gaur gaur iti pratyayenātatkārisvabhāvivekotatkārisvabhāvavivikta eva svabhāvo viṣayīkrite | na tvarthāntarabhūtaṃ sāmānyantena bheda ity ucyate | etatpaścārddhasya vyākhyānaṃ ||111|||
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati prati vyaktiḥ gauḥ gauḥ iti pratyayena atatkāri svabhāvi veka utatkāri svabhāva viviktaḥ eva svabhāvaḥ viṣayīkrite na tu artha antara bhūtam sāmānya antena bhedaḥ iti ucyate etat paśca arddhasya vyākhyānam

original: nanu kathaṃ jñānāder ekatvam ity āha – tadapotyādi | pūrvārddhasyaitad vyākhyānaṃ | tad pi jñānādikāryam abhinnaṃ khyātīti sambandhaḥ | prakṛtyeti svabhāvena | abhedāvaskandina ity abhedādhyavasāyinaḥ |
analyzed: nanu katham jñāna ādeḥ eka tvam iti āha tat apa utyādi pūrva arddhasya etat vyākhyānam tat jñāna ādi kāryam abhinnam khyāti iti sambandhaḥ prakṛtyā iti svabhāvena abheda avaskandinaḥ iti abheda adhyavasāyinaḥ

original: tathābhūtetyādinā vyaktīnām api vikalpaṃ prati pāramparyeṇa kāraṇatvam āha – abhedāvasāyo vidyate yasmiṃs tasya jñānāderity anubhavajñānasyodakādyāharaṇādeścārthasya hetutvāt kāraṇāt krameṇa vyaktayopyekaṃ pratyayaṃ janayantīti sambandhaḥ | kimviśiṣṭam ity āha – saṃsṛṣṭākāram ityādi | saṃsṛṣṭo vyaktiṣvāropita eka ākāro yena sa tathā |
analyzed: tathābhūta ityādinā vyaktīnām api vikalpam prati pāramparyeṇa kāraṇa tvam āha abheda avasāyaḥ vidyate yasmin tasya jñāna ādeḥ iti anubhava jñānasya udaka ādi āharaṇa ādeḥ ca arthasya hetu tvāt kāraṇāt krameṇa vyaktayaḥ api ekam pratyayam janayanti iti sambandhaḥ kimviśiṣṭam iti āha saṃsṛṣṭa ākāram ityādi saṃsṛṣṭaḥ vyaktiṣu āropitaḥ ekaḥ ākāraḥ yena sa tathā

original: svabhāvabhedonyavyāvṛttaṃ rūpaṃ sa eva paramārthonupacarito 'styeti vigrahaḥ | pāramparyeṇa vyāvṛttasvalakṣaṅadvārāyātatvād vikalpasya |
analyzed: svabhāva bhedaḥ nya vyāvṛttam rūpam saḥ eva vigrahaḥ pāramparyeṇa vyāvṛtta sva lakṣaṅa dvāra āyāta tvāt vikalpasya

original: nanu ca tāntu bhedinaḥ padārthā ityādināyamartho 'nantaram evoktaṃ |
analyzed: nanu ca tāntu bhedinaḥ padārthāḥ ityādinā ayam arthaḥ nantaram eva uktam

original: (p.229) sattyaṃ (|) kintu krameṇa vikalpahetavo bhavanta ityādyasyaivārtho 'nena sphuṭīkṛtaḥ | ekakāryabhedavastubhūtaṃ sāmānyambhaviṣyatīty ata āha – sācetyādi | sā caikakāryatā | atatkāryebhyo viśleṣo vyāvṛtta eva svabhāvo na vastubhūtaṃ sāmānyaṃ |
analyzed: sattyam kintu krameṇa vikalpa hetavaḥ bhavantaḥ iti ādyasya eva arthaḥ nena sphuṭīkṛtaḥ eka kārya bheda vastu bhūtam sāmānyam bhaviṣyati iti atas āha sā ca ityādi sā ca eka kārya tā a tad kāryebhyaḥ viśleṣaḥ vyāvṛttaḥ eva svabhāvaḥ na vastu bhūtam sāmānyam

original: kiṃ kāraṇantadanyasya svalakṣaṇādanyānurvattinonvayino vastuno vyaktivyatirekeṇādṛṣṭeḥ pratiṣedhāc ca pūrvoktāt |
analyzed: kim kāraṇam tad anyasya sva lakṣaṇāt anya anurvattinaḥ nvayinaḥ vastunaḥ vyakti vyatirekeṇa adṛṣṭeḥ pratiṣedhāt ca pūrva uktāt

original: na hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | dṛśyamupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptaṃ vibhāyena vyaktibhyo bhedena | sati vā sāmānye nityatvādanādheyātiṣa(?śa)yatvena kvacid vyaktyantare anāśritaṃ kathaṃ jñānahetuḥ | naiva | āśrayavyaṅgyasya tasya jñānahetutvam iṣṭam ity abhiprāyaḥ | etad apy uktam ity anena sambandhanīyaṃ | asyāpi prāguktatvāt |
analyzed: na hi ityādinā vyācaṣṭe dṛśyam upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptam vyaktibhyaḥ bhedena sati vā sāmānye nitya tvāt anādheya ati saśaya tvena kvacid vyakti antare anāśritam katham jñāna hetuḥ na eva āśraya vyaṅgyasya tasya jñāna hetu tvam iṣṭam iti abhiprāyaḥ etat api uktam iti anena sambandhanīyam asya api prāgukta tvāt

original: yata evambhūtaṃ sāmānyaṃ nāsti | tasmāt saṃketopītyādi | tadityanyāpohaḥ sambadhyate | tasyāsyāpohasya vikalpena svākārābhedenādhyas tasya vit jñānaṃ | tatpūrvako lābhaś ca | tadvit | saivārthaḥ phalam iti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ | (sa)mayasyāsti saṃketasyeti matvarthīyaṣīhan | vikalpādhyavasitabāhyārthapratipattyartham iti samudāyārthaḥ |
analyzed: yatas evambhūtam sāmānyam na asti tasmāt saṃketaḥ upi ityādi tat iti anya apohaḥ sambadhyate tasya asya apohasya vikalpena sva ākāra abhedena ādhyaḥ tasya vid jñānam tad pūrvakaḥ lābhaḥ ca tad vid saḥ eva arthaḥ phalam iti viśeṣaṇa samāsaḥ samayasya asti saṃketasya iti vikalpa adhyavasita bāhya artha pratipatti artham iti samudāya arthaḥ

original: sarvaścārambhaḥ phalārtha iti vidirlābhārthopyākṣipta evānyathāsaṃketakaraṇasya vaiyarthyāt |
analyzed: sarvaḥ ca ārambhaḥ phala arthaḥ iti vidiḥ lābha arthaḥ api ākṣiptaḥ eva anyathā saṃketa karaṇasya vaiyarthyāt

original: nanu tadvidartho yasyeti bahuvrīhiṇā bhavitavyaṃ lādhavāt | bahuvrīhiṇoktatvānmatvarthasya tadvibhā(gā)nutpattir lāghavatvaṃ | tathā ca bhāṣya uktaṃ karmadhārayād bahuvrīhir bhavatī NOTEREF _Ref500833213 \f \h  \* MERGEFORMAT Htyādi |
analyzed: nanu tadvid arthaḥ yasya iti bahuvrīhiṇā bhavitavyam lādhavāt bahuvrīhiṇā uktatvāt matvarthasya tad vibhāga anutpattiḥ lāghava tvam tathā ca bhāṣye uktam karmadhārayāt bahuvrīhiḥ bhavatī

original: naiṣa doṣaḥ. idam api tatroktam – kvacit karmadhārasya eva sarvasādhanādyartha NOTEREF _Ref500833352 \f \h  \* MERGEFORMAT I iti | ākṛtigaṇatvāc ca sarvasādhanādes tatrāyantadvirdathikaśabdo draṣṭavyaḥ |(|112||)
analyzed: na eṣa doṣaḥ idam api tatra uktam kvacid karmadhārasyaḥ eva sarva sādhana ādi artha iti ākṛti gaṇa tvāt ca sarva sādhana ādeḥ tatra ayanta dvirdathika śabdaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ 112

original: (p.230) yoyam ityādi vivaraṇaṃ | anyonyaṃ vivekonyavyāvṛttaḥ svabhāvo hāvānānta tpratītaye tanniścayārthaṃ svapratibhāse 'dhyavasitabāhyarūpe saṃketopi kriyamāṇaḥ obheta yuktiyuktatvāt (|) kimartha kriyata ity ata āha – atatkārītyādi | vivakṣitārthakriyākāriṇo ye na havanti teṣāṃ viekena parihāreṇa pravṛttyarthatayā |
analyzed: yaḥ yam ityādi vivaraṇam anyonyam vivekaḥ anya vyāvṛttaḥ svabhāvaḥ hāvānām tad pratītaye tad niścaya artham sva pratibhāse dhī avasita bāhya rūpe saṃketaḥ api kriyamāṇaḥ yukti yukta tvāt kimartha kriyate iti atas āha atatkāri ityādi vivakṣita arthakriyā kāriṇaḥ ye na havanti teṣām viekena parihāreṇa pravṛtti arthatayā

original: etad uktam bhavati | yadā vidhirūpeṇānyavyāvṛtortho viṣayīkṛtastadānyavyavacchedaḥ pratīyeta | etad evāha – na hītyādi | viveka iti viviktaḥ svabhāvaḥ | teṣāntatkāriṇāntebhya ity atatkāryebhyaḥ |
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati yadā vidhi rūpeṇa anya vyāvṛtaḥ ṛthaḥ viṣayīkṛtaḥ tadā anya vyavacchedaḥ pratīyeta etat eva āha na hi ityādi vivekaḥ iti viviktaḥ svabhāvaḥ teṣām tad kāriṇā antebhyaḥ iti a tad kāryebhyaḥ

original: yadi hi tasya viviktasya svabhāvasya pratītaye saṃketaḥ kṛtaḥ syād evaṃ vyavahārepi śabdena codyeta (|) tathā cānyaparihāreṇa pravartteteti saṃketopi tadvirdathika eva yuktaḥ |

original: nanu ca śabdajanitā buddhiḥ svākāram eva bāhyatayādhyasya grahaṇādalīkā | tataś ca tajjanakasya śabdasya katham vastusamvādaḥ kathaṃ cānyāpohaviṣayatvam ity ata āha –

original: sā cetyādi | anyāpohapratipattyartha yā saṃketikā | sā ca śrutiḥ | dhiyaṃ janayantyapīti sambandhaḥ | kimviśiṣṭām (|) akāryakṛti | avāhyarūpe svākāre | tatkāri tulyarūpeṇārthakriyākāri bāhyaikarūpeṇāvabhāsodhyavasāya iti tṛtīyāsamāsaḥ sa yasyā vidyata iti paścāt matvarthīyaḥ |
analyzed: sā ca ityādi anya apoha pratipatti artha yā saṃketikā sā ca śrutiḥ dhiyam janayanti api iti sambandhaḥ kimviśiṣṭām akārya kṛti avāhya rūpe sva ākāre tad kāri tulya rūpeṇa arthakriyā kāri bāhya eka rūpeṇa avabhāsa udhyavasāyaḥ iti tṛtīyā samāsaḥ sa yasyāḥ vidyate iti paścāt matvarthīyaḥ

original: etad uktambhavati yady anyavyāvṛttavastvadhyavasāyināṃ buddhiṃ janayecchutistadā tadanyavyāvṛtta eva svalakṣaṇe eva svalakṣaṇe puruṣaṃ pravarttayatīti samvādikā syāt | saṃketakāle ca śruteritaretarabhinna eva svabhāva āśrayas tatrāsyāḥ saṃketitatvāt | tadevampāramparyeṇā vastubhedāśrayāc ca kāraṇādarthe | na visamvādikā matā |
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati yadi anya vyāvṛtta vastu adhyavasāyinām buddhim janayet śutiḥ tadā tad anya vyāvṛtte eva sva lakṣaṇe eva sva lakṣaṇe puruṣam pravarttayati iti samvādikā syāt saṃketa kāle ca śruteḥ itaretara bhinnaḥ eva svabhāvaḥ āśrayaḥ tatra asyāḥ saṃketita tvāt tat evam pāramparyeṇa vastu bheda āśrayāt ca kāraṇāt arthe na visamvādikā matā

original: vyavahārakālepyanyavyāvṛttasyaiva vastunaḥ prāpaṇāt |
analyzed: vyavahāra kāle pi anya vyāvṛttasya eva vastunaḥ prāpaṇāt

original: nanu vidhirūpeṇa vastvadhyavasāyātkathaṃ śruteranyāpohaviṣayatvam ity ata āha – tata ityādi | yataścātatkāriparihārāṅgabhāvataḥ śruter vastubhedāśrayatvaṃ ca tataḥ kāraṇādanyāpohaviṣayā | etad eva dvayam āha – tatkartrāśritabhāvata iti | tasmin napohe karttṛ bhāvataḥ |
analyzed: nanu vidhi rūpeṇa vastu adhyavasāyāt katham śruteḥ anya apoha viṣayatvam iti atas āha tatas ityādi yatas ca atatkāri parihāra aṅgabhāvataḥ śruteḥ vastu bheda āśraya tvam ca tatas kāraṇāt anya apoha viṣayā etat eva dvayam āha tad kartṛ āśrita bhāvataḥ iti tasmin na apohe karttṛ bhāvataḥ

original: āśritabhāvaś ca svārthābhidhānadvāreṇārthādatatkāriparihārāṅgabhāvatastasmin napohe karttṛ bhāvaḥ śrateḥ | vyavahārakāle saṃketakāle ca vastubhedāśrayadvāreṇa pravṛttes tasmin napohe ḍruterāśritabhāvaḥ |
analyzed: āśrita bhāvaḥ ca svārtha abhidhāna dvāreṇa arthāt atatkāri parihāra aṅgabhāvataḥ tasmin napohe karttṛ bhāvaḥ śrateḥ vyavahāra kāle saṃketa kāle ca vastu bheda āśraya dvāreṇa pravṛtteḥ tasmin napohe ḍruteḥ āśrita bhāvaḥ

original: eketyādinā kārikārtham āha – tamityekamākāraṃ svapratibhāsinamāropyārtheṣvadhyasyotpadyamānāṃ | sa ca svapratibhāso mithyāvabhāsitvādakāryakārī | tam evaṃ bhūtam api kāryakāriṇam ivādhyavasyantīṃ | anenākāryakṛtātyādi vyākhyātaṃ | vastupṛthagbhāvamātramanyavyavacchedamātraṃ yasyā buddhet iti vigrahah |

original: mithyābuddhiṃ janayantyapi śrutiḥ (|) kasmān mithyābuddhir ity ata āha – samānādhyavasāyām ekākārādhyavasāyāṃ (p.232) | tadanyaparihārāṅgabhāvāt | vivakṣitādarthādanyasya parihārāṅgabhāvatayā vyavacchedāśrayabhāvataḥ | paramārthato vastutaḥ | tadvyatirekiṣvatatkāryatirekiṣu na visamvādikety ucyate |
analyzed: mithyā buddhim janayanti api śrutiḥ kasmāt mithyā buddhiḥ iti atas āha samāna adhyavasāyām eka ākāra adhyavasāyām tad anya parihāra aṅga bhāvāt vivakṣitāt arthāt anyasya parihāra aṅga bhāva tayā vyavaccheda āśraya bhāvataḥ paramārthataḥ vastutas tad vyatirekiṣu a tad kāri atirekiṣu na visamvādikā iti ucyate

original: tathā hyanityakṛtakādiśrutayo yathābhūtasya nityādivyāvṛttasya vastuno vyāvṛttimupādāya saṃketitatvād vyavahārepi tathā bhūtasyānyaparihārāṅgabhāvena prāptihetavo bhavanti | tena yathārthadarśanānyāyātatvācchūter api samvādaḥ |

original: yad vā yathābhūte vyavacchede sā śrutiḥ saṃketitā tasya paramārthatosti vastuṣu sadbhāva itīyatā lebhenāvisamvāditvaṃ na tu dhūmādivacchabdānāmāvaśyako vastunipratibandhasteṣām icchāmātrapratibaddhatvāt |

original: yad vā śabdajñānābhyāṃ dūramutsṛṣṭaṃ tyaktaṃ syāt | kutaḥ (|) tadviṣayābhimatasya śabdādiviṣayābhimatasya | tasyeti sāmānyasya vastusvabhāvāt | anyasya sāmānyavyatiriktasya vastudharmasya vastusvabhāvasya svalakṣaṇasyāsaṃsparśādagrahaṇāt | yataś ca svalakṣaṇan na gṛ hṇātyatha ca svākārābhinnamadhyavasyati |

original: evaṃ vṛkṣāvṛkṣayor madhye ekasya vṛkṣasyāvṛkṣasya vā grahābhāve dvayāgrahaḥ |

original: yadi vyavacchinnāstadā te jñātā aṅgīkarttavyā | ajñātānāṃ vyavacchedābhāvāt | tac ca jñānanteṣu na yujyate | tad āha – katham ityādi | kathaṃ jñātā vṛkṣārthagrahaṇād ṛte | ityetāvān kārikābhāgaḥ | prākchabdas tu miśrakavyākhyānenopāttaḥ | vṛkṣārthagrahaṇam vinā prāg vṛkṣārthagrahaṇād avṛkṣāḥ | kathaṃ jñātā ity arthaḥ |
analyzed: yadi vyavacchinnāḥ tadā te jñātāḥ aṅgīkarttavyāḥ ajñātānām vyavaccheda abhāvāt tat ca jñānam teṣu na yujyate tat āha katham ityādi katham jñātāḥ vṛkṣa artha grahaṇāt ṛte iti etāvān kārikā bhāgaḥ prāk śabdaḥ tu miśraka vyākhyānena upāttaḥ vṛkṣa artha grahaṇam vinā prāk vṛkṣa artha grahaṇāt avṛkṣāḥ katham jñātāḥ iti arthaḥ

original: ye tu prākśabdaṃ kārikāyāṃ paṭhanti tair arthaśabdo na paṭhitavyaḥ | na hy avṛkṣaniścayakāle vṛkṣārthagrahaṇam asty avṛkṣagrahaṇapūrvakatvāt vṛkṣagrahaṇasya (|) na ca vṛkṣaniścayamantareṇa vṛkṣārthagraho yuktas tasyāpi vṛkṣagrahaṇapūrvakatvāt | etad vāha – na hītyādi | tadeti saṃketakāle pratipattā | yasmai saṃketaḥ kriyate |
analyzed: ye tu prāc śabdam kārikāyām paṭhanti taiḥ artha śabdaḥ na paṭhitavyaḥ na hi a vṛkṣa niścaya kāle vṛkṣa artha grahaṇam asti a vṛkṣa grahaṇa pūrvaka tvāt vṛkṣa grahaṇasya na ca vṛkṣa niścayam antareṇa vṛkṣa artha grahaḥ yuktaḥ tasya api vṛkṣa grahaṇa pūrvaka tvāt etat vā āha na hi ityādi tadā iti saṃketa kāle pratipattā yasmai saṃketaḥ kriyate

original: kasmān na vettīty āha – tad ityādi | tasya vṛkṣāvṛkṣasya jñānāyaiva tadarthitayā saṃketārthitayopagamād upasthitatvāt | kathaṃ nāma saṃketottarakālaṃ vṛkṣāvṛkṣau jñāsyāmīti | yadvā tadarthitayopagamād iti saṃketārthitayā pravṛtteḥ | ato nāsti saṃketakāle vṛkṣāvṛkṣajñānaṃ pratipattuḥ |
analyzed: kasmāt na vetti iti āha tat ityādi tasya vṛkṣāvṛkṣasya jñānāya eva tad arthi tayā saṃketa arthi tayā upagamāt upasthita tvāt katham nāma saṃketa uttara kālam vṛkṣāvṛkṣau jñāsyāmi iti yat vā tad arthi tayā upagamāt iti saṃketa arthi tayā pravṛtteḥ atas na asti saṃketa kāle vṛkṣāvṛkṣa jñānam pratipattuḥ

original: sa ca vṛkṣāvṛkṣamajānānaḥ (p.235) katham avṛkṣavyavacchedaṃ pratipadyeta saṃkete | naiva pratipadyata | avṛkṣavyavacchedāpratipattau ca satyāmaparihṛto na vyavacchinnastadanyas tasmād vṛkṣād anyo yasmin vṛkṣārthe so parihṛtatadanyas tasmin niveśas saṃketaḥ | saptamīti yogavibhāgāt samasaḥ | sa yasmin śabdestīti matvarthīya iti |
analyzed: sa ca vṛkṣāvṛkṣam a jānānaḥ katham a vṛkṣa vyavacchedam pratipadyeta saṃkete na eva pratipadyata a vṛkṣa vyavaccheda a pratipattau ca satyām a parihṛtaḥ na vyavacchinnaḥ tad anyaḥ tasmāt vṛkṣāt anyaḥ yasmin vṛkṣa arthe saḥ u parihṛta tad anyaḥ tasmin niveśaḥ saṃketaḥ saptamī iti yogavibhāgāt samasaḥ sa yasmin iti

original: aparihṛtatadanyannirdeṣṭuṃ śīlam asyeti ṇinircā | avṛkṣādavyavacchinnerthe saṃpramugdharūpe saṃketitād iti yāvat |
analyzed: a parihṛta tad anyat nirdeṣṭum śīlam asya iti a vṛkṣāt avyavacchinna ṛthe saṃpramugdha rūpe saṃketitāt iti yāvat

original: aparaḥ prakāraḥ | vṛkṣādanyastadanyastasminniveśaḥ saṃketaḥ | aparihṛtaś cāsau tadanyaniveśaś ceti kamadhārayaḥ | sa yasyāsti vṛkṣaśabdasyeti pūrvavat | avṛkṣād avyavacchinnatvād vṛkṣārthasya | tatra saṃkety amānasya śabdasyāvṛkṣepi viveśaḥ prasaktaḥ | vṛkṣabhedeṣv iveti samudāyārthaḥ |(|118)
analyzed: aparaḥ prakāraḥ vṛkṣāt anyaḥ tad anyaḥ tasmin niveśaḥ saṃketaḥ aparihṛtaḥ ca asau tad anya niveśaḥ ca iti kamadhārayaḥ sa yasya asti vṛkṣa śabdasya iti pūrvavat avṛkṣāt avyavacchinna tvāt vṛkṣa arthasya tatra amānasya śabdasya avṛkṣe api viveśaḥ prasaktaḥ vṛkṣa bhedeṣu iva iti samudāya arthaḥ

original: tasmād evaṃbhūd vṛkṣāriṇāṃ puṃsāṃ vyavahārakāle tatparihāreṇāvṛkṣaparihāreṇa niyate śākhādimati pravṛttir na syāt | kintvaviśeṣaṇa vṛkṣāvṛkṣayoḥ pravṛttir bhavet | kimvat | vṛkṣabhedavat | na hi vṛkṣaśabdāt prakaraṇādirahitād vṛkṣaviśeṣe khadirādau tadanyavṛkṣaparihāreṇa pravṛttir bhavati | saṃketakāle teṣāmavyavacchedāt |
analyzed: tasmāt vṛkṣa ariṇām puṃsām vyavahāra kāle tad parihāreṇa avṛkṣa parihāreṇa niyate śākhā ādimati pravṛttiḥ na syāt kintu aviśeṣaṇa vṛkṣa avṛkṣayoḥ pravṛttiḥ bhavet kimvat vṛkṣa bheda vat na hi vṛkṣa śabdāt prakaraṇa ādi rahitāt vṛkṣa viśeṣe khadira ādau tad anya vṛkṣa parihāreṇa pravṛttiḥ bhavati saṃketa kāle teṣām avyavacchedāt

original: na hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | saṃketakālaḥ saṃketaśabdenoktaḥ parārthavyavacchedeneti parasmād avṛkṣād vṛkṣād vṛkṣārthasyāvyavacchedena | dvitīye tu vyākhyāne (|) parisminnavṛkṣe vṛkṣaśabdasya saṃketāvyavacchedeneti vyākhyeyaṃ | niveśitād iti saṃketitāt | tatparihāreṇāvṛkṣaparihāreṇa vṛkṣavad ity asya vyākhyānaṃ śiṃśapādibhedavad iti |
analyzed: na hi ityādinā vyācaṣṭe saṃketa kālaḥ saṃketa śabdena uktaḥ para artha vyavacchedena iti parasmāt a vṛkṣāt vṛkṣāt vṛkṣa arthasya avyavacchedena dvitīye tu vyākhyāne vṛkṣa śabdasya saṃketa avyavacchedena iti vyākhyeyam niveśitāt iti saṃketitāt tad parihāreṇa a vṛkṣa parihāreṇa vṛkṣa vat iti asya vyākhyānam śiṃśapā ādi bheda vat iti

original: śiśapādaya eva bhedā iti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ vatiḥ saptamyarthe | sūtre tu vṛkṣabhedā iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ | śiṃśapādayo hi bhedā vṛkṣasya bhedā bhavantīty anurūpaiva vṛttiḥ teṣu ca yathā vṛkṣaśabdān na parasparavyacchedena pravṛttis tathā sūtravibhāga eva  vyākhyātaṃ |
analyzed: śiśapa ādayaḥ eva bhedāḥ iti viśeṣaṇa samāsaḥ vatiḥ saptamī arthe sūtre tu vṛkṣa bhedāḥ iti ṣaṣṭhī samāsaḥ śiṃśapā ādayaḥ hi bhedāḥ vṛkṣasya bhedāḥ bhavanti iti anurūpā eva vṛttiḥ teṣu ca yathā vṛkṣa śabdāt na paraspara vyacchedena pravṛttiḥ tathā sūtra vibhāgaḥ eva vyākhyātam

original: athetyādinā parābhiprāyamāśaṃkate | avidhāyāniṣidhyānyad iti pratiṣedhadvayaṃ (p.236) kecit paṭhanti | saṃkete viṣayamabhidhāyātonyavvāniṣidhyeti | taccāyuktam iva dṛśyate vidhipratiśedgau muktvā śabdapravṛttyasambhavāt | ekasya hi pradarśanam abhidadhatā vidheraṅgīkṛtaḥ | tataś cāvidhāya padarśyetipadadvayaṃ vyāhatam syāt |
analyzed: atha ityādinā para abhiprāyam āśaṃkate a vidhāya a niṣidhya anyat iti pratiṣedha dvayam kecid paṭhanti saṃkete viṣayam abhidhāya atas nya vvā niṣidhya iti tat ca ayuktam iva dṛśyate muktvā śabda pravṛtti asambhavāt ekasya hi pradarśanam abhidadhatā vidheḥ aṅgīkṛtaḥ tatas ca a vidhāya vyāhatam syāt

original: tasmād avidhāyety atraiva nañ draṣṭavyaḥ | avidhāya niṣidhyānyad iti pāṭhaḥ | niṣidhyānyat pūrvantadvyavacchedenāparaṃ saṃketaviṣayam avidhāya | pratiṣedhapūrvakaṃ vidhim akṛtvā vidhimātram eva kevalaṃ kṛtvety arthaḥ ata |
analyzed: tasmāt a vidhāya iti atra eva nañ draṣṭavyaḥ a vidhāya niṣidhya anyat iti pāṭhaḥ niṣidhya anyat pūrva anta vyavacchedena aparam saṃketa viṣayam a vidhāya pratiṣedha pūrvakam vidhim a kṛtvā vidhi mātram eva kevalam kṛtvā iti arthaḥ atas

original: eva pradarśyaikam iti vṛttāv api na kasyācid vyavacchedena kiṃcid vidhīyata ity anyaniṣedhapūrvakam eva vidhānaṃ pratiṣedhati | kevalas tu vidhiraṅgīkṛta eva | ekam iti sāmānyaṃ | etena sāmānye saṃketakaraṇāt sarvavyaktiṣu kṛta iityācaṣṭe (|119||)
analyzed: eva pradarśya ekam iti vṛttau api na kasyācid vyavacchedena kiṃcid vidhīyate iti anya niṣedha pūrvakam eva vidhānam pratiṣedhati kevalaḥ tu vidhiḥ aṅgīkṛtaḥ eva ekam iti sāmānyam etena sāmānye saṃketa karaṇāt sarva vyaktiṣu kṛtaḥ iti ācaṣṭe 119

original: vṛkṣoyam iti saṃketasvarūpandarśayati | yadvastu pradarśya saṃketaḥ kṛtastat pratipadyate vyavahārepi (|) tena kāranenāyamanantarokto vastusāmānyavādino 'doṣaḥ | tathā dṛṣṭam evārtham iti sāmānyaṃ yatra saṃketaḥ kṛtaḥ | tatsambandhinaṃ veti sāmānyasambandhinamāśrayaṃ |
analyzed: vṛkṣaḥ ayam iti saṃketa svarūpan darśayati yat vastu pradarśya saṃketaḥ kṛtaḥ tat pratipadyate vyavahāre pi tena kāranena ayam anantara uktaḥ vastu sāmānya vādinaḥ doṣaḥ tathā dṛṣṭam eva artham iti sāmānyam yatra saṃketaḥ kṛtaḥ tad sambandhinam vā iti sāmānya sambandhinam āśrayam

original: tatrāpīti vidhinā kevalenāpi saṃkete kriyamāṇe dvau vikalpau vṛkṣoyam iti saṃketaṃ kurvāṇaḥ tarurayam apīti vidadhīta | tarurayam eveti vā | ādye pakṣe tarutvamanyasyāpyaniṣiddham iti vyavahāre niyamena pravṛttir na syād iti sa eva prasaṅgaḥ | atha tarurayam eveti tadā sa evātaruravyavacchedoṅgīkṛtaḥ |
analyzed: tatra api iti vidhinā kevalena api saṃkete kriyamāṇe dvau vikalpau vṛkṣaḥ ayam iti saṃketam kurvāṇaḥ taruḥ ayam api iti vidadhīta taruḥ ayam eva iti vā ādye pakṣe taru tvam anyasya api aniṣiddham iti vyavahāre niyamena pravṛttiḥ na syāt iti saḥ eva prasaṅgaḥ atha taruḥ ayam eva iti tadā saḥ eva a taruḥ avyavaccheda uṅgīkṛtaḥ

original: tataś ca saṃketakāle pratipadyamānena kathaṃ vṛkṣāvṛkṣau jñātāv iti tadavasthaḥ prasaṅgaḥ | tadāha (|) prasaṅgo na nivartata iti |

original: ekam ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | ayam api vṛkṣo 'yam eva vṛkṣa iti | gatim iti prakāraṃ | tayoś ceti dvayor api prakārayoḥ | na doṣa ityādi paraḥ | dṛṣṭopaṭākāronubhūtas tadviparītasya tato vilakṣaṇasya sujñānatvāt |
analyzed: ekam ityādinā vyācaṣṭe ayam api vṛkṣaḥ yam eva vṛkṣaḥ iti gatim iti prakāram tayoḥ ca iti dvayoḥ api prakārayoḥ na doṣaḥ ityādi paraḥ dṛṣṭaḥ upaṭa ākāraḥ anubhūtaḥ tad viparītasya tatas vilakṣaṇasya su jñāna tvāt

original: (p.237) etad eva grahaṇakavākyam ekaṃ hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | ekaṃ hi kiṃcit sāmānyaṃ vṛkṣatvādikampaśyatonyatra tatsāmānyarahite lakṣaṇe vastuni tadvākāravivekinī yathā paridṛṣṭākāravilakṣaṇākārāmbuddhim anubhāvataḥ puṃso yathānubhavantato yathā paridṛṣṭādanyad ity evaṃrūpo vaidharmyaniścayo vailakṣaṇyaniścayaḥ |
analyzed: etat eva grahaṇaka vākyam ekam hi ityādinā vyācaṣṭe ekam hi kiṃcid sāmānyam vṛkṣa tva ādikam paśyataḥ anyatra tad sāmānya rahite lakṣaṇe vastuni tat vā ākāra vivekinī yathā paridṛṣṭa ākāra vilakṣaṇa ākārām buddhim anubhāvataḥ puṃsaḥ yathā anubhavan tatas yathā paridṛṣṭāt anyat iti evaṃrūpaḥ vaidharmya niścayaḥ vailakṣaṇya niścayaḥ

original: etena vaidharmyaniścayasya svabhāva uktaḥ |(|120||)
analyzed: etena vaidharmya niścayasya svabhāvaḥ uktaḥ

original: tadvivecana iti vyāpāraḥ (pūrvadṛṣṭādṛṣṭārthavivecanaḥ) pṛthagbhāvasya vyavasthāpayati | tatonyad ity anenaiva tadvivecane siddhe yat punas tadvivecanagrahaṇantatspaṣṭārthaṃ | tatraitasmin krame sati yathānubhavamvaidharmyaniścayavān sa pratipattā | yaṃ śākhādimantam artham viśiṣṭasāmānyavantamākārāntarād vivecayati |
analyzed: tad vivecanaḥ iti vyāpāraḥ pūrva dṛṣṭa adṛṣṭa artha vivecanaḥ pṛthagbhāvasya vyavasthāpayati tatas anyat iti anena eva tad vivecane siddhe yat punar tad vivecana grahaṇam tat spaṣṭa artham tatra etasmin krame sati yathānubhavam vaidharmya niścayavān sa pratipattā yam śākhā ādimantam artham viśiṣṭa sāmānyavantam ākāra antarāt vivecayati

original: taṃ purodhāyāyam eva vṛkṣaiti pradarśya vyutpāditaḥ saṃketaṃ grāhito | yatraiva taṃ saṃketānurūpaṃ sāmānyātmānan na paśyati | tam evāvṛkṣaṃ svayam eva śabdavyāpāramvinā pratipadyate | tad evam ākārāntarāt svayam eva vivekenāvadhāritaṃ sāmānyātmānamupādāya saṃkete kṛte sarvāsu sajātīyavyaktiṣu kṛto bhavati | sāmānyasya sarvatrānvayāt |
analyzed: tam purodhāya ayam eva vṛkṣaḥ eti pradarśya vyutpāditaḥ saṃketam grāhitaḥ yatra eva tam saṃketa anurūpam sāmānya ātmānan na paśyati tam eva a vṛkṣam svayam eva śabda vyāpāram vinā pratipadyate tat evam ākāra antarāt svayam eva vivekena avadhāritam sāmānya ātmānam upādāya saṃkete kṛte sarvāsu sajātīya vyaktiṣu kṛtaḥ bhavati sāmānyasya sarvatra anvayāt

original: ayam eveti cāvadhāraṇāt saṃkete kṛte dṛṣṭaviparītasya sujñānatvāt | tatonyatrāvṛkṣa iti niścayo bhavatīti na yathoktadoṣaḥ |
analyzed: ayam eva iti ca avadhāraṇāt saṃkete kṛte dṛṣṭa viparītasya su jñāna tvāt tatas nyatra āvṛkṣaḥ iti niścayaḥ bhavati iti na yathā ukta doṣaḥ

original: apāstaṃ | yata ekasminn anyavyāvṛtte svalakṣaṇe śabdaliṅgābhyāṃ sambandham pratipadyamānopy anyatrāpy evaṃ rūpeṣu sambandhaṃ pratipadyata evaikatvādhyavasāyād iti kṛtonvayarahitatvādidoṣa iti | vastubhūtantu sāmānyam āśritya vṛkṣāvṛkṣavibhāgo na ghaṭate | tadāha (|) na punar ityādi |
analyzed: apāstam yatas ekasmin anya vyāvṛtte sva lakṣaṇe śabda liṅgābhyām sambandham pratipadyamānaḥ api anyatra api evam rūpeṣu sambandham pratipadyate eva ekatva adhyavasāyāt iti kṛtaḥ nvaya rahita tva ādi doṣaḥ iti vastu bhūtam tu sāmānyam āśritya vṛkṣa a vṛkṣa vibhāgaḥ na ghaṭate tat āha na punar ityādi

original: ekam vastu sāmānyaṃ dṛśyam upalabdilakṣaṇaprāptan tatra svalakṣaṇeṣv asti | yathā vṛkṣabhedebhyo ghaṭādayo bhinnās tathā dhavādayopi (|) parasparanteṣāmbhinnānāndarśanepi yasya sāmānyasya darśanādarśanābhyāṃ vṛkṣāvṛkṣavibhāgaṃ kurvīta yatredaṃ sāmānyaṃ dṛśyate sa vṛkṣo yatra na dṛśyate so 'vṛkṣa iti |
analyzed: ekam vastu sāmānyam dṛśyam tatra sva lakṣaṇeṣu asti yathā vṛkṣa bhedebhyaḥ ghaṭa ādayaḥ bhinnāḥ tathā dhava ādayaḥ api yasya sāmānyasya darśana adarśanābhyām vṛkṣa a vṛkṣa vibhāgam kurvīta yatra idam sāmānyam dṛśyate sa vṛkṣaḥ yatra na dṛśyate saḥ vṛkṣaḥ iti

original: kasmān nāstīty āha – tasyetyādi | sāmānyasya vyatiriktasya śākhādipratibhāsād vibhāge nāgrahaṇāt | na hi vṛkṣādiṣu dvau pratibhāsāv upalabhyete | ekaḥ śākhādyākāro 'paraś cāśākhādyākāraḥ | na ca śākhādyākāra eva sāmānyaṃ pratibhāsata iti śakyam vaktun tasya śākhādyākāratvāt | daṇḍavaddaṇḍinīti vaidharmyadṛṣṭāntaḥ |
analyzed: kasmāt na asti iti āha tasya ityādi sāmānyasya vyatiriktasya śākhā ādi pratibhāsāt vibhāge na agrahaṇāt na hi vṛkṣa ādiṣu dvau pratibhāsau upalabhyete ekaḥ śākhā ādi ākāraḥ paraḥ ca a śākhā ādi ākāraḥ na ca śākhā ādi ākāraḥ eva sāmānyam pratibhāsate iti śakyam vaktum tasya śākhā ādi ākāra tvāt daṇḍa vat daṇḍinī iti vaidharmya dṛṣṭāntaḥ

original: yathā daṇḍani daṇḍasya bhedena grahaṇaṃ | naivaṃ sāmānyasya | aparasmāc chākhādimataḥ pravibhāgenāgṛhītasya ca sāmānyasya vyaktiṣv anupalakṣaṇāt | svarūpeṇa parasyopalambhanam upalakṣaṇantac ca svayam agṛhītasya katham bhavet |
analyzed: yathā daṇḍani daṇḍasya bhedena grahaṇam na evam sāmānyasya aparasmāt śākhā ādimataḥ pravibhāgena agṛhītasya ca sāmānyasya vyaktiṣu anupalakṣaṇāt svarūpeṇa parasya upalambhanam upalakṣaṇam tat ca svayam agṛhītasya katham bhavet

original: anarthāntarasāmānyavādinastvākṛter ekatra vyaktau dṛṣṭāyāḥ svalakṣaṇād avyatirekāttadvadevānyatra vyaktyantare draṣṭum aśakyatvāt | tataś ca tadatadṛtor iti saṃketakālaparidṛṣṭaikavṛkṣākṛtiryasyāsti sa tadvān | paścād vyavahārakāle dṛśyamāno vṛkṣabhedaḥ pūrvadṛṣṭavṛkṣākṛtirahito 'tadvān |
analyzed: anartha antara sāmānya vādinaḥ tu ākṛteḥ ekatra vyaktau dṛṣṭāyāḥ sva lakṣaṇāt avyatirekāt tadvat eva anyatra vyakti antare draṣṭum aśakya tvāt tatas ca iti saṃketa kāla paridṛṣṭa eka vṛkṣa ākṛtiḥ yasya asti sa tadvān paścāt vyavahāra kāle dṛśyamānaḥ vṛkṣa bhedaḥ pūrva dṛṣṭa vṛkṣa ākṛti rahitaḥ tadvān

original: tayor yathākramaṃ vṛkṣāvṛkṣatve nyāyaprāptatve sati vyaktirekaiveti saṃketakāle dṛṣṭaiva vṛkṣaḥ syān na tu vyavahārakāle dṛśyamānā | saṃketakāle dṛṣṭāyā ākṛteranyatrādarśanāt |
analyzed: tayoḥ yathākramam vṛkṣa avṛkṣa tve nyāya prāpta tve sati vyaktiḥ ekā eva iti saṃketa kāle dṛṣṭā eva vṛkṣaḥ syāt na tu vyavahāra kāle dṛśyamānā saṃketa kāle dṛṣṭāyāḥ ākṛteḥ anyatra adarśanāt

original: anyāpohe śabdārthaparairavyāpitvaṃ coditaṃ tatparijihīrṣavān pūrvapakṣadigmātrantāvat (p.243) karoti | bhavatu nāmetyādi | kasmāt tatrārthāntaravyavacchedo nāstīty āha – na hy ajñeyam ityādi | yata ity ajñeyāt | ajñeyaṃ kasmān nāstīti ced āha – tata ityādi |
analyzed: anya apohe śabda artha paraiḥ avyāpi tvam ca uditam tat parijihīrṣavān pūrvapakṣa diś mātra antāvat karoti bhavatu nāma ityādi kasmāt tatra artha antara vyavacchedaḥ na asti iti āha na hi ajñeyam ityādi yatas iti ajñeyāt ajñeyam kasmāt na asti iti ced āha tatas ityādi

original: ajñeyād vijñeyasya bhedena viṣayīkaraṇam aṅgīkarttavyam anyavyavacchedavādinā 'nyathā katham ajñeyāt jñeyasya vyavacchedaḥ | tataś cājñeyāt jñeyasya bhedena viṣayīkaraṇe saty eva tasyājñeyābhimatasya jñeyatvāt | na hyaviṣayīkṛtād vyavacchedaḥ śakyo darśayituṃ | ādiśabdāt sarvasamudāyadvyādiśabdānāṃ grahaṇaṃ |
analyzed: ajñeyāt vijñeyasya bhedena viṣayīkaraṇam aṅgīkarttavyam anya vyavaccheda vādinā nyathā katham ajñeyāt jñeyasya vyavacchedaḥ tatas ca ajñeyāt jñeyasya bhedena viṣayīkaraṇe sati eva tasya ajñeya abhimatasya jñeya tvāt na hi aviṣayīkṛtāt vyavacchedaḥ śakyaḥ darśayitum ādi śabdāt sarva samudāya dvi ādi śabdānām grahaṇam

original: taduktambha ṭṭo dyo ta ka rā bhyāṃ | anyāpohaś ca śabdārtha ityayuktam avyāpakatvāt | yatra dvairāśyam bhavati tatretarapratiṣedhāditaraḥ pratīyate yathā gaur iti pade 'goḥ pratiṣedhena gauḥ pratīyate |
analyzed: tat uktam bha ṭṭa ta ka rā bhyām anya apohaḥ ca śabda arthaḥ iti ayuktam avyāpaka tvāt yatra dvairāśyam bhavati tatra itara pratiṣedhāt itaraḥ pratīyate yathā gauḥ iti pade goḥ pratiṣedhena gauḥ pratīyate

original: na punaḥ sarvapada etad asti | na hy asarvannāma kiṃ cid asti yatsarvaśabdena vinivarttyeta | atha manyase ekādyasarvaṃ tat sarvaśabdena nivarttyate | tatra svārthāpavād adoṣaprasaṅgāt | evaṃ hi saty ekādivyudāsena pravarttamānaḥ śabdaḥ | aṅgapratiṣedhād aṅgavyatiriktasya cāṅginonabhyupagamād anarthakaḥ syāt |
analyzed: na punar sarva pade etat asti na hi asarvat nāma kim cit asti yat sarva śabdena vinivarttyeta atha manyase eka ādi asarvam tat sarva śabdena nivarttyate tatra svārtha apavād adoṣa prasaṅgāt evam hi sati eka ādi vyudāsena pravarttamānaḥ śabdaḥ aṅga pratiṣedhāt aṅga vyatiriktasya ca aṅginaḥ anabhyupagamāt anarthakaḥ syāt

original: evaṃ sarvasamudāyaśabdā ekadeśapratiṣedharūpeṇa pravarttamānāḥ samudāyivyatiriktasamudāyān abhyupagamādanarthakāḥ prāpnuvanti | dvyādiśabdānāṃ ca samuccayaviṣayatvād ekādipratiṣedhe pratiṣidhyamānānāmasamuccayatvāt | dvyādiśabdānām anarthakatvam iti |
analyzed: evam sarva samudāya śabdāḥ eka deśa pratiṣedha rūpeṇa pravarttamānāḥ samudāyi vyatirikta samudāyān abhyupagamāt anarthakāḥ prāpnuvanti dvi ādi śabdānām ca samuccaya viṣaya tvāt eka ādi pratiṣedhe pratiṣidhyamānānām asamuccaya tvāt dvi ādi śabdānām anarthaka tvam iti

original: naiṣa doṣa ity ācāryaḥ | yasmād ākāṃkṣāvatīṃ buddhiṃ kutaś cin nivarttya tasyā buddheḥ kvacid viniyate 'rthe niveśanāyākāṅkṣāvataḥ puṃsaḥ kaś cic chabdaḥ prayujyate pratipādayitrā | kva cin niveśanāyety anenānvaya uktaḥ | kutaś cid vinivarttyety anena vyatirekaḥ |
analyzed: na eṣa doṣaḥ iti ācāryaḥ yasmāt ākāṃkṣāvatīm buddhim kutas cit nivarttya tasyāḥ buddheḥ kvacid viniyate rthe niveśanāya ākāṅkṣāvataḥ puṃsaḥ kaḥ cid śabdaḥ prayujyate pratipādayitrā kva cit niveśanāya iti anena anvayaḥ uktaḥ kutas cit vinivarttya iti anena vyatirekaḥ

original: kiṅ kāraṇaṃ kutaś cin nivarttya kva cin niveśyate śabda ity ata āha – tadarthasyetyādi | śabdārthasyāvadhāraṇāt | anyathā yadi tena śabdena na kaś cid artho vyavacchidyeta vyarthaḥ śabdaprayogaḥ syāt | yata evantasmājjjñeyādipadeṣvityādiśabdāt sarvaviśvādipadeṣu (p.244) | kim viśiṣṭeṣu (|) vyavahāropanīteṣu |
analyzed: kim kāraṇam kutas cit nivarttya kva cit niveśyate śabdaḥ iti atas āha tad arthasya ityādi śabda arthasya avadhāraṇāt anyathā yadi tena śabdena na kaḥ cid arthaḥ vyavacchidyeta vyarthaḥ śabda prayogaḥ syāt yatas evam tasmāt jñeya ādi padeṣu iti ādi śabdāt sarva viśva ādi padeṣu kim viśiṣṭeṣu vyavahāra upanīteṣu

original: vidhipratiṣedhalakṣaṇaḥ śabdo vyavahāras tadartham upanīteṣu | laukikaprayogastheṣv iti yāvat | teṣu vyavahhārāṅgeṣu yathā kathaṃ cid vyavacchedyosti kaś cit |
analyzed: vidhi pratiṣedha lakṣaṇaḥ śabdaḥ vyavahāraḥ tad artham upanīteṣu laukika prayoga stheṣu iti yāvat teṣu vyavahhāra aṅgeṣu yathā katham cit vyavacchedyaḥ asti kaḥ cit

original: etaduktam bhavati | yatparaś ca śabdaḥ sa śabdārtha iti vidhāyakasyāpi vākyasya vyavacchedaparatvād vyavacchedopi śabdārtha ucyate iti na kā cit kṣatiḥ |
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati yad paraḥ ca śabdaḥ sa śabda arthaḥ iti vidhāyakasya api vākyasya vyavaccheda para tvāt vyavacchedaḥ api śabda arthaḥ ucyate iti na kā cid kṣatiḥ

original: śabdaṃ hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | sarvaḥ pumān laukikaḥ parīkṣako vā kasmān nātivarttata ity āha – tasyetyādi | tasya śabdasya pravṛttinivṛttiphalatvād iti kutaś cin nivarttya kva cit pravṛttyarthatvād ity arthaḥ | itarathā śabdaprayogo viphalaḥ syāt | tad āha – yadītyādi |
analyzed: śabdam hi ityādinā vyācaṣṭe sarvaḥ pumān laukikaḥ parīkṣakaḥ vā kasmāt na ativarttate iti āha tasya ityādi tasya śabdasya pravṛtti nivṛtti phala tvāt iti kutas cit nivarttya kva cit pravṛtti artha tvāt iti arthaḥ itarathā śabda prayogaḥ viphalaḥ syāt tat āha yadi ityādi

original: ayam vaktā kasya cit pratipādyasya kutaś cid anabhimatān na nivartayed buddhim anivarttyābhimate ca kvacin na pravarttayet tadā yathābhūtānujñānād iti śabdaprayogāt pūrvaṃ pratipattur yathā saṃpramugdharūporthas tathābhūtasya śabdenānanujñānāt | yathā kathaṃ cid yādṛśasya tāḍrśasyānujñānād ity arthaḥ |
analyzed: ayam vaktā kasya cit pratipādyasya kutas cit anabhimatāt na nivartayet buddhim a nivarttya abhimate ca kvacid na pravarttayet tadā yathābhūta anujñānāt iti śabda prayogāt pūrvam pratipattuḥ yathā saṃpramugdha rūpaḥ ṛthaḥ tathābhūtasya śabdena ananujñānāt yathā katham cit yādṛśasya tāḍrśasya anujñānāt iti arthaḥ

original: sarvavyavahāreṣu na kiṃ cid vacanaṃ vyavahared uccārayet | kiṅ kāraṇaṃ (|) śabdavyavahārasyāvadhāraṇanāntarīyakatvāt |
analyzed: sarva vyavahāreṣu na kim cit vacanam vyavaharet uccārayet kim kāraṇam śabda vyavahārasya avadhāraṇa nāntarīyaka tvāt

original: etad eva sādhayannāha – yathetyādi | "atra ṭṭayudakamānaye"ty ukte śrotuḥ karaṇaviśeṣe 'vaśyamākāṃkṣā bhavati tatra ca niyamārthaṃ "ghaṭene"ty ucyate |
analyzed: etat eva sādhayan āha yathā ityādi atra ṭṭayudakam ānaya iti ukte śrotuḥ karaṇa viśeṣe vaśyam ākāṃkṣā bhavati tatra ca niyama artham ghaṭena iti ucyate

original: soyaṃ ghaṭo neti śabdaḥ svārthābhidhānapurassaram eva karaṇāntaravyavacchedākṣepāt phalavān bhavaty anyathā saty api ghaṭaśabdaprayoge yadi nāñjalinā tathānyenāpi karaṇenodakānayanaṃ yathā kathaṃ cid iti | alpapramāṇaṃ bahupramāṇaṃ vā jalānayanasabhipretam ity arthaḥ |

original: kiṅ kāraṇaṃ kevalasya jñeyaśabdasyārtho neti ced āha – tata iti (|) tato jñeyaśabdāt kva cid (api na) vastupratipatteḥ | vidhioratiṣedhaphale vyavahāre ca kevalasya jñeyaśabdasya prayogābhāvāt kutorthapratipattiḥ | yadādiśabdo 'nityādirūpeṇa kiṃ jñeyo bhavaty athājñeya ity evaṃ prakrānte jñeya iti kevalaḥ prayujyate |

original: tadāpi yārthapratipattiḥ sā prakṛtaṃ śabdād apadam apekṣya bhavantī vākyād eva jāyate | padāntarasahitasya padasya vākyatvāt | tasmān nāsti padāntaranirapekṣāt padārthapratipattiḥ | yathā jñeyādipadānāṃ kevalānāṃ na kiṃ cid vācyaṃ tathā ghaṭādiśabdānām api kevalānāṃ |

original: nanu ca kiṃ ghaṭodakamānayāmyathāñjalineti prastāve | ghaṭeneti prayukte | tatra ca yaḥ prakaraṇaṃ na jñātavān tasyāpi pratipatturghaṭeneti kevalaśabdaśravaṇād ghaṭākārā pratipattir utpadyata eveti katham ucyate kevalāc chabdād na pratipattir ity āha – yāpītyādi | aparisamāptaḥ sa jijñāsitortho yasyāṃ pratipattau sā 'parisamāptatadarthā |

original: katham aparisamāptatadarthatety āha – dṛṣṭaprayogānusāreṇeti | yāvatsu nayanānayanādikriyācodanāpravṛtteṣu | tena ghaṭaśabdasya prayogo dṛṣṭas tadanusāreṇa tāvatsu pūrvavākyeṣv ākāṃkṣāvatī pratītir bhavati kimayamartho vivakṣitaḥ kimvāyam ityevaṃ sākāṃkṣatvād upaplavamānaṃ rūpatvenāsamāptārthā viplavabhrāntir eva |

original: etat kathayati (|) naiva kevalaśabdamātraśravaṇād arthapratipattir asti kin tu vākyeṣūpalabdhasyārthavataḥ padasya sādṛśyenopahṛtabuddheḥ kevalaśabdaśravaṇād arthapratipattyabhimāna iti | yathā dṛṣṭaprayogānusāreṇa kevalaghaṭādipadaśravaṇād arthapratipattirviplavastādṛśo jñeyādiśabdeṣv api (|) yathā darśanaṃ | yathā prayogopalambhaṃ |

original: yāvatsu vākyeṣu jñeyaśabdaḥ prayujyamāno dṛṣṭas tadanusāreṇa kevalajñeyaśabdaśravaṇād asty evārthapratipattiviplavaḥ | anena sarvathā ghaṭādiśabdair jñeyādiśabdānāntulyatām āha –

original: nanu yady anyanivṛttir arthāt pratīyate saiva tarhi pāramārthikī bhāvānām asti yayā viśiṣṭā gṛhyanta ity evaṃ kasmān neṣyate (|) kiṃ purar evaṃ tadgates tadupādhitvāt tadviśiṣṭo gata iti vyākhyāyata ity ata āha – sa cāyam ityādi (|) yo bhedo vyāvṛttilakṣaṇa ācārya diṅnāgena viśeṣaṇatvanābhimataḥ sa cāyam rūpo niḥsvabhāvaḥ |

original: (p.255) nāsya vyatiriktam avyatiriktam vā rūpam astīti kṛtvā | kathan tarhi bhāvānāṃ vijātīyād bheda iti pratītir iti ced āha – rūpavattvena bhāvasaṃbandhitvena tasya bhedasya kevalan darśanam pratītir vipravo bhrāntiḥ (|) kevalam iti tathābhūtabāhyanirapekṣaṃ (|) kārikāyām apy evaṃ vyākhyānaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ | (|126-29||)
analyzed: na asya vyatiriktam a vyatiriktam vā rūpam asti iti kṛtvā katham tarhi bhāvānām vijātīyāt bhedaḥ iti pratītiḥ iti ced āha rūpavat tvena bhāva saṃbandhi tvena tasya bhedasya darśanam pratītiḥ bhrāntiḥ kevalam iti tathābhūta bāhya nirapekṣam kārikāyām api evam vyākhyānam draṣṭavyam

original: nanu yadi rūpavattvena darśanaṃ kathaṃ buddhiviplava ity ata āha – tenaivety ādi | rūpavattvena bhāvasambandhitvena yaddarśanam bhedasya tenaivāparamārtho na vastubhūto 'sattvāt | asāv iti bhedaḥ prasajyarūpaḥ | anyathety evam aniṣyamāṇe | na hi vastunaḥ svalakṣaṇasya sambandhinī vyāvṛttir vastu bhavati | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) bhedosyāsmāditīraṇāt |
analyzed: nanu yadi rūpavat tvena darśanam katham buddhi viplavaḥ iti atas āha tena eva iti ādi rūpavat tvena bhāva sambandhi tvena yat darśanam bhedasya tena eva aparamārthaḥ na sattvāt asau iti bhedaḥ prasajya rūpaḥ anyathā iti evam aniṣyamāṇe na hi vastunaḥ sva lakṣaṇasya sambandhinī vyāvṛttiḥ vastu bhavati kim kāraṇam bhedaḥ usya asmāt iti īraṇāt

original: etad uktam bhavati | yadi hi sā vastubhūtā syāt tadā vṛkṣebhyo 'vṛkṣavyāvṛttir abhinnā bhinnā vā syāt | yady abhinnā | asmād avṛkṣād vṛkṣasya bheda iti vyatirekapratītir na syāt | palāśāc caikasmād avṛkṣavyāvṛtter abhinnatvāt | dhavādīnāmavṛkṣavyāvṛttir na syāt | palāśavat tatsvabhāvāyā vyāvṛttes teṣv ananugamāt | atha palaśād bhinnā sā |
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati yadi hi sā vastu bhūtā syāt tadā vṛkṣebhyaḥ vṛkṣa vyāvṛttiḥ abhinnā bhinnā vā syāt yadi abhinnā asmāt avṛkṣāt vṛkṣasya bhedaḥ iti vyatireka pratītiḥ na syāt palāśāt ca ekasmāt avṛkṣa vyāvṛtteḥ abhinna tvāt dhava ādīnām avṛkṣa vyāvṛttiḥ na syāt palāśa vat tad svabhāvāyāḥ vyāvṛtteḥ teṣu ananugamāt atha palaśāt bhinnā sā abhinnā sā abhinnā sā abhinnā abhinnā abhinnā abhinnā abhinnā abhinnā abhinn

original: tatrāpy avṛkṣavyāvṛtteḥ sakāśāt palāśasya vyāvṛttiḥ syād avṛkṣavyāvṛtteś ca vyāvarttamānsya palāśasyāvṛkṣarūpatā syād avṛkṣavat | tataś cāsmād avṛkṣādasya vṛkṣasya bheda iti pratītir na syād iṣyate ca | tasmāt tadvyāvṛttir na vastu | bhedosyāsmāditīraṇād uccāraṇād ity arthaḥ | upalakṣaṇaṃ caitat pratīter api grahaṇaṃ |
analyzed: tatra api avṛkṣa vyāvṛtteḥ sakāśāt palāśasya vyāvṛttiḥ syāt avṛkṣa vyāvṛtteḥ ca vyāvarttamān sya palāśasya avṛkṣa rūpa tā syāt avṛkṣa vat tatas ca asmāt avṛkṣāt asya vṛkṣasya bhedaḥ iti pratītiḥ na syāt iṣyate ca tasmāt tad vyāvṛttiḥ na vastu bhedaḥ usya asmāt iti īraṇāt uccāraṇāt iti arthaḥ upalakṣaṇam ca etat pratīteḥ api grahaṇam

original: rūpaṃ hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | hi yasmāt | rūpaṃ kim ucyate paramārthaḥ | vastusvabhāvaḥ | bhedonyavyāvṛttir yadi rūpaṃ syād yadi svabhāvo bhavet | tad ity avṛkṣād vyāvṛttirūpaṃ | tadrūpam iti yat tadvyāvṛttaṃ palāśasvalakṣaṇaṃ tadātmakaṃ | atadrūpaṃ veti tatonyad ity arthaḥ | vastunas tattvānyattvān atikramād ity arthaḥ |
analyzed: rūpam hi ityādinā vyācaṣṭe hi yasmāt rūpam kim ucyate paramārthaḥ vastu svabhāvaḥ bhedaḥ nya vyāvṛttiḥ yadi rūpam syāt yadi svabhāvaḥ bhavet tat iti avṛkṣāt vyāvṛtti rūpam tat rūpam iti yat tat vyāvṛttam palāśa sva lakṣaṇam tad ātmakam a tad rūpam vā iti tatonyat iti arthaḥ vastunaḥ tattva anyattvān atikramāt iti arthaḥ

original: tādrūpya ityādinā prathamapakṣe doṣam āha – tādrūpye palāśād anyetve yayā vyāvṛttyā sāmānyabhūtayā sarve vṛkṣabhedāḥ vyāvṛttā dṛṣṭās tasyās tādrūpye palāśād ananyatvebhyupagamyamāne tadeva palāśasvalakṣaṇam eva vyāvṛttir iti kṛtvā palāśa evāvṛkṣād bhinnaḥ prāpnoti nānyo dhavādiḥ | tata ity avṛkṣād bhidyeta | kiṅ kāraṇam ity āha – na hītyādi |
analyzed: tādrūpye ityādinā prathama pakṣe doṣam āha tādrūpye palāśāt anyetve yayā vyāvṛttyā sāmānya bhūtayā sarve vṛkṣa bhedāḥ vyāvṛttāḥ dṛṣṭāḥ tasyāḥ tādrūpye palāśāt ananyatva abhyupagamyamāne tat eva palāśa sva lakṣaṇam eva vyāvṛttiḥ iti kṛtvā palāśaḥ eva avṛkṣāt bhinnaḥ prāpnoti na anyaḥ dhava ādiḥ tatas iti avṛkṣāt bhidyeta kim kāraṇam iti āha na hi ityādi

original: avṛkṣāddhi vyāvṛttiḥ palāśasyaiva rūpaṃ | na ca tasya rūpam anyasya dhavādeḥ (p.256) syāt |
analyzed: a vṛkṣāt hi vyāvṛttiḥ palāśasya eva rūpam na ca tasya rūpam anyasya dhava ādeḥ syāt

original: na tad evetyādinā dvitīyapakṣopanyāsaḥ | na tad eva palāśasvalakṣaṇam eva tasya bhedasya rūpaṃ (|) rūpaṃ ca svabhāvaś cāsau bheda iṣyate | tatonyad eva palāśād vyāvṛttirūpaṃ syāt | yad vā rūpaṃ cānyad eva bhedasya syāt | tataś cānyattvāt kāraṇāt | bhāvaḥ palāśātmakas tasmād avṛkṣavyāvṛttirūpād vyāvartteta | tataḥ kāraṇāt |
analyzed: na tat eva ityādinā dvitīya pakṣa upanyāsaḥ na tat eva palāśa sva lakṣaṇam eva tasya bhedasya rūpam rūpam ca svabhāvaḥ ca asau bhedaḥ iṣyate tatonyat eva palāśāt vyāvṛtti rūpam syāt yat vā rūpam ca anyat eva bhedasya syāt tatas ca anyattvāt kāraṇāt bhāvaḥ palāśa ātmakaḥ tasmāt avṛkṣa vyāvṛtti rūpāt vyāvartteta tatas kāraṇāt

original: ūṣmādity avṛkṣāt tasya palāśasya bheda iti na syāt | yasmād yat khalu vastu | yato bhedo yadbhedas tasmād vyāvarttate | tattad eva bhavati | avṛkṣavyāvṛtter bhavati | avṛkṣavyāvṛtter avṛkṣanivṛttirūpāyā nivartamānam palāśasvalakṣaṇam avṛkṣam iva syād avṛkṣavat | mā vā bhūd vṛkṣāvṛkṣayor ekatvan tathāpi sosya bheda iti ca na syāt |
analyzed: ūṣmāt iti avṛkṣāt tasya palāśasya bhedaḥ iti na syāt yasmāt yat khalu vastu yatas bhedaḥ yat bhedaḥ tasmāt vyāvarttate tat tat eva bhavati avṛkṣa vyāvṛtteḥ bhavati avṛkṣa vyāvṛtteḥ avṛkṣa nivṛtti rūpāyāḥ nivartamānam palāśa sva lakṣaṇam avṛkṣam iva syāt avṛkṣa vat mā vā bhūt vṛkṣa avṛkṣayoḥ tathā api saḥ usya bhedaḥ iti ca na syāt

original: yadi cāyam avṛkṣād bhedaḥ palāśād anyaḥ syāt tad ayam avṛkṣād bhedosya palāśasya sambandhīti na syāt | na hītyādy asyeva samarthanaṃ | anyaḥ svatantronyasya sambandhī bhedo dharmarūpo bhavati | sati veti sambandhitvebhyupagamyamāne vā | sambandhaḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvoṅgīkarttavyaḥ | bhinnayoḥ kāryakāraṇam antareṇa sambandhāyogāt |
analyzed: yadi ca ayam avṛkṣāt bhedaḥ palāśāt anyaḥ syāt tat ayam avṛkṣāt bhedaḥ usya palāśasya sambandhī iti na syāt na hi ityādi asya iva samarthanam anyaḥ svatantraḥ nyasya sambandhī bhedaḥ dharma rūpaḥ bhavati sati vā iti sambandhi tve abhyupagamyamāne vā sambandhaḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāva uṅgīkarttavyaḥ bhinnayoḥ kārya kāraṇam antareṇa sambandha ayogāt

original: tatra vyāvṛttimān kāraṇaṃ vyāvṛttiḥ kāryaṃ | iti heto rūpaṃ vastvantaram eva tajjanitantena vyāvṛttimatā svalakṣaṇena janitaṃ bheda iti | pādā(?padā)rthāntarasya nāma kṛtantasmāt kāryatvenābhimatād bhedākhyāt padārthād aviśeṣād anyatrāpi kāraṇānāṃ yāni kāryāṇi tāni sarvāṇi vyāvṛttayo bhedāḥ syuḥ | na caivaṃ |
analyzed: tatra vyāvṛttimān kāraṇam vyāvṛttiḥ kāryam iti hetoḥ rūpam vastu antaram eva tad janitantena vyāvṛttimatā sva lakṣaṇena janitam bhedaḥ iti pāda apadārtha antarasya nāma kṛtantasmāt kārya tvena abhimatāt bheda ākhyāt padārthāt aviśeṣāt anyatra api kāraṇānām yāni kāryāṇi tāni sarvāṇi vyāvṛttayaḥ bhedāḥ syuḥ na ca evam

original: tadānyatrāpi bhedābhimate bheda iti vyapadeśo mā bhūt |
analyzed: tadā anyatra api bheda abhimate bhedaḥ iti vyapadeśaḥ mā bhūt

original: atha kāryaṃ bheda iti noṣyate kin tu bhedaḥ kārya ity ucyate | tadāpy āha – arthāntaratve ca bhedasyābhyupagamyamāne | tatopi vyāvṛttimatopyasya bhedasya bhedosti | anyathā bhedasyārthāntaratvam eva na syāt | tataś ca palāśasyāvṛkṣād yo bhedas tasya bhedasya palāśād bheda iti kṛtvā sa bhedo bhedopādhiḥ sa palāśād bhedaḥ |
analyzed: atha kāryam bhedaḥ iti nā uṣyate kin tu bhedaḥ kāryaḥ iti ucyate tadā api āha artha antara tve ca bhedasya abhyupagamyamāne vyāvṛttimataḥ upi asya bhedasya bhedaḥ asti anyathā bhedasya artha antara tvam eva na syāt tatas ca palāśasya a vṛkṣāt yaḥ bhedaḥ tasya bhedasya palāśāt bhedaḥ iti kṛtvā sa bhedaḥ bheda upādhiḥ sa palāśāt bhedaḥ

original: upādhiviśeṣaṇaṃ yasya bhedasya sa bhedopādhis tadbhāvas tasmād asāv avṛkṣād bhedaḥ palāśasya na bhedaḥ syāt | dravyāntaravat | yathā hi dravyāntaraṃ ghaṭādikam (p.257) apy aghaṭāpekṣayā yo bhedas tadupādhitvān na palāśasya bhedas tadvat | svatantratvād ity abhiprāyaḥ |
analyzed: upādhi viśeṣaṇam yasya bhedasya sa bheda upādhiḥ tad bhāvaḥ tasmāt asau avṛkṣāt bhedaḥ palāśasya na bhedaḥ syāt dravya antara vat yathā hi dravya antaram ghaṭa ādikam api aghaṭa apekṣayā yaḥ bhedaḥ tad upādhi tvāt na palāśasya bhedaḥ tadvat svatantra tvāt iti abhiprāyaḥ

original: nanu yadi bhedopādhir bhedas tathāpi kim iti palāśasya bhedo na bhavatīty ata āha – na hītyādi | ayam ata iti viśeṣanirdeśāt | ayam avṛkṣād bhedaḥ | ata ity avṛkṣāt | asyety etad apekṣaṇīyaṃ | asya palāśasyāyaṃ bhedo 'smād avṛkṣād ity evaṃ viśeṣanirdeśāt pāratantryeṇa nirdeśāt palāśasya sambandhī bhedo dharmaḥ sidhyati |
analyzed: nanu yadi bheda upādhiḥ bhedaḥ tathā api kim iti palāśasya bhedaḥ na bhavati iti atas āha na hi ityādi ayam atas iti viśeṣa nirdeśāt ayam avṛkṣāt bhedaḥ atas iti avṛkṣāt asya iti etat apekṣaṇīyam asya palāśasya ayam smāt avṛkṣāt iti evam viśeṣa nirdeśāt pāratantryeṇa nirdeśāt palāśasya sambandhī bhedaḥ dharmaḥ sidhyati

original: pāratantryeṇa ca nirdeśo bhedasyābhede sati sidhyati bhedāntarapratikṣepeṇa | na tvarthāntaratve bhedasya | arthāntaratve hi bhedopādhitvād ghaṭavan na palāśasya bhedaḥ syāt | tataś cāsmādasya bheda iti viśeṣanirdeśo na syāt | tad evaṃ vyatirekapakṣe 'vṛkṣād bhedasyāpi palāśād yo bhedaḥ sopi rūpavān iti tasyāpi svāśrayād bhedena bhavitavyaṃ |
analyzed: pāratantryeṇa ca nirdeśaḥ bhedasya abhede sati sidhyati bheda antara pratikṣepeṇa na tu artha antara tve bhedasya artha antara tve hi bheda upādhi tvāt ghaṭa vat na palāśasya bhedaḥ syāt tatas ca asmāt asya bhedaḥ iti viśeṣa nirdeśaḥ na syāt tat evam vyatireka pakṣe vṛkṣāt bhedasya api palāśāt yaḥ bhedaḥ saḥ api rūpavān iti tasya api svāśrayāt bhedena bhavitavyam

original: tathā ca sarvabhedānāṃ bhinnasvabhāvatayā bhedopādhitvena svayan na rūpabhedateti na kaś cid bhedaḥ syāt |
analyzed: tathā ca sarva bhedānām bhinna svabhāva tayā bheda upādhi tvena svayan na rūpa bheda tā iti na kaḥ cit bhedaḥ syāt

original: etad evāha – tataś cetyādi | upādhyabhāva iti vyāvṛttilakṣaṇasya dharmabhūtasyopādher abhāve sarvasya svabhāvāntaratvena dharmitvād bhedasyaivābhāvaḥ syāt tasya dharmirūpatvāt |
analyzed: etat eva āha tatas ca ityādi upādhi abhāvaḥ iti vyāvṛtti lakṣaṇasya dharma bhūtasya upādheḥ abhāve sarvasya svabhāva antara tvena dharmi tvāt bhedasya eva abhāvaḥ syāt tasya dharmi rūpa tvāt

original: yopi manyate (|) yadi rūpavatī vyāvṛttiḥ syāt syāt tattvānyatvapakṣabhāvī doṣo yāvatā nīrūpā sāsti tayā ca bhāvā viśiṣṭā gṛhyanta iti |
analyzed: yaḥ api manyate yadi rūpavatī vyāvṛttiḥ syāt syāt tattva anyatva pakṣa bhāvī doṣaḥ yāvatā nīrūpā sā asti tayā ca bhāvāḥ viśiṣṭāḥ gṛhyante iti

original: nāpi niyatarūpānyathānupapattyā tatkalpanā sambandhābhāvād eva | svahetubhya eva ca niyatarūpāṇām utpannatvād iti "sarvabhāvā svabhāvena vyāvṛttibhāgina" (1|42) ity atrāntare 'bhihitatvāt |

original: nāpi ca sā 'pratipannā viśeṣaṇam bhavitum arhati | na hi daṇḍāpratītau daṇḍīti pratītir bhavati | nāpi sā kva cid āśritā nīrūpatvāt | na cāsambaddham viśeṣaṇam bhavati | nāpyanyanivṛttigrahaṇapurassaraṃ vṛkṣādiṣu vṛkṣaśabdaḥ pravartate 'pratītir ity uktatvāt | nivṛtter nīrūpatayā 'pratipannatvena saṃketasyāpravṛtteś ca |
analyzed: nā api ca sā pratipannā viśeṣaṇam bhavitum arhati na hi daṇḍa apratītau daṇḍī iti pratītiḥ bhavati nā api sā kva cit āśritā nīrūpa tvāt na ca asambaddham viśeṣaṇam bhavati nā api anya nivṛtti grahaṇa purassaram vṛkṣa ādiṣu vṛkṣa śabdaḥ pravartate pratītiḥ iti ukta tvāt nivṛtteḥ nīrūpa tayā pratipanna tvena saṃketasya apravṛtteḥ ca

original: kathaṃ śabdaviṣayatvan tasmād (p.258) anubhavadvāreṇa vṛkṣo 'yaṃ nāvṛkṣa ity evaṃ niścaya utpadyate | tenānyanivṛttiḥ pratiṣedhavikalpena kalpitā | yathā saṃketaṃ ca vṛkṣādau śabdaḥ pravarttamānorthād anyanivṛttim ākṣiti | anyanivṛttivikalpam ākṣipatīty arthaḥ | tenānyanivṛttyā viśiṣṭo | vastubhāgo gamyata ity ucyata iti |
analyzed: katham tasmāt tasmāt anubhava dvāreṇa vṛkṣaḥ yam na avṛkṣaḥ iti evam niścayaḥ utpadyate tena anya nivṛttiḥ pratiṣedha vikalpena kalpitā yathā saṃketam ca vṛkṣa ādau śabdaḥ pravarttamānaḥ ūrthāt anya nivṛttim anya nivṛtti vikalpam ākṣipati iti arthaḥ tena anya nivṛttyā viśiṣṭaḥ vastu bhāgaḥ gamyate iti ucyate iti

original: yadi vyāvṛttayaḥ sāmānyabhūtā bahir vastutvena neṣyante | nāpi paraparikalpitaṃ sāmānyam evaṃ sati bāhyam vastv eva vācyam āpatitaṃ | tatra ca doṣa ity āha – kathan tarhīti | abhinnasya niraṃśasya vastunaḥ śabdena codane upalakṣaṇaṃ caitat liṅgena pratipādane | tasyaivābhinnasya vastuna ekasmād bhinnasya punar anyatopi bhedāt |
analyzed: yadi vyāvṛttayaḥ sāmānya bhūtāḥ bahis vastu tvena na iṣyante na api para parikalpitam sāmānyam evam sati bāhyam vastu eva vācyam āpatitam tatra ca doṣaḥ iti āha katham tarhi iti abhinnasya niraṃśasya vastunaḥ śabdena codane upalakṣaṇam ca etat liṅgena pratipādane tasya eva abhinnasya vastunaḥ ekasmāt bhinnasya punar anyatas api bhedāt

original: tathā hi yena svabhāvena na śabdo 'kṛtakād bhinnas tenaiva mūrttānityatvāc ca | tasyānaṃśatvāt | anaṃśasya ca vastunaḥ kṛtakaśabdenaikasyākṛtakād bhedasya bhinnasya svabhāvasya codane | tathā liṅgena pratipādane sarvabhedagates sarvabhyo bhinnasya svabhāvasya pratipatteḥ | tatrānaṃśe vastuni kathaṃ śabdapramāṇāntarāṇi vyarthāni na syuḥ |
analyzed: tathā hi yena svabhāvena na kṛtakāt bhinnaḥ tena eva mūrtta anitya tvāt ca tasya an aṃśa tvāt an aṃśasya ca vastunaḥ kṛtaka śabdena ekasya akṛtakāt bhedasya bhinnasya svabhāvasya codane tathā liṅgena pratipādane sarva bheda gateḥ sarvabhyaḥ bhinnasya svabhāvasya pratipatteḥ tatra an aṃśe vastuni katham śabda pramāṇa antarāṇi vyarthāni na syuḥ

original: ekena śabdena codane śabdāntarāṇāṃ vaiyarthyaṃ syāt | ekena liṅgena pratipādane pramāṇāntarāṇāṃ vaiyarthyaṃ syāt |

original: yasmād ityādinā pariharati | tasmād yo yena dharmeṇa viśeṣaḥ saṃpratīyata (1|44) ityādinā prāgevedaṃ codyam parihṛtamadhikavidhānārthan tu punar upanyāsaḥ | artheṣvākārāntarasamāroporthaślaṣaḥ (|) sa ca pratipattibhedenānekaḥ | tatreti buddhipratibhāsini dharmiṇi bāhyabhinnatayā 'khyeyāste | bāhyatayādhyas tasyaiva buddhyākārasya śabdavācyatvāt |
analyzed: yasmāt ityādinā pariharati tasmāt yaḥ yena dharmeṇa viśeṣaḥ saṃpratīyate ityādinā prāk eva idam codyam parihṛtam adhika vidhāna arthan tu punar upanyāsaḥ artheṣu ākāra antara samāropaḥ artha ślaṣaḥ sa ca pratipatti bhedena anekaḥ tatra iti buddhi pratibhāsini dharmiṇi bāhya bhinna tayā khyeyāḥ te bāhya tayā ādhyaḥ tasya eva buddhi ākārasya śabda vācya tvāt

original: na punar bāhyam buddhyākāro vā kevalaḥ śabdavācyaḥ svalakṣaṇatvāt | tatra dharmiṇi vidhirūpatayā svārthapratipattidvāreṇaikārthaśleṣavicchede 'panayana eko dhvanir vyāpriyate | (|130||)
analyzed: na punar bāhyam buddhi ākāraḥ vā kevalaḥ śabda vācyaḥ sva lakṣaṇa tvāt tatra dharmiṇi vidhi rūpatayā sva artha pratipatti dvāreṇa eka artha śleṣa vicchede panayane ekaḥ dhvaniḥ vyāpriyate

original: liṅgaṃ caikārthaśleṣavicchede vyāpriyate | tatra svārthābhidhānarvāreṇa samāropavyāvacchede śabdapramāṇāntarāṇāṃ sāphalyam iti yāvat | na punar jñānād vyatiriktam bāhyam vastu svalakṣaṇaṃ (|) svalakṣaṇād vā vyatiriktam bāhyam vastu sāmānyalakṣaṇam vācyaṃ kiñvanāsti | yasya vastuno 'bhidhānato 'khile vastusvabhāve gatir bhavet |
analyzed: liṅgam ca ekārtha śleṣa vicchede vyāpriyate tatra svārtha abhidhāna ṛvāreṇa śabda pramāṇa antarāṇām sāphalyam iti yāvat na punar jñānāt vyatiriktam bāhyam vastu sva lakṣaṇam sva lakṣaṇāt vā vyatiriktam bāhyam vastu sāmānya lakṣaṇam vācyam yasya vastunaḥ khile vastu svabhāve gatiḥ bhavet

original: (p.259) vastusāmarthyād vastuvaśāt | yataś ca śabdaḥ svābhidhānadvāreṇa vyavacchedaṃ karoti tataḥ kāraṇāt taṃ taṃ vyavacchedaṃ kurvannānāphalaḥ śabdo bhavaty ekādhāraś ca | kathaṃ | arthakriyāyogyam adhyavasāya | anarthakriyākāriṇāpi svābhāsam arthakriyākāritvena svalakṣaṇarūpattvenādhyasyety arthaḥ | tatraiveti buddhipratibhāse bāhyatayādhyaste |
analyzed: vastu sāmarthyāt vastu vaśāt yatas ca śabdaḥ sva abhidhāna dvāreṇa vyavacchedam karoti tatas kāraṇāt tam tam vyavacchedam kurvan nānā phalaḥ śabdaḥ bhavati eka ādhāraḥ ca katham arthakriyā yogyam adhyavasāya anartha kriyā kāriṇā api sva ābhāsam arthakriyā kāri tvena sva lakṣaṇa rūpattvena adhyasya iti arthaḥ tatra eva iti buddhi pratibhāse bāhya tayā adhyaste

original: kiṃ bhūte | tais tair bhrāntikāraṇaiḥ saṃsṛṣṭarūpa iva bhavati | (|131||)
analyzed: kim bhūte taiḥ taiḥ bhrānti kāraṇaiḥ saṃsṛṣṭa rūpaḥ iva bhavati

original: sadṛśāparotpattyādibhir bhrāntihetubhir nityādyākāreṇa saṃsṛṣṭarūpa iva pratibhāsamāne | te 'nityādiśabdāḥ yathā saṃketaṃ yasya yasya samāropasya vyavacchedārthaṃ | svapratibhāse saṃketaḥ kutaḥ | tasya tasya pratiyogino vyavacchedāya vyāpriyante | saṃketānurūpam eva pratipādayannāha – na cetyādi | hyarthe caśabdaḥ |
analyzed: sadṛśa apara utpatti ādibhiḥ bhrānti hetubhiḥ nitya ādi ākāreṇa saṃsṛṣṭa rūpe iva pratibhāsamāne te nitya ādi śabdāḥ yathā saṃketam yasya yasya samāropasya vyavaccheda artham sva pratibhāse saṃketaḥ kutas tasya tasya pratiyoginaḥ vyavacchedāya vyāpriyante saṃketa anurūpam eva pratipādayan āha na ca ityādi hi arthe caśabdaḥ

original: yato yathā saṃketaṃ vyāpāras tato na hy ekaśabdasādhyaṃ vyavacchedam anyaḥ śabdaḥ karoti | kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) saṃketapratiniyamāt | ekaikavyavacchedārtham buddhyākāro 'vibhaktabāhyarūpe śabdaniveśanāt | vyavahārakālepi svārthābhidhānadvāreṇa tantam eva vyavacchedaṃ pratyāyayatīty arthaḥ | śabdagrahaṇam upalakṣaṇam evaṃ liṅgam apīti draṣṭavyaṃ |
analyzed: yatas yathā saṃketam vyāpāraḥ tatas na hi eka śabda sādhyam vyavacchedam anyaḥ śabdaḥ karoti kiṅkāraṇam saṃketa pratiniyamāt ekaika vyavaccheda artham buddhi ākāraḥ vibhakta bāhya rūpe śabda niveśanāt vyavahāra kāle api sva artha abhidhāna dvāreṇa tantam eva vyavacchedam pratyāyayati iti arthaḥ śabda grahaṇam upalakṣaṇam evam liṅgam api iti draṣṭavyam

original: nanv adhyavasitabāhyarūpatvāc chabdārthasya tataś ca śabdenanyalakṣaṇasya sarvātmanā viṣayīkaraṇāt kathaṃ na śabdāntarāṇām vaiyarthyam ity āha na cetyādi | avadhāraṇaś ca śabdaḥ | naiva vicchinnaṃ jñānāṃśād bhinnaṃ kiñ cid vastu | svalakṣaṇaṃ svalakṣaṇād vyatiriktaṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇam anyanivṛttilakṣaṇaṃ vākṣipyate gṛhyate śabdena liṅgena vā |
analyzed: nanu adhyavasita bāhya rūpa tvāt śabda arthasya tatas ca śabdena anya lakṣaṇasya sarva ātmanā viṣayīkaraṇāt katham na śabda antarāṇām vaiyarthyam iti āha na ca ityādi avadhāraṇaḥ ca śabdaḥ na eva vicchinnam jñāna aṃśāt bhinnam kiñ cit vastu sva lakṣaṇam sva lakṣaṇāt vyatiriktam sāmānya lakṣaṇam anya nivṛtti lakṣaṇam vā ākṣipyate gṛhyate śabdena liṅgena vā

original: yasyābhidhānād vastubaleneti vastugrahe niraṃśatvād vastunaḥ sarvathā gatiḥ syāt | dharmāṇāntato vyatirekāt | vyatirekepy upādhīnāṃ nānopādhyupakārāṅgaśaktyabhinnātmano graha (1|54) ityādinā sarvathāgrahaṇasyoktatvāt | kasmāc chabdair vicchinnam vastunākṣipyata ity ata āha – śabdānām ityādi |
analyzed: yasya abhidhānāt vastu balena iti vastu grahe niraṃśa tvāt vastunaḥ sarvathā gatiḥ syāt dharmāṇām tatas vyatirekāt vyatireke api upādhīnām nānā upādhi upakāra aṅga śakti abhinna ātmanaḥ graha ityādinā sarvathā grahaṇasya ukta tvāt kasmāt śabdaiḥ vicchinnam vastunā ākṣipyate iti atas āha śabdānām ityādi

original: etaduktam bhavati | yato buddhyākāramabāhyam bāhyam adhyavasyanti śabdās tato (p.260) vicchinnavastugrāhakā iva bhavantīty arthaḥ | buddher viplavaś ca buddhyākārasya bahīrūpatayā grahaḥ | tadviṣayatvāc chabdānāṃ | biddhiviplavepi vācyavastusāmarthyād akhile gatiḥ | kinneti ced āha – tatra cetyādi | tatra buddhiviplave 'vastuni |
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati yatas buddhi ākāram abāhyam bāhyam adhyavasyanti śabdāḥ vicchinna vastu grāhakāḥ iva bhavanti iti arthaḥ buddheḥ viplavaḥ ca buddhi ākārasya bahī rūpatayā grahaḥ tad viṣaya tvāt śabdānām biddhi viplave api vācya vastu sāmarthyāt akhile gatiḥ kim na iti ced āha tatra ca ityādi tatra buddhi viplave vastuni

original: vastusāmarthyābhāvāt |
analyzed: vastu sāmarthya abhāvāt

original: yadyapi buddhyākāro jñānasvalakṣaṅatvād vastu | tathāpy asau śabdair vikalpair vā bāhyābhinnatayādhyasto 'vastv eva | tena śabdo vikalpo vā na svalakṣaṇaviṣayo yathāvadekasyāpi bāhyasya jñānākārasya vā 'grahaṇād iti |
analyzed: yadi api buddhi ākāraḥ jñāna sva lakṣaṅa tvāt vastu tathā api asau śabdaiḥ vikalpaiḥ vā bāhya abhinna tayā adhyastaḥ vastu eva tena śabdaḥ vikalpaḥ vā na sva lakṣaṇa viṣayaḥ yathāvat ekasya api bāhyasya jñāna ākārasya vā grahaṇāt iti

original: yadi buddhiviplavaviṣayā eva sarvaśabdāḥ kathaṃ kṛtakānityādiśabdānān tathābhūte vastunyavyabhicāra ity ata  āha – tathā bhūtetyādi | tatas tato 'kṛtakanityāder bhinnasyārthasyānubhavadvāreṇety arthaḥ | ayaṃ vyavahāra iti sanbandhaḥ | kim bhūtaḥ (|) nānaiketyādi. nānā ekaś ca nānaikam. | tac ca dharmaś ceti karmadhārayaḥ |
analyzed: yadi buddhi viplava viṣayāḥ eva sarva śabdāḥ katham tathābhūte vastuni avyabhicāraḥ iti atas āha tathā bhūta ityādi tatas kṛtaka nitya ādeḥ bhinnasya arthasya anubhava dvāreṇa iti arthaḥ ayam vyavahāraḥ iti sanbandhaḥ kim bhūtaḥ nānā eka ityādi nānā ekaḥ ca nānā ekam tat ca dharmaḥ ca iti karmadhārayaḥ

original: tato bhedābhedaśabdābhyāntripado dvandvaḥ | nānaikadharmabhedābhedā eva buddhau pratibhāsanta iti pratibhāsāsta eva viplavo bhrāntatvāt | tadanusārī tenākāreṇa pravṛttaḥ | iti hetos tasya vyavahārasya tatpratibandhe tarmiṃs tathābhūte svalakṣaṇe pāramparyeṇotpattiprativandhe sati tadavyabhicāraḥ | vastvavyabhicāraḥ |
analyzed: tatas dvandvaḥ nānā eka dharma bheda abhedāḥ eva buddhau pratibhāsante iti pratibhāsāḥ te eva viplavaḥ bhrānta tvāt tad anusārī tena ākāreṇa pravṛttaḥ iti hetoḥ tasya vyavahārasya tad pratibandhe tarmin tathābhūte sva lakṣaṇe pāramparyeṇa utpatti prativandhe sati tad avyabhicāraḥ vastu avyabhicāraḥ

original: yathā hi kṛtakādyākārāḥ śabdā viplavās tathāvastūnām api kṛtakādirūpeṇa paramārthatovasthānam ityanenākāreṇāvyabhicāro draṣṭavyaḥ |
analyzed: yathā hi kṛtaka ādi ākārāḥ śabdāḥ viplavāḥ tathā vastūnām api kṛtaka ādi rūpeṇa paramārthataḥ vasthānam iti anena ākāreṇa avyabhicāraḥ draṣṭavyaḥ

original: etad evāha – tatopītyādi | tato buddhiviplavaviṣayāc chabdād vyavahārāt parārthānumānalakṣaṇād vitathād iti bhrāntāt | pravṛttasyānte pravṛttiparisamāptau tathābhūta eva kṛtakādirūpa eva vastuni natvakṛtakādirūpe | anenāvyabhicārasvarūpam uktaṃ | jñānasamvādāt svalakṣaṇagrāhijñānotpatteḥ śabdasya vā jñānasya samvādāt |
analyzed: etat eva āha tatas upi ityādi tatas buddhi viplava viṣayāt śabdāt vyavahārāt parārtha anumāna lakṣaṇāt vitathāt iti bhrāntāt pravṛttasya ante pravṛtti parisamāptau tathābhūte eva kṛtaka ādi rūpe eva vastuni na tu akṛtaka ādi rūpe anena avyabhicāra svarūpam uktam jñāna samvādāt sva lakṣaṇa grāhi jñāna utpatteḥ śabdasya vā jñānasya samvādāt

original: asminn evānyāpohe śabdārthe sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ sidhyati na tu vastunīty āha – na punar bhinnetyādi | bhinnā ākārā jātiguṇādayaḥ śabdapravṛttinimittabhūtāḥ | tadgrāhiṇāṃ jñānaśabdānām ekavastuviṣayatvāt | śabda ekādhāra iti sambandhaḥ | yadi hi bhinnākāraṃ jñānam ekavastuviṣayam pravartteta tatas tadanusāreṇa śabdopi tathā syāt |
analyzed: asmin eva anya apohe śabda arthe sāmānādhikaraṇyam sidhyati na tu vastuni iti āha na punar bhinna ityādi bhinnāḥ ākārāḥ jāti guṇa ādayaḥ śabda pravṛtti nimitta bhūtāḥ tad grāhiṇām jñāna śabdānām eka vastu viṣaya tvāt śabdaḥ eka ādhāraḥ iti sambandhaḥ yadi hi bhinna ākāram jñānam eka vastu viṣayam pravartteta tatas tad anusāreṇa śabdaḥ api tathā syāt

original: tathā ca nānāphalaḥ śabda ekādhāra iti bhavet sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ tac ca nāsti vyāghātāt | tathā hi nīlotpalaśabdayorekaṃ vā vastuvācyaṃ syād anekam vā | ādye pakṣe ekenaiva śabdena niraṃśasya vastunaḥ sarvātmanābhidhānāt | dvitīyasya śabdasyāpravṛttiḥ syāt pravṛttau vā paryāyateti na nānāphalatvaṃ | dvitīye pakṣa ekādhāratā nāsti |
analyzed: tathā ca nānā phalaḥ śabdaḥ eka ādhāraḥ iti bhavet sāmānādhikaraṇyam tat ca na asti vyāghātāt tathā hi nīla utpala śabdayoḥ ekam vā vastu vācyam syāt anekam vā ādye pakṣe ekena eva śabdena niraṃśasya vastunaḥ sarva ātmanā abhidhānāt dvitīyasya śabdasya apravṛttiḥ syāt pravṛttau vā paryāya tā iti na nānā phala tvam dvitīye pakṣe eka ādhāra tā na asti

original: (p.261) ghaṭapaṭādiśabdavan nānāviṣayatvāt |
analyzed: ghaṭa paṭa ādi śabda vat nānā viṣaya tvāt

original: atha mataṃ (|) nīlaśabdo nīlaguṇaviśiṣṭandravyam āha – utpalaśabdopy utpalajātiviśiṣṭantadeva dravyam āha – ato viśeṣaṇayor bhedān nānāphalaḥ śabdo viśeṣyābhedād ekādhāra iti |
analyzed: atha matam nīla śabdaḥ nīla guṇa viśiṣṭan dravyam āha utpala śabdaḥ upi utpala jāti viśiṣṭan tat eva dravyam āha atas viśeṣaṇayoḥ bhedāt nānā phalaḥ śabdaḥ viśeṣya abhedāt eka ādhāraḥ iti

original: tad apy asat | yato nīlaguṇena viśiṣṭadravyan nīlaśabdenābhidhīyamānaṃ sarvātmanābhidhīyate niraṃśatvāt | tataḥ koparo dravyasyotpalajātiviśiṣṭa ātmānabhihitosti yadutpalaśabdenābhidhīyeteti (|) tathaiva paryāyatā syād atha viśeṣaṇabhedād viśeṣyadravyasya bhedas tadāpy ekādhāratā na syāt | apohavādinas tv ayam doṣa ity āha – yathāvarṇṇita ityādi |
analyzed: tat api asat yatas nīla guṇena nīla śabdena abhidhīyamānam sarva ātmanā abhidhīyate niraṃśa tvāt tatas kaḥ paraḥ dravyasya utpala jāti viśiṣṭaḥ ātmā anabhihitaḥ usti yat utpala śabdena abhidhīyeta iti tathā eva paryāya tā syāt atha viśeṣaṇa bhedāt viśeṣya dravyasya bhedaḥ tadā api eka ādhāra tā na syāt apoha vādinaḥ tu ayam doṣaḥ iti āha yathā varṇṇitaḥ ityādi

original: buddhipratibhāsa āśrayo yasya śabdārthasya sa tathoktaḥ |
analyzed: buddhi pratibhāsaḥ āśrayaḥ yasya śabda arthasya sa tathā uktaḥ

original: yathā ca na doṣas tathā pratipādayannāha – vicchedam ityādi | eko nīlaśabda ekaṃ vyavacchedam anīlavyavacchinnaṃ nīlasvabhāvaṃ sūcayannanyam anutpalavyavacchinnam utpalasvabhāvam apratikṣipya varttate na nirākārotīty arthaḥ | (|132||)
analyzed: yathā ca na doṣaḥ tathā pratipādayan āha vicchedam ityādi ekaḥ nīla śabdaḥ ekam vyavacchedam anīla vyavacchinnam nīla svabhāvam sūcayan anyam anutpala vyavacchinnam utpala svabhāvam a pratikṣipya varttate na arthaḥ

original: sa ity anutpalavyavacchinnaḥ svabhāvaḥ | tena nīlaśabdena vyāpta ākrāntaḥ ākṣiptaḥ sann utpalaśabdaprayoge buddhāv ekatvena pratibhāsate | ekasyaiva dharmiṇaḥ vyavacchedadvayāyātanīlotpaladharmadvayayuktasya vikalpabuddhau pratibhāsanāt | yadā caivan tadā sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ syād buddhyanurodhataḥ |
analyzed: saḥ iti an utpala vyavacchinnaḥ svabhāvaḥ tena nīla śabdena vyāptaḥ ākrāntaḥ ākṣiptaḥ san utpala śabda prayoge buddhau ekatvena pratibhāsate ekasya eva dharmiṇaḥ vyavaccheda dvaya āyāta nīlotpala dharma dvaya yuktasya vikalpa buddhau pratibhāsanāt yadā ca evam tadā sāmānādhikaraṇyam syāt buddhi anurodhataḥ

original: tadekam ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | ekatvād evānaṃśam ekasyāṃśābhāvāt | ākriyata ityākāro biddhipratibhāsaḥ | tasya bhedas tadāśrayād bhedasya | vastunānātvasya | yadi bhinnākārābhir buddhibhir gṛhyeta bhinnaṃ syāt | na caivantasya cābhāvād vastunaḥ | sāmānyaviśeṣobhayātmakatvād vastuna ekasyāpi bhinnākārabuddhigrāhyatvam iti ced āha – tadātmanopītyādi |

original: svalakṣaṇātmanas tadekayogakṣematvāt | svalakṣaṇenaikayogakṣematvāt tadvadevābhinnatvaṃ | taditi tasmād ayaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyādir na syād iti sambandhaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) anyonyārthaparihāreṇa parasparārthaparihāreṇa bhinnapravṛttinimittatveneti yāvat | śabdayor ekaviṣayayor ekadravyādhārayor vṛttyasambhavāt |

original: anvayetyādi ślokabhāgaṃ na cetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | yadaika eva vastvātmā svalakṣaṇaṃ sāmānyaṃ ca tadā śāvaleyasvalakṣaṇasya gotvasāmānyātmakatvāt | tatraiva bāhuleye vṛttiḥ punaḥ svalakṣaṇātmakatvāt tatraivāvṛttis tasmin kāle prayuktā | sā cāyuktā | vyāghātāt | pramāṇabādhitatvāt | svalakṣaṇād abhinnatvān naiva sāṃānyamanyatra varttate |

original: yadāpi nīlaśabdo nīlaguṇābhidhāyīṣyate tadāpi bhinnārthābhidhānam asty eva | eko dharmī artho viṣayo yasyā buddhes sā (|) ekārthā cāsau buddhiś ceti karmadhārayaḥ pumvadbhāvaś ca | asyā āśrayāḥ kāraṇaṃ kathaṃ syuḥ | tataś ca sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na syād iti bhāvaḥ |

original: yadi nīlotpalādiśabdā viśeṣaṇadvayuktaikadharmiviṣayāṃ buddhiṃ janayayuḥ | tadaikārthapratipād anena syāt sāmānādhikaraṇyan tac ca nāsti | vyakter arthāntaraṃ sāmānyan tadabhidhāyinaś cānākṣepakās tadgatānāṃ bhedānān tadaparityāgena vṛttir ākṣepaḥ na tathā | kasmāt (|) nirākāṃkṣatvāt | yadā vṛkṣaśabdo vṛkṣatvam evābhidhatte |

original: tadā tasya nirviśeṣaṇatvāt tāvataivāsau nirākāṃkṣa iti kathan dhavādīnākṣipet | anākṣiptāś ca kathaṃ vṛkṣaśabdārthasya bhedā dhavādayo 'tadbhedatvāc ca kathaṃ vṛkṣaḥ śiṃśapeti viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ | tadāha – katham ityādi | sāmānyaviśiṣṭasya dravyasyābhidhānān na (p.265) yathokto doṣaḥ iti cen na | uktottaratvāt |

original: sāmānyam api teṣāṃ na sambhavatīty uktaṃ | tathā hi yadā tāvat svalakṣaṇād avyatiririktaṃ sāmānyantadā svalakṣaṇavad vyaktyantarānanugamādasāmānyaṃ (|) vyatirekepi katham anyasya samānyam atiprasaṅgād ityādi prāg uktaṃ | (|137|)

original: dvitīyā govyaktis tataḥ śabdād gaur ity evaṃ na pratīyeta | tatra pratyāsattinibandhanasya sāmānyasyābhāvāt | svabhāvānugamābhavepi śāvaleye niveśito 'pratyāsanne bāhuleye pratyayaṃ janayiṣyatīti ced āha – apratyāsattike cetyādi | atiprasaṅgāt | gośabdād aśvepi pratītiḥ syāt | evantāvad ekaṃ sāmānyaṃ vinā bahuṣv ekaśabdaniveśābhāva uktaḥ |
analyzed: dvitīyā go vyaktiḥ tatas śabdāt gauḥ iti evam na pratīyeta tatra pratyāsatti nibandhanasya sāmānyasya abhāvāt svabhāva anugama abhave pi śāvaleye pratyāsanne bāhuleye pratyayam janayiṣyati iti ced āha apratyāsattike ca ityādi atiprasaṅgāt go śabdāt aśve pi pratītiḥ syāt evantāvat ekam sāmānyam vinā bahuṣu eka śabda niveśa abhāvaḥ uktaḥ

original: abhyupagamya vaiphalyam āha – teṣu cetyādi | tathā hi bahuṣv ekā śrutir niveśyate 'nekavṛttim ekam arthaṃ pratipādayituṃ | tāneva vā bhedān asaṃkareṇa | tatrādyasyābhāvam āha – ekārthaniyogābhāvād iti | yady ekasminn arthe śabdasya niyogaḥ syāt tadā bhaved ekārthapratipādanaṃ | dvitīyābhāvam āha – bhinnetyādi |
analyzed: abhyupagamya vaiphalyam āha teṣu ca ityādi tathā hi bahuṣu ekā śrutiḥ niveśyate neka vṛttim ekam artham pratipādayitum tān eva vā bhedān asaṃkareṇa tatra ādyasya abhāvam āha eka artha niyoga abhāvāt iti yadi ekasmin arthe śabdasya niyogaḥ syāt tadā bhavet eka artha pratipādanam dvitīya abhāvam āha bhinna ityādi

original: bhinnasvabhāvānām asaṃkīrṇṇānāṃ śāvaleyādīnāṃ pratipattaya ity adhyāhāraḥ | pṛthagity ekaikasmin bhede | ekasya śabdasya niyoge | saṃkete kṛte | paścād vyavahārakāle | yathā coditānām ity asaṃkareṇa pratipattyarthaṃ coditānāṃ vibhāgāparijñānāt tasmān na teṣu śabdaniyogaḥ phalavān | evaṃ hi svalakṣaṇeṣu pṛthak pṛthakchabdaniyogaḥ phalavān bhavati |
analyzed: bhinna svabhāvānām asaṃkīrṇṇānām śāvaleya ādīnām pratipattayaḥ iti adhyāhāraḥ pṛthak iti ekaikasmin bhede ekasya śabdasya niyoge saṃkete kṛte paścāt vyavahāra kāle yathā coditānām iti asaṃkareṇa pratipatti artham coditānām vibhāga aparijñānāt tasmāt na teṣu śabda niyogaḥ phalavān evam hi sva lakṣaṇeṣu pṛthak pṛthak śabda niyogaḥ phalavān bhavati

original: yadi tasmāc chabdād asaṃkareṇa svalakṣaṇāni pratīyerann iti (|) kriyate ca bahuṣv ekaśabdaniyogas tasmād vastubhūtena sāmānyena bhāvyam ity abhiprāyaḥ |
analyzed: yadi tasmāt śabdāt asaṃkareṇa sva lakṣaṇāni pratīyeran iti kriyate ca bahuṣu eka śabda niyogaḥ tasmāt vastu bhūtena sāmānyena bhāvyam iti abhiprāyaḥ

original: tasyāpīty ācāryaḥ | ekam vastu sāmānyam astīty eva kṛtvānyareṇāpi prayojanaṃ | lokena śabdo niveśanīya ity eko vikalpaḥ | dvitīyam āha – tadvetyādi | taditi (p.268) sāmānyaṃ vastuśaktyaiveti | puruṣavyāpāram anapekṣya | ekāṃ śrutiṃ dhvanayatyutthāpayati | nāsty eva tad dvayam api | antareṇa pratojanaṃ puruṣavyāpārañ ca prayogābhāvāt |
analyzed: tasya api iti ācāryaḥ ekam vastu sāmānyam asti iti eva prayojanam lokena śabdaḥ niveśanīyaḥ iti ekaḥ vikalpaḥ dvitīyam āha tat vā ityādi tat iti sāmānyam vastu śaktyā eva iti puruṣa vyāpāram an apekṣya ekām śrutim dhvanayati utthāpayati na asti eva tat dvayam api antareṇa pratojanam puruṣa vyāpāram ca prayoga abhāvāt

original: tadeva kin tarhītyādināha – kena cit prayojananeti | ebhyaḥ śabdebhyo vyavahāre | tadatatsādhanam arthaṃ jñānatvā pratipadyeteti | anena prathamavikalpābhāvam āha –

original: nirdeśyanta ity anena dvitīyasya | nirdeśyante saṃketyante vyavaharttukāmair ity adhyāhāraḥ | tatraitasmin nyāye 'nekaṃ kāraṇav ekatra kārye upayujyeta vyāpriyeta | tadity anekaṃ | kutaḥ kāraṇakalāpāt tadutpadyata ity eva |
analyzed: nirdeśyante iti anena dvitīyasya nirdeśyante saṃketyante vyavaharttu kāmaiḥ iti adhyāhāraḥ tatra etasmin nyāye na ekam kāraṇau ekatra kārye upayujyeta tat iti anekam kutas kāraṇa kalāpāt tat utpadyate iti eva

original: tatraitasmin kārye vyavaharttukāmair avaśyantac cānekaṅkāraṇamatatkāryavyāvṛttilakṣaṇam ekakāryatām āśrityaikenaiva śabdena codayituṃ yuktaṃ | anekena codane doṣam āha – tasyetyādi | pṛthak pṛthag iti bhinnaiḥ śabdaiḥ | etac ca svalakṣaṇaśabdaniveśam abhyupagamyoktam (|)
analyzed: tatra etasmin kārye vyavaharttu kāmaiḥ ca anekam kāraṇam atatkārya vyāvṛtti lakṣaṇam eka kāryatām āśritya ekena eva śabdena codayitum yuktam anekena codane doṣam āha tasya ityādi pṛthak pṛthak iti bhinnaiḥ śabdaiḥ etat ca sva lakṣaṇa śabda niveśam abhyupagamya uktam

original: etad eva na sambhavatīty āha – na cetyādi | asya vastunaḥ | ananyasādhāraṇaṃ rūpam iti | nānyasādhāraṇam ananyasādhāraṇaṃ svalakṣaṇam ity arthaḥ | nāpyasyety anekaśabdaniveśanasya |
analyzed: etat eva na sambhavati iti āha na ca ityādi asya vastunaḥ ananya sādhāraṇam rūpam iti na anya sādhāraṇam ananya sādhāraṇam sva lakṣaṇam iti arthaḥ na api asya iti aneka śabda niveśanasya

original: etac ca gaur avāśāktivaiphalyād ity asya yathākramaṃ vivaraṇaṃ | kasmād vaiphalyam iti ced āha – kevalam ityādi | anena prayoktrā tatraitasmin kārye | terthāḥ kāraṇabhūtāś codanīyā ity etāvat prayojanaṃ | te tu kāraṇabhūtāḥ padārthā ekena vā śabdena codyeran bahubhir veti svātantryam atra codane vaktuḥ |
analyzed: etat ca gauḥ avāśa ākti vaiphalyāt iti asya yathākramam vivaraṇam kasmāt vaiphalyam iti ced āha kevalam ityādi anena prayoktrā tatra etasmin kārye kāraṇa bhūtāḥ codanīyāḥ iti etāvat prayojanam te tu kāraṇa bhūtāḥ padārthāḥ ekena vā śabdena codyeran bahubhiḥ vā iti svātantryam atra codane vaktuḥ

original: yata evaṃ taditi tasmād iyam ekā śrutir bahuṣu vācyeṣu vaktur abhiprāyavaśād hetoḥ pravarttamānā nopa(ā)lambhamarhati | bahuṣv ekā śrutir na śakyā pravarttayitum iti ced āha – na ceyam ityādi | iyam ekā śrutiḥ | aśakyaṃ pravarttanamayasyā iti vigrahaḥ | kasmānnāśakyapravarttanety āha – icchādhīnatvād icchāyā | adhīnam aśakyapravarttanaṃ |
analyzed: yatas evam tat iti tasmāt iyam ekā śrutiḥ bahuṣu vācyeṣu vaktuḥ abhiprāya vaśāt hetoḥ pravarttamānā na upaālambham arhati bahuṣu ekā śrutiḥ na śakyā pravarttayitum iti ced āha na ca iyam ityādi iyam ekā śrutiḥ aśakyam pravarttanam ayasyāḥ iti vigrahaḥ kasmāt na aśakya pravarttanā iti āha icchā adhīna tvāt icchāyāḥ adhīnam aśakya pravarttanam

original: yadi hy ekatrāpītyādi | tathā hīcchayaiva tatra paraparikalpite sāmānye na vastusthityaiva ekasyāḥ śruteḥ pravattiḥ (|) kin tarhi (p.269) vaktur icchāvaśāt | tathā na yadi prayoktur icchā bhavet | katham iyam ekā śrutir ekatrāpi pravartteta | naivety abhiprāyaḥ | tathaikatrāpi pravarttayitum icchaiva kāraṇaṃ |

original: bhinneṣu śāvaleyādibhedeṣv ekasmād gośabdāt pratītiratatprayojanebhyo bhedena | tadgobhedasādhyaṃ vāhadohādikaṃ kāryaṃ prayojanaṃ na bhavati yeṣām aśvādīnān tebhyo bhedeneti | kiṃ punar vastubhūtam evaikatvaṃ na codyata ity ata āha – na punaḥ svabhāvasyaikatvān na punar vastubhūtasya sāmānyasyaikatvād bhinneṣv ekāśrutiḥ |
analyzed: bhinneṣu śāvaleya ādi bhedeṣu ekasmāt go śabdāt pratītiḥ atatprayojanebhyaḥ bhedena tat go bheda sādhyam vāha doha ādikam kāryam prayojanam na bhavati yeṣām tebhyaḥ bhedena iti kim punar vastu bhūtam eva ekatvam na codyate iti atas āha na punar svabhāvasya ekatvāt na punar vastu bhūtasya sāmānyasya ekatvāt bhinneṣu eka aśrutiḥ

original: tasyaiva sāmānyavyatiriktasyāvyatiriktasya cāyogāt | (|139||)

original: bhavatu nāma sāmānyaṃ vyatiriktan tadapi tasmin svabhāve vyavasthitam amiśram eva | tad evāha – yathāsvam ityādi | yasya yallakṣaṇantena vyavasthitasv abhāvānām anyonyarūpasaṃśleṣāt katham ekanimittiḥ sāmānyanibandhanaḥ śabdo bhinneṣu bhavet | naivety abhiprāyaḥ | na hy anyenānye samānā bhavanti | etac coktaṃ prāk |

analyzed: sarve bhāvāḥ svabhāvena sva svabhāva vyavasthiteḥ iti atra prastāve

original: anyāpohavādinas tvayam adoṣa ity āha – atatorayojanetyādi | atatprayojanebhyo vyāvṛttis tu bhinnānām apy aviruddheti kṛtvā sa evātatprayojanebhyo bhedas tatprayojanānām abhedas tadvyāvṛtteḥ sarvatra bhāvāt | śabdābhedasya kāraṇam bhavatu | yataś ca na kathaṃ cid vastubhūtaṃ sāmānyaṃ ghaṭate |
analyzed: anya apoha vādinaḥ tu ayam adoṣaḥ iti āha a tatoḥ ayojana ityādi a tad prayojanebhyaḥ vyāvṛttiḥ tu bhinnānām api aviruddhā iti kṛtvā saḥ eva a tad prayojanebhyaḥ bhedaḥ tad prayojanānām abhedaḥ tad vyāvṛtteḥ sarvatra bhāvāt śabda abhedasya kāraṇam bhavatu yatas ca na katham cit vastu bhūtam sāmānyam ghaṭate

original: teneme gobhedās tatprayojanā vāhadohaprayojanā iti yaduktan tat | atatprayojanebhyo 'śvādibhyo bhinnā evoktāḥ | (|140||)
