original: na punar eṣām anyā tatkāryatānyatrānyato bhedāt | anyavyāvṛtta eva svabhāva (p.270) eṣām abheda iti yāvat | etena tatkāryatāpītyādi kārikābhāgo vyākhyātaḥ | (|141||)
analyzed: na punar eṣām anyā tad kārya tā anyatra anyatas bhedāt anya vyāvṛttaḥ eva svabhāva eṣām abhedaḥ iti yāvat etena tad kārya tā api ityādi kārikā bhāgaḥ vyākhyātaḥ

original: yathetyādinā cakṣurādau yathā rūoavijñānaikaphala ityādi vyācaṣṭe | ātmendriyamanorthasannikarṣeṣv iti paraprasiddhyoktaṃ | rūpavijñānam ekaṃ kāryaṃ yeṣām iti vigrahaḥ | (|142||) tadrūpavijñānaṃ kāryaṃ yoṣāntāni tatkāryāṇi teṣāṃ sāmānyam aviśeṣeṇaikakāryakaraṇasāmarthyantasya codanā prakāśanā |
analyzed: yathā ityādinā cakṣuḥ ādau yathā rūoa vijñāna eka phalaḥ ityādi vyācaṣṭe ātma indriya manaḥ ūrtha sannikarṣeṣu iti para prasiddhyā uktam rūpa vijñānam ekam kāryam yeṣām iti vigrahaḥ tat rūpa vijñānam kāryam yoṣā antāni tad kāryāṇi teṣām sāmānyam aviśeṣeṇa eka kārya karaṇa sāmarthī antasya codanā prakāśanā

original: tasyāḥ sambhave sati (|) kena punaḥ prastāvena codanāsambhava ity āha – kuto rūpavijñānam ity aviśeṣeṇa sāmagrīgate praśne satīty arthaḥ | vyavahāralāghavārtham ekena śabdena bahūnāṃ pratipādanārthaṃ rūpavijñānasya hetuś cakṣirādikalāpaḥ saraḥ śaro vety evaṃ śrutinniveśayed iti sambandhaḥ |
analyzed: tasyāḥ sambhave sati kena punar prastāvena codanā sambhavaḥ iti āha kutas rūpa vijñānam iti aviśeṣeṇa sāmagrī gate praśne sati iti arthaḥ vyavahāra lāghava artham ekena śabdena bahūnām pratipādana artham rūpa vijñānasya hetuḥ cakṣiḥ ādi kalāpaḥ saraḥ śaraḥ vā iti evam śrutin niveśayet iti sambandhaḥ

original: api nāmetyādinā vyavahāralāghavam eva vyācaṣṭe | taddhetūnāṃ cakṣurvijñānahetunāṃ | na cātreti cakṣurādau | yenānugāminā rūpeṇaikaṃ cakṣurvijñānaṃ janayanti | tathābhūtaṃ sāmānyañcakṣurādīnān nāsti (|) sattā vidyata iti cet | tasyās tarhi sarvatrāviśeṣāt sarvatra cakṣurādivijñānaṃ syāt |
analyzed: api nāma ityādinā vyavahāra lāghavam eva vyācaṣṭe tad hetūnām cakṣuḥ vijñāna hetunām na ca atra iti cakṣuḥ ādau yena anugāminā rūpeṇa ekam cakṣuḥ vijñānam janayanti tathābhūtam na asti sattā vidyate iti ced tasyāḥ tarhi sarvatra aviśeṣāt sarvatra cakṣuḥ ādi vijñānam syāt

original: na ca sambandhibhedāt sattāyā bhedo nityatvenānādheyātiśayatvāt | kevalan tadarthatayā rūpavijñānaikakāryatayā bhāvāś cakṣurādayaḥ | atadarthebhyo rūpavijñānājanakebhyo bhinnā iti kṛtvā bheda evātatkāryebhyo vyāvṛttir eva | eṣāṃ cakṣurādīnām abhedaḥ sarveṣām atatkāryavyāvṛttes tulyatvāt |
analyzed: na ca sambandhi bhedāt sattāyāḥ bhedaḥ nitya tvena anādheya atiśaya tvāt tad artha tayā rūpa vijñāna eka kārya tayā bhāvāḥ cakṣuḥ ādayaḥ atadarthebhyaḥ rūpa vijñāna ajanakebhyaḥ bhinnāḥ iti kṛtvā bhedaḥ eva a tad kāryebhyaḥ vyāvṛttiḥ eva eṣām cakṣuḥ ādīnām abhedaḥ sarveṣām atad kārya vyāvṛtteḥ tulya tvāt

original: yathā cakṣurādīnām abhedaḥ sarveṣām atatkāryavyāvṛttes tulyatvāt | yathā cakṣūrūpādiṣv ekaṃ sāmānyaṃ vināpy ekakāryatvakhyāpanāyaikaḥ śabdo niveśyate | evaṃ jātīyāḥ sarva ityādi | samūhasya santānasyāvasthāviśeṣasya ca vācakāḥ samūhasantānāvasthāviśeṣaśabdāḥ | tatra samūhābhidhāyinaṃ śabdam adhikṛtyāha – ye samastā ityādi |
analyzed: yathā cakṣuḥ ādīnām abhedaḥ sarveṣām a tad kārya vyāvṛtteḥ tulya tvāt yathā cakṣuḥ rūpa ādiṣu ekam sāmānyam vinā api eka kāryatva khyāpanāya ekaḥ śabdaḥ niveśyate evam jātīyāḥ sarve ityādi samūhasya santānasya avasthā viśeṣasya ca vācakāḥ samūha santāna avasthā viśeṣa śabdāḥ tatra samūha abhidhāyinam śabdam adhikṛtya āha ye samastāḥ ityādi

original: ye rūparasagandhādayassamastāḥ kiñ cid ekam udakādyāharaṇādi kāryaṃ | teṣāṃ rūpādīnāṃ | tatra kārye kāraṇatayā viśeṣābhāvāt | sarveṣāṃ hy ekaṃ kāryam iti kṛtvā tenaikakāryatvena viśeṣābhāva ucyate | na tu svalakṣaṇasyāviśeṣāt |
analyzed: ye rūpa rasa gandha ādayaḥ samastāḥ kiñ cit ekam udaka ādi āharaṇa ādi kāryam teṣām rūpa ādīnām tatra kārye kāraṇatayā viśeṣa abhāvāt sarveṣām hi ekam kāryam iti kṛtvā tena eka kāryatvena viśeṣa abhāvaḥ ucyate na tu sva lakṣaṇasya aviśeṣāt

original: teṣām ekakāryakaraṇaśaktikhyāpanamātre karttavye 'pārthikā viśeṣacodanā | pratirūpādibhinnena (p.271) śabdena codanāniṣphaleti kṛtvā sakṛdekakālaṃ sarveṣāṃ kvacit kārye niyojanārthaṃ rūpādiviśeṣeṣūdakadhāraṇādikāryasameṣu ghaṭa ity ekaṃ śabdaṃ prayukte 'yaṃ loka iti vyavaharttā | (|143||)
analyzed: teṣām eka kārya karaṇa śakti khyāpana mātre karttavye pārthikā viśeṣa codanā pratirūpa ādi bhinnena śabdena codanā niṣphalā iti kṛtvā sakṛt eka kālam sarveṣām kvacid kārye niyojana artham rūpa ādi viśeṣeṣu udaka dhāraṇa ādi kārya sameṣu ghaṭaḥ iti ekam śabdam prayukte yam lokaḥ iti vyavaharttā

original: nanu bhinnā eva rūpādayaḥ katham ekasmād ghaṭaśabdād abhedena pratīyanta iti ced āha – tepītyādi | sajātīyād rūpād anyataś ca rasāder bhedāviśeṣepi | tatprayonāṅgatayā | viśiṣṭodakādyāharaṇakāryāṅgatayā | tadanyebhya iti tatkāryakaraṇāsamarthebhyaḥ paṭādibhyo bhidyanta iti bheda evaiṣām abhedas tato 'bhedāt |
analyzed: nanu bhinnāḥ eva rūpa ādayaḥ katham ekasmāt ghaṭa śabdāt abhedena pratīyante iti ced āha te pi ityādi sajātīyāt rūpāt anyatas ca rasa ādeḥ bheda aviśeṣe api tad prayona aṅgatayā viśiṣṭa udaka ādi āharaṇa kārya aṅgatayā tad anyebhyaḥ iti tad kārya karaṇa asamarthebhyaḥ paṭa ādibhyaḥ bhidyante iti bhedaḥ eva eṣām abhedaḥ tatas bhedāt

original: tasmād abhedād aviśeṣeṇaiva sāmānyenaivaikasmād ghaṭaśabdāt sarve rūpādayaḥ pratīyante |
analyzed: tasmāt abhedāt aviśeṣeṇa eva sāmānyena eva ekasmāt ghaṭa śabdāt sarve rūpa ādayaḥ pratīyante

original: yadi rūpādaya eva kevalā ghaṭo na tu tadvyatiriktaṃ dravyaṃ (|) kathan tarhi ghaṭasya rūpādaya iti vyatireka iti ced āha – tatretyādi | ghaṭasya rūpādaya ityapi yo vyatirekas tasyāyamartho ghaṭasvabhāvā rūpādayo na paṭādisvabhāvā iti |
analyzed: yadi rūpa ādayaḥ eva kevalāḥ ghaṭaḥ na tu tad vyatiriktam dravyam kathan tarhi ghaṭasya rūpa ādayaḥ iti vyatirekaḥ iti ced āha tatra ityādi ghaṭasya rūpa ādayaḥ iti api yaḥ vyatirekaḥ tasya ayam arthaḥ ghaṭa svabhāvāḥ rūpa ādayaḥ na paṭa ādi svabhāvāḥ iti

original: etadeva vyācaṣṭe | udaketyādi | udakāhāraṇasya viśeṣo ghaṭād anyenāsādhyatvaṃ | ādiśabdād anyasyāpi ghaṭasādhyasya kāryasya parigrahaḥ | tasmin kārye samarthāḥ saptamīti yogavibhāgāt samāsaḥ | ayam atrārthaḥ (|) rūpādiśabdā rūpādīn rūpasādhyakāryamātraśaktiyuktānaviśeṣeṇa pratipādayanti |
analyzed: etat eva vyācaṣṭe udaka ityādi udaka āhāraṇasya viśeṣaḥ ghaṭāt anyena asādhya tvam ādi śabdāt anyasya api ghaṭa sādhyasya kāryasya parigrahaḥ tasmin kārye samarthāḥ saptamī iti yogavibhāgāt samāsaḥ ayam atra arthaḥ rūpa ādi śabdāḥ rūpa ādīn rūpa sādhya kārya mātra śakti yuktān aviśeṣeṇa pratipādayanti

original: ghaṭaśabdas tu viśiṣṭakāryaśaktiyogena paṭādisvabhāvebhyopi rūpādibhyo bhedena viśiṣṭān rūpādīn āha – ato ghaṭasya rūpādaya iti śabdadvayavyāpāreṇa sāmānyaviśeṣākārabuddhyutpatteḥ sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvo vyatirekavimatiś ca prayujyata iti |
analyzed: ghaṭa śabdaḥ tu viśiṣṭa kārya śakti yogena paṭa ādi svabhāvebhyaḥ api rūpa ādibhyaḥ bhedena viśiṣṭān rūpa ādīn āha atas ghaṭasya rūpa ādayaḥ iti śabda dvaya vyāpāreṇa sāmānya viśeṣa ākāra buddhi utpatteḥ sāmānya viśeṣa bhāvaḥ vyatireka vimatiḥ ca prayujyate iti

original: etam eva sāmānyetyādināha – sāmānyakāryaṃ rūpādimātrasādhyan tasya siddhiḥ sādhanan tasmin prasiddhenātmanā svabhāvena | itthaṃ bhūtalakṣaṇā tṛtīyā | hetau vā | itthaṃ bhūtena rūpeṇa hetunā vā rūpādiśabdaiḥ karaṇabhūtaiḥ prasiddhāssantaḥ viśiṣṭaṃ kāryaṃ ghaṭasādhyaṃ ghaṭasādhyam evodakāharaṇādi | tasya sādhanaṃ sādhyateneneti kṛtvā |
analyzed: etam eva sāmānya ityādinā āha sāmānya kāryam rūpa ādi mātra sādhyan tasya siddhiḥ sādhanan tasmin prasiddhena ātmanā svabhāvena ittham bhūta lakṣaṇā tṛtīyā hetau vā ittham bhūtena rūpeṇa hetunā vā rūpa ādi śabdaiḥ karaṇa bhūtaiḥ prasiddhāḥ santaḥ viśiṣṭam kāryam ghaṭa sādhyam ghaṭa sādhyam eva udaka āharaṇa ādi tasya sādhanam sādhyate enena iti kṛtvā

original: tathābhūtā ākhyā saṃjñā yasya sa tathā tena viśiṣṭāḥ | ta iti rūpādaya evam ucyanta iti |
analyzed: tathābhūtā ākhyā saṃjñā yasya sa tathā tena viśiṣṭāḥ te iti rūpa ādayaḥ evam ucyante iti

original: na punar atra rūpādisaṃhatau hy atra vā ghaṭa iti vyavahāre yathāvarṇṇitalakṣaṇam iti (p.272) rūpādivyatiriktandravyaṃ | tasyāvayavinas tādṛśasyeti rūpādivyatiriktasya | upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptaś cāvayavī parair iṣṭo darśanaṃ spārśanaṃ dravyam iti vacanāt | tenopalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptatvenābhyupagatasya rūpādivyatirekeṇānupalambhād iti vākyārthaḥ |
analyzed: na punar atra rūpa ādi saṃhatau hi atra vā ghaṭaḥ iti vyavahāre yathā varṇṇita lakṣaṇam iti rūpa ādi vyatiriktan dravyam tasya avayavinaḥ tādṛśasya iti rūpa ādi vyatiriktasya upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptaḥ ca avayavī paraiḥ iṣṭaḥ darśanam spārśanam dravyam iti vacanāt tena upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāpta tvena abhyupagatasya rūpa ādi vyatirekeṇa anupalambhāt iti vākya arthaḥ

original: yathāvāntareṇāpy avayavinaṃ paramāṇava eva pratyakṣasya viṣayas tathā dvitīye paricchede pratipādayiṣyate |
analyzed: yathā avāntareṇa api avayavinam paramāṇavaḥ eva pratyakṣasya viṣayaḥ tathā dvitīye paricchede pratipādayiṣyate

original: yadi rūpādaya eva saṃhatā ghaṭaḥ kathan tarhi bahuṣu ghaṭa ity ekavacanam iti ced āha – ekavacanam ityādi | yathā bahuṣv ekaḥ śabda ekaśaktisūcanārthas tathaikavacanam api | teṣāṃ rūpādīnām ekasminn udakāharaṇakārye yā śaktis tasyāḥ sūcanārthaṃ | ekakāryakarttṛtvena teṣv ekatvam āropyaikavacanam ity arthaḥ | na punas teṣv ekā śaktir vidyate |
analyzed: yadi rūpa ādayaḥ eva saṃhatāḥ ghaṭaḥ kathan tarhi bahuṣu ghaṭaḥ iti eka vacanam iti ced āha eka vacanam ityādi yathā bahuṣu ekaḥ śabdaḥ eka śakti sūcana arthaḥ tathā eka vacanam api teṣām rūpa ādīnām ekasmin udaka āharaṇa kārye yā śaktiḥ tasyāḥ sūcana artham eka kārya karttṛ tvena teṣu eka tvam āropya eka vacanam iti arthaḥ na punar teṣu ekā śaktiḥ vidyate

original: anapekṣitabāhyārtham akavacanaṃ saṃketaparatantram vā | etac ca "yeṣāṃ vastuvaśā vāca"(1|66) ityādinā pratipāditaṃ | santānābhidhāyinaḥ śabdānadhikṛtyāha – tathetyādi | hetuś ca phalaṃ ca hetuphale | tayor viśeṣa upādānopādeyabhāvenaikasantāna ......nāśrayatvaṃ | tam bhūtāḥ prāptāḥ prāptivacano bhavatiḥ sakarmakaḥ |
analyzed: an apekṣita bāhya artham akavacanam saṃketa paratantram vā etat ca yeṣām vastu vaśāḥ vācaḥ ityādinā pratipāditam santāna abhidhāyinaḥ śabdān adhikṛtya āha tathā ityādi hetuḥ ca phalam ca hetu phale tayoḥ viśeṣaḥ upādāna upādeya bhāvena eka santāna na āśraya tvam tam bhūtāḥ prāptāḥ prāpti vacanaḥ bhavatiḥ sakarmakaḥ

original: sādhanaṃ kṛteti dvitīyātatpuruṣaḥ | hetuphalaviśeṣo vā bhūto niṣpanno yeṣām iti bahuvrīhiḥ | āhitāderākṛtigaṇatvād bhūtaśabdasya paranipātaḥ | kiṃ cid ekaṃ sādhayantīti | yathāṃkuranāḍapatrādayaḥ phalam ekaṃ | sādhyante caikena | yathā ta evopādānabhūtena bījena | tepy akurādayo naikakṣaṇātmakāḥ sakṛtpratītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: sādhanam kṛtā iti dvitīyā tatpuruṣaḥ hetu phala viśeṣaḥ vā bhūtaḥ niṣpannaḥ yeṣām iti bahuvrīhiḥ āhita ādeḥ ākṛti gaṇa tvāt bhūta śabdasya paranipātaḥ kim cit ekam sādhayanti iti yathā aṃkura nāḍa patra ādayaḥ phalam ekam sādhyante ca ekena yathā te eva upādāna bhūtena bījena te api akura ādayaḥ na eka kṣaṇa ātmakāḥ sakṛt prati iti arthaḥ

original: tenaikakāryatvenaikakāraṇatvena vā sāmyena brīhyādiśabdaiḥ santānābhidhāyibhiḥ kṛtasaṃketāḥ saṃketakāle | paścād vyavahārakāle kathyante vyavahāralāghavārthaṃ | abhedena prabandhajijñāsāyāṃ bījāṃkurādibhedenānekaśabdaprayogasya vaiphalyāt | ādigrahaṇena manuṣyādiśabdagrahaṇaṃ | tair api bālakumārādibhedabhinnasya prabandhasyābhidhānāt |
analyzed: tena eka kārya tvena eka kāraṇa tvena vā sāmyena brīhi ādi śabdaiḥ santāna abhidhāyibhiḥ kṛta saṃketāḥ saṃketa kāle paścāt vyavahāra kāle kathyante vyavahāra lāghava artham abhedena prabandha jijñāsāyām bīja aṃkura ādi bhedena aneka śabda prayogasya vaiphalyāt ādi grahaṇena manuṣya ādi śabda grahaṇam taiḥ api bāla kumāra ādi bheda bhinnasya prabandhasya abhidhānāt

original: nanu brīhyādiśabdā api samudāyaśabdā eva rūpādisamudāyabhidhāyitvāt |
analyzed: nanu brīhi ādi śabdāḥ api samudāya śabdāḥ eva rūpa ādi samudāya abhidhāyi tvāt

original: satyaṃ | kin tu hetuphalaviśeṣaphalaprabandhābhidhānād evam ucyate (|) tathā samudāyaśabdonekasamudāyāpekṣayā jātiśabdo bhavaty evam avasthāśabdopi (|) kevalaṃ viśiṣṭārthavivakṣayā kaś cic chabda ity ucyata ity adoṣaḥ | yathā ca ghaṭasya rūpādayaḥ ghaṭa iti caikavacanaṃ yena nibandhanenoktaṃ |
analyzed: satyam kin tu hetu phala viśeṣa phala prabandha abhidhānāt evam ucyate tathā jāti śabdaḥ bhavati evam avasthā śabdaḥ api kevalam viśiṣṭa artha vivakṣayā kaḥ cid śabdaḥ iti ucyate iti adoṣaḥ yathā ca ghaṭasya rūpa ādayaḥ ghaṭaḥ iti ca ekavacanam yena nibandhanena uktam

original: tathā brīhe rūpādayo brīhir iti naikavacanaṃ draṣṭavyam ata evāha – pūrvavadvācyam iti | avasthāśabdān adhikṛtyāha – yepītyādi | yepi nīlādiparamāṇavaḥ (p.273) pṛthag iti nīlapītādayaḥ parasparānapekṣāḥ samastā veti parasparasahitāḥ | kva cid iti cakṣurvijñāne savedeśe parasyotpattipratibandhe vā sakṛd eva pratyāyanārthaṃ |
analyzed: tathā brīheḥ rūpa ādayaḥ brīhiḥ iti na ekavacanam draṣṭavyam atas eva āha pūrvavat vācyam iti avasthā śabdān adhikṛtya āha ye pi ityādi ye pi nīla ādi paramāṇavaḥ pṛthak iti nīla pīta ādayaḥ paraspara anapekṣāḥ samastāḥ vā iti paraspara sahitāḥ kva cid iti cakṣuḥ vijñāne parasya utpatti pratibandhe vā sakṛt eva pratyāyana artham

original: ekasmāc chabdād bahunāṃ niścayārthaṃ | tatra ye cakṣurvijñāne upayujyante | tevasthāviśeṣavācinaḥ sanidarśanā ity ucyante | ye svadeśe parasyotpattiṃ pratidhnanti | te sapratighā iti |
analyzed: ekasmāt śabdāt bahunām niścaya artham tatra ye cakṣuḥ vijñāne upayujyante sa nidarśanāḥ iti ucyante ye sva deśe parasya utpattim pratidhnanti te sa pratighāḥ iti

original: nanu nīlapītādayo 'tyantabhinnās te katham ekena sanidarśanādiśabdenocyanta ity ata āha –
analyzed: nanu nīla pīta ādayaḥ tyanta bhinnāḥ te katham ekena sa nidarśana ādi śabdena ucyante iti atas āha

original: tadanyebhyo bhedasāmānyeneti | tadanyebhyo 'nidarśanāpratighebhyo yo bhedassa eva teṣāṃ sāmānyaṃ sarveṣān tato vyāvṛttatvāt | tena hetunā | sanidarśanādiśabdā api paramāṇusamudayā 'bhidhānāt samudāyaśabdā eveti cet (|) na | ekasyāpi paramāṇoḥ sapratighādiśabdair abhidhānāt |
analyzed: tad anyebhyaḥ bheda sāmānyena iti tad anyebhyaḥ nidarśana apratighebhyaḥ yaḥ bhedaḥ saḥ eva teṣām sāmānyam sarveṣām tatas vyāvṛtta tvāt tena hetunā sa nidarśana ādi śabdāḥ api paramāṇu samudayāḥ abhidhānāt samudāya śabdāḥ eva iti ced na ekasya api paramāṇoḥ sa pratigha ādi śabdaiḥ abhidhānāt

original: kāryadvāreṇa śabdapravṛttim uktvā kāraṇadvāreṇāha – yathaikakāryā rūpādayas tatkāryaṃ codanāyāṃ | tadudakadhāraṇādy ekaṃ kāryaṃ yasya rūpādisāmarthyasya tasya codanāyām ekaśakticodanāyām ity arthaḥ | tadanyasmāt ghaṭāder bhedena ghaṭādiśabdaiḥ | ādigrahaṇād brīhyādiparigrahaḥ | kṛtasamayāḥ khyāpy anta iti prakṛtaṃ |
analyzed: kārya dvāreṇa śabda pravṛttim uktvā kāraṇa dvāreṇa āha yathā eka kāryāḥ rūpa ādayaḥ tat kāryam codanāyām tat udaka dhāraṇa ādi ekam kāryam yasya rūpa ādi sāmarthyasya tasya codanāyām eka śakti codanāyām iti arthaḥ tad anyasmāt ghaṭa ādeḥ bhedena ghaṭa ādi śabdaiḥ ādi grahaṇāt brīhi ādi parigrahaḥ kṛta samayāḥ khyā api antaḥ iti prakṛtam

original: tathā kāraṇāpekṣayāpy anekorthaḥ ekena śabdena kṛtasamayaḥ khyāpy ata iti vacanapariṇāmena sanbandhaḥ vyavahārārtham eva lāghavenety arthād | yathā śavalāyā gorapatyāni sarvāṇyevaikakāraṇatvena śāvaleyaśabdenocyante bahulāyāś cāpatyāni bāhuleyaśabdena |
analyzed: tathā kāraṇa apekṣayā api anekaḥ ūrthaḥ ekena śabdena kṛta samayaḥ khyāpī atas iti vacana pariṇāmena sanbandhaḥ vyavahāra artham eva lāghavena iti arthāt yathā śavalāyāḥ goḥ apatyāni sarvāṇi eva eka kāraṇa tvena śāvaleya śabdena ucyante bahulāyāḥ ca apatyāni bāhuleya śabdena

original: yāvāṃś ca puruśaprayatnena kāraṅena janitaḥ ṣabdaḥ sarvaḥ samānakāraṇajanyatvena prayatnānantarīyakaḥ kthyate | kariṣyām iti cetanā prayatnaḥ | tasyānantaram avyavadhānan tatra bhava iti grahāderākṛtigaṇatvācchaḥ | deśagrahaṇan tatra na smaryate | tasya svārthikaḥ kan | etac ca kāraṇaviśeṣāpekṣayoktaṃ |
analyzed: yāvān ca puruśa prayatnena kāraṅena janitaḥ ṣabdaḥ sarvaḥ samāna kāraṇa janya tvena prayatna ānantarīyakaḥ kthyate kariṣyām iti cetanā prayatnaḥ tasya anantaram tatra bhavaḥ iti graha ādeḥ ākṛti gaṇa tvāt śaḥ deśa grahaṇan tatra na smaryate tasya svārthikaḥ etat ca kāraṇa viśeṣa apekṣayā uktam

original: kāraṇamātraśrayeṇāha – kṛtako veti | kāraṇāyattajanmanaḥ prayatnānantarīyakasyānyasya ca sarvasya kṛtaka ity abhidhānāt |
analyzed: kāraṇa mātra śrayeṇa āha kṛtakaḥ vā iti kāraṇa āyatta janmanaḥ prayatna ānantarīyakasya anyasya ca sarvasya kṛtakaḥ iti abhidhānāt

original: evantāv advidhimukhenoktaṃ |
analyzed: evantau a t vidhi mukhena uktam

original: (p.274) pratiṣedhamukhenāha – tathetyādi | tasya cākṣuṣasya nīlāderyat kāryañcakṣurvijñānantasya pratiṣedhenācākṣuṣaḥ śabdaḥ | na samarthañcakṣurvijñānaṃ prtīty evama cākṣuṣaśabdena sāmānyenocyate | anityaśabdopi nityavyavacchedena vyavasthāpy amānaḥ | tatkāryapratiṣedhenaiva |
analyzed: pratiṣedha mukhena āha tathā ityādi tasya cākṣuṣasya nīla ādeḥ yat kāryam cakṣuḥ vijñānam tasya pratiṣedhena acākṣuṣaḥ śabdaḥ na samartham cakṣuḥ vijñānam evam a cākṣuṣa śabdena sāmānyena ucyate anitya śabdaḥ api nitya vyavacchedena vyavasthāpī amānaḥ tad kārya pratiṣedhena eva

original: tathā hi nityaṃ parair vastveveṣṭan tac cāsādhyasādhanabhūtaṃ vyavahārapathaṃ nāvataratīti sādhyasādhanaṃ cāṅgīkartavyaṃ | nityakāryapratiṣedhenānityaḥ | ātmaśabdopi kvacit kārye svatantrasya khyāpanāya kṛta ity anātmaśabdo 'tatkāryavyavacchedena syāt |
analyzed: tathā hi nityam paraiḥ vastu eva iṣṭan tat ca asādhyasādhana bhūtam vyavahāra patham na avatarati iti sādhya sādhanam ca aṅgīkartavyam nitya kārya pratiṣedhena anityaḥ ātma śabdaḥ api kvacid kārye svatantrasya khyāpanāya kṛtaḥ iti tad kārya vyavacchedena syāt

original: evaṃ kāryapratiṣedhenābhidhāya kāraṇapratiṣedhenāha – tadityādi | tasya sasvāmikasyāśūnyasya ca yatkāraṇan tasya pratiṣedhenāyaṃ śabdādiko bhavosvāmikaḥ śūnya iti vyavahārārthaṃ khyāpy ata iti sambandhaḥ | tathā hi svatantreṇātmādinā yodhiṣṭitassa sasvāmikaḥ parair iṣyate |
analyzed: evam kārya pratiṣedhena abhidhāya kāraṇa pratiṣedhena āha tat ityādi tasya sasvāmikasya aśūnyasya ca tasya pratiṣedhena ayam śabda ādikaḥ śūnyaḥ iti vyavahāra artham khyāpī atas iti sambandhaḥ tathā hi svatantreṇa ātma ādinā sa sasvāmikaḥ paraiḥ iṣyate

original: evam aśūnyopi tathābhūtenādhiṣṭitatvād evādhiṣṭitā cādhiṣṭātavyasvīkaraṇam anyathādhiṣṭātṛtvāyogāt | tasmāt sasvāmikādiśabdāḥ kāraṇadvārapravṛttāḥ pareṣāṃ | na pratikṣaṇaviṣarāruṣu bhāveṣu sāmagrīmātrapratibaddheṣu vyavasthitasvabhāvaḥ kaś cid adhiṣṭātāsti yatpratibaddhāssaṃskārāḥ pravarrtante |
analyzed: evam a śūnyaḥ api tathābhūtena adhiṣṭita tvāt eva adhiṣṭitā ca adhiṣṭātavya svīkaraṇam anyathā adhiṣṭātṛ tva ayogāt tasmāt sa svāmika ādi śabdāḥ kāraṇa dvāra pravṛttāḥ pareṣām na prati kṣaṇa viṣara aruṣu bhāveṣu sāmagrī mātra pratibaddheṣu vyavasthita svabhāvaḥ kaḥ cit adhiṣṭātā asti yat pratibaddhāḥ saṃskārāḥ pravarrtante

original: tato svamikāḥ śūnyaś ca yathoktakāraṇapratiṣedhena vyavasthāpy ata iti | evam anyad apīti | duḥkhāśūnyānāthāpratiśaraṇādikam api | yathāyogam iti kiṃ cit kāryapratiṣedhena kiṃ cit kāraṇapratiṣedhenety arthaḥ | duḥkhāśūnyādikāryapratiṣedhena sukhaśūnyādīnām aprātikūlyakāryatvena vyavasthāpy amanatvāt |
analyzed: śūnyaḥ ca yathā ukta kāraṇa pratiṣedhena vyavasthāpi atas iti evam anyat api iti duḥkha aśūnya anātha apratiśaraṇa ādikam api yathāyogam iti kim cit kārya pratiṣedhena kim cit kāraṇa pratiṣedhena iti arthaḥ duḥkha aśūnya ādi kārya pratiṣedhena sukha śūnya ādīnām a prātikūlya kārya tvena vyavasthāpi a mana tvāt

original: sarvasya ca saṃskṛtasya vipariṇām dharmitvena pratikūlatvāt | anāthāpratiśaraṇādi | kāryapratiṣedhena svatantrasya nāthāder abhāvāt | tadevaṃ kāryakāraṇayor vidhipratiṣedhamukhena catuṣṭayī śabdānām pravṛttur ākhyātā bhavati |
analyzed: sarvasya ca saṃskṛtasya dharmi tvena pratikūla tvāt anātha a pratiśaraṇa ādi kārya pratiṣedhena svatantrasya nātha ādeḥ abhāvāt tat evam kārya kāraṇayoḥ vidhi pratiṣedha mukhena catuṣṭayī śabdānām pravṛttuḥ ākhyātā bhavati

original: nanu cāśūnyanityāder vyavacchedyasyābhāvāt kathaṃ śūnyādiśabdeṣv anyavyavacchedābhidhānam iti ced āha – yathākathitam iti yasya yādṛśī siddhāntāśrayaṇakalpanā tayā samīhito racito śūnyanityādīnāṃ ya ākāras taṃ vikalpya buddhāvāropya tadvyavacchedena paraparikalpitā 'śūnyādyākāravyavacchedena śūnyādivyapadeśaḥ kriyate |
analyzed: nanu ca a śūnya nitya ādeḥ vyavacchedyasya abhāvāt katham śūnya ādi śabdeṣu anya vyavaccheda abhidhānam iti ced āha yathā kathitam iti yasya yādṛśī siddhānta āśrayaṇa kalpanā tayā samīhitaḥ śūnya nitya ādīnām yaḥ ākāraḥ tam vikalpya buddhau āropya tad vyavacchedena para parikalpitā śūnya ādi ākāra vyavacchedena śūnya ādi vyapadeśaḥ kriyate

original: kasmiād ity āha – buddhītyādi | buddhessamīhā imam artham āropayām iti saṃkalpaḥ | tathā sa (rvvaṃ......) sāṃkaryaṃ yasya śabdasya sa tathā tadbhāvastamāt | sarvagrahaṇād etad āha – yatrāpi vastubhūte ............īti |
analyzed: iti āha buddhi ityādi buddheḥ samīhā imam artham āropayām iti saṃkalpaḥ tathā sa rvvam sāṃkaryam yasya śabdasya sa tathā sarva grahaṇāt etat āha yatra api vastu bhūte

original: etad uktam bhavati | na vastusvalakṣaṇaṃ śabdaiḥ svarūpeṇa vidhīyate 'panīyate vā (|) (p.275) kevalaṃ vikalpabiddhisandarśita eva sarvo vidhipratiṣedhavyavahāraḥ | tataś cānityādiśabdeṣv anityādipratipakṣo nityādir vyavacchedyo nāstīty apratipakṣadoṣas tasyopakṣepa udbhāvanaṃ |
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati na vastu sva lakṣaṇam śabdaiḥ sva rūpeṇa vidhīyate panīyate vā kevalam vikalpa biddhi sandarśitaḥ eva sarvaḥ vidhi pratiṣedha vyavahāraḥ tatas ca anitya ādi śabdeṣu anitya ādi pratipakṣaḥ nitya ādiḥ vyavacchedyaḥ na asti iti a pratipakṣa doṣaḥ tasya upakṣepaḥ udbhāvanam

original: ādiśandānnāstyātmeti pratiṣedhe cāpratiṣedhadoṣa ity evam ādyupakṣepaś ca (|) durmatīnām udyotakaraprabhṛtīnāṃ vispanditāni vijṛmbhitānyasambaddhānīti yāvat | na hi vyāyānugatabiddhir asambaddham udbhāvayet | ataś ca te doṣopakṣepā upekṣaṇīyā nāvadhānārhā ity arthaḥ |
analyzed: ādi śandāt na asti ātmā iti pratiṣedhe ca apratiṣedha doṣaḥ iti evam ādi upakṣepaḥ ca durmatīnām udyota kara prabhṛtīnām vispanditāni vijṛmbhitāni asambaddhāni iti yāvat na hi vyāya anugata biddhiḥ asambaddham udbhāvayet atas ca te doṣa upakṣepāḥ upekṣaṇīyāḥ na avadhāna arhāḥ iti arthaḥ

original: athetyādi paraḥ | apiśabdo bhinnakramaḥ | ekasya vastunaḥ sāmānyasya vṛtter api kāraṇādaneko vyaktibhedaḥ | ekā śrutir ekaśrutiḥ | sā cādhikā asyānekasyāstīty ekaśrutimān | ekaśabdavācyo yadi bhaved ity arthaḥ | ekakāryatvenaikaḥ śabdabahuṣv ekena vā sāmānyeneti na kaś cid viśeṣa iti manyate | ata eva vyācaṣṭe | na kevalam ityādi |
analyzed: atha ityādi paraḥ apiśabdaḥ bhinnakramaḥ ekasya vastunaḥ sāmānyasya vṛtteḥ api kāraṇāt anekaḥ vyakti bhedaḥ ekā śrutiḥ eka śrutiḥ sā ca adhikā asya anekasya asti iti eka śrutimān eka śabda vācyaḥ yadi bhavet iti arthaḥ eka kāryatvena ekaḥ śabda bahuṣu ekena vā sāmānyena iti na kaḥ cid viśeṣaḥ iti manyate atas eva vyācaṣṭe na kevalam ityādi

original: tadanyasmād atatkāryād yo bhedassa eva sarveṣāṃ tatkāryāṇām aviśeṣas tasmād ekaśabdenocyante | api tvekavṛttyāpy ekasya sāmānyasya varttanenāpy anekaḥ padārtha ekaśabdenocyeta ko virodhaḥ syāt | tathaikakāryatvena bahuṣv ekaśabdapravṛttau nāsti virodhas tathā vastubhūtenāpi sāmānyena | tasmād vastubhūtasāmānyakalpanāpi yuktaiveti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: tad anyasmāt atatkāryāt yaḥ bhedaḥ saḥ eva sarveṣām tad kāryāṇām aviśeṣaḥ tasmāt eka śabdena ucyante api tu eka vṛttyā api ekasya sāmānyasya varttanena api anekaḥ padārthaḥ eka śabdena ucyeta kaḥ virodhaḥ syāt tathā eka kārya tvena bahuṣu eka śabda pravṛttau na asti virodhaḥ tathā vastu bhūtena api sāmānyena tasmāt vastu bhūta sāmānya kalpanā api yuktā eva iti bhāvaḥ

original: uktam ity ācāryaḥ | tasya vastubhūtasya sāmānyasya upalabhyate rūpeṇābhimataṃ | abhimatatve upalabhyatvaṃ karaṇatvena vivakṣitam iti karttṛkaraṇe kṛtety eva samāsaḥ | upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptasya vyaktivyatirekeṇānupalabdher abhāvaḥ sāmānyasyeti vākyārthaḥ |
analyzed: uktam iti ācāryaḥ tasya vastu bhūtasya sāmānyasya upalabhyate rūpeṇa abhimatam abhimata tve upalabhya tvam karaṇa tvena vivakṣitam iti karttṛ karaṇe kṛtā iti eva samāsaḥ upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptasya vyakti vyatirekeṇa anupalabdheḥ abhāvaḥ sāmānyasya iti vākya arthaḥ

original: anupalambhyamānatāyāmvā 'ṅgīkriyamāṇāyāntaddarśanāśrayā iti sāmānyadarśanāśrayā vyapadeśapratyabhijñānādayo na bhaveyar iti | uktam iti sambhandhaḥ | bahuṣv ekaśabdo vyavadeśas tulyākāraṃ jñānaṃ pratyabhijñānaṃ | ādiśabdāt sāmānyāśrayā vyaktau pravṛttir na bhaved ityādeḥ parigrahaḥ |
analyzed: anupalambhyamāna tāyām vā ṅgīkriyamāṇāyām tad darśana āśrayāḥ iti sāmānya darśana āśrayāḥ vyapadeśa pratyabhijñāna ādayaḥ na iti uktam iti sambhandhaḥ bahuṣu eka śabdaḥ vyavadeśaḥ tulya ākāram jñānam pratyabhijñānam ādi śabdāt sāmānya āśrayā vyaktau pravṛttiḥ na bhavet iti ādeḥ parigrahaḥ

original: na hi svayam anupalabhyamānam upalambhanibandhanaṃ vyapadeśapratyabhijñānam anyatra pravarttayati (p.276) | na bhaveyur ityādīnyanena cādiśabdenānyasyāpi pūrvoktasya doṣasya grahaṇaṃ | na hy anyenānye  samānānāmatadvanto nāma syuḥ (|) tathā na jātir vāhadohādāv upayujyata ityādi | anenaitad āha (|) jātikalpanāyām bādhakaṃ pramāṇam asti |
analyzed: na hi svayam anupalabhyamānam upalambha nibandhanam vyapadeśa pratyabhijñānam anyatra pravarttayati na bhaveyuḥ ityādīni anena ca ādi śabdena anyasya api pūrvoktasya doṣasya grahaṇam na hi anyena anye samānānām atadvantaḥ nāma syuḥ tathā na jātiḥ vāha doha ādau upayujyate ityādi anena etat āha jāti kalpanāyām bādhakam pramāṇam asti

original: tato na tannibandhano vyapadeśādiḥ | ekakāryatve tu virodhābhāvāt tatkṛtam eva vyapadeśapratyabhijñānādikaṃ yuktam iti | dūṣaṇāntaram apy āha – api cedādi | vastubhūte sāmānyam icchatā svāśraye naikasmiṃs tasya pravṛttireṣṭavyā | na hi tatrāvarttamānamāśraye vyapadeśādikāraṇaṃ yuktaṃ | sā ca sāmānyasya svāśraye pravṛttir ādheyatā vā bhvet |
analyzed: tatas na tad nibandhanaḥ vyapadeśa ādiḥ eka kārya tve tu virodha abhāvāt tad kṛtam eva vyapadeśa pratyabhijñāna ādikam yuktam iti dūṣaṇa antaram api āha api ced ādi vastu bhūte sāmānyam icchatā sva āśraye na ekasmin tasya pravṛttiḥ eṣṭavyā na hi tatra āvarttamānam āśraye vyapadeśa ādi kāraṇam yuktam sā ca sāmānyasya sva āśraye pravṛttiḥ ādheya tā vā

original: tadbalenāvasthānāt | āśrayabalenopalabdhir vyaktiḥ sā vā vṛttir bhavet | etad dvayam api tasmin sāmānye na yujyate | (|144-45||)
analyzed: tad balena avasthānāt āśraya balena upalabdhiḥ vyaktiḥ sā vā vṛttiḥ bhavet etat dvayam api tasmin sāmānye na yujyate

original: yadetad ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | yadetad ekam iti vastubhūtaṃ sāmānyam anekatrāśraye varttamānam ekāṃ śrutiṃ varttayati (|) tasya sāmānyasya svaśraye keyaṃ vṛttir iti praśnayitvā svayam eva vikalpadvayam āha – ādheyatā cetyādi | atha vā kiṃ śabdaḥ pratikṣepe (|) keyaṃ vṛttir na kā cid ity arthaḥ | tathā hi vṛtteḥ svāśraye ādheyatā vā syāt |
analyzed: yat etat ityādinā vyācaṣṭe yat etat ekam iti vastu bhūtam sāmānyam anekatra āśraye varttamānam ekām śrutim vartayati tasya sāmānyasya sva āśraye kā iyam vṛttiḥ iti praśnayitvā svayam eva vikalpa dvayam āha ādheya tā ca ityādi atha vā kim śabdaḥ pratikṣepe kā iyam vṛttiḥ na kā cid iti arthaḥ tathā hi vṛtteḥ sva āśraye ādheya tā vā syāt

original: yathā kuṇḍe ādhāre badarāṇi varttanta iti | vyaktir vā tasya sāmānyasyāśraye vṛttiḥ syāt tair āśrayair vyakteḥ prakāśanāt | tatra yady ādheyatā vṛttir iṣyate | tadā vyaktayas tadādhāratvenaiṣṭavyāḥ | nityaṃ ca sāmānyam abhyupagataṃ vyaktyutpatteḥ pūrvvan tadanādheyan tato nityasyāśrayair anupakāryatvād dhetor āśrayābhimatā vyaktayo nādhāraḥ |
analyzed: yathā kuṇḍe ādhāre badarāṇi varttante iti vyaktiḥ vā tasya sāmānyasya āśraye vṛttiḥ syāt taiḥ āśrayaiḥ vyakteḥ prakāśanāt tatra yadi ādheya tā vṛttiḥ iṣyate tadā vyaktayaḥ tad ādhāra tvena eṣṭavyāḥ nityam ca sāmānyam abhyupagatam vyakti utpatteḥ tatas nityasya āśrayaiḥ anupakārya tvāt hetoḥ āśraya abhimatāḥ vyaktayaḥ na ādhāraḥ

original: nityaṃ hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | atha nityaṃ neṣyate tadāpy anityatve 'parāparotpatter anyasyānyasyotpatter anekaṃ sāmānyam anekatvāt kāraṇād bhedeṣv iva bhedavat tasmin sāmānye ekapratyayāyogād ekasya jñānasyāyogāt kāraṇāt | nityaṃ sāmānyam iṣyata ity anena sambandhaḥ | nityasya ca sāmānyasya kiṃ kurvāṇa āśraya ādhāraḥ syān naivety abhiprāyaḥ |

analyzed: a pratibadhan asya ca asambandhāt kāraṇāt sarva vastu sambandhāḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvāt na vyatiricyante iti prakṛtena saṃbandhaḥ

original: satyam etat | kin tu yady api sākṣād anyonyaṃ nopakāras tathāpy ekakāraṇāyattatayā pāram paryeṇāpi sambandhaṃ kalpayed ity upanyāsaḥ | ekārthasamavāyinaḥ parasparam upakāryopakārakabhāvo naiveṣyata iti ced āha – yady apītyādi | tata ekasmād āśrayād upakārasyābhāve yathoktadoṣaprasaṅgāt |

original: atiprasaṅgabhayād ity ukto doṣaḥ yataś ca svāśrayād ekārthasamavāyinor avaśyam upakāro 'taḥ svāśrayakṛtaḥ samavāyinoryaḥ svopakāra ātnopakāras tena dvāreṇa param api dvitīyam api samavāyinaṃ saṅghaṭayya pratipādayitrā khyāpyate samavāyināv āha sambaddhāv iti |

original: etad uktam bhavati | yathā parasyaikārthasamavāyinoḥ parasparāsambaddhepy ekārthasamavāyāt sambandhas tathāsmākam ekakāryatvena tayoḥ sambandhaḥ | yata evaṃ tasmāt tatrāpy ekārthasamavāyini kāryakāraṇabhāvakṛta evāśrayeṇa saha yaḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvas tatkṛta eva yaddvāreṇāorpita eva sambandhaḥ | yasmād upakāradvāreṇaivādhārādibhāvaḥ |
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati yathā parasya eka artha samavāyinoḥ paraspara asambaddhaḥ ipi ekārtha samavāyāt sambandhaḥ tathā asmākam eka kārya tvena tayoḥ sambandhaḥ yatas evam tasmāt tatra api ekārtha samavāyini kārya kāraṇa bhāva kṛte eva āśrayeṇa saha yaḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ tad kṛtaḥ eva yad dvāreṇa ā aurpitaḥ eva sambandhaḥ yasmāt upakāra dvāreṇa eva ādhāra ādi bhāvaḥ

original: tasmād ayam āśrayaḥ śāvaleyādi | svātmani sāmānyasvabhāvenupakurvāṇaḥ sāmānyasyānapekṣasyādhāra iti yācitakamaṇḍanam etat | maṇḍanamalaṅkāro maṇḍyateneneti kṛtvā (|) tasya yācitakaśabdena karmadhārayaḥ | kasmāt parasmād yācitakam maṇḍanandaridrasyātmanyavidyamānaṃ | tadvat sāmānyāśrayasyāpi sāmānyaṃ pratyādhāratvaṃ |

original: bhāvasādhano vā tṛtīyāsamāsaś ca | yathā yācitakenālaṅkāreṇa maṇḍanakriyā | tathā sāmānyāśrayasya parasmāt prārthitenādhārabhāvenādhāravyapadeśo na vastusthityā tata upakārābhāvād iti |

original: 1--katham ityādiparaḥ | na hi kuṇḍaṃ badarāṇāṃ janakaṃ | teṣāṃ svahetor eva (p.279) niṣpatteḥ (|) tataś ca yaduktaṃ "sarvatra vastusambandhāḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvān na vyatiricyanta" iti tadanekāntikam iti manyate |

original: pravisarppato deśāntaravisarppaṇaśīlasya badarādes taddeśajananam upādānabhūtasya pūrvakasya badaralakṣaṇasya yo deśaḥ kuṇḍasambaddhas tasminn eva deśe jananam anyatrāgamanāt | iyaṃ śaktiḥ kuṇḍāderādhārābhimatasya badarādiṣv ādheyeṣu |

original: prakṛtyevetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | prakṛtyā svabhāvenaivāsamāno deśe yasya tattathoktaṃ | prakṛtiśabdam apekṣamāṇasyāpi gamakatvād bahuvrīhiḥ | tathābhūtaṃ ca tatkāryaṃ ceti karmadhārayaḥ | kāryaṃ ca badarādikam evottarottarakṣaṇasaṅgṛhītaṃ | tasyotpādanaṃ tadeva dharmaḥ svabhāvo yasya guruṇo dravyasya badarādeḥ pūrvakṣaṇasaṅgṛhītasya |

original: samānadeśakāryotpādanabhāva ādhārakṛtaḥ | ātmanā tulyadeśasyotpādakatvam ādhārakṛtam ity arthaḥ | yata evaṃ tasmāt pāścāt yasya badarakāryasya yaḥ pūrvakṣaṇaḥ upādānabhūtas tasya sahakāri kuṇḍaṃ | tatraivopādānakṣaṇadeśa eva badarakārya janayat kuṇḍamādhāra ity ucyate |

original: anena naikasāmagryadhīnayoḥ kuṇḍabadarakṣaṇayor ādhārādheyabhāva ity uktam bhavati | anyathā yadi kuṇḍena vadarāṇāṃ yathokta upakāro na kriyate tadeha kuṇḍe badarāṇoty evaṃ vyāpadeśo na syāt | niyatādhārasya vyapadeśasya nimittam antareṇāyogāt | tadupakārakṛta ity ādhāropakārakṛtāyaṃ vyāpadeśa iha kuṇḍe badarāṇīti |
analyzed: anena na eka sāmagrī adhīnayoḥ kuṇḍa badara kṣaṇayoḥ ādhāra ādheya bhāvaḥ iti uktam bhavati anyathā yadi kuṇḍena vadarāṇām yathā uktaḥ upakāraḥ na kriyate tadā iha kuṇḍe badarāṇi iti evam vyāpadeśaḥ na syāt niyata ādhārasya vyapadeśasya nimittam antareṇa ayogāt tad upakāra kṛtaḥ iti ādhāra upakāra kṛtā ayam vyāpadeśaḥ iha kuṇḍe badarāṇi iti

original: kin tarhi kuṇḍabadarayor yaḥ saṃyogas tatkṛtaḥ |

original: kim punar ityādi siddhāntavādī | pṛcchataś cāyam abhiprāyo kṣaṇikatve sati saṃyogādīnām bhavadbhiḥ kalpaneṣyate | akṣaṇikatvaṃ ced bhāvānām abhyupagamyate saṃyogādīnām evotpattir na syād ity arthaḥ | tayor iti kuṇḍabadarayoḥ saṃyoga ity api vyapadeśanimittaṃ nāsty upakāryopakārakatvābhāvād ity abhiprāyaḥ |
analyzed: kim punar ityādi siddhāntavādī pṛcchataḥ ca ayam kṣaṇika tve sati saṃyoga ādīnām bhavadbhiḥ kalpanā iṣyate akṣaṇika tvam ced bhāvānām abhyupagamyate saṃyoga ādīnām eva utpattiḥ na syāt iti arthaḥ tayoḥ iti kuṇḍa badarayoḥ saṃyogaḥ iti api vyapadeśa nimittam na asti upakārya upakāraka tva abhāvāt iti abhiprāyaḥ

original: (p.280)tābhyām ityādi paraḥ | tābhyāṃ kuṇḍabadarābhyāṃ saṃyogasya jananāttayoḥ saṃyoga iṣyate | dvābhyām eva saṃyogasya jananam ubhayatra samavāyaḥ | pareṇokta ity a(va)mṛśya siddhāntavādy āha – sa ityādi | sa saṃyoga ekatraiva kuṇḍe badare vā kin na samavaiti janyate vā |
analyzed: tābhyām ityādi paraḥ tābhyām kuṇḍa badarābhyām saṃyogasya jananāt tayoḥ saṃyogaḥ iṣyate dvābhyām eva saṃyogasya jananam ubhayatra samavāyaḥ pareṇa uktaḥ iti avamṛśya siddhāntavādī āha saḥ ityādi sa saṃyogaḥ ekatra eva kuṇḍe badare vā kin na samavaiti janyate vā

original: ekena kuṇḍena badareṇa vā pṛcchataś cāyaṃ bhāvo yadi tau kuṇḍabadarākhyau bhāvau saṃyogajanane | ādhārabhāvopagamane vā | pratyekaṃ samarthasvabhāvau tadā kim ity anyonyam apekṣata iti | pṛthagarthan tadubhayaṃ parasparasahitam eva samartham iti ced āha – tad ityādi |
analyzed: ekena kuṇḍena badareṇa vā pṛcchataḥ ca ayam bhāvaḥ yadi tau kuṇḍa badara ākhyau bhāvau saṃyoga janane ādhāra bhāva upagamane vā pratyekam samartha svabhāvau tadā kim iti anyonyam apekṣate iti tat ubhayam paraspara sahitam eva samartham iti ced āha tat ityādi

original: yatkuṇḍabadaravastupṛthagasamartham tatparasparasahitam api tādṛśam evāsamartham evākṣaṇikatvād iti bhāvaḥ | kṣaṇikāstu pratyekaṃ pṛthagasamarthāḥ paścāt sahakārikṛtaviśeṣāssahitāssamarthā ity aviruddhaṃ | tataś ca saṃyogaṃ pratyanupakārakatvāt | kuṇḍabadarākhyam vastu | na saṃyogena taddharmyāt |
analyzed: yat kuṇḍa badara vastu pṛthak asamartham tat paraspara sahitam api tādṛśam eva asamartham eva akṣaṇika tvāt iti bhāvaḥ kṣaṇikāḥ tu pratyekam pṛthak asamarthāḥ paścāt sahakāri kṛta viśeṣāḥ sahitāḥ samarthāḥ iti aviruddham tatas ca saṃyogam prati anupakāraka tvāt kuṇḍa badara ākhyam vastu na saṃyogena tad dharmyāt

original: sahitasyetyādi paraḥ | sahitasya kuṇḍasya badarasya ca tadanyopakārāt | tasmāt kuṇḍād yo yo badarātmā tasmāt kuṇḍasyopakārāt | tasmād vā badarād yad anyat kuṇḍan tasmād badarasyopakārāt | viśeṣotpatter hetoḥ kuṇḍabadarayoḥ saṃyogasya janane | ādhārabhāvopagamane vā sāmarthya na kevalayor iti |
analyzed: sahitasya ityādi paraḥ sahitasya kuṇḍasya badarasya ca tad anya upakārāt tasmāt kuṇḍāt yaḥ yaḥ badara ātmā tasmāt kuṇḍasya upakārāt tasmāt vā badarāt yat anyat tasmāt badarasya upakārāt viśeṣa utpatteḥ hetoḥ kuṇḍa badarayoḥ saṃyogasya janane ādhāra bhāva upagamane vā sāmarthya na kevalayoḥ iti

original: koyam ity ācāryaḥ | badarāṇāṃ kuṇḍādīnāṃ cājanyajanakabhūtānāṃ koyam upakāraḥ (|) naivāsti | ajanyajanakatvam eva katham iti ced āha – svarūpetyādi | badarasvarūpasyānyataḥ hetor eva siddher ākāryatvān na badarāṇāṃ janyatvaṃ nāpi janakatvaṃ kuṇḍasyeti bhāvaḥ | na hi paro badarādīnāṃ kuṇḍādeḥ sakāśāt svarūpotpattim vāñchati |
analyzed: kaḥ yam iti ācāryaḥ badarāṇām kuṇḍa ādīnām ca ajanya janaka bhūtānām kaḥ yam upakāraḥ na eva asti ajanya janaka tvam eva katham iti ced āha svarūpa ityādi badara svarūpasya anyatas hetoḥ eva siddheḥ ākārya tvāt na badarāṇām janya tvam na api janaka tvam kuṇḍasya iti bhāvaḥ na hi paraḥ badara ādīnām kuṇḍa ādeḥ sakāśāt svarūpa utpattim vāñchati

original: svahetor eva teṣān niṣpatteḥ | na kuṇḍena badararūpam eva kriyate kin tu tatonyadrūpam ity ata āha – pararūpetyādi | tatrety ādheye | na hy arthāntare kṛterthāntaram upakṛtaṃ syāt | ubhayartheti svarūpapararūpakriyābhyāṃ | anantaroktena vidhinānupakārakasya kuṇḍāder akiñcit karatvāt |
analyzed: sva hetoḥ eva niṣpatteḥ na kuṇḍena badara rūpam eva kriyate kin tu tatonyat rūpam iti atas āha para rūpa ityādi tatra iti ādheye na hi artha antare kṛta irtha antaram upakṛtam syāt ubhaya arthā iti sva rūpa para rūpa kriyābhyām anantara uktena vidhinā anupakārakasya kuṇḍa ādeḥ akiñcit kara tvāt

original: etac coktaprāyaṃ | prāyaśabdo bāhulyavacanaḥ | prāyeṇoktam uktaprāyaṃ | rājadantāder ākṛtigaṇatvāt prāyaśabdasya paranipātaḥ | ayaṃ cārthaḥ "kāryaś ca tāsāṃ prāptosau jananaṃ yad upakriye"(1|108)tyādi vistareṇokotaḥ | prāyaśabdaṃ sadṛśārtham anyeprāhuḥ | uktena sadṛśam uktaprāyaṃ |
analyzed: etat ca ukta prāyam prāya śabdaḥ bāhulya vacanaḥ prāyeṇa uktam ukta prāyam rājadanta ādeḥ ākṛti gaṇa tvāt prāya śabdasya para nipātaḥ ayam ca arthaḥ kāryaḥ ca tāsām prāptā asau jananam yat upakriyā ityādi vistareṇa ukta ūtaḥ prāya śabdam sadṛśa artham anye prāhuḥ uktena sadṛśam ukta prāyam

original: prāguktenāśrayakṛtena sāmānyasya svarūpopakāreṇedaṃ kuṇḍādikṛtam ādheyasyopakārakaraṇan tulyam ity arthaḥ | sarva evetyādinopasaṃhāraḥ | sarva eva vastusambandhāḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvād dhetor vyavasthāpy ata iti sambandhaḥ | vibhāgas teṣāṃ na syād iti ced āha – janakasyaivetyādi |
analyzed: prāguktena āśraya kṛtena sāmānyasya svarūpa upakāreṇa idam kuṇḍa ādi kṛtam ādheyasya upakāra karaṇan tulyam iti arthaḥ sarve eva ityādinā upasaṃhāraḥ sarve eva vastu sambandhāḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvāt hetoḥ vyavasthā api atas iti sambandhaḥ vibhāgaḥ teṣām na syāt iti ced āha janakasya eva ityādi

original: yad vā kāryakāraṇabhāvāt sakāśāt pravibhāgena bhedena vyavasthāpy ante | katham bheda ity āha – janakasyaivetyādi | kāraṇakṛtaḥ kāryasya ya upakāraviśeṣas tasya balād ity arthaḥ | tathā hi pravisarppaṇadharmaṇo badarādeḥ svopādānadeśotpādanalakṣaṇenopayogenādhārādheya bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: yat vā kārya kāraṇa bhāvāt sakāśāt pravibhāgena bhedena vyavasthāpī ante katham bhedaḥ iti āha janakasya eva ityādi kāraṇa kṛtaḥ kāryasya yaḥ upakāra viśeṣaḥ tasya balāt iti arthaḥ tathā hi pravisarppaṇa dharmaṇaḥ badara ādeḥ sva upādāna deśa utpādana lakṣaṇena upayogena ādhāra ādheya bhāvaḥ

original: pradīpakṛtena ca vijñānajananasamarthasvarūpotpādena ghaṭapradīpādīnāṃ vyaṅgyavyañjakalakṣaṇaḥ sambandha ity evam anyasminn api sambandhe yathāyogaṃ vācyaṃ |
analyzed: pradīpa kṛtena ca vijñāna janana samartha sva rūpa utpādena ghaṭa pradīpa ādīnām vyaṅgya vyañjaka lakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ iti evam anyasmin api sambandhe yathāyogam vācyam

original: nanu sarva eva vastusambandhā ityādinā na saṃyogalakṣaṇasya sambandhasya kāryakāraṇabhāventar bhāvaḥ samānakālabhāvinor evāsya sattvāt | athākṣaṇikapakṣe saṃyogotpattir na yujyate (|) aṇike tarhi bhaviṣyati saṃyuktāsaṃyuktāvasthayoś ca kuṇḍabadarayor na savarūpabhedaḥ pratīyate | tenākṣaṇikepi saṃyogosty eva pratīteḥ |
analyzed: nanu sarve eva vastu sambandhāḥ ityādinā na saṃyoga lakṣaṇasya sambandhasya bhāvaḥ samāna kāla bhāvinoḥ eva asya sattvāt atha akṣaṇika pakṣe saṃyoga utpattiḥ na yujyate aṇike tarhi bhaviṣyati saṃyukta asaṃyukta avasthayoḥ ca kuṇḍa badarayoḥ na eva pratīteḥ

original: yad āhodyotakaraḥ | "yadi saṃyogo na nārthāntaram bhavet tadā kṣetrabījodakādayo nirviśiṣṭatvāt sarvadaivāṃkurādikāryaṃ kuryur na caivaṃ | tasmāt sarvadā kāryānārambhāt kṣetrādīnyaṅkurotpattau kāraṇāntarasāpekṣāṇi | yathā mṛtpiṇḍādisāmagrī ghaṭādikaraṇe kulālādisāpekṣā | yosau kṣetrādinirapekṣaḥ sa samyoga iti siddhaṃ |
analyzed: yat āha udyotakaraḥ yadi saṃyogaḥ na na artha antaram bhavet tadā kṣetra bīja udaka ādayaḥ niḥ viśiṣṭa tvāt sarvadā eva aṃkura ādi kāryam kuryuḥ na ca evam tasmāt sarvadā kārya anārambhāt kṣetra ādīni aṅkura utpattau kāraṇa antara sāpekṣāṇi yathā mṛd piṇḍa ādi sāmagrī ghaṭa ādi karaṇe kulāla ādi sāpekṣā yaḥ asau kṣetra ādi nirapekṣaḥ sa samyogaḥ iti siddham

original: kiṃ cāsau saṃyogo dravyayor viśeṣaṇabhāvena pratīyamānatvāt tatorthāntaratvena pratyakṣasiddha eva | tathā hi kaś cit kena cit saṃyukte dravye āharety ukto yayor eva dravyayoḥ saṃyogam upalabhate te evāharati | na dravyamātraṃ |
analyzed: kim ca asau saṃyogaḥ dravyayoḥ viśeṣaṇa bhāvena pratīyamāna tvāt tatas ṛtha antara tvena pratyakṣa siddhaḥ eva tathā hi kaḥ cit kena cid saṃyukte dravye āhara iti uktaḥ yayoḥ eva dravyayoḥ saṃyogam upalabhate te eva āharati na dravya mātram

original: kiṃ ca dūrataravarttinaḥ puṃsaḥ sāntarepi vane nirantararūpāvasāyinī seyaṃ buddhir udayam āsādayati mithyābuddhir mukhyapadārthānubhavam antareṇa na kva cid upajāyate | na hy ananubhūtagodarśanasya gavaye gaur iti vibhramo bhavati tasmād avaśyaṃ saṃyogo mukhyobhyupagantavyaḥ |
analyzed: kim ca dūratara varttinaḥ puṃsaḥ sāntare api vane nirantara rūpa avasāyinī sā iyam buddhiḥ udayam āsādayati mithyābuddhiḥ mukhya padārtha anubhavam antareṇa na kva cit upajāyate na hi ananubhūta go darśanasya gavaye gauḥ iti vibhramaḥ bhavati tasmāt avaśyam saṃyogaḥ mukhyaḥ abhyupagantavyaḥ

original: tathā na caitraḥ kuṇḍalīty anena pratiṣedhavākyena na kuṇḍalaṃ pratiṣidhyate tasyānyatra deśādau sattvāt | tasmāc caitrasya kuṇḍalasaṃyogaḥ pratiṣidhyate | tathā caitraḥ kuṇḍalīty anenāpi vidhivākyena na caitrakuṇḍalayor anyataravidhānantayoḥ siddhatvāt | pāriśeṣyāt saṃyogavidhānaṃ | tasmād asty eva saṃyoga" iti | 1*
analyzed: tathā na caitraḥ kuṇḍalī iti anena pratiṣedha vākyena na kuṇḍalam pratiṣidhyate tasya anyatra deśa ādau sattvāt tasmāt caitrasya kuṇḍala saṃyogaḥ pratiṣidhyate tathā caitraḥ kuṇḍalī iti anena api vidhi vākyena na caitra kuṇḍalayoḥ siddha tvāt pāriśeṣyāt saṃyoga vidhānam tasmāt asti eva saṃyogaḥ iti

original: fn.1*: Nyāyavārttika.
analyzed: Ro-0

original: atrocyate | (1) yathā śretrādināṃ viśiṣṭāvasthāpratilambhena saṃyogārambhakatvam (p.282) iṣyate tathā saṃyogam aṃtareṇa kāryārambhakatvam eva kin neṣyate | anyathā sarvadā saṃyogārambhakatvaṃ syāt | (2) nāpi nirvikalpakena  pratyakṣeṇa saṃyukte dravye savarūpeṇa gṛhyamāṇe tṛtīyaḥ saṃyogaḥ pratibhāsate |
analyzed: atra ucyate yathā śretra ādinām viśiṣṭa avasthā pratilambhena saṃyoga ārambhaka tvam iṣyate tathā saṃyogam aṃtareṇa kārya ārambhaka tvam eva kin na iṣyate anyathā sarvadā saṃyoga ārambhaka tvam syāt na api nirvikalpakena pratyakṣeṇa saṃyukte dravye sava rūpeṇa gṛhyamāṇe tṛtīyaḥ saṃyogaḥ pratibhāsate

original: (3) nāpi savikalpake jñāne saṃyukte dravye muktvā saṃyogaśabdaṃ cāparaḥ saṃyogo viśeṣaṇabhāvena pratibhāsate | (4) nāpi saṃyuktapratyayānyathānupapattyā saṃyogakalpanā | utpannanirantarāvasthayor eva bhavayoḥ saṃyuktapratyayahetutvāt |
analyzed: nā api sa vikalpake jñāne saṃyukte dravye muktvā saṃyoga śabdam ca aparaḥ saṃyogaḥ viśeṣaṇa bhāvena pratibhāsate nā api saṃyukta pratyaya anyathā anupapattyā saṃyoga kalpanā utpanna nirantara avasthayoḥ eva bhavayoḥ saṃyukta pratyaya hetu tvāt

original: yāvac ca tasyām avasthāyāṃ saṃyogajanakatvena saṃyuktapratyayaviṣayau tāviṣyate tāvat saṃyogam antareṇa saṃyuktapratyayahetutvena tadviṣayau kiṃ neṣyete | kim pāram paryeṇa | (5) nāpi sāntare vane nirantarāvabhāsinī buddhir mukhyapadārthānubhavapūrvikā skhalatpratyayaviṣayatvenānupacaritatvāt |
analyzed: yāvat ca tasyām avasthāyām saṃyoga janaka tvena saṃyukta pratyaya viṣayau tau iṣyate tāvat saṃyogam antareṇa saṃyukta pratyaya hetu tvena tad viṣayau kim neṣyete kim na api sāntare vane nirantara avabhāsinī buddhiḥ mukhya padārtha anubhava pūrvikā skhalat pratyaya viṣaya tvena anupacarita tvāt

original: (6) tathā na caitraḥ kuṇḍalītyādau caitrasambandhikuṇḍalaṃ pratiṣidhyate vidhīyate vā | na saṃyogaḥ | tasmād ekasāmagryadhīnayor eva saṃyutāv iti pratītiḥ | yathā kuṇḍabadasyostasmāt saṃyogasyāpi kāryakāraṇabhāva evāntarbhāvaḥ | kevalaṃ bhedāntarapratikṣepeṇa saṃyuktāvetau saṃyogasyeti vā pratītir na punar vastubhūtasaṃyogabalāt |
analyzed: tathā na caitraḥ kuṇḍalī ityādau caitra sambandhi kuṇḍalam pratiṣidhyate vidhīyate vā na saṃyogaḥ tasmāt eka sāmagrī adhīnayoḥ eva saṃyutau iti pratītiḥ yathā kuṇḍa badasyoḥ tasmāt saṃyogasya api kārya kāraṇa bhāve eva antarbhāvaḥ kevalam bheda antara pratikṣepeṇa saṃyuktau etau saṃyogasya iti vā pratītiḥ na punar vastu bhūta saṃyoga balāt

original: yataś ca nāsti kāryakāraṇabhāvam antareṇa vāstavaḥ sambandhaḥ |
analyzed: yatas ca na asti kārya kāraṇa bhāvam antareṇa vāstavaḥ sambandhaḥ

original: tadayam ityādi | badarādiṣu janataśaktir eva kuṇḍādīnām ādhāra iti sambandhaḥ sāmānyasyāśrayo jananaśaktyaivādhārostv iti ced āha – netyādi | sati jananaśaktiḥ | atreti sāmānye |
analyzed: tat ayam ityādi badara ādiṣu janata śaktiḥ eva kuṇḍa ādīnām ādhāraḥ iti sambandhaḥ sāmānyasya āśrayaḥ janana śaktyā eva ādhāraḥ ustu iti ced āha na ityādi sati janana śaktiḥ atra iti sāmānye

original: na hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | svopādānadeśa eva jananaṃ jananaviśeṣaḥ sa lakṣaṇaṃ yasyādhārabhāvasya sa tathā | tasyājanyatvād iti sāmānyasya nityatvenājanyatvāt | tadabhāvetyāśrayābhāvepi sāmānyasyāvasthiter hetor āśrayavaśena na sthitiḥ sāmānyasya |
analyzed: na hi ityādinā vyācaṣṭe sva upādāna deśaḥ eva jananam janana viśeṣaḥ sa lakṣaṇam yasya ādhāra bhāvasya sa tathā tasya ajanya tvāt iti sāmānyasya nitya tvena ajanya tvāt tad abhāva iti āśraya abhāve api sāmānyasya avasthiteḥ hetoḥ āśraya vaśena na sthitiḥ sāmānyasya

original: athetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | tasyeti sāmānyasya tadabhāvepīti vyaktyabhāvepi vyaktiśanye deśe sāmānyasya sthānāt | yadi hi vyaktiśūnye deśe sāmānyaṃ na bhavet tadā tatrāpūrvavyaktyutpāde sāmānyasambandho na bhavet | na hi tasyānyata āgamanaṃ niṣkriyatvāt (p.283) | na ca bhinnadeśāvasthitā vyaktis tasya sāmānyasyādhāro bhinnadeśatvāt |
analyzed: atha ityādinā vyācaṣṭe tasya iti sāmānyasya tad abhāve api iti vyakti abhāve api vyakti śanye deśe sāmānyasya sthānāt yadi hi vyakti śūnye deśe sāmānyam na bhavet tadā tatra apūrva vyakti utpāde sāmānya sambandhaḥ na bhavet na hi tasya anyatas āgamanam niṣkriya tvāt na ca bhinna deśa avasthitā vyaktiḥ tasya sāmānyasya ādhāraḥ bhinna deśa tvāt

original: ekatvāt sāmānyasya nāsti bhinnadeśateti cet | sarvās tarhi vyaktaya ekajātimatya ekadeśāḥ prāpnuvanti | na ca sarvā jātimatyaḥ syuḥ | ekasya katham bhinnadeśāvasthitatvam iti ced ayam aparosya doṣostu |
analyzed: eka tvāt sāmānyasya na asti bhinna deśa tā iti ced sarvāḥ tarhi vyaktayaḥ eka jātimatyaḥ eka deśāḥ prāpnuvanti na ca sarvāḥ jātimatyaḥ syuḥ ekasya katham bhinna deśa avasthita tvam iti ced ayam aparaḥ sya doṣaḥ ustu

original: patanadharmetyādinopacayahetum āha – hi śabdaś cārthe | apiśabdobhyupagamasūcanārthaḥ | abhyupagamyāpy ayaṃ prakāraḥ sāmānye vyavasthāpayitum aśakyaḥ | sāmānyasyāpatanadharmmatvādity evam artham upanyāsaḥ | na tvajanakasya sthāpakatvaṃ sambhavati | ata evāha – atrāpītyādi |
analyzed: patana dharma ityādinā upacaya hetum āha hi śabdaḥ ca arthe apiśabdaḥ abhyupagama sūcana arthaḥ abhyupagamya api ayam prakāraḥ sāmānye vyavasthāpayitum aśakyaḥ sāmānyasya a patana dharmma tvāt iti evam artham upanyāsaḥ na tu ajanakasya sthāpaka tvam sambhavati atas eva āha atra api ityādi

original: atrāpi pātapratibandhāt sthāpakābhyupagame yadi nyāyavādī kaś cit pātapratibandhaṃ na paryanuyuñjīta | tadā bhaved ajanakopi sthāpakaḥ | svasamayānurodhenety ākūtaṃ | atrāpy ayaṃ paryanuyogaḥ sambhavati | yaḥ sthāpayitrā kriyate pātapratibandhaḥ sa sthāpy asyātmabhūto vā syāt tatorthāntaraṃ vā pātābhāvamātram vā |
analyzed: atrā api pāta pratibandhāt sthāpaka abhyupagame yadi nyāya vādī kaḥ cit pāta pratibandham na paryanuyuñjīta tadā bhavet ajanakaḥ api sthāpakaḥ sva samaya anurodhena iti ākūtam atrā api ayam paryanuyogaḥ sambhavati yaḥ sthāpayitrā kriyate pāta pratibandhaḥ sa sthāpī asya ātma bhūtaḥ vā syāt tatas ṛtha antaram vā pāta abhāva mātram vā

original: na tāvad ātmabhūtas tatsvabhāvasyānyato niṣpattyabhyupagamāt nāpy arthāntaram ity āha – arthāntaratvebhyupagamyamāne tatraiva pratibandherthāntarabhūte 'syādhārasyopayoga iti kaḥ patato badarādeḥ pratibandho vighātaḥ (|) naiva kaś cit | tataś ca kuṇḍādistham api badarādi patedeveti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: na tāvat ātma bhūtaḥ tad svabhāvasya anyatas niṣpatti abhyupagamāt nā api artha antaram iti āha artha antara tve abhyupagamyamāne tatra eva sya ādhārasya upayogaḥ iti kaḥ patataḥ badara ādeḥ pratibandhaḥ vighātaḥ nā eva kaḥ cid tatas ca kuṇḍa ādi stham api badara ādi patet eva iti bhāvaḥ

original: tasmād ityādinā tṛtīyapakṣopanyāsaḥ | sa pātābhāvaḥ kathaṃ kena cit kriyate | (p.284) naiva kena cit | abhāvasyākāryatvād iti bhāvaḥ | kathan tarhy abhāvaṃ karotīti vyapadeśa iti ced āha – abhāvam ityādi | abhāvaṅkarotīti vyapadeśe nābhāvo nāma kaś cit kārya iṣyate | kasmād ity āha – tasyetyādi |
analyzed: tasmāt ityādinā tṛtīya pakṣa upanyāsaḥ sa pāta abhāvaḥ katham kena cid kriyate na eva kena cid abhāvasya akārya tvāt iti bhāvaḥ kathan tarhi abhāvam karoti iti vyapadeśaḥ iti ced āha abhāvam ityādi abhāvam karoti iti vyapadeśe na abhāvaḥ nāma kaḥ cid kāryaḥ iṣyate kasmāt iti āha tasya ityādi

original: tasyety abhāvasya kāryatvād bhāva eva syād ity abhiprāyaḥ |
analyzed: tasya iti abhāvasya kārya tvāt bhāvaḥ eva syāt iti abhiprāyaḥ

original: nanu yathā ghaṭavat kāryatvāt paṭasya na ghaṭarūpatā | tathā bhāvavannābhāvasya kāryatvād abhāvarūpatā bhaviṣyatīti cet (|) na | ghaṭāder api hi bhāvarūpatvam bhavanadharmatvād eva (|) taccābhāvety astīti kathaṃ na bhāvarūpatvam abhāvarūpatvena pratibhāsanān na bhāvarūpateti cet (|) na (|) abhāvasya pratibhāsābhāvāt |
analyzed: nanu yathā ghaṭa vat kārya tvāt paṭasya na ghaṭa rūpatā tathā bhāva vat na abhāvasya kārya tvāt abhāva rūpatā bhaviṣyati iti ced na ghaṭa ādeḥ api hi bhāva rūpatvam bhavana dharma tvāt eva tat ca abhāva iti asti iti katham na bhāva rūpatvam abhāva rūpa tvena pratibhāsanāt na bhāva rūpatā iti ced na abhāvasya pratibhāsa abhāvāt

original: abhāvānām parasparavibhāgapratīter ghaṭābhāvaḥ paṭābhāva ity atra paṭādīnām bhedo nābhāvānām ekatvena pratibhāsanād ity uktaṃ | yata evaṃ tasmād bhāvasya yā kriyā tasyāḥ pratiṣedhanirdeśo 'bhāvaṃ karotīti |
analyzed: abhāvānām paraspara vibhāga pratīteḥ ghaṭa abhāvaḥ paṭa abhāvaḥ iti atra paṭa ādīnām bhedaḥ na abhāvānām eka tvena pratibhāsanāt iti uktam yatas evam tasmāt bhāvasya yā kriyā tasyāḥ pratiṣedha nirdeśaḥ bhāvam karoti iti

original: ata eva spaṣṭayati | bhāvaṃ na karotīti yāvad iti | yāvānevāsya vākyasyārthas tāvānevābhāvaṃ karotīty asyāpīty arthaḥ | tathā ceti (|) pātapratibandhasyābhāvamātratvenākāryatve | ayam iti kuṇḍādiḥ | tena kāraṇenāyam iti badarādiḥ | kena citkuṅḍādinādhāreṇa pratibaddhaḥ | pātād anivārito na kadā citt iṣṭhet | sadaiva pated ity arthaḥ |
analyzed: atas eva spaṣṭayati bhāvam na karoti iti yāvat iti yāvān eva asya vākyasya arthaḥ tāvān eva abhāvam karoti iti asya api iti arthaḥ tathā ca iti pāta pratibandhasya abhāva mātra tvena akārya tve ayam iti kuṇḍa ādiḥ tena kāraṇena ayam iti badara ādiḥ kena cit kuṅḍa ādinā ādhāreṇa pratibaddhaḥ pātāt anivāritaḥ na kadā cid iṣṭhet sadā eva patet iti arthaḥ

original: tasmād ityādinopasaṃhāraḥ | apiśabdād ādheya ity anenāpi vyapadeśena kṣaṇikānāṃ pūrvakṣaṇasaṅgṛhītenopādānena samānadeśasyottarakṣaṇasaṅgṛhītasya kāryasyotpādanam ucyate | tasmād sāmānye 'yam api prakāro na sambhavatīti khyāpanāyābhyupagamyaietad uktaṃ pātapratibandhād ajanakepi sthāpaka iti |
analyzed: tasmāt ityādinā upasaṃhāraḥ apiśabdāt ādheyaḥ iti anena api vyapadeśena kṣaṇikānām pūrva kṣaṇa saṅgṛhītena upādānena samāna deśasya uttara kṣaṇa saṅgṛhītasya kāryasya utpādanam ucyate tasmāt sāmānye yam api prakāraḥ na sambhavati iti khyāpanāya abhyupagamyai etat uktam pāta pratibandhāt ajanake api sthāpakaḥ iti

original: tamevāsambhavan darśayitum āha – astu nāmetyādi | pātināgbadarādīnān tatpratibandhaḥ pātapratibandhostu nāmājananasvabhāvaḥ | tatkaraṇād iti pātapratibandhakaraṇāt | gatimato dravyasyeti sakriyasya sāmānyasya punar amūrttatvād akriyasya kiṃ lakṣaṇām sthitiṃ karvāṇa āśrayaḥ sthāpakaḥ syāt |
analyzed: tam eva asambhavān darśayitum āha astu nāma ityādi pāti nāk badara ādīnām tad pratibandhaḥ pāta pratibandhoḥ tu nāma ajanana svabhāvaḥ tad karaṇāt iti pāta pratibandha karaṇāt gatimataḥ dravyasya iti sa kriyasya sāmānyasya punar amūrtta tvāt akriyasya kim lakṣaṇām sthitim karvāṇaḥ āśrayaḥ sthāpakaḥ syāt

original: na hi sāmānyasya pāto 'sti yena tatpratibandhaḥ (p.285) sthitir bhavet | kin tu sthitir hi tasya sāmānyasya svarūpāpracyutir evocyate | sā ca svarūpāpracyutir nāśrayāyattā sāmānyasya nityatvāt | abhyupagamyāpy ucyate | sāpy āśrayāyattā sāmānyasya sthitir ayuktaiva | sāmānyāt tasyāḥ sthiter bhedābhedavivecane | anyattvānanyattvavicāre kriyamāṇe |
analyzed: na hi sāmānyasya pātaḥ sti yena tad pratibandhaḥ sthitiḥ bhavet kin tu sthitiḥ hi tasya sāmānyasya svarūpa apracyutiḥ evā ucyate sā ca svarūpa apracyutiḥ na āśraya āyattā sāmānyasya nitya tvāt abhyupagamya api ucyate sā api āśraya āyattā sāmānyasya sthitiḥ ayuktā eva sāmānyāt tasyāḥ sthiteḥ bheda abheda vivecane anyattva ananyattva vicāre kriyamāṇe

original: astu nāmetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | āśrayahetukety āśrayāyattā | seti sthitiḥ | tām evāśrayādanyāṃ sthitiṃ sa āśrayaḥ karoti na sāmānyaṃ | sā sthitiḥ sāmānye pratibaddhā tataḥ sambandhasambaddhāt sāmānyam upakṛtam evety ata āha – sā cetyādi | sety arthāntarabhūtā sthitiḥ |
analyzed: astu nāma ityādinā vyācaṣṭe āśraya hetukā iti āśraya āyattā sā iti sthitiḥ tām eva āśrayāt anyām sthitim saḥ āśrayaḥ karoti na sāmānyam sā sthitiḥ sāmānye pratibaddhā tatas sambandha sambaddhāt sāmānyam upakṛtam eva iti atas āha sā ca ityādi sā iti artha antara bhūtā sthitiḥ

original: na hi tasyāḥ sāmānye pratibandhakāraṇaṃ kiṃ cid asti kiṃ sāmānyasyāśrayeṇa kṛtam bhavatīty adhyāhāraḥ |
analyzed: na hi tasyāḥ sāmānye pratibandha kāraṇam kim cit asti kim sāmānyasya āśrayeṇa kṛtam bhavati iti adhyāhāraḥ

original: abhyupagamyata eva sthiteḥ sāmānye pratibandha iti ced āha – pratibandhe cetyādi | pratibandhe vābhyupagamyamāne | sthitakaraṇaṃ cet | āśrayeṇa janitā yā sthitis tasyāḥ  sthiteḥ sthitiḥ sāmānyena kriyate | tataḥ sāśrayajanitā sthitiḥ sāmānye pratibaddheti | tatrāpi sthiteḥ sthitikaraṇe tulyaḥ prasaṅgaḥ |
analyzed: abhyupagamyate eva sthiteḥ sāmānye pratibandhaḥ iti ced āha pratibandhe ca ityādi pratibandhe vā abhyupagamyamāne sthita karaṇam ced āśrayeṇa janitā yā sthitiḥ tasyāḥ sthiteḥ sthitiḥ sāmānyena kriyate tatas sa āśraya janitā sthitiḥ sāmānye pratibaddhā iti tatra api sthiteḥ sthiti karaṇe tulyaḥ prasaṅgaḥ

original: yā sā cāśrayapratibaddhāyāḥ sthiteḥ sāmānyena sthitiḥ kriyate sā āśrayahetukāyāḥ sthiter ātmabhūtā vā bhaved vyatiriktā vā | ātmabhūtatve āśrayeṇaiva sā kṛteti kathaṃ sāmānyena kriyate | vyatiriktatve ca saiva sthitiḥ sāmānyena kṛtā āśrayajanitāyā ādyāyāḥ sthiteḥ kiṃ sāmānyena kṛtaṃ syāt | atha sāṃānyena dvitīyā sthitiḥ kriyate |
analyzed: yā sā ca āśraya pratibaddhāyāḥ sthiteḥ sāmānyena sthitiḥ kriyate sā āśraya hetukāyāḥ sthiteḥ ātma bhūtā vā bhavet vyatiriktā vā ātma bhūta tve āśrayeṇa eva sā kṛtā iti katham sāmānyena kriyate vyatirikta tve ca sā eva sthitiḥ sāmānyena kṛtā āśraya janitāyāḥ ādyāyāḥ sthiteḥ kim sāmānyena kṛtam syāt atha sāṃānyena dvitīyā sthitiḥ kriyate

original: sā āśrayeṇa janitāyāṃ sthitau pratibaddhā | tadā kaḥ pratibandha iti vācyaṃ | sāmānyajanutāyāḥ sthiter āśrayajanitayā sthityā 'parā tṛtīyā sthitiḥ yata iti tulyaḥ prasaṅgaḥ ity anavasthā syāt |
analyzed: sā āśrayeṇa janitāyām sthitau pratibaddhā tadā kaḥ pratibandhaḥ iti vācyam sāmānya janutāyāḥ sthiteḥ āśraya janitayā sthityā parā tṛtīyā sthitiḥ yatas iti tulyaḥ prasaṅgaḥ iti anavasthā syāt

original: tatonavasthānād āśrayajanitāyāṃ sthitau sāmānyakṛtasyopakārasyānavadhāraṇād asya sāmānyasya sambandhinīyam āśrayeṇa janitā sthitir ity apratītiḥ jananaṃ cet pratibandha iti prakṛtaṃ | na sāmānyenāśrayajanitāyā sthiter aparā sthitiḥ kriyate | kin tu saivādyā sthitir janyata iti |
analyzed: tatas navasthānāt āśraya janitāyām sthitau sāmānya kṛtasya upakārasya anavadhāraṇāt asya sāmānyasya sambandhinī iyam āśrayeṇa janitā sthitiḥ iti apratītiḥ jananam ced pratibandhaḥ iti prakṛtam na sāmānyena āśraya janitāyāḥ sthiteḥ aparā sthitiḥ kriyate kin tu sā eva ādyā sthitiḥ janyate iti

original: tadā kevalaṃ sāmānyaṃ samarthaṃ sthitiṃ (p.286) karotu kim āśrayeṇa śāvaleyādinā sthitikaraṇāyāpekṣitena | na hy anupakārariṇyapekṣā yuktā | tasmād apekṣeti hi tatpratibandhaḥ | asmin vastunyasyāpekṣeti yeyam apekṣā sā tasminn apekṣye pratibandhas tadāyattatā | sa ca pratibandho nityatvād anādheyātiśayasyāyukta iti kevalaṃ sāmānyaṃ |
analyzed: tadā kevalam sāmānyam samartham sthitim karotu kim āśrayeṇa śāvaleya ādinā sthiti karaṇāya apekṣitena na hi anupakārariṇī apekṣā yuktā tasmāt apekṣā iti hi tad pratibandhaḥ asmin vastuni asya apekṣā iti yā iyam apekṣā sā tasmin apekṣye pratibandhaḥ tad āyatta tā sa ca pratibandhaḥ nitya tvāt anādheya atiśayasya ayuktaḥ iti kevalam sāmānyam

original: sthitiṃ janayed iti nāsty asya āśrayaḥ sthitihetuḥ | tataś ca sthitikaraṇād āśrayassāmānyasyādhāra ity etad ayuktam iti bhāvaḥ | evam bhedābhedavivecana iti yaduktan tato bhedapakṣas tāvad apanītaḥ |
analyzed: sthitim janayet iti na asti asya āśrayaḥ sthiti hetuḥ tatas ca sthiti karaṇāt āśrayaḥ sāmānyasya ādhāraḥ iti etat ayuktam iti bhāvaḥ evam bheda abheda vivecane iti tatas bheda pakṣaḥ tāvat apanītaḥ

original: dvitīyapakṣam āśrity āha – abheda ityādi | sāmānyād abhede vā sthiter abhyupagamyamāne svarūpam eva tatsthitirūpaṃ sāmānyasya (|) tac ca svarūpaṃ sāmānyasya nityam astīti na sthitir asya sāmānyasya kena cidāśrayeṇa kriyate | yata evaṃ tasmād ityādi | tadityādinopasaṃhāraḥ | taditi tasmād asyeti sāmānyasya |
analyzed: dvitīya pakṣam āśritya āha abhedaḥ ityādi sāmānyāt abhede vā sthiteḥ abhyupagamyamāne svarūpam eva tad sthiti rūpam sāmānyasya tat ca svarūpam sāmānyasya nityam asti iti na sthitiḥ asya sāmānyasya kena cit āśrayeṇa kriyate yatas evam tasmāt ityādi tat ityādinā upasaṃhāraḥ tat iti tasmāt asya iti sāmānyasya

original: tadevaṃ vṛttir ādheyatā vyaktir iti yatpakṣadvayam uktan tata ādyasya nirāsaḥ kṛtaḥ (|)
analyzed: tat evam vṛttiḥ ādheyatā vyaktiḥ iti yat pakṣa dvayam tatas ādyasya nirāsaḥ kṛtaḥ

original: 2--dvitīyapakṣam āśrity āha – atha punar ityādi | avyaktasyety aprakāśitasya | vyaktety āśrayeṇa jñānasyākāraṇatvāt tadvyaktes tenāśrayeṇa prakāśanaṃ yat | tadeva tatrāśraye sāmānyasya vṛttiḥ syāt | (|146-47||)
analyzed: dvitīya pakṣam āśritya āha atha punar ityādi avyaktasya iti aprakāśitasya vyaktā iti āśrayeṇa jñānasya akāraṇa tvāt tad vyakteḥ tena āśrayeṇa prakāśanam yat tat eva tatra āśraye sāmānyasya vṛttiḥ syāt

original: nety ācāryaḥ | ātmani svaviṣaye vijñānotpādanaṃ | tatra yogyatvaṃ sāmānyan tadartham anyānurodhi | kāraṇantarasāpekṣaṃ yat tad astu vyaṅgyaṃ pratītaṃ | tasyāś ca svaviṣayajñānajananayogyatāyāḥ kāraṇaṃ yatpradīpādi tadvyaṅgyasya kārakam eva janakam eva | pūrvam ayogyasya paścād vijñānajananayogyasya ghaṭāder utpādanāt |
analyzed: na iti ācāryaḥ ātmani sva viṣaye vijñāna utpādanam tatra yogya tvam sāmānyan tad artham anya anurodhi kāraṇa antara sāpekṣam yat tat astu vyaṅgyam pratītam tasyāḥ ca sva viṣaya jñāna janana yogya tāyāḥ kāraṇam yat pradīpa ādi tat vyaṅgyasya kārakam eva janakam eva pūrvam ayogyasya paścāt vijñāna janana yogyasya ghaṭa ādeḥ utpādanāt

original: yadi punaḥ pradīpādisannidhānāt prāg api ghaṭādi svākārajñānajananayogyan tadā prāg evāsya ca ghaṭāder yogyatve tadapekṣeti pradīpāpekṣā | sāmānyasya nityatvād avikāryasya (p.287) | taditi yathoktalakṣaṇaṃ vyaṅgyatvaṃ sāmānyavata ity āśrayāt sakāśāt kuto naivety arthaḥ | aparam iti svasantānād anyam bhāvam eva janayan vyañjaka ucyate |
analyzed: yadi punar pradīpa ādi sannidhānāt prāk api ghaṭa ādi sva ākāra jñāna janana yogyan tadā prāk eva asya ca ghaṭa ādeḥ yogya tve tad apekṣā iti pradīpa apekṣā sāmānyasya nitya tvāt avikāryasya tat iti yathā ukta lakṣaṇam vyaṅgya tvam sāmānyavataḥ iti āśrayāt sakāśāt kutas nā eva iti arthaḥ aparam iti sva santānāt anyam bhāvam eva janayan vyañjakaḥ ucyate

original: kim bhūtaṃ svaviṣayasya vijñānotpādanasamarthaṃ | sajātīyopādānāpekṣam iti svasantānasaṅgṛhītapūrvakṣaṇasāpekṣaṃ | yathāndhakārāvasthitaghaṭādikṣaṇasāpekṣam vijñānajananasamartham uttaraṃ ghaṭakṣaṇañ janayat prakāśakaḥ |
analyzed: kim bhūtam sva viṣayasya vijñāna utpādana samartham sajātīya upādāna apekṣam iti sva santāna saṅgṛhīta pūrva kṣaṇa sāpekṣam yathā andhakāra avasthita ghaṭa ādi kṣaṇa sāpekṣam vijñāna janana samartham uttaram ghaṭa kṣaṇan janayat prakāśakaḥ

original: nanu pradīpakāryatve ghaṭasya pradīpoyacayepi ghaṭasyopacayopi syād iti cet (|) na | upādānagatād vibhedāt kāryasya bhedo na sahakārigatāt | sahakārikāraṇaṃ ca pradīpādir vyaṅgyasya ghaṭasyeti kuto mahatvādiprasaṅgosya (|) yad vā 'bhivyaktāv api kriyamāṇāyāṃ tulyoyaṃ prasaṇga iti yat kiñ cid etat |
analyzed: nanu pradīpa kārya tve ghaṭasya ghaṭasya upacayaḥ api syāt iti ced na upādāna gatāt vibhedāt kāryasya bhedaḥ na sahakāri gatāt sahakāri kāraṇam ca pradīpa ādiḥ vyaṅgyasya ghaṭasya iti kutas mahat tva ādi prasaṅgaḥ usya yat vā abhivyaktau api kriyamāṇāyām tulyaḥ yam prasaṇgaḥ iti yat kiñ cit etat

original: na ca vyaṅgyakṣaṇasadṛśasya kṣaṇasya mṛtpiṇḍād utpattir api tu pradīpādeveti kutonyādṛśāt tādṛśasyotpattiḥ | anapekṣaṃ ceti | yathā sajātīyopādānāpekṣaṃ svaviṣayavijñānajananasamarthaṃ śabdaṃ janayann abhighātaḥ | na hy abhighātāt prāk chabdosti yena samānajātīyāpekṣaḥ śabdo bhavet | śbdopi hi vyaṅgyaḥ parair iṣyata ity evam uktaṃ |
analyzed: na ca vyaṅgya kṣaṇa sadṛśasya kṣaṇasya mṛd piṇḍāt utpattiḥ api tu pradīpāt eva iti kutas nyādṛśāt tādṛśasya utpattiḥ anapekṣam ca iti yathā sajātīya upādāna apekṣam sva viṣaya vijñāna janana samartham śabdam janayan abhighātaḥ na hi abhighātāt prāk śabdaḥ asti yena samāna jātīya apekṣaḥ śabdaḥ bhavet śbdaḥ api hi vyaṅgyaḥ paraiḥ iṣyate iti evam uktam

original: yadi tarhi kāraka eva vyañjakaḥ kas tarhi kārakavyañjakayor hetvor viśeṣa ity ata āha – paratretyādi | vyañjakādanyasmin kārakatvenābhimata ity arthaḥ | jñānajananaśaktir anākṣiptā janyasya | na hi svaviṣayavijñānajananasamartham eva kāryaṃ kārakeṇa bījādinā janyate |
analyzed: yadi tarhi kārakaḥ eva vyañjakaḥ kaḥ tarhi kāraka vyañjakayoḥ hetvoḥ viśeṣaḥ iti atas āha paratra ityādi vyañjakāt anyasmin kāraka tvena abhimataḥ iti arthaḥ jñāna janana śaktiḥ an ākṣiptā janyasya na hi sva viṣaya vijñāna janana samartham eva kāryam kārakeṇa bīja ādinā janyate

original: tato jananamātreṇa kārakatvaṃ svaviṣayavijñānajananasamarthakāryotpādanalakṣaṇena tu viśeṣeṇa vyaṅjakatvam iti | (147-48||)
analyzed: tatas janana mātreṇa kāraka tvam sva viṣaya vijñāna janana samartha kārya utpādana lakṣaṇena tu viśeṣeṇa vyaṅjaka tvam iti

original: yady api vyañjakād vyaṅgyo vijñānotpādanayogyatāṃ pratilabhate tathāpi na janyata iti ced āha – yadi hītyādi | yata iti vyañjakāt | sa cet vyaṅgyaḥ | tasyeti vyañjakasya sā yokyatā 'sya vyaṅgyasya vyañjakasannidhānāt prāg evāsti | yato (p.288) vyaṅgyasya svabhāvabhūtā sā | yathāvyaṅgyaḥ prāg evāsti tathā tatsvabhāvabhūtāpi yogyatā |
analyzed: yadi api vyañjakāt vyaṅgyaḥ vijñāna utpādana yogyatām pratilabhate tathā api na janyate iti ced āha yadi hi ityādi yatas iti vyañjakāt sa ced vyaṅgyaḥ tasya iti vyañjakasya sā vyaṅgyasya vyañjaka sannidhānāt prāk eva asti yatas vyaṅgyasya svabhāva bhūtā sā yathā vyaṅgyaḥ prāk eva asti tathā tad svabhāva bhūtā api yogyatā

original: tam apekṣata iti vyañjakaṃ | vyaṅgyād vyatiriktaiva yogyatā vyañjakena kriyata iti ced āha – paretyādi | asyām iti yogyatāyāṃ | saiva yogyatā | tata iti vyañjakāt sthitivatprasaṅgaḥ | yaduktam (|) anyā cet sthitis tām evāśrayaḥ karotītyādi tad ihāpi prasajyeta | tam iti vyaṅgyaṃ |
analyzed: tam apekṣate iti vyañjakam vyaṅgyāt vyatiriktā eva yogyatā vyañjakena kriyate iti ced āha para ityādi asyām iti yogyatāyām sā eva yogyatā tatas iti vyañjakāt sthiti vat prasaṅgaḥ yat uktam anyā ced sthitiḥ tām eva āśrayaḥ karoti ityādi tat iha api prasajyeta tam iti vyaṅgyam

original: nāpi vyaṅgyād anyat tatkaraṇe vyaṅgyasya na kiñ cid iti kṛtvā 'pekṣyata ity anenopakāritvam uktaṃ | akiṃ cit karatvena tatpratiṣedhas tato vyāhatam etat |
analyzed: nā api vyaṅgyāt anyat tad karaṇe vyaṅgyasya na kiñ cit iti kṛtvā pekṣyate iti anena upakāri tvam uktam a kim cit kara tvena tad pratiṣedhaḥ tatas vyāhatam etat

original: yaduktaṃ (|) janaka eva vyañjaka iti tasya tat tv ityādinā vyabhicāram āha – na hi dhūmogner janako 'tha ca kāryatvāt tasya vyañjakaḥ | ādiśabdād balājādiḥ salilasya (|) sattyam ityādinā pariharati | na tu dhūmaṃ liṅgam apekṣyāgnir ātmani svalakṣaṇe jñānaṃ janayati | kasmāt (|) tathābhūtasyānumeyatvenābhimatasyāgneḥ sākṣād ajanakatvāt |
analyzed: yat uktam janakaḥ eva vyañjakaḥ iti tasya tat tu ityādinā vyabhicāram āha na hi dhūma ugneḥ ca kārya tvāt tasya vyañjakaḥ ādi śabdāt balāja ādiḥ salilasya sattyam ityādinā pariharati na tu dhūmam liṅgam apekṣya agniḥ ātmani sva lakṣaṇe jñānam janayati kasmāt tathābhūtasya anumeya tvena abhimatasya agneḥ sākṣāt ajanaka tvāt

original: anyathāgnisvalakṣaṇākāratvāt pratyakṣāt pratibhāsāviśeṣaḥ syāt | kevalam ityādinopādānakāraṇam eva tasya sākṣāj janakam ity ādarśayati | liṅgajñānam upādānaṃ | na viṣayabalenāgnisvalakṣaṇabalena (|) kiṅ kāraṇam (|) asaty api tasmin vahnau pūrvadhvas tepi bhāvād agnijñānasya | katham ity āha – paramparayetyādi |
analyzed: anyathā agni sva lakṣaṇa ākāra tvāt pratyakṣāt pratibhāsa aviśeṣaḥ syāt kevalam ityādinā upādānakāraṇam eva tasya sākṣāt janakam iti ādarśayati liṅga jñānam upādānam na viṣaya balena agni sva lakṣaṇa balena kim kāraṇam asati api tasmin vahnau bhāvāt agni jñānasya katham iti āha paramparayā ityādi

original: liṅgānusārī liṅgānusmaraṇavikalpas tena | tathā hi kasya cit puruṣasya kva cid dhūmandṛṣṭavato dhvas te dhūme vahnau ca katham api tatra dhūmānusmaraṇavikalpa utpanne paścād anvayavyatirekānusmaraṇād abhūd atra dhūmas tasmād vahnir apy atrāsīd ityevaṃ paramparayāgnijanyadhūmād agnijñānam utpadyata eva |
analyzed: liṅga anusārī liṅga anusmaraṇa vikalpaḥ tena tathā hi kasya cid puruṣasya kva cit dhūman dṛṣṭavataḥ dhvaḥ te dhūme vahnau ca katham api tatra dhūma anusmaraṇa vikalpe utpanne paścāt anvaya vyatireka anusmaraṇāt abhūt atra dhūmaḥ tasmāt vahniḥ api atra āsīt iti evam paramparayā agni janya dhūmāt agni jñānam utpadyate eva

original: nāpītyādinā pūrvoktam atraiva yojayati | sāmānyākārāvabhāsi cānumānajñānaṃ | na sannihitaviṣayatā | vinaṣṭepi hi viṣaye anutpanne ca sambhavāt | yadāpi sannihito viṣayas tadāpi na viṣayabalenotpattir iti niveditaṃ prāk na hi vikalpā (p.289) yathābhāvam eva pravarttanta ityādinā |
analyzed: nā api ityādinā pūrva uktam atra eva yojayati sāmānya ākāra avabhāsi ca anumāna jñānam na sannihita viṣayatā vinaṣṭe api hi viṣaye anutpanne ca sambhavāt yadā api sannihitaḥ viṣayaḥ tadā api na viṣaya balena utpattiḥ iti niveditam prāk na hi vikalpāḥ yathābhāvam eva pravarttante ityādinā

original: bhāvābhāvānavidhānāc ca sāmarthyann pratibhāsād ityādinā tṛtīye paricchede   (   ) pratipādayiṣyate ca | sākṣād upayogena svarūpānukārivijñānajananasāmarthyena | tatreti svaviṣayajñānajanane | param iti pradīpādikaṃ | tata ity apekṣyāt pradīpadeḥ |
analyzed: bhāva abhāva an avidhānāt ca pratibhāsāt ityādinā tṛtīye paricchede pratipādayiṣyate ca sākṣāt upayogena svarūpa anukāri vijñāna janana sāmarthyena tatra iti sva viṣaya jñāna janane param iti pradīpa ādikam tatas iti apekṣyāt pradīpa deḥ

original: etad uktam bhavati | na sarvo vyañjako janaka ity ucyate (|) kin tu svākārajñānajanakasya parasya sāhāyyaṃ yaḥ pratipadyate sa eva | tato nāsti vyabhicāra iti | sāmānyam api svākārajñānajananāśrayam apekṣata iti vyaṅgyam iṣṭan tatas tenāśrayād upalambhayogya ātmā labdhavyaḥ (|) na cāyamātmapratilambhaḥ sāmānyasya kutaś cit sambhavati |
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati na sarvaḥ vyañjakaḥ janakaḥ iti ucyate kin tu sva ākāra jñāna janakasya parasya sāhāyyam yaḥ pratipadyate saḥ eva tatas na asti vyabhicāraḥ iti sāmānyam api sva ākāra jñāna janana āśrayam apekṣate iti vyaṅgyam tatas tena āśrayāt upalambha yogyaḥ ātmā labdhavyaḥ na ca ayam ātma pratilambhaḥ sāmānyasya kutas cit sambhavati

original: nityatvenābhyupagatatvāt | taditi sāmānyaṃ |
analyzed: nitya tvena abhyupagata tvāt tat iti sāmānyam

original: naivetyādi paraḥ | svāśrayasamavāyavyaktiṃ brūma iti sambandhaḥ | svāśrayasamavāyaḥ kathaṃ vyaktir iti ced āha – svāśrayetyādi | tad iti sāmānyaṃ | anyatreti svāśraye |
analyzed: na eva ityādi paraḥ sva āśraya samavāya vyaktim brūmaḥ iti sambandhaḥ sva āśraya samavāyaḥ katham vyaktiḥ iti ced āha sva āśraya ityādi tat iti sāmānyam anyatra iti sva āśraye

original: uktam ity ācāryaḥ | "tadevedam anupakārakasyāśrayatvaṃ ba sambhāvayāma" ityādinoktatvāt | svāśrayasamavetaṃ hi tadātmanyanyatra vā vijñānahetur iti brūvāṇena svāśrayasāvāyāpekṣaḥ sāmānyapadārthaḥ vijñānahetur iṣṭaḥ | tataś ca tena svāśrayasamavāyena sāmānyātmā janyasya syāt |
analyzed: uktam iti ācāryaḥ tat eva idam anupakārakasya āśraya tvam sambhāvayāmaḥ ityādinā ukta tvāt sva āśraya samavetam hi tat ātmani anyatra vā vijñāna hetuḥ iti brūvāṇena sva āśraya sāvāya apekṣaḥ sāmānya padārthaḥ vijñāna hetuḥ iṣṭaḥ tatas ca tena sva āśraya samavāyena sāmānya ātmā janyasya syāt

original: kiṅ kāraṇaṃ (|) taddhetor jñānahetoḥ svabhāvasya svāśrayasamavāyāt prāgbhāvāt | svāśrayasamavāye sati paścāc ca tataḥ svāśrayasamavāyād vijñānahetoḥ svabhāvasya bhāvāt | nityaṃ sāmānyasya vijñānajananasvabhāvatvād asiddham etad iti ced āha – nityam ityādi |
analyzed: kim kāraṇam tad hetoḥ jñāna hetoḥ svabhāvasya sva āśraya samavāyāt prāc bhāvāt sva āśraya samavāye sati paścāt ca tatas sva āśraya samavāyāt vijñāna hetoḥ svabhāvasya bhāvāt nityam sāmānyasya vijñāna janana svabhāva tvāt asiddham etat iti ced āha nityam ityādi

original: tatsvabhāvasadbhāva iti vijñānajananasvabhāve prāg api svāśrayasamavāyād vyaktiśūnyepi deśe kevalāt sāmānyād ity arthaḥ | sāmānyākāravijñānodayaprasaṅgāt | (|148-49||)
analyzed: tad svabhāva sadbhāve iti vijñāna janana svabhāve prāk api sva āśraya samavāyāt vyakti śūnye api deśe kevalāt sāmānyāt iti arthaḥ sāmānya ākāra vijñāna udaya prasaṅgāt

original: netyādiparaḥ | vyaktir āśrayaḥ sāmānyasya saṃskāro yogyatādhānan tasmād dhetor na (p.290) vyañjikā sāmānyasya | yena tayā janyaṃ syāt sāmānyaṃ | kin tarhi tadgrāhiṇa iti sāmānyagrāhiṇaḥ saṃskārād vyañjaketi prakṛtaṃ |
analyzed: na ityādi paraḥ vyaktiḥ āśrayaḥ sāmānyasya saṃskāraḥ tasmāt hetoḥ na vyañjikā sāmānyasya yena tayā janyam syāt sāmānyam kin tarhi tad grāhiṇaḥ iti sāmānya grāhiṇaḥ saṃskārāt vyañjakā iti prakṛtam

original: yopītyādy ācāryaḥ | añjanāder iveti vaidharmyadṛṣṭāntaḥ | añjanādeḥ sakāśād yathendriyasaṃskāro yukto naivaṃ vyakteḥ sakāśāt | kasmāt pratipatter jñānasya vyañjakatvenābhimatāyā vyakter bhāvābhāvakālayoḥ saptamīdvivacanam etat |
analyzed: yopī ityādi ācāryaḥ añjana ādeḥ iva iti vaidharmya dṛṣṭāntaḥ añjana ādeḥ sakāśāt yathā indriya saṃskāraḥ yuktaḥ na evam vyakteḥ sakāśāt kasmāt pratipatteḥ jñānasya vyañjaka tvena abhimatāyāḥ vyakteḥ bhāva abhāva kālayoḥ saptamī dvivacanam etat

original: saṃskṛtam ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | añjanādibhiḥ saṃskṛtam indriyaṃ kaṃ cid tiśayamātmabhūtamāsādayati | pratipattau pratipattinimittaṃ | viśiṣṭajñānotpādanāyeti yāvat | nimittāt karmasaṃyoga ity anenātra saptamī | kuta etad iti ced āha – spaṣṭetyādi | pratipatter iti vibhaktivipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ |
analyzed: saṃskṛtam ityādinā vyācaṣṭe añjana ādibhiḥ saṃskṛtam indriyam kam cid tiśayam ātma bhūtam āsādayati pratipattau pratipatti nimittam viśiṣṭa jñāna utpādanāya iti yāvat nimittāt karma saṃyogaḥ iti anena atra saptamī kutas etat iti ced āha spaṣṭa ityādi pratipatteḥ iti vibhakti vipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ

original: tathā hi timirādyupahatam indriyam aspaṣṭaṃ vijñānañ janayati | tadevāñjanādisaṃskṛtaṃ spaṣṭato 'vasīyate (|) saṃskṛtam indriyaṃ pratipattyartham atiśayamāsādayatīti |
analyzed: tathā hi timira ādi upahatam indriyam aspaṣṭam vijñānan janayati tat eva añjana ādi saṃskṛtam spaṣṭataḥ vasīyate saṃskṛtam indriyam pratipatti artham atiśayam āsādayati iti

original: athāñjanādeḥ sakāśān na pratipattibhedas tadā | tadakāriṇaś ca pratipattibhedākāriṇaś cāñjanāder atatsaṃskāra(ka)tvād indriyāsaṃskārakatvāt | yathāñjanādeḥ sakāśād indriyasya saṃskāro naivaṃ vyakteḥ sakāśāt (|) kiṅ kāraṇaṃ (|) tadbhāvābhāvakālayor ityādi |
analyzed: atha añjana ādeḥ sakāśāt na pratipatti bhedaḥ tadā tad akāriṇaḥ ca pratipatti bheda akāriṇaḥ ca añjana ādeḥ a tad saṃskāraka tvāt indriya a saṃskāraka tvāt yathā añjana ādeḥ sakāśāt indriyasya saṃskāraḥ na evam vyakteḥ sakāśāt kim kāraṇam tad bhāva abhāva kālayoḥ ityādi

original: tathā hi vyañjikāyā govyakter abhāvakāle yādṛśaṃ cakṣurvijñānaṃ vṛkṣādāv utpannan tasyā govyakteḥ (a)bhāvepi vṛkṣādau tādṛśam eva | yadi tadabhāvakāle pūrvam aspaṣṭaṃ vijñānaṃ vṛkṣādiṣūtpannaṃ paścād govyaktikṛta indrayasaṃskāro gamyeta |
analyzed: tathā hi vyañjikāyāḥ go vyakteḥ abhāva kāle yādṛśam cakṣuḥ vijñānam vṛkṣa ādau utpannan tasyāḥ go vyakteḥ abhāve pi vṛkṣa ādau tādṛśam eva yadi tad abhāva kāle pūrvam aspaṣṭam vijñānam vṛkṣa ādiṣu utpannam paścāt go vyakti kṛtaḥ indraya saṃskāraḥ gamyeta

original: viṣayasaṃskārepi sati viṣayāntare naiva pratipattibhedo 'sty ataḥ sopi na yukta iti ced āha – viṣayetyādi | viṣayasya gandhāder yaḥ kena cit saṃskārassa indriyāviśeṣepi | yadi nāmānyatra  viṣayāntare indriyasya pratipattiṃ prati viśeṣo nāsti | tathāpi tadviveṣādhānantasya saṃskṛtaviṣayagrāhakasya jñānasya viśeṣādhānād upakārī syāt |
analyzed: viṣaya saṃskāre api sati viṣaya antare nā eva pratipatti bhedaḥ sti atas saḥ api na yuktaḥ iti ced āha viṣaya ityādi viṣayasya gandha ādeḥ yaḥ kena cid saṃskāraḥ saḥ indriya aviśeṣe pi yadi nāma anyatra viṣaya antare indriyasya pratipattim prati viśeṣaḥ na asti tathā api tad viveṣa ādhānantasya saṃskṛta viṣaya grāhakasya jñānasya viśeṣa ādhānāt upakārī syāt

original: (p.291) nendriyasaṃskāra upakārī syād iti sambandhaḥ |
analyzed: na indriya saṃskāraḥ upakārī syāt iti sambandhaḥ

original: etad uktam bhavati | viṣayā hi viniyatās te svākārasyaiva vijñānasya sādhanaṃ nākārāntarayuktasya (|) tato viṣayasaṃskāraḥ pratiniyatatvāt svaviṣayam eva viśiṣṭāṃ pratipattiñ janayan na virudhyate | indriyaṃ tu svagrāhye viṣayabhede tulyaṃ sādhanamatas tatsaṃskāraḥ sarvasmiṃs tadgrāhye pratipatter bhedakaḥ prāpnotīti |
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati viṣayāḥ hi viniyatāḥ te sva ākārasya eva vijñānasya sādhanam na ākāra antara yuktasya tatas viṣaya saṃskāraḥ pratiniyata tvāt sva viṣayam eva viśiṣṭām pratipattim janayan na virudhyate indriyam tu sva grāhye viṣaya bhede tulyam sādhanam atas tad saṃskāraḥ sarvasmin tad grāhye pratipatteḥ bhedakaḥ prāpnoti iti

original: nendriyasya vyaktibhedas tadindriyagrāhye sarvasmin dṛśye viṣaye spaṣṭākārajñānajananāya saṃskāram ādhatte | kin tarhi vyaktyutpatteḥ prāg adṛśya sāmānye indriyasya darśanaśaktyādhānāt kāraṇād vyaktibheda upakārakaṃ iti cet | atondriyadarśanād eva ca spaṣṭam indriyasya saṃskāro gamyate |
analyzed: na indriyasya vyakti bhedaḥ tad indriya grāhye sarvasmin dṛśye viṣaye spaṣṭa ākāra jñāna jananāya saṃskāram ādhatte kin tarhi vyakti utpatteḥ prāk adṛśya sāmānye indriyasya darśana śakti ādhānāt kāraṇāt vyakti bhedaḥ upakārakam iti ced atas indriya darśanāt eva ca spaṣṭam indriyasya saṃskāraḥ gamyate

original: vyaktisannidhānāt pūrvam asamartham paścāt tatsannidhāne samartham iti sa vyaktibhedotīndriyaṃ sāmānyākhyam arthandarśayan kathaṃ pratipatteḥ sarvatra na bhedako bhedaka evety arthaḥ |
analyzed: vyakti sannidhānāt pūrvam asamartham paścāt tad sannidhāne samartham iti sa sāmānya ākhyam arthan darśayan katham pratipatteḥ sarvatra na bhedakaḥ bhedakaḥ eva iti arthaḥ

original: etad uktam bhavati | dṛśyepi tāvad aspaṣṭe spaṣṭākāradarśanaśaktyādhānād añjanādikṛtaḥ indriyasaṃskāraḥ sarvatra tadindriyagrāhye viṣaye pratipatter bhedako dṛṣṭaḥ (|) kiṃ punar yotīndriyasyārthasya darśakas tathā cānyasyāpy atīndriyasya paramāṇvāder darśakaḥ syād iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati dṛśye api tāvat aspaṣṭe spaṣṭa ākāra darśana śakti ādhānāt añjana ādi kṛtaḥ indriya saṃskāraḥ sarvatra tad indriya grāhye viṣaye pratipatteḥ bhedakaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ kim punar yaḥ utīndriyasya arthasya darśakaḥ tathā ca anyasya api atīndriyasya paramāṇu ādeḥ darśakaḥ syāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: sāmānyasyaiva darśanāyendriyasya saṃskāram ādhatte vyaktibhedaḥ tato nāsty atiprasaṇga iti ced āha – eketyādi | ekasmin sāmānye draṣṭavye indriyasaṃskārasya pratiniyamas tasminn abhyupagamyamāne tasminn eva vyaktibhede śāvaleyādikesamavetaṃ yatsāmānyāntaraṃ sattādravyatvādi | tasya darśaka indriyasaṃskāro na syāt | iṣyate ca |
analyzed: sāmānyasya eva darśanāya indriyasya saṃskāram ādhatte vyakti bhedaḥ tatas na asti atiprasaṇgaḥ iti ced āha eka ityādi ekasmin sāmānye draṣṭavye indriya saṃskārasya pratiniyamaḥ tasmin abhyupagamyamāne tasmin eva vyakti bhede śāvaleya ādike samavetam yat sāmānya antaram sattā dravya tva ādi tasya darśakaḥ indriya saṃskāraḥ na syāt iṣyate ca

original: ātmasamavetānām eva sarvasāmānyānān darśanāyendriyasaṃskāro naikasyaiveti ced āha – vyaktyā cetyādi | taddarśana iti teṣāṃ vyaktisamavetānāṃ sāmānyānān darśane | tadvyaṅgyeṣu tayā vyaktyā vyaṅgiyeṣu | dṛṣṭaṣ ca dūrād dravyamātradarśane dravyatvam arthatvayor niścayepi sati gotvādāv aniścayaḥ |
