original: tanniṣedhārtham āha – svabhāvo hītyādi | svabhāvāt tattvam evānyattvam eva vā na laṅghayatīti sambandhaḥ |
analyzed: tad niṣedha artham āha svabhāvaḥ hi ityādi svabhāvāt tattvam eva anyattvam eva vā na laṅghayati iti sambandhaḥ

original: nanu deśakālasvabhāvābhedepi sāmānyaviśeṣayor anugatavyāvṛttirūpābhyāṃ bhedopīṣyata ity ata āha – rūpasyānugatasya svabhāvasyātadbhūtasya vyavṛttarūpasvabhāvasyānyattvāvyatikramāt | vyāvṛttebhyo viśeṣarūpebhyo bhinnasyānugatarūpasya sāmānyasyānyattvam eva syād ity arthaḥ | asty atadrūpatvam anyattvam eva (|) katham ity ata āha – idam evetyādi |
analyzed: nanu deśa kāla svabhāva abhede api sāmānya viśeṣayoḥ anugata vyāvṛtti rūpābhyām bhedaḥ upi iṣyate iti atas āha rūpasya anugatasya svabhāvasya atadbhūtasya vyavṛtta rūpa svabhāvasya anyattva avyatikramāt vyāvṛttebhyaḥ viśeṣa rūpebhyaḥ bhinnasya anugata rūpasya sāmānyasya anyattvam eva syāt iti arthaḥ asti atadrūpatvam anyattvam eva katham iti atas āha idam eva ityādi

original: yan na tadity atadrūpam ity arthaḥ | etāvad evānyattvalakṣaṇam ity arthaḥ | ākārāntaravat | ṣaṣṭhyarthe vatiḥ | tathā hi sukhād duḥkhasyāpy anyattvam asukharūpaṃ duḥkham iti kṛtvā | iyatā cātadrūpasyānyattvalakṣaṇena vyāptir uktā | asya cānyattvalakṣaṇasyāviśeṣād abhimatepi sāmānye |
analyzed: yat na tat iti atadrūpam iti arthaḥ etāvat eva anyattva lakṣaṇam iti arthaḥ ākāra antara vat ṣaṣṭhī arthe vatiḥ tathā hi sukhāt duḥkhasya api anyattvam asukha rūpam duḥkham iti kṛtvā iyatā ca atadrūpasya anyattva lakṣaṇena vyāptiḥ uktā asya ca anyattva lakṣaṇasya aviśeṣāt abhimate api sāmānye

original: etena pakṣadharma uktaḥ | prayogas tu | yadvastutve satyatadrūpan tasya tatonyattvam eva tadyathā sukhād duḥkhasya | vastutve satyavyaktirūpaṃ ceṣyate sāmānyam ity atadrūpatvenānyattve vyavahārasya sādhyatvāt svabhāvahetuḥ | evaṃ tāvad atadrūpatve sāmānyasyānyattvam evāpāditam (|) athānyattvaṃ neṣyate tadā tattvaṃ prāpnotīty āha – tac cetyādi |
analyzed: etena pakṣa dharmaḥ uktaḥ prayogaḥ tu tasya tatonyatvam eva tat yathā sukhāt duḥkhasya vastu tve sati avyakti rūpam ca iṣyate sāmānyam iti a tad rūpa tvena anyat tve vyavahārasya sādhya tvāt svabhāva hetuḥ evam tāvat a tad rūpa tve sāmānyasya anyat tvam eva āpāditam atha anyat tvam na iṣyate tadā tattvam prāpnoti iti āha tat ca ityādi

original: vyākter anyat tadā tad eva vyaktirūpam eva tat sāmānyam bhavati | atattve ity avyaktirūpatve tastvantaravad anyattvaprasaṅgāt | etac cānantaram evoktaṃ |
analyzed: vyākteḥ anyat tadā tat eva vyakti rūpam eva tat sāmānyam bhavati atattve iti avyakti rūpa tve tastu antara vat anyattva prasaṅgāt etat ca anantaram evā uktam

original: astv anyattvaṃ sāmānyasya tathāpi vyaktyantaram anuyāsyatīty ata āha – na caiketyādi | ekavyaktisvabhāvasya vyaktyantarānvāveśonugamo vyaktyantarasvabhāvam iti yāvat | kasmāt tasyāvagamyamānasyāvyaktyantaratvaprasaṅgāt |
analyzed: astu anyattvam sāmānyasya tathā api vyakti antaram anuyāsyati iti atas āha na ca eka ityādi eka vyakti svabhāvasya vyakti antara anvāveśaḥ anugamaḥ vyakti antara svabhāvam iti yāvat kasmāt tasya avagamyamānasya avyakti antara tva prasaṅgāt

original: yadi śābaleyātmakaṃ sāmānyaṃ bāhuleyasyātmabhūtaṃ bhavet tadā bāhuleyaḥ śābaleya eva jātaḥ śābaleyātmakāt sāmānyād avyaktirekācchābaleyavad iti kutosya vyaktyantaratvaṃ | tata iti tasmād vyakter avyatirekiṇaḥ sāmānyāt sakāśād anvayinīty anugāminī | (p.297) nāpi vyatirekiṇaḥ sāmānyād anvayinī buddhir iti prakṛtaṃ |
analyzed: yadi śābaleya ātmakam sāmānyam bāhuleyasya ātma bhūtam bhavet tadā bāhuleyaḥ śābaleyaḥ eva jātaḥ śābaleya ātmakāt sāmānyāt avyaktiḥ ekāt śābaleya vat iti kutas asya vyakti antara tvam tatas iti tasmāt vyakteḥ a vyatirekiṇaḥ sāmānyāt sakāśāt anvayinī iti anugāminī nā api vyatirekiṇaḥ sāmānyāt anvayinī buddhiḥ iti prakṛtam

original: kasmāt (|) tasya vyatiriktasya sāmānyasya kvacid bhede 'nāśrayād apravṛtteḥ (|) sanbandham antareṇa pravṛttyayogāt | "vṛttir ādheyatā vyaktir iti tasmin na yujyata" ityādinā ca vyaṅgyavyañjakasyādhārādheyabhāvasya ca sambandhasya niṣiddhatvāt | anyas tarhi sāmānyatadvatoḥ sambandho bhaviṣyatīti ced āha – anyasyāpītyādi |
analyzed: kasmāt tasya vyatiriktasya sāmānyasya kvacid bhede na āśrayāt apravṛtteḥ sanbandham antareṇa pravṛtti ayogāt vṛttiḥ ādheyatā vyaktiḥ iti tasmin na yujyate ityādinā ca vyaṅgya vyañjakasya ādhāra ādheya bhāvasya ca sambandhasya niṣiddha tvāt anyaḥ tarhi sāmānya tadvatoḥ sambandhaḥ bhaviṣyati iti ced āha anyasya api ityādi

original: vyaṅgyavyañjakabhāvāder iti pañcamī | ādiśabdād ādhārādheyabhāvaparigrahaḥ | etasmāt pūrvaniṣiddhāt sanbandhadvayād anyasyāpi yasya kasyacit sambandhasya vyaktiṃ prati sāmānyasyābhāvāt | kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) nityatvāt kenacid vyaktibhedenānupakāryasya sāmānyasyāpratibandhena | na hy apratibandhasya kaścit sambandhostīty uktaṃ |
analyzed: vyaṅgya vyañjaka bhāva ādeḥ iti pañcamī ādi śabdāt ādhāra ādheya bhāva parigrahaḥ etasmāt pūrva niṣiddhāt sanbandha dvayāt anyasya api yasya kasyacid sambandhasya vyaktim prati sāmānyasya abhāvāt kiṅkāraṇam nitya tvāt kenacid vyakti bhedena anupakāryasya sāmānyasya apratibandhena na hi apratibandhasya kaścid sambandhaḥ usti iti uktam

original: etena cānyattve 'pāśrayād iti ślokabhāgo vyākhyātaḥ | (|152-53||)
analyzed: etena ca anyattve iti śloka bhāgaḥ vyākhyātaḥ

original: asatsambandham api sāmānyaṃ vyaktiṣu svarūpānukāriṇīṃ pratītiṃ janayatīti ced āha – sambandhād ityādi | nāsya sambandhostīti vigrahaḥ | sarvasmāt sarvatra pratītiḥ syād ity arthaḥ | tad iti tasmād ayam iti sāmānyavādī | ekasya sāmānyasya darśanena hetunā |
analyzed: asat sambandham api sāmānyam vyaktiṣu sva rūpa anukāriṇīm pratītim janayati iti ced āha sambandhāt ityādi na asya sambandhaḥ usti iti vigrahaḥ sarvasmāt sarvatra pratītiḥ syāt iti arthaḥ tat iti tasmāt ayam iti sāmānya vādī ekasya sāmānyasya darśanena hetunā

original: ekasmin śābaleye vyaktibhede vṛttir asya tasyānyatra vyaktyantare vṛttimanvicchin vastutveneṣṭasya sāmānyasya vyakteḥ sakāśād ye tattvānyattve | te nākramati vastuno gatyantarābhāvāt | cokto doṣa ity yuktam etadvastubhūtāt sāmānyād anuyāyijñānam iti |
analyzed: ekasmin śābaleye vyakti bhede vṛttiḥ asya tasya anyatra vyakti antare vṛttim anvicchin vastu tvena iṣṭasya sāmānyasya vyakteḥ sakāśāt ye tattva anyattve te na ākramati vastunaḥ gati antara abhāvāt ca uktaḥ doṣaḥ iti yuktam etat vastu bhūtāt sāmānyāt anuyāyi jñānam iti

original: yata evaṃ tasmādartheṣu parasparavivekiṣv iyam ekarūpaikākārā pratītir bhrāntir eva (|) bhinneṣv abhedādhyāropeṇa vṛtteḥ | kutas tarhi sotpannety āha – vikalpetyādi | vijātīyavyāvṛttapadārthānubhavena yā tathābhūtavikalpasya prakṛtyā janikā vāsanāhitā tataḥ samuthitāḥ | etac ca prāg evoktam ity āha – bhāvabheda ityādi |
analyzed: yatas evam tasmāt artheṣu paraspara vivekiṣu iyam eka rūpā eka ākārā pratītiḥ bhrāntiḥ eva bhinneṣu abheda adhyāropeṇa vṛtteḥ kutas tarhi sā utpannā iti āha vikalpa ityādi vijātīya vyāvṛtta padārtha anubhavena yā tathābhūta vikalpasya prakṛtyāḥ janikā vāsanā āhitā tatas samuthitāḥ etat ca prāk eva uktam iti āha bhāva bhedaḥ ityādi

original: bhāvānān tatkāryāṇām atatkāryebhyo bhedaḥ | tathābhūtānāṃ cānubhāvenāhitā yā vāsanā tasyāḥ prakṛtiś ca svabhāvaś cāsyā āśraya iti nirṇītam etat prāk tatra bhāvabhedaḥ pāramparyeṇa kāraṇaṃ (p.298) vāsanā prakṛtiḥ sākṣād iti dvayam upanyastaṃ | yady anyāpoha eva śabdavācyaḥ kathan tarhīdānīm ityādi |
analyzed: tad kāryāṇām a tad kāryebhyaḥ bhedaḥ tathābhūtānām ca anubhāvena āhitā yā vāsanā tasyāḥ prakṛtiḥ ca svabhāvaḥ ca asyāḥ āśrayaḥ iti nirṇītam etat prāk tatra bhāva bhedaḥ pāramparyeṇa kāraṇam vāsanā prakṛtiḥ sākṣāt iti dvayam upanyastam yadi anya apohaḥ eva śabda vācyaḥ kathan tarhi idānīm ityādi

original: pradhāneśvarādikāryaśabdā iti pradhānakāryamīśvarakāryañjagad iti | ādiśabdāc chabdabrahmapariṇāma ity ādiśabdānāṃ parigrahaḥ |
analyzed: pradhāna īśvara ādi kārya śabdāḥ iti pradhāna kāryam īśvara kāryan jagat iti ādi śabdāt śabda brahma pariṇāmaḥ iti ādi śabdānām parigrahaḥ

original: bhaveṣvādhyātmikabāhyeṣu | atadbhūto 'pradhānādikāryātmako bhedo yeṣānte tathoktāḥ | yady apy apradhānakāryāt teṣāṃ bhedaḥ syāt tadā bhavet pradhānādikāryātmako bhedaḥ (|) sa eva ca sarveṣām abhedaḥ | tenābhedenānimittena sarvatra varttante | sa ca nāsti bhāvānām anyāpohavādino matenāpradhānādikāryātmakatvāt |
analyzed: bhaveṣu ādhyātmika bāhyeṣu pradhāna ādi kārya ātmakaḥ bhedaḥ yeṣām te tathā uktāḥ yadi api apradhāna kāryāt teṣām bhedaḥ syāt tadā bhavet pradhāna ādi kārya ātmakaḥ bhedaḥ saḥ eva ca sarveṣām abhedaḥ tena abhedena animittena sarvatra varttante sa ca na asti bhāvānām anya apoha vādinaḥ matena apradhāna ādi kārya ātmaka tvāt

original: tataś ca katham evaṃbhūteṣv abhedena varttante | naivety abhiprāyaḥ | tataś cāvyāpinyapohavyavastheti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: tatas ca katham evaṃbhūteṣu abhedena varttante nā evā iti abhiprāyaḥ tatas ca avyāpinī apoha vyavasthā iti bhāvaḥ

original: tepītyādinā pariharati | tepi pradhānādikāryaśabdā vikalpavijñānapratibhāsinyarthe pravarttante iti sambandhaḥ | katham ity āha (|) saṃketetyādi | vastuny tathābhūte | icchāvaśād yaḥ saṃketaḥ pradhānakāryaṃ jagad iti |
analyzed: te pi ityādinā pariharati te api pradhāna ādi kārya śabdāḥ vikalpa vijñāna pratibhāsini arthe pravarttante iti sambandhaḥ katham iti āha saṃketa ityādi vastuni tathābhūte icchā vaśāt yaḥ saṃketaḥ pradhāna kāryam jagat iti

original: tenāhitā yā vāsanāśaktis tayottarottarakṣaṇavipariṇāmenopaskṛtatvād vijñānasantateḥ sarveṣāṃ bāhyādhyatmikānām arthānāṃ darśaneṣv anubhaveṣu satsv apy anapekṣya tadbhedam apradhānakāryād bhedam vastugataṃ |
analyzed: tena āhitā yā vāsanā śaktiḥ tayā uttara uttara kṣaṇa vipariṇāmena upaskṛta tvāt vijñāna santateḥ sarveṣām bāhya ādhyatmikānām arthānām darśaneṣu anubhaveṣu satsu api an apekṣya tad bhedam a pradhāna kāryāt bhedam vastugatam

original: yadi nāmārthānām apradhānakāryāṇām eva darśanam vastudharmeṇa tathāpi vastusvabhāvam anapekṣyety arthaḥ (|) tathādhyavasāyād yathāsaṃketam apradhānakāryān api bhāvān pradhānakāryatvenādhyavasānāt | atathābhūtakalpitapradhānakāryatvena kalpitaṃ caitanyaṃ sāṃkhyena tasya vyavacchedena pradhānakāryābhāvā iti yad vikalpavijñānan tapratibhāsiny arthe |
analyzed: yadi nāma arthānām apradhāna kāryāṇām eva darśanam vastu dharmeṇa tathā api vastu svabhāvam an apekṣya iti arthaḥ tathā adhyavasāyāt yathāsaṃketam apradhāna kāryān api bhāvān pradhāna kārya tvena adhyavasānāt atathābhūta kalpita pradhāna kārya tvena kalpitam caitanyam sāṃkhyena tasya vyavacchedena pradhāna kārya abhāvāḥ iti yat arthe

original: sa eva vijātīyavyavacchedenānyāpoha iti bhāvaḥ | kiṃ bhūtās te śabdā ity āha – upādānetyādi | vikalpahetor vāsanāyā dārḍhyam upādānabalan tasmāt prabhava utpādo yasya vikalpasya tasmāt samutthitāḥ
analyzed: saḥ eva vijātīya vyavacchedena anya apohaḥ iti bhāvaḥ kim bhūtāḥ te śabdāḥ iti āha upādāna ityādi vikalpa hetoḥ vāsanāyāḥ dārḍhyam tasmāt prabhavaḥ utpādaḥ yasya vikalpasya tasmāt samutthitāḥ

original: etad uktam bhavati | yadi nāma vastuni tathābhūtabhedābhāvas tathāpi vikalpāropita evānyāpohaḥ śabdānāṃ pravṛtter aṅgan tato nāsyāvyāpitādoṣa iti | pradhānādikāryaśabdānām abhedena pravṛttau teṣu bhāveṣu sāmānyam eva vastubhūtaṃ kin neṣyata iti ced āha – na hītyādi | teṣu pradhānakāryatvenādhyāropiteṣu |
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati yadi nāma vastuni tathābhūta bheda abhāvaḥ tathā api vikalpa āropitaḥ eva anya apohaḥ śabdānām pravṛtteḥ tatas na asya avyāpita adoṣaḥ iti pradhāna ādi kārya śabdānām abhedena pravṛttau teṣu bhāveṣu sāmānyam eva vastu bhūtam kim na iṣyate iti ced āha na hi ityādi teṣu pradhāna kārya tvena adhyāropiteṣu

original: atathābhūteṣu pradhānakāryeṣu vyaktyabhāvāt sāmānyasyābhāva iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: atathābhūteṣu pradhāna kāryeṣu vyakti abhāvāt sāmānyasya abhāvaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: (p.299) anyāpohavādinas tu na doṣa ity āha – tathetyādi | pradhānādikāryatvakalpanayety arthaḥ | tadanyasyāpradhānādikāryasya bhedo vyavacchedaḥ pradhānādikāryatvenāropitānām bhāvānāṃ pratipattṛṇāṃ adhyavasāyavaśāt syāt |
analyzed: anya apoha vādinaḥ tu na doṣaḥ iti āha tathā ityādi pradhāna ādi kārya tva kalpanayā iti arthaḥ tad anyasya apradhāna ādi kāryasya bhedaḥ vyavacchedaḥ pradhāna ādi kārya tvena āropitānām bhāvānām pratipattṛṇām adhyavasāya vaśāt syāt

original: tadadhyavasāyavaśād eva pratipattradhyavasāyavaśād eva śāvaleyādiṣv anuvṛttipratyayanimittaṃ sāmānyaṃ kin neti cet |
analyzed: tad adhyavasāya vaśāt eva pratipattṛ adhyavasāya vaśāt eva śāvaleya ādiṣu anuvṛtti pratyaya nimittam sāmānyam kim na iti ced

original: naitad asti | yasmāt tena sāmānyavādinā sāmānyaṃ kalpayatāpy avaśyaṃ tatra śābaleyādiṣu vijātīyād bhedo nāntarīyakatayeṣṭavyonyathā gotvāder asiddhiḥ syāt | sa eva bhedaḥ sāmānyakārye 'bhinnaśabdapravṛttyādilakṣaṇe paryāntaḥ śaktaḥ | ityevaṃ niṣprayojanā sāmānyakalpanā |
analyzed: na etat asti yasmāt tena sāmānyavādinā sāmānyam kalpayatā api avaśyam tatra śābaleya ādiṣu vijātīyāt bhedaḥ nāntarīyakatayā iṣṭavyaḥ anyathā go tva ādeḥ asiddhiḥ syāt saḥ eva bhedaḥ sāmānya kārye bhinna śabda pravṛtti ādi lakṣaṇe śaktaḥ iti evam niṣprayojanā sāmānya kalpanā

original: tad uktam bhavati | yathā pradhānakāryeṣv api bhāveṣu sāmānyam antareṇa pradhānādikāryaśabdas tadbuddhayaś caikākārāḥ pravarttante | tathā gavādiṣu gavādiśabdās tadbuddhayaś caikākārāḥ kin neṣyante kiṃ sāmānyena pāramārthikena kalpitena | dṛṣṭā ca parair api sāmānyam antareṇa bahuṣu sāmānyeṣv abhinnābhidhānapratyayavṛttiḥ |
analyzed: tat uktam bhavati yathā pradhāna kāryeṣu api bhāveṣu sāmānyam antareṇa pradhāna ādi kārya śabdaḥ tad buddhayaḥ ca eka ākārāḥ pravarttante tathā gavādiṣu gavādi śabdāḥ tad buddhayaḥ ca eka ākārāḥ kin na iṣyante kim sāmānyena pāramārthikena kalpitena dṛṣṭā ca paraiḥ api sāmānyam antareṇa bahuṣu sāmānyeṣu abhinna abhidhāna pratyaya vṛttiḥ

original: tad uktam bhaṭṭodyotakarābhyāṃ
analyzed: tat uktam bhaṭṭa udyota karābhyām

original: "tasmād ekasya bhinneṣu yā vṛttis tannibandhanaḥ |
analyzed: tasmāt ekasya bhinneṣu yā vṛttiḥ tad nibandhanaḥ

original: sāmānyaśabdaḥ sattādāv ekadhīkaraṇena veti |" śloka vā° ākṛ° 24
analyzed: sāmānya śabdaḥ sattā ādau eka dhīkaraṇena vā iti

original: tenāyam arthaḥ (|) yathā pratyekam anekārthasamavāyitvena sattvadravyatvādau sāmānyaśabdas tadbuddhiś ca sāmānyam antareṇa pravarttete (|) na cānekārthasamavāyitvaṃ sāmānyaṃ yad eva sattve tad eva dravyatvādav asti | niḥsāmānyāni sāmānyānīti vacanāt | na copacārāttayoḥ (śabdajñānayoḥ) vṛttiraskhaladbuddhigrāhyatvāt |
analyzed: tena ayam arthaḥ yathā pratyekam aneka artha samavāyi tvena sattva dravya tva ādau sāmānya śabdaḥ tad buddhiḥ ca sāmānyam antareṇa pravarttete na ca aneka artha samavāyi tvam sāmānyam yat eva sattve tat eva dravya tva ādau asti niḥsāmānyāni sāmānyāni iti vacanāt na ca upacārāt tayoḥ śabda jñānayoḥ vṛttiḥ askhalat buddhi grāhya tvāt

original: tasmād yathā sāmānyaṃ vinā tayoḥ sattādau vṛttis tathā śābaleyādiṣu sāmānyam antareṇa (|) yathā śābaleyo 'govyāvṛttas tathā bāhuleyo 'govyāvṛttas tathā khaṇḍo 'govyāvṛtta ity abhinnābhidhānapratyayavṛttiḥ kin neṣyata ity arthaḥ |
analyzed: tasmāt yathā sāmānyam vinā tayoḥ sattā ādau vṛttiḥ tathā śābaleya ādiṣu sāmānyam antareṇa yathā śābaleyaḥ go vyāvṛttaḥ tathā bāhuleyaḥ go vyāvṛttaḥ tathā khaṇḍaḥ go vyāvṛttaḥ iti abhinna abhidhāna pratyaya vṛttiḥ kin na iṣyate iti arthaḥ

original: syād etat (|) sarvatra sāmānyabuddhir nirviṣayeṣṭaiva kevalaṃ sāmānyam antareṇa kvacidasamvādo na syād ity ata āha – yadītyādi | yadiśabdobhyupagamadyotanārthaḥ | yady asyās sarvatra nirviṣayatvam abhyupagamyate | satsv iti vidyamāneṣu bhāveṣv agovyāvṛtteṣu | asatsv iti paramārthataḥ pradhāneśvarādikāryatayā 'vidyamāneṣu bhāveṣu |
analyzed: syāt etat sarvatra sāmānya buddhiḥ nirviṣayā iṣṭā eva kevalam sāmānyam antareṇa kvacid asamvādaḥ na syāt iti atas āha yadi ityādi yadi śabdaḥ abhyupagama dyotana arthaḥ yadi asyāḥ sarvatra nirviṣaya tvam abhyupagamyate satsu iti vidyamāneṣu bhāveṣu a go vyāvṛtteṣu asatsu iti paramārthataḥ pradhāna īśvara ādi kāryatayā vidyamāneṣu bhāveṣu

original: neyam (p.300) arthavatī sāmānyabuddhiḥ | tayā yathāropitasyābhinnākārasya bāhyeṣv abhāvabhā(?)vādataś cābhūtagrahād | viplavo bhrāntir eveti kṛtvā | nāsyās sāmānyabuddher nirviṣayāyā viṣayanirūpaṇaṃ prati kaścidādaraḥ | yadi sarvaiva sāmānyabuddhir bhrāntā kathan tarhy anumānād vastusamvāda ity āha – kvacid ityādi |
analyzed: na iyam arthavatī sāmānya buddhiḥ tayā yathā āropitasya abhinna ākārasya bāhyeṣu abhāva bhāvāt atas ca abhūta grahāt viplavaḥ bhrāntiḥ eva iti kṛtvā na asyāḥ sāmānya buddheḥ nirviṣayāyāḥ viṣaya nirūpaṇam prati kaścid ādaraḥ yadi sarvā eva sāmānya buddhiḥ bhrāntā kathan tarhi anumānāt vastu samvādaḥ iti āha kvacid ityādi

original: kvacid vastunyasya buddheḥ sakāśād avisamvādo yasm(ād) kāryakāraṇasambaddhād yathoktāt | etac ca niveditaṃ prāk | "yatrāsti vastusambandho yathoktānumitau yathe"tyādinā (1|83) | na tathābhūtasyābhinnarūpasyānumānagrāhyasya vastuni samāveśād vidyamānatvād anumānavikalpasya vastuvisamvādaḥ | pratyakṣavad iti | vaidharmyadṛṣṭāntaḥ |
analyzed: kvacid vastuni asya buddheḥ sakāśāt avisamvādaḥ yasmāt kārya kāraṇa sambaddhāt yathā uktāt etat ca niveditam prāk yatra asti vastu sambandhaḥ yathā ukta anumitau yathā ityādinā na tathābhūtasya abhinna rūpasya anumāna grāhyasya vastuni samāveśāt vidyamāna tvāt anumāna vikalpasya vastu visamvādaḥ pratyakṣa vat iti vaidharmya dṛṣṭāntaḥ

original: kiṅkāraṇam (|) atathābhāvepīti vyatītepi vastuni paramparayā liṅgānusāreṇa bhāvāt | yadvā 'tathābhāvepi sāmānyarahite 'pi vastuny abhinnākārāyā buddher bhāvāt | iti evaṃ | nivedayiṣyāmaḥ | niveditaṃ ca prāk | bhāvābhāvānuvidhānāt sāmarthyam ity antare (|)
analyzed: kiṅkāraṇam atathābhāve pi iti vyatīte api vastuni paramparayā liṅga anusāreṇa bhāvāt yat vā tathābhāve pi sāmānya rahite pi vastuni abhinna ākārāyāḥ buddheḥ bhāvāt iti evam nivedayiṣyāmaḥ niveditam ca prāk bhāva abhāva anuvidhānāt sāmarthyam iti antare

original: yadi sāmānyabuddhiḥ svākārābhedena bhinnāna bhāvānabhinnānadhyasya vidhirūpatayā pratipadyate katham asyā anyāpohaviṣayatvam uktam ity ata āha – bhedetyādi | asyāḥ sāmānyabuddher bhinnapadārthadarśanabaleneti vijātīyavyāvṛttasvalakṣaṇānubhavasāmarthyena | utpatter ity adhyāhāraḥ |
analyzed: yadi sāmānya buddhiḥ sva ākāra abhedena vidhi rūpatayā pratipadyate katham asyāḥ anya apoha viṣaya tvam uktam iti atas āha bheda ityādi asyāḥ sāmānya buddheḥ bhinna padārtha darśana balena iti vijātīya vyāvṛtta sva lakṣaṇa anubhava sāmarthyena utpatteḥ iti adhyāhāraḥ

original: bahulagrahaṇam vastvabhāvepi śaśaviṣāṇādau vikalpabuddheḥ pravṛttikhyāpanārthaṃ | teṣu bhinneṣu svalakṣaṇeṣu bhāvādhyavasāyāt svākārābhedena svarūpādhyavasāyāt | dṛśyavikalpayor ekīkṛtya pravṛtter ity arthaḥ |
analyzed: bahula grahaṇam vastu abhāve api śaśaviṣāṇa ādau vikalpa buddheḥ pravṛtti khyāpana artham teṣu bhinneṣu sva lakṣaṇeṣu bhāva adhyavasāyāt sva ākāra abhedena svarūpa adhyavasāyāt dṛśya vikalpayoḥ ekīkṛtya pravṛtteḥ iti arthaḥ

original: yasmād bhinnavastudarśanabalenotpadyate buddhir utpannā ca tāny eva bhinnavastūni svākārābhedena pratipadyate (|) tasmād bhedaviṣayatvam bhinnaviṣayatvam ity arthaḥ | yuktantāvadvastudarśanadvārāyāteṣv anityādivikalpeṣu vastudarśanabalotpatter bhedaviṣayatvaṃ | yatra tu na tathābhūtam bhinnam vastu | yathā nityādivikalpeṣu |
analyzed: yasmāt bhinna vastu darśana balena utpadyate buddhiḥ utpannā ca tāni eva bhinna vastūni sva ākāra abhedena pratipadyate tasmāt bheda viṣaya tvam bhinna viṣaya tvam iti arthaḥ yuktam tāvat vastu darśana dvārā āyāteṣu anitya ādi vikalpeṣu vastu darśana bala utpatteḥ bheda viṣaya tvam yatra tu na tathābhūtam bhinnam vastu yathā nitya ādi vikalpeṣu

original: śaśaviṣāṇādivikalpeṣu ca (|) tatra katham bhedaviṣayatvaṃ teṣām iti ced āha – tathā bhāvetyādi | yathaiva bhinnavastusvabhāvagrāhyānubhavabalenotpannā anityādibuddhayaḥ svapratibhāse bhinnabhāvādhyavasāyena pravarttamānā bhedaviṣayāḥ |
analyzed: śaśaviṣāṇa ādi vikalpeṣu ca tatra katham bheda viṣaya tvam teṣām iti ced āha tathā bhāva ityādi yathā eva bhinna vastu svabhāva grāhya anubhava balena utpannāḥ anitya ādi buddhayaḥ sva pratibhāse bhinna bhāva adhyavasāyena pravarttamānāḥ bheda viṣayāḥ

original: evaṃ tathā bhāvakalpanāyām eva svapratibhāsa eva bhinnabāhyabhāvādhyavasāyakalpanāyāṃ satyāṃ bhinnaviṣayatve satyaparatreti avidyamāneṣu nityapradhānakāryādiṣu śaśaviṣāṇādiṣu ca (p.301) nityapradhānādikāryaśaśaviṣāṇādivikalpānām bhedaviṣayatvasya bhāvāt | svāśrayamātragatavyaktibheda eva sthitaṃ | na tu vyaktiśūnye deśe | tad uktaṃ bhaṭṭena |
analyzed: evam tathā bhāva kalpanāyām eva sva pratibhāse eva bhinna bāhya bhāva adhyavasāya kalpanāyām satyām bhinna viṣaya tve satya paratra iti avidyamāneṣu nitya pradhāna kārya ādiṣu śaśaviṣāṇa ādiṣu ca nitya pradhāna ādi kārya śaśaviṣāṇa ādi vikalpānām bheda viṣaya tvasya bhāvāt sva āśraya mātra gata vyakti bhede eva sthitam na tu vyakti śūnye deśe tat uktam bhaṭṭena

original: udyotakaropy āha –2* "kena sarvagatatvaṃ jāter abhyupagamyate yena (mṛtpiṇḍe) mṛdgavake gotvaṃ syād api tu svaviṣaye sarvatra vṛttir varttata iti sarvagatety ucyate | kaḥ punar gotvasya svo viṣayaḥ | yatra gotvam bhavati | kva punar gotvam varttate | yatra gotvanimittonuvṛttipratyayo bhavati |
analyzed: āha kena sarvagata tvam jāteḥ abhyupagamyate yena mṛd piṇḍe go tvam syāt api tu sva viṣaye sarvatra vṛttiḥ varttate iti sarvagatā iti ucyate kaḥ punar go tvasya svaḥ viṣayaḥ yatra go tvam bhavati kva punar go tvam varttate yatra go tva nimittaḥ anuvṛtti pratyayaḥ bhavati

original: kva punar anuvṛttipratyayaṃ gotvaṃ karoti (|) yat tasya sādhanaṃ | kaḥ punar nitye gotve gossādhanārthaḥ | yat tena vyajyate | na hi kakudād idam arthavyatirekeṇa gotvasya vyaktir iti | na piṇḍebhyorthāntaraṃ gotvam piṇḍāntarāleṣv agrahaṇād iti bauddo bruvāṇaḥ piṇḍāntarālamparyanuyojyaḥ | kim idam paṇḍāntarālaṃ |
analyzed: kva punar anuvṛtti pratyayam go tvam karoti yat tasya sādhanam kaḥ punar nitye go tve goḥ sādhana arthaḥ yat tena vyajyate na hi kakudāt idam artha vyatirekeṇa go tvasya vyaktiḥ iti na piṇḍebhyaḥ artha antaram go tvam piṇḍa antarāleṣu agrahaṇāt iti bauddaḥ bruvāṇaḥ piṇḍa antarālam paryanuyojyaḥ kim idam paṇḍa antarālam

original: kimākāśamāhosvidabhāva uta dravyāntaram iti | yady ākāśaṃ na tatra gotvaṃ na hy ākāśaṃ gaur iti pratīyate | etenābhāve dravyāntaraṃ ca vyākhyātaṃ |
analyzed: kim ākāśam āhosvit abhāvaḥ uta dravya antaram iti yadi ākāśam na tatra go tvam na hi ākāśam gauḥ iti pratīyate etena abhāve dravya antaram ca vyākhyātam

original: tatra tayoḥ pakṣayor madhye yadi svāśrayamātragataṃ apūrvaghaṭādyutpattau ghaṭatvādiśūnye pradeśe paścādutpannād ghaṭāder bhinnadeśaṃ yad dravyan tadvarttinaḥ sāmānyasya | kathan teṣu paścādutpanneṣu ghaṭādiṣu sambhavo naivety abhiprāyaḥ | bhavet sambhavo yadi tasmāt pūrvadravyāt tatsāmānyam paścādutpadyamānan dravyaṃ yāti |
analyzed: tatra tayoḥ pakṣayoḥ madhye yadi sva āśraya mātra gatam apūrva ghaṭa ādi utpattau ghaṭa tva ādi śūnye pradeśe paścāt utpannāt ghaṭa ādeḥ bhinna deśam yat tad varttinaḥ sāmānyasya kathan teṣu paścāt utpanneṣu ghaṭa ādiṣu sambhavaḥ na eva iti abhiprāyaḥ bhavet sambhavaḥ yadi tasmāt pūrva dravyāt tat sāmānyam paścāt utpadyamānan dravyam yāti

original: tac ca nāstīty āha – yasmād ityādi | tad iti sāmānyaṃ pūrvadravyād iti yatra tatpūrvaṃ samavetaṃ tasmād utpitsu dravyam utpattum icchu pūrvaṃ ghaṭādikaṃ na yāti | amūrttatvena niṣkriyatvāt sāmānyasya (|) pūrvadravyādacalatopi bhinnadeśena yogo bhaviṣyati vimbasyādarśa iveti ced āha – na hītyādi |
analyzed: tat ca na asti iti āha yasmāt ityādi tat iti sāmānyam pūrva dravyāt iti yatra tat pūrvam samavetam tasmāt utpitsu dravyam utpattum icchu pūrvam ghaṭa ādikam na yāti amūrtta tvena niṣkriya tvāt sāmānyasya pūrva dravyāt acalataḥ api bhinna deśena yogaḥ bhaviṣyati vimbasya ādarśaḥ iva iti ced āha na hi ityādi

original: anyadravyavṛtter ity utpitsudravyād bhinnadeśadravyavṛtter bhāvasya sāmānyākhyasya tataḥ pūrvakādāśrayādacalatas tadubhayāntarālāvyāpinaḥ pūrvapaścādutpannadvayāntarālāvyāpinaḥ svāśrayād bhinnadeśena dravyeṇa yogo na hi yukta iti sambandhaḥ | bimbasya tu bhinnadeśe nādarśena yogostīti bruvāṇaḥ kathan nonmataḥ syāt |
analyzed: anya dravya vṛtteḥ iti utpitsu dravyāt bhinna deśa dravya vṛtteḥ bhāvasya sāmānya ākhyasya tatas pūrvakāt āśrayāt acalataḥ tad ubhaya antarāla avyāpinaḥ pūrva paścāt utpanna dvaya antarāla avyāpinaḥ sva āśrayāt bhinna deśena dravyeṇa yogaḥ na hi yuktaḥ iti sambandhaḥ bimbasya tu bhinna deśe na ādarśena yogaḥ asti iti bruvāṇaḥ katham na unmataḥ syāt

original: yepi tatra bhāvāntarotpattim icchanti (|) teṣām api na bimbena yogostīti yatkiñcid etat | utpitsudravyāt prāk sāmānyātmā na ca tatrotpitsudeśe āsīt | vyaktiśūnye deśe tasya tathānānabhyupagamāt | asti paścāt tatsāmānyaṃ (p.303) vyaktāv utpannāyāṃ | sāmānyaśūnyāyā vyakter anabhyupagamāt | na ca tatra deśe vyaktyā sahotpannaṃ nityatvāt |

analyzed: jahāti pūrvat na ādhāram iti etat pūrva ityādinā vyācaṣṭe sa ca iti pūrva ādhāra tyāgaḥ sāmānyasya na abhimataḥ

original: anyatreti pūrvavyaktau varttamānasya sāmānyasya svasmāt pūrvādhāradeśād acalatas tataḥ pūrvādhāradeśād anyatra sthāne janma yasya dravyasya tasmin vṛttir ity atiyuktim ity upahasati (156)
analyzed: anyatra iti pūrva vyaktau varttamānasya sāmānyasya svasmāt pūrva ādhāra deśāt acalataḥ tatas pūrva ādhāra deśāt anyatra sthāne janma yasya dravyasya tasmin vṛttiḥ iti ati yuktim iti upahasati

original: (p.307) pūrvavyaktideśād avicalad api sāmānyan tatonyadeśan dravyaṃ vyāpnotīti ced āha – yatretyādi | yatra deśe 'sau paścātkālabhāvī bhāvo varttate | tena deśena sāmānyaṃ na sambandhyate svavyaktisarvagatatvābhyupagamāt |
analyzed: pūrva vyakti deśāt avicalat api dravyam vyāpnoti iti ced āha yatra ityādi yatra deśe paścātkālabhāvī bhāvaḥ varttate tena deśena sāmānyam na sambandhyate sva vyakti sarvagata tva abhyupagamāt

original: yatra deśe sāmānyaṃ na varttate taddeśinaṃ ca paścāt kālabhāvinam bhāvaṃ vyāpnotīti nyāyātikrāntatvāt kim apy etan mahādbhutam iti prakārāntareṇopahasati | na hi yo yatra deśe na varttate sa taddeśaṃ vyāpnotīti nyāyānusāriṇā śakyam avasātuṃ (157)
analyzed: yatra deśe sāmānyam na varttate tad deśinam ca paścāt kāla bhāvinam bhāvam vyāpnoti iti nyāya atikrānta tvāt kim api etat mahā adbhutam iti prakāra antareṇa upahasati na hi yaḥ yatra deśe na varttate sa tad deśam vyāpnoti iti nyāya anusāriṇā śakyam avasātum

original: sarvagatatvakalpanām api nirācikīrṣann āha – yasyetyādi | tasyāpi sarvagatasāmānyavādinaḥ sarvatragā yadi jātis tadaikatra śāvaleyādau yā tasyāvyaktir abhivyaktis tayā karaṇabhūtayā | sā jātis sarvatra vyaktiśūnyepi deśe | vijātīyavyaktibhede ca vyaktaiva prakāsitaivābhedād ekatvāt sarvatra vyaktiśūnyepi deśe dṛśyeta |
analyzed: sarvagata tva kalpanām api nirācikīrṣan āha yasya ityādi tasya api sarvagata sāmānya vādinaḥ sarvatragā yadi jātiḥ tadā ekatra śāvaleya ādau yā tasya avyaktiḥ abhivyaktiḥ tayā karaṇa bhūtayā sā jātiḥ sarvatra vyakti śūnye api deśe vijātīya vyakti bhede ca vyaktā eva prakāsitā eva abhedāt ekatvāt sarvatra vyakti śūnye api deśe dṛśyeta

original: etad uktam bhavati | yady api vyaktiśūnye pradeśe vijātīyavyaktau ca svavyakter vyañjakāyā abhāvas tathāpi svavyaktyabhivyaktenaiva rūpeṇa tatrāvasthānāj jāter upalambhaḥ syān no cet svabhāvanānātvaṃ prāpnotīty ekarūpā ceṣyata iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati yadi api vyakti śūnye pradeśe vijātīya vyaktau ca sva vyakteḥ vyañjakāyāḥ abhāvaḥ tathā api sva vyakti abhivyaktena eva rūpeṇa tatra avasthānāt jāteḥ upalambhaḥ syāt no ced svabhāva nānātvam prāpnoti iti eka rūpā ca iṣyate iti bhāvaḥ

original: na jāter nityāyā anādheyātiśatvena kadācidabhivyaktir iti niṣiddham etat |" vṛttirādheyatā vyaktir iti tasmin na yujyata" (1|146) ity atrāntare | yata evaṃ tasmāt sā jātir nityam anapekṣitaparopaskārānādheyātiśayā | evambhūtā yadi svabhāvena svavijñānajananayogyā | tadā nityan dṛśyeta vyakteḥ prāk paścāc ca | atha na yogyā tadā kadācid daśyeta |
analyzed: na jāteḥ nityāyāḥ anādheya atiśa tvena kadācid abhivyaktiḥ iti niṣiddham etat vṛttiḥ ādheya tā vyaktiḥ iti tasmin na yujyate iti atra antare yatas evam tasmāt sā jātiḥ nityam an apekṣita para upaskāra anādheya atiśayā evambhūtā yadi svabhāvena sva vijñāna janana yogyā tadā dṛśyeta vyakteḥ prāk paścāt ca atha na yogyā tadā kadācid daśyeta

original: kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tasmin vijñānajananayogyasvabhāve tadviparīte cāvasthānāt | sarvakālam ekarūpatvād ity arthaḥ | asamarthā vyaktyasannidhāne tatsannidhāne tu samarthā bhavati | (p.308) tato na nityan darśanam adarśanam vā jāter ity ata āha – svabhāve ityādi | nityatvenānādheyātiśayatvād iti bhāvaḥ || (157-58)
analyzed: kim kāraṇam tasmin vijñāna janana yogya svabhāve tad viparīte ca avasthānāt sarvakālam eka rūpa tvāt iti arthaḥ asamarthā vyakti asannidhāne tad sannidhāne tu samarthā bhavati tatas na darśanam adarśanam vā jāteḥ iti atas āha svabhāve ityādi nitya tvena anādheya atiśaya tvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: yadi jāter nāsti vyaktis tat kiṃ vyaktyaivaikatra sā vyaktetyādy ucyata ity ata āha – abhyupagamyāpītyādi | vyāpinyāpi jātiḥ | ekatrāśraye vyaktā bhedābhāvād ekatvāj jāter vyaktaiva prakāśitaiva sarvatra vyaktiśūnye deśe | vijātīye ca vyaktibhede | vyaktiśūnyeṣv apīty api śabdād vijātīyepi vyaktibhede | api ca na ca sā jātir vyaktyapekṣiṇī |
analyzed: yadi jāteḥ na asti vyaktiḥ tat kim vyaktyā eva ekatra sā vyaktā ityādi ucyate iti atas āha abhyupagamya api ityādi vyāpinyā api jātiḥ ekatra āśraye vyaktā bheda abhāvāt ekatvāt jāteḥ vyaktā eva prakāśitā eva sarvatra vyakti śūnye deśe vijātīye ca vyakti bhede vyakti śūnyeṣu api iti api śabdāt vijātīye api vyakti bhede api ca na ca sā jātiḥ vyakti apekṣiṇī

original: vyañjakā vyaktir nnāpekṣyeta | vyakter jātivyañjakatvābhāvād iti bhāvaḥ | yadi hi vyañjikāṃ vyaktim apekṣeta | tadā vyañjakāpratipattau na vyaṅgyasya pratītiḥ syān na hi pradīpādyapratītau ghaṭādeḥ pratītir bhavati | tathehāpi vyaktyapratītau na jātipratītiḥ syāt | sāmānyatadvatos tu vyaṅgyavyañjakayor viparyayaḥ punaḥ kasmād iṣṭaḥ |
analyzed: vyañjakā vyaktiḥ vyakteḥ jāti vyañjaka tva abhāvāt iti bhāvaḥ yadi hi vyañjikām vyaktim apekṣeta tadā vyañjaka apratipattau na vyaṅgyasya pratītiḥ syāt na hi pradīpa ādi apratītau ghaṭa ādeḥ pratītiḥ bhavati tathā iha api vyakti apratītau na jāti pratītiḥ syāt sāmānya tadvatoḥ tu vyaṅgya vyañjakayoḥ viparyayaḥ punar kasmāt iṣṭaḥ

original: tathā hi nāgṛhītaviśeṣaṇāviśeṣye buddhir varttata iti niyamāt | prāg eva sāmānyagrahaṇam iṣṭan taddvāreṇa tu vyakteḥ | tato vyañjikāyā vyakter grahaṇam antareṇāpi vyaṅgyābhimatasya sāmānyasya pratipattir iṣṭeti viparyayaḥ |
analyzed: tathā hi na agṛhīta viśeṣaṇa aviśeṣye buddhiḥ varttate iti niyamāt prāk eva sāmānya grahaṇam tad dvāreṇa tu vyakteḥ tatas vyañjikāyāḥ vyakteḥ grahaṇam antareṇa api vyaṅgya abhimatasya sāmānyasya pratipattiḥ iṣṭā iti viparyayaḥ

original: yo hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | svāśrayo yatra samavetaṃ sāmānyaṃ | sāmānyagrāhakam indriyaṃ ca tayos saṃyogas tadapekṣā pratītir yasya sāmānyasya tatthoktaṃ | āśrayaśūnyāḥ pradeśā vijātīyavyaktyadhyāsitā vyaktiśūnyāś ca | teṣu na dṛśyate | yathoktasaṃyogābhāvāt | tasyāpy evaṃ vādinaḥ |
analyzed: yaḥ hi ityādinā vyācaṣṭe svāśrayaḥ yatra samavetam sāmānyam sāmānya grāhakam indriyam ca tayoḥ saṃyogaḥ tad apekṣā pratītiḥ yasya sāmānyasya āśraya śūnyāḥ pradeśāḥ vijātīya vyakti adhyāsitāḥ vyakti śūnyāḥ ca teṣu na dṛśyate yathā ukta saṃyoga abhāvāt tasya api evam vādinaḥ

original: kvacid vyaktir darśane saty asty evāśrayendriyasaṃyogo jāteḥ sarvatra sthitāyā upakāraka iti | tata āśrayendriyasaṃyogād dhetos taddarśī kvacid vyaktibhede jātidarśī yathāsthitāṃ sarvadeśavyāpinīñ jātim paśyeta | yatraiva vyañjikā vyaktis tatraiva jāteḥ svarūpaṃ dṛśyaṃ nānyatreti ced āha – na hītyādi | tasyām iti jātau |
analyzed: kvacid vyaktiḥ darśane satī asti eva āśraya indriya saṃyogaḥ jāteḥ sarvatra sthitāyāḥ upakārakaḥ iti tatas āśraya indriya saṃyogāt hetoḥ tad darśī kvacid vyakti bhede jāti darśī yathāsthitām sarva deśa vyāpinīm jātim paśyeta yatra eva vyañjikā vyaktiḥ tatra eva jāteḥ sva rūpam dṛśyam na anyatra iti ced āha na hi ityādi tasyām iti jātau

original: kvacid vyaktau dṛśyamānāyāntadīyām iti sāmānyasambandhi | ekasya dṛṣṭādṛṣṭavirodhāt | evaṃ tāvad vyakter vyañjikātvam abhyupagamya ca śabdopāttortho vyākhyātaḥ |
analyzed: kvacid vyaktau dṛśyamānāyām antadīyām iti sāmānya sambandhi ekasya dṛṣṭa adṛṣṭa virodhāt evam tāvat vyakteḥ vyañjikā tvam abhyupagamya ca śabda upātta ūrthaḥ vyākhyātaḥ

original: (p.309) adhunā na sā vyaktyapekṣiṇītyādi vyākhyātum āha – vyaktivyaṅgyatvād ityādi | tasya ca mithyātvam anantaroktenaiva pratipāditaṃ | na hy ekasya dṭṣṭādṛṣṭam asty ato 'pūrvapakṣa evāyaṃ kevalan doṣāntarābhidhānārthaṃ gajanimīlanaṃ kṛtvopanyastaṃ | tathābhūtasyeti nyāyyasya | tatreti jātitadvati | nyāyyasya vyaṅgyavyañjakabhāvasyābhāvāt |
analyzed: adhunā na sā vyakti apekṣiṇī ityādi vyākhyātum āha vyakti vyaṅgya tvāt ityādi tasya ca mithyātvam anantara uktena eva pratipāditam na hi ekasya dṛṣṭa adṛṣṭam asti pūrvapakṣaḥ eva ayam doṣa antara abhidhāna artham gaja nimīlanam kṛtvā upanyastam tathābhūtasya iti nyāyyasya tatra iti jāti tadvati nyāyyasya vyaṅgya vyañjaka bhāvasya abhāvāt

original: kiṅkāraṇaṃ | svetyādi | hi yasmāt | svarūpaśūnye deśe pradīpādir ahito deśe | svavyaṅgyaṃ ghaṭādikaṃ | naivaṃ yathoktena nyāyena vyaktir vyañjikā sāmānyasya | kiṅkāraṇam (|) viparyayāt | yasmād agṛhītvāpi vyaktiṃ sāmānyam ādau gṛhyata itīṣyate pareṇa |
analyzed: kiṅkāraṇam sva ityādi hi yasmāt svarūpa śūnye deśe pradīpa ādiḥ ahitaḥ deśe sva vyaṅgyam ghaṭa ādikam na evam yathā uktena nyāyena vyaktiḥ vyañjikā sāmānyasya kiṅkāraṇam viparyayāt yasmāt a gṛhītvā api vyaktim sāmānyam ādau gṛhyate iti iṣyate pareṇa

original: sāmānyagrahaṇadvāreṇaiva vyakter grahaṇābhyupagamād ataś ca vyañjakāpratipattyāpi vyaṅgyasya grahaṇāt | vyañjakadharmātikramo vyakteḥ |
analyzed: sāmānya grahaṇa dvāreṇa eva vyakteḥ grahaṇa abhyupagamāt atas ca vyañjaka apratipattyā api vyaṅgyasya grahaṇāt vyañjaka dharma atikramaḥ vyakteḥ

original: tad evāha – kathaṃ hītyādi | seti vyaktiḥ sāmānyasya vyañjikā ca syād iti sambandhaḥ | tatpratipattidvāreṇeti sāmānyadarśanabalena | vyakter darśanebhyupagamyamāne | vyaṅgyā sā vyaktiḥ prasajyate sāmānyañ cety adhyāhāraḥ | pradīpena ghaṭavad iti | tṛtīyeti yogavibhāgāt samāsaḥ | supsupeti vā samāsaḥ |
analyzed: tat eva āha katham hi ityādi sā iti vyaktiḥ sāmānyasya vyañjikā ca syāt iti sambandhaḥ tad pratipatti dvāreṇa iti sāmānya darśana balena vyakteḥ darśane abhyupagamyamāne vyaṅgyā sā vyaktiḥ prasajyate sāmānyam ca iti adhyāhāraḥ pradīpena ghaṭa vat iti tṛtīyā iti yogavibhāgāt samāsaḥ vā samāsaḥ

original: yathā pradīpena ghaṭo vyaṅgyas tadvat sāmānyena vyaktir vyaṅgyā prāpterthaḥ | tatpratipattim antareṇa sāmānyapratipattim vinā vyakter adṛśyarūpatvāt | anye tv āhuḥ | vyaṅgyā ca saivaṃ prasajyata ity atra caśabdena sāmānyavyañjakam ity etad upāttaṃ | tataḥ pradīpaghaṭābhyāṃ tulyam iti dvandvād eva vatir draṣṭavyaḥ |
analyzed: yathā pradīpena ghaṭaḥ vyaṅgyaḥ tadvat sāmānyena vyaktiḥ vyaṅgyā prāpti īrthaḥ tad pratipattim antareṇa sāmānya pratipattim vinā vyakteḥ adṛśya rūpa tvāt anye tu āhuḥ vyaṅgyā ca sā evam prasajyate iti atra caśabdena sāmānya vyañjakam iti etat upāttam tatas pradīpa ghaṭābhyām tulyam iti dvandvāt eva vatiḥ draṣṭavyaḥ

original: pūrvanipātalakṣaṇasya vyabhicāritvād ghaṭaśabdasyāpūrvanipātaḥ | pradīpavat sāmānyaṃ vyañjakaṃ | ghaṭavac ca vyaktivyaṅgyā | prasajyata iti vākyārtha iti | aneneti sāmānyavādinā | sāmānyam vinā kim asambhavatkāryam abhisamīkṣya | evam ity uktividhinā | bahvāyāsaḥ | aśakyasādhanatayā bahuduḥkhahetuḥ | (158-59)
analyzed: pūrva nipāta lakṣaṇasya vyabhicāri tvāt ghaṭa śabdasya apūrva nipātaḥ pradīpa vat sāmānyam vyañjakam ghaṭa vat ca vyakti vyaṅgyā prasajyate iti vākya arthaḥ iti anena iti sāmānya vādinā sāmānyam vinā kim asambhavat kāryam abhisamīkṣya evam iti ukti vidhinā bahu āyāsaḥ aśakya sādhanatayā bahu duḥkha hetuḥ

original: parasparetyādi paraḥ | bhedādilakṣaṇatvād dhetor vyatirekiṇīṣv ananvayinīṣu | anvayina ekākārasya pratyayasya pratyayagrahaṇam upalakṣaṇam evaṃ śabdasya | sāmānyam antareṇāyogāt | sāmānyavāda āśrita iti sambandhaḥ |
analyzed: paraspara ityādi paraḥ bheda ādi lakṣaṇa tvāt hetoḥ vyatirekiṇīṣu ananvayinīṣu anvayinaḥ eka ākārasya pratyayasya pratyaya grahaṇam upalakṣaṇam evam śabdasya sāmānyam antareṇa ayogāt sāmānya vādaḥ āśritaḥ iti sambandhaḥ

original: katham ity ācāryaḥ | ye pācakādiśabdā na kriyānimittān icchanti tān praty etad (p.310) uktaṃ | abhinnena sāmānyākhyenārthena vinā pācakādiṣu katham ekaḥ śabdo vācakaḥ | vācakagrahaṇena pratyayonvayī gṛhīta eva tena vinā śabdasyāpravṛtteḥ | ata eva vṛttau śabdapratyayānuvṛttir astīty āha –
analyzed: katham iti ācāryaḥ ye pācaka ādi śabdāḥ na kriyā nimittān icchanti tān prati etat uktam abhinnena sāmānya ākhyena arthena vinā pācaka ādiṣu katham ekaḥ śabdaḥ vācakaḥ vācaka grahaṇena pratyayaḥ anvayī gṛhītaḥ eva tena vinā śabdasya apravṛtteḥ atas eva vṛttau śabda pratyaya anuvṛttiḥ asti iti āha

original: udyotakareṇāpi gavādiṣv anuvṛttipratyayaḥ piṇḍādivyatiriktanimittād bhavati viśeṣapratyayānāmanākasmikatvān nīlādipratyayavat | yattannimittan tatsāmānyam iti sāmānyasiddhau pramāṇe kṛte svayam evāṃśakitam (|)
analyzed: udyota kareṇa api gavā ādiṣu anuvṛtti pratyayaḥ piṇḍa ādi vyatirikta nimittāt bhavati viśeṣa pratyayānām an ākasmika tvāt nīla ādi pratyaya vat yat tad nimittam tat sāmānyam iti sāmānya siddhau pramāṇe kṛte svayam eva aṃśakitam

original: atha manyase yathā pācakādiśabdā anuvṛttāś ca bhavanti na ca pācakatvan nāma sāmānyam asti (|) yadi syāt | bhāvotpattikāla evābhivyaktaṃ syāt tathā gavādiṣv anuvṛttipratyayā iti | na (|) hetvarthāparijñānāt | viśeṣapratyayānāmanākasmikatvād ity asya hetoḥ piṇḍapratyayavyatiriktasya pratyayasya nimittāntarād utpāda ity ayam arthaḥ |
analyzed: atha manyase yathā pācaka ādi śabdāḥ anuvṛttāḥ ca bhavanti na ca pācaka tvat nāma sāmānyam asti yadi syāt bhāva utpatti kāle eva abhivyaktam syāt tathā gavādiṣu anuvṛtti pratyayāḥ iti na hetu artha aparijñānāt viśeṣa pratyayānām an ākasmika tvāt iti asya hetoḥ piṇḍa pratyaya vyatiriktasya pratyayasya nimitta antarāt utpādaḥ iti ayam arthaḥ

original: na punaḥ sarvānuvṛttipratyayaḥ sāmānyād eva bhavatīti | evañ ca sati pacanakriyāyā yatpradhānaṃ sādhanan tatpācakaśabdenocyate | tac ca pradhānyaṃ pācakāntareṣv apy astīti na doṣa iti vadatā pācakatvādisāmānyam vinā pācakādiśabdānāṃ vṛttir iṣṭaivodyotakareṇety anenābhiprāyeṇācāryeṇāpy uktaṃ katham ityādi |
analyzed: na punar sarva anuvṛtti pratyayaḥ sāmānyāt eva bhavati iti evam ca sati pacana kriyāyāḥ yat pradhānam sādhanan tat pācaka śabdena ucyate tat ca pradhānyam pācaka antareṣu api asti iti na doṣaḥ iti vadatā pācaka tva ādi sāmānyam vinā pācaka ādi śabdānām vṛttiḥ iṣṭā eva udyota kareṇa iti anena abhiprāyeṇa ācāryeṇa api uktam katham ityādi

original: na ca pacanakriyāyāṃ prādhānyanimittāyāṃ pācakādiśabdapravṛttir yuktā | tannimittatve hi pradhānaṃ pradhānam ity anugāmī śabdaḥ syān na pācaka iti | ata evāha (|) na hītyādi | teṣv iti pācakādiṣu | anyad iti dravyād vyatiriktaṃ | evaṃ sarvaśaktiṣv abhinnaṃ yenaikena te pācakādayo bhinnās santopi tathetyabhedena pratīyeran jñānena |
analyzed: na ca pacana kriyāyām prādhānya nimittāyām pācaka ādi śabda pravṛttiḥ yuktā tad nimitta tve hi pradhānam pradhānam iti anugāmī śabdaḥ syāt na pācakaḥ iti atas eva āha na hi ityādi teṣu iti pācaka ādiṣu anyat iti dravyāt vyatiriktam evam sarva śaktiṣu abhinnam yena ekena te pācaka ādayaḥ bhinnāḥ santaḥ api tathā iti abhedena pratīyeran jñānena

original: upalakṣaṇam etat tathābhidhīyeran | pācakeṣv adhiśrayaṇādilakṣaṇaṃ | pāṭhakeṣv adhyayanātmakam evamanyeṣv api yathāyogyaṃ | karmaikapratyayādinimittam astīti cet | sa ity anvayī | pratyayagrahaṇam upalakṣaṇam evaṃ śabdopi | anyena veti karmaṇo hetunā prayatnādinā | bhinnam ityādinaitad eva samarthayate | tad iti bāhyopanyāse |
analyzed: upalakṣaṇam etat tathā abhidhīyeran pācakeṣu adhiśrayaṇa ādi lakṣaṇam pāṭhakeṣu adhyayana ātmakam evam anyeṣu api yathāyogyam karma eka pratyaya ādi nimittam asti iti ced saḥ iti anvayī pratyaya grahaṇam upalakṣaṇam evam śabdaḥ api anyena vā iti karmaṇaḥ hetunā prayatna ādinā bhinnam ityādinā etat eva samarthayate tat iti bāhya upanyāse

original: tatkarmeti (p.311) vā sambandhanīyaṃ | pratipācakaṃ karmaṇo bhedāt | yenāparādhena tā vyaktayas tathety abhinnapratyayahetutvena |
analyzed: tat karma iti vā sambandhanīyam pratipācakam karmaṇaḥ bhedāt yena aparādhena tāḥ vyaktayaḥ tathā iti abhinna pratyaya hetu tvena

original: sattyaṃ (|) na kaścidaparādhaḥ kintu tāsāṃ vyaktīnām ekarūpatvāt | tathā hi dravyam ekarūpam anaṃśatvāt | etad eva ced abhinnapratyayanibandhanaṃ na tu tato vyatiriktaṃ dharmāntaran tadā pācakasya pācakatvam iti vyatirekapratītir na syāt | na hi tasyaiva tato vyatireko yuktaḥ |
analyzed: sattyam na kaścid aparādhaḥ kintu tāsām vyaktīnām eka rūpa tvāt tathā hi dravyam eka rūpam an aṃśa tvāt etat eva ced abhinna pratyaya nibandhanam na tu tatas vyatiriktam tadā pācakasya pācaka tvam iti vyatireka pratītiḥ na syāt na hi tasya eva tatas vyatirekaḥ yuktaḥ

original: tasyāvyakter ākāras tadākāras tasmād anyo 'bhedākāras tasya viśeṣaḥ sosti yasyāṃ sā atadākāraviśeṣavatī | dravyākārād anyākārety arthaḥ |
analyzed: tasya avyakteḥ ākāraḥ tad ākāraḥ tasmāt anyaḥ bheda ākāraḥ tasya viśeṣaḥ saḥ usti yasyām sā a tad ākāra viśeṣavatī dravya ākārāt anya ākārā iti arthaḥ

original: tad uktam bhavati | dravyebhya eva pratyayo dravyam ityevamākāraḥ | tatonyenaivākāreṇa pācakapratyaya[ḥ pratiṣedhapratyaya]s sa yadi dravyanimittam eva syāt tadā dravyamātrapratyayāviśiṣṭaḥ syāt | atha kimartham tadākāraviśeṣavatīty ubhayam uktam atadākārety eva vaktavyaṃ | viśeṣavatīty eva vā |
analyzed: tat uktam bhavati dravyebhyaḥ eva pratyayaḥ dravyam iti evam ākāraḥ tatonyena eva ākāreṇa pācaka pratyayaḥ pratiṣedha pratyayaḥ sa yadi dravya nimittam eva syāt tadā dravya mātra pratyaya aviśiṣṭaḥ syāt atha kimartham tad ākāra viśeṣavatī iti ubhayam uktam a tad ākārā iti eva vaktavyam viśeṣavatī iti eva vā

original: ucyate 'bhedākārety ukte dravyasyābhāva iti pratiṣedhaprayayopy atadākāra iti śakyeta vyapadeṣṭuṃ na cāsau vastvantaranibandhanaḥ pareṇeṣṭaḥ | viśeṣapratyayānām eva dharmāntaranibandhanatvāt | viśeṣagrahaṇe ca kevale kriyamāṇe | caitrapratyayo maitrāpekṣayā bhavati viśeṣavān | na tv atadākāraḥ | caitrādyabhidhānena dravyasyaiva pratipādanāt |
analyzed: ucyate bheda ākārā iti ukte dravyasya abhāvaḥ iti pratiṣedha prayayā upi a tad ākāraḥ iti śakyeta vyapadeṣṭum na ca asau vastu antara nibandhanaḥ pareṇa iṣṭaḥ viśeṣa pratyayānām eva dharma antara nibandhana tvāt viśeṣa grahaṇe ca kevale kriyamāṇe caitra pratyayaḥ maitra apekṣayā bhavati viśeṣavān na tu a tad ākāraḥ caitra ādi abhidhānena dravyasya eva pratipādanāt

original: ubhayopādānāttvayam artho bhavaty adravyākāraś cāsau pratyayo vastusparśād viśeṣavāṃśceti | tasmāt tatra dravyavyatirikte na nimittāntareṇa bhāvyam iti |
analyzed: ubhaya upādānāt tu ayam arthaḥ bhavati adravya ākāraḥ ca asau pratyayaḥ vastu sparśāt viśeṣavān ca iti tasmāt tatra dravya vyatirikte na nimitta antareṇa bhāvyam iti

original: uktam ityācāryaḥ | yathā vyatireko gorgotvaṃ pācakasya pācakatvam ityādiko yathā ca viśeṣapratyayā anantaroktās tathoktam iti sambandhaḥ | katham uktam ity āha – yathāsvam ityādi | arthāntaravivekorthāntaravyavacchedaḥ | yathāsvam iti yasya śabdasya yathāsaṃketaṃ yo vyavacchedas tasmād ity arthaḥ |
analyzed: uktam iti ācāryaḥ yathā vyatirekaḥ goḥ go tvam pācakasya pācaka tvam iti ādikaḥ yathā ca viśeṣa pratyayāḥ anantara uktāḥ tathā uktam iti sambandhaḥ katham uktam iti āha yathāsvam ityādi artha antara viveka ūrtha antara vyavacchedaḥ yathāsvam iti yasya śabdasya yathāsaṃketam yaḥ vyavacchedaḥ tasmāt iti arthaḥ

original: tathā hi pācakaśabdo 'pācakavyavacchinnam apratikṣiptabhedāntaraṃ pratipādayan dharmivacanaḥ (|) pācakatvaśabdas tu tam eva vyavacchinnaṃ pratikṣiptabhedāntaram āheti dharmavacanaḥ | tato dharmadharmibhedakalpanayā pācakasya pācakatvam iti vyatirekavibhaktiḥ prayujyate |
analyzed: tathā hi pācaka śabdaḥ pācaka vyavacchinnam a pratikṣipta bheda antaram pratipādayan dharmi vacanaḥ pācaka tva śabdaḥ tu tam eva vyavacchinnam pratikṣipta bheda antaram āha iti dharma vacanaḥ tatas dharma dharmi bheda kalpanayā pācakasya pācaka tvam iti vyatireka vibhaktiḥ prayujyate

original: evaṃ dravyaśabdasyāpy adravyavyavacchinne svabhāve saṃketitatvāt tadanusāreṇādravyāvyavacchedānusāreṇādravyavyavacchedānukāriṇī buddhir (p.312) utpadyate | pācakaśabdāt tv apācakavyavacchinnānukāriṇy eva buddhir ato yathāvyavacchedaṃ saṃketānusāreṇa viśeṣavatī buddhir ekatrāpy aviruddhā | etac ca bhedāntarapratikṣepāpratikṣepetyādiṣu pratipāditaṃ |
analyzed: evam dravya śabdasya api adravya vyavacchinne svabhāve saṃketita tvāt tad anusāreṇa adravya a vyavaccheda anusāreṇa adravya vyavaccheda anukāriṇī buddhiḥ utpadyate pācaka śabdāt tu apācaka vyavacchinna anukāriṇī eva buddhiḥ atas yathāvyavacchedam saṃketa anusāreṇa viśeṣavatī buddhiḥ ekatra api aviruddhā etat ca bheda antara pratikṣepa apratikṣepa ityādiṣu pratipāditam

original: tasmād ityādinopasaṃhāraḥ | yathā vyaktīnāṃ bhedas tadvat karmaṇopi bhedād dhetor asya pācakādyabhepratyayasya na hetuḥ karmeti sambandhaḥ | teṣāṃ pācakānāṃ yāni karmāṇi pākākhyāni teṣu karmasu yā pācakatvajātiḥ samavetā saivābhedād dhetuḥ pācakābhedapratyayasya | netyādinā pratiṣedhati | na jātir hetur iti prakṛtaṃ |
analyzed: tasmāt ityādinā upasaṃhāraḥ yathā vyaktīnām bhedaḥ tadvat karmaṇaḥ api bhedāt hetoḥ asya pācaka ādi abhe pratyayasya na hetuḥ karma iti sambandhaḥ teṣām pācakānām yāni karmāṇi pāka ākhyāni teṣu karmasu yā pācaka tva jātiḥ samavetā sā eva abhedāt hetuḥ pācaka abheda pratyayasya na ityādinā pratiṣedhati na jātiḥ hetuḥ iti prakṛtam

original: kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) karmasaṃśrayāt | karmaṇi samavetatvāt | dravyād arthāntaraṃ karma tatsambandhinī | arthāntara iti dravye | gotvam iveti nidarśanaṃ | na hi gotvaṃ śābaleyādisambandhi | karkkādiṣv aśvabhedeṣu gopratyayahetuḥ | pācakakarmasu pākākhyeṣu karmajātis samavetā | na ca tāni karmāṇīti pākākhyāni | śabdagrahaṇam upalakṣaṇaṃ |
analyzed: kiṅkāraṇam karma saṃśrayāt karmaṇi samaveta tvāt dravyāt artha antaram karma tad sambandhinī artha antare iti dravye go tvam iva iti nidarśanam na hi go tvam śābaleya ādi sambandhi karkka ādiṣu aśvabhedeṣu go pratyaya hetuḥ pācaka karmasu pāka ākhyeṣu karma jātiḥ samavetā na ca tāni karmāṇi iti pāka ākhyāni śabda grahaṇam upalakṣaṇam

original: tathā pācakapratyayena paricchidyante | tasya pākākhyasya karmaṇa āśrayo dravyaṃ pācakaśabdenocyate | na ca tatra dravye karmajātisamavetā |
analyzed: tathā pācaka pratyayena paricchidyante tasya pāka ākhyasya karmaṇaḥ āśrayaḥ dravyam pācaka śabdena ucyate na ca tatra dravye karma jāti samavetā

original: evan tāvad arthāntarasambandhitvaṃ karmajāter āśritya dravyaviṣayaṃ pācakābhidhānapratyayaṃ pratyayanimittatvam uktam (|) (159-60)
analyzed: evam tāvat artha antara sambandhi tvam karma jāteḥ āśritya dravya viṣayam pācaka abhidhāna pratyayam pratyaya nimitta tvam uktam

original: adhunā prakārāntareṇāha – tasyetyādi | pācakaśruter anyā śrutiḥ śruyantaraṃ | śrutigrahaṇam upalakṣaṇam evaṃ jñānāntaranimittatvāt | śrutyantaram evāha – pāka ityādi | tata iti karmajāteḥ karmaviṣayasyābhidhānasya pratyayasya ca hetutvāt karmajāter ity abhiprāyaḥ |
analyzed: adhunā prakāra antareṇa āha tasya ityādi pācaka śruteḥ anyā śrutiḥ śruyantaram śruti grahaṇam upalakṣaṇam evam jñāna antara nimitta tvāt śruti antaram eva āha pākaḥ ityādi tatas iti karma jāteḥ karma viṣayasya abhidhānasya pratyayasya ca hetu tvāt karma jāteḥ iti abhiprāyaḥ

original: syān mataṃ (|) na karmajātiḥ pācakapratyayaṃ janayati kintu karmajātisamāśrayāt karmaivety ata āha – tasyetyādi | tasyeti pācakādyabhedapratyayasya | karmanimittaṃ yasyeti vigrahaḥ | proktaṃ vyaktivad bhedān na hetuḥ karmāsyetyādi |
analyzed: syāt matam na karma jātiḥ pācaka pratyayam janayati kintu karma jāti samāśrayāt karma eva iti atas āha tasya ityādi tasya iti pācaka ādi abheda pratyayasya karma nimittam yasya iti vigrahaḥ proktam vyakti vat bhedāt na hetuḥ karma asya ityādi

original: nanūktaṃ jātisamāśrayād bhinnam api karmābhinnapratyayahetur iti |
analyzed: nanu uktam jāti samāśrayāt bhinnam api karma abhinna pratyaya hetuḥ iti

original: (p.313) uktam idam ayuktan tūktaṃ | jātisambandhepi karmaṇas tathaiva bhinnatvāt | kiñcetyādinopacayahetum āha – tasya pācakādyabhedapratyayasya karmanimittatve 'bhyupagamyamāne | niruddhe karmaṇi punuṣaḥ pācaka iti nocyeta | ucyate ca yogyatāmātreṇa (|) tato na vastubhūtakriyānimittoyaṃ vyapadeśaḥ |
analyzed: uktam idam tu uktam jāti sambandhe pi karmaṇaḥ tathā eva bhinna tvāt kiñca ityādinā upacaya hetum āha tasya pācaka ādi abheda pratyayasya karma nimitta tve bhyupagamyamāne niruddhe karmaṇi punuṣaḥ pācakaḥ iti nā ucyeta ucyate ca yogyatā mātreṇa tatas na vastu bhūta kriyā nimittaḥ yam vyapadeśaḥ

original: atītasyāpi karmaṇostitvād adoṣa iti ced āha pācata evetyādi (|) yady atītasya sattvaṃ syād varttamānavadupalabhyetopalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptaṃ ca karmeṣyate |
analyzed: atītasya api karmaṇaḥ ustitvāt adoṣaḥ iti ced āha pācataḥ eva ityādi yadi atītasya sattvam syāt varttamāna vat upalabhyeta upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptam ca karma iṣyate

original: syān mataṃ (|) karmajātiḥ karmaṇi samavetā karmāpi dravye samavetan tataḥ sambaddhasanbandhāt karmajātir dravyaviṣayasya pācakapratyayasya hetur iti ced āha – tata evetyādi | tata eveti karmaṇo vinaṣṭatvād eva na sāmānyasya karmaṇā sambandhaḥ sākṣāt |
analyzed: syāt matam karma jātiḥ karmaṇi samavetā karma api dravye tatas sambaddha sanbandhāt karma jātiḥ dravya viṣayasya pācaka pratyayasya hetuḥ iti ced āha tatas eva ityādi tatas eva iti karmaṇaḥ vinaṣṭa tvāt eva na sāmānyasya karmaṇā sambandhaḥ sākṣāt

original: nāpi karmadvāreṇa pāramparyeṇa dravyasambandhosyāsambandhāt kāraṇān na sāmānyaṃ pācakādyabhidhānapratyayasya hetuḥ | asambaddham api hetur iti ced āha – netyādi | ayuktam ity asambaddhaṃ | śabdagrahaṇam upalakṣaṇam asambaddhaṃ sāmānyaṃ na jñānaśabdakāraṇam ity arthaḥ | kutaḥ (|) atiprasaṅgāt | gotvam apy aśvajñānasya hetuḥ syāt | (160-61)
analyzed: nā api karma dvāreṇa pāramparyeṇa dravya sambandhaḥ usya asambandhāt kāraṇāt na sāmānyam pācaka ādi abhidhāna pratyayasya hetuḥ asambaddham api hetuḥ iti ced āha na ityādi ayuktam iti asambaddham śabda grahaṇam upalakṣaṇam asambaddham sāmānyam na jñāna śabda kāraṇam iti arthaḥ kutas atiprasaṅgāt go tvam api aśva jñānasya hetuḥ syāt

original: vinaṣṭe hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | tata sāmānyam iti karmasāmānyan na karmaṇi samavetan tasyāsattvāt | karmābhāvād eva karttari pācake pāramparyeṇāpi samavetam (|) ataḥ sambaddhasambandhopy asya sāmānyasya dravyeṇa saha nāsti (|) tama(?da)tītetyādinā pakṣāntaram āśaṃkte | atītaṃ yadvinaṣṭaṃ | anāgataṃ yad bhaviṣyati karma |
analyzed: vinaṣṭe hi ityādinā vyācaṣṭe tata sāmānyam iti karma sāmānyan na karmaṇi samavetan tasya asattvāt karma abhāvāt eva karttari pācake pāramparyeṇa api samavetam atas sambaddha sambandhaḥ api asya sāmānyasya dravyeṇa saha na asti pakṣa antaram āśaṃkte atītam yat vinaṣṭam anāgatam yat bhaviṣyati karma

original: tayor iti śabdajñānayoḥ (|) karmāpy atītānāgatam asat | jñānābhidhānayor nimittam iti (p.314) sambandhaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tayor ityādi | tayor jñānābhidhānayoḥ |
analyzed: tayoḥ iti śabda jñānayoḥ karma api atīta anāgatam asat jñāna abhidhānayoḥ nimittam iti sambandhaḥ kim kāraṇam tayoḥ ityādi tayoḥ jñāna abhidhānayoḥ

original: astītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | upākhyāyate prakāśyate vastvanayety upākhyārthakriyāśaktiḥ | sā nirgatā yasmād asatas tattathoktaṃ | asad yasmādarthakriyāśaktivikalaṃ | tadevaṃbhūtaṃ kathaṃ śabdajñānayor nimittaṃ syād ity arthaḥ |'
analyzed: asti ityādinā vyācaṣṭe upākhyāyate prakāśyate vastu anayā iti upākhyā artha kriyā śaktiḥ sā nirgatā yasmāt asataḥ tat tathā uktam asat yasmāt artha kriyā śakti vikalam tat evaṃbhūtam katham śabda jñānayoḥ nimittam syāt iti arthaḥ

original: athāsatopi hetutvam iṣyate tadā tasya tastutvam eva syān nāsattvaṃ | kiṅkāraṇam ity āha – kāryetyādi | lakṣaṇaśabda svabhāvavacanaḥ | tad iti tasmāt | atītaṃ pracyutarūpaṃ | anāgatam asaṃprāptarūpaṃ | karmaṇaḥ sakāśādanyac ca vyaktyādikaṃ jñānābhidhānayor nimittatvena neṣṭaṃ sāmānyavādinā |
analyzed: atha asataḥ api hetu tvam iṣyate tadā tasya eva syāt na asattvam kiṅkāraṇam iti āha kārya ityādi lakṣaṇa śabda svabhāva vacanaḥ tat iti tasmāt atītam pracyuta rūpam anāgatam asaṃprāpta rūpam karmaṇaḥ sakāśāt anyat ca vyakti ādikam jñāna abhidhānayoḥ nimitta tvena na iṣṭam sāmānyavādinā

original: "vyaktiḥ karmāśrayo dravyaṃ |"
analyzed: vyaktiḥ karma āśrayaḥ dravyam

original: ādiśabdāt saṃketavāsanā tatparipākayor grahaṇaṃ | te iti śabdajñāne | tathā cety anvayinoḥ pācakādiśabdajñānayor animittatve sati na jātisiddhiḥ | caśabdāt nityaṃ sattvam asattvam vā śabdajñānayoḥ syāt | kasmān na jātisiddhir ity āha – tasyā ityādi | tasyā jāter abhinnasya jñānasyābhidhānasya ca nimittatveneṣṭatvāt | yathā ca pācakādiviṣaye |
analyzed: ādi śabdāt saṃketa vāsanā tad paripākayoḥ grahaṇam te iti śabda jñāne tathā ca iti anvayinoḥ pācaka ādi śabda jñānayoḥ animitta tve sati na jāti siddhiḥ caśabdāt nityam sattvam asattvam vā śabda jñānayoḥ syāt kasmāt na jāti siddhiḥ iti āha tasyāḥ ityādi tasyāḥ jāteḥ abhinnasya jñānasya abhidhānasya ca nimitta tvena iṣṭa tvāt yathā ca pācaka ādi viṣaye

original: abhyupagame vā jātikalpanāyā nirnibandhanatvaprasaṅgāt | (p.315) bhinnaiva śaktir iti ced āha – na hītyādi | na hi dravyād anyaiva śaktir yadi syāt tadā tasyā ekaśakteḥ pākādyarthakriyāsūpayogena kāraṇena dravyasya śaktyādhārasyānupayogitvaprasaṅgāt | tasyāṃ pākādinirvarttikāyāṃ śaktau tasya dravyasyopayogaḥ |

original: tasyām api śaktāv upayogāyāparā vyatiriktā śaktiḥ kalpanīyā tatrāpy aparetyanavasthā syād ity arthaḥ | tasmād antareṇa vyatiriktaṃ śaktiṃ dravyam eva prathamāyāṃ pākādinirvarttikāyāṃ śaktāv upayujyata iti vācyaṃ | evaṃ ca dravyasyopayoge śaktāv iṣyamāṇe | taddravyam arthakriyāyāṃ pākādilakṣaṇāyām evopayujyata iti kin neṣyate |
analyzed: tasyām api śaktau upayogāya aparā vyatiriktā śaktiḥ kalpanīyā tatra api aparā iti anavasthā syāt iti arthaḥ tasmāt antareṇa vyatiriktam śaktim dravyam eva prathamāyām pāka ādi nirvarttikāyām śaktau upayujyate iti vācyam evam ca dravyasya upayoge śaktau iṣyamāṇe tat dravyam arthakriyāyām pāka ādi lakṣaṇāyām eva upayujyate iti kin na iṣyate

original: pācakādiṣu dravyeṣu pācakatvādisāmānyam asti tadanvayi śabdajñānanibandhanam iti ced āha – sāmānyam ityādi | sāmānyaṃ pācakatvādi yadīṣyate | tadā pākādinirvarttanaśaktyavasthāyāḥ prāg eva dravyasyotpattisamakāla eva dravyasamavetan tad bhaved ity arthaḥ | tathā ca tadaharjātopi bālaḥ pācakādijñānābhidhānaviṣayaḥ syād iti bhāvaḥ |

original: no cet prāg eva bhavet tadā paścād api na bhavet | tasyā dravyasyāviśeṣāt | asty eva sarvakālaṃ (p.316) dravye pācakatvādi | kintu prāganabhivyaktam ato na śabdajñānayor nimittam ity ata āha – vyaktam iti | prāg evābhivyaktam bhaved ity arthaḥ | sattādivat | yathā sattādravyatvādi | yāvaddravyabhāvi |

original: athāpītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | satyarthe jātyāśraye tatsamavāyasya sāmānyasamavāyasyākādācitkatvāt sarvakālabhāvitvāt | etad eva draḍhayann āha – yāvanti hītyādi | arthe jātyāśraye | samavāyadharmāṇi sambandhayogyāni tāni sāmānyāni | asyārthasya ya utpādaḥ | tena saha samavayanti | asmin sāmānyāśraya iti vibhaktivipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ |
analyzed: atha api ityādinā vyācaṣṭe sati arthe jāti āśraye tad samavāyasya sāmānya samavāyasya akādācitkatvāt sarva kāla bhāvi tvāt etat eva draḍhayan āha yāvanti hi ityādi arthe jāti āśraye samavāya dharmāṇi sambandha yogyāni tāni sāmānyāni asya arthasya yaḥ utpādaḥ tena saha samavayanti asmin sāmānya āśraye iti vibhakti vipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ

original: utpādasamakālam eva dravyeṇa saha sambandhyata iti yāvat | iti samayaḥ | sāmānyavādinaḥ siddhāntaḥ | yadāhodyotakaraḥ (|) "prāggotvān nāsau gaur nāpy agaur iti | kiṅkāraṇam (|) abhāve tau viśeṣaṇapratyayau na ca viśeṣaṇapratyayau viśeṣyasambandham antareṇa bhavato na ca prāg gotvayogād vastu vidyate |
analyzed: utpāda sama kālam eva dravyeṇa saha sambandhyate iti yāvat iti samayaḥ sāmānyavādinaḥ siddhāntaḥ yat āha udyotakaraḥ prāk go tvāt na asau gauḥ na api a gauḥ iti kiṅkāraṇam abhāve tau viśeṣaṇa pratyayau na ca viśeṣaṇa pratyayau viśeṣya sambandham antareṇa bhavataḥ na ca prāk go tva yogāt vastu vidyate

original: na cāvidyamānaṃ gaur iti vā 'gaur iti vā śakyate vyapadeṣṭuṃ | yadaiva vastūtpadyate tadaiva gotvenābhisambadhyata iti | tathā na satas sattāsambandho nāsataḥ | yadiava ca vastu tadaiva sattayā sambadhyata" iti |1*
analyzed: na ca avidyamānam gauḥ iti vā gauḥ iti vā śakyate vyapadeṣṭum yadā eva vastu utpadyate tadā eva go tvena abhisambadhyate iti tathā na sataḥ sattā sambandhaḥ na asataḥ ca vastu tadā eva sattayā sambadhyate iti

original: fn.1: Nyāyavārtika.
analyzed: nyāyavārtika

original: atha siddhāntam atikramya paścād bhāvitvaṃ sāmānyasya kalpyate | tadā tadvyatikrame siddhāntavyatikrame | tasya sāmānyasyāśrayasya dravyasya paścād apy aviśeṣān na tatsamavāyaḥ syāt | tena sāmānyena samavāyo na syāt |
analyzed: atha siddhāntam atikramya paścāt bhāvi tvam sāmānyasya kalpyate tadā tad vyatikrame siddhānta vyatikrame tasya sāmānyasya āśrayasya dravyasya paścāt api aviśeṣāt na tad samavāyaḥ syāt tena sāmānyena samavāyaḥ na syāt

original: yathā phalaikasvabhāvasyāpi raktatā prāṅ na bhavati | paścāc ca bhavati | tadvatpuruṣasya pācakatvādisāmānyam ity ata āha – tatsambandhītyādi | tatsambandhisvabhāvavaiguṇyāt | pācakatvādisāmānyasambandhisvabhāvavaiguṇyāt | sa iti sāmānyasamavāyaḥ | tasyeti puṃsaḥ | na hy aviguṇe svabhāve sthitasya tatsambandho na bhavet |
analyzed: yathā phala eka svabhāvasya api rakta tā prāk na bhavati paścāt ca bhavati tadvat puruṣasya pācaka tva ādi sāmānyam iti atas āha tad sambandhi ityādi tad sambandhi svabhāva vaiguṇyāt pācaka tva ādi sāmānya sambandhi svabhāva vaiguṇyāt saḥ iti sāmānya samavāyaḥ tasya iti puṃsaḥ na hi aviguṇe svabhāve sthitasya tad sambandhaḥ na bhavet

original: tatraiva ca sāmānyasamavāyaviguṇe svabhāve sthitasya dravyasya paścāt sāmānyasamavāyo bhaviṣyatīti duranvayandurbodham etat | phalasyāpyāmrādeḥ pūrvaṃ paścāc ca yady ekasvabhāvatā | tatrāpi tulyaṃ codyaṃ | sāmānyasambaddham eva tadā dravyaṃ kriyopakārāpekṣan tu sāmānyaṃ vyanakti | (162-63)
analyzed: tatra eva ca sāmānya samavāya viguṇe svabhāve sthitasya dravyasya paścāt sāmānya samavāyaḥ bhaviṣyati iti duranvayan durbodham etat phalasya api āmra ādeḥ pūrvam paścāt ca yadi eka svabhāva tā tatra api tulyam codyam sāmānya sambaddham eva tadā dravyam kriyā upakāra apekṣan tu sāmānyam vyanakti

original: sā ca prāṅ nāstīti na prāk sāmānyābhivyaktir ity ata āha – kriyopakāretyādi | pākādilakṣaṇā kriyā | tatkṛto ya upakāras tadapekṣasya sāmānyaṃ prati vyañjakatve 'bhyupagamyamāne | tasya dravyasyākṣaṇikatvād avikāriṇonapekṣā sahakāriṇaṃ prati |
analyzed: sā ca prāṅ na asti iti na prāk sāmānya abhivyaktiḥ iti atas āha kriyā upakāra ityādi pāka ādi lakṣaṇā kriyā tad kṛtaḥ yaḥ upakāraḥ tad apekṣasya sāmānyam prati vyañjaka tve bhyupagamyamāne tasya dravyasya akṣaṇika tvāt avikāriṇaḥ ūnapekṣā sahakāriṇam prati

original: atha vikriyeta tadāpy atiśayesya dravyasya kṣaṇikatvam āpadyate | kṣaṇikatvāc cotpādānantaraṃ dhvaṃsinaḥ kutaḥ kriyā | yena tadupakārāpekṣaṃ jāter vyañjakaṃ syāt |
analyzed: atha vikriyeta tadā api dravyasya kṣaṇika tvam āpadyate kṣaṇika tvāt ca utpāda anantaram dhvaṃsinaḥ kutas kriyā yena tad upakāra apekṣam jāteḥ vyañjakam syāt

original: karmopakāretyādinā vyācaṣṭe | adhiśrayaṇādilakṣaṇo vyāpāraḥ karma | tatkṛta upakārotiśayas tam apekṣya sthirasvabhāvasya pūrvasvabhāvādacalatonatiśayāt svabhāvāntarānupādānāt | aviśeṣādhāyini karmaṇi | kāpekṣā | naiva |
analyzed: karma upakāra ityādinā vyācaṣṭe adhiśrayaṇa ādi lakṣaṇaḥ vyāpāraḥ karma tad kṛtaḥ upakāra utiśayaḥ tam apekṣya sthira svabhāvasya pūrva svabhāvāt acalataḥ natiśayāt svabhāva antara anupādānāt aviśeṣa ādhāyini karmaṇi kā apekṣā nā eva

original: atiśaye vā dravyasya kriyākṛtebhyupagamyamāne 'tiśayādhāyakasya karmaṇaḥ kṣaṇikatvāta tasyāpy upakāryasya dravyasya svabhāvabhūtenānyenātiśayenotpttavyaṃ |
analyzed: atiśaye vā dravyasya kriyā kṛta iti abhyupagamyamāne tiśaya ādhāyakasya karmaṇaḥ kṣaṇika tvāt tasya api upakāryasya dravyasya svabhāva bhūtena anyena atiśayena utpttavyam

original: yadi kriyākṛto 'tiśayo na svabhāvabhūto dravyasya tadarthāntarasya karaṇād dravyaṃ naivopakṛtaṃ syāt | tasmād yathākriyākṣaṇaṃ pratikṣaṇaṃ svabhāvabhūtasyānyānyasyātiśaotpattes tad api dravyaṃ devadattādi kṣaṇikaṃ syāt | tata iti kṣaṇikatvāt | svotpattisthānavināśinaḥ svasminn evotpattideśe vināśinaḥ puṃsaḥ kṛtaḥ pākalakṣaṇā kriyā |
analyzed: yadi kriyā kṛtaḥ utiśayaḥ na svabhāva bhūtaḥ dravyasya tad artha antarasya karaṇāt dravyam na eva upakṛtam syāt tasmāt yathākriyā kṣaṇam pratikṣaṇam svabhāva bhūtasya anya anyasya atiśa utpatteḥ tat api dravyam devadatta ādi kṣaṇikam syāt tatas iti kṣaṇika tvāt sva utpatti sthāna vināśinaḥ svasmin eva utpatti deśe vināśinaḥ puṃsaḥ kṛtaḥ pāka lakṣaṇā kriyā

original: yadapekṣan tat kriyāsāpekṣaṃ pācakādidravyasāmānyasya vyañjakaṃ syat |
analyzed: yat apekṣan tat kriyā sāpekṣam pācaka ādi dravya sāmānyasya vyañjakam syat

original: nanu ca prathamādikriyākṣaṇadvāreṇa dravyasya kṣaṇikatvaṃ kriyā 'bhāve ca kathaṃ kṣaṇikatvam iti cet (|) na | yataḥ kriyāsambandhotpannānāṃ kṣaṇānām anyasyāḥ kriyāyās sāmānyābhivyañjakāyā abhāvād ity arthaḥ |
analyzed: nanu ca prathama ādi kriyā kṣaṇa dvāreṇa dravyasya kṣaṇika tvam kriyā bhāve ca katham kṣaṇika tvam iti ced na yatas kriyā sambandha utpannānām kṣaṇānām anyasyāḥ kriyāyāḥ sāmānya abhivyañjakāyāḥ abhāvāt iti arthaḥ

original: kathan tarhītyādi paraḥ |

original: yathetyādi siddhāntavādī | yathā pācakādiṣu pācakatvādisāmānyan nāsti tathā (p.318) prasādhitamatha ca tatra pravarttete anvayinau jñānaśabdau | tathānyatrāpy antareṇa sāmānyantau bhivaṣyataḥ |
analyzed: yathā ityādi siddhāntavādī yathā pācaka ādiṣu pācaka tva ādi sāmānyan na asti tathā prasādhitam atha ca tatra pravarttete anvayinau jñāna śabdau tathā anyatra api antareṇa sāmānya ntau

original: tadvad ityādi paraḥ | teṣv iti pācakādiṣu sāmānyam vinā katham anvayinor jñānaśabdayor vṛttir iti | tatonvayajñānaśabdavṛtteḥ pācakādiṣv api pācakatvādisāmānyam astīti cintitam etad anantaraṃ | tathā teṣu pācakatvādi sāmānyaṃ sa na sambhavatīti |
analyzed: tadvat ityādi paraḥ teṣu iti pācaka ādiṣu sāmānyam vinā katham anvayinoḥ jñāna śabdayoḥ vṛttiḥ iti tatonvaya jñāna śabda vṛtteḥ pācaka ādiṣu api pācaka tva ādi sāmānyam asti iti cintitam etat anantaram tathā teṣu pācaka tva ādi sāmānyam sa na sambhavati iti

original: yady anvayi rūpan nāsti tat kim idānīm animitte te śabdajñāne syātāṃ | netyādi siddhāntavādī | asty eva tayor nimittaṃ yat pareṇeṣyate tasya pratikṣepaḥ | tad evāha – kin tarhītyādi | vastubhūtaṃ sāmānyam bāhyatatvaṃ nimitte te na bhavataḥ | kin tarhi tayor nimittam ity ata āha – yathāsvam ityādi |
analyzed: yadi anvayi na asti tat kim idānīm animitte te śabda jñāne syātām na ityādi siddhāntavādī asti eva tayoḥ nimittam yat pareṇa iṣyate tasya pratikṣepaḥ tat eva āha kim tarhi ityādi vastu bhūtam sāmānyam bāhya tatvam nimitte te na bhavataḥ kim tarhi tayoḥ nimittam iti atas āha yathāsvam ityādi

original: yo ya ātmīyo vāsanāprabodhas tasmād anvayino vikalpasyotpattiḥ | tato vikalpotpatteḥ sakāśād yathāvikalpaṃ śabdā bhavanti | na punar vikalpābhidhānayor vastusattā | anvayipadārthasattāsamāśraya ity uktaprāyam etat | avaśyaṃ caitad eṣṭavyaṃ |
analyzed: yaḥ yaḥ ātmīyaḥ vāsanā prabodhaḥ tasmāt anvayinaḥ vikalpasya utpattiḥ tatas vikalpa utpatteḥ sakāśāt yathāvikalpam śabdāḥ bhavanti na punar vikalpa abhidhānayoḥ vastu sattā anvayi padārtha sattā samāśrayaḥ iti ukta prāyam etat avaśyam ca etat eṣṭavyam

original: tathā hi yathāsvaṃ samavāyavāsanāvaśāt siddhāntāśrayeṇa jñānavāsanānurodhād virīdhirūpasamāveśena parasparaviruddharūpādhyāropeṇa pradhānakāryamīśvarakāryam ahetukaṃ samvṛttimātraṃ jagad ityevaṃ sarvabhedeṣv anvayinos tayor iti jñānābhidhānayoḥ | aparāparadarśanepīti parasparabhinnānām arthānān darśanepi |
analyzed: tathā hi yathāsvam samavāya vāsanā vaśāt siddhānta āśrayeṇa jñāna vāsanā anurodhāt virīdhi rūpa samāveśena paraspara viruddha rūpa adhyāropeṇa pradhāna kāryam īśvara kāryam ahetukam samvṛtti mātram jagat iti evam sarva bhedeṣu anvayinoḥ tayoḥ iti jñāna abhidhānayoḥ apara apara darśane api iti paraspara bhinnānām darśane api

original: na ca tatreti pradhānādikāryatvena parasparaviruddhena rūpeṇa kalpiteṣv artheṣu | tannibandhanaḥ śabdajñānayor nibandhanaḥ | kasmān nāstīty āha – parasparavirodhinor ityādi |
analyzed: na ca tatra iti pradhāna ādi kārya tvena paraspara viruddhena rūpeṇa kalpiteṣu artheṣu tad nibandhanaḥ śabda jñānayoḥ nibandhanaḥ kasmāt nā asti iti āha paraspara virodhinoḥ ityādi

original: aniyamenetyādi paraḥ | sarvaṃ sarvatrānvayi jñānam abhidhānaṃ ca syāt |
analyzed: aniyamena ityādi paraḥ sarvam sarvatra anvayi jñānam abhidhānam ca syāt

original: etad eva sādhayann āha – na hy animittam ityādi |
analyzed: etat eva sādhayan āha na hi animittam ityādi

original: nanu yathāsvaṃ vāsanāprabodhād vikalpotpatter ityādinā tayor animittatvaṃ pratiṣiddham ity anavakāśam eva codyaṃ | evam manyate | āntaram eva nimittan tayor iṣyate tasya ca nimittasya kenacidāsattiviprakarṣābhāvāt | sarvatra sarvavikalpahetutvaṃ syād iti | (p.319) na hy animitte bhavad ity atra bāhyanimittābhāvād animittam iti draṣṭavyaṃ |
analyzed: nanu yathāsvam vāsanā prabodhāt vikalpa utpatteḥ ityādinā tayoḥ animitta tvam pratiṣiddham iti anavakāśam eva codyam evam manyate āntaram eva tayoḥ iṣyate tasya ca nimittasya kenacid āsatti viprakarṣa abhāvāt sarvatra sarva vikalpa hetu tvam syāt iti na hi animitte bhavat iti atra bāhya nimitta abhāvāt animittam iti draṣṭavyam

original: nānimitte iti siddhāntavādī | aviśiṣṭanimitte | na bhavata ity arthaḥ | ata evāha – vāsanāviśeṣanimittatvād iti | yathābhūtadarśanadvārāyātā vāsanā sā tatraivādhyavasitatadbhāvam vikalpaṃ janayati | na sarvatreti samudāyārthaḥ | tathābhūtam ity anvayi rūpaṃ | na cāsati tasminn anvayini bāhye nimitte vikalpena na bhavitavyam bhavitavyam eva |
analyzed: na animitte iti siddhāntavādī aviśiṣṭa nimitte na bhavataḥ iti arthaḥ atas eva āha vāsanā viśeṣa nimitta tvāt iti yathābhūta darśana dvāra āyātā vāsanā sā tatra eva adhyavasita tad bhāvam vikalpam janayati na sarvatra iti samudāya arthaḥ tathābhūtam iti anvayi rūpam na ca asati tasmin anvayini bāhye nimitte vikalpena na bhavitavyam bhavitavyam eva

original: tad eva suptetyādinā sādhayati | suptaś ca taimirikaś ca tābhyām upalabdheṣv artheṣu gavādiṣu keśamakṣikādiṣu ca yathākramaṃ | abhāveṣu śaśaviṣāṇādiṣu | samavāyavāsanā | yathā svaṃ siddhāntaṃ saṃketavāsanā tadbalenāropitarūpaviśeṣe pradhānakāryādiṣu | tathā vikalpotpatter anvayino vikalpasyotpatteḥ |
analyzed: tat eva supta ityādinā sādhayati suptaḥ ca taimirikaḥ ca tābhyām upalabdheṣu artheṣu go ādiṣu keśa makṣikā ādiṣu ca yathākramam abhāveṣu śaśaviṣāṇa ādiṣu samavāya vāsanā yathā svam siddhāntam saṃketa vāsanā tad balena āropita rūpa viśeṣe pradhāna kārya ādiṣu tathā vikalpa utpatteḥ anvayinaḥ vikalpasya utpatteḥ

original: na hy eteṣu yathokteṣu bāhyam anvayi rūpam asti | svapnatimiropalabdhānām evāsattvāt | teṣāṃ cāsattvaṃ tṛtīye paricchede (3|85) pratipādayiṣyate | siddhāntasamāropitasya tu parasparavirodhinor yugapadekatretyādinā pratipāditam evāsattvaṃ |
analyzed: na hi eteṣu yathā ukteṣu bāhyam anvayi rūpam asti svapna timira upalabdhānām eva asattvāt teṣām ca asattvam tṛtīye paricchede pratipādayiṣyate siddhānta samāropitasya tu paraspara virodhinoḥ yugapad ekatra ityādinā pratipāditam eva asattvam

original: sa ca te vikalpāḥ svapnādyupalabdheṣv asatsu vastubhūtānvayirūpam antareṇāpy utpadyaṃta iti sarvatrārthāḥ sarvākārā bhavanty api tu pratiniyatā eva | niyamahetuṃ cāha – vibhāgenaivetyādi | tathaivopalabdhānām iti vibhāgenopalabdhānāṃ | vibhāgenaiva vikalpanāt | suptatimirāvasthāyān tāvad bhrāntajñānarūḍhānām arthānāṃ vibhāgenopalambhaḥ |
analyzed: sa ca te vikalpāḥ svapna ādi upalabdheṣu asatsu vastu bhūta anvayi rūpam antareṇa api utpadyaṃte iti sarvatra arthāḥ sarva ākārāḥ bhavanti api tu pratiniyatāḥ eva niyama hetum ca āha vibhāgena eva ityādi tathā eva upalabdhānām iti vibhāgena upalabdhānām vibhāgena eva vikalpanāt supta timira avasthāyān tāvat bhrānta jñāna rūḍhānām arthānām vibhāgena upalambhaḥ

original: siddhāntāropitānām api yathāsvaṃ siddhāntaśravaṇakāle | śaśaviṣāṇam ityādiṣv api | śaśaviṣāṇaṃ bandhyāsuta iti vyavahāravyutpattikāle 'nāditvād vyavahāravāsanāyāḥ | uktaṃ cātretyādi |
analyzed: siddhānta āropitānām api yathāsvam siddhānta śravaṇa kāle śaśa viṣāṇam ityādiṣu api śaśa viṣāṇam bandhyā sutaḥ iti vyavahāra vyutpatti kāle nādi tvāt vyavahāra vāsanāyāḥ uktam ca atra ityādi

original: "ekapratyamarśārthajñānādyekārthasādhana" (1|75) ity atra |
analyzed: eka pratyamarśa artha jñāna ādi eka artha sādhana iti atra

original: api ca yathā dhavakhadirādayaḥ parasparabhinnās tathā gavādayaḥ | tatra tulye bhede (p.320) kasmād vṛkṣatvaṃ dhavādiṣv eva varttate na gavādiṣv iti pṛṣṭena pareṇaitad eva vaktavyaṃ bhāvaśaktir eva sā dhavādīnāṃ yena na eva vṛkṣatvam prati pratyāsannā na gavādaya iti |
analyzed: api ca yathā dhava khadira ādayaḥ paraspara bhinnāḥ tathā go ādayaḥ tatra tulye bhede kasmāt vṛkṣa tvam dhava ādiṣu eva varttate na gava ādiṣu iti pṛṣṭena pareṇa etat eva vaktavyam bhāva śaktiḥ eva sā dhava ādīnām yena na eva vṛkṣa tvam prati pratyāsannāḥ na go ādayaḥ iti

original: tadā tulye bhedye yayā pratyāsattyā bhāvaśaktilakṣaṇayā jātiḥ kvacit svāśrayābhimate 'rtharāśau | prasarppati | vyāpya varttate | saiva bhāvaśaktir anvayiśabdajñānanibandhanam astu | kiṃ sāmānyena kalpitena (|)
analyzed: tadā tulye bhedye yayā pratyāsattyā bhāva śakti lakṣaṇayā jātiḥ kvacid sva āśraya abhimate rtha rāśau prasarppati vyāpya varttate sā eva bhāva śaktiḥ anvayi śabda jñāna nibandhanam astu kim sāmānyena kalpitena

original: yena yad ucyate |
analyzed: yena yat ucyate

original: "viṣayeṇa hi buddhīnāṃ vinā notpattir iṣyate |
analyzed: viṣayeṇa hi buddhīnām vinā nā utpattiḥ iṣyate

original: viśeṣād anyad icchanti sāmānyan tena tad dhruvaṃ |
analyzed: viśeṣāt anyat icchanti tena tat dhruvam

original: tā hi tena vinotpannā mithyā syur viṣayādṛte |
analyzed: tāḥ hi tena vinā utpannāḥ mithyā syuḥ viṣayāt ṛte

original: na tv anyena vinā vṛttis sāmānyasyeha duṣyatī"ti |
analyzed: na tu anyena vinā vṛttiḥ sāmānyasya iha duṣyati iti

original: tadapāstaṃ | na hi yathā sāmānyam antareṇa keṣucit sāmānyavṛttir iṣyate | tathā sāmānyam vinā sāmānyabuddhir iṣyatām iti parobhyupagamaṃ kāryate | yena tā hi tena vinotpannā mithyā syur iti parasyottaraṃ syāt |
analyzed: tat apāstam na hi yathā sāmānyam antareṇa keṣucid sāmānya vṛttiḥ iṣyate tathā sāmānyam vinā sāmānya buddhiḥ iṣyatām iti paraḥ abhyupagamam kāryate yena tāḥ hi tena vinā utpannāḥ mithyā syuḥ iti parasya uttaram syāt

original: kevalaṃ yathā parasya sāmānyam antareṇa keṣucit padārtheṣu yayā pratyāsattyā sāmānyavṛttiḥ saiva bhrāntānvayijñānaśabdanimittam astu kiṃ sāmānyenety ayam arthotra vivakṣita iti na kaściddoṣaḥ |
analyzed: kevalam yathā parasya sāmānyam antareṇa keṣucid padārtheṣu yayā pratyāsattyā sāmānya vṛttiḥ sā eva bhrānta anvayi jñāna śabda nimittam astu kim sāmānyena iti ayam arthaḥ utra vivakṣitaḥ iti na kaścid doṣaḥ

original: tasmāt sthitam etad (|) vyāvṛtter evaikatvādhyavasāyād bhāveṣv anvayo nānyasyeti | (|164-65||)
analyzed: tasmāt sthitam etat vyāvṛtteḥ evā ekatva adhyavasāyāt bhāveṣu anvayaḥ nā anyasya iti

original: atra sāṃkhyaḥ prāha – na nivṛttim ityādi | bhāvānvayo bhāvānām ekarūpatvaṃ | apara iti vastubhūtaḥ | tadekasya bījasya yatkāryan tadanyasya pṛthivyāder na syāt | kasmāt (|) tayor bījapṛthivyor atyantabhedataḥ | (|165-66)
analyzed: atra sāṃkhyaḥ prāha na nivṛttim ityādi bhāva anvayaḥ bhāvānām eka rūpa tvam aparaḥ iti vastu bhūtaḥ tat ekasya bījasya tat anyasya pṛthivī ādeḥ na syāt kasmāt tayoḥ bīja pṛthivyoḥ atyanta bhedataḥ

original: yadyeta ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | eṣām iti bhāvānāṃ yathā bījādekādīnām ekaṃ akurākhyaṃ kāryaṃ | yo hītyādinā tadeva sādhayati | yo hi tasya bījasyāṃkurajananasvabhāvo (p.321) na hi sonyasya pṛthivyāder asti | yosti buddhyāropito vyāvṛttilakṣaṇo na sa janakaḥ | kasmād | vyatirekasyānyavyāvṛttilakṣaṇasya niḥsvabhāvatvāt |
analyzed: yadi ete ityādinā vyācaṣṭe eṣām iti bhāvānām yathā bījāt eka ādīnām ekam akura ākhyam kāryam yaḥ hi ityādinā tat eva sādhayati yaḥ hi tasya bījasya aṃkura janana svabhāvaḥ na hi saḥ anyasya pṛthivī ādeḥ asti buddhi āropitaḥ vyāvṛtti lakṣaṇaḥ na sa janakaḥ kasmāt vyatirekasya anya vyāvṛtti lakṣaṇasya niḥsvabhāva tvāt

original: tasmād bījasvalakṣaṇam eva janakaṃ yac ca janakarūpan tad eva vastu | tajjanakaṃ cety aṅkurajanakaṃ svalakṣaṇaṃ | aparatreti pṛthivyādau | aparaṃ pṛthivyādikam aṃkuraṃ janayet | sa hītyādi | hiśabda evākārārthaḥ | tasyeti bījasya | anyasya pṛthivyādeḥ (|) sa pṛthivyādis tenāṃkurajananena bījasvabhāvena tato bījād abhinnaḥ syāt |
analyzed: tasmāt bīja sva lakṣaṇam eva janakam yat ca tat eva vastu tat janakam ca iti aṅkura janakam sva lakṣaṇam aparatra iti pṛthivī ādau aparam pṛthivī ādikam aṃkuram janayet sa hi ityādi hi śabdaḥ eva ākāra arthaḥ tasya iti bījasya anyasya pṛthivī ādeḥ sa pṛthivī ādiḥ tena aṃkura jananena bīja svabhāvena tatas bījāt abhinnaḥ syāt

original: ity asti svabhāvānvayaḥ | tena kecit svabhāvabhedepi prakṛtyaikakāryakāriṇa indriyādivad ity ayuktam uktam iti |
analyzed: iti asti svabhāva anvayaḥ tena kecid svabhāva bhede pi prakṛtyā eka kārya kāriṇaḥ indriya ādi vat iti ayuktam uktam iti

original: yadītyādinā siddhāntavādī | ātmaikatrāpīti | kāraṇakalāpasya yenābhinnenātmanā janakatvam iṣyate | sa ātmā teṣāṃ kāraṇānām madhye ekatrāpi kāraṇestīti | tenaikena kāryaṃ kṛtam iti kṛtvā vyarthāḥ syuḥ sahakāriṇaḥ |
analyzed: yadi ityādinā siddhānta vādī ātmā ekatra api iti kāraṇa kalāpasya yena abhinnena ātmanā janaka tvam iṣyate saḥ ātmā teṣām kāraṇānām madhye ekatra api tena ekena kāryam kṛtam iti kṛtvā vyarthāḥ syuḥ sahakāriṇaḥ

original: nanu vyāvṛttivādinopy antyāvasthāyāṃ sarveṣāṃ janakatvāt kāraṇāntaravaiyarthyaṃ |
analyzed: nanu vyāvṛtti vādinā api antya avasthāyām sarveṣām janaka tvāt kāraṇa antara vaiyarthyam

original: naitad asti | samuditānām eva teṣān tādṛśaṃ sāmarthyaṃ kṣaṇikānāṃ | hetupratyayāyattasannidhitvāt | parasya tu nityavādinaḥ sadā tad rūpam astīti bhavet kāraṇāntarāṇāmānarthakyaṃ | ata evoktam ekatrāpi sostīti kāraṇāntaravikalāvasthāyām apīty arthaḥ |
analyzed: na etat asti samuditānām eva teṣām tādṛśam sāmarthyam kṣaṇikānām hetu pratyaya āyatta sannidhi tvāt parasya tu nitya vādinaḥ sadā tat rūpam asti iti bhavet kāraṇa antarāṇām ānarthakyam atas eva uktam ekatra api saḥ asti iti kāraṇa antara vikala avasthāyām api iti arthaḥ

original: yadītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | anekaḥ padārtho yady ekasvabhāvatvād ekasya kāryasya kārakaḥ janakaḥ sa teṣāṃ kāraṇābhimatānām abhinno janakaḥ svabhāva ekakāraṇasannidhānepy asti | tataś ca sarvasyām avasthāyām avaikalyāt kāraṇasya yatra tatrāvasthitir ekopi janakaḥ syāt | (|166-67)
analyzed: yadi ityādinā vyācaṣṭe anekaḥ padārthaḥ yadi eka svabhāva tvāt ekasya kāryasya kārakaḥ janakaḥ sa teṣām kāraṇa abhimatānām abhinnaḥ janakaḥ svabhāvaḥ eka kāraṇa sannidhāne api asti tatas ca sarvasyām avasthāyām avaikalyāt kāraṇasya yatra tatra avasthitiḥ ekaḥ api janakaḥ syāt

original: etad eva draḍhayann āha – yasmād ityādi | ekasminn api bījādau sannihite nāpaityabhinnaṃ tatkāryajananaṃ | viśeṣā vyaktibhedā apāyinaḥ | na hi tasyābhinnasya (p.322) kāryajananasvabhāvasya bījād arthāntarepi pṛthivyādau viśeṣosti | kiṅkāraṇam (|) viśeṣe satyabhedahāneḥ | sa hy abhinno janakābhimataḥ svabhāvas tatrāpi bījepi kevalestīti |
analyzed: etat eva draḍhayan āha yasmāt ityādi ekasmin api bīja ādau sannihite na apaiti abhinnam tad kārya jananam viśeṣāḥ vyakti bhedāḥ apāyinaḥ na hi tasya abhinnasya kārya janana svabhāvasya bījāt artha antare pi pṛthivī ādau viśeṣaḥ usti kiṅkāraṇam viśeṣe sati abheda hāneḥ sa hi abhinnaḥ janaka abhimataḥ svabhāvaḥ tatra api bīje api kevale asti iti

original: naikasya sthitāv api tasyety abhinnasya rūpasya janakābhimatasyāpāyo vināśosti | traiguṇyasya sarvātmanā sarvatra sarvadā sattvāt | ye viśeṣā avasthābhedās teṣāṃ sahasthitiniyamābhāvāt syād apāyaḥ |
analyzed: na ekasya sthitau api tasya iti abhinnasya rūpasya janaka abhimatasya apāyaḥ vināśaḥ usti traiguṇyasya sarva ātmanā sarvatra sarvadā sattvāt ye viśeṣāḥ avasthā bhedāḥ teṣām saha sthiti niyama abhāvāt syāt apāyaḥ

original: etac cābhyupagamyoktaṃ | anyathā nityād avasthāntaravyatiriktānāṃ veśeṣāṇām api katham apāyaḥ | na ca te janakā iti viśeṣāḥ kasmān neṣṭā ity āha – sahakāriṇām ityādi | tasmād ekasminn api bījādau sthite janakasyātmanaḥ sthānāt | asthāyina iti viśeṣasya | ekasthitāv apīti bījāder anyatamasya sthitāv api kāryotpattiḥ syāt |
analyzed: etat ca abhyupagamya uktam anyathā nityāt avasthā antara vyatiriktānām veśeṣāṇām api katham apāyaḥ na ca te janakāḥ iti viśeṣāḥ kasmāt na iṣṭāḥ iti āha sahakāriṇām ityādi tasmāt ekasmin api bīja ādau sthite janakasya ātmanaḥ sthānāt asthāyinaḥ iti viśeṣasya eka sthitau api iti bīja ādeḥ anyatamasya sthitau api kārya utpattiḥ syāt

original: na ca bhavati kāryotpattiḥ | tataḥ sāmānyasthitepi sahakāriṇām madhye | ekasya viśeṣasyāpāye | phalābhāvād viśeṣebhyas tadudbhavaḥ kāryodbhavaḥ | na sāmānyāt | tatkāryam aṅkurādikaṃ | kiṃ bhūtaṃ | anekam ityādi | anekasya sahakāriṇaḥ sādhāraṇaṃ | anekasahakārijanyam ity arthaḥ | ekaviśeṣāpāyepīti sahakāriṇām anyatamabhedāpāyepi |
analyzed: na ca bhavati kārya utpattiḥ tatas sāmānya sthite api sahakāriṇām madhye ekasya viśeṣasya apāye phala abhāvāt viśeṣebhyaḥ tad udbhavaḥ kārya udbhavaḥ na sāmānyāt tat kāryam aṅkura ādikam kim bhūtam anekam ityādi anekasya sahakāriṇaḥ sādhāraṇam aneka sahakāri janyam iti arthaḥ eka viśeṣa apāye pi iti sahakāriṇām anyatama bheda apāye pi

original: anena vyatirekam āha –
analyzed: anena vyatirekam āha

original: punar ityādinānvayaṃ | tasmād viśeṣeṣv evānvayavyatirekau kāryasya na tu sāmānye | tad āha (|) nanv avikala iti | ekaviśeṣasthitāv avikalepy abhinne rūpe tatkāryan na bhavati | kāryaṃ hītyādinaitad eva vibhajate | kutaścid bhāva utpādaḥ sa eva dharmaḥ | sa yasyāsti tat tadbhāvadharmi |
analyzed: punar ityādinā anvayam tasmāt viśeṣeṣu eva anvaya vyatirekau kāryasya na tu sāmānye tat āha nanu avikale iti eka viśeṣa sthitau avikale api abhinne rūpe tat kāryat na bhavati kāryam hi ityādinā etat eva vibhajate kutaścid bhāvaḥ utpādaḥ saḥ eva dharmaḥ sa yasya asti tat tad bhāva dharmi

original: kadācit yatra bhavati tattasya janakasya vaikalyān na cābhinnasya rūpasya janakābhimatasya sahakāriṇāṃ madhye | ekasya sthitāv api vaikalyam asti | avikale tasmin sāmānyarūpe kāryamabhata tasya sāmānyasyājanakātmatāṃ (p.323) sacayati | (|167-68||)
analyzed: kadācid yatra bhavati tat tasya janakasya vaikalyāt na ca abhinnasya rūpasya janaka abhimatasya sahakāriṇām madhye ekasya sthitau api vaikalyam asti avikale tasmin sāmānya rūpe kāryam abhata tasya sāmānyasya ajanaka ātmatām sacayati

original: nanu na sāmānyam eva janakam iṣyate yenānyadoṣaḥ syād api tu anekātmatayā janaka ity uktam ity atrāha – yatsākalyetyādi | yeṣāṃ ca viśeṣāṇāṃ sākalyavaikalyābhyāṃ kāryam bhāvābhāvavat | tata eva viśeṣebhyaḥ kāryasyotpattiḥ | tasmin satīti hetubhāvayogye viśeṣe sati bhavataḥ kāryasya | tadanyasmād iti |

original: tasmāt svabhāvosya kāraṇādibhimatasya svahetoḥ sakāśād bhavatīty ucyate | tasyāpi svahetos tajjananātmatā tathābhūtakāraṇasvabhāvajananātmatā tadanyasmāt svahetor ity anādirhetuparamparā |

original: (p.325) na hi bhinnānām bhāvānāṃ hetupravibhāge bādhakaṃ pramāṇam asti | tad evāha – bhinnetyādi | svabhāvād iti vastusthiteḥ | ekatve tu bādhakam astīty āha – abhedo tv ityādi | parasparam abhedād ekasya nāśe sarvasya yugapannāśaḥ utpāde sarvasyotpādaḥ syād ity arthaḥ |
analyzed: na hi bhinnānām bhāvānām hetu pravibhāge bādhakam pramāṇam asti tat eva āha bhinna ityādi svabhāvāt iti vastu sthiteḥ ekatve tu bādhakam asti iti āha tu ityādi parasparam abhedāt ekasya nāśe sarvasya yugapad nāśaḥ utpāde sarvasya utpādaḥ syāt iti arthaḥ

original: abhedād ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | viśvasya sarvasya padārtharāśeḥ svabhāvenābhedāt | vibhāgotpattītyādi | ekasyotpattir anyasyānutpattir ekasya sthitir anyasya nirodha ityevamvibhāgenotpattyādayo na syuḥ | svātmavad iti | yathaikasyāvasthāviśeṣasya vibhāgena notpattyādayas tadvad ity arthaḥ | ādiśabdād ekasya grahaṇam anyasyāgrahaṇam ityādi |
