original: sūtre tu nāśotpādagrahaṇam upalakṣaṇārthaṃ | tathā tenaiva vibhāgotpattyādinā upalakṣaṇān niścayād abhedasya | anyathā bhedābhedau kena lakṣyeta | ekākārasyāpīti tulyākārasyāpi vyatireko vibhāgaḥ pṛthagutpattyādimattvaṃ | tad bhedasya lakṣaṇaṃ | avyatireko 'vibhāgaḥ pṛthagutpattyādimattvābhāvaḥ | tadabhedasya lakṣaṇaṃ |

original: netyādinā pariharati | ayam atrārthā dvividhonyāpoha eko vijātīyavyāvṛttau bāhyaḥ svākārabhedenādhyasto vikalpabuddhyā yo viṣayīkriyate śabdena ca | tasyaivārthakriyākāritvena ca pravṛttiviṣayatvān na buddhipratibhāsamātrasyārthakāritvābhāvāt | aparorthād yat pratīyate 'nyanivṛttimātraṃ | (170-71)
analyzed: na ityādinā pariharati ayam atra arthāḥ dvividhaḥ anya apohaḥ ekaḥ vijātīya vyāvṛttau bāhyaḥ sva ākāra bhedena adhyastaḥ vikalpa buddhyā yaḥ viṣayīkriyate śabdena ca tasya eva arthakriyā kāri tvena ca pravṛtti viṣaya tvāt na buddhi pratibhāsa mātrasya artha kāri tva abhāvāt aparaḥ ūrthāt yat pratīyate yat pratīyate

original: yac caitad anyanivṛttimātrasya niḥsvabhāvatvān naitac codyaṃ | ācāryeṇa vā yadabhimatan tasya niḥsvabhāvatvād abhāvād ity arthaḥ | tad āha (|) nivṛtter niḥsvabhāvatvād iti na sthānāsthānakalpanā |
analyzed: yat ca etat anya nivṛtti mātrasya niḥsvabhāva tvāt na etat codyam ācāryeṇa vā tasya niḥsvabhāva tvāt abhāvāt iti arthaḥ tat āha nivṛtteḥ niḥsvabhāva tvāt iti na sthāna asthāna kalpanā

original: viśeṣe vinaśyati kimanyāpohas tiṣṭhati | kim vā nivartata iti | iyaṃ sthānāsthānakalpanā yuktā | tasyety anyāpohasya | svabhāvānuṣaṅgiṇyo vastvanupātinyaḥ | vikalpabuddhyāyopitaṃ yas sāmānyan tatra tarhi svarūpasthitipracyutikalpanā bhaviṣyatīty ata āha – upaplavaś cetyādi |
analyzed: viśeṣe vinaśyati kim anya apohaḥ tiṣṭhati kim vā nivartate iti iyam sthāna asthāna kalpanā yuktā tasya iti anya apohasya svabhāva anuṣaṅgiṇyaḥ vastu anupātinyaḥ vikalpa buddhyā āyopitam tatra tarhi svarūpa sthiti pracyuti kalpanā bhaviṣyati iti atas āha upaplavaḥ ca ityādi

original: yaḥ sāmānyākāro 'nekapadārthābhinnaḥ pratibhāsate (|) sāmānyadhiya upaplavo bhrānto 'taḥ sopi bahir nāsty eva (|) yata evaṃ tenāpi viplavatvena kāraṇena sāmānyadhīḥ | adūṣaṇā | nāsyāṃ yathoktaṃ dūṣaṇam astīti vigrahaḥ |
analyzed: yaḥ sāmānya ākāraḥ neka padārtha abhinnaḥ pratibhāsate sāmānya dhiyaḥ upaplavaḥ saḥ api bahis na asti eva yatas evam tena api viplava tvena kāraṇena sāmānya dhīḥ adūṣaṇā na asyām yathoktam dūṣaṇam asti iti vigrahaḥ

original: idam ekākāraṃ vikalpavijñānaṃ nirviṣayaṃ | yasmān mithyājñānam mithyārtham eva katham iti ced āha – yad ityādi | yasmād anekatraikākāraṃ | tadviṣayasya vikalpavijñānaviṣayasya sāmānyasya na sthitir asthitir vā | kasmāt (|) tasya mithyājñānaviṣayasyābhāvāt | (171-72)
analyzed: idam eka ākāram vikalpa vijñānam nirviṣayam yasmāt mithyājñānam mithyārtham eva katham iti ced āha yat ityādi yasmāt anekatra eka ākāram tad viṣayasya vikalpa vijñāna viṣayasya sāmānyasya na sthitiḥ asthitiḥ vā kasmāt tasya mithyājñāna viṣayasya abhāvāt

original: (p.328) samānadoṣatāmapanīya punaḥ prakārāntareṇa prakrāntañ codyaṃ pariharttum āha – yat punar ityādi | tajjanako hi tasya śālyaṅkurasya janako hi sa tasya śālibījasya svabhāvaḥ | yac ca tasya śālibījasya śālyaṅkurajanakaṃ rūpaṃ | tato janakād rūpād anyaḥ pṛthivyādir janakaḥ katham iti | tatrety upanyāse | tatra vā codyo pratividhīyate |
analyzed: samāna doṣa tām apanīya punar prakāra antareṇa codyam pariharttum āha yat punar ityādi tad janakaḥ hi tasya śāli aṅkurasya janakaḥ hi sa tasya śāli bījasya svabhāvaḥ yat ca tasya śāli bījasya śāli aṅkura janakam rūpam tatas janakāt rūpāt anyaḥ pṛthivī ādiḥ janakaḥ katham iti tatra iti upanyāse tatra vā codyā pratividhīyate

original: śālibījād anyasya pṛthivyādes tajjanakam aṅkurajanakaṃ rūpaṃ nāstīti na brūmaḥ | kin tarhi yad ekasya śālibījasya janakaṃ rūpan tadanyasya pṛthivyāder neti brūmaḥ | bhāvānāṃ parasparam ananvayāt | anyopīti | pṛthivyādiḥ | na pararūpeṇeti na śālibījarūpeṇa | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) atatvād astv abhāvatvāt |
analyzed: śāli bījāt anyasya pṛthivī ādeḥ tad janakam aṅkura janakam rūpam na asti iti na brūmaḥ kim tarhi yat ekasya śāli bījasya janakam tad anyasya pṛthivī ādeḥ na iti brūmaḥ bhāvānām parasparam ananvayāt anyaḥ api iti pṛthivī ādiḥ na para rūpeṇa iti na śāli bīja rūpeṇa kim kāraṇam a tatvāt astu abhāva tvāt

original: na cātra bādhakaṃ pramāṇam astīty āha – te pṛthivyādayo yathāsvam iti (|) yasya yatsvalakṣaṇaṃ tena bhinnāś ca parasparam ekasya kāryasya janakāś ca svabhāveneti ketra virodho na kaścid bādhakapramāṇābhāvāt | na tu śālyaṅkurajanakābhimatena śālibījarūpeṇa vikalasya pṛthivyādeḥ śālyaṅkurakāryatvam viruddham ity ata āha – ekarūpetyādi |
analyzed: na ca atra bādhakam pramāṇam asti iti āha te pṛthivī ādayaḥ yathāsvam iti yasya yat sva lakṣaṇam tena bhinnāḥ ca parasparam ekasya kāryasya janakāḥ ca svabhāvena iti virodhaḥ na kaścid bādhaka pramāṇa abhāvāt na tu śāli aṅkura janaka abhimatena śāli bīja rūpeṇa vikalasya pṛthivī ādeḥ śāli aṅkura kārya tvam viruddham iti atas āha eka rūpa ityādi

original: ekasya śālibījasya janakaṃ yadrūpan tena vikalaḥ pṛthivyādis tadrūpaḥ śālibījādisvabhāvo na syāt | nātatkāryaḥ kintu tatkārya eva | sa śālyaṅkuraḥ kāryam asyeti vigrahaḥ | yadi tu bījasyaivāṅkurajanakatvaṃ syāt syād virodhas tac ca nāsti | tad āha – tenaivetyādi | śālibījenaiva tatkāryam aṅkurākhyaṃ |
analyzed: ekasya śāli bījasya janakam tena vikalaḥ pṛthivī ādiḥ tad rūpaḥ śāli bīja ādi svabhāvaḥ na syāt na atatkāryaḥ kintu tad kāryaḥ eva sa śāli aṅkuraḥ kāryam asya iti vigrahaḥ yadi tu bījasya eva aṅkura janaka tvam syāt syāt virodhaḥ tat ca na asti tat āha tena eva ityādi śāli bījena eva tat kāryam aṅkura ākhyam

original: api cetyādinā pūrvoktaṃ smārayati |
analyzed: api ca ityādinā pūrva uktam smārayati

original: "ekāpāye phalābhāvād viśeṣebhyas tadudbhava" iti (|) pramāṇabalena viśeṣājanakā ity uktaṃ prāk | tenātmaneti tena janakarūpeṇa | yad ekasya bījasya janakaṃ (p.329) rūpam anyasya pṛthivyādes tan nāsti | na tāvateti śālybījarūpavaikalyamātreṇā janakaḥ pṛthivyādayaḥ | apy abheda ityādi | teṣu bhedeṣv abhedopy astīty arthaḥ |
analyzed: eka apāye phala abhāvāt viśeṣebhyaḥ tad udbhavaḥ iti pramāṇa balena viśeṣa ajanakāḥ iti uktam prāk tena ātmanā iti tena janaka rūpeṇa yat ekasya bījasya janakam rūpam anyasya pṛthivī ādeḥ tat nā asti na tāvatā iti śāli bīja rūpa vaikalya mātreṇa ā janakaḥ pṛthivī ādayaḥ api abhedaḥ ityādi teṣu bhedeṣu abhedaḥ api asti iti arthaḥ

original: syād etad ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | tena sāmānyarūpeṇa te viśeṣā ajanakāḥ (|) kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) tasya sāmānyarūpasya nityatvenānapāyat | etac ca "nāpaityabhinnan tadrūpam viśeṣāḥ khalv apāyina" (1|167) ityādinā prāguktaṃ | (172-73)
analyzed: syāt etat ityādinā vyācaṣṭe tena sāmānya rūpeṇa te viśeṣāḥ ajanakāḥ kiṅkāraṇam tasya sāmānya rūpasya nitya tvena etat ca na apaiti tad rūpam viśeṣāḥ khalu apāyinaḥ ityādinā prāguktam

original: "syātāṃ nāśodbhavau sakṛd" (1|170) ityādinā viruddhadharmādhyāsād bhedam prasādhya pratibhāsabhedenāpi sādhayitum āha – kiṃ cetyādi | kimviśiṣṭaḥ pratibhāsabhedaḥ (|) ananyabhāk | prativyakta bhinnaḥ | apiśabdād utpattyādibhedaś ca bhedakaḥ | etac ca pūrvoktam eva samuccīyate |
analyzed: syātām nāśa udbhavau sakṛt ityādinā viruddha dharma adhyāsāt bhedam prasādhya pratibhāsa bhedena api sādhayitum āha kim ca ityādi kimviśiṣṭaḥ pratibhāsa bhedaḥ ananya bhāj bhinnaḥ apiśabdāt utpatti ādi bhedaḥ ca bhedakaḥ etat ca pūrva uktam eva samuccīyate

original: yopi vedāntavādy āha – abhāvagrahaṇanimittako hi bhedagrāho na cābhāvaḥ pratyakṣagrāhyaḥ | tena pratyakṣeṇa sattāmātraṅgṛhyate na bhedaḥ | tad uktaṃ |
analyzed: yaḥ api vedāntavādī āha abhāva grahaṇa nimittakaḥ hi bheda grāhaḥ na ca abhāvaḥ pratyakṣa grāhyaḥ tena pratyakṣeṇa sattā mātram gṛhyate na bhedaḥ tat uktam

original: "gavyaś ca vopajātan tu pratyakṣaṃ na viśiṣyate" (|)
analyzed: gavyaḥ ca vā upajātan tu pratyakṣam na viśiṣyate

original: ity ata āha – nāyam ityādi | tasyety abhedavādinaḥ | buddhipratibhāsabhedo buddher ākārabhedaḥ | viruddhadharmādhyāsaś ceti pṛthagutpattivināśādikaḥ | sati vā tasmin pratibhāsādibhede bhāvānām abhedebhyupagamyamāne na kvacid bhedaḥ syāt | lokapratītaś ca bhedaḥ | tathā cetyabhede sati ayaṃ pratibhāga iti pratibhāsādiprabhāgaḥ | ekātmavat |
analyzed: iti atas āha na ayam ityādi tasya iti abheda vādinaḥ buddhi pratibhāsa bhedaḥ buddheḥ ākāra bhedaḥ viruddha dharma adhyāsaḥ ca iti pṛthak utpatti vināśa ādikaḥ sati vā tasmin pratibhāsa ādi bhede bhāvānām abheda abhyupagamyamāne na kvacid bhedaḥ syāt loka pratītaḥ ca bhedaḥ tathā ca iti abhede sati ayam pratibhāgaḥ iti pratibhāsa ādi prabhāgaḥ eka ātma vat

original: yathaikasmin sukhātmani na pratibhāsādibhedas tadvat | tasmād ayaṃ bāhyādhyātmiko bhedo viśeṣa eva parasparavilakṣaṇa eva | kiṃbhūtaḥ (|) bhinnapratibhāsādiḥ (p.330) | bhinnaḥ pratibhāsādir yeti vigrahaḥ |
analyzed: yathā ekasmin sukha ātmani na pratibhāsa ādi bhedaḥ tadvat tasmāt ayam bāhya ādhyātmikaḥ bhedaḥ viśeṣaḥ eva paraspara vilakṣaṇaḥ eva kiṃbhūtaḥ bhinna pratibhāsa ādiḥ bhinnaḥ pratibhāsa ādiḥ yā iti vigrahaḥ

original: nirvikalpakabodhena dvayātmakasyāpi vastuno grahaṇād abhedepīti ced āha – na cātretyādi | atreti bhedeṣu | aparam iti dvitīyaṃ | yadvalenābhinnapratibhāsabalena | tato viśeṣa eva bheda eva | na tv abhedosti | sa eva viśeṣo vastu |
analyzed: nirvikalpaka bodhena dvaya ātmakasya api vastunaḥ grahaṇāt abhedaḥ api iti ced āha na ca atra ityādi atra iti bhedeṣu aparam iti dvitīyam yad valena abhinna pratibhāsa balena tatas viśeṣaḥ eva bhedaḥ eva na tu saḥ eva viśeṣaḥ vastu

original: ye tv apare sāmānyadharmā vastutvādayas tasyaiva vyāvṛttayaḥ kalpitāḥ | (173-74)
analyzed: ye tu apare sāmānya dharmāḥ vastu tva ādayaḥ tasya eva vyāvṛttayaḥ kalpitāḥ

original: tatkāryam ityādi | kāryādipadasāmānyādhikaraṇyān napuṃsakaṃ | anyathā viśeśasya prakrāntatvāt sa iti syāt | tad eva viśeṣarūpaṃ kāryaṃ kāraṇaṃ coktan tad eva svalakṣaṇam ucyate (|) tattyāgāptiphalā iti tasyaiva viśeṣasya heyasyopādeyasya vā yathākramaṃ tyāga āptiś ca phalaṃ yāsāmpravṛttīnāntāsthoktāḥ | sa cārthakriyākārī viśeṣa eva |
analyzed: tat kāryam ityādi kārya ādi pada sāmānya adhikaraṇyāt napuṃsakam anyathā saḥ iti syāt tat eva viśeṣa rūpam kāryam kāraṇam ca uktan tat eva sva lakṣaṇam ucyate tad tyāga āpti phalāḥ iti tasya eva viśeṣasya heyasya upādeyasya vā yathākramam tyāgaḥ āptiḥ ca phalam sa ca arthakriyā kārī viśeṣaḥ eva

original: tasyaiveti viśeṣasyāparasmād vijātīyād bhedo vyāvṛttimātraṃ | na tu vastubhūtaṃ kiñcit sāmānyaṃ nāma | (174-75)
analyzed: tasya eva iti viśeṣasya aparasmāt vijātīyāt bhedaḥ vyāvṛtti mātram na tu vastu bhūtam kiñcid sāmānyam nāma

original: yadi hi syāt tadupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptam bhedavyatirekiṇopalabhyeta | hi yasmāt | na hi tasya sāmānyasyārthatve vastutve sati dṛśyasya sataḥ | rūpānupalakṣaṇaṃ svarūpagrahaṇaṃ yuktaṃ | kasmāt | tadupalakṣaṇakṛtatvāt sāmānyopalakṣaṇakṛtatvād bhedeṣu bhedapratyayasya | na hi svayam agṛhītam paratra jñanahetuḥ |
analyzed: yadi hi syāt tat upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptam bheda vyatirekiṇā upalabhyeta hi yasmāt na hi tasya sāmānyasya artha tve vastu tve sati dṛśyasya sataḥ rūpa anupalakṣaṇam sva rūpa grahaṇam yuktam kasmāt tad upalakṣaṇa kṛta tvāt sāmānya upalakṣaṇa kṛta tvāt bhedeṣu bheda pratyayasya na hi svayam agṛhītam paratra jñana hetuḥ

original: evan tāvat mīmāṃsakādimatena prātibhāsikaṃ sāmānyaṃ nirākṛtyānumānikam api pūrvoktaṃ sāṃkhyamatena nirākarttum āha – api cetyādi | yathā sāṃkhyasya bhedāviśeṣepi na sarvaṃ sarvasādhanaṃ | tathā bauddhasya bhedāviśeṣepi na sarvaṃ sarvasādhanaṃ | kasya punaś codyasyāyaṃ samādhir ity āha – yad uktam ityādi |
analyzed: evam tāvat mīmāṃsaka ādi matena prātibhāsikam sāmānyam nirākṛtya ānumānikam api pūrva uktam sāṃkhya matena nirākarttum āha api ca ityādi yathā sāṃkhyasya bheda aviśeṣe api na sarvam sarva sādhanam tathā bauddhasya bheda aviśeṣe api na sarvam sarva sādhanam kasya punar codyasya ayam samādhiḥ iti āha yat uktam ityādi

original: tajjanakasvabhāvād iti (|) (p.331) śālyaṅkurajananasvabhāvād bhinnaḥ pṛthivyādiḥ | asyety aṅkurasya | janakatve vābhyupagamyamāne bhedasyāviśeṣāt sarvo janakaḥ syād iti | atra codye uktam evottaraṃ | idan tu dvitīyam ucyate | kiṃ punaruktam ityāha – yadītyādi | pratiniyatakāryajanakājanakatvalakṣaṇo viśeṣo na syāt (175-76)
analyzed: tad janaka svabhāvāt iti śāli aṅkura janana svabhāvāt bhinnaḥ pṛthivī ādiḥ asya iti aṅkurasya janaka tve vā abhyupagamyamāne bhedasya aviśeṣāt sarvaḥ janakaḥ syāt iti atra codye uktam eva uttaram idan tu dvitīyam ucyate kim punar uktam iti āha yadi ityādi pratiniyata kārya janaka ajanaka tva lakṣaṇaḥ viśeṣaḥ na syāt

original: bhedamātretyādinā vyācaṣṭe | hetur upādānakāraṇaṃ | pratyayās sahakāriṇaḥ (|) svehetupratyayāḥ svahetupratyayās tair niyamito viśiṣṭakāryanirvarttanasamarthaḥ kṛtaḥ svabhāvo yeṣān te tathoktāḥ | tadbhāvas tasmāt | nānya ity akārakābhimatā na kārakā syuḥ | kiṅkāraṇam (|) atatsvabhāvatvāt | atatkāryajananasvabhāvatvāt | tasyety ekasya traiguṇyasya |
analyzed: bheda mātra ityādinā vyācaṣṭe hetuḥ upādānakāraṇam pratyayāḥ sahakāriṇaḥ sve hetu pratyayāḥ sva hetu pratyayāḥ taiḥ niyamitaḥ viśiṣṭa kārya nirvarttana samarthaḥ kṛtaḥ svabhāvaḥ yeṣān te tathā uktāḥ tad bhāvaḥ tasmāt na anyaḥ iti akāraka abhimatāḥ na syuḥ kiṅkāraṇam atatsvabhāva tvāt atatkārya janana svabhāva tvāt tasya iti ekasya traiguṇyasya

original: tatravety ekasminn neva kārye | tatheti tenaivābhinnena prakāreṇa | tathāpi yadā śālibījaṃ śālyaṅkuraṃ janayati tadaiva na yavavījaṃ śālyaṅkuraṃ janayati | yaś ca śālybījasyātmā | sa eva yavabījasyety ekatraikasya kriyākriye prasajyete | (p.332) traiguṇyasya tena tena śālivījādisanniveśena bhedopy asti | ato bhedāt kasyacid kriyā cet |

original: vyatireke cetyādinārtham āha – bhedasāmānyayor ajanyajanakatvena sambandhābhāvāt | bhavati ca tayos sambandhitayā pratītis tasmād bhrāntatvam uktam iti "na syāt sāmānyabhedadhīr" ity atrāntare (1|171) | (180-81)
analyzed: vyatireke ca ityādinā artham āha bheda sāmānyayoḥ ajanya janaka tvena sambandha abhāvāt bhavati ca tayoḥ sambandhi tayā pratītiḥ tasmāt bhrānta tvam uktam iti na syāt sāmānya bheda dhīḥ iti atra antare

original: (p.336) evamūrdhvasāmānyavādaṃ digambarādyabhimataṃ | tiryakisāmānyavādañ ca sāṃkhyādyabhimataṃ sādhāraṇadūṣaṇena nirākṛtya punastiryaksāmānyavadām eva dūṣayitum āha – api cetyādi |
analyzed: evam ūrdhva sāmānya vādam digambara ādi abhimatam tiryaki sāmānya vādam ca sāṃkhya ādi abhimatam sādhāraṇa dūṣaṇena nirākṛtya punar tiryak sāmānya vadām eva dūṣayitum āha api ca ityādi

original: etad uktam bhavati (|) arthakriyārthinaḥ sāmānyaviṣayabhedābhedacintayā na kiñcit prayojanam arthakriyārahitatvāt | kintu | yamātmānam arthakriyāyogyaṃ punaskṛtyālambanīkṛtya | tatsādhyaphalavāñ chāvān | tenātmanā yatsādhyam phalan tadabhilāpāṣāt | ayaṃ puruṣaḥ pravartate | tadāśrayāv arthakriyāsamarthādhiṣṭhānau bhedābhedau ciṃtyete |
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati arthakriyā arthinaḥ sāmānya viṣaya bheda abheda cintayā na kiñcid prayojanam arthakriyā rahita tvāt kintu yam ātmānam arthakriyā yogyam punaskṛtya ālambanīkṛtya tad sādhya phalavān śāvān tena ātmanā yat sādhyam phalan tad abhilāpāt ayam puruṣaḥ pravartate tad āśrayau arthakriyā samartha adhiṣṭhānau bheda abhedau ciṃtyete

original: tasya cārthakriyāyogyasya svātmanā svena rūpeṇa bheda ātyantakosty eva | vyāvṛttyā ca vijātīyavyāvṛttena rūpeṇa sāmānyatāsty evādhyavasitaikatvarūpayā | iyataivārthakriyārthino bhedābhedacintā samāptā | tatorthakriyākāriṇaḥ sāmānyasya kim svalakṣaṇe bhedābhedacintayeti | (181-82)
analyzed: tasya ca arthakriyā yogyasya sva ātmanā svena rūpeṇa bhedaḥ eva vyāvṛttyā ca vijātīya vyāvṛttena rūpeṇa sāmānyatā asti eva adhyavasita eka tva rūpayā iyatā eva arthakriyā arthinaḥ bheda abheda cintā samāptā tatas ṛthakriyā kāriṇaḥ sāmānyasya kim sva lakṣaṇe bheda abheda cintayā iti

original: nanu cārthakriyārthinaḥ puruṣasya vyāvṛttyāpi samānatāyāḥ kimprayojanam arthakriyārahitatvāt |
analyzed: nanu ca arthakriyā arthinaḥ puruṣasya vyāvṛttyā api samāna tāyāḥ kimprayojanam arthakriyā rahita tvāt

original: sattyaṃ (|) svalakṣaṇāny eva vyāvṛttyā sāmānyam ucyate śabdāt tatraikatvādhyavasāyena pravṛttir yathāsyādity adoṣaḥ |
analyzed: sattyam sva lakṣaṇāni eva vyāvṛttyā sāmānyam ucyate śabdāt tatra ekatva adhyavasāyena pravṛttiḥ yathā asyāt iti adoṣaḥ

original: atha syāt svalakṣaṇam eva svalakṣaṇāntarānuyāyīti kiṃ parikalpitayā vyāvṛttyety āha – svalakṣaṇānām parasparam bhedāt | yadi ghaṭārūpam paṭe syād udakāharaṇārthī paṭepi pravartteta | tad āha – pravṛttyādītyādi | ādiśabdāt tulyotpattinirodhādiprasaṅgaḥ |
analyzed: atha syāt sva lakṣaṇam eva sva lakṣaṇa antara anuyāyi iti kim parikalpitayā vyāvṛttyā iti āha sva lakṣaṇānām parasparam bhedāt yadi ghaṭa ārūpam paṭe syāt udaka āharaṇa arthī paṭe api pravartteta tat āha pravṛtti ādi ityādi ādi śabdāt tulya utpatti nirodha ādi prasaṅgaḥ

original: sarva evetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | viśeṣam evārthakriyāyogyaṃ svabhāvākhyam ātmabhūtam ity arthaḥ | kasya bhavasya vastunodhikṛtya pravartate | sa eva hīty arthakriyākārī viśeṣaḥ | tatheti | gaur ityādiśabdaiḥ | arthakriyārthī hi svalakṣaṇapratipādanābhiprāya eva śabdaṃ prayuṅkto dṛśyavikalpyayor ekīkṛtya | pratipattāpi tathaiva pratipadyate (p.337) |
analyzed: sarve eva ityādinā vyācaṣṭe viśeṣam eva arthakriyā yogyam svabhāva ākhyam ātma bhūtam iti arthaḥ kasya bhavasya vastunā adhikṛtya pravartate saḥ eva hi iti arthakriyā kārī viśeṣaḥ tathā iti gauḥ ityādi śabdaiḥ arthakriyā arthī hi sva lakṣaṇa pratipādana abhiprāyaḥ eva śabdam prayuṅktaḥ dṛśya vikalpyayoḥ ekīkṛtya pratipattā api tathā eva pratipadyate pratipadyate pratipattā api tathā eva pratipadyate pratipadyate pratipadyate pratipadyate pratip

original: tato vyavaharttṛṇāmadhyavasāyavaśāc chabdavyāpārāpekṣayaitad uktaṃ | śabdo tu jñāna svalakṣaṇapratibhāso nāstīti svalakṣaṇam avācyam uktam ity adoṣaḥ |
analyzed: tatas vyavaharttṛṇām adhyavasāya vaśāt śabda vyāpāra apekṣayā etat uktam tu sva lakṣaṇa pratibhāsaḥ na asti iti sva lakṣaṇam avācyam uktam iti adoṣaḥ

original: dravyādayas tu na tatreti | gaur ityādiśabdair gavādicodanāyāṃ | kasmāt yathāsvaṃ dravyatvādiśabdais teṣāṅ gavādeḥ pṛthagabhidhānāt godravyam ityādiṇā | kathan tarhi gaur ityādipadaprayoge sattādravyatvādayaḥ pratīyanta ity āha – arthasyetyādi | arthasya gavādeḥ | tena sattvadravyatvādinā 'vyabhicārāt | tatorthād gatiḥ sāmānyānāṃ syāt |
analyzed: dravya ādayaḥ tu na tatra iti gauḥ ityādi śabdaiḥ gavādi codanāyām kasmāt yathāsvam dravya tva ādi śabdaiḥ teṣām gavādeḥ pṛthak abhidhānāt go dravyam ityādiṇā kathan tarhi gauḥ ityādi pada prayoge sattā dravya tva ādayaḥ pratīyante iti āha arthasya ityādi arthasya gavādeḥ tena sattva dravya tva ādinā vyabhicārāt tatas ṛthāt gatiḥ sāmānyānām syāt

original: na tu viśeṣaśabdaḥ sāmānye vyāpriyate | nirloṭhitaṃ caitadācāryadiṅnāgena sāmānyaparīkṣādau yathā na viśeṣaśabdānāṃ sāmānye vṛttir iti |
analyzed: na tu viśeṣa śabdaḥ sāmānye vyāpriyate nirloṭhitam ca etat ācārya diṅnāgena sāmānya parīkṣā ādau yathā na viśeṣa śabdānām sāmānye vṛttiḥ iti

original: atra codyate | kasya punaḥ sāmānyasya viśeṣeṇāvyabhicāraḥ | yattāvat paraparikalpitan nāsty eva | yac cānyavyāvṛttilakṣaṇaṃ prasajyamātran tad api nāsty eva | nāpi vikalpabuddhipratibhāsino bāhyenāvyabhicārosti tasya svatantratvāt |
analyzed: atra codyate kasya punar sāmānyasya viśeṣeṇa avyabhicāraḥ yat tāvat para parikalpitat na asti eva yat ca anya vyāvṛtti lakṣaṇam tat api na asti eva na api vikalpa buddhi pratibhāsinaḥ bāhyena avyabhicāraḥ usti tasya svatantra tvāt

original: ucyate | svalakṣaṇam eva sajātīyavyāvṛttam viśeṣaḥ | tad eva vijātīyavyāvṛttim apekṣābhedenopāttaṃ sāmānyam ity ucyate | tataḥ sāmānyaviśeṣayor vastuta ekatvāt | kṛtakatvānityatvayor ivāvyabhicāraḥ | śabdavyāpārabhedāt tu kevalaṃ kvacicchābdī pratipattiḥ kvacidārthīty ucyate | tad iti tasmād ayaṃ puruṣaḥ |
analyzed: ucyate sva lakṣaṇam eva sajātīya vyāvṛttam viśeṣaḥ tat eva vijātīya vyāvṛttim apekṣā bhedena upāttam sāmānyam iti ucyate tatas sāmānya viśeṣayoḥ vastutas ekatvāt kṛtaka tva anitya tvayoḥ iva avyabhicāraḥ śabda vyāpāra bhedāt tu kevalam kvacid śābdī pratipattiḥ kvacid ārthī iti ucyate tat iti tasmāt ayam puruṣaḥ

original: gavādiśabdapratyupasthāpitaṅ gavādiśabdasannidhāpitam artham arthakriyāśrayaṃ | arthāntarasya sāmānyasyopanyāsena bhedasāmānyākāratayā dvimukhā buddhir yasya sa tathoktaḥ | yosya gavāder ātmā svabhāvaḥ | ananyabhāvasādhāraṇas sa eva svabhāvaḥ śabdacodita iti vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ |
analyzed: go ādi śabda pratyupasthāpitaṅ go ādi śabda sannidhāpitam artham arthakriyā āśrayam artha antarasya sāmānyasya upanyāsena bheda sāmānya ākāra tayā dvimukhā buddhiḥ yasya sa tathā uktaḥ yaḥ asya go ādeḥ ātmā svabhāvaḥ ananya bhāva sādhāraṇaḥ saḥ eva svabhāvaḥ śabda coditaḥ iti vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ

original: yam arthaṃ sāsnādimanttaṃ puraskṛtyālambanīkṛtya viśiṣṭārthakriyārthī | tam evāha – yathetyādi | yathā gorvāhadehādāvarthī ggāmadhikṛtya pravartate | anyasambavina iti goranyasmin naśve sambhavinorthārthī gāṃ puraskṛtya na pravarttata iti vākyārthaḥ samarthanīyaḥ | korthonyasambhavīty āha – yathā yuddhapraveśa iti |
analyzed: yam artham sāsnādimanttam puraskṛtya ālambanīkṛtya viśiṣṭa artha kriyā arthī tam eva āha yathā ityādi yathā goḥ vāha deha ādau arthī ggām adhikṛtya pravartate anya sambavinaḥ iti goḥ anyasmin sambhavinā ūrtha arthī gām puraskṛtya na pravartate iti vākya arthaḥ samarthanīyaḥ kaḥ ūrthaḥ nya sambhavī iti āha yathā yuddha praveśaḥ iti

original: yathāsvam iti yasya yaḥ śabdo vācakaḥ | na dravyatvādi sāmānyaṃ | coditam iti liṅgavipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ | taccodanayā gavādīnāṃ gavādiśabdaiś codanayā | tadety arthakriyārthinaḥ (p.338) pravṛttikāle | prāptum anabhipretatvād dravyatvādisāmānyasyeti | vibhaktivipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ |
analyzed: yathāsvam iti yasya yaḥ śabdaḥ vācakaḥ na dravya tva ādi sāmānyam coditam iti liṅga vipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ tat codanayā gavādīnām gavādi śabdaiḥ codanayā tadā iti arthakriyā arthinaḥ pravṛtti kāle prāptum anabhipreta tvāt dravya tva ādi sāmānyasya iti vibhakti vipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ

original: kasmāt punargavādiśabdena dravyatvādisāmānyaṃ codayituṃ nābhipretam ity āha – gavādisamāveśād gavādiśabdasya gavādau loke saṃketitatvāt | gavādisvabhāvatvād dravyatvādisāmānyasya gavādicodanayā 'bhidhānam iti ced āha – tadātmabhūtānāṃ ceti | gavādisvabhāvānāṃ dravyatvādisāmānyānāṃ gavādivedivānanvyayena hetunā tatreti tasya gavādibhedasya |
analyzed: kasmāt punar gavādi śabdena dravya tva ādi sāmānyam codayitum na abhipretam iti āha gavādi samāveśāt gavādi śabdasya gavādau loke saṃketita tvāt gavādi svabhāva tvāt dravya tva ādi sāmānyasya gavādi codanayā abhidhānam iti ced āha tad ātma bhūtānām ca iti gavādi svabhāvānām dravya tva ādi sāmānyānām hetunā tatra iti tasya gavādi bhedasya

original: anubhayarūpatvād asāmānyaviśeṣarūpatvād eveti yāvat | tataś ca viśeṣa eva codyate |
analyzed: anubhaya rūpatvāt asāmānya viśeṣa rūpatvāt eva iti yāvat tatas ca viśeṣaḥ eva codyate

original: tad evāha – tam evetyādi | tam eva cānanyasādhāraṇam bhāvam arthakriyārthī puruṣo bhedābhedaprakāraiḥ paryanuyuṅkte | anyāpohavādinopi vyāvṛttilakṣaṇo dravyatvādyabhedaḥ svalakṣaṇām iṣṭas tato 'tyantabhedo viśeṣāṇāṃ viruddha ity ata āha – tasyetyādi |
analyzed: tat eva āha tam eva ityādi tam eva ca ananya sādhāraṇam bhāvam arthakriyā arthī puruṣaḥ bheda abheda prakāraiḥ paryanuyuṅkte anya apoha vādinaḥ api vyāvṛtti lakṣaṇaḥ dravya tva ādi abhedaḥ sva lakṣaṇām iṣṭaḥ tyanta bhedaḥ viśeṣāṇām viruddhaḥ iti atas āha tasya ityādi

original: tasyārthakriyākāriṇorthasya bhede prakṛtyā sthite sati vyāvṛttilakṣaṇo dravyatvādyabhedosya viśeṣasyābādhaka eva | tasya kalpitatvāt | tasmāt pāramārthiko bhedaḥ | svalakṣaṇānām upakalpitam ekatvam anena ca prakāreṇa bhedābhedāviśiṣṭāv asmākaṃ (|) tad eva darśayann āha – sarvatretyādi | svabhāvena bhedaḥ svajātīyavijātīyāt |
analyzed: tasya arthakriyā kāriṇā ṛthasya bhede prakṛtyā sthite sati vyāvṛtti lakṣaṇaḥ dravya tva ādi abhedaḥ usya viśeṣasya ābādhakaḥ eva tasya kalpita tvāt tasmāt pāramārthikaḥ bhedaḥ sva lakṣaṇānām upakalpitam ekatvam anena ca prakāreṇa bheda abheda aviśiṣṭau asmākam tat eva darśayan āha sarvatra ityādi svabhāvena bhedaḥ sva jātīya vijātīyāt

original: sāmānyasya ca vyāvṛttilakṣaṇasyābhyupagamād iti sambandhaḥ |
analyzed: sāmānyasya ca vyāvṛtti lakṣaṇasya abhyupagamāt iti sambandhaḥ

original: na vyāvṛttirūpeṇa sāmānyenābhedaḥ kintu vastubhūtenaiveti ced āha – svabhāvabhūtasyetyādi | vastubhūtasya sāmānyasyābheda iti vyaktibhyonarthāntaratve | uktam iti sāmānyād avyatirekād bhedānāmaikyaṃ | bhedavad eva vā sāmānyasyāpy anekatvam ity uktaṃ prāk | na sāmānyadvāreṇa bhedānām aikyam ity ucyate |
analyzed: na vyāvṛtti rūpeṇa sāmānyena abhedaḥ kintu vastu bhūtena eva iti ced āha svabhāva bhūtasya ityādi vastu bhūtasya sāmānyasya abhedaḥ iti vyaktibhyaḥ nartha antara tve uktam iti sāmānyāt avyatirekāt bhedānām aikyam bheda vat eva vā sāmānyasya api anekatvam iti uktam prāk na sāmānya dvāreṇa bhedānām aikyam iti ucyate

original: kintu yosau viśeṣastenaivābheda ity āha – svātmanaivetyādi | svenaiva viśeṣarūpeṇa gavāśvādīnām abhede tad godravyaṃ nibandhanaṃ yasyā arthakriyāyā vāhadohādilakṣaṇāyās tayārthī puruṣaḥ (|) samam ity ubhayatrāpy avasitagavādibhāvaḥ | dvayor apīti gavi cāśve caiva |
analyzed: kintu yaḥ asau viśeṣaḥ tena eva abhedaḥ iti āha sva ātmanā eva ityādi svena eva viśeṣa rūpeṇa gavāśva ādīnām abhede tat go dravyam nibandhanam yasyāḥ arthakriyāyāḥ vāha doha ādi lakṣaṇāyāḥ tayā arthī puruṣaḥ samam iti ubhayatra api avasita gavādi bhāvaḥ dvayoḥ api iti gavi ca aśve ca eva

original: yasmād ekopi hi kāraṇatvenābhimato gopadārthas tām arthakriyām vāhadohādisvabhāvāṃ | (p.339) tatsvabhāvatvāt tadarthakriyākaraṇasvabhāvatvād eva karoti | tadanyasyāpi tasmād godravyād anyasyāpy aśvasya tadvāhadehādikaraṇasvabhāvatvan tulyam iti sopy aśvaḥ gosādhyām arthakriyāṃ kin na karoti ||0|| (182-83)
analyzed: yasmāt ekaḥ api hi kāraṇa tvena abhimataḥ go padārthaḥ tām arthakriyām vāha doha ādi svabhāvām tad svabhāva tvāt tad arthakriyā karaṇa svabhāva tvāt eva karoti tad anyasya api tasmāt go dravyāt anyasya api aśvasya tad vāha deha ādi karaṇa svabhāva tvan tulyam iti saḥ upi aśvaḥ go sādhyām arthakriyām kin na karoti

original: etenaiveti sarvasyārthasya bhedasādhanena | ahrīkā nagnatayā nirlajjāḥ kṣapaṇakāḥ | ayuktābhidhānasya kutsitatvāt kim apīty āha – aślīlaṅgrāmyaṃ | sarvaḥ sarvasvabhāvo na ca sarvaḥ sarvasvabhāva iti yat pralapanti pratikṣiptan tad api tasmād ekāntasambhavāt | ekasyaivāntasyātyantabhedaprakārasya sambhavāt | (183-84)
analyzed: etena eva iti sarvasya arthasya bheda sādhanena ahrīkāḥ nagna tayā nirlajjāḥ kṣapaṇakāḥ ayukta abhidhānasya kutsita tvāt kim api iti āha aślīlam grāmyam sarvaḥ sarva svabhāvaḥ na ca sarvaḥ sarva svabhāvaḥ iti yat pralapanti tat api tasmāt ekānta sambhavāt ekasya eva antasya atyanta bheda prakārasya sambhavāt

original: nanu digamvarāṇāṃ sarvaṃ sarvātmakaṃ na sarvaṃ sarvātmakam iti naitaddarśanan tatkimartham idam ācāryeṇocyate |
analyzed: nanu digamvarāṇām sarvam sarva ātmakam na sarvam sarva ātmakam iti tat kimartham idam ācāryeṇa ucyate

original: sattyaṃ (|) yathā darśanan tv "atyantabhedābhedau ca syātām" (1|178) ityādinā pūrvam eva dūṣītaṃ |
analyzed: sattyam yathā tu atyanta bheda abhedau ca syātām ityādinā pūrvam eva

original: yatpuranaretad uktaṃ (|) tad yathā kaṭakeyūrādiṣu suvarṇṇapratyayasyānuyāyinas sadbhāvās suvarṇṇatvasāmānyaṃ kalpyate | tathā ghaṭapaṭādiṣu dravyatvādipratyayasyānvayinaḥ sadbhāvād dravyatvasāmānyam ekaṃ kinneṣyate | na ceṣyate 'bhinnapratyayasadbhāvepi tathā kaṭakakeyūrādiṣu sāmānyakalpanā mābhūd ity evamparametat |
analyzed: yat puranar etat uktam tat yathā kaṭa keyūra ādiṣu suvarṇṇa pratyayasya anuyāyinaḥ sadbhāvāt suvarṇṇa tva sāmānyam kalpyate tathā ghaṭa paṭa ādiṣu dravya tva ādi pratyayasya anvayinaḥ sadbhāvāt dravya tva sāmānyam ekam kim nā iṣyate na ca iṣyate bhinna pratyaya sadbhāve pi tathā kaṭaka keyūra ādiṣu sāmānya kalpanā mā abhūt iti evamparam etat

original: (p.340) etad uktam bhavati | yadāvasthātadvatos sarvātmano 'bhedovasthānāt tu parasparam bhedas tadāyan doṣas tadāha – tadanye veti | tasya svabhāvabhedasya parasparānvaye vā | dadhyādisvabhāvasya dravyasyoṣṭrādiṣu tādātmyenānugamād iti yāvat |
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati yadā avasthā tadvatoḥ sarvātmanaḥ bhedaḥ avasthānāt tu parasparam bhedaḥ tadā ayan doṣaḥ tat āha tad anye vā iti tasya svabhāva bhedasya paraspara anvaye vā dadhi ādi svabhāvasya dravyasya uṣṭra ādiṣu tādātmyena anugamāt iti yāvat

original: sarvasyobhayarūpatvaṃ | ubhayagrahaṇam anekatvopalakṣaṇārthan tasmin sati tadviśaṣasya uṣṭra uṣṭra eva na dadhi | dadhi dadhyeva noṣṭra ityevaṃ lakṣaṇasya nirākṛteḥ | dadhi khādetyevaṃ coditaḥ puruṣaḥ kimuṣṭraṃ khādituṃ nābhidhāvati | uṣṭropi dadhyabhinnād dravyatvād avyatirekāt syād dadhi | nāpi sa eveti | uṣṭra evoṣṭra ityekāntavādaḥ |
analyzed: sarvasya ubhaya rūpa tvam ubhaya grahaṇam tasmin sati tad viśaṣasya uṣṭraḥ uṣṭraḥ eva na dadhi dadhi dadhi eva na uṣṭraḥ iti evam lakṣaṇasya nirākṛteḥ dadhi khāda iti evam coditaḥ puruṣaḥ kim uṣṭram khāditum na abhidhāvati uṣṭraḥ upi dadhi abhinnāt dravya tvāt avyatirekāt syāt dadhi na api saḥ eva iti uṣṭraḥ eva uṣṭraḥ iti ekānta vādaḥ

original: yenānyopi dadhyādikaḥ syād uṣṭraḥ tathā dadhyapi syād uṣṭraḥ | uṣṭrābhinnena dravyatvena dadhnas tādātmyenābhisambandhāt | nāpi tadeveti dadhyeva dadhi | yenānyad apy uṣṭrādikaṃ syād dadhi | etena sarvasyobhayarūpatvaṃ vyākhyātaṃ |
analyzed: yena anyaḥ api dadhi ādikaḥ syāt uṣṭraḥ tathā dadhi api syāt uṣṭraḥ uṣṭra abhinnena dravya tvena dadhnaḥ tādātmyena abhisambandhāt na api tat eva iti dadhi eva dadhi yena anyat api uṣṭra ādikam syāt dadhi etena sarvasya ubhaya rūpa tvam vyākhyātam

original: tadviśeṣanirākṛter ity etadanayor ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | ubhayathāpi dadhyuṣṭraviśeṣaḥ syāt | dadhirūpābhāvo veṣṭre syāt | uṣṭrarūpaṃ vā dadhyasambhavi yady uṣṭrasvarūpa eva niyatam bhavet | evaṃ dadhnopi vācyaṃ |
analyzed: tad viśeṣa nirākṛteḥ iti etat anayoḥ ityādinā vyācaṣṭe ubhayathā api dadhi uṣṭra viśeṣaḥ syāt dadhi rūpa abhāvaḥ vā iṣṭre syāt uṣṭra rūpam vā dadhi asambhavi yadi uṣṭra sva rūpe eva niyatam bhavet evam dadhnaḥ api vācyam

original: ādyasya tāvadasambhavas tad ityādinā kathyate | tadevamanekayor dhadhyuṣṭrayor na kaścid viśeṣa iti sambandhaḥ | ekasyāpīti dadhna uṣṭrasya vā kasyacit tadrūpābhāvasyeti | uṣṭrarūpābhāvasya dadhirūpābhāvasya cābhāvāt |
analyzed: ādyasya tāvat asambhavaḥ tat ityādinā kathyate tat evam anekayoḥ dhadhi uṣṭrayoḥ na kaścid viśeṣaḥ iti sambandhaḥ ekasya api iti dadhnaḥ uṣṭrasya vā kasyacid tad rūpa abhāvasya iti uṣṭra rūpa abhāvasya dadhi rūpa abhāvasya ca abhāvāt

original: dvitīyasyāpi prakārābhāvam āha – svarūpasyetyāpi | atadbhāvino dadhyabhāvina uṣṭrasvarūpasya | uṣṭrābhāvino vā dadhisvarūpasya | svaniyatasya uṣṭrasvabhāvaniyatasya | dadhisvabhāvaniyatasya cābhāvāt (184-85)
analyzed: dvitīyasya api prakāra abhāvam āha sva rūpasya iti āpi atad bhāvinaḥ dadhi abhāvinaḥ uṣṭra sva rūpasya uṣṭra abhāvinaḥ vā dadhi sva rūpasya sva niyatasya uṣṭra svabhāva niyatasya dadhi svabhāva niyatasya ca abhāvāt

original: athāsti dadhyuṣṭrayor atiśayaḥ kaścid yenātiśayena dadhi khādeti coditaḥ puruṣo bhedena varttate | uṣṭraparihāreṇa dadhnyeva pravartatte |
analyzed: atha asti dadhi uṣṭrayoḥ atiśayaḥ kaścid yena atiśayena dadhi khāda iti coditaḥ puruṣaḥ bhedena varttate uṣṭra parihāreṇa dadhni eva

original: etad uktam bhavati | yathā dadhyuṣṭrayoḥ parasparaṃ svarūpam bhinnan tathā dravyaparyāyayor (p.341) lakṣaṇabhedād bhedo yadīṣyate tadā sa eva rūpātiśayo dadhi | sa conyatroṣṭre nāsti | nāpi dravyatvaṃ dadhyādivyatiriktaṃ pratibhāsate | ity anena dvāreṇānubhayaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣarahitaṃ sarvam vastu | paraṃ kevalaṃ | ekatvan tu kalpitaṃ |
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati yathā dadhi uṣṭrayoḥ parasparam sva rūpam tathā dravya paryāyayoḥ lakṣaṇa bhedāt bhedaḥ yadi iṣyate tadā saḥ eva rūpa atiśayaḥ dadhi sa ca unyatra uṣṭre na asti na api dravya tvam dadhi ādi vyatiriktam pratibhāsate iti anena dvāreṇa anubhayam sāmānya viśeṣa rahitam sarvam vastu param kevalam eka tvam tu kalpitam

original: anayor iti dadhyuṣṭrayoḥ | tathā codita iti dadhi khādeti coditaḥ | kṣīravikāro dadhi | nānyatrety uṣṭre | sa evātiśayo dadhi | kimbhūtaḥ (|) arthakriyārthipravṛttiviṣayaḥ | dadhisādhyārthakriyā tayā yorthī puruṣas tasya pravṛttiviṣayaḥ (|) kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) tatphaletyādi | dadhisādhyaṃ phalaṃ tad eva viśiṣyatenyasmād iti viśeṣaḥ |
analyzed: anayoḥ iti dadhi uṣṭrayoḥ tathā coditaḥ iti dadhi khāda iti coditaḥ kṣīra vikāraḥ dadhi na anyatra iti uṣṭre saḥ eva atiśayaḥ dadhi kimbhūtaḥ arthakriyā arthi pravṛtti viṣayaḥ dadhi sādhya arthakriyā tayā yaḥ ṛthī puruṣaḥ tasya pravṛtti viṣayaḥ kiṅkāraṇam tad phala ityādi dadhi sādhyam phalam tat eva viśiṣyate nyasmāt iti viśeṣaḥ

original: tasyopādānabhāvo hetubhāvas tena lakṣitaḥ svabhāvo yasya vastunaḥ | tad eva dadhīti kṛtvā | sa ca tādṛśa ity anantarokto dadhisvabhāvaḥ | anyatrety uṣṭre | kasmād (|) dadhyarthinas tatroṣṭre pravṛttyabhāvāt | (185-86)
analyzed: tasya upādāna bhāvaḥ hetu bhāvaḥ tena lakṣitaḥ svabhāvaḥ yasya vastunaḥ tat eva dadhi iti kṛtvā sa ca tādṛśaḥ iti anantara uktaḥ dadhi svabhāvaḥ anyatra iti uṣṭre kasmāt dadhi arthinaḥ tatra uṣṭre pravṛtti abhāvāt

original: sarvātmatva ity ekarūpatve satīty arthaḥ | bhinno niyatārthau | dhīdhvanī | jñānaṃ śabdasya | tadbhāvād bhinnabuddhiśabdābhāvāt | bhedānāṃ saṃhāravādasya | ekīkaraṇavādasyāsambhavaḥ | bhedena gṛhītayoḥ śrutayor vā | ekatvenopasaṃhāro nirdeśaḥ | syād uṣṭro dadhītyādi |
analyzed: sarva ātma tve iti eka rūpa tve sati iti arthaḥ bhinnaḥ niyata arthau dhī dhvanī jñānam śabdasya tad bhāvāt bhinna buddhi śabda abhāvāt bhedānām saṃhāra vādasya ekīkaraṇa vādasya asambhavaḥ bhedena gṛhītayoḥ śrutayoḥ vā ekatvena upasaṃhāraḥ nirdeśaḥ syāt uṣṭraḥ dadhi ityādi

original: soyam ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | kvacid api dadhnyuṣṭre vā pratiniyatam ekam ākāram apaśyan kathaṃ buddhyādhim ucyetārthān iti sambandhaḥ | kimviśiṣṭayā buddhyety āha – asaṃsṛṣṭetyādi | saṃsṛṣṭonyākāro yasminn arthe sa tathoktaḥ | sa yasyā buddher asti sā saṃsṛṣṭānyākāravatī | vibhaktārthagrāhiṇy eveti yāvat | abhilaped vā kathaṃ |
analyzed: saḥ ayam ityādinā vyācaṣṭe kvacid api dadhni uṣṭre vā pratiniyatam ekam ākāram apaśyan katham buddhyā ādhim ucyeta arthān iti sambandhaḥ kimviśiṣṭayā buddhyā iti āha asaṃsṛṣṭa ityādi saṃsṛṣṭaḥ anya ākāraḥ yasmin arthe sa tathā uktaḥ sa yasyāḥ buddheḥ asti sā saṃsṛṣṭa anya ākāravatī vibhakta artha grāhiṇī eva iti yāvat abhilapet vā katham abhilapet artha grāhiṇī eva iti yāvat abhilapet vā katham abhilapet artha grāhiṇī e

original: pratyarthaṃ prati(ni)yatasaṃketena dhvaninetyākṛtaṃ | kasmān nādhimucyetety āha – (p.342) vibhāgābhāvād bhāvānām iti | tatsaṃhāravāda iti bhedasaṃhāravādo na syāt (|) syād uṣṭraḥ syād dadhītyādikaḥ |
analyzed: pratyartham pratiniyata saṃketena dhvaninā iti ākṛtam kasmāt na adhimucyeta iti āha vibhāga abhāvāt bhāvānām iti tad saṃhāra vādaḥ iti bheda saṃhāra vādaḥ na syāt syāt uṣṭraḥ syāt dadhi iti ādikaḥ

original: atha punarasaṃsṛṣṭau dadhyuṣṭrau pratipadya saṃharet | syād uṣṭraḥ syād dadhīti | tadāpy ekarūpasaṃsargiṇyā | uṣṭrarūpaṇaiva dadhirūpeṇaiva vā saṃsargiṇyā buddher asaṃsṛṣṭākāragrāhiṇyā kvaciduṣṭre dadhani ca | pratiniyamāt tatpratibhāsabhedakṛta eva tayor dadhyuṣṭrayoḥ svabhāvabhedopi | ekāneketyādi | pratibhāsabhedasyānekavyavasthitir viṣayaḥ |
analyzed: atha punar asaṃsṛṣṭau dadhi uṣṭrau pratipadya saṃharet syāt uṣṭraḥ syāt dadhi iti tadā api eka rūpa saṃsargiṇyāḥ uṣṭra rūpaṇā eva dadhi rūpeṇa eva vā saṃsargiṇyāḥ buddheḥ asaṃsṛṣṭa ākāra grāhiṇyā kvacid uṣṭre dadhani ca pratiniyamāt tad pratibhāsa bheda kṛtaḥ eva tayoḥ dadhi uṣṭrayoḥ svabhāva bhedaḥ upi eka aneka ityādi pratibhāsa bhedasya aneka vyavasthitiḥ viṣayaḥ

original: ekavyavasthitiḥ pratibhāsabhedasyeti yojyaṃ | bhinnapratibhāsaviṣayau ca dadhyuṣṭrau tathā ca sati naika uṣṭro dadhi vā tadubhayarūpaḥ tadubhayan dadhyuṣṭrātmakaṃ rūpaṃ yadyeti vigrahaḥ | mithyāvāda eva syādvādaḥ ||0|| (186-87)
analyzed: eka vyavasthitiḥ pratibhāsa bhedasya iti yojyam bhinna pratibhāsa viṣayau ca dadhi uṣṭrau tathā ca sati na ekaḥ uṣṭraḥ dadhi vā tad ubhaya rūpaḥ dadhi uṣṭra ātmakam rūpam yadi eti vigrahaḥ mithyāvādaḥ eva syādvādaḥ

original: bhedalakṣaṇam iti vyāvṛttikṣaṇam vijātīyavyāvṛttāny eva svalakṣaṇāni sāmānyam ity ucyante | prakṛtyā svabhāvena | ādiśabdād udkādyāharaṇādyekaphalāḥ |
analyzed: bheda lakṣaṇam iti vyāvṛtti kṣaṇam vijātīya vyāvṛttāni eva sva lakṣaṇāni sāmānyam iti ucyante prakṛtyā svabhāvena ādi śabdāt udka ādi āharaṇa ādi eka phalāḥ

original: bhavatu nāmetyādinā cācāryaḥ parābhipram āśaṃkate | bhāvānām vastūnāṃ svabhāvabhedaḥ svabhāve naivānyasmād vyāvṛttiḥ | tatreti nirupākhyeṣu (|) kathaṃ svabhāvabhedaviṣayā vyāvṛttiviṣayāḥ śabdāḥ |
analyzed: bhavatu nāma ityādinā ca ācāryaḥ āśaṃkate bhāvānām vastūnām svabhāva bhedaḥ svabhāve na eva anyasmāt vyāvṛttiḥ tatra iti nirupākhyeṣu katham svabhāva bheda viṣayāḥ vyāvṛtti viṣayāḥ śabdāḥ

original: nanu nirupākhyeṣu śabdānāṃ pravṛttir eva nāsti tatkimartham idam āśaṃkatam iti kadācit paro brūte | tannirākaraṇārtham ācāryaḥ prāha – teṣv avaśyaṃ śabdapravṛttyā bhāvyaṃ | ya tu na cānyāpohāvādinā śakyam vaktun naiva nirupākhyeṣu śabdānāṃ pravṛttir iti | yatas teṣv avaśyaṃ śabdapravṛttyā bhāvyam iti codako brūta iti vyācakṣate |
analyzed: nanu nirupākhyeṣu śabdānām pravṛttiḥ eva na asti tat kimartham idam āśaṃkatam iti kadācid paraḥ brūte tad nirākaraṇa artham ācāryaḥ prāha teṣu avaśyam śabda pravṛttyā bhāvyam tu na ca anya apoha avādinā śakyam na eva nirupākhyeṣu śabdānām pravṛttiḥ iti yatas teṣu avaśyam śabda pravṛttyā bhāvyam iti codakaḥ brūte iti vyācakṣate

original: teṣām anena krameṇa deśakālaniṣedha eva sarvabhāveṣu kriyate | tathā sambandhasya svarūpaṇān abhidhānam uktaṃ | (p.343) evaṃ yatpunar etat tadarthaniṣedhe 'narthakaśabdāprayogāt | nirviṣayasya naño 'prayoga ity artottaram vakṣyata ityādi grantho vakṣyamāṇaś codakābhiprāyeṇāvācakaḥ syāt |
analyzed: teṣām anena krameṇa deśa kāla niṣedhaḥ eva sarva bhāveṣu kriyate tathā sambandhasya abhidhānam uktam evam yat punar etat tad artha niṣedhe narthaka śabda aprayogāt nirviṣayasya prayogaḥ iti arta uttaram vakṣyate ityādi granthaḥ vakṣyamāṇaḥ codaka abhiprāyeṇa avācakaḥ syāt

original: tasmād ācārya eva nirupākhyeṣu śabdapravṛttiṃ samarthayate "teṣv avaśyaṃ śabdapravṛttyā bhāvyam" ityādinā granthena | kasmād (|) kathaṃcijjñānaśabdatvenāvyavasthāpiteṣu nirupākhyeṣu sarvatrārtha vidhipratiṣedhe vāyogāt | yadi kvacid asata ākārasya viṣedhe jñānābhidhāne syātāṃ | tadā niṣiddhākāraparihṛterthe vidhiḥ syāt |
analyzed: tasmāt ācāryaḥ eva nirupākhyeṣu śabda pravṛttim samarthayate teṣu avaśyam śabda pravṛttyā bhāvyam ityādinā granthena kasmāt kathaṃcid jñāna śabda tvena avyavasthāpiteṣu nirupākhyeṣu sarvatra artha vidhi pratiṣedhe vā ayogāt yadi kvacid asataḥ ākārasya viṣedhe jñāna abhidhāne syātām tadā niṣiddha ākāra parihṛta īrthe vidhiḥ syāt

original: tathā ceti vidhipratiṣedhāve | anvayavyatirekau vidhipratiṣedhau āśrayo yasya vyavahārasya sa tathoktaḥ | tam eva vyavahārabhāvam uṣṇetyādinā 'ha | uṣṇasvabhāvognir ity anvayāśrayo vyavahāraḥ | nānuṣṇa iti vyatirekāśrayaḥ | ayam apy atiprasiddho lokavyavahāro na syād ity apiśabdenāha – uṣṇavyavasthā hy anuṣṇavyavacchedena (|)
analyzed: tathā ca iti vidhi pratiṣedhau anvaya vyatirekau vidhi pratiṣedhau āśrayaḥ yasya vyavahārasya sa tathā uktaḥ tam eva vyavahāra bhāvam uṣṇa ityādinā ha uṣṇa svabhāvaḥ ugniḥ iti anvaya āśrayaḥ vyavahāraḥ na anuṣṇaḥ iti vyatireka āśrayaḥ ayam api ati prasiddhaḥ loka vyavahāraḥ na syāt iti apiśabdena āha uṣṇa vyavasthā hi anuṣṇa vyavacchedena

original: tasya cānaṣṇasyoṣṇābhāvalakṣaṇasya kathañcid vyavasthānāt kathan tadvyavacchedeṇoṣṇaṃ vyavasthāpyeta | tadāha – svabhāvāntaretyādi | uṣṇābhāva evoṣṇasvabhāvād antaram vilakṣaṇan tadviraharūpeṇeti svabhāvāntaram uktaṃ | ata evāsata ity etad ghaṭate |

original: abhāvo nāstīty asyaivābhāvaśabdasya prayogo na syāt (|) kathañ ca na syād abhāvasyaivānabhyupagamāt | abhāvo hy asya vācyaḥ sa ca nābhyupagamyate | paraparikalpitasyābhāvasya pratiṣedha iti ced iṣṭas tāvad abhāvaviṣayaḥ śabdaḥ | tasmāt kathaṃcid abhāvavyavahāraṃ pravarttayatā 'vaśyam abhāvaviṣayā jñānaśabdā eṣṭavyāḥ |

original: etad uktam bhavati (|) abhāvaviṣayāṇāṃ śabdānāṃ bhāvasvarūpāgrāhakatvād apohaviṣayatvan tathā bhāvaviṣayāṇām api śābdānām bhāvasvarūpāgrāhakatvād apohaviṣayatvam eva (|) kevalaṃ kecic chabdā bhāvādhyavasāyād bhāvaviṣayāḥ kecidabhāvādhyavasāyād abhāvaviṣayā ucyante |
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati abhāva viṣayāṇām śabdānām bhāva svarūpa agrāhaka tvāt tathā bhāva viṣayāṇām api śābdānām bhāva svarūpa agrāhaka tvāt apoha viṣaya tvam eva kevalam kecid śabdāḥ bhāva adhyavasāyāt bhāva viṣayāḥ kecid abhāva adhyavasāyāt abhāva viṣayāḥ ucyante

original: vastuni vṛttir vyāpāro yeṣāṃ śabdānān teṣāṃ kiṃ rūpam abhidheyaṃ vidhirūpeṇa vastugrāhyamāhosvid bhedo 'nyavyāvṛttaḥ svabhāvodhyavasīyata iti śaṅkā syāt | abhāvas tu vivekalakṣaṇa iti svabhāvavirahalakṣaṇaḥ kasmān nimittīkarttavyasya rūpasya vastusvabhāvasya | tadbhāve tasya rūpasya sattayā hy abhāvayogāt |
analyzed: vastuni vṛttiḥ vyāpāraḥ yeṣām teṣām kim rūpam abhidheyam vidhi rūpeṇa vastu grāhyam āhosvit bhedaḥ svabhāvaḥ adhyavasīyate iti śaṅkā syāt abhāvaḥ tu viveka lakṣaṇaḥ iti svabhāva viraha lakṣaṇaḥ kasmāt nimittīkarttavyasya rūpasya vastu svabhāvasya tad bhāve tasya rūpasya sattayā hi abhāva yogāt

original: tasya rūpasya bhāvas tadbhāvaḥ sa eva lakṣaṇe yasya bhāvasya sa tathoktaḥ | ayam eva sa mukhyo vivekonyāpohaḥ | anyas tu gavādiśabdaviṣayopohanimittatvād apoha ity upacaritaḥ sarvabhāvavirahalakṣaṇaḥ | tasya vivekasya tathābhāvakhyāpina iti vivekarūpābhidhāyinaḥ || vivekaviṣayā ity anyāpohaviṣayā vikalpāś ca vivekaviṣayā iti sambandhaḥ |
analyzed: tasya rūpasya bhāvaḥ tad bhāvaḥ saḥ eva lakṣaṇe yasya bhāvasya sa tathā uktaḥ ayam eva sa mukhyaḥ vivekaḥ anya apohaḥ anyaḥ tu go ādi śabda viṣaya upoha nimitta tvāt apohaḥ iti upacaritaḥ sarva bhāva viraha lakṣaṇaḥ tasya vivekasya tathābhāva khyāpinaḥ iti viveka rūpa abhidhāyinaḥ viveka viṣayāḥ iti anya apoha viṣayāḥ vikalpāḥ ca viveka viṣayāḥ iti sambandhaḥ

original: te śabdā vikalpāś ca | ekaṃ vyāvṛttisamāśrayabhūtam vastu | pratisa(?śa)raṇam adhiṣṭhānaṃ yeṣāṃ śabdānāṃ vikalpānāñ ca | te tathoktāḥ | tathā hy akṛtakavyavacchedena yad eva kṛtakaśabdasya vikalpasya vādhiṣṭhānan tad evānityānātmādiśabdānām vikalpānāṃ ca | te tathābhūtā api bhinnaviṣayā eveti sambandhaḥ | kasmād yathāsvam ityādi |
analyzed: te śabdāḥ vikalpāḥ ca ekam vyāvṛtti samāśraya bhūtam vastu pratisaśaraṇam adhiṣṭhānam yeṣām śabdānām vikalpānām ca te tathā uktāḥ tathā hi akṛtaka vyavacchedena yat eva kṛtaka śabdasya vikalpasya vā adhiṣṭhānam tat eva anitya anātma ādi śabdānām vikalpānām ca te tathābhūtāḥ api bhinna viṣayāḥ eva iti sambandhaḥ kasmāt yathāsvam ityādi

original: yā vyāvṛttir yato vyavasthāpyate sā tasyā avadhiḥ | yathā kṛtakākhyasya vyavacchedasyākṛtakaḥ | evam anityatvalakṣaṇasya vyavacchedasya nitya ityādi | teṣāṃ yathāsvam avadhīnāṃ bhedās tair bhedair upakalpitā racitā anityatvādīnāṃ (p.348) vivekināṃ bhedāḥ parasparaṃ viśeṣāḥ |
analyzed: yā vyāvṛttiḥ yatas vyavasthāpyate sā tasyāḥ avadhiḥ yathā kṛtaka ākhyasya vyavacchedasya akṛtakaḥ evam anitya tva lakṣaṇasya vyavacchedasya nityaḥ ityādi teṣām yathāsvam avadhīnām bhedāḥ taiḥ bhedaiḥ upakalpitāḥ racitāḥ anitya tva ādīnām vivekinām bhedāḥ parasparam viśeṣāḥ

original: tair bhedair bhinneṣv iva vikalpabuddhau pratibhātsu pratibhāsamāneṣu dharmiṣu | teṣāṃ śabdānām vivekeṣu bhedeṣu vikalpānāṃ copasthāpanāt | yathākramaṃ vacakatvena grāhakatvena copaśleṣāt |
analyzed: taiḥ bhedaiḥ bhinneṣu iva vikalpa buddhau pratibhātsu pratibhāsamāneṣu dharmiṣu teṣām śabdānām vivekeṣu bhedeṣu vikalpānām ca upasthāpanāt yathākramam vacaka tvena grāhaka tvena ca upaśleṣāt

original: nanu ca kṛtakānityatvayor naivāvadhibhedo 'sti, akṛtakasyeva nityarūpatvāt. tataś ca pratijñārthaikadeśa eva hetuḥ. naiṣa doṣaḥ. yasmād? akṛtakasyāpi prāgbhāvasyānityatvāt. kṛtakatvāpi pradhvaṃsābhāvasya nityatvād asty evāvadhibhedaḥ |
analyzed: nanu ca kṛtaka anitya tvayoḥ na eva avadhi bhedaḥ u sti akṛtakasya iva nitya rūpa tvāt tatas ca pratijñā artha eka deśaḥ eva hetuḥ na eṣa doṣaḥ yasmāt akṛtakasya api prāgbhāvasya anitya tvāt kṛtaka tva api pradhvaṃsa abhāvasya nitya tvāt asti eva avadhi bhedaḥ

original: yad vā kāraṇena kṛtaḥ śabdo na bhavatīty asya samāropasya vyavacchedena kṛtako dvitīyādikṣaṇe sthāyitvasamāropavyavacchedenānitya ity ucyata ity asyevāvadhibhedaḥ | teneti yathoktena vyāvṛttibhedena svabhāvahetau svabhāvasyaiva sādhyasādhanabhāvepi na sādhyāsādhanayoḥ saṃsarga ekatvaṃ |
analyzed: yat vā kāraṇena kṛtaḥ śabdaḥ na bhavati iti asya samāropasya vyavacchedena kṛtakaḥ dvitīya ādi kṣaṇe sthāyi tva samāropa vyavacchedena anityaḥ iti ucyate iti asya iva avadhi bhedaḥ tena iti yathā uktena vyāvṛtti bhedena svabhāva hetau svabhāvasya eva sādhya sādhana bhāve pi na sādhya asādhanayoḥ saṃsargaḥ ekatvam

original: tataś ca yad uktaṃ svabhāvo sādhye pratijñārthaikadeśo hetuḥ syād iti sa doṣo nāstīty āha – tan neti. tad iti tasmād. sa cāyaṃ svabhāva iti sambandhaḥ. svabhāva ity avyatirikto dharmaḥ. sa kadācit sattvam anyo vā | yady api sattvam asti satsu ca kṛtakatvan tathāpi hetukṛtoyaṃ svabhāva ity etāvanmātravivākṣāyāṃ kṛtako hetur ucyate |
analyzed: tatas ca yat uktam sādhye pratijñā artha eka deśaḥ hetuḥ syāt iti sa doṣaḥ na asti iti āha tat na iti tat iti tasmāt sa ca ayam svabhāvaḥ iti sambandhaḥ svabhāvaḥ iti avyatiriktaḥ dharmaḥ sa kadācid sattvam anyaḥ vā yadi api sattvam asti satsu ca tathā api hetu kṛtaḥ yam svabhāvaḥ iti etāvat mātra vivākṣāyām kṛtakaḥ hetuḥ ucyate

original: na tu sāmarthyavivakṣāyām, prameyatvādivat. sāmarthyam asty etāvanmātravivakṣāyāñ ca sattvaṃ hetur ucyate tena tu hetukṛtatvavivakṣāyāṃ | (187-88)
analyzed: na tu sāmarthya vivakṣāyām prameya tva ādi vat sāmarthyam asti etāvat mātra vivakṣāyām ca sattvam hetuḥ ucyate tena tu hetu kṛta tva vivakṣāyām

original: tena yad ucyate – kṛtake sattvaṃ vidyate na tasyānityatve vyabhicārosti (|) tatkim ity upādhibhedena viśeṣyata iti tadapāstaṃ | kṛtakatvādau sāmarthyasyāvivakṣitatvād iti | hetutvenāpadiśyamāna ucyamānaḥ | upādhibhedāpekṣo viśeṣaṇabhedāpekṣaḥ | kevalo vety upādhyanapekṣaḥ | sādhyasiddhyartham ucyate |
analyzed: tena yat ucyate kṛtake sattvam vidyate na tasya anitya tve vyabhicāraḥ usti tat kim iti upādhi bhedena viśeṣyate iti tat apāstam kṛtaka tva ādau sāmarthyasya avivakṣita tvāt iti hetu tvena apadiśyamānaḥ ucyamānaḥ upādhi bheda apekṣaḥ viśeṣaṇa bheda apekṣaḥ kevalaḥ vā iti upādhi anapekṣaḥ sādhya siddhi artham ucyate

original: anityatve sādhye kṛtakatvam upādhibhedopekṣan tadanapekṣan tu sattvaṃ | apekṣatetyādinopādhibhedāpekṣatvaṃ kṛtakatvasyāha – parasyāhetvabhimatasya jananaśaktir eva vyāpāraḥ | anvayavyatirekānuvidhānam eva cāpekṣā | svabhāvaniṣpattau svabhāvaniṣpattinimittam apekṣitaḥ paravyāpāro yena bhāvena sa kṛtakaḥ |
analyzed: anitya tve sādhye kṛtaka tvam upādhi bheda upekṣan tad anapekṣan tu sattvam apekṣata ityādinā upādhi bheda apekṣa tvam kṛtaka tvasya āha parasya a hetu abhimatasya janana śaktiḥ eva vyāpāraḥ anvaya vyatireka anuvidhānam eva ca apekṣā svabhāva niṣpattau svabhāva niṣpatti nimittam apekṣitaḥ para vyāpāraḥ yena bhāvena sa kṛtakaḥ

original: saṃjñāyāṃ kano vidhānāt saṃjñāśabdoyaṃ kṛtaka iti | yata (p.349) evaṃ teneyaṃ kṛtakaśrutiḥ svabhāvābhidhāyiny api satī paropādhim atyantaviśeṣaṇamena svabhāvam ākṣipati | eteneti kṛtakatvasyopadhibhedāpekṣatvapratipādanena | pratyayānāṃ kāraṇanāmbhedas tena bhettuṃ śīlaṃ yasya sa tathoktas tadabhāvas tattvaṃ |
analyzed: saṃjñāyām kanaḥ vidhānāt saṃjñā śabdaḥ yam kṛtakaḥ iti evam tena iyam kṛtaka śrutiḥ svabhāva abhidhāyinī api satī para upādhim svabhāvam ākṣipati etena iti kṛtaka tvasya upadhi bheda apekṣa tva pratipādanena pratyayānām tena bhettum śīlam yasya sa tathā uktaḥ tad abhāvaḥ tattvam

original: tathānakaraṇādibhedād bhidyate śabdaḥ | ādiśabdāt prayatnānantarīyakatvādayo vyākhyātāḥ |
analyzed: tathā an a karaṇa ādi bhedāt bhidyate śabdaḥ ādi śabdāt prayatna ānantarīyaka tva ādayaḥ vyākhyātāḥ

original: evam ityādinopasaṃhāraḥ | kvacit prayoge upādhibhedaṃ pratyanapekṣaḥ | ata evāha – sāmānyena anitya eva sādhye yathā sattvaṃ | svabhāvabhūtaś cāsau dharmaś ca tasya parigraheṇa kvacitsvabhāvo hetur ucyate iti prakṛtaṃ | yathā tatraivety anityatve sādhya utpattiḥ | na cotpattir utpattim atonyābhāvasyājanyatvenotpattyabhāvaprasaṅgāt |
analyzed: evam ityādinā upasaṃhāraḥ kvacid prayoge upādhi bhedam prati anapekṣaḥ atas eva āha sāmānyena anitye eva sādhye yathā sattvam svabhāva bhūtaḥ ca asau dharmaḥ ca tasya parigraheṇa kvacid svabhāvaḥ hetuḥ ucyate iti prakṛtam yathā tatra eva iti anitya tve sādhye utpattiḥ na ca utpattiḥ utpattim atonya abhāvasya ajanya tvena utpatti abhāva prasaṅgāt

original: kevalam arthāntarabhūtevakalpitāviśeṣaṇatvena tenotpatter ity utpattimatvād ity arthaḥ | ayam upādhyapekṣa eva svabhāvo draṣṭavyaḥ | kṛtakatvādau parabhūta upādhirahitatvātmabhūta eva dharmaviśeṣa ity etāvān viśeṣaḥ |
analyzed: kevalam tena utpatteḥ iti utpattimatvāt iti arthaḥ ayam upādhi apekṣaḥ eva svabhāvaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ kṛtaka tva ādau para bhūtaḥ upādhi rahita tva ātma bhūtaḥ eva dharma viśeṣaḥ iti etāvān viśeṣaḥ

original: anayā diśeti | upādhyapekṣānapekṣahetupravibhāgādiśā | (189)
analyzed: anayā diśā iti upādhi apekṣā anapekṣa hetu pravibhāga ādiśā

original: yadi sattvākhyaḥ svabhāvo hetuḥ sattvam iti yāvat | pradhānādisattā kathaṃ na sādhyate | atha sattā sāmānye sādhye siddhasādhyatā syād ataḥ sattaviśeṣas sādhyas tasmiṃś ca sādhye viśeṣasyānanvayāt sādhyaśunyo dṛṣṭāntaḥ syād ato na sattā sādhyate | tadā hetāv api sattve viśeṣasyānanvayāt sādhanaśūnyo dṛṣṭāntaḥ syāt | tadāha (|) ananvayo hītyādi |
analyzed: yadi sattva ākhyaḥ svabhāvaḥ hetuḥ sattvam iti yāvat pradhāna ādi sattā katham na sādhyate atha sattā sāmānye sādhye siddha sādhyatā syāt atas sattā viśeṣaḥ sādhyaḥ tasmin ca sādhye viśeṣasya ananvayāt sādhya śunyaḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ syāt atas na sattā sādhyate tadā hetau api sattve viśeṣasya ananvayāt sādhana śūnyaḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ syāt tat āha ananvayaḥ hi ityādi

original: bhedānām viśeṣāṇāṃ vyāhato duṣṭo hetusādhyayoḥ | hetau sādhye cety arthaḥ | anyatra cety anātmādau | tad iti sattvaṃ | kilaśabdonabhimatārthe eva prasādhyamānam iti | (189-90)
analyzed: bhedānām viśeṣāṇām vyāhataḥ duṣṭaḥ hetu sādhyayoḥ hetau sādhye ca iti arthaḥ anyatra ca iti anātma ādau tat iti sattvam kila śabdaḥ ūnabhimata arthe eva prasādhyamānam iti

original: asti pradhānam ityādinā pradhānalakṣaṇayogena viśeṣībhavati na ca viśeṣaḥ (p.350) sādhayituṃ śakyate tasyānanvayāt | yathā 'hetyācārya dignāgaḥ | "asti pradhānam ity anena pradhānasvalakṣaṇam eva sādhyata" iti yat sānkhye  noktaṃ tatpramāṇasyānumānasya viṣayājñānāt sāmānyaviṣayaṃ hy anumānaṃ svalakṣaṇaviṣayaṃ | vyāhanyate duṣyati |
analyzed: asti pradhānam ityādinā pradhāna lakṣaṇa yogena viśeṣībhavati na ca viśeṣaḥ sādhayitum śakyate tasya ananvayāt yathā ha iti ācārya dignāgaḥ asti pradhānam iti anena pradhāna sva lakṣaṇam eva sādhyate iti yat sānkhye na uktam tad pramāṇasya anumānasya viṣaya ajñānāt sāmānya viṣayam hi anumānam sva lakṣaṇa viṣayam vyāhanyate duṣyati

analyzed: etat uktam bhavati na bhūmi bīja ādayaḥ eka svabhāvāḥ paścāt iva prāk api kārya utpādana prasaṅgāt kintu uttarottara pariṇāmena bhinnāḥ tatra iti tasyām santāna pariṇāmena bhinnāyām sāmagryām antyā yā sāmagrī kārya utpādane lakṣaṇa antareṇa avyavahitā sā phalavatī eva iti kutas hetoḥ anaikāntika tvam

original: syādetat (|) pūrvā sāmagrī janikāpi satī na niyatety āha – saivetyantyā sāmagrī tatra tāsu madhye 'ṅkurahetur nānyā kācit | kim arthantarhyaṅkurārthibhiḥ pūrvā sāmagryupādīyata ity āha – anyāstvityādi | pūrvaḥ pariṇāmaḥ pūrvovasthāviśeṣastad arthaevāṅkurajananasamarthāntyasāmagryartha eva | tenārthibhir upādīyate sāmagrī rūpatayā cādhyavasīyate |
analyzed: syāt etat pūrvā sāmagrī janikā api satī na niyatā iti āha sā eva iti antyā sāmagrī tatra tāsu madhye ṅkura hetuḥ na anyā kācid kim artham tarhi aṅkura arthibhiḥ pūrvā sāmagrī upādīyate iti āha anyāḥ tu ityādi pūrvaḥ pariṇāmaḥ pūrvaḥ vasthā viśeṣaḥ tat arthaḥ eva aṅkura janana samartha antya sāmagrī arthaḥ eva tena arthibhiḥ upādīyate sāmagrī rūpatayā ca adhyavasīyate

original: syād etad (|) antyāyā api sāmagryāḥ pratibandhaḥ sambhavati | tena kāryotpādaniyamābhāvāt sādhyaśūnyo dṛṣṭānta ity āha na cetyādi | tāmantyāṃ (p.363) sāmagrīntatra kārye janye | ekatra bhāva ityantye kṣaṇe | vikārasyotpattau vā tasyāntyasya kṣaṇasyaikatvahāneḥ pūrvasya pracyutervikārākhyasya ca dvitīyasyotpatteḥ | tataś ca nāsāvantyaḥ syāt |
analyzed: syāt etat antyāyāḥ api sāmagryāḥ pratibandhaḥ sambhavati tena kārya utpāda niyama abhāvāt sādhya śūnyaḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ iti āha na ca ityādi tām antyām sāmagrīn tatra kārye janye ekatra bhāvaḥ iti antye kṣaṇe vikārasya utpattau vā tasya antyasya kṣaṇasya ekatva hāneḥ pūrvasya pracyuteḥ vikāra ākhyasya ca dvitīyasya utpatteḥ tatas ca na asau antyaḥ syāt

original: atha na tasyāntyasya janakasvabhāvāt pracyutiriṣyate | tadā tadātmano janakātmanaḥ | svabhāvād apracyutasya tadutpādanaṃ kāryotpādanaṃ prati vaiguṇyamakurvāṇasya pratibandhahetor apratibandhakatvād vighātakaraṇāt |
analyzed: atha na tasya antyasya janaka svabhāvāt pracyutiḥ iṣyate tadā tad ātmanaḥ janaka ātmanaḥ svabhāvāt apracyutasya tat utpādanam kārya utpādanam prati vaiguṇyam akurvāṇasya pratibandha hetoḥ apratibandhaka tvāt vighāta karaṇāt

original: punarapi vyabhicāramāśaṃkate | yavabījādayo na sāpekṣāḥ (|) kasmin (|) śālyaṅkure kārye janye | kasmāt (|) tadutpattipratyayānāṃ kadācit tatrāpi yavabījādau sannidhānāt | te nirapekṣā api na śālyaṃkuraṃ janayantītyanaikāntika eveti |
analyzed: punar api vyabhicāram āśaṃkate yava bīja ādayaḥ na sāpekṣāḥ kasmin śāli aṅkure kārye janye kasmāt tad utpatti pratyayānām kadācid tatra api yava bīja ādau sannidhānāt te nirapekṣāḥ api na śāli aṃkuram janayanti iti anaikāntikaḥ eva iti

original: katham iti siddhāntavādī | sāpekṣā evety arthaḥ | eṣām iti yavabījādīnāṃ śālibījasya yastadutpādanaḥ śālyaṅkurotpādanaḥ svabhāvaḥ sa evaiṣāṃ nāstītisambandhaḥ | tatsvabhāvāpekṣā iti śālyaṃkurotpādanasvabhāvāpekṣāḥ |
analyzed: katham iti siddhāntavādī sāpekṣāḥ eva iti arthaḥ eṣām iti yava bīja ādīnām śāli bījasya yaḥ tad utpādanaḥ śāli aṅkura utpādanaḥ svabhāvaḥ saḥ eva eṣām na asti iti sambandhaḥ tad svabhāva apekṣāḥ iti śāli aṃkura utpādana svabhāva apekṣāḥ

original: kadā ca kathaṃ nirapekṣatvaṃ syādevantarhīti paraḥ | kṛtakānāṃ ca keṣāṃcit satāmvā keṣāṃcit | sa eva svabhāvo nāsti yo naśvaraḥ | tasmāt tatsvabhāvāpekṣatvād vinaśvarasvabhāvāpekṣatvān na vinaśvarā ity asiddhatvaṃ hetor iti |
analyzed: kadā ca katham nirapekṣa tvam syāt eva tarhi iti paraḥ kṛtakānām ca keṣāṃcid satām vā keṣāṃcid saḥ eva svabhāvaḥ na asti yaḥ naśvaraḥ tasmāt tad svabhāva apekṣa tvāt vinaśvara svabhāva apekṣa tvāt na vinaśvarāḥ iti asiddha tvam hetoḥ iti

original: etannirākarttumprakramate | śālibījetyādi | ādiśbdād yavabījādīnāṃ | sa svabhāva ity abhimatetarakārya jananājananasvabhāvaḥ svahetor iti kṛtvā | yo yavabījādir na taddhetuḥ | sa śālibījahetur yasya hetur nabhavatīty arthaṃḥ | so 'tatsvabhāva ityaśālyaṃkurajananasvabhāvaḥ |
analyzed: etat nirākarttum prakramate śāli bīja ityādi ādi śbdāt yava bīja ādīnām sa svabhāvaḥ iti abhimata itara kārya janana ajanana svabhāvaḥ sva hetoḥ iti kṛtvā yaḥ yava bīja ādiḥ na tad hetuḥ sa śāli bīja hetuḥ yasya hetuḥ na bhavati iti arthaḥ tad svabhāvaḥ iti a śāli aṃkura janana svabhāvaḥ

original: nanvataddhetuś ca syāt tatsvabhāvaś cety āha – niyataśaktiś cetyādi | niyatā pratiniyatā śaktir yasya sa tathā (|) sa hetur iti śāliyavabījajananasvabhāvaḥ | svarūpeṇa vibhaktenaiva svabhāvena pratītaḥ pratyakṣataḥ |
analyzed: nanu ataddhetuḥ ca syāt tad svabhāvaḥ ca iti āha niyata śaktiḥ ca ityādi niyatā pratiniyatā śaktiḥ yasya sa tathā sa hetuḥ iti śāli yava bīja janana svabhāvaḥ sva rūpeṇa vibhaktena eva svabhāvena pratītaḥ pratyakṣataḥ

original: (p.364)  syād etat (|) na hetukṛtaḥ svabhāvabhedo bhāvānāṃ kin tu svabhāva eva kasyacit (|) tādṛśasvabhavāvo 'nyasya cānyādṛśa ity āha (|) na cetyādi | ākasmika iti nirhetukaḥ | anpekṣasyāhetoḥ kvacid deśe kvacitkāle | kvacic ca śālibījādau dravye śālyaṃkurotpādanasya svabhāvasya niyamo na syāt |
analyzed: syāt etat na hetu kṛtaḥ svabhāva bhedaḥ bhāvānām kin tu svabhāvaḥ eva kasyacid nyasya ca anyādṛśaḥ iti āha na ca ityādi ākasmikaḥ iti nirhetukaḥ anpekṣasya ahetoḥ kvacid deśe kvacid kāle kvacid ca śāli bīja ādau dravye śāli aṃkura utpādanasya svabhāvasya niyamaḥ na syāt

original: kin tu sarvasya sarvadā sarvatra bhavedapekṣābhāvāt | tasmād deśādikam apekṣya bhavan niyamo hetumān iti gamyate | yathā śālibījādīnāṃ svabhāvaniyamas tathātrāpi kṛtakeṣu, satsu vā niyamaheturvaktavyo yato niyāmakāddhetoḥ kṛtakās santo vā kecin naśvarātmāno jātā nānye |
analyzed: kin tu sarvasya sarvadā sarvatra bhavet apekṣā abhāvāt tasmāt deśa ādikam apekṣya bhavan niyamaḥ hetumān iti gamyate yathā śāli bīja ādīnām svabhāva niyamaḥ tathā atra api kṛtakeṣu satsu vā niyama hetuḥ vaktavyaḥ yatas niyāmakāt hetoḥ kṛtakāḥ santaḥ vā kecid naśvara ātmānaḥ jātāḥ na anye

original: syād etad (|) yadi nāma niyāmako hetur na śakyate darśayitun tathāpi sambhāvyata ity āha – na cātraloke naśvarasya svabhāvasya niyāmako hetur asti | na sambhāvyata eveti yāvat | sarveṣāṃ janmavatāṃ nāśasya siddher dṛṣṭatvāt | aniyatahetuho vināśa iti yāvat |
analyzed: syāt etat yadi nāma niyāmakaḥ hetuḥ na śakyate darśayitum tathā api sambhāvyate iti āha na ca atra loke naśvarasya svabhāvasya niyāmakaḥ hetuḥ asti na sambhāvyate eva iti yāvat sarveṣām janmavatām nāśasya siddheḥ dṛṣṭa tvāt aniyata hetu haḥ vināśaḥ iti yāvat

original: yadi sarvajanmināṃ vināśasiddher evān tarhi sattvād iti hetur anaikāntikaḥ syāt tad āha – janmītyādi | janmavatām eva svabhāvo nāśī nājanmavatāṃ | nākāśādīnāṃ satām apīti paro manyate | ācārya āha – na vai janmeti | na hi janmavaśād bhāvasya svabhāva utpadyate | tasmān na janma nāśasya hetuḥ | nāpy ākāśādau sattvam astīty āha – na cetyādi |
analyzed: yadi sarva janminām vināśa siddheḥ tarhi sattvāt iti hetuḥ anaikāntikaḥ syāt tat āha janmi ityādi janmavatām eva svabhāvaḥ nāśī na ajanmavatām na ākāśa ādīnām satām api iti paraḥ manyate ācāryaḥ āha na vai janma iti na hi janma vaśāt bhāvasya svabhāvaḥ utpadyate tasmāt na janma nāśasya hetuḥ na api ākāśa ādau sattvam asti iti āha na ca ityādi

original: ahetor ākāśādeḥ svabhāvaniyamaḥ svarūpaniyamo 'hetor deśakālaprakṛtiniyamāyogāt | yataś ca sarvajanmināṃ vināśasiddhir ākāśādīnāṃ cāsattvaṃ | tasmān nātra kṛtakeṣu satsu vā hetor naśvarānaśvarajanakatvena svabhāvapravibhāgaḥ | tadbhāvād dhetupravibhāgābhāvāt phalasya kṛtakasya sato vā naśvarānaśvarapravibhāgo nāstīty asamānaṃyababījādinā |
analyzed: ahetoḥ ākāśa ādeḥ svabhāva niyamaḥ svarūpa niyamaḥ hetoḥ deśa kāla prakṛti niyama ayogāt yatas ca sarva janminām vināśa siddhiḥ ākāśa ādīnām ca asattvam tasmāt na atra kṛtakeṣu satsu vā hetoḥ naśvara anaśvara janaka tvena svabhāva pravibhāgaḥ tad bhāvāt hetu pravibhāga abhāvāt phalasya kṛtakasya sataḥ vā naśvara anaśvara pravibhāgaḥ na asti iti asamānaṃyaba bīja ādinā

original: seyamivanāśasya nirapekṣatā kvacid vastuni | kadācit kāle vināśasya yo bhāvas tena virodhinī karoti tadabhāvaṃ | tasya kvacit (p.365) kadācic ca vināśasyābhāvaṃ svabhāvena sattayā sādhayati | sarvatra sarvakālam bhāvaṃ sādhayatīti yāvat | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ yo hītyādi | tatkāladravyāpekṣa iti yasmin kāle bhavati yatra vā dravye |
analyzed: sā iyam iva nāśasya nirapekṣa tā kvacid vastuni kadācid kāle vināśasya yaḥ bhāvaḥ tena virodhinī karoti tad abhāvam tasya kvacid kadācid ca vināśasya abhāvam svabhāvena sattayā sādhayati sarvatra sarvakālam bhāvam sādhayati iti yāvat kim kāraṇam yaḥ hi ityādi tad kāla dravya apekṣaḥ iti yasmin kāle bhavati yatra vā dravye

original: taṃ kālaṃ dravyañcāpekṣata iti nirapekṣa eva na syād ity uktaṃ prāk |
analyzed: tam kālam dravyam ca apekṣate iti nirapekṣaḥ eva na syāt iti uktam prāk

original: nanu vināśakahetuvanapekṣatvena vināśasyānapekṣatvaṃ, na tu kālādyanapekṣatvena (|) tat katham ucyate | tatkāladravyāpekṣa iti nirapekṣa eva vināśo na syād iti | yadi ca kālānapekṣo vināśaḥ dvitīyepi kṣaṇe vināśo na syāt tatkālāpekṣatvāt | dravyānapekṣatve ca kasya tarhi vināśaḥ syāt |
analyzed: nanu vināśaka hetu vanapekṣa tvena vināśasya anapekṣa tvam na tu kāla ādi anapekṣa tvena tat katham ucyate tad kāla dravya apekṣaḥ iti nirapekṣaḥ eva vināśaḥ na syāt iti yadi ca kāla anapekṣaḥ vināśaḥ dvitīye api kṣaṇe vināśaḥ na syāt tad kāla apekṣa tvāt dravya anapekṣa tve ca kasya tarhi vināśaḥ syāt

original: evam manyate (|) jātasya tadbhāve 'anyonapekṣaṇād iti vacanāt | dvitīya eva kṣaṇe vināśo bhavati nānyasmin kṣaṇe | tathā srvasya jātasya bhavati na dravyaviśeṣasya tena dravyā'napekṣatve kasya tarhi vināśo bhavatu (|)
analyzed: evam manyate jātasya tad bhāve iti vacanāt dvitīye eva kṣaṇe vināśaḥ bhavati na anyasmin kṣaṇe tathā srvasya jātasya bhavati na dravya viśeṣasya tena dravya anapekṣa tve kasya tarhi vināśaḥ bhavatu

original: iti nirastaṃ | kālāntare dravyaviśeṣe ca nāśasya bhave kālāntarasya dravyaviśeṣasya ca vināśakatvem eva syāt | vināśasya tadbhava eva bhāvāt | tasmāt tatkāladravyāpekṣatve nirapekṣa eva na syād ity ucyate |
analyzed: iti nirastam kāla antare dravya viśeṣe ca nāśasya bhave kāla antarasya dravya viśeṣasya ca eva syāt vināśasya tad bhave eva bhāvāt tasmāt tad kāla dravya apekṣa tve nirapekṣaḥ eva na syāt iti ucyate

original: tarhīti paraḥ | netyācāryaḥ | sattāyā yo hetur bhāvas tasmād eva tathotpatter naśvarasvabhāvasyotpatteḥ | etad eva spaṣṭayati | sato hi bhvata iti sattāṃ pratipadyamānasya tādṛśasyaiva naśvarasvabhāvasyaiva (|) bhāvāt | nāvśyaṃ sataḥ padārthasya kutaś cit kāraṇād bhāva utpādna iti cet |
analyzed: tarhi iti paraḥ na iti ācāryaḥ sattāyāḥ yaḥ hetuḥ bhāvaḥ tasmāt eva tathā utpatteḥ naśvara svabhāvasya utpatteḥ etat eva spaṣṭayati sataḥ hi bhvataḥ iti sattām pratipadyamānasya tādṛśasya eva naśvara svabhāvasya eva bhāvāt na āvśyam sataḥ padārthasya kutas cit kāraṇāt bhāvaḥ utpādne iti ced

original: kecid dhi santopi notpattim anyo yathākāśādaya iti paro manyate | ākasminkīty ahetukā | neyaṃ sattā kasyacid arthasya kadācit kāle kvacid dravye viram eta |
analyzed: kecid hi santaḥ api na utpattim anyaḥ yathā ākāśa ādayaḥ iti paraḥ manyate ahetukā na iyam sattā kasyacid arthasya kadācid kāle kvacid dravye

original: nanu ca ghaṭādīnāṃ svahetutaḥ sattāniyame katham ākāśādisattāprasaṅgaḥ |
analyzed: nanu ca ghaṭa ādīnām sva hetutaḥ sattā niyame katham ākāśa ādi sattā prasaṅgaḥ

original: sattyaṃ (|) kin tu na kasyacid virametety asyāyam arthaḥ | na sa kaścid bhāvo yatsvabhāvosāvākāśādir na syāt sarvātmakaḥ prasajyata ity eke tad ayuktaṃ (|) yadi hi ghaṭādirūpamākāśe syād ahetukaṃ syāt tasya mṛtpiṇḍādikam antareṇa bhāvāt | asmān neyamākāśādes sattā | kasyacid ātmādeḥ kadācit kāle kvacid deśe (p.366) virameta |
analyzed: sattyam kin tu na kasyacid virameta iti asya ayam arthaḥ na sa kaścid bhāvaḥ yad svabhāvaḥ usau ākāśa ādiḥ na syāt sarva ātmakaḥ prasajyate iti eke tat ayuktam yadi hi ghaṭa ādi rūpam ākāśe syāt ahetukam syāt tasya mṛd piṇḍa ādikam antareṇa bhāvāt asmāt na iyam ākāśa ādeḥ sattā kasyacid ātma ādeḥ kadācid kāle kvacid deśe virameta

original: deśakāladravyaniyatā na bheved ity arthaḥ |
analyzed: deśa kāla dravya niyatā na iti arthaḥ

original: etad eva draḍhayan nāha – taddhītyādi | taddhi vastu | kiṃcid upalīyetāśrayet | yasya yatra kiṃcid utpādādikaṃ pratibaddhamāyattaṃ | na copalīyeta yasya yatrāpratibaddhaṃ | seyaṃ sattā kvacid apratibandhinī cet | dravyakālāpekṣayā na niyamavatī syāt | tathā cākāśasyeyaṃ sattā nātmamanaḥ | ātmanas sattā na kālasyetyādi na syāt |
analyzed: etat eva draḍhayan na āha tat hi ityādi tat hi vastu kiṃcid upalīyeta āśrayet yasya yatra kiṃcid utpāda ādikam pratibaddham āyattam na ca upalīyeta yasya yatra apratibaddham sā iyam sattā kvacid apratibandhinī ced dravya kāla apekṣayā na niyamavatī syāt tathā ca ākāśasya iyam sattā na ātma manaḥ ātmanaḥ sattā na kālasya ityādi na syāt

original: yataś caivantasmān neyaṃ sattākasmikī kvacin nityābhimateṣv api |
analyzed: yatas na iyam sattā ākasmikī kvacid nitya abhimateṣu api

original: yadi sattāhetor eva vinaśvarasyotpādaḥ katham idānīm ahetuko vināśa ukta iti vyāghātam āha –
analyzed: yadi sattā hetoḥ eva vinaśvarasya utpādaḥ katham idānīm ahetukaḥ vināśaḥ uktaḥ iti vyāghātam āha

original: jātasyetyādinā pariharati | jātasya niṣpannasya tadbhāve vinaśvaratābhāve janakāddhetor anyasyānapekṣaṇāt |
analyzed: jātasya ityādinā pariharati jātasya niṣpannasya tad bhāve vinaśvara tā abhāve janakāt hetoḥ anyasya anapekṣaṇāt

original: ahetuko vināśa uktaḥ | uktaṃ cātra prāk yathā na vināśo nāmānya eva kaścid bhāvāt kin tu bhāva eva hi nāśaḥ |
analyzed: ahetukaḥ vināśaḥ uktaḥ uktam ca atra prāk yathā na vināśaḥ nāma anyaḥ eva kaścid bhāvāt kin tu bhāvaḥ eva hi nāśaḥ

original: nanu ca pradhvaṃsābhāvo nāśaḥ sa katham bhāvasvabhāvo bhavatīy āha –
analyzed: nanu ca pradhvaṃsa abhāvaḥ nāśaḥ sa katham bhāva svabhāvaḥ bhavati it āha

original: sa eva hītyādi | yasmāt svabhetor eva kṣaṇasthāyī jātas tasmād bhāva eva nāśa uktaḥ | ya eva sattākālo bhāvasya tam evaikaṃ kṣaṇsaṃ sthātuṃ śīlaṃ yasya sa tathā | na punar utpadya kṣaṇam api tiṣṭhati | yadi tiṣṭhen na vivartteteti vakṣyāmaḥ |
analyzed: saḥ eva hi ityādi yasmāt sva bhetoḥ eva kṣaṇa sthāyī jātaḥ tasmāt bhāvaḥ eva nāśaḥ uktaḥ yaḥ eva sattā kālaḥ bhāvasya tam eva ekam sthātum śīlam yasya sa tathā na punar utpadya kṣaṇam api tiṣṭhati yadi tiṣṭhet na vivartteta iti vakṣyāmaḥ

original: yady ekakṣaṇasthāyī bhāvo vināśaḥ kasmāt pravāhavicchedāt prāg api tathā na niścīyate 'niścayāc cākṣaṇikaḥ sa ity āha – tam asyetyādi | taṃ nāsvabhāvam asya ghaṭāder āsaṃsāramavidyānubandhāt madā urdhvaṃ pravāhavicchedakāle vyavasyanti na prāk sattākāle | darśnepīti naśvarasvabhāvasya saty api darśane | na darśanakāle 'dhyavasāyo 'sti |
analyzed: yadi eka kṣaṇa sthāyī bhāvaḥ vināśaḥ kasmāt pravāha vicchedāt prāk api tathā na niścīyate niścayāt ca akṣaṇikaḥ saḥ iti āha tam asya ityādi tam na asvabhāvam asya ghaṭa ādeḥ āsaṃsāram avidyā anubandhāt madāḥ urdhvam pravāha viccheda kāle vyavasyanti na prāk sattā kāle darśne pi iti naśvara svabhāvasya sati api darśane na darśana kāle dhyavasāyaḥ u sti

original: avidyā(sāma)rthyātsadṛśāparotpattyā ca darśanapāṭavasyābhāvāt | yataś ca santānavicchedakāle nāśasvabhāvasya niścayas tasmāt tadvaśena niścayavaśena (p.367) | paścād iti yasmin kāle nāśasvabhāvasya niścayas tatkālopādhir eva sa bhāvasya vināśasvabhāvo vyavasthāpyate (|) dṛṣṭāntam āha – vikāretyādi |
analyzed: avidyā sāmarthyāt sadṛśa apara utpattyā ca darśana pāṭavasya abhāvāt yatas ca santāna viccheda kāle nāśa svabhāvasya niścayaḥ tasmāt tad vaśena niścaya vaśena paścāt iti yasmin kāle nāśa svabhāvasya niścayaḥ tad kāla upādhiḥ eva sa bhāvasya vināśa svabhāvaḥ vyavasthāpyate dṛṣṭāntam āha vikāra ityādi

original: yathā viṣadravyaṃ guhītam api bhrāntisadbhāvāt prāg anavadhāritam ajñaiḥ puruṣaiḥ paścād viṣakṛtasya vikārasya lālāsrutyāder darśanena viṣaṃ vyavasthāpyate tavat | etāvan mātreṇāyaṃ dṛṣṭānto na tu māraṇaśaktir gṛhītā paścād avdhāryata iti dṛṣṭāntaḥ | tad iti tasmād ayam iva nāśa iti sambandhaḥ |
analyzed: yathā viṣa dravyam api bhrānti sadbhāvāt prāk anavadhāritam ajñaiḥ puruṣaiḥ paścāt viṣa kṛtasya vikārasya lālā sruti ādeḥ darśanena viṣam vyavasthāpyate tavat etāvat mātreṇa ayam dṛṣṭāntaḥ na tu māraṇa śaktiḥ gṛhītā paścāt iti dṛṣṭāntaḥ tat iti tasmāt ayam iva nāśaḥ iti sambandhaḥ

original: vatuno yā sattā tadvayatirekeṇa na kiṃcid vināśakāraṇam apekṣata iti tadvyāpī sattāvyāpī |
analyzed: yā sattā tad vayatirekeṇa na kiṃcid vināśa kāraṇam apekṣate iti tad vyāpī sattā vyāpī

original: katham ityādi paraḥ | asāmarthyāc ceti prativacanaṃ | tadhetor iti nāśahetoḥ | cakārādakārakatvāc ca | etad eva vivṛṇvann āha – abhāvakāriṇa ity abhāvakāritayābhimatasya kriyāyāḥ kārakatvasya pratiṣedhāc ceti | avastukārī yobhimataḥ sokāraka eva bhavati | asāmarthyan darśayitum āha – siddhe hītyādi |
analyzed: katham ityādi paraḥ asāmarthyāt ca iti prativacanam tad hetoḥ iti nāśa hetoḥ cakārāt akāraka tvāt ca etat eva vivṛṇvan āha abhāva kāriṇaḥ iti abhāva kāri tayā abhimatasya kriyāyāḥ kāraka tvasya pratiṣedhāt ca iti avastu kārī yaḥ abhimataḥ saḥ kārakaḥ eva bhavati darśayitum āha siddhe hi ityādi

original: nāśahetur bhāvād abhinnam vā vināśaṃ kuryāt tatonyam vā | na tāvadādyaḥ pakṣaḥ siddhe hi bhāve kārako nāśahetus tam bhāvaṃ na karoti siddhatvād eva | nāpi dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ | yato nāpy anyakriyān tasya bhāvasya na kiñcit | tadavastuatvāt | tadatadrūpetyādi |
analyzed: nāśa hetuḥ bhāvāt abhinnam vā vināśam kuryāt tatonyam vā na tāvat ādyaḥ pakṣaḥ siddhe hi bhāve kārakaḥ nāśa hetuḥ tam bhāvam na karoti siddha tvāt eva nā api dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ yatas nā api tasya bhāvasya na kiñcid tad avastu atvāt tad a tad rūpa ityādi

original: bhāvarūpasya tato 'nyasya ca vināśasya kāraṇāc cākiñcitkaro vināśahetur ato nāpekṣyata iti siddham asāmarthyaṃ |
analyzed: bhāva rūpasya tatas nyasya ca vināśasya kāraṇāt ca akiñcitkaraḥ vināśa hetuḥ atas nā apekṣyate iti siddham asāmarthyam

original: kriyāpratiṣedhas tu katham ity āha – vināśa iti hi bhāvasyābhāvante hetuman nāśavādino mayante | asmābhir bhāvasvabhāva eva vināśa ity uktaṃ | tad iti tasmād ayaṃ vināśahetur vināśaṃ karoty abhāvaṃ karotīti prāptaṃ | tatraitasmin prāpte sati yady abhāvo nāma kaścit svabhāvaḥ kāryaḥ syāt | tadā kāryatvād aṃkurādivat sa eva bhāva iti nābhāvaḥ syāt |
analyzed: kriyā pratiṣedhaḥ tu katham iti āha vināśaḥ iti hi hetumat nāśa vādinaḥ asmābhiḥ bhāva svabhāvaḥ eva vināśaḥ iti uktam tat iti tasmāt ayam vināśa hetuḥ vināśam karoti abhāvam karoti iti prāptam tatra etasmin prāpte sati yadi abhāvaḥ nāma kaścid svabhāvaḥ kāryaḥ syāt tadā kārya tvāt aṃkura ādi vat saḥ eva bhāvaḥ iti na abhāvaḥ syāt

original: atha yathā ghaṭo ghaṭarūpeṇa kāryaḥ paṭaś ca paṭarūpeṇa kāryo na tu kāryatvād ghaṭaḥ paṭo bhavati | tathā bhāvo bhāvarūpeṇa kāryo 'bhāvopyabhāvarūpeṇa kāryaḥ syāt | na tu bhāva eva bhavatīti | tad ayuktam bhavatyīti hi bhāvo na bhvatīti (p.368) cābhāvas tenābhāvo bhāvavirodhī | na cābhāvarūpatayā tasyā pratibhāvasanādabhāvarūpatā |
analyzed: atha yathā ghaṭaḥ ghaṭa rūpeṇa kāryaḥ paṭaḥ ca paṭa rūpeṇa kāryaḥ na tu kārya tvāt ghaṭaḥ paṭaḥ bhavati tathā bhāvaḥ bhāva rūpeṇa kāryaḥ bhāvaḥ api abhāva rūpeṇa kāryaḥ syāt na tu bhāvaḥ eva bhavati iti tat ayuktam bhavatī iti hi bhāvaḥ na ca abhāvaḥ tena abhāvaḥ bhāva virodhī na ca abhāva rūpatayā pratibhāva sanāt abhāva rūpatā

original: bhavanadharmatvenābhāvarūpatayā pratibhāsa eva na syād itīdam eva codyate | na ca parasparaviviktarūpatayā'bhāvānaṃ pratibhāsaḥ | yataś cābhāvasya nīrūpatvādakāryatvan tasmād abhāvaṃ karotīti bhāvaṃ na karotīti vākyārthaḥ syāt | tena kriyāpratiṣedhosya nāśahetoḥ kṛtaḥ syāt | tathāpi kriyāpratiṣedhepy ayaṃ vināśahetur akiñcitkaraḥ |
analyzed: bhavana dharma tvena abhāva rūpatayā pratibhāsaḥ eva na syāt iti idam eva codyate na ca paraspara vivikta rūpatayā pratibhāsaḥ yatas ca abhāvasya nīrūpa tvāt akārya tvan tasmāt abhāvam karoti iti bhāvam na karoti iti vākya arthaḥ syāt tena kriyā pratiṣedhaḥ usya nāśa hetoḥ kṛtaḥ syāt tathā api kriyā pratiṣedhe api ayam vināśa hetuḥ akiñcitkaraḥ

original: kin iti nāśe'pekṣyate bhāveneti siddhā vināśaṃ pratyanapekṣā bhāvasya |
analyzed: iti nāśa ipekṣyate bhāvena iti siddhā vināśam prati anapekṣā bhāvasya

original: nanu nirhetukepi vināśe katham iva nāsaṃ pratyanepekṣā bhāvasya | svabhāvo hi sa tasyetthaṃ yenāpekṣya nivartate virodhinaṃ (|) yathā'nyeṣāṃ pravāho mudgarādikaṃ | tena pūrvam iva rodhino'bhāve nānivṛtteḥ kathaṃ kṣaṇikatvam iti |
analyzed: nanu nirhetuke api vināśe katham iva prati anepekṣā bhāvasya svabhāvaḥ hi sa tasya ittham yena apekṣya nivartate virodhinam yathā anyeṣām pravāhaḥ mudgara ādikam tena pūrvam iva na anivṛtteḥ katham kṣaṇika tvam iti

original: tad ayuktaṃ | yato virodhyapekṣasvabhāvatvaṃ yadi vastuno na pūrvam api tadāsya pūrvottararūpayor bhedād nityatvam eva atha pūrvam api sa svabhāvo 'sti tadā pūrvam apy asya nivṛttiḥ syāt | atha tadā virodhyabhāvān na nivartate | kathan tarhi virodhyapekṣasvabhāvatvaṃ | saty eva virodhini | virodhyapekṣasvabhāvatvasya bhāvān nānyadā |
analyzed: tat ayuktam yatas virodhi apekṣa svabhāva tvam yadi vastunaḥ na pūrvam api tadā asya pūrva uttara rūpayoḥ bhedāt nitya tvam eva atha pūrvam api sa svabhāvaḥ sti tadā pūrvam api asya nivṛttiḥ syāt atha tadā virodhi abhāvāt na nivartate kathan tarhi virodhi apekṣa svabhāva tvam sati eva virodhini virodhi apekṣa svabhāva tvasya bhāvāt na anyadā

original: yadi virodhī vastuno nopakārakaḥ kathan tan tadapekṣate | upakāre vā virodhisannidhānepy aparasya bhāvasyotpattir iti pūrvako bhāvas tadavstho dṛśyata | virodhe sannidhānābhāvenānivṛtteḥ | atha nivartate | na tarhi virodhyapekṣayā bhāvasya nivṛttiḥ (|) yadi ca na bhāvam ivanāśayati katham ivarodhī |
analyzed: yadi virodhī vastunaḥ na upakārakaḥ kathan tat tat apekṣate upakāre vā virodhi sannidhāne api aparasya bhāvasya utpattiḥ iti pūrvakaḥ bhāvaḥ dṛśyata virodhe sannidhāna abhāvena anivṛtteḥ atha nivartate na tarhi virodhi apekṣayā bhāvasya nivṛttiḥ yadi ca na bhāvam katham iva rodhī

original: na ca kṣaṇikavādināṃ virodhisannidhāne sattā no nivartate | kin tarhi notpadyate | tathā hi nirodham upagacchann eva ghaṭo mudgarādisahakāryapekṣaḥ papālajanakatvena sadṛśakṣaṇānāram bhako bhavatīti santānān utpattir na tu virodhinam apekṣya pravāho nivartate |
analyzed: na ca kṣaṇika vādinām virodhi sannidhāne sattā no nivartate kim tarhi na utpadyate tathā hi nirodham upagacchan eva ghaṭaḥ mudgara ādi sahakāri apekṣaḥ papāla janaka tvena sadṛśa kṣaṇān āram bhakaḥ bhavati iti santānān utpattiḥ na tu virodhinam apekṣya pravāhaḥ nivartate

original: yataś ca pūrvaṃ santānenotpitsorbhāvasya virodhisannidhāne santānān utpattir ata eva mandamatīnāṃ sahetukanāśādhyavasāyo mudgarādau ca virodhitvāvasāya iti sarvaṃ susthaṃ | tasmān nirapekṣatvād eva yatra nāma kvacid bhavaddṛṣṭo vināśas tatraiṣa svabhāvata eva bhavati |
analyzed: yatas ca pūrvam santānena utpitsoḥ bhāvasya virodhi sannidhāne santānān utpattiḥ atas eva manda matīnām sa hetuka nāśa adhyavasāyaḥ mudgara ādau ca virodhi tva avasāyaḥ iti sarvam sustham tasmāt nirapekṣa tvāt eva yatra nāma kvacid bhavat dṛṣṭaḥ vināśaḥ tatra eṣa svabhāvataḥ eva bhavati

original: nanv ahetukepi nāśe yadaiva ghaṭāder nāśaḥ pratīyate tadaivāhetukaḥ syān na pūrvam apratīter athaikakṣaṇasthāyitvena ghaṭāder utpateḥ pūrvam api nāśaḥ (|) nanu yathaikakṣaṇasthāyitve notpattiḥ svahetubhyas tathā 'nekakṣaṇasthāyitvenāpy utpattiḥ syāt | vicitraśaktayo hi sāmagryo dṛśyante |
analyzed: nanu ahetuke api nāśe yadā eva ghaṭa ādeḥ nāśaḥ pratīyate tadā eva ahetukaḥ syāt na pūrvam apratīteḥ atha eka kṣaṇa sthāyi tvena ghaṭa ādeḥ utpateḥ pūrvam api nāśaḥ nanu yathā eka kṣaṇa sthāyi tve nā utpattiḥ sva hetubhyaḥ tathā neka kṣaṇa sthāyi tvena api utpattiḥ syāt vicitra śaktayaḥ hi sāmagryaḥ dṛśyante

original: tatra kācit syād api yā'naśvarātmānaṃ janayed ity āha – (p.369)  asmād ityādi | asmāc ca svabhāvamātrabhāvād anyatrāpi deśādivyavadhānenadṛṣṭe | tathā dṛṣṭe (|) virodhi sannidhānāt pūram api svabhāvata eva vināśo bhavati |
analyzed: tatra kācid syāt api yā anaśvara ātmānam janayet iti āha asmāt ityādi asmāt ca svabhāva mātra bhāvāt anyatra api deśa ādi vyavadhānena dṛṣṭe tathā dṛṣṭe virodhi sannidhānāt pūram api svabhāvataḥ eva vināśaḥ bhavati

original: evam manyate | yeṣān tāvad vināśo dṛśyate teṣāṃ yadi na pratikṣaṇaṃ vināśaḥ syāt tadā vināśapratītir eva na syāt | tathā hi yadi dvitīye kṣaṇe bhāvasya sthitis tadāsau sarvadaiva tiṣṭhet | dvitīyepi kṣaṇe kṣaṇadvayasthāyī svabhāvatvāt | tadā ca tenāparakṣaṇadvayaṃ sthātavyaṃ |
analyzed: evam manyate yeṣām tāvat vināśaḥ dṛśyate teṣām yadi na pratikṣaṇam vināśaḥ syāt tadā vināśa pratītiḥ eva na syāt tathā hi yadi dvitīye kṣaṇe bhāvasya sthitiḥ tadā asau sarvadā eva tiṣṭhet dvitīye api kṣaṇe kṣaṇa dvaya sthāyī svabhāva tvāt tadā ca tena apara kṣaṇa dvayam sthātavyam

original: aparasminn api kṣaṇe kṣaṇadvayasthāyisvabhāvatvād aparasmin kṣaṇe'vasthānaṃ syād evam uttarottare kṣaṇe draṣṭavyam ity āsaṃsāram bhāvasya sthitiḥ syāt |
analyzed: aparasmin api kṣaṇe kṣaṇa dvaya sthāyi svabhāva tvāt aparasmin kṣaṇa ivasthānam syāt evam uttara uttare kṣaṇe draṣṭavyam iti āsaṃsāram bhāvasya sthitiḥ syāt

original: atha prathame kṣaṇe bhāvasya kṣaṇadvayasthāyī svabhāvo svabhāvo dvitīye kjṣaṇa ekakṣaṇasthāyī | tathāpi tayoḥ svabhāvayor bhedāt kṣaṇikatvaṃ syāt | na tv evam api prathame kṣaṇe bhāvasyānekakṣaṇāvasthāyisvabhāvād akṣaṇikatvaṃ syān nāsaṃsāraṃ sthitiprasaṅgād ity uktatvāt |
analyzed: atha prathame kṣaṇe bhāvasya kṣaṇa dvaya sthāyī svabhāvaḥ svabhāvaḥ dvitīye eka kṣaṇa sthāyī tathā api tayoḥ svabhāvayoḥ bhedāt kṣaṇika tvam syāt na tu evam api prathame kṣaṇe bhāvasya aneka kṣaṇa avasthāyi svabhāvāt akṣaṇika tvam syāt na asaṃsāram sthiti prasaṅgāt iti ukta tvāt

original: nanu dvitīyepi kṣaṇe bhāvasyottarakṣaṇānavasthānepi pūrvakṣaṇasthāyī rūpābhedena pūrvam api sthānāt kṣaṇadvayasthāyitvam asty eveti cet (|)
analyzed: nanu dvitīye api kṣaṇe bhāvasya uttara kṣaṇa anavasthāne pi pūrva kṣaṇa sthāyī rūpa abhedena pūrvam api sthānāt kṣaṇa dvaya sthāyi tvam asti eva iti ced

original: na | pūrvam bhāvasya hy eṣa svabhāvo yadekasmin kṣaṇe tiṣṭhaty anayasmin kṣaṇe sthāsyati | sa eva cet svabhāvo dvitīye kṣaṇe tadāpy ekasmin kṣaṇe tiṣṭhaty anyasmin kṣaṇe dvayaṃ sthāsyatīty evam uttarottarakṣaṇepi draṣṭavyam iti na vināśo bhāvasya syāt | dṛśyate ca (|) tasmād vināśapratīty anyathānupapattyā pratikṣaṇavināśānumānaṃ |
analyzed: na pūrvam bhāvasya hi eṣa svabhāvaḥ yat ekasmin kṣaṇe tiṣṭhati anayasmin kṣaṇe sthāsyati saḥ eva ced svabhāvaḥ dvitīye kṣaṇe tadā api ekasmin kṣaṇe tiṣṭhati anyasmin kṣaṇe dvayam sthāsyati iti evam uttara uttara kṣaṇe api draṣṭavyam iti na vināśaḥ bhāvasya syāt dṛśyate ca tasmāt vināśa pratītī anyathā anupapattyā prati kṣaṇa vināśa anumānam

original: adṛṣṭeṣu tarhi kṛtakeṣu kathaṃ pratikṣaṇavināśitvānumānaṃ vināśasyaivādarśanāt |
analyzed: adṛṣṭeṣu tarhi kṛtakeṣu katham pratikṣaṇa vināśi tva anumānam vināśasya eva adarśanāt

original: naiṣa doṣo yasmāt teṣām api prathame kṣaṇe ya eva svabhāvaḥ sa eva cet dvitīyādikṣaṇe tadā'bhūtvā bhavanam eva prathamakṣaṇavat | atha prthame kṣaṇe tasya janmeaiva na sthitir dvitīye ca kṣaṇe sthitir eva na janma | evam api kṣaṇikatvaṃ syāt | janmajanminoḥ sthitisthitimatoś cābhedāt | na ca dvitīye kṣaṇe janma vinā shtitir yuktā |
analyzed: na eṣa doṣaḥ yasmāt teṣām api prathame kṣaṇe yaḥ eva svabhāvaḥ saḥ eva ced dvitīya ādi kṣaṇe tadā bhūtvā bhavanam eva prathama kṣaṇa vat atha prthame kṣaṇe tasya na sthitiḥ dvitīye ca kṣaṇe sthitiḥ eva na janma evam api kṣaṇika tvam syāt janma janminoḥ sthiti sthitimatoḥ ca abhedāt na ca dvitīye kṣaṇe janma vinā shtitiḥ yuktā

original: janma cen na tadāsthitis tasyā dvitīyādikṣaṇabhāvitvāt | dvitīyādau kṣaṇepy evam iti sarvatrotpattir eva na sthitir iti kṣaṇikatvaṃ | kiṃ ca parasparabhinnasyāparāparakālasambandhitvasya kṛtakād bhāvād abhinnatvāt kṣaṇikatvam eva |
analyzed: janma ced na tadā sthitiḥ tasyāḥ dvitīya ādi kṣaṇa bhāvi tvāt dvitīya ādau kṣaṇe pi evam iti sarvatra utpattiḥ eva na sthitiḥ iti kṣaṇikatvam kim ca paraspara bhinnasya apara apara kāla sambandhi tvasya kṛtakāt bhāvāt abhinna tvāt kṣaṇikatvam eva

original: so 'yam ityādinā kārikārtham āha – ayam iti vināśaḥ | kvacid ghaṭādau mudgarādisannidhāne tathānyatrāpīti mudgarasannidhānāt pūrvam api | evan deśādivyavadhānepi (p.370) | (198-99)
analyzed: saḥ yam ityādinā kārikā artham āha ayam iti vināśaḥ kvacid ghaṭa ādau mudgara ādi sannidhāne tathā anyatra api iti mudgara sannidhānāt pūrvam api deśa ādi vyavadhāne api
