original: asattve sādhye nāsti prāmāṇyam iti | svabhāvājñānaṃ pratyakṣanivṛttiḥ | jñāpakājñānam anumānanivṛttiḥ | adṛśyaviṣayāyāḥ pratyakṣānumānanivṛtter ayaṃ nyāya udāhṛta iti samudāyārthaḥ |
analyzed: asattve sādhye na asti prāmāṇyam iti svabhāva ajñānam pratyakṣa nivṛttiḥ jñāpaka ajñānam anumāna nivṛttiḥ adṛśya viṣayāyāḥ pratyakṣa anumāna nivṛtteḥ ayam nyāyaḥ udāhṛtaḥ iti samudāya arthaḥ

original: yasyetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | yasya kasyacit piśācādeḥ sa iti svabhāvaḥ | tad anupalambhamātreṇeti tena tadviṣayānupalambhamāterṇa pratyakṣanivṛttirūpeṇāsannāma | yathoktaṃ prāg iti | "satām api kadācid anupalambhād" ityādinā | svabhāvājñānam anena vyākhyātaṃ |
analyzed: yasya ityādinā vyācaṣṭe yasya kasyacid piśāca ādeḥ saḥ iti svabhāvaḥ tat anupalambha mātreṇa iti tena pratyakṣa nivṛtti rūpeṇa āsat nāma yathā uktam prāk iti satām api kadācid anupalambhāt ityādinā svabhāva ajñānam anena vyākhyātam

original: jñāpakājñānam vyākhyātum āha – yopītyādi | jñāpakasyety asya vivaraṇaṃ liṅgasyeti | atīndriyaḥ pratikṣipyate 'rthaḥ | yathā nāsti viraktaṃ ceti ityādi | tathā jñāpakasya liṅgasyābhāvāt svabhāvaviśeṣo vā pratikṣipyate | atara viśeṣaḥ pratikṣipyate na dhārmimātraṃ | yathā nāsti dānetyādi | dānaṃ ca hiṃsā virotiś ceti dvandvaḥ | tadviṣayāś cetanāḥ |
analyzed: jñāpaka ajñānam vyākhyātum āha yopi ityādi jñāpakasya iti asya vivaraṇam liṅgasya iti atīndriyaḥ pratikṣipyate rthaḥ yathā na asti viraktam ca iti ityādi tathā jñāpakasya liṅgasya abhāvāt svabhāva viśeṣaḥ vā pratikṣipyate viśeṣaḥ pratikṣipyate na dhārmi mātram yathā na asti dāna ityādi dānam ca hiṃsā virotiḥ ca iti dvandvaḥ tad viṣayāḥ cetanāḥ

original: dānacetanānāṃ hiṃsāviraticttanānāṃ cety arthaḥ | (p.375) abhyudayahetunā svargādiphalahetunā | atra cetanānāṃ na svarūpaṃ pratikṣipyate tāsāṃ pratyakṣatvāt | kin tv abhyudayahetutvaṃ svabhāvo viśeṣo nāśtīty ucyate |
analyzed: dāna cetanānām ca iti arthaḥ abhyudaya hetunā svarga ādi phala hetunā atra cetanānām na svarūpam pratikṣipyate tāsām pratyakṣa tvāt kin tu abhyudaya hetu tvam svabhāvaḥ viśeṣaḥ ucyate

original: nanu cetanānāṃ pratyakṣatvād abhyudayahetutāpi tadātmabhūtatvāt | pratyakṣasyaiveti kuto bhrāntir ityādi |
analyzed: nanu cetanānām pratyakṣa tvāt abhyudaya hetutā api tad ātma bhūta tvāt pratyakṣasya eva iti kutas bhrāntiḥ ityādi

original: pratyakṣepy arthe viparyasto 'pavadetāpīti sambandhaḥ | katham viparyasta ity āha – atatphaletyādi | atatphalā anabhyudayaphalā ye dṛṣṭāś cetanā viśeṣā avyākṛtāḥ | tais sādharmyāt | sādharmyam eva katham ity āha – phalasyānantaryābhāvād iti yā anyā atatphalāścetanāḥ | yāś ca tatphalā ubhayatra tatphalasyānantaryan na dṛśyate |
analyzed: pratyakṣe api arthe upavadeta api iti sambandhaḥ katham viparyastaḥ iti āha atatphala ityādi atatphalāḥ anabhyudaya phalāḥ ye dṛṣṭāḥ cetanāḥ viśeṣāḥ avyākṛtāḥ taiḥ sādharmyāt sādharmyam eva katham iti āha phalasya ānantarya abhāvāt iti yāḥ anyāḥ atatphalāḥ cetanāḥ yāḥ ca tad phalāḥ ubhayatra tad phalasya ānantaryat na dṛśyate

original: na tāvateti phalasyānntaryādarśanamātreṇa | tadabhāvaḥ phalābhāvaḥ | kasmād (|) vyavahitānām ityādi | hetoḥ sakāśāt kālāntareṇottarottarāvasthāpariṇāmalakṣaṇena vyavahitānāṃ phalānān darśanāt | mūṣikasyālarkkasya conmattakukkurasya viṣavikāra iva sa hi na viṣasaṃcārakāla eva bhavati kin tu sahakāriṇaḥ kālaviśeṣasya sannidhauniṣpadyate |
analyzed: na tāvatā iti phalasya anntarya a darśana mātreṇa tad abhāvaḥ phala abhāvaḥ kasmāt vyavahitānām ityādi hetoḥ sakāśāt kāla antareṇa uttara uttara avasthā pariṇāma lakṣaṇena vyavahitānām darśanāt mūṣikasya alarkkasya ca unmatta kukkurasya viṣa vikāraḥ iva sa hi na viṣa saṃcāra kāle eva bhavati kin tu sahakāriṇaḥ kāla viśeṣasya sannidhau niṣpadyate

original: na tu hetvantaram eva tadvat |
analyzed: na tu hetu antaram eva tadvat

original: syād etat (|) mūṣikādiviṣavikārasya kālāntare dṛṣṭatvāt sadbhāvo yukta eva dānādiphalan tu na kadācanāpi dṛṣṭam iti kathan tasya sadbhāva ity āha – tad ityādi | tadbhāva iti | tayor dānādiphalātīndriyavastunor bhāve virodhābhāvāt | atra dānādiphale 'tīndriyabhāve vānupalabdhimātram apramāṇaṃ |
analyzed: syāt etat mūṣika ādi viṣa vikārasya kāla antare dṛṣṭa tvāt sadbhāvaḥ yuktaḥ eva dāna ādi phalan tu na kadācana api dṛṣṭam iti kathan tasya sadbhāvaḥ iti āha tat ityādi tad bhāvaḥ iti tayoḥ dāna ādi phala atīndriya vastunoḥ bhāve virodha abhāvāt atra dāna ādi phale tīndriya bhāve vā anupalabdhi mātram apramāṇam

original: yadi bādhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ nāstīty apratikṣepo bhāve 'stitve kiṃ pramāṇan naivāsti pramāṇam ataḥ sattāniścayo na yukta iti paraḥ |
analyzed: yadi bādhakam pramāṇam na asti iti apratikṣepaḥ bhāve stitve kim na eva asti pramāṇam atas sattā niścayaḥ na yuktaḥ iti paraḥ

original: ata evety ācāryaḥ | atyantam atīndriyasyārthasya sādhakabādhakapramāṇābhāvāt prekṣāvataḥ saṃśayo yuktaḥ | yadi vā yad vatu nirākartun na śakyate na ca tasya sādhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ pratibhāti | tasyaivaṃ sambhāvanā yuktā bhaved asya kadāciat sādhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ (p.376) kasyacit pratibhāvataḥ | tasmād arthasaṃśayāt pramāṇasaṃśayād vā 'pratikṣepaḥ |
analyzed: atas eva iti ācāryaḥ atyantam atīndriyasya arthasya sādhaka bādhaka pramāṇa abhāvāt prekṣāvataḥ saṃśayaḥ yuktaḥ yadi vā yat nirākartun na śakyate na ca tasya sādhakam pramāṇam pratibhāti tasya evam sambhāvanā yuktā bhavet asya kadācid sādhakam pramāṇam kasyacid pratibhāvataḥ tasmāt artha saṃśayāt pramāṇa saṃśayāt vā pratikṣepaḥ

original: anye tu viraktacitte 'byudayahetutve cāta eveti sādhakabādhakapramāṇābhāvāt saṃśayos tv iti vyākhyāya | viraktaṃ cittaṃ sarvajñatve bhaved vā pramāṇam ity apratikṣepaḥ | tac ca pramāṇaṃ dvitīye pricchede 'bhidhāsyata iti vyācakṣate |
analyzed: anye tu virakta citte byudaya hetu tve ca atas eva iti sādhaka bādhaka pramāṇa abhāvāt saṃśayoḥ tu iti vyākhyāya viraktam cittam sarvajñatve bhavet vā pramāṇam iti apratikṣepaḥ tat ca pramāṇam dvitīye pricchede bhidhāsyate iti vyācakṣate

original: yata eva vyavahitasyāpi kāryotpattiḥ | tat asmād atra evātīndriyeṣu madhye keṣāṃcid arthānāṃ svabhāvānāṃ ceti yady api pāṭhakramaḥ | tathāpi yathāyogaṃ sambandhaḥ |
analyzed: yatas eva vyavahitasya api kārya utpattiḥ tat asmāt atra eva atīndriyeṣu madhye keṣāṃcid arthānām svabhāvānām ca iti yadi api pāṭha kramaḥ tathā api yathāyogam sambandhaḥ

original: keṣāṃcit svabhāvanām abhudayahetvādīnāṃ bhavej jñāpakāsiddhiḥ | kathaṃ (|) darśanapāṭavābhāvāt | tadviṣayasyānubhavasya yathāgahītasvarūpaniścayotpādane sāmarthyābhāvāt keṣāṃcid arthānāṃ viraktacittatvādīnāṃ | pratyakṣānumānalakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ jñāpakantasyābhāvāt |
analyzed: keṣāṃcid bhavet jñāpaka asiddhiḥ katham darśana pāṭava abhāvāt tad viṣayasya anubhavasya sāmarthya abhāvāt keṣāṃcid arthānām virakta citta tva ādīnām pratyakṣa anumāna lakṣaṇam kāryam jñāpakam tasya abhāvāt

original: tathābhūtasya kāryasya kasmād abhāva ity āha – kāraṇānām ityādi | na hi kāraṇair vaśyamātmajñāpakaṅ kāryaṃ sarvapuruṣagrāhyam ārabdhavyam iti niyamaḥ |
analyzed: tathābhūtasya kāryasya kasmāt abhāvaḥ iti āha kāraṇānām ityādi na hi kāraṇaiḥ vaśyam ātma jñāpakam kāryam sarva puruṣa grāhyam ārabdhavyam iti niyamaḥ

original: anne tv anyathā vyācakṣate | keṣāṃ cit svabhāvānām abhyudayahetuvādināṃ | arthānāṃ ca viraktacittādīnām bhavej jñāpakasya niścāyakasya pramāṇasyāsiddhiḥ | kutaḥ (|) darśanapāṭavābhāvāt |
analyzed: anne tu anyathā vyācakṣate keṣām cit svabhāvānām abhyudaya hetu vādinām arthānām ca virakta citta ādīnām bhavet jñāpakasya niścāyakasya pramāṇasya asiddhiḥ kutas darśana pāṭava abhāvāt

original: etad uktam bhavati | darśanam eva jñāpakaṃ kasyacid arthasya tac cāpaṭutvāt sarvākāraniścayan notpādayati | kāraṇānāṃ ca kāryotpādananiyamābhāvas tenānantarakāryādarśanāt | kāryadvāreṇāpy abhyudayahetutvan na śakyaṃ niṣeddhuṃ | tathātīndriyāṇām arthānāṃ darśanasya manovijñānalakṣaṇasyāpāṭavāt pratyakṣeṇāgarhaṇaṃ |
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati darśanam eva jñāpakam kasyacid arthasya tat ca apaṭu tvāt sarva ākāra niścayan na utpādayati kāraṇānām ca kārya utpādana niyama abhāvaḥ tena anantara kārya adarśanāt kārya dvāreṇa api abhyudaya hetu tvat na śakyam niṣeddhum tathā atīndriyāṇām arthānām darśanasya manaḥ vijñāna lakṣaṇasya apāṭavāt pratyakṣeṇa agarhaṇam

original: na hi kāryadvāreṇaiṣāṃ niścayaḥ kāraṇānāṃ ca kāryotpādananiyamābhāvāt | na hi kāraṇair avaśyamātmajñāpakaṃ kāryaṃ santānāntare janayitavyam iti niyamaḥ | tasmān na pratyakṣaṃ nānumānaṃ teṣām asti |
analyzed: na hi kārya dvāreṇa eṣām niścayaḥ kāraṇānām ca kārya utpādana niyama abhāvāt na hi kāraṇaiḥ avaśyam ātma jñāpakam kāryam santāna antare janayitavyam iti niyamaḥ tasmāt na pratyakṣam na anumānam teṣām asti

original: neyateti yathoktajñāpakābhāvamātreṇa tadabhāvo 'tīnriyāṇām abhāvaḥ | yasmāt pratyakṣānumānābhyām anupalabdhānām api keṣāṃcid arthānāṃ punar api paryāyeṇa krameṇa kuḍyavivarāvasthitānām arthānāṃ pratyakṣeṇānumānenābhivyaktaeḥ pratīteḥ | tad evaṃ viprakṛṭe svabhāvānupalambho nāsattāsādhanaṃ | nāpi kāryāṇupalambhaḥ |
analyzed: neyatā iti yathā ukta jñāpaka abhāva mātreṇa tīnriyāṇām abhāvaḥ yasmāt pratyakṣa anumānābhyām anupalabdhānām api keṣāṃcid arthānām punar api paryāyeṇa krameṇa kuḍya vivara avasthitānām arthānām pratyakṣeṇa anumānena abhivyaktaeḥ pratīteḥ tat evam viprakṛṭe svabhāva anupalambhaḥ na asattā sādhanam nā api kārya aṇupalambhaḥ

original: (p.377)  kāraṇānupalambhas tu tatrāpy abhāvasādhanm ity āha – kārye tv ityādi | kārye tu svabhāvādiviprakarṣiṇy api kārakājñānaṃ kāraṇānupalabdhir abhāvasya sādhanam eva |
analyzed: kāraṇa anupalambhaḥ tu tatra api abhāva sādhan iti āha kārye tu ityādi kārye tu svabhāva ādi viprakarṣiṇi api kāraka ajñānam kāraṇa anupalabdhiḥ abhāvasya sādhanam eva

original: svabhāvetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | viprakṛṣṭaviṣayasy svabhāvasyābhāve sādhye svabhāvānupalambha evāpramāṇam ucyate | kāraṇānupalambhas tu pramāṇam eva |
analyzed: svabhāva ityādinā vyācaṣṭe viprakṛṣṭa viṣayasi svabhāvasya abhāve sādhye svabhāva anupalambhaḥ eva apramāṇam ucyate kāraṇa anupalambhaḥ tu pramāṇam eva

original: nanu viprakṛṣṭaviṣaye kāraṇānupalambha eva niścetum aśakyas tat kathaṃ kāryābhāvaṃ sādhayet | sattyam (|) etāvad vaktuṃ śakyate (|) kāraṇam antareṇānuddiṣṭaviṣaye kāryam avaśyaṃ na bhavatītīyatā leśenāsyopanyāsaḥ | ata eva sāmānyenāha – na hy astītyādi |
analyzed: nanu viprakṛṣṭa viṣaye kāraṇa anupalambhaḥ eva niścetum aśakyaḥ tat katham kārya abhāvam sādhayet sattyam etāvat vaktum śakyate kāraṇam antareṇa anuddiṣṭa viṣaye kāryam avaśyam na bhavati iti iyatā leśena asya upanyāsaḥ atas eva sāmānyena āha na hi asti ityādi

original: nanv ityādi paraḥ | agner vināśepi vāsagrahādau dhūmasya darśanāt | tathā cāsaty api kāraṇe kāryaṃ dṛṣṭam iti vyabhicāraḥ | asati kāraṇe kāryan na syād ity anena vākyena kāraṇasthitikālabhāvi kāryaṃ | yāvat kāraṇasattā tāvat kāryasattety evan na brūmo yena kāraṇanāśepītyādikaḥ prasaṅgaḥ syāt |
analyzed: nanu ityādi paraḥ agneḥ vināśe pi vāsa graha ādau dhūmasya darśanāt tathā ca asati api kāraṇe kāryam dṛṣṭam iti vyabhicāraḥ asati kāraṇe na syāt iti anena vākyena kāraṇa sthiti kāla bhāvi kāryam yāvat kāraṇa sattā tāvat kārya sattā iti evat na brūmaḥ yena kāraṇa nāśe pi ityādikaḥ prasaṅgaḥ syāt

original: kin tarhy anena vākyenocyata ityāha – hetur ahitetyādi |
analyzed: kim tarhi anena vākyena ucyate iti āha hetuḥ ahita ityādi

original: evan tāvat sthiratām abhyupagamyoktaṃ | kṣaṇikatve tu kāraṇe vinaṣṭe kāryasthānam eva nāstīti kuto vyabhicārāśaṃkā | tathā hi yognijanyo dhūmakṣaṇas tasyāgnivināśe nāsty evāvasthānaṃ | kṣaṇikatvena vināśāt | yaś ca paścāt sthāyī dhūmaḥ sa dhūmahetuka eva nāgnihetukaḥ | tad eva darśayan nāha – na ca tathetyādi |
analyzed: evam tāvat sthira tām abhyupagamya uktam kṣaṇika tve tu kāraṇe vinaṣṭe kārya sthānam eva nā asti iti kutas vyabhicāra āśaṃkā tathā hi yaḥ agni janyaḥ dhūma kṣaṇaḥ tasya agni vināśe nā asti eva avasthānam kṣaṇika tvena vināśāt yaḥ ca paścāt sthāyī dhūmaḥ sa dhūma hetukaḥ eva nā agni hetukaḥ tat eva darśayan na āha na ca tathā ityādi

original: tathā sthāyīti naṣṭepyādye kāraṇe kālāntarasthāyī | tadupādānaḥ pūrvaniruddhahetūpādānaḥ |
analyzed: tathā sthāyī iti naṣṭe ipi ādye kāraṇe kāla antara sthāyī tad upādānaḥ pūrva niruddha hetu upādānaḥ

original: kathan tarhi pāścātyopi dhūmognihetuka ity ucyata ity āha – pāram paryetyādi | ādyan tāvad dhūmakṣaṇam vahnir eva janayati (|) sa dhūmakṣaṇo 'paraṃ sopy aparam ity evaṃ pāram paryeṇa | etad eva sphuṭayan nāha – santānopakārād iti | prabandhasya prathamato jananāt tatkāryavyapadeśaḥ |
analyzed: kathan tarhi pāścātyaḥ api dhūma ugni hetukaḥ iti ucyate iti āha pāram paryetyādi ādyan tāvat dhūma kṣaṇam vahniḥ eva janayati sa dhūma kṣaṇaḥ param saḥ api aparam iti evam pāram etat eva sphuṭayan na āha santāna upakārāt iti prabandhasya prathamatas jananāt tad kārya vyapadeśaḥ

original: tasmād yasya kāraṇasya pāścātyam api kāryam ity evaṃ vyapadeśaḥ (p.378) | yady asya hetoḥ kathaṃcit pramāṇenābhāvaḥ sidhyate tadā tatphalantasya hetoḥ phalan nāstīti niścīyate |
analyzed: tasmāt yasya kāraṇasya pāścātyam api kāryam iti evam vyapadeśaḥ yadi asya hetoḥ kathaṃcid pramāṇena abhāvaḥ sidhyate tadā tat phalat tasya hetoḥ phalat na asti iti niścīyate

original: etac coddiṣṭaviṣayasyābhāvasya sādhanam abhipretyoktam (|) anuddiṣṭaviṣaye tu naitatpramāṇaṃ pratibandhaphalatvāt |
analyzed: etat ca uddiṣṭa viṣayasya abhāvasya sādhanam abhipretya uktam anuddiṣṭa viṣaye tu na etat pramāṇam pratibandha phala tvāt

original: svabhāvetyādi | arthasyeti vyāpakasya svabhāve 'vyatirikte liṅginyasattvena sādhye svabhāvānupalambhaś ca vyāpakānupalambhaś cābhāvasya sādhanam iti prakṛtaṃ | (203-4)
analyzed: svabhāva ityādi arthasya iti vyāpakasya svabhāve vyatirikte liṅgini asattvena sādhye svabhāva anupalambhaḥ ca vyāpaka anupalambhaḥ ca abhāvasya sādhanam iti prakṛtam

original: svabhāvābhāvetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | kaścid iti vyāpakānupalmbhaḥ | yady anupalabhyamāno vyāpakaḥ svabhāvo 'sya vyāpyasya siddhaḥ syāt tadā bhavet pramāṇaṃ | kāraṇavyāpakānupalambhaś ca bhavet pramāṇaṃ yadi tadabhāvas tayoḥ kāraṇavyāpakayor abhāvaḥ pratīyeta hetunā kenacit | svabhāvānupalambhākhyena |
analyzed: svabhāva abhāva ityādinā vyācaṣṭe kaścid iti vyāpaka anupalmbhaḥ yadi anupalabhyamānaḥ vyāpakaḥ svabhāvaḥ vyāpyasya siddhaḥ syāt tadā bhavet pramāṇam kāraṇa vyāpaka anupalambhaḥ ca bhavet pramāṇam yadi tad abhāvaḥ tayoḥ kāraṇa vyāpakayoḥ abhāvaḥ pratīyeta hetunā kenacid svabhāva anupalambha ākhyena

original: yadītyādinā kārikāryam āha – yady asya kārakasyābhāvaḥ siddhyed iti sambandhaḥ | vyāpakasya ca svabhāvasyābhāvaḥ | kutaś cid gamakād dhetor ity upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptānupalambhāt | so 'yaṃ kārako vyāpako vā 'san neva siddho yathākramaṃ kāryaṃ vyāpyañ ca nivartayati |
analyzed: yadi ityādinā kāri kāryam āha yadi asya kārakasya abhāvaḥ siddhyet iti sambandhaḥ vyāpakasya ca svabhāvasya abhāvaḥ kutas cit gamakāt hetoḥ iti upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāpta anupalambhāt saḥ yam kārakaḥ vyāpakaḥ vā san na iva siddhaḥ yathākramam kāryam ca nivartayati

original: tadabhāvāsiddhau kārakavyāpakayor abhāvāsiddau nivarttye 'pi (p.379) kārye vyāpye ca saṃśayāt | (204-5)
analyzed: tad abhāva asiddhau kāraka vyāpakayoḥ abhāva asiddau nivarttye pi kārye vyāpye ca saṃśayāt

original: yadi svabhāvābhāve sādhye tadanupalambha evāpramāṇam ucyate | katham idānīm bhāvasta ghaṭādeḥ svayam anupalabdher abhāvasiddhiḥ |
analyzed: yadi svabhāva abhāve sādhye tad anupalambhaḥ evā apramāṇam ucyate katham idānīm ghaṭa ādeḥ svayam anupalabdheḥ abhāva siddhiḥ

original: uttaram āha – dṛśyasyetyādi | viprakṛṣṭe viṣaye svabhāvānupalambhe pramāṇam uktaṃ | na tu dṛśyaviṣaya ity arthaḥ | dṛśyasyeti svabhāvādyaviprakṛṣṭasya bhāvasyānplabdhasya sataḥ | bhāvasya sattāyā abhāvaḥ pratīyate | kadā darśanābhāvakāraṇāsambhave sati | darśanābhāvasya kāraṇaṃ kāraṇāntarāṇāṃ vaikalyantasyāsambhave sati |
analyzed: uttaram āha dṛśyasya ityādi viprakṛṣṭe viṣaye svabhāva anupalambhe pramāṇam uktam na tu dṛśya viṣaye iti arthaḥ dṛśyasya iti svabhāva ādi aviprakṛṣṭasya bhāvasya anplabdhasya sataḥ bhāvasya sattāyāḥ abhāvaḥ pratīyate kadā darśana abhāva kāraṇa asambhave sati darśana abhāvasya kāraṇam kāraṇa antarāṇām vaikalyantasya asambhave sati

original: upalambhapratyayāntarasākalye satīty arthaḥ |
analyzed: upalambha pratyaya antara sākalye sati iti arthaḥ

original: bhāvo hītyādi viraṇaṃ | svabhāvādyviprakṛṣṭo bhāāvo yadi bhavet | yathāsva grāhakeṇa karaṇaneti yasya yad grāhakam indriyantenopalabhya eva bhavet sa iti yathokto bhāvaḥ | darśanaprapibandhiṣū vyavadhānādiṣu (|) ādiśabdād vaikalyapratibandhādiṣv asatsu | upalambhapratyayeṣu satsv iti yāvat | (205-6)
analyzed: bhāvaḥ hi ityādi svabhāva ādi viprakṛṣṭaḥ yadi bhavet grāhakeṇa karaṇanā iti yasya yat grāhakam eva bhavet saḥ iti yathā uktaḥ bhāvaḥ vyavadhāna ādiṣu ādi śabdāt vaikalya pratibandha ādiṣu asatsu upalambha pratyayeṣu satsu iti yāvat

original: tathā bhūtonupalabdhas tv asann iti niścīyate | kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) tādṛśaḥ sata upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptasya sataḥ | upalambhāvyabhicārāt | ya evāyaṃ svabhāvasyābhāvaniścaye dṛśyasya darśanetyādinokto 'yam eva hetur veditavyaḥ | kasmin sādhye (|) hetuvyāpakayor abhāvepi sādhye |
analyzed: tathā bhūtaḥ unupalabdhaḥ tu asan iti niścīyate kiṅkāraṇam tādṛśaḥ sataḥ upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptasya sataḥ upalambha avyabhicārāt yaḥ eva ayam svabhāvasya abhāva niścaye dṛśyasya darśana ityādinā uktaḥ yam eva hetuḥ veditavyaḥ kasmin sādhye hetu vyāpakayoḥ abhāve pi sādhye

original: viruddhasya cetyādi | yasyābhāvasādhyas tena yo viruddhas tasyopalabdhau ca syād asattāyāḥ pratiṣedhyābhāvasya niścayaḥ | kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) viruddhasya bhāvasya bhāve sattāyān tadbhāvabādhanāt | tasya niṣedhyābhimatasya sattābādhanāt |
analyzed: viruddhasya ca ityādi yasya abhāva sādhyaḥ tena yaḥ viruddhaḥ tasya upalabdhau ca syāt asattāyāḥ pratiṣedhya abhāvasya niścayaḥ kiṅkāraṇam viruddhasya bhāvasya bhāve sattāyān tad bhāva bādhanāt tasya niṣedhya abhimatasya sattā bādhanāt

original: yo hītyādi vivaraṇaṃ | kasmān nāvatiṣṭhata ityāha – tad ityādi | tayor viruddhayor ye upādāne tayor anyonyaṃ parasparaṃ yad vaiguṇyantasyāśrayatvena | yathā śītopādānam uṣṇopādānavaiguṇyasyāśraya itaraś cetarasyety arthaḥ | tena kāraṇena viruddhayor (p.380) ekatra yugapadārambhavirodhāt | tayor viruddhayor ekasya bhāve 'py anyābhāvagatir bhavati |
analyzed: yaḥ hi ityādi vivaraṇam kasmāt na avatiṣṭhate iti āha tat ityādi tayoḥ viruddhayoḥ ye upādāne tayoḥ anyonyam parasparam yat vaiguṇyam tasya āśraya tvena yathā śīta upādānam uṣṇa upādāna vaiguṇyasya āśrayaḥ itaraḥ ca itarasya iti arthaḥ tena kāraṇena viruddhayoḥ ekatra yugapad ārambha virodhāt tayoḥ viruddhayoḥ ekasya bhāve pi anya abhāva gatiḥ bhavati

original: yathoktaṃ prāg anupalabdhiprabhede | "na śītasparśo 'trāgner" ityādi | yady apy atrānupalabdhir iti na śrūyate tathāpīdaṃ svabhāvaviruddhākhyaṃ liṅhgam anupalabdhes sakāśān na pṛthag ucyate (|) kiṅ kāraṇaṃ (|) tata evānupalambhād virodhagateḥ | virodhāc cābhāvasādhanād ity uktaṃ |
analyzed: yathā uktam prāk anupalabdhi prabhede na śīta sparśaḥ u tra agneḥ ityādi yadi api atra anupalabdhiḥ iti na śrūyate tathā api idam svabhāva viruddha ākhyam liṅhgam anupalabdheḥ sakāśāt na pṛthak ucyate kim kāraṇam tatas eva anupalambhāt virodha gateḥ virodhāt ca abhāva sādhanāt iti uktam

original: bhavatu nāmaivam vidhāyā dṛśyānupalabdheḥ sakāśād bhāvagatiḥ | sā punaḥ katham anumānaṃ (|) naivānumānaṃ kin tu pramāṇāntaram eveti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: bhavatu nāma evam vidhāyāḥ dṛśya anupalabdheḥ sakāśāt bhāva gatiḥ sā punar katham anumānam na eva anumānam kin tu pramāṇa antaram eva iti bhāvaḥ

original: kathan na syād ityācaryaḥ |
analyzed: katham na syāt iti ācaryaḥ

original: dṛṣṭāntetyādi paraḥ | dṛṣṭāntāpekṣaṃ hy anumānam anvayavyatirekavattvāt | dṛṣṭāntāpekṣaṇam evāha – na hīti | asyām ity anupalabdhau |
analyzed: dṛṣṭānta ityādi paraḥ dṛṣṭānta apekṣam hi anumānam anvaya vyatirekavat tvāt dṛṣṭānta apekṣaṇam eva āha na hi iti asyām iti anupalabdhau

original: kin netyācāryaḥ |
analyzed: kim na iti ācāryaḥ

original: tad ityādi paraḥ | tad vyomakusumādi | asad iti kathaṃ kena pramāṇenāvagantavyaṃ yenaivaṃ syād adṛṣṭāntaḥ syāt | anapalabdher eva liṅgād vyomakusumādyasadavagantavyam iti cet | tatreti vyomakusumādau | katham adṛṣṭāntikā dṛṣṭāntarahitā 'sattāsiddhiḥ | sadṛṣṭāntatve vānavasthāprsaṅga iti tatrāpya(pa)ropīti kṛtvā |
analyzed: tat ityādi paraḥ tat vyoma kusuma ādi asat iti katham kena pramāṇena avagantavyam yena evam syāt adṛṣṭāntaḥ syāt anapalabdheḥ eva liṅgāt vyoma kusuma ādi asat avagantavyam iti ced tatra iti vyoma kusuma ādau katham adṛṣṭāntikā dṛṣṭānta rahitā sattā siddhiḥ sa dṛṣṭānta tve vā anavasthā prsaṅgaḥ iti tatra api aparopī iti kṛtvā

original: tathā cety anavasthāyāṃ satyāṃ sādhyasyāpratipattiḥ | yataś ca dṛṣṭāntatvenavasthādoṣaḥ | tasmān nirupākhyābhāvasiddhir adṛṣṭāntaikā | tadvad anyatrāpi (|) neha ghaṭonupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptasyānupalabdher ityādāv api prayoge dṛṣṭāntānapekṣaṇād ananumānam anupalabdhiḥ (|)
analyzed: tathā ca iti anavasthāyām satyām sādhyasya apratipattiḥ yatas ca dṛṣṭānta tvena avasthā doṣaḥ tasmāt nirupākhya abhāva siddhiḥ adṛṣṭānta ekā tadvat anyatra api na iha ghaṭaḥ nupalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptasya anupalabdheḥ ityādau api prayoge dṛṣṭānta anapekṣaṇāt ananumānam anupalabdhiḥ

original: śṛṇvannapītyācāryaḥ | asakṛduktam etat | yathā svabhāvānupalabdhau nābhāvaḥ sādhyate kin tv abhāvavyavahāra iti śṛṇvann api devānāṃ mūrkhāṇāṃ priyo nāvadhāraṇapaṭuryena (p.381) saty api dṛṣṭānte tadasiddhiś codyate | dṛṣṭāntam eva darśayitum upakramate | nimittaṃ hītyādi |
analyzed: śṛṇvan api iti ācāryaḥ asakṛt uktam etat yathā svabhāva anupalabdhau na abhāvaḥ sādhyate kin tu abhāva vyavahāraḥ iti śṛṇvan api devānām mūrkhāṇām priyaḥ na avadhāraṇa paṭuḥ yena sati api dṛṣṭānte tad asiddhiḥ codyate dṛṣṭāntam eva darśayitum upakramate nimittam hi ityādi

original: upalabhyānupalabdhir dṛśyānupalabdhir yā nimittaṃ kāraṇam asadvyavahārāṇāṃ | sety anupalabdhiḥ svasannidhānād ātmasannidhānāt | svanimittān svam anupalabdhirūpaṃ nimittaṃ yeṣān tānetānasadvyavahārātn sādhayatīti kṛtvā sarvotra dṛṣṭāntaḥ | kiṅbhūtaḥ (|) svanimittasāmagrīyogyasannidhānaḥ |
analyzed: upalabhya anupalabdhiḥ dṛśya anupalabdhiḥ yā nimittam kāraṇam asat vyavahārāṇām sā iti anupalabdhiḥ sva sannidhānāt ātma sannidhānāt sva nimittān svam anupalabdhi rūpam nimittam yeṣān tān etān asat vyavahārān sādhayati iti kṛtvā sarvaḥ atra dṛṣṭāntaḥ kiṅbhūtaḥ sva nimitta sāmagrī yogya sannidhānaḥ

original: svakāraṇānāṃ sāmagrī tasyāṃ yogyaṃ sannidhānaṃ yasyāṅkurādes sa tathoktaḥ (|) prayogaḥ punaḥ | yasya yatra nimittaṃ sakalam apratibadvam asti tatra tena bhavitavyantadyarthāṅkurādi | asti copalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptasyānupalabdhāvasadvyavahārāṇāṃ nimittatvam iti svabhāvahetuḥ |
analyzed: sva kāraṇānām sāmagrī tasyām yogyam sannidhānam yasya aṅkura ādeḥ sa tathā uktaḥ prayogaḥ punar yasya yatra nimittam sakalam apratibadvam asti tatra tena bhavitavyam tad yartha aṅkura ādi asti ca upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptasya anupalabdhau asat vyavahārāṇām nimitta tvam iti svabhāva hetuḥ

original: kasmād (|) atrābhāvavyavahāra eva sādhyate na punar abhāva evety āha – asattetyādi | atra dṛśyānupalabdhāvanupalabdhir eva sattā | yathoktaṃ prāk | tasmād abhāvo na (?) sādhyate | yata evātrābhāvavyavahāraḥ sādhyate 'ta eveyam anupalabdhiḥ svabhāvahetāv antarbhavatīti sambandhaḥ |
analyzed: kasmāt atra abhāva vyavahāraḥ eva sādhyate na punar abhāvaḥ eva iti āha asat tā ityādi atra dṛśya anupalabdhau anupalabdhiḥ eva sattā yathā uktam prāk tasmāt abhāvaḥ na sādhyate yatas eva atra abhāva vyavahāraḥ sādhyate te eva iyam anupalabdhiḥ svabhāva hetau antarbhavati iti sambandhaḥ

original: kāraṇād duśyānupalambhāt kāryasyāsadvyavahārasyānumānaṃ tad eva lakṣaṇaṃ yasyeti sāmānyenānyapadārtham upadarśya paścād bhāvapratyayaḥ | samagrāt kāraṇāt kāryānumāne ca yogyatānumānam iti svabhāvahetāv antarbhāvaḥ (|) vakṣyāmaś caturthe paricchede ( ) |
analyzed: kāraṇāt duśya anupalambhāt kāryasya asat vyavahārasya anumānam tat eva lakṣaṇam yasya iti sāmānyena anya padārtham upadarśya paścāt bhāva pratyayaḥ samagrāt kāraṇāt kārya anumāne ca yogyatā anumānam iti svabhāva hetau antarbhāvaḥ vakṣyāmaḥ caturthe paricchede

original: dṛśyānupalabdhau bhavatu dṛṣṭānto 'dṛśyānupalabdhau tu katham ity āha – sacchabdetyādi deśādiviprakṛṣṭeṣu pramāṇanivṛttyā sadvyavahāraniṣedhe sādhye kāraṇābhāvāt kāryasyābhāvaḥ sādhyastenātra na kevalannirupākhyaṃ dṛṣṭāntaḥ kun tu nimittasya kāraṇasya vaikalyenābhāvinoṅkurādayopi dṛṣṭāntaḥ |
analyzed: dṛśya anupalabdhau bhavatu dṛṣṭāntaḥ dṛśya anupalabdhau tu katham iti āha sat śabda ityādi deśa ādi viprakṛṣṭeṣu pramāṇa nivṛttyā sat vyavahāra niṣedhe sādhye kāraṇa abhāvāt kāryasya abhāvaḥ sādhyaḥ tena atra na kevalam nirupākhyam dṛṣṭāntaḥ tu nimittasya kāraṇasya vaikalyena abhāvinā uṅkura ādayaḥ api dṛṣṭāntaḥ

original: prayogas tu (|) yodvikalakāraṇan tan na bhavati yathā bījaratihoṅkuraḥ | vikalakāraṇaś cādṛśyānupalabdhau sadvyavahāra iti kāraṇānupalabdhiḥ |
analyzed: prayogaḥ tu yat udvikala kāraṇan tat na bhavati yathā bīja rati hoṅkuraḥ vikala kāraṇaḥ ca adṛśya anupalabdhau sat vyavahāraḥ iti kāraṇa anupalabdhiḥ

original: yat punar uktaṃ (|) tadasannirupākhyaṃ kathaṃ pratipattavyam iti tatrāpi nirupākhye dṛṣṭānte | iyam evam ajñānavyavahāralakṣaṇā pravṛttir niṣdhyate | anupalabdhito na tv abhāvaḥ sādhyate | kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) anupalabdhītyādi | viṣāṇādiviviktaśaśam (p.382) asatakādyupalabdhir evānupalabdhiḥ paryudāsavṛttyā |
analyzed: yat punar uktam tat asat nirupākhyam katham pratipattavyam iti tatra api nirupākhye dṛṣṭānte iyam evam ajñāna vyavahāra lakṣaṇā pravṛttiḥ anupalabdhitaḥ na tu abhāvaḥ sādhyate kiṅkāraṇam anupalabdhi ityādi viṣāṇa ādi vivikta śaśam asataka ādi upalabdhiḥ eva anupalabdhiḥ paryudāsa vṛttyā

original: saiva lakṣaṇaṃ yasyāḥ śaśaviṣāṇāsattāyāḥ sā siddhaiva |
analyzed: sā eva lakṣaṇam yasyāḥ śaśaviṣāṇa asattāyāḥ sā siddhā eva

original: syād etad (|) adṛśyānupalabdhāvasattve viṣayabhūte siddhe | tannimitto 'py asadvyavahāraḥ siddha eveti kin tenāsadvyavahāreṇa | adṛśyānupalabdhāv api sadvyavahāranimittasyābhāvād vyavahārāpravṛttiḥ siddhaiveti sadvyavahāraniṣedhenāpi sādhitena kiṃ |
analyzed: syāt etat adṛśya anupalabdhau asattve viṣaya bhūte siddhe tad nimittaḥ pi asat vyavahāraḥ siddhaḥ eva iti kin tena asat vyavahāreṇa adṛśya anupalabdhau api sat vyavahāra nimittasya abhāvāt vyavahāra apravṛttiḥ siddhā eva iti sat vyavahāra niṣedhena api sādhitena kim

original: tathā pūrvaprasiddhaviṣayopadarśanalakṣaṇena dṛṣṭāntenāpy anupalabdhau na kiṃcit prayojanam ity ata āha – so 'yam ityādi mūḍha praty etat sādhyata iti yāvat |
analyzed: tathā pūrva prasiddha viṣaya upadarśana lakṣaṇena dṛṣṭāntena api anupalabdhau na kiṃcid prayojanam iti atas āha saḥ yam ityādi mūḍha prati etat sādhyate iti yāvat

original: kvacid apy asadvyavahāranimittaṃ dṛśyānupalambham abhyupagamyāsadvyavahārapravṛttim ivalomayan na kurvan | adṛśyānupalabdhau tadabhāvaṃ ca sadvyavahāranimittasya pramāṇasyābhāvaṃ cābhyupagamya sadvyavahāranivṛttiṃ ca vilomayann akurvan |
analyzed: kvacid api asat vyavahāra nimittam dṛśya anupalambham abhyupagamya asat vyavahāra pravṛttim na kurvan adṛśya anupalabdhau tad abhāvam ca sat vyavahāra nimittasya pramāṇasya abhāvam ca abhyupagamya sat vyavahāra nivṛttim ca vilomayan akurvan

original: yathābhyupagamaṃ pratipādyata iti dṛśyānupalambhena nimittena tvayā 'sadvyavahāro 'nyatra kṛtas tad ihāpy asti (|) tasmād asadvyavahāraṅ kurv iti pratipādyate | tathā pramāṇena nimitena tvayā kvacit sadvyavahāraḥ kṛtas tadihāpy anirupākhye nāsti | tasmād sadvyavahāram mā kurv iti pratipādyate | kim iva nirupākhyāvat |
analyzed: yathā abhyupagamam pratipādyate iti dṛśya anupalambhena nimittena tvayā sat vyavahāraḥ nyatra kṛtaḥ tat iha api asti tasmāt asat vyavahāram kuru iti pratipādyate tathā pramāṇena nimitena tvayā kvacid sat vyavahāraḥ kṛtaḥ tat iha api anirupākhye na asti tasmāt sat vyavahāram mā kuru iti pratipādyate kim iva nirupākhyā vat

original: yathā śaśaviṣāṇādāv asadvyavahāranimittasya dṛśyānupalambhasya dṛśyānupalambhasya bhāvād asadvyavahāras tathehāpīti |
analyzed: yathā śaśaviṣāṇa ādau asat vyavahāra nimittasya dṛśya anupalambhasya dṛśya anupalambhasya bhāvāt asat vyavahāraḥ tathā iha api iti

original: anyad veti (|) yathā sannihitanimittasyā 'ṅkurādeḥ pratipattir eva sadvyavahārasyāpīti | yathā ca nirupākhye pramāṇābhāvāt sadvyavahārasya nivṛttiḥ | anyasmin vā kāraṇavikale kārye nivṛttis tadvad viprakṛṣṭeṣu sadvyavahārasya nivṛttir iti pratipādyate |
analyzed: anyat vā iti yathā sannihita nimittasyāḥ ṅkura ādeḥ pratipattiḥ eva sat vyavahārasya api iti yathā ca nirupākhye pramāṇa abhāvāt sat vyavahārasya nivṛttiḥ anyasmin vā kāraṇa vikale kārye nivṛttiḥ tadvat viprakṛṣṭeṣu sat vyavahārasya nivṛttiḥ iti pratipādyate

original: sa eva tāvad upalabdhyabhāvo 'nupalabdhyākhyaḥ kathaṃ kena pramāṇena siddhaḥ (|) na pratyakṣeṇābhāvaviṣayatvavirodhāt | nāpy anumānena pratyakṣapūrvakatvād asya | nāpi pradeśasambandhyanupalambho 'bhāvasy nīrūpatvena sambandhitvāyogāt |
analyzed: saḥ eva tāvat upalabdhi abhāvaḥ nupalabdhi ākhyaḥ katham kena pramāṇena siddhaḥ na pratyakṣeṇa abhāva viṣaya tva virodhāt nā api anumānena pratyakṣa pūrvaka tvāt asya nā api pradeśa sambandhi anupalambhaḥ bhāvasi nīrūpa tvena sambandhi tva ayogāt

original: pradeśasyānupalambhe ca dharmmasiddher āśrayāsiddho hetur ity anupalabdher na pakṣadharmatvam ity udyotakara prabhṛtayaḥ |
analyzed: pradeśasya anupalambhe ca dharmma siddheḥ āśraya asiddhaḥ hetuḥ iti anupalabdheḥ na pakṣa dharma tvam iti udyota kara prabhṛtayaḥ

original: atrāha – etad uttaratra vakṣyāmas tadviśeṣṭopalambho 'tas tasyāpy anupalambhanan tasmād (p.383) anupalambho 'yaṃ pratyakṣeṇaiva sidhyatīti | yat punar uktam anupalabdhau kin dṛṣṭāntopadarśanenety āha – anyatrāpītyādi |
analyzed: atra āha etat uttaratra vakṣyāmaḥ tad viśeṣṭa upalambhaḥ tasya api anupalambhanan tasmāt anupalambhaḥ yam pratyakṣeṇa eva sidhyati iti yat punar uktam anupalabdhau kin dṛṣṭānta upadarśanena iti āha anyatra api ityādi

original: vidhisādhanepy anumāne sādhyadharmeṇa vyāpakena vyāpyadharmaṃ kṛtakatvādikaṃ sādhanam icchan pratipādyaḥ kim iti dṛṣṭāntena pratyāyyaḥ | kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) yathāsvaṃ sādhyena vyāpyasya hetor nirdeśād eva vyāpnuvataḥ sādhyadharmasya siddheḥ | niścitārthas sambandhalakṣaṇo yena tasya vyāmūḍham prati smṛty arthaḥ |
analyzed: vidhi sādhane api anumāne sādhya dharmeṇa vyāpakena vyāpya dharmam kṛtaka tva ādikam sādhanam icchan pratipādyaḥ kim iti dṛṣṭāntena pratyāyyaḥ kiṅkāraṇam yathāsvam sādhyena vyāpyasya hetoḥ nirdeśāt eva vyāpnuvataḥ sādhya dharmasya siddheḥ niścita arthaḥ sambandha lakṣaṇaḥ yena tasya vyāmūḍham prati smṛtī arthaḥ

original: tad etad dṛṣṭāntena mūḍhaṃ prati smṛtijananam atrānupalabdhau | etad evāha – so 'yam ityādi | anyatrāpīti śaśaviṣāṇādau ( | 205-6)
analyzed: tat etat dṛṣṭāntena mūḍham prati smṛti jananam atra anupalabdhau etat eva āha saḥ yam ityādi anyatra api iti śaśaviṣāṇa ādau

original: atha yad idam ācārya dignāga prabhṛtibhir uktaṃ | "na santi pradhānādayo 'nupalabdher" iti tatra prayoge | ācārya āha – kathaṃ ca na syād iti |
analyzed: atha yat idam ācārya dignāga prabhṛtibhiḥ uktam na santi pradhāna ādayaḥ n upalabdheḥ iti tatra prayoge ācāryaḥ āha katham ca na syāt iti

original: codakaḥ svābhiprāyeṇāha – tadarthetyādi | tadarthasya pradhānārthasya niṣedhe sati pradhānādidharmivācino 'bhidhānasyāprayogāt | na hi vācyamantareṇa vācakasya prayogo 'sti | yadā ca pradhānādiśabdānām aprayogas tadā na santīti pratiṣedhavācyeva śabdo 'vaśiṣyate |
analyzed: codakaḥ sva abhiprāyeṇa āha tad artha ityādi tad arthasya pradhāna arthasya niṣedhe sati pradhāna ādi dharmi vācinaḥ bhidhānasya aprayogāt na hi vācyam antareṇa vācakasya sti yadā ca pradhāna ādi śabdānām aprayogaḥ tadā na santi iti pratiṣedha vācyā iva śabdaḥ

original: tasya ca pratiṣedhyāsaṃkīrttane nirviṣayasya pratiṣedhasyeti pratiṣedhavācinaḥ śabdasyāprayogāt | tathā ca na santi pradhānādaya iti dvayor api pratijñāpadayor aprayogāt | kutra kiṃ sādhyata iti vyarthānupalabdheḥ sādhanayogaḥ | pradhānādīnāṃ ca pakṣabhūtānām abhāvād pakṣadharmo hetuḥ syāt |
analyzed: tasya ca pratiṣedhya asaṃkīrttane nirviṣayasya pratiṣedhasya iti pratiṣedha vācinaḥ śabdasya aprayogāt tathā ca na santi pradhāna ādayaḥ iti dvayoḥ api pratijñā padayoḥ aprayogāt kutra kim sādhyate iti vyartha anupalabdheḥ sādhana yogaḥ pradhāna ādīnām ca pakṣa bhūtānām abhāvāt pakṣa dharmaḥ hetuḥ syāt

original: pratijñāpadayor vā parasparaṃ virodhas tathā hi pradhānādaya iti prayogāt tadarthasannidhānaṃ | punar na santīti vacanāt teṣām asannidhānaṃ | ete ca sannidhānāsannidhāne yugapad ekatra virudhyete | (206-7)
analyzed: pratijñā padayoḥ vā parasparam virodhaḥ tathā hi pradhāna ādayaḥ iti prayogāt tad artha sannidhānam punar na santi iti vacanāt teṣām asannidhānam ete ca sannidhāna asannidhāne yugapad ekatra virudhyete

original: (p.384) naiṣa doṣa iti parihāraḥ | yasmād anādervāsanāyās samudbhūte vikalpe pariniṣṭhitas samāruḍhaḥ śabdārthaḥ sa ca bhāvābhāvobhayāśritatvāt trividho dharmmaḥ | tasmin śabderthe vāhyapradhānādiko bhāvonupādānam asyeti tasmin bhāvānupādāne sādhye | asyeti buddhiparivarttinaḥ pradhānādidharmiṇaḥ |
analyzed: na eṣa doṣaḥ iti parihāraḥ yasmāt anādeḥ vāsanāyāḥ samudbhūte vikalpe pariniṣṭhitaḥ samāruḍhaḥ śabda arthaḥ sa ca bhāva abhāva ubhaya āśrita tvāt trividhaḥ dharmaḥ tasmin śabda ṛthe vāhya pradhāna ādikaḥ bhāvaḥ anupādānam asya iti tasmin bhāva anupādāne sādhye asya iti buddhi parivarttinaḥ pradhāna ādi dharmiṇaḥ

original: tatheti bāhyapradhānādyupādānatvenānupalambhanaṃ hetuḥ | vāsanopādānatvenopalambhanam evātrānupalambhanaṃ | na tasyaiva vikalpapratiniṣṭhitasya dharmiṇo 'bhāvas sādhyate | kasmāt (|) pradhānādiśabdānāṃ prayogataḥ | tanniṣedhe hi nirviṣayatvāc chabdaprayoga eva na syāt |
analyzed: tathā iti bāhya pradhāna ādi upādāna tvena anupalambhanam hetuḥ vāsanā upādāna tvena upalambhanam eva atra anupalambhanam na tasya eva vikalpa pratiniṣṭhitasya dharmiṇaḥ bhāvaḥ sādhyate kasmāt pradhāna ādi śabdānām prayogataḥ tad niṣedhe hi nirviṣaya tvāt śabda prayogaḥ eva na syāt

original: niveditam ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | yadi hi svalakṣaṇam abhidheyaṃ syāt tadā svalakṣaṇapratiṣedhe śabdārthasya pratiṣedhāt tadvācinaḥ śabdasyāprayogaḥ syāt | yāvatā niveditam etad yathaite śabdā na svalakṣaṇaviṣayā iti | kintv anādivāsanāyāḥ prabhava utpādo yasya vikalpasya tasmin pratibhāsī yorthas tamviṣayatvenātmasātkurvanti |
analyzed: niveditam ityādinā vyācaṣṭe yadi hi sva lakṣaṇam abhidheyam syāt tadā sva lakṣaṇa pratiṣedhe śabda arthasya pratiṣedhāt tad vācinaḥ śabdasya aprayogaḥ syāt yāvatā niveditam etat yathā ete śabdāḥ na sva lakṣaṇa viṣayāḥ iti kintu anādi vāsanāyāḥ prabhavaḥ utpādaḥ yasya vikalpasya tasmin pratibhāsī yaḥ ṛthaḥ tam viṣaya tvena ātmasātkurvanti

original: kuta etad vikalpaviṣayam evārtham viṣayīkṛtantīty āha – vaktus tadvikalpabhāja iti bhāvābhāvobhayāśrayasāmānyākāravikalpabhājaḥ (|) kāraṇam āha – yathetyādi | yathāpratibhāsi vastu | pratibhāsivastvanatikrameṇa yā pratipādanasamīha tayā śabdaprayogāt | tasmād vikalpapratibhāsina evārthān viṣayīkurvanti |
analyzed: kutas etat vikalpa viṣayam eva artham āha vaktuḥ tad vikalpa bhājaḥ iti bhāva abhāva ubhaya āśraya sāmānya ākāra vikalpa bhājaḥ kāraṇam āha yathā ityādi yathā pratibhāsi vastu pratibhāsi vastu anatikrameṇa yā pratipādana samīha tayā śabda prayogāt tasmāt vikalpa pratibhāsinaḥ eva arthān viṣayīkurvanti

original: tathā śrotuś ca tadvikalpabhāja iti sambandhaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tadākāravikalpajananāt | bhāvābhāvobhayāśrayasāmānyākāravikalpajananāc ca vikalpapratibhāsina evārthān śabdā viṣayīkurvanti |
analyzed: tathā śrotuḥ ca tad vikalpa bhājaḥ iti sambandhaḥ kim kāraṇam tad ākāra vikalpa jananāt bhāva abhāva ubhaya āśraya sāmānya ākāra vikalpa jananāt ca vikalpa pratibhāsinaḥ eva arthān śabdāḥ viṣayīkurvanti

original: syād etad (|) yadi nāmaivan tathāpi svalakṣaṇaviṣayā śabdāḥ svalakṣaṇapratīter ity āha – na cetyādi | upādānaṃ ca kāryaṃ ca te eva pratyayo jñānan tatrāpratibhāsi (p.385) yadūpan tadviṣayatvena tan na śakyan niścetuṃ | tatropādānapratyayo vaktuḥ pratipādanasamīhārūpo vikalpaḥ śabdasya kāraṇatvāt | kāryapratyayaḥ śabdotthaḥ śrotur vikalpaḥ |
analyzed: syāt etat yadi nāma tathā api sva lakṣaṇa viṣayā śabdāḥ sva lakṣaṇa pratīteḥ iti āha na ca ityādi upādānam ca kāryam ca te eva pratyayaḥ tatra apratibhāsi tad viṣaya tvena tat na śakyat niścetum tatra upādāna pratyayaḥ vaktuḥ pratipādana samīhā rūpaḥ vikalpaḥ śabdasya kāraṇa tvāt kārya pratyayaḥ śabda utthaḥ śrotuḥ vikalpaḥ

original: na hi sa śabdārtho yaḥ śabde pratyaye na pratibhāsate | na ca tatra svalakṣaṇaṃ pratibhāsate | spaṣṭākāravivekāt |
analyzed: na hi sa śabda arthaḥ yaḥ śabde pratyaye na pratibhāsate na ca tatra sva lakṣaṇam pratibhāsate spaṣṭa ākāra vivekāt

original: nanu kathaṃ vikalpābhāvāśrayo 'rthajanyatvenāvikalpakatvaprasaṅgāt | kathañcābhāvāśrayo 'bhāvasyākāraṇatvāt | kathañcaika ubhayāśrayo 'hetukatvaprasaṅgād ity ata āha – sa tv ityādi | sadasadubhayākāro vikalpaḥ sadasadubhayapratyayas tenāhitā vāsanā tataḥ prabhava utpādo yasya sa tathoktaḥ | iti hetor bhāvābhāvobhayadharma ity ucyate |
analyzed: nanu katham vikalpa abhāva āśrayaḥ rtha janya tvena avikalpaka tva prasaṅgāt katham ca abhāva āśrayaḥ bhāvasya akāraṇa tvāt katham ca ekaḥ ubhaya āśrayaḥ hetuka tva prasaṅgāt iti atas āha sa tu ityādi sat asat ubhaya ākāraḥ vikalpaḥ sat asat ubhaya pratyayaḥ tena āhitā vāsanā tatas prabhavaḥ utpādaḥ yasya sa tathā uktaḥ iti hetoḥ bhāva abhāva ubhaya dharmaḥ iti ucyate

original: dvitīyaṃ kāraṇam āha – tad ityādi | tasminn neva vikalpe pratibhāsī ya ākāras tasya sadasadubhayarūpatayādhyavasāyas tadvaśena ca | bhāvābhāvobhayadharma ity ucyate | (209)
analyzed: dvitīyam kāraṇam āha tat ityādi tasmin na iva vikalpe pratibhāsī yaḥ ākāraḥ tasya sat asat ubhaya rūpa tayā adhyavasāyaḥ tad vaśena ca bhāva abhāva ubhaya dharmaḥ iti ucyate 209

original: etad uktam bhavati | satpratyayāhitavāsanāprabhavas sadākārādhyavasāyīva bhāvadharma ity ucyate | evamabhāvobhayadharmayor api draṣṭavyaṃ pūrvapūrvasadādipratyayāhitavāsanāprabhavatvād eva sadādivikalpānām anāditvam (|) ato na bhāvādijanyatvaṃ | yataś ca śabdārthastrividhaḥ |
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati sat pratyaya āhita vāsanā prabhavaḥ sat ākāra adhyavasāyī iva bhāva dharmaḥ iti ucyate evam abhāva ubhaya dharmayoḥ api draṣṭavyam pūrva pūrva sat ādi pratyaya āhita vāsanā prabhava tvāt eva sat ādi vikalpānām anādi tvam atas na bhāva ādi janya tvam yatas ca śabda arthaḥ trividhaḥ

original: tat tasmād atra śabdārthe dharmiṇi vyavasthitā vivādāśrayatvena sthitāḥ puruṣās sadasattvaṃ pradhānādeś cintayanti | kathaṃ cintayantīty āha – kim ayaṃ pradhānaśabdād uccaritād vikalpapratibhāsamānortho bāhyapradhānanibandhano bhavati na veti |
analyzed: tat tasmāt atra śabda arthe dharmiṇi vyavasthitāḥ vivāda āśraya tvena sthitāḥ puruṣāḥ sat asat tvam pradhāna ādeḥ cintayanti katham cintayanti iti āha kim ayam pradhāna śabdāt uccaritāt vikalpa pratibhāsamāna ūrthaḥ bāhya pradhāna nibandhanaḥ bhavati na vā iti

original: tasya pradhānādivikalpapratibhāsasya bhāvānupādānatvena dharme sādhye sa eva vikalpapratibhāso buddhisvabhāvatayā pratyātmavedyatvāt svasamvedanapratyakṣasiddhatvād apratikṣepārthortho dharmī |
analyzed: tasya pradhāna ādi vikalpa pratibhāsasya bhāva anupādāna tvena dharme sādhye saḥ eva vikalpa pratibhāsaḥ buddhi svabhāva tayā pratyātma vedya tvāt sva samvedana pratyakṣa siddha tvāt a pratikṣepa arthaḥ ṛthaḥ dharmī

original: nanu ca sa eva vikalpagrāhyārthaḥ svalakṣaṇaṃ svalakṣaṇarūpatayādhyavasāyāt | tataś ca pratyakṣasiddhi eva pradhānādiḥ śabdaś ca svalakṣaṇaviṣaya ity āha – na ca sa evetyādi | sa eva vikalpapratibhāsyartho bāhyaṃ svalakṣaṇam iti śakyam vaktuṃ | kiṃ (p.386) kāraṇam (|) asaṃprāpte 'nutpanne svalakṣaṇe niruddhe ca tasya vikalpapratibhāsasyānapāyāt |
analyzed: nanu ca saḥ eva vikalpa grāhya arthaḥ sva lakṣaṇam sva lakṣaṇa rūpatayā adhyavasāyāt tatas ca eva pradhāna ādiḥ śabdaḥ ca sva lakṣaṇa viṣayaḥ iti āha na ca saḥ eva ityādi saḥ eva vikalpa pratibhāsi arthaḥ bāhyam sva lakṣaṇam iti śakyam vaktum kim kāraṇam asaṃprāpte nutpanne sva lakṣaṇe niruddhe ca tasya vikalpa pratibhāsasya anapāyāt

original: kiṃ ca vastuni ghaṭādau viparītākāraḥ parasparavirodhino nityānityādayaḥ | tānabhiniveṣṭuṃ śīlaṃ yeṣān tīrthāntarīyapratyayānān teṣu bhāvācchārthapratibhāsasya | na ca sa evārthaḥ svalakṣaṇam iti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ || (209-10)
analyzed: kim ca vastuni ghaṭa ādau viparīta ākāraḥ paraspara virodhinaḥ nitya anitya ādayaḥ tān abhiniveṣṭum śīlam yeṣām teṣu bhāvāt cha artha pratibhāsasya na ca saḥ eva arthaḥ sva lakṣaṇam iti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ

original: amum evārthaṃ saṅgrahītum āha – paramārthaḥ svalakṣaṇan tasminn ekasthānaḥ pravṛttir yeṣān tadbhāvas tattvan tasmin sati śabdānām anibandhanā paramārthanibandhanarahitā pravṛttir na syāt | darśanāntarabhinneṣv artheṣu | atītājātayor vāpīti atītānagate cārthe śabdānām pravṛttir na syāt | tathā kasyācid vāco (')bhūtārthatā mṛṣārthatā na syāt |
analyzed: amum eva artham saṅgrahītum āha paramārthaḥ tasmin eka sthānaḥ pravṛttiḥ yeṣān tad bhāvaḥ tattvan tasmin sati śabdānām anibandhanā paramārtha nibandhana rahitā pravṛttiḥ na syāt darśana antara bhinneṣu artheṣu atīta ajātayoḥ vā api iti atīta anagate ca arthe śabdānām pravṛttiḥ na syāt tathā kasyācid vācaḥ bhūta artha tā mṛṣārtha tā na syāt

original: iti yathoktād dhetor eṣā vāk | bauddhārthaviṣayā | vikalpapratibhāsyarthaviṣayā matā | (210-11)
analyzed: iti yathā uktāt hetoḥ eṣā vāc bauddha artha viṣayā vikalpa pratibhāsi artha viṣayā matā

original: tasya ceti pradhānādivikalpapratibhāsasya | yathāsamīhitaṃ rūpaṃ yathāparikalpitam vāhyapradhānādirūpan tadanupādānatve sādhye | tathānupalambha iti yathā samīhitarūpopādānatvenānupalambhostīti kṛtvā na sādhanadharmāsiddhir nāpakṣadharmo hetur ity arthaḥ |
analyzed: tasya ca iti pradhāna ādi vikalpa pratibhāsasya yathā samīhitam rūpam yathā parikalpitam tad anupādāna tve sādhye tathā anupalambhaḥ iti yathā samīhita rūpa upādāna tvena anupalambhaḥ usti iti kṛtvā na sādhana dharma asiddhiḥ na apakṣa dharmaḥ hetuḥ iti arthaḥ

original: na punar atra prayoge 'yam eva śabdetyādi | śabdād utpadyate yo vikalpas tatpratibhāsyarthopahanūyate | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tasya vikalpapratibhāsyarthasya śrotṛbuddhāv upasthāpanāya (p.387) śabdaprayogāt | tadabhāve vikalpapratibhāsyarthābhāve | tadayogāc chabdaprayogāyogāt |
analyzed: na punar atra prayoge yam eva śabda ityādi śabdāt utpadyate yaḥ vikalpaḥ tad pratibhāsi artha upahanūyate kim kāraṇam tasya vikalpa pratibhāsi arthasya śrotṛ buddhau upasthāpanāya śabda prayogāt tad abhāve vikalpa pratibhāsi artha abhāve tad ayogāt śabda prayoga ayogāt

original: api ca yadi śabdārthasya vāpahnavaḥ sādhyate | tadā śabdārthāpahnave sādhye tasya sādhyadharmasya nāstitvasya ya ādhāro dharmī śabdārthalakṣaṇas tasya nirākṛter na sādhyaḥ dharmidharmātmakaḥ samudāyaḥ syāt | kevalaś ca sādhyadharmas siddha eva | nāsti tvamātrasya kvacit siddhatvāt |
analyzed: api ca yadi śabda arthasya vā apahnavaḥ sādhyate tadā śabda artha apahnave sādhye tasya sādhya dharmasya nāstitvasya yaḥ ādhāraḥ dharmī śabda artha lakṣaṇaḥ tasya nirākṛteḥ na sādhyaḥ dharmi dharma ātmakaḥ samudāyaḥ syāt kevalaḥ ca sādhya dharmaḥ siddhaḥ eva nāsti tva mātrasya kvacid siddha tvāt

original: yadītyādi vivaraṇaṃ | tad iti tasmād ayaṃ sādhyadharmaḥ ādhāreṇa yo vyavacchedo viśeṣaṇam asyedaṃ nāstitvan tadanapekṣaḥ | iti hetor nāpanyasanīya eva vivādakāle | (211-12)
analyzed: yadi ityādi vivaraṇam tat iti tasmāt ayam sādhya dharmaḥ ādhāreṇa yaḥ vyavacchedaḥ viśeṣaṇam asya idam tad anapekṣaḥ iti hetoḥ na apanyasanīyaḥ eva vivāda kāle

original: sadasatpakṣabhedeneti sadasatpratijñābhedena vastvneva cintyate | śabdārthānapavādibhirathakriyārthibhiḥ prekṣāvadbhiḥ | yasmād atra vastuni pratibaddhaḥ phalodayaḥ | (212-13)
analyzed: sat asat pakṣa bhedena iti sat asat pratijñā bhedena vastvnā iva cintyate śabda artha anapavādibhiḥ athakriyā arthibhiḥ prekṣāvadbhiḥ yasmāt atra vastuni pratibaddhaḥ phala udayaḥ

original: yadi nāmaivan tathāpi kin na śabdārtho vicāraṇīya ity āha (|) arthetyādi | arthakriyāṃ pratyasamarthasya śabdārthasya vicāraiḥ sadasattvavicāraiḥ kin tadadarthināmarthakriyārthināṃ (|) nidarśanam āha ṣaṇḍhasyetyādi | puṃstvarihitasya yad rūpavairūpyantasmin viṣaye kāminyā maithunābhiṣiṇyāḥ kimparīkṣayā | (213-14)
analyzed: yadi nāma tathā api kin na śabda arthaḥ vicāraṇīyaḥ iti āha artha ityādi arthakriyām prati asamarthasya śabda arthasya vicāraiḥ sat asat tva vicāraiḥ kin nidarśanam āha ṣaṇḍhasya ityādi puṃstva rihitasya yat viṣaye kāminyāḥ kimparīkṣayā

original: na hītyādi vivaraṇaṃ | na hi śabdārthosan kiṃcit puruṣārtham uparuṇaddhi nivartayati | san vā samādadhāti karotīti yathāyogaṃ sambandhanīyaṃ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) yathābhiniveśaṃ puruṣastaṃ śabdārtham bāhyatā 'bhiniveśate 'dhyavasyati tathā tasyāsattvād (p.388) avidyamānatvāt | yathātattvaṃ vā samīhitatvāt |
analyzed: na hi ityādi vivaraṇam na hi śabda arthaḥ usan kiṃcid puruṣa artham uparuṇaddhi nivartayati san vā samādadhāti karoti iti yathāyogam sambandhanīyam kim kāraṇam yathā abhiniveśam puruṣaḥ tam śabda artham bāhyatā abhiniveśate dhyavasyati tathā tasya asattvāt avidyamāna tvāt yathātattvam vā samīhita tvāt

original: yathārthasvalakṣaṇaṃ jñānasvalakṣaṇam vā sthitan tathā śabdenāviṣayīkṛtatvāt | yata evaṃ tasmād ayaṃ puruṣas sadasaccintāyāṃ pravarttamānaḥ sarvadā 'vadhīritavikalpapratibhāso 'napekṣitavikalpapratibhāso vastv evādhiṣṭhānīkaroti viṣayīkaroti yatra vastunyayaṃ puruṣārthaḥ pratibaddhaḥ | agnāv ity agnisvalakṣaṇe | ādigrahaṇād dāhapākādi |
analyzed: yathārtha sva lakṣaṇam jñāna sva lakṣaṇam vā tathā śabdena aviṣayīkṛta tvāt yatas evam tasmāt ayam puruṣaḥ sat asat cintāyām pravarttamānaḥ sarvadā vadhīrita vikalpa pratibhāsaḥ vastu eva adhiṣṭhānīkaroti viṣayīkaroti yatra vastuni ayam puruṣa arthaḥ pratibaddhaḥ agnau iti agni sva lakṣaṇe ādi grahaṇāt dāha pāka ādi

original: syād etad (|) īdṛśorthaḥ śabdārthenāpi sādhyata ity āha – na hītyādi | atreti śītapratighātādau | kasmāt tadanubhavāptāvapi | tasya śabdārthasyānubhavāptāvapi | tadabhāvāt tasya śītapratīkārāder abhāvāt | tat tasmād ayam arthakriyārthī puruṣaḥ |
analyzed: syāt etat īdṛśaḥ ṛthaḥ śabda arthena api sādhyate iti āha na hi ityādi atra iti śīta pratighāta ādau kasmāt tad anubhava āptau api tasya śabda arthasya anubhava āptau api tad abhāvāt tasya śīta pratīkāra ādeḥ abhāvāt tat tasmāt ayam arthakriyā arthī puruṣaḥ

original: tadasamarthan tasyām arthakriyāyām asamarthaṃ śabdārthaṃ prati dattānuyogo dattāvadhāno bhavitun na yuktaḥ | na hi vṛṣasyantī maithunam icchantī ṣaṇḍhasya paricaritum aśaktasya rūpavairūpyaparīkṣāyām avadhatte 'vadhānavatī bhavati |
analyzed: tasyām arthakriyāyām asamartham śabda artham prati datta anuyogaḥ datta avadhānaḥ bhavitun na yuktaḥ na hi vṛṣasyantī maithunam icchantī ṣaṇḍhasya paricaritum aśaktasya rūpa vairūpya parīkṣāyām avadhatte vadhānavatī bhavati

original: udyotakarādyuktadūṣaṇanirāsārthaṃ pṛcchati | yatpunar etad uktam ācāryadignāgena (|) kalpitasyetyādi | tasya korthaḥ |
analyzed: udyota kara ādi ukta dūṣaṇa nirāsa artham pṛcchati yat punar etat uktam ācārya dignāgena kalpitasya ityādi tasya kaḥ ṛthaḥ

original: uttaram āha – śabdārtha ityādi | kalpanājñānaviṣayatvāc chabdārthaḥ pradhānādiśabdārthaḥ | kalpito vastuno bāhyasya pradhānalakṣaṇasyāśrayaṇaṃ tenāsiddhir anupalabdhir asya pradhānādiśabdārthasya dharma ukto liṅgabhūto bhāvānupādānatve sādhye | nyāyavādinācāryadignāgena |
analyzed: uttaram āha śabda arthaḥ ityādi kalpanā jñāna viṣaya tvāt śabda arthaḥ pradhāna ādi śabda arthaḥ kalpitaḥ vastunaḥ bāhyasya pradhāna lakṣaṇasya āśrayaṇam tena asiddhiḥ anupalabdhiḥ asya pradhāna ādi śabda arthasya dharmaḥ uktaḥ liṅga bhūtaḥ bhāva anupādāna tve sādhye nyāya vādinā ācārya dignāgena

original: (p.389) tena yad ucyate udyotakarādibhiḥ – yadi pramāṇena pradhānaṃ sattvena kalpitaṃ katham asyānupalabdhir ddharmaḥ pratīyate | athāsattvena kalpitaṃ pradhānan tathāpi katham asyānupalabdhir dharmo 'sattvād iti, tadapāstam, yasmāt kalpanājñānaviṣayatvāc chabdārtha eva kalpitaḥ | na tu pramāṇena bāhyaṃ pradhānaṃ sattvena kalpitaṃ |
analyzed: tena yat ucyate udyota kara ādibhiḥ yadi pramāṇena pradhānam sattvena kalpitam katham asya anupalabdhiḥ dharmaḥ pratīyate atha asattvena kalpitam pradhānam tathā api katham asya anupalabdhiḥ sattvāt iti tat apāstam yasmāt kalpanā jñāna viṣaya tvāt śabda arthaḥ eva kalpitaḥ na tu pramāṇena bāhyam pradhānam sattvena kalpitam

original: tasyeti pradhānaśabdārthasya bāhyapradhānavastvāśrayaṇānulambha ity ayam abhiprāya ācāryadignāgasya | (214-15)
analyzed: tasya iti pradhāna śabda arthasya bāhya pradhāna vastu āśrayaṇa anulambhaḥ iti ayam abhiprāyaḥ ācārya dignāgasya

original: yad uktam ityādi paraḥ | pramāṇatrayaṃ pratyakṣānumānāgamalakṣaṇaṃ | anyapramāṇanivṛttāv iti pratyakṣānumānanivṛttau nivṛttir deśādiviprakṛṣṭānāṃ | tayor iti pratyakṣānumānayoḥ | na kiñcid vyāpnoti sarvam eva viṣayīkaroti | tanninivṛttir āgamanivṛttiḥ |
analyzed: yat uktam ityādi paraḥ pramāṇa trayam pratyakṣa anumāna āgama lakṣaṇam anya pramāṇa nivṛttau iti pratyakṣa anumāna nivṛttau nivṛttiḥ deśa ādi viprakṛṣṭānām tayoḥ iti pratyakṣa anumānayoḥ na kiñcid vyāpnoti sarvam eva viṣayīkaroti āgama nivṛttiḥ

original: uktam atreti siddhāntavādī | aaprakaraṇāpannatvād iti puruṣārthacintāprastāvānupayogitvāt | "śāstrādhikārāsambandhā bahavorthā" ity atrāntare (1|201) uktatvāt |
analyzed: uktam atra iti siddhāntavādī a aprakaraṇa āpanna tvāt iti puruṣa artha cintā prastāva anupayogi tvāt śāstra adhikāra asambandhāḥ bahavaḥ ṛthāḥ iti atra antare ukta tvāt

original: etac ca bāhyeṣu āgamasya prāmāṇyam abhyupagamyoktam (|)
analyzed: etat ca bāhyeṣu āgamasya prāmāṇyam abhyupagamya uktam

original: adhunā naiva bāhyerthasya prāmāṇyam ity āha – api cetyādi | vastubhis svalakṣaṇais saha | śabdānāntarīyakaatāyā avinābhāvasyābhāvāt tebhyaḥ śabdebhyo nārthasiddhir na bāhyavastuniścayaḥ | yasmāt te hi vaktrabhiprāyasūcakāḥ |
analyzed: adhunā nā eva bāhya ṛthasya prāmāṇyam iti āha api ca ityādi vastubhiḥ sva lakṣaṇaiḥ saha avinābhāvasya abhāvāt tebhyaḥ śabdebhyaḥ nā artha siddhiḥ na bāhya vastu niścayaḥ yasmāt te hi vaktṛ abhiprāya sūcakāḥ

original: yady api ghaṭavivakṣātaḥ paṭaaśabdasyotpattis tathāpi sthānakaraṇābhighātāder eva sākṣāt karaṇāt tadutpatter vyabhicārābhāvān nāhetukatvaṃ (|) yaś ca ghaṭavivakṣājanyaṃ ghaṭaśabdam avadhārayati | tasya paṭaśabdāt paṭavivakṣānumānan tadavadhāraṇaṃ ca prakaraṇādinā lokasya vidyata eveti vivakṣānumāne 'vyabhicāra eva |
analyzed: yadi api ghaṭa vivakṣātaḥ paṭa a śabdasya utpattiḥ tathā api sthāna karaṇa abhighāta ādeḥ eva sākṣāt karaṇāt tad utpatteḥ vyabhicāra abhāvāt na ahetuka tvam yaḥ ca ghaṭa vivakṣā janyam ghaṭa śabdam avadhārayati tasya paṭa śabdāt tad avadhāraṇam ca prakaraṇa ādinā lokasya vidyate eva iti vivakṣā anumāne vyabhicāraḥ eva

original: (p.390) yathābhāvaṃ yathāsvalakṣaṇaṃ | yata iti yathābhāvaṃ pravṛtteḥ śabdebhyorthaprakṛtir arthasvabhāvo niścīyeta | te hīti śabdāḥ | vivakṣayā varttiyāṣānte tathoktāḥ | tatrāntarīyakā vivakṣānāntarīyakāḥ | tām eva vivakṣāṃ | saiva vivakṣā svalakṣaṇam antareṇa na bhavati (|) ato 'sty eva śabdānām arthāvyabhicāra ity āha – na cetyādi |
analyzed: yathābhāvam yathāsva lakṣaṇam yatas iti yathābhāvam pravṛtteḥ śabdebhyaḥ ṛtha prakṛtiḥ artha svabhāvaḥ niścīyeta te hi iti śabdāḥ vivakṣayā tathā uktāḥ tatra āntarīyakāḥ vivakṣā nāntarīyakāḥ tām eva vivakṣām sā eva vivakṣā sva lakṣaṇam antareṇa na bhavati atas sti eva śabdānām artha avyabhicāraḥ iti āha na ca ityādi

original: yathārthaṃ yathāvastu bhavituṃ śīlaṃ yāsāntās tathoktāḥ | kṣīṇadoṣasya kṛpālor yathārthabhāvinī sarvā ity āha – arthe 'pratibaddhopi śabdārthaṃ gamayiṣyatīti ced āha – na cetyādi | tasmin vastuny apratibaddhaḥ svabhāvo yasya śabdalakṣaṇasya | anyaṃ yatrāsau na pratibaddhaḥ |
analyzed: yathārtham yathāvastu bhavitum śīlam yā sāntāḥ tathā uktāḥ kṣīṇa doṣasya kṛpāloḥ yathārtha bhāvinī sarvāḥ iti āha arthe pratibaddhaḥ api śabda artham gamayiṣyati iti ced āha na ca ityādi tasmin vastuni apratibaddhaḥ svabhāvaḥ yasya śabda lakṣaṇasya anyam yatra asau na pratibaddhaḥ

original: yadi bāhye vastuni śabdasya nāsti prāmāṇyam, yat tarhīdam āptavādāvisamvādasāmānyāt. yo ya āptavādaḥ, so 'visamvādī, yathā kṣaṇikāḥ sarve saṃskārā ityādikaḥ. āptavādaś cāyam atyantaparokṣe 'py arthe. tasmād ayam apy avisamvādīty evam āptavādasyāvisamvādasāmānyād avisamvāditvād anumānatety āgamasya bāhye 'rthe 'numānatvam uktam ācāryadignāgena.
analyzed: yadi bāhye vastuni śabdasya na asti prāmāṇyam yat tarhi idam āpta vāda avisamvāda sāmānyāt yaḥ yaḥ āpta vādaḥ saḥ visamvādī yathā kṣaṇikāḥ sarve saṃskārāḥ iti ādikaḥ āpta vādaḥ ca ayam atyanta parokṣe arthe tasmāt ayam api avisamvādī iti evam āpta vādasya avisamvāda sāmānyāt avisamvādi tvāt anumāna tā iti āgamasya bāhye rthe numāna tvam uktam ācārya dignāgena

original: tat katham ity anenābhyupetabādhām āha. nāyam ityādinā pariharati. etat kathayati – nācāryeṇa bhāvikaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ kathayatā anumānatvam āgamasyoktam, api tu puruṣapravṛttim apekṣya, yasmān nāyam puruṣaḥ pravṛttikāmaḥ āgamaprāmāṇyam anāśrityāsituṃ samarthaḥ. kiṃ kāraṇam.
analyzed: tat katham iti anena abhyupeta bādhām āha na ayam ityādinā pariharati etat kathayati na ācāryeṇa bhāvikam prāmāṇyam kathayatā anumāna tvam āgamasya uktam api tu puruṣa pravṛttim apekṣya yasmāt na ayam puruṣaḥ pravṛtti kāmaḥ āgama prāmāṇyam an āśritya āsitum samarthaḥ kim kāraṇam

original: pratyakṣaṃ parokṣaṃ phalaṃ yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ keṣāṃcit pravṛttinivṛttyor iti yathāyogaṃ sambandhaḥ. hiṃsādicetanāviṣayāṇāṃ nivṛtteḥ svargādiphalatvena mahānuśaṃsāśravaṇāt | hiṃsācetanāviśeṣāṇāṃ pravṛtter narakādiphalatvena mahāpāpaśravaṇatvāt | na cātra vastubalapravṛttam anyat ptamāṇaṃ sādhakam asti yenāgamamanapekṣyānyataḥ pramāṇam pravartteta |
analyzed: pratyakṣam parokṣam phalam yeṣām teṣām keṣāṃcid pravṛtti nivṛttyoḥ iti yathāyogam sambandhaḥ hiṃsā ādi cetanā viṣayāṇām nivṛtteḥ svarga ādi phala tvena mahā anuśaṃsā śravaṇāt hiṃsā cetanā viśeṣāṇām pravṛtteḥ naraka ādi phala tvena mahā pāpa śravaṇa tvāt na ca atra vastu bala pravṛttam anyat sādhakam asti yena āgamam an apekṣya anyatas pramāṇam pravarteta

original: nāpi bādhakam asti yato nivartteta | bādhakābhāvam evāha – tadbhāva iti yathoktābhyāṃ pravṛttinivṛttibhyām iṣṭāniṣṭasya phalasya bhāve virodhādarśanāc ca icchati cāyam āgamavaśena pravartitum. tat sati pravartitavye (p.391) varam evam āgamam parīkṣya pravṛtta ity āgamasya parīkṣayā prāmāṇyam āhācāryaḥ. (215-16)
analyzed: nā api bādhakam asti yatas nivartteta bādhaka abhāvam eva āha tad bhāvaḥ iti yathā uktābhyām pravṛtti nivṛttibhyām iṣṭa aniṣṭasya phalasya bhāve virodha adarśanāt ca icchati ca ayam āgama vaśena pravartitum tat sati pravartitavye varam evam āgamam parīkṣya pravṛttaḥ iti āgamasya parīkṣayā prāmāṇyam āha ācāryaḥ

original: na ca sarvaṃ śāstraṃ parīkṣayādhikṛtaṃ | kin tu tac cetyādi śāstraṃ | padārthānām parasparasambandhāt sambaddhaṃ | anuguṇaḥ sādhayituṃ śakyaḥ phalasādhanopāyo yasmiṃs tadanuguṇopāyaṃ sambaddhaṃ ca tadanuguṇopāyaṃ ceti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ | evaṃbhūtam api yadi puruṣārthābhidhāyakan tadā parīkṣādhikṛtaṃ vākyaṃ |
analyzed: na ca sarvam śāstram parīkṣayā adhikṛtam kin tu tat ca ityādi śāstram padārthānām paraspara sambandhāt sambaddham anuguṇaḥ sādhayitum śakyaḥ phala sādhana upāyaḥ yasmin tad anuguṇa upāyam sambaddham ca tad anuguṇa upāyam ca iti viśeṣaṇa samāsaḥ evaṃbhūtam api yadi puruṣa artha abhidhāyakan tadā parīkṣā adhikṛtam vākyam

original: ato yathoktasvabhāvād aparam anyad vākyam anadhikṛtam parīkṣāyāṃ |
analyzed: atas yathā ukta svabhāvāt aparam anyat vākyam anadhikṛtam parīkṣāyām

original: sambandha ityādinā vyācaṣṭe. vākyānām aṅgāṅgibhāvenaikasminn arthe vidheyapratiṣedhyalakṣaṇe upasaṃhāro mīlanantenopakāraḥ parasparaṃ vākyānāṃ sambandhaḥ | anupakārakaḥ punaḥ keṣām ity āha – daśa dāḍimetyādi daśa dāḍimāni ṣaḍpūpāḥ kuṇḍamajājinaṃ palalam ityevamādīni vākyāni | na hy eṣām ekārthopasaṃhārosti parasparam asambandhāt |
analyzed: sambandhaḥ ityādinā vyācaṣṭe vākyānām aṅga aṅgi bhāvena ekasmin arthe vidheya pratiṣedhya lakṣaṇe upasaṃhāraḥ mīlana ntena upakāraḥ parasparam vākyānām sambandhaḥ anupakārakaḥ punar keṣām iti āha daśa dāḍima ityādi daśa dāḍimāni ṣaṭ pūpāḥ kuṇḍam aja ajinam palalam iti evamādīni vākyāni na hi eṣām ekārtha upasaṃhāraḥ usti parasparam asambandhāt

original: anayathety asambaddhatve vaktuḥ śāstrakārasya vaiguṇyam asambaddhābhidhāyitvam udbhāvayet | aśakyopāyo yeṣāṃ phalānantānyaśakyopāyāni | evaṃ bhūtāni phalāni yeṣāṃ śāstrāṇān tāni | phalārthī pumānnādriyet vicārayituṃ | etac cānugaṇopāyam ity etasya vaidharmyeṇa vivaraṇaṃ |
analyzed: anayathā iti asambaddha tve vaktuḥ śāstrakārasya vaiguṇyam asambaddha abhidhāyi tvam udbhāvayet aśakya upāyaḥ yeṣām phala anantāni aśakya upāyāni evam bhūtāni phalāni yeṣām tāni phala arthī pumān na ādriyet vicārayitum etat ca anugaṇa upāyam iti etasya vaidharmyeṇa vivaraṇam

original: puruṣārthaḥ phalaṃ yeṣāṃ śāstrāṇāṃ tāni tathoktāni | tato 'nyānyapuruṣārthaphalāni | tāni ca nādriyeta vicārayituṃ |
analyzed: puruṣa arthaḥ phalam yeṣām śāstrāṇām tāni tathā uktāni tatas nyāni anya puruṣa artha phalāni tāni ca na ādriyeta vicārayitum

original: aśakyopāyaphalasyodāharaṃ | viṣetyādi | evaṃ hy asya viṣaṃ śāmyati yadi takṣakanāgarājasya karṇāvasthitena ratnenālaṅkāraḥ kriyata iti | etac cāśakyasādhanaṃ |
analyzed: aśakya upāya phalasya udāharam viṣa ityādi evam hi asya viṣam śāmyati yadi takṣaka nāga rājasya karṇa avasthitena ratnena alaṅkāraḥ kriyate iti etat ca aśakya sādhanam

original: apuruṣārthaphalasyodāharaṇaṃ | kākadantaparīkṣāvac ceti |
analyzed: apuruṣa artha phalasya udāharaṇam kākadanta parīkṣā vat ca iti

original: yadviparyayeṇa teṣāṃ yathoktānān trayāṇāṃ viparyeyeṇopasaṃhāravat | etena sambaddham ity etad vyākhyātaṃ | śakyopāyam ity anenānuguṇopāyam iti | anyatreti sambandhāditrayarahite | (p.392) avadhānasyaivety ādārasya | tad iti yathoktaguṇatrayayuktaṃ śāstraṃ parīkṣāyāṃ satyāṃ na visamvādabhāg bhavati |

original: na hi nīlādiviṣayaṃ paṃca vyatirekeṇānyasya pratyakṣatāsti | tadvyatirekeṇānupalabdheḥ | castubalapravṛttam anumānam anāgamāpekṣānumānaṃ | tasya viṣayatvenābhimatānān tathābhāvonumānaviṣayabhāvonumānenābādhakaṃ | catvāri cāryasatyāni | uttaratra pratipādayiṣyate | ananumeyānān tathābhāve 'nanumeyatvam anumānenābādhakaṃ |

original: yathātmādīnām (|) ādiśabdāt pradhāneśvarādiparigrahaḥ | na hy eṣāṃ kiñcitlliṅgam asti yenānumeyāḥ syuḥ | etad api pratipādayiṣyati | viśuddhe viṣayadvaye (      ) 'tyantaparokṣe cāgamaviṣaye paurvāparyavirodhena yasmin cintāṃ pravarttayati tasminn āgamāpekṣam anumānam api | abādhanam iti prakṛtaṃ |

original: kīdṛśan tadabādhanam ity āha – rāgādirūpaṃ rāgadveṣamohasvabhāvam adharmam abhyupagamya tatprabhavaṃ rāgādisamutthāpitaṃ kāyavākkarma cādharmam abhyupagapya | tatprahāṇāya tasyādharmasyāpagamāya snānāgnihotrādeḥ | tīrthasnānena pāpakṣayo bhavati | yamuddiśyāgnau ghṛtādikaṃ hūyate tasya pāpakṣayo bhavatīty evamāder anupadeśaḥ |

original: seyam anantaroktāpratyakṣeṇānumānena dvividhena śakyaparicchedasya śakyaniścayasyāśeṣasya viṣayasya bādhālakṣaṇā | tasyāptāvadasyāvisamvādāt sāmānyāt | yathā śakyaparicchede 'rthe āptavādasyāvisamvādaḥ, tathātyantaparokṣe 'pi, āptavādatvād eva.
analyzed: sā iyam anantara ukta apratyakṣeṇa anumānena dvividhena śakya paricchedasya śakya niścayasya aśeṣasya viṣayasya bādhā lakṣaṇā sāmānyāt yathā śakya paricchede rthe āpta vādasya avisamvādaḥ tathā atyanta parokṣe pi āpta vāda tvāt eva

original: PVSV 1.216

original: tasyetyādi vivaraṇaṃ | tasyāgamasyācāryadignāgena nirdiṣṭānumānabhāvasya | asyety asmābhis sambandhād anuguṇopāyam ityādinā vicāritasya | ata evāha – evaṃbhūtasyeti sambandhādiguṇayuktasyety arthaḥ | pratyakṣānumānagamye tasmin vastuny avisamvādasāmānyād avisamvādatvāt kāraṇād dṛṣṭavyabhicārasyāpavādasya pratyakṣānumānāgamyerthe viṣaye |
analyzed: tasya ityādi vivaraṇam tasya āgamasya ācārya dignāgena nirdiṣṭa anumāna bhāvasya asya iti asmābhiḥ sambandhāt anuguṇa upāyam ityādinā vicāritasya atas eva āha evaṃbhūtasya iti sambandha ādi guṇa yuktasya iti arthaḥ pratyakṣa anumāna gamye tasmin vastuni avisamvāda sāmānyāt avisamvāda tvāt kāraṇāt dṛṣṭa vyabhicārasya apavādasya pratyakṣa anumāna agamya īrthe viṣaye

original: āptavādād anutpannāyāḥ pratipatter buddher avisamvādo 'numīyate | kasmāt (|) tadāśrayatvād āptavādāśrayatvaṃ cācāryapāramparyopadeśāt siddhaṃ | tadanyapratipattivat | atyantaparokṣād anyasmin viṣaye pratyakṣānumānaviṣaye pratipattivat |

original: tato yathoktād āptavādā(d a)tyantaparokṣe 'rthe yathoktāgāmāśritā buddhiḥ śabdaprabhavāpi satī śabdād utpannāpi | śābdavad iti yathānyaḥ śābdaḥ pratyayo 'bhiprāyamātraṃ nivedayati | tathā neyaṃ buddhir abhiprāyam eva nivedayati | evakārasya bhinnakramatvāt |

original: kiṃ tarhīṣṭasya pratyakṣānumānāgamyasyārthasyānantaroktena nyāyenāvisamvādād anumānam api pravṛttikāmasya puṃso 'bhiprāyavaśāt | vastutas tv ananumānam, śabdānām arthais saha sambandhābhāvāt | asyaivārthasya khyāpanārtho 'piśabdaḥ.
analyzed: kim tarhi iṣṭasya pratyakṣa anumāna agamyasya arthasya anantara uktena nyāyena avisamvādāt anumānam api pravṛtti kāmasya puṃsaḥ bhiprāya vaśāt vastutas tu ananumānam śabdānām arthaiḥ saha sambandha abhāvāt asya eva arthasya khyāpana arthaḥ upiśabdaḥ

original: PVSV 1.217

original: asya heyopādeyatattvasya sopāyasya bhagavaddarśitasya vastubalāyātena pramāṇena prasiddhito niścayataḥ kāraṇāt | bhagavadvacane satyacatuṣṭayalakṣaṇasya pradhānasyārthasyāvisamvādaḥ (|) satyacatuṣṭayalakṣaṇo 'rthaḥ pradhānan tadadhigamena nirvāṇaprāpte | tasmāt pradhānārthāvisamvādāt |

original: bhagavadvacanād utpannaṃ jñānaṃ paratrāpy atyantaparokṣe 'py (p.395) arthe 'numānam. vāśabdaḥ pūrvaprakārāpekṣa yā vikalpārthaḥ.

original: tayor heyopādeyor upāyau tadupāyau | heyaṃ copādeyaṃ ca tadupāyau ceti dvandvaḥ | teṣān tadupadiṣṭānān tenāptenopadiṣṭānāmavaiparītyam anumānena nirūpyamāṇānāmavitathatvam avisamvādaḥ | yathā caturṇṇān duḥkhādīnām āryasatyānāṃ dvitīye paricchede | vakṣyamāṇayā nītyā vicāreṇa |

original: tasyāsyeti bhagavatā pūrvanirdiṣṭasyādhunā vibhaktatvād asya sattyacatuṣṭayalakṣaṇasya | kiṃbhūtasya puruṣārthopāyoginaḥ | puruṣārtho nirvāṇaṃ tatropayogaḥ kāraṇatvaṃ sa yasyāsti tathā | ata evābhiyogārhābhyāsārhasyāvisamvādād viṣayāntare 'pi pratyakṣānumānāgamye | tathātvopagama ity avisamvādopagamo na vipralambhāya | na visamvādāya bhavati |
analyzed: tasya asya iti bhagavatā pūrva nirdiṣṭasya adhunā vibhakta tvāt asya sattya catuṣṭaya lakṣaṇasya kiṃbhūtasya puruṣa artha upāyoginaḥ puruṣa arthaḥ nirvāṇam tatra upayogaḥ kāraṇa tvam sa yasya asti tathā atas eva abhiyoga arha abhyāsa arhasya avisamvādāt viṣaya antare pi pratyakṣa anumāna agamye tathātva upagamaḥ iti avisamvāda upagamaḥ na vipralambhāya na visamvādāya bhavati

original: kiṃ kāraṇam (|) anuparodhāt | pramāṇenābādhanāt | pradhāne ca sattyacatuṣṭayalakṣaṇe 'rthe puruṣam avisamvādyapunas tṛtīye sthāne vaktur niṣprayojanaṃ yadvitathābhidhānan tasya vaiphalyāt |

original: tadācit tatrājñānād api tathābhidhānaṃ syād iti ced āha – tad ityādi | ubhayathāpīti ślokadvayanirdiṣṭena prakāreṇa | tad etad āgamasyānumānatvam agatyopavarṇitam iti sambandhaḥ | anumānakāraṇatvād anumānam iti draṣṭavyaṃ | āgamāt pravṛttau satyām varam evaṃ yuktād āgamāt pravṛtto na tu pramāṇagamya evārthe visamvādakād iti |

analyzed: prayogaḥ punar ye yad upadhānāt apakarṣiṇaḥ te tad atyanta vṛddhau tad abhibhavāt niranvaya vināśa dharmāṇaḥ tat yathā jvālā ādayaḥ salila abhibhava vṛddhau ca apakarṣa dharmāṇaḥ doṣāḥ iti svabhāva hetuḥ

original: yata evaṃ tena kāraṇena syād api kaścin nirdoṣaḥ | katham ityādi paraḥ | yāvatety ayan nipāto yadety asminn arthe varttate | doṣasātmano vipakṣotpattivad iti cānādikālābhyāsāt | doṣasātmanaḥ puṃsaḥ vipakṣotpattir nairātmyadarśanotpattiḥ | evandoṣavipakṣasya nairātmyadarśanasya sātmatvepi yathāpratyayaṃ |
analyzed: yatas evam tena kāraṇena syāt api kaścid nirdoṣaḥ katham ityādi paraḥ yāvatā iti ayan nipātaḥ yadā iti asmin arthe varttate doṣa sātmanaḥ vipakṣa utpatti vat iti ca anādi kāla abhyāsāt doṣa sātmanaḥ puṃsaḥ vipakṣa utpattiḥ nairātmya darśana utpattiḥ evam doṣa vipakṣasya nairātmya darśanasya sātma tve pi yathāpratyayam

original: yathākāraṇasannidhānan doṣotpattir api syāt |
analyzed: yathā kāraṇa sannidhānan doṣa utpattiḥ api syāt

original: nāyam ity ācāryaḥ | sarvasāṃsārikopadravarahitatvād nirupadravaḥ | bhūtaviparītam anityādisvalakṣaṇam artho viṣayosyeti bhūtārthaḥ | bhūtārthagrahaṇād eva ca mārgaścittasvabhāvaḥ |
analyzed: na ayam iti ācāryaḥ sarva sāṃsārika upadrava rahita tvāt nirupadravaḥ bhūta viparītam anitya ādi sva lakṣaṇam arthaḥ viṣayaḥ usya iti bhūtārthaḥ bhūta artha grahaṇāt eva ca mārgaḥ citta svabhāvaḥ

original: nirupadravaś cāsau bhūtārthaś ceti nirupadravabhūtārthas tathābhūtaś cāsau svabhāvaś ceti karmadhārayagarbha eva karmadhārayasamāsaḥ nirupadravyasya bhūtārthasya bhūtārthatvenābhyāsāt sātmībhāvagate (|) anena ca cittasvabhāvasya doṣapratipakṣasya viparyayair yathoktāt trayād vilakṣaṇaiḥ sopadravairabhūtārtharasvabhāvaiś ca doṣair na bādhanaṃ |
analyzed: nirupadravaḥ ca asau bhūtārthaḥ ca iti nirupadrava bhūtārthaḥ tathābhūtaḥ ca asau svabhāvaḥ ca iti karmadhāraya garbhaḥ eva karmadhāraya samāsaḥ nirupadravyasya bhūtārthasya bhūtārtha tvena abhyāsāt sātmībhāva gate anena ca citta svabhāvasya doṣa pratipakṣasya viparyayaiḥ yathā uktāt trayāt vilakṣaṇaiḥ sa upadravaiḥ abhūtārthaḥ asvabhāvaiḥ ca doṣaiḥ na bādhanam

original: sātmībhūtaṃ mārgam abhibhūya na doṣāṇām utpattir ity arthaḥ | kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) yatnavattve pītyādi | etad āha – sātmībhūtasya mārgasya doṣotpādanāya yat na eva na sambhavati |
analyzed: sātmībhūtam mārgam abhibhūya na doṣāṇām utpattiḥ iti arthaḥ kiṅkāraṇam yatnavat tve pi ityādi etat āha sātmībhūtasya mārgasya doṣa utpādanāya yat na eva na sambhavati

original: tathāpy abhyupagamyocyate (|) doṣotpādane yatnavattve buddhes tatpakṣapātataḥ | tasmin na doṣapratipakṣabhūte guṇavati nairātmyamārge | pakṣatātena bahumānataḥ | doṣotpādane (p.400) yatnannivarttya | guṇapakṣapātena doṣapratipakṣa eva yatnādhānād iti yāvat |
analyzed: tathā api abhyupagamya ucyate doṣa utpādane yatnavat tve buddheḥ tad pakṣapātataḥ tasmin na doṣa pratipakṣa bhūte guṇavati nairātmya mārge pakṣatātena bahu mānataḥ doṣa utpādane guṇa pakṣapātena doṣa pratipakṣe eva yatna ādhānāt iti yāvat

original: svabhāvapadam eva tāvadādau vyācaṣṭe | na hi svabhāvo nairapmyadarśanalakṣaṇaḥ pratipakṣasātmani vyavasthitena puruṣeṇa | ayan tena prayatnena vinā nivartayituṃ śakyaḥ śrotriyakāpālikaghṛṇāvad iti | yaḥ śrotriyaḥ san kāpāliko bhavati tasya śrotriyāvasthāyāṃ yā ghṛṇā sā yathā yatnamantareṇa na śakyate nivartayitun tadvat |
analyzed: svabhāva padam eva tāvat ādau vyācaṣṭe na hi svabhāvaḥ nairapmya darśana lakṣaṇaḥ pratipakṣa sātmani vyavasthitena puruṣeṇa ayan tena prayatnena vinā nivartayitum śakyaḥ śrotriya kāpālika ghṛṇāvat iti yaḥ śrotriyaḥ san kāpālikaḥ bhavati tasya śrotriya avasthāyām yā ghṛṇā sā yathā yatnam antareṇa na śakyate nivartayitum tadvat

original: mārgasvabhāvanivartanāya yatnaśca kriyamāṇaḥ | prāpyasya rāgādisvabhāvasya guṇadarśanena nivarttyasya vipaśyanāsvabhāvasya doṣadarśanena kriyeta | tac ca doṣadarśanaṃ vipakṣasātmanaḥ doṣapratipakṣasātmanaḥ puṃso doṣapratipakṣena sambhavati | tathā tac ca guṇadarśanam vipakṣasātmano doṣeṣu na sambhavati |
analyzed: mārga svabhāva nivartanāya yatnaḥ ca kriyamāṇaḥ prāpyasya rāga ādi svabhāvasya guṇa darśanena nivarttyasya vipaśyanā svabhāvasya doṣa darśanena kriyeta tat ca doṣa darśanam vipakṣa sātmanaḥ doṣa pratipakṣa sātmanaḥ puṃsaḥ doṣa pratipakṣena sambhavati tathā tat ca guṇa darśanam vipakṣa sātmanaḥ doṣeṣu na sambhavati

original: kasmāt punaḥ pratipakṣe doṣadarśanan na sambhavatīty āha – tasyetyādi | tasya pratipakṣasya nirupadravatvāt | trividho hy upadravo yasyābhāvān nirupadravo mārgaḥ | tathā hi cittam vibaddhaṃ hetur doṣopadravo yaiś cittam vivaddham bhūtārthadarśane na pravartate | kāyacittavyathāhetur duḥkhadaurmanasyopadravaḥ |
analyzed: kasmāt punar pratipakṣe doṣa darśanat na sambhavati iti āha tasya ityādi tasya pratipakṣasya nirupadrava tvāt trividhaḥ hi upadravaḥ yasya abhāvāt nirupadravaḥ mārgaḥ tathā hi cittam vibaddham hetuḥ doṣa upadravaḥ yaiḥ cittam vivaddham bhūta artha darśane na pravartate kāya citta vyathā hetuḥ duḥkha daurmanasya upadravaḥ

original: sāsravasukhasyāpraśāntatayā tadupabhoge vairasyodvegaś ca |
analyzed: sa āsrava sukhasya apraśānta tayā tad upabhoge vairasya udvegaḥ ca

original: tatra prathamasyopadravasyābhāvam āha – sarvadoṣahāner iti | sarvasya rāgādidoṣasya hāner vigamāt |
analyzed: tatra prathamasya upadravasya abhāvam āha sarva doṣa hāneḥ iti sarvasya rāga ādi doṣasya hāneḥ vigamāt

original: paryavasthānetyādinā dvitīyasyābhāvam āha – rāgādisammukhībhāvaḥ paryavasthānaṃ ca janma ca paryavasthānajanmanī | tayor yatprativaddhan duḥkhan tasya vivekāt | rāgādyutpattikāle yad duḥkhaṃ kāyacittaparidāhalakṣaṇan tatparyavasthānapratibaddhajātijarāvyādhyādiduḥkhan tu janmapratibaddhaṃ |
analyzed: paryavasthāna ityādinā dvitīyasya abhāvam āha rāga ādi sammukhībhāvaḥ paryavasthānam ca janma ca paryavasthāna janmanī tayoḥ yat prativaddhan duḥkhan tasya vivekāt rāga ādi utpatti kāle yat duḥkham kāya citta paridāha lakṣaṇan tad paryavasthāna pratibaddha jāti jarā vyādhi ādi duḥkhan tu janma pratibaddham

original: tatīyasyopadravasyābhāvam āha – praśametyādi praśamo rāgādivirahalakṣaṇaṃ nirvāṇaṃ | tasmin yatsukhamanāsravan tasya rasa asvādastasyānudvejanāt | avaimukhakaraṇāt | abhūtārtham abhataviṣayaṃ khalv api rāgādi | na syād iti sambandhaḥ |
analyzed: tatīyasya upadravasya abhāvam āha praśama ityādi praśamaḥ rāga ādi viraha lakṣaṇam nirvāṇam tasmin yat sukham anāsravan tasya rasaḥ asvādaḥ tasya anudvejanāt avaimukha karaṇāt abhūta artham abhata viṣayam khalu api rāga ādi na syāt iti sambandhaḥ

original: yady abhūtārthaṃ kathan tarhi tasyotpattir ity āha – upādānabalabhāvīti vitathaavikalpavāsanābalabhāvi (p.401) | tadevaṃbhūtarāgādibījāśrayasya vijñānasantānasya viparyayopādānāt rāgādiviparyayalakṣaṇasya pratipakṣasya parigrahān na syān notpadyeta | na tu bhūtārtham aviparītaviṣayaṃ na bhavet | kintu bhaved eva |
analyzed: yadi abhūta artham kathan tarhi tasya utpattiḥ iti āha upādāna bala bhāvi iti vitatha avikalpa vāsanā bala bhāvi tat evaṃbhūta rāga ādi bīja āśrayasya vijñāna santānasya viparyaya upādānāt rāga ādi viparyaya lakṣaṇasya pratipakṣasya parigrahāt na syāt na utpadyeta na tu bhūta artham aviparīta viṣayam na bhavet kintu bhavet eva

original: kiṃ kāraṇam (|) vastubalapravṛtteḥ | yathāvasthitavastusāmarthyenotpatteḥ | doṣasātmyepi tāvat sthitasya | pramānāny anityādibhatākāragrāhīṇi | pratipakṣamārgamāvahanti | (222-23)
analyzed: kim kāraṇam vastu bala pravṛtteḥ yathā avasthita vastu sāmarthyena utpatteḥ doṣa sātmye pi tāvat sthitasya pramānāni anitya ādi bha tā ākāra grāhīṇi pratipakṣa mārgam āvahanti

original: kiṃ punar vipaśyanā sātmani sthitasya | abhūtārthaś ca doṣā rāgādayaḥ | ātmātmīyādhyāropiterthe pravṛtteḥ | te pratipakṣasya bhūtārthasya yat sātmyaṃ svabhāvatvan tasya vācino na bhavanti | yata evaṃ tasmān na punaḥ prahīṇadoṣāṇāṃ doṣotpattiḥ |
analyzed: kim punar vipaśyanā sa ātmani sthitasya abhūta arthaḥ ca doṣāḥ rāga ādayaḥ ātma ātmīya adhyāropita irthe pravṛtteḥ te pratipakṣasya bhūta arthasya yat sātmyam svabhāva tvan tasya vācinaḥ na bhavanti yatas evam tasmāt na punar prahīṇa doṣāṇām doṣa utpattiḥ

original: doṣotpādanayatnepi buddher guṇapakṣapātena kāraṇena rāgādipratipakṣa eva yatnādhānāt prayatnasya karaṇāt | kasya parīkṣāvato yuktyā vicārakasya doṣasātmyepi tāvat sthitasya | viśeṣeṇātiśayena guṇeṣv eva yatnādhānamaduṣṭātmanaḥ pratipakṣasātmani sthitasya |
analyzed: doṣa utpādana yatne pi buddheḥ guṇa pakṣapātena kāraṇena rāga ādi pratipakṣe eva yatna ādhānāt prayatnasya karaṇāt kasya parīkṣāvataḥ yuktyā vicārakasya doṣa sātmye pi tāvat sthitasya viśeṣeṇa atiśayena guṇeṣu eva yatna ādhānam aduṣṭa ātmanaḥ pratipakṣa sātmani sthitasya

original: kaḥ punar eṣān doṣāṇāṃ prabhava utpattikāraṇaṃ | prabhavaty utpadyatesmād iti kṛtvā | yasya doṣahetoḥ pratipakṣābhyāsena prahīyaṃte |
analyzed: kaḥ punar eṣān doṣāṇām prabhavaḥ utpatti kāraṇam prabhavati utpadyate ismāt iti kṛtvā yasya doṣa hetoḥ pratipakṣa abhyāsena prahīyaṃte

original: uttaram āha – sarvāsām ityādi | doṣajātīnān doṣaprakārāṇāṃ jātir utpattiḥ satkāyadarśanāt | ātmātmīyābhiniveśāt |
analyzed: uttaram āha sarvāsām ityādi doṣa jātīnām doṣa prakārāṇām jātiḥ utpattiḥ sat kāya darśanāt ātma ātmīya abhiniveśāt

original: nanu cāvidyāhetukāḥ kleśā āgame uktās tat kathaṃ na vyāghāt ity āha – sā 'vidyeti saiva satkāyadṛṣṭir avidyā | tato nāsti virodhaḥ | kena punaḥ krameṇa doṣāṇāṃ satkāyadarśanād utpattir ity āha – tatretyādi | tatrātmātmīyatvenābhini(vi)ṣṭe viṣaye | tatsnehaḥ | atmātmīyasnehaḥ | tasmād ātmātmīyasnehāt dveṣādisambhava iti kramaḥ |
analyzed: nanu ca avidyā hetukāḥ kleśāḥ āgame uktāḥ tat katham na vyāghāt iti āha sā vidyā iti sā eva sat kāya dṛṣṭiḥ avidyā tatas na asti virodhaḥ kena punar krameṇa doṣāṇām sat kāya darśanāt utpattiḥ iti āha tatra ityādi tatra ātma ātmīya tvena abhiniviṣṭe viṣaye tad snehaḥ atma ātmīya snehaḥ tasmāt ātma ātmīya snehāt dveṣa ādi sambhavaḥ iti kramaḥ

original: na hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | nāham ity ātmākārapratiṣedhaḥ | na mamety ātmīyākārasya | anātmākāreṇa nātmīyākāreṇa capaśyataḥ puruṣasya | parigraham antareṇeti | (p.402) ātmātmīyatvena tadanugrāhakatvena parikalpya grahaḥ tena vinā na kvacit viṣaye snehaḥ | na cānanurāgiṇaḥ ātmātmīyādisneharahitasya kvacid dveṣaḥ | anunayam antareṇa tasyābhāvāt |
analyzed: na hi ityādinā vyācaṣṭe na aham iti ātma ākāra pratiṣedhaḥ na mama iti ātmīya ākārasya anātma ākāreṇa na ātmīya ākāreṇa ca paśyataḥ puruṣasya parigraham antareṇa iti ātma ātmīya tvena tad anugrāhaka tvena parikalpya grahaḥ tena vinā na kvacid viṣaye snehaḥ na ca ananurāgiṇaḥ ātma ātmīya ādi sneha rahitasya kvacid dveṣaḥ anunayam antareṇa tasya abhāvāt

original: kiṅkāraṇam (|) ātmātmīyetyādi | ātmātmīyor anuparodhiny apratikūlavarttini | udāsīnapakṣe | tadabhāvāt tasya dveṣasyābhāvāt | uparodhapratighātini ceti | ātmātmīyatvena gṛhītasya ya uparodhaḥ pīḍā | tatpratighātini tatpratiṣedhaṃ kurvati | mitrapakṣe tadabhāvāt | dveṣābhāvāt | kiṃtv ātmātmīyasnehaviṣayabhūtavirodhena |
analyzed: kiṅkāraṇam ātma ātmīya ityādi ātma ātmīyoḥ an uparodhini a pratikūla varttini udāsīna pakṣe tad abhāvāt tasya dveṣasya abhāvāt uparodha pratighātini ca iti ātma ātmīya tvena gṛhītasya yaḥ uparodhaḥ pīḍā tad pratighātini tad pratiṣedham kurvati mitra pakṣe tad abhāvāt dveṣa abhāvāt kiṃtu ātma ātmīya sneha viṣaya bhūta virodhena

original: yaḥ sthitaḥ pratikūlavarttī | tatraiva dveṣaḥ | tasmān nātmātmīyasneham antareṇa dveṣa iti | tasmād ityādinā nigamanaṃ | yata evaṃ tasmāttau ceti | ātmadarśanātmīgrahau | snehaṃ prasuvāte iti vacanavipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ | sa ca sneho dveṣādīn prasūte janayati |
analyzed: yaḥ sthitaḥ pratikūla varttī tatra eva dveṣaḥ tasmāt na ātma ātmīya sneham antareṇa dveṣaḥ iti tasmāt ityādinā nigamanam yatas evam tasmāt tau ca iti ātma darśana ātmīgrahau sneham prasuvāte iti vacana vipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ sa ca snehaḥ dveṣa ādīn prasūte janayati

original: tayos tarhy ātmadarśanātmīyagrahayoḥ ko hetur ity āha – samānetyādi | samānajatīyan tad evātmadarśanan tasyābhyāsaḥ paunaḥpunyenādikālam utpattiḥ | tadvāsanā na | tasmāj jātamātmadarśam ātmīyagrahaṃ prasūte | tasmāt satkāyadarśanajāḥ sarve kleśāḥ | (223-24)
analyzed: tayoḥ tarhi ātma darśana ātmīya grahayoḥ kaḥ hetuḥ iti āha samāna ityādi tat eva ātma darśanan tasya abhyāsaḥ paunaḥpunyena ādi kālam utpattiḥ tad vāsanā na tasmāt jātam ātma darśam ātmīya graham prasūte tasmāt sat kāya darśana jāḥ sarve kleśāḥ

original: tad eva ca satkāyadarśanam ajñānam avidyety ucyate siddhānte |
analyzed: tat eva ca sat kāya darśanam ajñānam avidyā iti ucyate siddhānte

original: yenaiva satkāyadarśanam evā 'vidyā 'ta eva kāraṇāt mohonidānaṃ pradhānakāraṇan doṣāṇāṃ rādādīnām abhidhīyate sūtrantare1* --- "avidyāhetukāḥ sarvakleśā" iti satkāyadṛṣṭir doṣāṇāṃ nidānam anyatra sūtrāntarebhidhīyate | kasmāt | tatprahāṇe satkāyadṛṣṭeḥ prahāṇe doṣāṇāṃ prahāṇaḥ | "mohan doṣanidānaṃ" doṣa kāraṇam āhur buddhā bhagavantaḥ |
analyzed: yena eva satkāya darśanam evā vidyā te eva kāraṇāt mohaḥ nidānam doṣāṇām abhidhīyate sūtra antare avidyā hetukāḥ sarva kleśāḥ iti satkāya dṛṣṭiḥ doṣāṇām nidānam anyatra sūtra antare abhidhīyate kasmāt tad prahāṇe satkāya dṛṣṭeḥ prahāṇe doṣāṇām prahāṇaḥ mohan doṣa nidānam doṣa kāraṇam āhuḥ buddhāḥ bhagavantaḥ

original: kasmād (|) amūḍhasyājñānarahitasya doṣān utpatteḥ punar anyatra pradeśe satkāyadṛṣṭin doṣanidānam āhuḥ | tac caitat kāraṇatvaṃ mohasya satkāyadṛṣṭeś ca pradhānahetunirdeśe sati syān na hetumātranirdeśe | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) anekasmād indriyaviṣayo 'yoniśomanaskārakalāpāj janama yeṣān doṣāṇān teṣām ekasmāt mohāt satkāyadṛṣṭeś cotpattivirodhāt |
analyzed: kasmāt amūḍhasya ajñāna rahitasya doṣān utpatteḥ punar anyatra pradeśe satkāyadṛṣṭin doṣa nidānam āhuḥ tat ca etat kāraṇa tvam mohasya satkāyadṛṣṭeḥ ca pradhāna hetu nirdeśe sati syāt na hetu mātra nirdeśe kim kāraṇam anekasmāt indriya viṣayaḥ teṣām ekasmāt mohāt satkāyadṛṣṭeḥ ca utpatti virodhāt

original: tasmād anyakaraṇasambhavepi pradhānyaṃ gṛhītvā mohasatkāyadṛṣṭyoḥ kāraṇatvam uktam iti gamyate |
analyzed: tasmāt anya karaṇa sambhave pi pradhānyam gṛhītvā moha satkāyadṛṣṭyoḥ kāraṇa tvam uktam iti gamyate

original: fn. 1: buddhavacane

original: ekavarṇṇarūpantarhi padamekabuddhigrāhyambhaviṣyatītyata āha – ekavarṇṇetyādi | ekavarṇaniṣpattikālepyanekabuddhibyatikramānnaikavarṇṇaḥ | tathā hi bhāgityukte 'rddhamātrākālo niracko gakāraḥ pratīyate | sāckastu mātrākālaḥ pratīyata iti kathamekavarṇṇarūpaṃ padamvidyate yadekabuddhigrāhyaṃ syāt | tena yaducyate | sakalameva gṛhṇāti |
analyzed: eka varṇṇa rūpam tarhi padam eka buddhi grāhyam bhaviṣyati iti atas āha eka varṇṇa ityādi eka varṇa niṣpatti kāle pi aneka buddhi byatikramāt na ekavarṇṇaḥ tathā hi bhāj iti ukte rddha mātrā kālaḥ nirackaḥ gakāraḥ pratīyate sāckaḥ tu mātrā kālaḥ pratīyate iti katham eka varṇṇa rūpam padam vidyate yat eka buddhi grāhyam syāt tena yat ucyate sakalam eva gṛhṇāti

original: "alpīyasāpi yatnena śbdamuccaritammatiḥ |

original: (p.436) syādetad (|) yāvatā kālena varṇṇaniṣpattistāvatkāla ekaḥ kṣaṇastata ekayā buddhyā padasya grahaṇambhaviṣyatītyata āha – kṣaṇasyetyādi | yāvatā kālenaikaḥ paramāṇuḥ paramāṇvantaramatikrāmati tāvatkālatvāt kṣaṇasya | vibhāgarahitaḥ kālaḥ sa caikaparamāṇvatikramakāla eva yujyate | yathoktātkālādādhikye kṣaṇasyābhyupagamyamāne |

original: vibhāgavataḥ śakyavibhāgasya kṣaṇasya kālaparyavasānāyogāt | tenaikasyāpyatiniṣkṛṣṭasa varṇṇasyānekakṣaṇena niṣpattiḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ | aneketyādi | anekasyāṇorvyatyayo vyatikramo yasminnimeṣe sonekā¨uvyatyayo nimeṣaḥ | tena tulyakālatvādantyasya niṣkṛṣṭasyāpyākārādervarṇṇasya parisamāpteḥ | tasmānnaikavarṇṇarūpaṃ padamekabuddhigrāhyaṃ |

original: nāpyanekātmakamekapadaṃ smṛtigrāhyaṃ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) yathānubhavaṃ smaraṇāt | yathānubhavo varṇṇānāmanukrameṇa tathā smṛtirapi tatra kramabhāvinyeveti smṛtirapi tatkālaiva | sa evanubhavakramakālosyā iti kṛtvā |

original: etaccānyāṃ pravṛttimadhikṛtyoktamabhyāsavatyāntu pravṛttau krameṇānubhūtānāmapi varṇṇānāṃ yadyapi yugapatsmaraṇambhavati tathāpyanubhavasmaraṇānukramayorviśeṣānupalakṣaṇācca naikampadādi |

original: (p.437) nānekameva padādi | taditi tasmād (|) ekānekatvena pratibhāsanādekānekayorvirodhenāyogāt padādi na vastu | yadvā tatpadādi na vastu | ekānekatvāyogāditi bhāvaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tasya vastunaḥ etadvikalpānatikramāt | yasmād vastvekarūpaṃ vā syādanekarūpaṃ vā kadācit syānna tūbhayarūpaṃ virodhāt |
analyzed: na anekam eva pada ādi tat iti tasmāt eka aneka tvena pratibhāsanāt eka anekayoḥ virodhena ayogāt pada ādi na vastu yat vā tat pada ādi na vastu eka aneka tva ayogāt iti bhāvaḥ kim kāraṇam tasya vastunaḥ etad vikalpa anatikramāt yasmāt vastu eka rūpam vā syāt aneka rūpam vā kadācid syāt na tu ubhaya rūpam virodhāt

original: vastu ca śabdārthasambandhaḥ pareṇeṣṭaḥ sa kathantadāśrayaḥ syāt | avastubhūtapadavākyāśrayaḥ syāt | tatpadavākyamāśrayosyeti vigrahaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ | asattvena padāderāśrayaṇīyasyāyogāt | evamityāśrayaṇīyābhāve 'nāśritaḥ sambandhaḥ syāt | tathā cānāśritatvādasambandhaḥ sambandhaḥ syāt | sambandhipāratantryābhāvāt |

original: yata evantasmānna svābhāvikopauruṣeyaḥ śabdārthayossambandhaḥ | kintu pauruṣeya eva sambandhaḥ | yasmāt | tadabhiprāyasyārthapratpādanābhiprāyasya yaḥ prayogāntaḥ parispandādiḥ | tasmādutpannaḥ śabda etat svadarśanenoktaṃ | abhivyakto vā śabda etatparābhiprāyeṇoktaṃ | tadavyabhicārī |
