original: arthapratipādanāvyabhicārīti kṛtvā tattvamarthapratipādanābhiprāyakāryatvamasya śabdasya sambandhaḥ | arthapratipādanābhiprāyeṇa śabdaprayogāt |sā cotpattirabhivyaktirvā śabdasyārthapratipādanampratyavyabhicārāśrayo 'vyabhicārasya nimittaṃ pauruṣeyī puruṣakṛtā | iti evaṃ pauruṣeya eva sambandhaḥ śabdārthayoḥ |

original: taddvāreṇa ca yathoktasambandhadvāreṇārthapratyāyane śabdānānna niyamaityapauruṣeyatvepi śabdānāṃ sa eva vipralambho visamvādaḥ | tathā cāpauruṣeyatvakalpanā vyarthaiveti bhāvaḥ | (241-242)

original: yāpītyādi vyākhyānaṃ | bahūnāmarthānāṃ karttā na svaryate | na ca te tāvatā 'kṛtakāḥ | tadyathā jīrṇṇakūpādayaḥ | evaṃ hetorvyabhicārādayuktarūpāpīyamapauruṣeyatā | vedavākyānāṃ kartturasmaraṇād varṇyate jaimininā | asyaivamvidhasya vastunaḥ santyadyatvepyanuvaktāra (p.438) iti | kimatra vaktavyaṃ kevalaṃ dhigvyāpakantamaḥ |

original: bauddhādīnāṃ mantratvameva nāstīti cedāha – bauddhādīnāmamantratva iti | tadanyatrāpi tasmād bauddhādimantrādanyatrāpi vaidike mantre mantratvapratipādanāya kośapānaṃ karaṇīyaṃ | na hi kācid vyaktirastītyabhiprāyaḥ | dṛṣṭaviruddhaṃ caitad bauddhādayo na mantrā iti | tathā hi viṣādikarmakṛto viṣakarmādīn kurvanto bauddhā api mantrā dṛśyante |
analyzed: bauddha ādīnām mantra tvam eva na asti iti ced āha bauddha ādīnām amantra tve iti tat anyatra api tasmāt bauddha ādi mantrāt anyatra api vaidike mantre mantra tva pratipādanāya kośa pānam karaṇīyam na hi kācid vyaktiḥ asti iti abhiprāyaḥ dṛṣṭa viruddham ca etat bauddha ādayaḥ na mantrāḥ iti tathā hi viṣa ādi karma kṛtaḥ viṣa karma ādīn kurvantaḥ bauddhāḥ api mantrāḥ dṛśyante

original: tena tatra bauddhādiṣu mantrakalpeṣvamantratvamapi vipratisśiddhaṃ | viṣakarmādikaraṇaddhāreṇa vaidikānāmapi mantratvavyavasthāpanāt | na ca viṣastambhanādisāmarthyayogāt vedavākyaṃ laukivākyādatiśayavadityevāpauruṣeyaṃ yuktaṃ |
analyzed: tena tatra bauddha ādiṣu mantra kalpeṣu amantra tvam api vipratisśiddham viṣa karma ādi karaṇa ddhāreṇa vaidikānām api mantra tva vyavasthāpanāt na ca viṣa stambhana ādi sāmarthya yogāt veda vākyam lauki vākyāt atiśayavat iti eva apauruṣeyam yuktam

original: tathā hi pāṇyaṅgulasanniveśo mudrā | maṇḍalaṃ devatādiracanāviśeṣaḥ | dhyānandevatādirūpacintanaṃ tairanakṣarairaśabdasvabhāvaiḥ svakarmāṇi viṣādyapanayanādilakṣaṇāni kriyante | na ca tāni mudrāmaṇḍaladhyānānyapauruṣeyāṇi yujyante (|)
analyzed: tathā hi pāṇi aṅgula sanniveśaḥ mudrā maṇḍalam devatā ādi racanā viśeṣaḥ dhyānam devatā ādi rūpa cintanam taiḥ anakṣaraiḥ aśabda svabhāvaiḥ sva karmāṇi viṣādi apanayana ādi lakṣaṇāni kriyante na ca tāni mudrā maṇḍala dhyānāni apauruṣeyāṇi yujyante

original: syādetat (|) mudrādiṣveva puṃsāṃ karaṇasāmarthyanna varṇṇakrameṣu mantreṣviti |
analyzed: syāt etat mudrā ādiṣu eva puṃsām karaṇa sāmarthyan na varṇṇa krameṣu mantreṣu iti

original: (p.451) tanna | yasmāt teṣāṃ mudrādīnāṃ kriyāsambhave satyakṣararacanāyāṃ sattyādimatāṃ puṃsāṃ kaḥ pratighāto viśeṣābhāvāt | tasmānna kiñcidaśakyakriyameṣāṃ puṃsāṃ | puṃsāṃ kaḥ pratighāto viśeṣābhāvāt | tasmān na kiñcidaśakyakriyameṣāṃ puṃsāṃ | yena puruṣeṇākṛtamatiśayamupalabhya laukikebhyo vaidikānāṃ svabhāvabhedaḥ kalpyeta |
analyzed: tat na yasmāt teṣām mudrā ādīnām kriyā sambhave sati akṣara racanāyām satti ādimatām puṃsām kaḥ pratighātaḥ viśeṣa abhāvāt tasmāt na kiñcid aśakya kriyam eṣām puṃsām puṃsām kaḥ pratighātaḥ viśeṣa abhāvāt tasmāt na kiñcid aśakya kriyam eṣām puṃsām yena puruṣeṇa akṛtam atiśayam upalabhya laukikebhyaḥ vaidikānām svabhāva bhedaḥ kalpyeta

original: yadi bauddhetarau mantrakalpau dvāvapi pauruṣeyo tau ca sattyaprabhavau | avitathābhidhāyipuruṣādutpannau | tatkathamidānīntāveva sattyaprabhavau bhantrakalpau bauddhetarauparasparaviruddhau yujyete | ekatra hiṃsādīnāmanabhyudayahetutvena darśanādanyatrābhyudayahetutvena |
analyzed: yadi bauddha itarau mantra kalpau dvau api tau ca sattya prabhavau avitatha abhidhāyi puruṣāt utpannau tat katham idānīm tau eva sattya prabhavau bhantra kalpau bauddha itarau paraspara viruddhau yujyete ekatra hiṃsā ādīnām anabhyudaya hetu tvena darśanāt anyatra abhyudaya hetu tvena

original: netyādinā pariharati | na vai sarvatra tau mantrakalpau sattyaprabhavau yenāyaṃ virodhaḥ | kintu prabhāvayuktapuruṣapratijñnālakṣaṇāvapi tau mantrakalpau staḥ | prabhāvavatā puruṣeṇa "ya imāṃ varṇṇapadaracanāmabhyasyati tadvidhiṃ cānutiṣṭhati tasyāhaṃ yathāpratijñātamarthaṃ sampādayiṣyāmī" ti yā pratijñā tallakṣaṇāvapi mantrakalpau bhavataḥ |
analyzed: na ityādinā pariharati na vai sarvatra tau mantra kalpau sattya prabhavau yena ayam virodhaḥ kintu prabhāva yukta puruṣa pratijñnā lakṣaṇau api tau mantra kalpau staḥ prabhāvavatā puruṣeṇa yaḥ imām varṇṇa pada racanām abhyasyati tad vidhim ca anutiṣṭhati tasya aham yathā pratijñātam artham sampādayiṣyāmi iti yā pratijñā tad lakṣaṇau api mantra kalpau bhavataḥ

original: tatonyathāvādyapi orabhāvayuktau mantrakalpau kuryādevetyavirodhaḥ | sa eva sattyābhāvāt prabhāvaḥ kuta iti vedāha sa | sa prabhāvo gatisiddhiviśeṣābhyāmapi syāt | puṇyena gativiśeṣa eva sa tādṛśo labdho devatādisaṅgṛhīto mantrasiddhiviśeṣo yena sa tādṛśaḥ prabhāvo bhavatīti |
analyzed: tatonyathāvādī api orabhāva yuktau mantra kalpau kuryāt eva iti avirodhaḥ saḥ eva sattya abhāvāt prabhāvaḥ kutas iti veda āha sa sa prabhāvaḥ gati siddhi viśeṣābhyām api syāt puṇyena gati viśeṣaḥ eva sa tādṛśaḥ labdhaḥ devatā ādi saṅgṛhītaḥ mantra siddhi viśeṣaḥ yena sa tādṛśaḥ prabhāvaḥ bhavati iti

original: yadi pauruṣeyā mantrāstadā puruṣatvāt sarve puruṣāḥ kinna mantrakāriṇaḥ (|) na ca kurvanti | tasmādabhimatā api puruṣā na mantrānakārṣurityabhiprāyaḥ |
analyzed: yadi pauruṣeyāḥ mantrāḥ tadā puruṣa tvāt sarve puruṣāḥ kin na mantra kāriṇaḥ na ca kurvanti tasmāt abhimatāḥ api puruṣāḥ na mantrān akārṣuḥ iti abhiprāyaḥ

original: tadityādi siddhāntavādī | teṣāmmantrāṇāṃ yat kriyāsādhanaṃ sattyatapaḥprabhāvadi tena vaikalyānna sarve puruṣā mantrakāriṇaḥ |
analyzed: tat ityādi siddhānta vādī teṣām mantrāṇām yat kriyā sādhanam sattya tapaḥ prabhāva di tena vaikalyāt na sarve puruṣāḥ mantra kāriṇaḥ

original: yadi punastādṛśaiḥ sattyatapaḥprabhṛtibhirmantrahetubhiḥ puruṣā yuktāḥ syustadā te mantrān kurvantyeva |
analyzed: yadi punar tādṛśaiḥ sattya tapaḥ prabhṛtibhiḥ mantra hetubhiḥ puruṣāḥ yuktāḥ syuḥ tadā te mantrān kurvanti eva

original: (p.452) api ca kāvyāni tatkriyāpratibhāyuktaḥ puruṣaḥ karotīti kṛtvā tatkriyāpratibhārahitopi sarvaḥ puruṣaḥ puruṣatvasāmyāt kāvyakṛt syāt | akaraṇe vā kasyacidanyopi naiva kuryāt | tadvat kāvyakaraṇāsamarthapuruṣavat | ityapūrveṣā vā co yuktiḥ | vyabhicāriṇītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: api ca kāvyāni tad kriyā pratibhā yuktaḥ puruṣaḥ karoti iti kṛtvā tad kriyā pratibhā rahitaḥ api sarvaḥ puruṣaḥ puruṣa tva sāmyāt kāvya kṛt syāt akaraṇe vā kasyacid anyaḥ api na eva kuryāt tadvat kāvya karaṇa asamartha puruṣa vat iti apūrveṣā vā caḥ yuktiḥ vyabhicāriṇī iti arthaḥ

original: sattyamityādi paraḥ | mantrakriyāsādhanena vikalāḥ puruṣā mantrānna kurvate | kevalantadevātra mantrakriyāsādhanasya sattyādeḥ sākalyaṃ kasyacit puruṣasya na paśyāmaḥ | sarvapuruṣāṇāṃ samānadharmatvāt |
analyzed: sattyam ityādi paraḥ mantra kriyā sādhanena vikalāḥ puruṣāḥ mantrān na kurvate kevalam tat eva atra mantra kriyā sādhanasya satti ādeḥ sākalyam kasyacid puruṣasya na paśyāmaḥ sarva puruṣāṇām samāna dharma tvāt

original: uktamiti siddhāntavādī | atra codya uktamuttaraṃ | kimuktaṃ | na mantro nāmetyādi | vacanaṃ ca samayaśceti dvandvaḥ | sattyādimatāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ samīhitārthasādhanādvacanāt | tathā sattyādiyuktapuruṣapratijñālakṣaṇācca samayānna mantronāmānyadeva kiṃcit | tāni ca sattyatapogatisiddhiviśeṣalakṣaṇāni mantrakriyāsādhanāni kvacidevapuruṣeṣu dṛśyante |
analyzed: uktam iti siddhānta vādī atra codyaḥ uktam uttaram kim uktam na mantraḥ nāma ityādi vacanam ca samayaḥ ca iti dvandvaḥ satti ādimatām puruṣāṇām samīhita artha sādhanāt vacanāt tathā satti ādi yukta puruṣa pratijñā lakṣaṇāt ca samayāt na mantraḥ nāma anyat eva kiṃcid tāni ca sattya tapaḥ gati siddhi viśeṣa lakṣaṇāni mantra kriyā sādhanāni kvacid eva puruṣeṣu dṛśyante

original: syādetad (|) yo yaḥ puruṣasya mantrakriyāsādhanarahitastadyathā rathyāpuruṣaḥ | puruṣaścāyaṃ mantrakarttṛtvenābhimataḥ puruṣa iti | tatrāpi sarvapuruṣāstadrahitāstena mantrakriyāsādhanena rahitā ityapi tatsambhavasya mantrakriyāsādhanasambhavasya puruṣatvena saha virodhābhāvāt | anirṇṇayo 'niścayaḥ |
analyzed: syāt etat yaḥ yaḥ puruṣasya mantra kriyā sādhana rahitaḥ tat yathā rathyā puruṣaḥ puruṣaḥ ca ayam mantra karttṛ tvena abhimataḥ puruṣaḥ iti tatra api sarva puruṣāḥ tad rahitāḥ tena mantra kriyā sādhanena rahitāḥ iti api tad sambhavasya mantra kriyā sādhana sambhavasya puruṣa tvena saha virodha abhāvāt anirṇṇayaḥ niścayaḥ

original: mantrakriyāsādhanasya svabhāvanupalambhādeva puruṣe svabhāvaniśvaya iti cedāha – na cetyādi | atikṣasvabhāveṣu akṣātikrāntaḥ svabhāvo yeṣānteṣvatyantaparokṣeṣvityarthaḥ | anupalabdhirnābhāvaniścayasya hetuḥ | ātmani mantrakriyāsādhanānāṃ smṛtyādīnāmanupalambhenaparatrāpyabhāvo niścīyata iti cedāha – na cetyādi | atikrāntajanmādismaraṇaṃ smṛtiḥ |
analyzed: mantra kriyā sādhanasya svabhāva anupalambhāt eva puruṣe svabhāva niśvayaḥ iti ced āha na ca ityādi ati kṣa svabhāveṣu akṣa atikrāntaḥ svabhāvaḥ yeṣān teṣu atyanta parokṣeṣu iti arthaḥ anupalabdhiḥ na abhāva niścayasya hetuḥ ātmani mantra kriyā sādhanānām smṛti ādīnām anupalambhena paratra api abhāvaḥ niścīyate iti ced āha na ca ityādi atikrānta janma ādi smaraṇam smṛtiḥ

original: paracittāvabodho matiḥ | adṛṣṭeṣu padārthatattvadarśanaṃ prativedhaḥ | sattyamananyathāvāditvam | śaktiḥ prabhāvaḥ | tā mantrahetavaḥ sarvabhāvinyaḥ | sarvapuruṣasantānabhāvinyo (p.453) bhavanti | yena tā ātmani na dṛṣṭā ityanyatrāpi pratikṣiperan |
analyzed: para citta avabodhaḥ matiḥ adṛṣṭeṣu padārtha tattva darśanam prativedhaḥ sattyam ananyathāvādi tvam śaktiḥ prabhāvaḥ tāḥ mantra hetavaḥ sarva bhāvinyaḥ sarva puruṣa santāna bhāvinyaḥ bhavanti yena tāḥ ātmani na dṛṣṭāḥ iti anyatra api pratikṣiperan

original: idānīṃ smṛtyādīmāṃ kvacideva puruṣe sambhavamāha – tatsādhanamityādi | teṣāṃ smṛtyādīnāṃ yathoktānāṃ yatsādhanamutpattikāraṇantasya saṃpradāya upadeśastasya bhedo viśeṣaḥ kvacidevāgame sambhavo na sarvatra | tadvad guṇāntarasādhanānyapi syuḥ | kvacideva puruṣe bhaveyuḥ | siddhiḥ sādhanaṃ |
analyzed: idānīm smṛti ādi imām kvacid eva puruṣe sambhavam āha tat sādhanam ityādi teṣām smṛti ādīnām yathā uktānām yat sādhanam utpatti kāraṇan tasya saṃpradāyaḥ upadeśaḥ tasya bhedaḥ viśeṣaḥ kvacid eva āgame sambhavaḥ na sarvatra tadvat guṇa antara sādhanāni api syuḥ kvacid eva puruṣe bhaveyuḥ siddhiḥ sādhanam

original: smṛtyādikāraṇānāṃ kāryabhūtāni yāni guṇāntarāṇi smṛtyādirūpāṇi teṣāṃ sādhanāni niṣpattayopi kvacideva puruṣe syuḥ smṛtyādikāraṇānuṣṭhānāt | yadi smṛtyādi sādhanaṃ syāt kinna dṛśyata iti cedāha – nāpītyādi | sannapi vidyamānopi santānāntarastho manoguṇo draṣṭupuruṣamātreṇa na śakyaḥ |
analyzed: smṛti ādi kāraṇānām kārya bhūtāni yāni guṇa antarāṇi smṛti ādi rūpāṇi teṣām sādhanāni niṣpattayaḥ api kvacid eva puruṣe syuḥ smṛti ādi kāraṇa anuṣṭhānāt yadi smṛti ādi sādhanam syāt kim na dṛśyate iti ced āha na api ityādi san api vidyamānaḥ api santāna antara sthaḥ manaḥ guṇaḥ draṣṭu puruṣa mātreṇa na śakyaḥ

original: ata eva kāraṇādadṛṣṭasya santānāntarasya manoguṇasyānapahnavopratikṣepaḥ | nāpi puruṣeṣu manofuṇasyotpitsorutpattimicchoḥ pratiroddhā bādhakosti yena tadanyaguṇātiśāyī manoguṇaḥ kasyavidapi nāstīti syāt | puruṣatvādika eva dharmo bādhaka iti cet (|) na | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ | tasyānyasantānabhāvino bādhyasya guṇasya puruṣamātreṇādṛṣṭeḥ |
analyzed: atas eva kāraṇāt adṛṣṭasya santāna antarasya manaḥ guṇasya anapahnavaḥ pratikṣepaḥ nā api puruṣeṣu manaḥ fuṇasya utpitsoḥ utpattim icchoḥ pratiroddhā bādhakaḥ asti yena tad anya guṇa atiśāyī manaḥ guṇaḥ kasyavid api nā asti iti syāt puruṣa tva ādikaḥ eva dharmaḥ bādhakaḥ iti ced na kim kāraṇam tasya anya santāna bhāvinaḥ bādhyasya guṇasya puruṣa mātreṇa adṛṣṭeḥ

original: puruṣatvādinā dharmeṇa bādhyabādhakabhāvāsiddheḥ | abādhakāccāpratikṣepaḥ |
analyzed: puruṣa tva ādinā dharmeṇa bādhya bādhaka bhāva asiddheḥ abādhakāt ca apratikṣepaḥ

original: etenāntaroktena sarvasyārthasya yajjñānantasya pratiṣedhaḥ | ādiśabdād vītarāgādipratiṣedhādayo nirvarṇṇitottarāḥ |
analyzed: etena antara uktena sarvasya arthasya pratiṣedhaḥ ādi śabdāt vīta rāga ādi pratiṣedha ādayaḥ nirvarṇṇita uttarāḥ

original: yathā na vaktṛtvādiliṅgena sarvajñatvādīnāṃ pratikṣepa iti | tatrāpi bītarāgatvādipratikṣepa evambhūtaḥ puruṣo vītarāgatvādiguṇayukto neti nyāyo yuktaḥ | kiṃbhūtaḥ | yādṛśoyamasambhavantatsādhanasmpradāyaḥ | asamabhavantatsādhanasaṃpradāyo vītarāgatvādisādhanasaṃpradāyo yasyeti vigrahaḥ |
analyzed: yathā na vaktṛ tva ādi liṅgena sarvajña tva ādīnām pratikṣepaḥ iti tatra api bīta rāga tva ādi pratikṣepaḥ evambhūtaḥ puruṣaḥ vīta rāga tva ādi guṇa yuktaḥ na iti nyāyaḥ yuktaḥ kiṃbhūtaḥ yādṛśaḥ yam asambhavat tad sādhana smpradāyaḥ asamabhavan tad sādhana saṃpradāyaḥ vīta rāga tva ādi sādhana saṃpradāyaḥ yasya iti vigrahaḥ

original: vītarāgatvādisādhanenopāyena vikalassavītarāgādirna bhavatyevaṃ nyāya iti yāvat | na dṛṣṭajñāpakotatsvabhāva ityapi | adṛṣṭaṃ jñāpakaṃ vītarāgatvādi kiṅgaṃ yasya | sa jñnāpako darśanamātreṇātatsvabhāvo vītarāgatvādiguṇaviyuktasvabhāvo bhavatītyapi na yuktamvaktuṃ | na hi jñāpakānupalambhamātreṇa jñāpyasyābhāvo nyāyyaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ |
analyzed: vīta rāga tva ādi sādhanena upāyena vikalaḥ sa vīta rāga ādiḥ na bhavati evam nyāyaḥ iti yāvat na dṛṣṭa jñāpaka uta svabhāvaḥ iti api adṛṣṭam jñāpakam vīta rāga tva ādi kiṅgam yasya sa jñnāpakaḥ darśana mātreṇa atatsvabhāvaḥ vīta rāga tva ādi guṇa viyukta svabhāvaḥ bhavati iti api na yuktam vaktum na hi jñāpaka anupalambha mātreṇa jñāpyasya abhāvaḥ nyāyyaḥ kim kāraṇam

original: satāmapi keṣāṃcidarthānāṃ liṅgabhūtasya kāryasyānārambhasambhavāt | ārabdhannāma tairatīndriyaiḥ kāryantathāpi svabhāvaviprakarṣeṇāmīṣām (p.454) idaṃ kāryamiti draṣṭumaśakyatvācca | tasmānmantrakriyāsādhanavaikalyaṃ yathaikasya tathā sarvasyetyetadaśakyaniścayamiti sthitaṃ |
analyzed: satām api keṣāṃcid arthānām liṅga bhūtasya kāryasya anārambha sambhavāt ārabdham nāma taiḥ atīndriyaiḥ kāryam tathā api svabhāva viprakarṣeṇa amīṣām idam kāryam iti draṣṭum aśakya tvāt ca tasmāt mantra kriyā sādhana vaikalyam yathā ekasya tathā sarvasya iti etat aśakya niścayam iti sthitam

original: yata evantasmādadhyayanamadhyayanāntaravad adhyayanāntarapūrvakamiti sādhye adhyayanāditi kiṅgaṃ vaybhicāri | bhāratādyadhyayane pauruṣeyādhyayanatvasya bhāvāt |
analyzed: yatas evam tasmāt adhyayanam adhyayana antara vat adhyayana antara pūrvakam iti sādhye adhyayanāt iti kiṅgam vaybhicāri bhārata ādi adhyayane pauruṣeya adhyayana tvasya bhāvāt

original: vedena viśeṣaṇādadoṣaḥ | adhyayanamātrasya hi vyabhicāro na vedena viśiṣṭasyādhyayananasyetyabhiprāyaḥ | kaḥ punarityādi siddhāntavādī | kotiśayo vedādhyayanasya yena tadvedādhyayanamanyatheti svayaṃ kṛtvādhyetuṃ na śakyate | naiva kaścidatiśayaḥ (|) tato vedādhyayanaṃ ca syānna cādhyayanapūrvakamiti virodhābhāvāt sa eva vyabhicāraḥ |
analyzed: vedena viśeṣaṇāt adoṣaḥ adhyayana mātrasya hi vyabhicāraḥ na vedena viśiṣṭasya adhyayananasya iti abhiprāyaḥ kaḥ punar ityādi siddhāntavādī kaḥ utiśayaḥ veda adhyayanasya yena tat veda adhyayanam anyathā iti svayam kṛtvā adhyetum na śakyate na eva kaścid atiśayaḥ tatas veda adhyayanam ca syāt na ca adhyayana pūrvakam iti virodha abhāvāt saḥ eva vyabhicāraḥ

analyzed: atha veda vākyānām eva apauruṣeya tvam iṣyate tadā veda vākyānām eva apauruṣeya tve sati api tad vācyeṣu artheṣu saṃśayaḥ eva punar iti bhūyas apauruṣeya tvam api kalpayitvā abhūyas saṃśayaḥ eva prāptaḥ iti arthaḥ kim kāraṇam artha bhedānām veda artha vyākhyāna vikalpānām ācārya bhedena darśanāt

original: yadītyādinā vyācaṣṭe |

analyzed: apauruṣeya tve pi yadi veda vākyam yathāsvam pratiniyatām eva tad artha pratibhām veda vācyārtha ālambanām buddhi pravṛtti kāmasya yadi janayet tadā viparīta artha samāropa abhāvāt āśvāsanam syāt labdha āśvāsaḥ puruṣaḥ bhavet tat tu nā asti yasmāt samāropa apavādābhyām adhika śabda prakṣepeṇa śabda antara apahnavena vā iti arthaḥ

original: viruddhaśāstravyavahāriṇo nai ru ktāḥ | ādiśabdād vai yā ka ra ṇādiparigrahaḥ | vedavākyāni viśasanto nānārthān kurvanto dṛśyante | na ca te parasparavirodhinoḥ vyākhyābhedopanītā arthāsteṣām vedavākyānān na saṅghaṭanta eva sambhavanty evety arthaḥ | (p.459) kiṃ kāraṇam (|) arthaniveśasyārthavācakatvena pravarttanasya samayaprādhānyāt |

original: saṃketapratibaddhatvāt | ekasyāpi vākyasya yathāsamayamanekārthavikalpasambhavāt saṃśaya eva | prakṛtipratyayānusāreṇa ca vedavākyānāṃ vyākhyānāt | teṣāṃ ca niyatārthatvān na vedavākyeṣvanekārthavikalpasambhava ity api mithyā | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) prakṛtipratyayānāmanekārthapāṭhasambhavāt | ekāpi hi prakṛtir anekeṣv artheṣu paṭhyate |
analyzed: saṃketa pratibaddha tvāt ekasya api vākyasya yathāsamayam aneka artha vikalpa sambhavāt saṃśayaḥ eva prakṛti pratyaya anusāreṇa ca veda vākyānām vyākhyānāt teṣām ca niyata artha tvāt na veda vākyeṣu aneka artha vikalpa sambhavaḥ iti api mithyā kim kāraṇam prakṛti pratyayānām aneka artha pāṭha sambhavāt ekā api hi prakṛtiḥ anekeṣu artheṣu paṭhyate

original: tathā pratyayopīti (|) tadavastha eva yathābhiprāyamarthasaṃskārabhedāt saṃśayaḥ |

original: syād etad (|) ruḍhim āśritya vedārthavyākhyānāt prakṛtipratyayānām anekārthapāṭhepi na saṃśaya ity apy asat | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) ruḍher apy ekāntena svayam evānanumateranaṅgīkaraṇāt | etad eva kutaḥ | arūḍhaśabdabāhulyāt | arūḍhā eva ye loke śabdāste vede bāhulyena dṛśyante | tadyathā jarbhurāṇaprabhṛtayaḥ | tato na tatra rūḍhiśabdānnirṇṇyaḥ |
analyzed: syāt etat ruḍhim āśritya veda artha vyākhyānāt prakṛti pratyayānām aneka artha pāṭhe pi na saṃśayaḥ iti api asat kim kāraṇam ruḍheḥ api ekāntena svayam eva ananumateḥ anaṅgīkaraṇāt etat eva kutas arūḍha śabda bāhulyāt arūḍhāḥ eva ye loke śabdāḥ te vede bāhulyena dṛśyante tat yathā jarbhurāṇa prabhṛtayaḥ tatas na tatra rūḍhi śabdān nirṇṇyaḥ

original: tatra tadarthasyārūḍhaśabdārthasya nirṇṇaye vyākhyātṛpuruṣopadeśāpekṣaṇāt | tadupadeśasya ca puruṣopadeśasya ca | tadicchānuvatteḥ puruṣecchānavṛtter anirṇaya eva vedavākyārtheṣu | (249)
analyzed: tatra tad arthasya ārūḍha śabda arthasya nirṇṇaye vyākhyātṛ puruṣa upadeśa apekṣaṇāt tad upadeśasya ca puruṣa upadeśasya ca tad icchā anuvatteḥ puruṣa icchā anavṛtteḥ anirṇayaḥ eva veda vākya artheṣu

original: api cāyaṃ ve da vā dyapauruṣetvaṃ sādhayan varṇṇānāmvā sādhayed vākyasya vā | vākyavikalpenaiva padasyāpy abhidhānaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ |
analyzed: api ca ayam vā dya pauruṣetvam sādhayan varṇṇānām vā sādhayet vākyasya vā vākya vikalpena eva padasya api abhidhānam draṣṭavyam

original: (1) varṇṇavikalpamadhikṛtyāha – tatretyādi | anyāviśeṣāditi (|) laukikebhyo varṇṇebhyo vaidikānāmaviśeṣāt | varṇṇānāmapauruṣeyatvasādhane kimphalambhet (|) naiva kiñcit |

original: na hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | yasmān na hi laukikavaidikavākyayor nānā varṇṇāḥ | (p.460) kin tarhi (|) yathā vaidikā akārādayo 'bhinnās tathā laukikā api | ekatvena pratyabhijñāyamānatvat | saty api pratyabhijñāne yadi laukikebhyo vaidikānāṃ varṇṇānāṃ bheda iṣyate | tadā bhedepi |
analyzed: na hi ityādinā vyācaṣṭe yasmāt na hi laukika vaidika vākyayoḥ nānā varṇṇāḥ kin tarhi yathā vaidikāḥ akāra ādayaḥ bhinnāḥ tathā laukikāḥ api ekatvena sati api pratyabhijñāne yadi laukikebhyaḥ vaidikānām varṇṇānām bhedaḥ iṣyate tadā bhede pi

original: tataḥ pratyabhijñānād vaidikānāmakārādīnāṃ pratyuccāraṇaṃ yadekatvantasyāsiddhiprasaṅgāt | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) pratyabhijñāviśeṣāt | laukikavaidikavarṇṇabhede dṛṣṭasya pratyabhijñānasya vaidikeṣu varṇṇeṣv aviśeṣāt | ekatvavyabhicāriṇaḥ pratyabhijñānāt kathamvaidikānām ekatvaṃ sidhyatīty arthaḥ | bhedānupalakṣaṇāc ca vaidikavarṇṇāsiddhiḥ |
analyzed: tatas pratyabhijñānāt vaidikānām akāra ādīnām pratyuccāraṇam yat eka tu antasya asiddhi prasaṅgāt kim kāraṇam pratyabhijñā viśeṣāt laukika vaidika varṇṇa bhede dṛṣṭasya pratyabhijñānasya vaidikeṣu varṇṇeṣu aviśeṣāt eka tva vyabhicāriṇaḥ pratyabhijñānāt katham vaidikānām eka tvam sidhyati iti arthaḥ bheda anupalakṣaṇāt ca vaidika varṇṇa asiddhiḥ

original: laukikavaidikayor bhedānupalakṣaṇāt |
analyzed: laukika vaidikayoḥ bheda an upalakṣaṇāt

original: atha syād vaidikeṣu varṇṇeṣv ekatvanimittatvāt pratyabhijñānaṃ pramāṇam evānyatra tu sādṛśyena bhrāntatvād apramāṇam ity ata āha – pratyabhijñānādapratītiprasaṅgād iti | yady anyatrāpramāṇaṃ ghaṭādāv api tarhi pratyabhijñānād kṣaṇikatvāpratipattiprasaṅgāt | anyattvād eva | bhavadibharmīmāṃsakair llaukikavaidikavarṇṇabhedānabhyupagamāc ca |
analyzed: atha syāt vaidikeṣu varṇṇeṣu ekatva nimitta tvāt pratyabhijñānam pramāṇam eva anyatra tu sādṛśyena bhrānta tvāt apramāṇam iti atas āha pratyabhijñānāt apratīti prasaṅgāt iti yadi anyatra apramāṇam ghaṭa ādau api tarhi pratyabhijñānāt kṣaṇikatva apratipatti prasaṅgāt anyattvāt eva ca

original: teṣāñ ca varṇṇānāmapauruṣeyatvasādhanebhyupagamyamāne te varṇṇāḥ sarvatra loke vede ca tulyā iti kimanena mīmāṃsakenaivamapauruṣeyatvaṃ sādhayatā pariśeṣitaṃ parityaktamvarṇṇajātaṃ yat pauruṣeyaṃ syāt |
analyzed: teṣām ca varṇṇānām apauruṣeya tva sādhane abhyupagamyamāne te varṇṇāḥ sarvatra loke vede ca tulyāḥ iti kim anena mīmāṃsakena evam apauruṣeya tvam sādhayatā pariśeṣitam parityaktam varṇṇa jātam yat pauruṣeyam syāt

original: tathā vai laukikavaidikavarṇṇānāmapauruṣeyatve sati sarvaḥ śābdo vyavahāro laukiko vaidikaścāpauruṣeyo na ca sarvo 'vitatho na ca sarvaḥ sattyārthaḥ | apauruṣeyatvepi vitathārthasya sambhavāt | iti hetor vyarthaḥ | pariśramo 'pauruṣeyatvakalpanāyāḥ
analyzed: tathā vai laukika vaidika varṇṇānām apauruṣeya tve sati sarvaḥ śābdaḥ vyavahāraḥ laukikaḥ vaidikaḥ ca apauruṣeyaḥ na ca sarvaḥ vitathaḥ na ca sarvaḥ sattya arthaḥ apauruṣeya tve api vitatha arthasya sambhavāt iti hetoḥ vyarthaḥ pauruṣeya tva kalpanāyāḥ

original: (2) athetyādinā dvitīyapakṣopanyāsaḥ | atha vākyam apauruṣeyam iṣṭaṃ tadasat | tathā hi vākyan na bhinnamvarṇṇebhyo vidyate | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ | dṛśyasyānupalambhanāt |
analyzed: atha ityādinā dvitīya pakṣa upanyāsaḥ atha vākyam apauruṣeyam iṣṭam tat asat tathā hi vākyat na vidyate kim kāraṇam dṛśyasya anupalambhanāt

original: na hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | na hi vayandevadattādipadavākyeṣu | devadattādipadeṣu vākyeṣu ca dakārādīnāṃ varṇṇānāṃ yaḥ pratibhāsas taṃ muktvānyavarṇṇātmakaṃ padavākyapratibhāsaṃ (p.461) buddheḥ paśyāmaḥ | dvitīyavarṇṇapratibhāsavat | yathā dakāre pratibhāsamāne tatsmānakālam eva dvitīyo varṇṇo na pratibhāsate | tadvan na padavākyaṃ pratibhāsate |
analyzed: na hi ityādinā vyācaṣṭe na hi vayan devadatta ādi pada vākyeṣu devadatta ādi padeṣu vākyeṣu ca dakāra ādīnām varṇṇānām yaḥ pratibhāsaḥ tam muktvā anya varṇṇa ātmakam pada vākya pratibhāsam buddheḥ paśyāmaḥ dvitīya varṇṇa pratibhāsa vat yathā dakāre pratibhāsamāne eva dvitīyaḥ varṇṇaḥ na pratibhāsate tadvat na pada vākyam pratibhāsate

original: a cāpratibhāsamānaṃ grahaṇe buddhau grāhyatayeṣṭamupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptaṃ sadastīti śakyamavasātuṃ | tathā varṇṇebhyonyad veti śakyamavasātuṃ | na ceti sambandhaḥ | astitve niṣiddhenyattvam api niṣiddham eva | tathāpi dvayor upādānam atyantasattvapratipādanārthaṃ | ākārāntavat |
analyzed: ca apratibhāsamānam grahaṇe buddhau grāhyatayā iṣṭam upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptam sat asti iti śakyam avasātum tathā varṇṇebhyaḥ nyat vā iti śakyam avasātum na ca iti sambandhaḥ astitve niṣiddhenyattvam api niṣiddham eva tathā api dvayoḥ upādānam atyanta sattva pratipādana artham ākāra anta vat

original: yathaikasminnākāre bhāsamāne tatrāpratibhāsamānaṃ dṛśyam ākārāntaram anyan nāsti tadvat |
analyzed: yathā ekasmin ākāre bhāsamāne tatra apratibhāsamānam dṛśyam ākāra antaram anyat na asti tadvat

original: anyāsambhavītyādi (|) anyeṣu varṇṇeṣv asambhavi | arthapratyāyanakāryalakṣaṇaṃ kāryavyatiriktasya padavākyasya gamakam iti cet | tathā hy apratipattir devadattādipadavākyeṣu dṛṣṭā | na ceyam varṇṇebhyas teṣāṃ pratyekam anarthakatvāt | ekavarṇṇakāle 'paravarṇṇābhāvena sāmastyābhāvāccātovagamyate 'sti tatpadavākyaṃ yata iyam arthapratītir bhavatīti |
analyzed: anya asambhavi ityādi anyeṣu varṇṇeṣu asambhavi artha pratyāyana kārya lakṣaṇam kārya vyatiriktasya pada vākyasya gamakam iti ced tathā hi apratipattiḥ devadatta ādi pada vākyeṣu dṛṣṭā na ca iyam varṇṇebhyaḥ teṣām pratyekam anarthaka tvāt eka varṇṇa kāle para varṇṇa abhāvena sāmastya abhāvāt ca atas vagamyate sti tat pada vākyam yatas iyam artha pratītiḥ bhavati iti

original: syādityādinā pratividhatte | syād varṇebhyorthāntaraṃ padādi | yadi teṣu varṇṇeṣu satsv api tadarthapratītilakṣaṇaṃ kāryan na syāt | yāvān varṇṇasamudāyorthapratipādanāya saṃketitastāvato yadyarthapratītir na syāt syād etat | yāvatā bhavaty eva | taduktaṃ (|)
analyzed: syāt ityādinā pratividhatte syāt varṇebhyaḥ ṛtha antaram pada ādi yadi teṣu varṇṇeṣu satsu api tad artha pratīti lakṣaṇam na syāt yāvān varṇṇa samudāyaḥ ṛtha pratipādanāya saṃketitaḥ tāvataḥ yadi artha pratītiḥ na syāt syāt etat yāvatā bhavati eva tat uktam

original: nānyathānupapattis tu bhavaty arthamatiṃ prati |
analyzed: na anyathā anupapattiḥ tu bhavati artha matim prati

original: tadevāsyānimittaṃ syājjāyate yadanantaram iti | (sphuṭa° 95)
analyzed: tat eva asya animittam syāt jāyate yat anantaram iti

original: na bhavatītyādi paraḥ | na bhavati varṇṇebhyorthapratītiḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) teṣām varṇṇānām aviśeṣepi padavākyāntarerthapratīter asambhavāt | yadi hi varṇṇebhyorthapratītiḥ syāt tadā sara ity asmin pade yādṛśyarthapratītis tādṛśy eva rasa ityatrāpi syād ubhayatra varṇṇānāntulyatvāt | evaṃ vākyepi sadṛśavarṇṇe boddhavyaṃ | na ca bhavati |
analyzed: na bhavati ityādi paraḥ na bhavati varṇṇebhyaḥ ṛtha pratītiḥ kim kāraṇam teṣām varṇṇānām aviśeṣe pi pada vākya antara ṛtha pratīteḥ asambhavāt yadi hi varṇṇebhyaḥ ṛtha pratītiḥ syāt tadā saraḥ iti asmin pade yādṛśī artha pratītiḥ tādṛśī eva rasaḥ iti atra api syāt ubhayatra evam vākye api sadṛśa varṇṇe boddhavyam na ca bhavati

original: tasmān na varṇṇebhyorthapratītilakṣaṇaṃ kāryam iti |
analyzed: tasmāt na varṇṇebhyaḥ ṛtha pratīti lakṣaṇam kāryam iti

original: netyādinā pariharati | teṣām varṇṇānāṃ vākyāntareṣvaviśeṣāsiddheḥ | tathā hi ya ekatra vākye varṇṇā na ta eva vākyāntareṣu puruṣaprayatnabhedena varṇṇānāṃ prativākyam bhinnānām evotpatteḥ | (p.462)
analyzed: na ityādinā pariharati teṣām varṇṇānām vākya antareṣu aviśeṣa asiddheḥ tathā hi ye ekatra vākye varṇṇāḥ na te eva vākya antareṣu puruṣa prayatna bhedena varṇṇānām prativākyam bhinnānām eva utpatteḥ

original: sa evāyamvarṇṇa iti pratyabhijñānāt prativākyaṃ varṇṇānām aviśaṣo 'bhedaḥ siddha iti cet |
analyzed: saḥ eva ayam varṇṇaḥ iti pratyabhijñānāt prativākyam varṇṇānām a viśaṣaḥ bhedaḥ siddhaḥ iti ced

original: naitadevaṃ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ | tasya pratyabhijñānasya vyabhicāritvāt | dṛśyate hi lūnapunarjāteṣu keśeṣu bhinneṣv api sādṛśyagrahaṇād vipralabdhasya pratyabhijñānaṃ | sādṛśyagrahaṇaṃ ca sadṛśasya svarūpagrahaṇaṃ na tv anyasadṛśa iti grahaṇaṃ | anidarśanatvāc cādṛṣṭāntatvāc ca pratyabhijñānasyāliṅgasya |
analyzed: na etat evam kim kāraṇam tasya pratyabhijñānasya vyabhicāri tvāt dṛśyate hi lūna punar jāteṣu keśeṣu bhinneṣu api sādṛśya grahaṇāt vipralabdhasya pratyabhijñānam sādṛśya grahaṇam ca sadṛśasya svarūpa grahaṇam na tu anya sadṛśaḥ iti grahaṇam anidarśana tvāt ca adṛṣṭānta tvāt ca pratyabhijñānasya aliṅgasya

original: na hyekaḥ pratyabhijñāyamāno vādiprativādisiddho dṛṣṭāntosti | nāpi pratipadaṃ varṇṇaikatvagrāhakaṃ pratyakṣaṃ pratyabhijñānaṃ sambhavati | pūrvakālasambandhitvasyedānīmasannihitatvenāgrahaṇāt | grahaṇe vā śrotrajñānavat spaṣṭapratibhāsaḥ syāt (|) na ca bhavati (|) tasmān na pūrvakālavarṇṇagrāhakaṃ |

original: syād etad | āvaraṇasya vaiguṇyādhāne sāmarthyam anvayavyatirekābhyām anugantavyaṃ (|) na cānvayavyatirekau vidyate ity āha – āvaraṇabhedenetyādi | karppaṭapaṭakuḍyādi vyavadhānabhedena śabdādau śabdagandhasparśeṣu | śrutigrahaṇam upalakṣaṇārthaṃ | tena śravaṇadarśanādīnāṃ māndyatatpāṭavayor darśanādāvāvaraṇasāmarthyam anugamyate |
analyzed: syāt etat āvaraṇasya vaiguṇya ādhāne sāmarthyam anvaya vyatirekābhyām anugantavyam na ca anvaya vyatirekau vidyate iti āha āvaraṇa bhedena ityādi karppaṭa paṭa kuḍya ādi vyavadhāna bhedena śabda ādau śabda gandha sparśeṣu śruti grahaṇam upalakṣaṇa artham tena śravaṇa darśana ādīnām māndya tad pāṭavayoḥ darśana ādau āvaraṇa sāmarthyam anugamyate

original: anyathā yadyāvaraṇena viśeṣo nādhīyate | tadā tasyāvaraṇasyākiṃcitkarasya yatsannidhānantasya sannidhānasyāpy asannidhānatulyatvāt | tasya śabdasyedamāvaraṇam ity upasaṃhāraḥ sambandho vikalpanirmita eva syān na vastvāśrayaḥ |
analyzed: anyathā yadi āvaraṇena viśeṣaḥ na ādhīyate tadā tasya āvaraṇasya akiṃcitkarasya yat sannidhānam tasya sannidhānasya api asannidhāna tulya tvāt tasya śabdasya idam āvaraṇam iti upasaṃhāraḥ sambandhaḥ vikalpa nirmitaḥ eva syāt na vastu āśrayaḥ

original: vikalpāropitārthakriyāśrayo bhaviṣyatīti ced āha – na cetyādi | na ca samāropānuvidhāyinyo na vikalpasamāropitārthāśrayā arthakriyās tāsām vastvāśrayatvāt | yasmān na hi māṇavako dahanopacārādagnirmāṇavaka ity upacārāt pāke sādhye ādhīyate niyujyate | yata evaṃ tasmāt satyām api kalpanāyāmatatparāvṛttayo bhāvāḥ |
analyzed: vikalpa āropita arthakriyā āśrayaḥ bhaviṣyati iti ced āha na ca ityādi na ca samāropa anuvidhāyinyaḥ na vikalpa samāropita artha āśrayāḥ arthakriyāḥ tāsām vastu āśraya tvāt yasmāt na hi māṇavakaḥ dahana upacārāt agniḥ māṇavakaḥ iti upacārāt pāke sādhye ādhīyate niyujyate yatas evam tasmāt satyām api kalpanāyām atatparāvṛttayaḥ bhāvāḥ

original: tayā kalpanayā parāvṛttir yeṣānte tathā | tadabhāvādatatparā vṛttayaḥ kin tu yathāsvabhāvavṛttaya eva syuḥ . yathāsvabhāvaṃ vṛttir yeṣām iti vigrahaḥ |
analyzed: tayā kalpanayā parāvṛttiḥ yeṣām te tathā tad abhāvāt atatparāḥ vṛttayaḥ kin tu yathāsvabhāva vṛttayaḥ eva syuḥ yathāsvabhāvam vṛttiḥ yeṣām iti vigrahaḥ

original: (p.475) tad iti tasmāt | yadyāvaraṇena na viśeṣa ādhīyate tadā saty apy āvaraṇe jñāpayeyur jñānaṃ janayeyur evendriyādayaḥ | na caivaṃ (|) tasmāt tenāvaraṇenādheyaviśeṣā janmaviśeṣā indriyādaya iti gamyante |

original: tad iti tasmāt | yadi teṣāṃ nityānāṃ śabdānāṃ jñānajananaḥ svabhāvaḥ | sarvasya puruṣasya sarvadā sarvāṇi svaviṣayāṇi jñānāni sakṛjjanayeyuḥ | no ced vijñānajananasvabhāvas tadā na kadācit kasya(ci)tpuruṣasya kiñcid vijñānaṃ janayeyurityekānta eṣaḥ | kasyacit sahakāriṇo vikalatvān nityasyāpi śabdasya sarvakālam aśrutir iti vet |

original: syād etad ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | api tu kiṃcideṣāṃ nityānāṃ śabdānāṃ pratipattau pratipattinimittaṃ sahakāri pratiniyataṃ | kasyacit kiñcid eva vastu sthityā niyatam asti | tatsahakāri | kadyacitkāle kasyacic chabdasya bhavatīti yatkṛtaṃ sahakārikṛtam eṣāṃ śabdānāṃ kadācit kvacit pradeśe śravaṇam iti | (254)
analyzed: syāt etat ityādinā vyācaṣṭe api tu kiṃcid eṣām nityānām śabdānām pratipattau pratipatti nimittam sahakāri pratiniyatam kasyacid kiñcid eva vastu sthityāḥ niyatam asti tat sahakāri kadyacid kāle kasyacid śabdasya bhavati iti yat kṛtam sahakāri kṛtam eṣām śabdānām kadācid kvacid pradeśe śravaṇam iti

original: kāmam ityādi siddhāntavādī | kāmamevam ity arthaḥ | anyasya sahakāriṇaḥ pratīkṣā pratīkṣaṇamastu na nivāryate | kevalaṃ niyamas tu virudhyate | pūrvasvabhāva eva śabdaḥ | sthita ity ayaṃ niyamo na syādupakārakasyāpekṣaṇīyatvāt |

original: api cetyādi (|) yadyavyāpitā tadā sarvatra deśe teṣāṃ śabdānām anupalambhaḥ syāt | tathā hi kathamekadeśavartinaṃ śabdaṃ tacchūnyadeśasthitaḥ puruṣa upalabheta | aprāptagrahaṇapakṣe 'yam adoṣa iti cet | aprāpta eva śrotradeśaṃ śabdaḥ śrotrendriyeṇa gṛhyate tataḥ śabdaśūnyadeśāvasthitopi śabdaṃ gṛhṇīyadatassarvatrānupalambhadoṣo na bhavatīti |
analyzed: api ca ityādi yadi avyāpi tā tadā sarvatra deśe teṣām śabdānām anupalambhaḥ syāt tathā hi katham eka deśa vartinam śabdam tad śūnya deśa sthitaḥ puruṣaḥ upalabheta aprāpta grahaṇa pakṣe yam adoṣaḥ iti ced aprāptaḥ eva śrotra deśam śabdaḥ śrotra indriyeṇa gṛhyate tatas śabda śūnya deśa avasthitaḥ api śabdam gṛhṇīyat atas sarvatra anupalambha doṣaḥ na bhavati iti

original: naitad evaṃ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tatrāpy aprāptagrahaṇapakṣepi na vyavahitasya grahaṇaṃ sambhavati | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tasya śabdasya yogyadeśe yāvat sthitistasyāstāratamyasyāpekṣaṇād indriyasya | kim iva (|) ayaskāntādivat | yathāyaskāntasyāprāptākarṣakatvepi nāyogyadeśāvasthitalohākarṣaṇantadvat | ādiśabdād āśīviṣādirdīpādyupaghātaṃ kurvan gṛhyate |

original: tānītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | tāni pratiniyataśaktīnyapīndriyāṇi yugapannānārūpān dhvanīn śṛṇvanti | kīdṛśān (|) pratiśabdaniyatān | śabdaṃ śabdaṃ prati vyañjakatvena niyatān | na tv eva śabdān yugapacchṛṇvantīti kaḥ śabdeṣveṣām indriyāṇāṃ nirvedo vaimukhyaṃ yena tān na śṛṇvanti |
analyzed: tāni ityādinā vyācaṣṭe tāni pratiniyata śaktīni api indriyāṇi yugapad nānā rūpān dhvanīn śṛṇvanti kīdṛśān pratiśabda niyatān śabdam śabdam prati vyañjaka tvena niyatān na tu eva śabdān yugapad śṛṇvanti iti kaḥ śabdeṣu eṣām indriyāṇām nirvedaḥ vaimukhyam yena tān na śṛṇvanti

original: yaduktam ityādi paraḥ | yaduktambauddena vācakebhyaḥ varṇṇapadavākyebhyo bhedena dhvanayo na siddhā iti | kathan na siddhāḥ (|) siddhā eva | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ | vacanādarthapratīteḥ | śabdād uccaritād arthasya vācyasya gateḥ | na ceyamarthagatir dhvanibhyaḥ sambhavati | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) na hi dhvanibhāgādalpīyaso varṇṇavyañjakādarthapratītiḥ |
analyzed: yat uktam ityādi paraḥ yat uktam bauddena vācakebhyaḥ varṇṇa pada vākyebhyaḥ bhedena dhvanayaḥ na siddhāḥ iti kathan na siddhāḥ siddhāḥ eva kim kāraṇam vacanāt artha pratīteḥ śabdāt uccaritāt arthasya vācyasya gateḥ na ca iyam artha gatiḥ dhvanibhyaḥ sambhavati kim kāraṇam na hi dhvani bhāgāt alpīyasaḥ varṇṇa vyañjakāt artha pratītiḥ

original: varṇṇopyekastāvat prāyeṇānarthakaḥ (|) prāg eva vyañjakolpīyān dhvanibhāgaḥ | sahitā pratipādakā iti ced āha – na ca sonyaṃ sameti (|) solpīyān dhvanibhāgaḥ kṣaṇikatvād anyam uttarakālabhāvinaṃ dhvanibhāgaṃ sameti saṃśliṣyati | taditi tasmādiyamarthapratītiḥ samastāni paripūrṇṇāni padavākyarūpāṇi yasmin vācake tattathā |
analyzed: varṇṇaḥ api ekaḥ tāvat prāyeṇa anarthakaḥ prāk eva vyañjaka ulpīyān dhvani bhāgaḥ sahitā pratipādakāḥ iti ced āha na ca saḥ anyam sameti sa ulpīyān dhvani bhāgaḥ kṣaṇika tvāt anyam uttara kāla bhāvinam dhvani bhāgam sameti saṃśliṣyati tat iti tasmāt iyam artha pratītiḥ samastāni paripūrṇṇāni pada vākya rūpāṇi yasmin vācake tat tathā

original: tena sādhyā dhvaniṣu na sambhavati | kīdṛśeṣu | asamastā asaṃśliṣṭā bhāgā utpannotpannadhvanibhāgasya kṣaṇikatvena dvitīyadhvanibhāgānavasthānād yeṣān teṣu | iti evamarthapratipattyanyathānupapattyā siddham akramasattvaṃ | akramaṃ sattvaṃ yasya śabdarūpasya tattathā | nirvibhāgam iti yāvat |
analyzed: tena sādhyā dhvaniṣu na sambhavati kīdṛśeṣu asamastāḥ asaṃśliṣṭāḥ bhāgāḥ utpanna utpanna dhvani bhāgasya kṣaṇika tvena dvitīya dhvani bhāga anavasthānāt yeṣān teṣu iti evam artha pratipatti anyathā anupapattyā siddham akrama sattvam akramam sattvam yasya śabda rūpasya tat tathā nirvibhāgam iti yāvat

original: kramavad vibhāgaś ca vācakavyatirikto dhvaniḥ (p.484) (|) kramavanto bhāgā yasyeti vigrahaḥ |
analyzed: kramavat vibhāgaḥ ca vācaka vyatiriktaḥ dhvaniḥ kramavantaḥ bhāgāḥ yasya iti vigrahaḥ

original: tannetyādinā pratiṣedhati | tadetadanantaroktaṃ na sambhavati | kasmāt | kramavanto ye varṇṇāstadvyatirekiṇā kramasya śabdasya | ''na hi vyandevadattādi padavākyeṣu dakārādipratibhāsaṃ muktvā paraṃ pratibhāsamupalakṣayāma'' ityādinā prāg eva niṣiddhatvāt |
analyzed: tat na ityādinā pratiṣedhati tat etat anantara uktam na sambhavati kasmāt kramavantaḥ ye varṇṇāḥ tad vyatirekiṇā kramasya śabdasya na hi pada vākyeṣu dakāra ādi pratibhāsam muktvā param pratibhāsam upalakṣayāmaḥ ityādinā prāk eva niṣiddha tvāt

original: yadi cāsamastabhāgeṣu dhvaniṣvarthapratīterasambhavādakramasattvaṃ śabdarūpaṃ kalpyate | tadātiprasaṅgaś caivaṃ kalpyamāne | tathā hi hastādīnāṃ yathā saṃketagamanāgamanādisūcakāni yāni karmāṇi teṣāṃ ye bhāgās teṣāṃ kṣaṇikatvāt pūrveṇa karmabhāgenāparasyottarasya karmabhāgasyāpratisandhānādaghaṭanāt | ekāṃśāccāpratīteḥ |

original: kiṃ ceti doṣāntaram apy āha – yaiḥ kair api doṣaiḥ pūrvapūrvasya dhvanibhāgasyottarottareṇa dhvanibhāgenāpratisandhānād ityādikaiḥ karaṇabhūtais te dhvanayo vaiyākaraṇādīnāmavācakāssammatāḥ | dṛṣṭāḥ (|) taiḥ kramabhāvibhir dhvanibhir vyajyamānesmindhvivyatiriktepi vācake kathan na te | dhvanibhāvino doṣā na santi bhavanty eva |

original: yena yasya varṇṇābhivyaktipratyayāstālvādivyāpārāsteṣāṃ kramād bhavantī kramayoginīti kṛtvā tadānupūrvī teṣāṃ vyaktānāṃ varṇṇānāmānupūrvī vākyam (|) ity api mithyā | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tasyā vyakter nityeṣu prāg eva sāmānyavyakticintāsthāne niṣiddhatvāt | tad eva smārayannāha – kāryatetyādi | vyañjakakṛtena sākṣājjananaśaktyupadhānena |

original: (p.492) yat khalu rūpaṃ yata evopalabhyate tasya rūpasya lokaḥ kāryatāṃ prajñāpayatīti sambandhaḥ | yata evopalabhyata iti yacchabdena yo nirdiṣṭastasyopalabdhistadupalabdhistannāntarīyikām evopalabdhim āśrityeti bhinnakrama evakāraḥ | sā yathoktopalabdhir varṇṇeṣv apy asti (|) prayatnavyāpāropalabdhināntarīyakatvād eva varṇṇopalabdheḥ |

original: netyādi paraḥ | na caitadupalabdhyāśrayā | ekopalabdhināntarīyikā yāparasyopalabdhistadāśrayā kāryatāsthitiḥ (|) kintarhi (|) yatsaty eva bhavati | yasmin saty eva yad bhavati | iti evaṃ sattāśrayā kāryatāsthitiḥ | na ca varṇṇānāṃ karaṇebhyaḥ sattā bhavati kintūpalabdhir eveti manyate |

original: sā sattety ācāryaḥ | sattāśrayasyaiva kāryatā prajñaptirityasattyametat | kevalaṃ sā sattā kutaḥ pramāṇāt siddhā yeneyaṃ kāryatāṃ sādhayet | na hy asiddhāyāmasyāṃ sattāyāmevambhavati | satyevāsminnidaṃ bhavatītyevambhavati | tasmāt sattāsiddhistatsādhanī | tasyāḥ kāryatāyāḥ sādhanī | sā siddhirupalabdhir eva siddher jñānasvabhāvatvāt |

original: tataś ca yannāntarīyikaiva yatsattopalabdhistattasya kāryamityetāvat sthitaṃ (|) tac ca varṇṇeṣv api tulyam iti kathaṃ na varṇṇāḥ kāryāḥ |

original: sattyam ityādi paraḥ | sattyam evaṃ karaṇavyāpārād eva śabdopalabdhau tatkāryatā syāt | yadi tasya śabdasya tālvādivyāpārāt sattā na siddhā syāt | kin tu siddhaiva pramāṇena | tathā hi pūrvaṃ gośabdaṃ śrutavataḥ puṃsonyadā gośabdaśravaṇe sa evāyaṃ gośabda iti tattvagrāhiṇī pratyabhijñotpadyate | tattvagrahaṇam evānyathā na syāt |
analyzed: sattyam ityādi paraḥ sattyam evam karaṇa vyāpārāt eva śabda upalabdhau tad kārya tā syāt yadi tasya śabdasya tālu ādi vyāpārāt sattā na siddhā syāt kin tu siddhā eva pramāṇena tathā hi pūrvam go śabdam śrutavataḥ puṃsaḥ anyadā go śabda śravaṇe saḥ eva ayam go śabdaḥ iti tattva grāhiṇī pratyabhijñā utpadyate tattva grahaṇam eva anyathā na syāt

original: yadi pūrvottaraśravaṇakālayor antarāle śabdo na syādityarthāpattyā prākchabdasya sattā siddhaiva | na ca siddhipūrvikā siddhiḥ kāryatāsādhanī | kin tu sā hi sattāsiddhiḥ kāryatvaprajñapter nimittaṃ yā siddhipūrvikā | yathā ghaṭasya prāgasataḥ kulālādivyāpārād eva paścāt siddhiḥ |
analyzed: yadi pūrva uttara śravaṇa kālayoḥ antarāle śabdaḥ na syāt iti artha āpattyā prāk śabdasya sattā siddhā eva na ca siddhi pūrvikā siddhiḥ kāryatā sādhanī kin tu sā hi sattā siddhiḥ kārya tva prajñapteḥ nimittam yā siddhi pūrvikā yathā ghaṭasya prāk asataḥ kulāla ādi vyāpārāt eva paścāt siddhiḥ

original: nanvityādi siddhāntavādī | etat kathayati (|) na tāvat pratyabhijñā pramāṇam iti prātipādayiṣyate tatkathaṃ sattā siddhā | bhavatu nāma prākchabdasya sattā siddhā | tathāpi śabdasya tadrūpam asiddhaṃ| katarat tad rūpam ity āha – yat tathāvidhetyādi (p.493) |

original: siddham eva tacchabdasya yathoktaṃ rūpaṃ kevalamanyasya sahakāriṇo vaikalyācchrotravijñāne kāraṇatvena nopayuktam iti cet |

original: yadyevaṃ sahakārisannidhāne yā paścāt svajñāne upayuktā | yā prayatnāt prāganupayuktāvasthā | te parasparaviruddhe | kathamidānīmupayuktānupayuktayoravasthayor viruddhayor abhedaḥ (|) api tu bheda eva tataś ca nānātvāt sa tādṛśaḥ śabdasya svabhāvaḥ kṛta iti kārya eva śabdaḥ syāt |

original: athāpi syād (|) yosāvatiśayo bhavati na sa śabdasyātmabhūtopi tvarthāntaramiti pūrvakasvabhāvādapracyuta evāsāv ity āha –

original: nanu pūrvaṃ jananamātreṇa kārakaṃ jñānajananayogyatvenotpādakantu vyañjakam evety uktaṃ | tena tālvādīnāṃ vyañjakatvam eva yuktaṃ |
analyzed: nanu pūrvam janana mātreṇa kārakam jñāna janana yogya tvena utpādakan tu vyañjakam eva iti uktam tena tālu ādīnām vyañjaka tvam eva yuktam

original: naiṣa doṣo yataḥ (|) kāryamātramabhipretya jananamātreṇa kārakaṃ (|) jñānajananayogyatvena tu vyañjaka ity uktaṃ | na tu dṛśyakāryāpekṣayā | tathā hy avikalasahakārikāraṇasya puṃsaḥ pradīpādijanako niyamena pradīpāder upalambhakaḥ kārako na vyañjaka ity adoṣaḥ |
analyzed: na eṣa doṣaḥ yatas kārya mātram abhipretya janana mātreṇa kārakam jñāna janana yogya tvena tu vyañjakaḥ iti uktam na tu dṛśya kārya apekṣayā tathā hi avikala sahakāri kāraṇasya puṃsaḥ pradīpa ādi janakaḥ niyamena pradīpa ādeḥ upalambhakaḥ kārakaḥ na vyañjakaḥ iti adoṣaḥ

original: (p.501) atha punaḥ karaṇaṃ śabdasyākarttṛ | tasyākartuḥ karaṇasya vyāpāreṇa tatsiddhyayogāt | śabdasya siddhyayogāt | vyāpinaḥ śabdā nityāśca | tato vyāpinityatvācchabdānāṃ | vyañjakasya karaṇasya vyāpārāt sarvatropalabdhiḥ | ghaṭādayastu na vyāpino nāpi nityāḥ | tena te vyañjakavyāpāreṇa nāvaśyam upalabhyanta iti |
analyzed: atha punar karaṇam śabdasya akarttṛ tasya akartuḥ karaṇasya vyāpāreṇa tad siddhi ayogāt śabdasya siddhi ayogāt vyāpinaḥ śabdāḥ nityāḥ ca tatas vyāpi nitya tvāt śabdānām vyañjakasya karaṇasya vyāpārāt sarvatra upalabdhiḥ ghaṭa ādayaḥ tu na vyāpinaḥ na api nityāḥ tena te vyañjaka vyāpāreṇa na avaśyam upalabhyante iti

original: yady evaṃ ka idānīṃ ghaṭādiṣu samāśvāsaḥ | niścayaḥ yathā te na nityā nāpi vyāpina iti | yāvatā tepi nityā vyāpinaś ca bhavantu | kathaṃ sarvadā nopalabhyanta iti cet | etacchabdeṣv api tulyaṃ | yattatra pratividhānaṃ tad ghaṭādiṣv api bhaviṣyati | teṣāṃ ghaṭādīnāntathā vyāpinityatvenāniṣṭer iti cet |
analyzed: yadi evam kaḥ idānīm ghaṭa ādiṣu samāśvāsaḥ niścayaḥ yathā te na nityāḥ na api vyāpinaḥ iti yāvatā te api nityāḥ vyāpinaḥ ca bhavantu katham sarvadā na upalabhyante iti ced etat śabdeṣu api tulyam yat tatra pratividhānam tat ghaṭa ādiṣu api bhaviṣyati teṣām ghaṭa ādīnām tathā vyāpi nitya tvena aniṣṭeḥ iti ced

original: śabdo vyāpinityatvena kimiṣṭaḥ (|) kasmādiṣṭastatsamānadharmā | ghaṭādisamānadharmā | pratiṣiddhe ca vyāpinityatve prāgiti yatkiñcidetat |
analyzed: śabdaḥ vyāpi nitya tvena kim iṣṭaḥ kasmāt iṣṭaḥ tad samāna dharmā ghaṭa ādi samāna dharmā pratiṣiddhe ca vyāpi nitya tve prāk iti yat kiñcid etat

original: ghaṭādīnām ityādi paraḥ | kārakavyatirekeṇa vyañjakāntarasadbhāvādadoṣaḥ | śabdena tulyatvaprasaṅgadoṣo nāsti | vyañjakāntaram eva darśayannāha – prakāśo hītyādi | prakāśo hy eṣāṃ ghaṭādīnāṃ vyañjako loke siddho na kulālādayaḥ | kulālādīnāṃ vyañjakatve | te kulālādayastādṛśā eva syuḥ (|) yathā pradīpādayo na niyamena ghaṭamupalambhayanti |
analyzed: ghaṭa ādīnām ityādi paraḥ kāraka vyatirekeṇa vyañjaka antara sadbhāvāt adoṣaḥ śabdena tulya tva prasaṅga doṣaḥ na asti vyañjaka antaram eva darśayan āha prakāśaḥ hi ityādi prakāśaḥ hi eṣām ghaṭa ādīnām vyañjakaḥ loke siddhaḥ na kulāla ādayaḥ kulāla ādīnām vyañjaka tve te kulāla ādayaḥ tādṛśāḥ eva syuḥ yathā pradīpa ādayaḥ na niyamena ghaṭam upalambhayanti

original: kvacit prakāśepi ghaṭasyābhāvāt | tathā kulālādayopi bhaveyuḥ (|) na caivam (|) atiśerate ca kulālādayaḥ | kulālādivyāpāre sarvadā ghaṭāder bhāvāt | tato vyañjakātiśayāt | vyañjakād bhedena vṛtteḥ | kārakā eva kulālādayaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) upakārakasya gatyantarābhāvāt | kārakavyañjakatvavyatirekeṇa prakārāntarābhāvāt |
analyzed: kvacid prakāśe api ghaṭasya abhāvāt tathā kulāla ādayaḥ api bhaveyuḥ na ca evam atiśerate ca kulāla ādayaḥ kulāla ādi vyāpāre sarvadā ghaṭa ādeḥ bhāvāt tatas vyañjaka atiśayāt vyañjakāt bhedena vṛtteḥ kārakāḥ eva kulāla ādayaḥ kim kāraṇam upakārakasya gati antara abhāvāt kāraka vyañjaka tva vyatirekeṇa prakāra antara abhāvāt

original: tatra vyañjakatve niṣiddhe pāriśeṣyāt kārakatvaṃ kulālādīnāṃ (|) naivaṃ śabdasya karaṇamuktvānyad vyañjakāntaraṃ siddhaṃ yena karaṇam eva śabdasya kārakaṃ kalpyeta | tasmād ghaṭādivailakṣaṇyācchabdo vyaṅgya eva |
analyzed: tatra vyañjaka tve niṣiddhe pāriśeṣyāt kāraka tvam kulāla ādīnām na evam śabdasya karaṇam uktvā anyat vyañjaka antaram siddham yena karaṇam eva śabdasya kārakam kalpyeta tasmāt ghaṭa ādi vailakṣaṇyāt śabdaḥ vyaṅgyaḥ eva

original: tad ityādi siddhāntavādī | tadetad vyañjakāntarasambhavanaṃ śabdepi tulyaṃ | (p.502) yasmāt tatrāpi śabde indriyayogyadeśatādibhyaḥ śrotrendriyācchrotrayogyadeśāvasthānāt | ādiśabdāt manaskārāc ca | karaṇānām atiśayāt | atiśaya eva katham iti ced āha – ghaṭādītyādi | hy arthe caśabdaḥ |
analyzed: tat ityādi siddhāntavādī tat etat vyañjaka antara sambhavanam śabde api tulyam yasmāt tatra api śabde indriya yogya deśatā ādibhyaḥ śrotra indriyāt śrotra yogya deśa avasthānāt ādi śabdāt manaskārāt ca karaṇānām atiśayāt atiśayaḥ eva katham iti ced āha ghaṭa ādi ityādi hi arthe caśabdaḥ

original: ghaṭāder ye kārakāḥ kulālādayaḥ samagrāsteṣāṃ yo dharmo niyamena svakāryārambhakatvantasya karaṇeṣu dṛṣṭe | tāny api hi vyāpṛtāni śabdaṃ niyamena janayanti | tasmāt tāny api kulālādivat kārakāṇy eva |
analyzed: ghaṭa ādeḥ ye kārakāḥ kulāla ādayaḥ samagrāḥ teṣām yaḥ dharmaḥ niyamena sva kārya ārambhaka tva ntasya karaṇeṣu dṛṣṭe tāni api hi vyāpṛtāni śabdam niyamena janayanti tasmāt tāni api kulāla ādi vat kārakāṇi eva

original: yadi ca śabdasya vyañjakāntarābhāvāt karaṇāni vyañjakānīṣyante | tadā tasyaiva vyañjakasya pradīpāderviṣayāntarasta ca kasyacid iti rasādervyañjakāntarampradīpādir nāsti | tato vyañjakāntārābhāvāt | tatkāraṇāni pradīpādikāraṇāni caiṣāṃ pradīpādīnāṃ vyañjakāni syuḥ |
analyzed: yadi ca śabdasya vyañjaka antara abhāvāt karaṇāni vyañjakāni iṣyante tadā tasya eva vyañjakasya pradīpa ādeḥ viṣaya antaraḥ ca kasyacid iti rasa ādeḥ vyañjaka antaram pradīpa ādiḥ na asti tatas vyañjaka antāra abhāvāt tad kāraṇāni pradīpa ādi kāraṇāni ca eṣām pradīpa ādīnām vyañjakāni syuḥ

original: yata evantasmānna vyaktiḥ śabdasya karaṇebhyaḥ kintūtpattir eva | bhavantī vā karaṇebhyaḥ sakāśād vyaktistridhā bhavet | (1) pūrvāvasthātyāgenātiśayavattāvā śabdasya vyaktir bhavet | (2) upalambhāvaraṇavigamo vā (3) śabdālambanaṃ (vi)jñānam vā vyaktiḥ | prakāratrayavyatirekeṇa gatyantarābhāvāt |
analyzed: yatas evam tasmāt na vyaktiḥ śabdasya karaṇebhyaḥ kintu utpattiḥ eva bhavantī vā karaṇebhyaḥ sakāśāt vyaktiḥ tridhā bhavet pūrva avasthā tyāgena atiśayavat tāvā śabdasya vyaktiḥ bhavet 2 upalambha āvaraṇa vigamaḥ vā śabda ālambanam vijñānam vā vyaktiḥ prakāra traya vyatirekeṇa gati antara abhāvāt

original: (1) tatra nātiśayotpattiḥ śabdasya vyaktiranityatāprasaṅgāt | bhavatv atiśayotpattiranityatvantu katham iti ced āha – tasyā atiśayotpatteḥ pūrvarūpasya yā hāniraparasya pāścātyasya rūpasya ya(d) upajananaṃ tallakṣaṇatvāt |
analyzed: tatra na atiśaya utpattiḥ śabdasya vyaktiḥ anitya tā prasaṅgāt bhavatu atiśaya utpattiḥ anitya tvam tu katham iti ced āha tasyāḥ atiśaya utpatteḥ pūrva rūpasya yā hāniḥ aparasya pāścātyasya rūpasya yat upajananam tad lakṣaṇa tvāt

original: (2) dvitīyapakṣam āha – athetyādi | tasya śabdasya yajjanakaṃ rūpantasyopalambhapratighātīni stimitavāyavīyāvayavasaṃyogarūpāṇyāvaraṇāni (|) teṣāṃ vigamaḥ prayatnapreritena vāyunā viyogaḥ | sa yadi śabdasya vyaktiste tava mīmāṃsakasya matā | taduktaṃ |
analyzed: dvitīya pakṣam āha atha ityādi tasya śabdasya yat janakam rūpam tasya upalambha pratighātīni stimita vāyavīya avayava saṃyoga rūpāṇi āvaraṇāni teṣām vigamaḥ prayatna preritena vāyunā viyogaḥ sa yadi śabdasya vyaktiḥ te tava mīmāṃsakasya matā tat uktam

original: ''prayatnābhihato vāyuḥ koṣṭhyo yātītyasaṃśayaṃ |
analyzed: prayatna abhihataḥ vāyuḥ koṣṭhyaḥ yāti iti asaṃśayam

original: sa saṃyogavibhāgau ca tālvāsder anuvarttate ||
analyzed: sa saṃyoga vibhāgau ca tālu āsdeḥ anuvarttate

original: vegavatvāc ca sovaśyaṃ yāvadvegaṃ pratiṣṭhate |
analyzed: vegava tvāt ca sā uvaśyam yāvadvegam pratiṣṭhate

original: tasyātmāvayavānāñ ca stimitena ca vāyunā |
analyzed: tasya ātma avayavānām ca stimitena ca vāyunā

original: saṃyogāś ca viyogāś ca jāyante gamanād ghruvam'' iti || (Ślo. śabda 122-24)
analyzed: saṃyogāḥ ca viyogāḥ ca jāyante gamanāt ghruvam iti

original: (p.503) sā vyaktiḥ kathaṃ kriyate | yasmādāvaraṇavigamo 'bhāvastaspinnabhāve kathaṃcid apyakārye karaṇagrāmasya karaṇasaṅghātasya sāmarthyaṃ kin na tad bhavet (|) naiveti yāvat |
analyzed: sā vyaktiḥ katham kriyate yasmāt āvaraṇa vigamaḥ bhāvaḥ kathaṃcid api akārye karaṇa grāmasya karaṇa saṅghātasya sāmarthyam kim na tat bhavet na eva iti yāvat

original: na hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | etad āha (|) āvaraṇasvarūpe niṣpanne 'kiṃcitkarāṇy eva karaṇāni na hi samarthāni bhavanti | āvaraṇavigamepi na teṣāṃ sāmarthyaṃ | yasmād vigamaścābhāvo na cābhāvaḥ kārya iti niveditametat sāmarthyacintāyāṃ |
analyzed: na hi ityādinā vyācaṣṭe etat āha āvaraṇa svarūpe niṣpanne kiṃcitkarāṇi eva karaṇāni na hi samarthāni bhavanti āvaraṇa vigame pi na teṣām sāmarthyam yasmāt vigamaḥ ca abhāvaḥ na ca abhāvaḥ kāryaḥ iti niveditam etat sāmarthya cintāyām

original: abhyupagamya caitaduktaṃ | tad eva nāstīty āha – nāpītyādi | na śabdasya nityasyānādheyātiśayatvāt kiñcidāvaraṇam asti yenāvaraṇavigamo vyaktiḥ syāt | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tasyāvaraṇasya nityavastunyasāmarthyād ity apy uktaṃ |
analyzed: abhyupagamya ca etat uktam tat eva na asti iti āha nā api ityādi na śabdasya nityasya anādheya atiśaya tvāt kiñcid āvaraṇam asti yena āvaraṇa vigamaḥ vyaktiḥ syāt kim kāraṇam tasya āvaraṇasya nitya vastuni asāmarthyāt iti api uktam

original: yata evantasmānnāvaraṇe karaṇānāmupakṣepaḥ | karaṇānyāvaraṇavigamaṃ śabdasya kurvantītyetannopanyasanīyam ity arthaḥ |
analyzed: yatas evam tasmāt na āvaraṇe karaṇānām upakṣepaḥ karaṇāni āvaraṇa vigamam śabdasya kurvanti iti etat na upanyasanīyam iti arthaḥ

original: nāpy evaṃ kāraṇānāṃ śabdaṃpratyasāmarthyam eva | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tadvyāpārābhāve karaṇānāṃ vyāpārābhāve śabdānupalabdheḥ (|) ato yuktam ete karaṇavyāpārā yacchabdān kuryuḥ (|)
analyzed: nā api evam kāraṇānām śabdam prati asāmarthyam eva kim kāraṇam tad vyāpāra abhāve karaṇānām vyāpāra abhāve śabda anupalabdheḥ atas yuktam ete karaṇa vyāpārāḥ yat śabdān kuryuḥ

original: anyathā yadi karaṇāni na kārakāṇi kintu vyañjakāny eva | tadā śabdāviśeṣādanyeṣām api ghaṭādīnāṃ vyaktiḥ kulālādibhyaḥ prasajyate |
analyzed: anyathā yadi karaṇāni na kārakāṇi kintu vyañjakāni eva tadā śabda aviśeṣāt anyeṣām api ghaṭa ādīnām vyaktiḥ kulāla ādibhyaḥ prasajyate

original: atha punas tepi ghaṭādayo vyajyanta eva kulālādibhir itīṣyate | tadā tathābhyupagame sarvakāraṇānānnirarthatā |
analyzed: atha punar te pi ghaṭa ādayaḥ vyajyante eva kulāla ādibhiḥ iti iṣyate tadā tathā abhyupagame sarva kāraṇa ānāt nirartha tā

original: tathā hi (|) vyaṅgye vastunyatiśayasya kārako vāvaraṇābhāvasya kārako vā jñānasya vā kārako vyañjakaḥ syāt | atiśayāder vyaktisvarūpasya cākāryatvāt | sarveṣāṃ vyaktikārakāṇāṃ svarūpakārakāṇāṃ ca nirarthatā |
analyzed: tathā hi vyaṅgye vastuni atiśayasya kārakaḥ vā āvaraṇa abhāvasya kārakaḥ vā jñānasya vā kārakaḥ vyañjakaḥ syāt atiśaya ādeḥ vyakti svarūpasya ca akārya tvāt sarveṣām vyakti kārakāṇām svarūpa kārakāṇām ca nirartha tā

original: yadītyādinā vyākhyānaṃ | yadi śabdasya karaṇāni vyañjakāni kīdṛśāni (p.504) (|) sarvakāraṇasamānadharmāṇy api sarve kāraṇānāṃ samānā dharmā yeṣāṃ karaṇānām iti vigrahaḥ | tadā na kiñcid ghaṭādikam apīdānīṃ kasyacit kulālādeḥ kāryaṃ syācchabdenāviśeṣāt | sarvasya vyaṅgyatvam iṣṭam iti cet (|) na caitad yuktaṃ |
analyzed: yadi ityādinā vyākhyānam yadi śabdasya karaṇāni vyañjakāni kīdṛśāni sarva kāraṇa samāna dharmāṇi api sarve kāraṇānām samānāḥ dharmāḥ yeṣām karaṇānām iti vigrahaḥ tadā na kiñcid ghaṭa ādikam api idānīm kasyacid kulāla ādeḥ kāryam syāt śabdena aviśeṣāt sarvasya vyaṅgya tvam iṣṭam iti ced na ca etat yuktam

original: kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) sarvakārakāṇāṃ vyañjakatvenābhimatānāmānarthakyaprasaṅgāt | tathāhi vyañjakānāṃ trayo vikalpāḥ | vyaṅgye vastunyatiśayasya vāvaraṇābhāvasya vā jñānasya vā karaṇād vyañjakaḥ syād iti |
analyzed: kim kāraṇam sarva kārakāṇām vyañjaka tvena abhimatānām ānarthakya prasaṅgāt tathā hi vyañjakānām trayaḥ vikalpāḥ vyaṅgye vastuni atiśayasya vā āvaraṇa abhāvasya vā jñānasya vā karaṇāt vyañjakaḥ syāt iti

original: na tāvad vyaṅgyasyātiśayakaraṇād vyañjakaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) vastunovasthitarūpasyānādheyātiśayatvāt | nāpyāvaraṇavigamakaraṇāt | āvaraṇābhāvasyākāryatvāt | nāpi jñānakaraṇād vyañjakaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ | vastuvad eva tadviṣayasyāpi jñānasya satkāryavādidarśane siddhatvāt | athāsadeva jñānaṃ kriyate | tadā jñānaṃprati kārakatve kasyacidiṣyamāṇe |
analyzed: na tāvat vyaṅgyasya atiśaya karaṇāt vyañjakaḥ kim kāraṇam vastunaḥ uvasthita rūpasya anādheya atiśaya tvāt na api āvaraṇa vigama karaṇāt āvaraṇa abhāvasya akārya tvāt na api jñāna karaṇāt vyañjakaḥ kim kāraṇam vastu vat eva tad viṣayasya api jñānasya satkārya vādi darśane siddha tvāt atha asat eva jñānam kriyate tadā jñānam prati kāraka tve kasyacid iṣyamāṇe

original: tathābhūtānāṃ jñānasya kārakaistulyadharmāṇāmanyeṣām api kulālādīnāntathābhāvaprasaṅgena | ghaṭādīn prati kārakatvaprasaṅgena sarvasya vastunaḥ kāryatāprasaṅgāt | viśeṣo vā vācyo yena jñānaṃ prati kārakatvaṃ na ghaṭādīn prati | na cānyo vyakteḥ prakāraḥ sambhavati |
analyzed: tathābhūtānām jñānasya kārakaiḥ tulya dharmāṇām anyeṣām api kulāla ādīnām tathābhāva prasaṅgena ghaṭa ādīn prati kāraka tva prasaṅgena sarvasya vastunaḥ kāryatā prasaṅgāt viśeṣaḥ vā vācyaḥ yena jñānam prati kāraka tvam na ghaṭa ādīn prati na ca anyaḥ vyakteḥ prakāraḥ sambhavati

original: tasmād ayaṃ kārakābhimatorthakalāpo ghaṭādeḥ kasyacid api na vyaktāv upayujyate | vastuno nādheyaviśeṣatvādinā vyakterniṣiddhatvāt | nāpi kriyāyām upayujyate | kāryakatvānabhyupagamād iti vyartha eva syāt |
analyzed: tasmāt ayam kāraka abhimata ūrtha kalāpaḥ ghaṭa ādeḥ kasyacid api na vyaktau upayujyate vastunaḥ na ādheya viśeṣa tva ādinā vyakteḥ niṣiddha tvāt nā api kriyāyām upayujyate kāryakatva anabhyupagamāt iti vyarthaḥ eva syāt

original: tathā ceti kārakāṇāṃ vaikalye sati | idaṃ jagannirīhaṃ nirvyāpāraṃ syāt | kiṃ bhūtam (|) anupakāryopakārakaṃ | na vidyate upakāryamupakārakaṃ ca yasminn iti vigrahaḥ |
analyzed: tathā ca iti kārakāṇām vaikalye sati idam jagat nirīham nirvyāpāram syāt kim bhūtam anupakārya upakārakam na vidyate upakāryam upakārakam ca yasmin iti vigrahaḥ

original: tadānupūrvī buddhyanupūrvī vākyaṃ | sā ca nārthāntaraṃ buddhibhya iti tasyā ānupūrvyā apauruṣeyasvaprasādhane | buddherevāpauruṣeyatvaṃ sādhitaṃ syāt | tatra ca samayaḥ siddhāntosya mīmāṃsakasya bādhyate | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) buddhīnāṃ svasiddhānte puruṣaguṇatvenābhyupagamāt |
analyzed: tad ānupūrvī buddhi anupūrvī vākyam sā ca na artha antaram buddhibhyaḥ iti tasyāḥ ānupūrvyāḥ apauruṣeya sva prasādhane buddheḥ eva apauruṣeya tvam sādhitam syāt tatra ca samayaḥ siddhāntaḥ asya mīmāṃsakasya bādhyate kim kāraṇam buddhīnām sva siddhānte puruṣa guṇa tvena abhyupagamāt

original: pratyakṣabādhāndarśayannāha – pratyakṣaṃ khalv apy etad yadi tā buddhayo manaskārādibhyo bhavantīti | ādigrahaṇādindriyaparigrahaḥ | kīdṛśebhyo manaskārādibhyaḥ (p.509) puruṣa iti vyavahāralāghavārthaṃ kṛtasaṃketebhyaḥ | etatsvamatenoktaṃ | puruṣaguṇebhyo veti vyatikramya puruṣasya guṇebhyaḥ | etat tu paramatenoktaṃ |
analyzed: pratyakṣa bādhān darśayan āha pratyakṣam khalu api etat yadi tāḥ buddhayaḥ manaskāra ādibhyaḥ bhavanti iti ādi grahaṇāt indriya parigrahaḥ kīdṛśebhyaḥ manaskāra ādibhyaḥ puruṣaḥ iti vyavahāra lāghava artham kṛta saṃketebhyaḥ etat sva matena uktam puruṣa guṇebhyaḥ vā iti vyatikramya puruṣasya guṇebhyaḥ etat tu para matena uktam

original: tasmāt manaskārādibhya utpadyamānāyā buddheḥ kāryatvaṃ pratyakṣasiddhamiti tasyā apauruṣeyatve sādhye pratyakṣabādhā |
analyzed: tasmāt manaskāra ādibhyaḥ utpadyamānāyāḥ buddheḥ kārya tvam pratyakṣa siddham iti tasyāḥ apauruṣeya tve sādhye pratyakṣa bādhā

original: syānmataṃ (|) kāryatāyā apratyakṣatvān na pratyakṣabādheti ced āha – nanv ityādi | kāraṇābhimatasya bhāva eva bhāvaḥ tadabhāve cābhāva ity etau bhāvābhāvaviśeṣau | tābhyāṃ nānyā kāryatā bhāvasya (|) sa yathokto bhāvaḥ pratyakṣasiddhaḥ | tadabhāve tvabhāvaḥ kathaṃ pratyakṣasiddha iti ced āha – abhāvopi |
analyzed: syāt matam kāryatāyāḥ apratyakṣa tvāt na pratyakṣa bādhā iti ced āha nanu ityādi kāraṇa abhimatasya bhāvaḥ eva bhāvaḥ tad abhāve ca abhāvaḥ iti etau bhāva abhāva viśeṣau tābhyām na anyā kāryatā bhāvasya sa yathā uktaḥ bhāvaḥ pratyakṣa siddhaḥ tad abhāve tu abhāvaḥ katham pratyakṣa siddhaḥ iti ced āha abhāvaḥ api

original: anupalabdhir eva lakṣaṇaṃ svabhāvo yasyābhāvasyeti vigrahaḥ sopi pratyakṣasāmarthyasiddhaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ | tadanyaviviktarūpambhāvam eva pratipādayata pratyakṣaṃ sāmarthyādabhāvaṃ gamayatīti sāmarthyagrahaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ | yataś ca manaskārādibhāvābhāvābhyāṃ buddhibhāvābhāvau | tata eva tadbhāvabhāvitvāt puruṣakāryatā buddhīnām anumeyā |
analyzed: anupalabdhiḥ eva lakṣaṇam svabhāvaḥ yasya abhāvasya iti vigrahaḥ saḥ api pratyakṣa sāmarthya siddham vakṣyāmaḥ tad anya vivikta rūpam bhāvam eva pratipādayata pratyakṣam sāmarthyāt abhāvam gamayati iti sāmarthya grahaṇam kṛtam yatas ca manaskāra ādi bhāva abhāvābhyām buddhi bhāva abhāvau tatas eva tad bhāva bhāvi tvāt puruṣa kārya tā buddhīnām anumeyā

original: kiṃ kāraṇam (|) anvayavyatirekaliṅgatvādasyāḥ kāryatāyāḥ | tadanenanumānabādhoktā |
analyzed: kim kāraṇam anvaya vyatireka liṅga tvāt asyāḥ kārya tāyāḥ tat anena anumāna bādhā uktā

original: atha syān na vyaktikramo vākyaṃ | kin tu varṇṇānupūrvī vākyam ity ata āha – kiṃ cetyādi | varṇṇebhyaḥ sakāśādānupūrvyā bhedaḥ sphoṭeneti pūrvoktena sphoṭavicāreṇa | abhinnāpi prāg eva niṣiddhā (|) bhedābhedaṃ ca muktvā vastuno nānyā gatir asti | tadā ca vyāpināmvarṇṇānāmānupūrvī kalpanāropitā syāt | kathaṃ vā tadānīmapuruṣāśrayā |
analyzed: atha syāt na vyakti kramaḥ vākyam kin tu varṇṇa ānupūrvī vākyam iti atas āha kim ca ityādi varṇṇebhyaḥ sakāśāt ānupūrvyā bhedaḥ sphoṭena iti pūrva uktena sphoṭa vicāreṇa abhinnā api prāk eva niṣiddhā bheda abhedam ca muktvā vastunaḥ nā anyā gatiḥ asti tadā ca vyāpinām varṇṇānām ānupūrvī kalpanā āropitā syāt katham vā tadānīm apuruṣa āśrayā

original: puruṣāśrayaiva syāt |
analyzed: puruṣa āśrayā eva syāt

original: varṇṇetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | varṇṇebhyaḥ sakāśād vyatirekiṇī bhinnasvabhāvānupūrvī | pūrvoktena sphoṭavicārānukrameṇaiva prativihitā |
analyzed: varṇṇa ityādinā vyācaṣṭe varṇṇebhyaḥ sakāśāt vyatirekiṇī bhinna svabhāva ānupūrvī pūrva uktena sphoṭa vicāra anukrameṇa eva prativihitā

original: vākyanna bhinnamvarṇebhyo vidyatenupalambhanād (|) ityādinā dūṣaṇenānupūrvy api pratikṣiptā |
analyzed: vākyam na bhinnam varṇebhyaḥ vidyate na upalambhanāt ityādinā dūṣaṇena ānupūrvī api pratikṣiptā

original: nāpi sā varṇasvabhāvā | sarorasa iti pratipattibhedabhāvaprasaṅgāt | na cāpi sā tattvānyattvābhyāmavācyā | vastusvabhāvasyaitadvikalpānatikramāt | tattvānyattvavikalpānatikramāt (p.510) | tasmādatadrūpeṣu vastubhūtabhinnānupūrvīrahiteṣu varṇṇeṣu tadrūpasamāropapratibhāsinyā ānupūrvīsamāropapratibhāsinyā buddherayamvibhramaḥ syādānupūrvīti |
analyzed: nā api sā varṇa svabhāvā saraḥ rasaḥ iti pratipatti bheda bhāva prasaṅgāt na ca api sā tattva anyattvābhyām avācyā vastu svabhāvasya etad vikalpa anatikramāt tattva anyattva vikalpa anatikramāt tasmāt a tadrūpeṣu vastu bhūta bhinna ānupūrvī rahiteṣu varṇṇeṣu tad rūpa samāropa pratibhāsinyāḥ ānupūrvī samāropa pratibhāsinyāḥ buddheḥ ayam vibhramaḥ syāt ānupūrvī iti

original: sā cānupūrvī kathamapauruṣeyī pauruṣeyyeva | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) buddherviṭhaṃ (?) panena vyāpāreṇa pratyupasthāpanāt | sandarśitatvāt |
analyzed: sā ca ānupūrvī katham apauruṣeyī pauruṣeyya eva kim kāraṇam buddheḥ viṭham vyāpāreṇa pratyupasthāpanāt sandarśita tvāt

original: api cātyantikasya nityasya kasyacitsvabhāvasyābhāvāt | bhavatā vidyamānena dhvaninā śabdenāvaśyamanātyantikenāsthireṇa bhavitavyaṃ | sa ca dhvanirahetukaḥ syāt | puruṣavyatirekeṇānyo heturasyetyanyahetuko vā | tatrāhetukatve nityambhavet | anyānapekṣaṇāt | anyahetukatve tu na ca puruṣavyāpārād bhavet | bhavati ca puruṣavyāpārāt |
analyzed: api ca ātyantikasya nityasya kasyacid svabhāvasya abhāvāt bhavatā vidyamānena dhvaninā śabdena avaśyam anātyantikena asthireṇa bhavitavyam sa ca dhvaniḥ ahetukaḥ syāt puruṣa vyatirekeṇa anyaḥ hetuḥ asya iti anya hetukaḥ vā tatra ahetuka tve nityam bhavet anya anapekṣaṇāt anya hetuka tve tu na ca puruṣa vyāpārāt bhavet bhavati ca puruṣa vyāpārāt

original: tasmāt pauruṣeya iti gamyate |
analyzed: tasmāt pauruṣeyaḥ iti gamyate

original: katham ityādi paraḥ | anātyantiko dhvaniranyo vā pṛthivyādikābhāva iti kathamidaṃ gamyate |
analyzed: katham ityādi paraḥ anātyantikaḥ dhvaniḥ anyaḥ vā pṛthivī ādika abhāvaḥ iti katham idam gamyate

original: sattetyācāryaḥ | nāśasya sattāmātrānubandhitvāt | kāraṇādanityatā dhvaneḥ | sannityeva kṛtvā nāso bhavati na kāraṇāntaram apekṣate | saṃśca śabdaḥ | tasmānna nitya iti samudāyārthaḥ |
analyzed: sattā iti ācāryaḥ nāśasya sattā mātra anubandhi tvāt kāraṇāt anitya tā dhvaneḥ san iti eva kṛtvā nāsaḥ bhavati na kāraṇa antaram apekṣate san ca śabdaḥ tasmāt na nityaḥ iti samudāya arthaḥ

original: kasmāt sattāmātrānubandhī vināśa ity āha – na hītyādi | yasmānna bhāvānāṃ nāśo nāma dharmāntaraṃ kutaścinnāśakāraṇād bhavati |
analyzed: kasmāt sattā mātra anubandhī vināśaḥ iti āha na hi ityādi yasmāt na bhāvānām nāśaḥ nāma dharma antaram kutaścid nāśa kāraṇāt bhavati

original: yata evaṃ (|) tad iti tasmād bhāvasvabhāva eva nāśo bhavet | kuta etad (|) bhāvasyaiva svahetubhyaḥ sakāśāt taddharmaṇo vināśadharmaṇo bhāvād utpatteḥ | ekakṣaṇasthitidharmakatvam eva vināśaḥ (|) tac ca hetubhya evotpadyata iti yāvat |
analyzed: yatas evam tat iti tasmāt bhāva svabhāvaḥ eva nāśaḥ bhavet kutas etat bhāvasya eva sva hetubhyaḥ sakāśāt tad dharmaṇaḥ vināśa dharmaṇaḥ bhāvāt utpatteḥ eka kṣaṇa sthiti dharmaka tvam eva vināśaḥ tat ca hetubhyaḥ evā utpadyate iti yāvat

original: (p.511) kṛtakānām eva satāṃ vināśo nānyeṣāṃ satāṃ | taduktaṃ (|) ''sadakāraṇa vannityam'' iti (|)
analyzed: kṛtakānām eva satām vināśaḥ na anyeṣām satām tat uktam sat akāraṇa vat nityam iti

original: na cetyādi | na ca bhāvaviśeṣasya kasyacitsvabhāvo vināśaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tasyottaratra niṣetsyamānatvāt | tasmād bhāvamātrasvabhāvaḥ syād vināśaḥ | sattāmātrasvabhāvaḥ syāt | tena kāraṇena śabdonyo vā sarva eva bhāvaḥ sattābhājanaḥ sattādhāraḥ sanniti yāvat | anātyantika iti siddhaṃ |
analyzed: na ca ityādi na ca bhāva viśeṣasya kasyacid svabhāvaḥ vināśaḥ kim kāraṇam tasya uttaratra niṣetsyamāna tvāt tasmāt bhāva mātra svabhāvaḥ syāt vināśaḥ sattā mātra svabhāvaḥ syāt tena kāraṇena śabdaḥ anyaḥ vā sarvaḥ eva bhāvaḥ sattā bhājanaḥ sattā ādhāraḥ san iti yāvat anātyantikaḥ iti siddham

original: na siddham iti paraḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tasyaiva vināśasyāparajanmāsiddheḥ | parasmāj janma parajanma | na parajanmāparajanma | tasyāsiddheḥ | vināśasyāhetukatvāsiddher iti yāvat |
analyzed: na siddham iti paraḥ kim kāraṇam tasya eva vināśasya apara janma asiddheḥ parasmāt janma para janma na para janma apara janma tasya asiddheḥ vināśasya ahetuka tva asiddheḥ iti yāvat

original: tathā hy agninā kāṣṭhaṃ dagdhaṃ | daṇḍena ghaṭo bhagna iti vināśahetavo 'gnyādayaḥ kāṣṭhādīnāmbhāvānāndṛśyante | tathā hyagnyādibhāve kāṣṭādīnāṃ nāśastadabhāve cānāśa ityanvayavyatirekānuvidhānaṃ nāśasyāsti | etac ca hetutadvatorhetumatorlakṣaṇam āhuḥ | taduktaṃ |
analyzed: tathā hi agninā kāṣṭham dagdham daṇḍena ghaṭaḥ bhagnaḥ iti vināśa hetavaḥ gni ādayaḥ kāṣṭha ādīnām bhāvānām dṛśyante tathā hi agni ādi bhāve kāṣṭa ādīnām nāśaḥ tad abhāve ca anāśaḥ iti anvaya vyatireka anuvidhānam nāśasya asti etat ca hetu tadvatoḥ hetumatoḥ lakṣaṇam āhuḥ tat uktam

original: ''abhighātāgnisaṃyoganāśapratyayasannidhiṃ |

original: vinā, saṃsargitāṃ yāti vināśo na ghaṭādibhir'' iti (|)2
analyzed: vinā saṃsargi tām yāti vināśaḥ na ghaṭa ādibhiḥ iti

original: netyādinā pratiṣedhati | nāgnyādayaḥ kāṣṭhādervinā karaṇālloke vināśahetavaḥ pratīyante | kin tu pūrvapūrvasya kāṣṭhādikṣaṇasya svarasanirodhe svayam eva nirodhe sati | anyasyottarasya kṣaṇasya nikṛtasya bhasmādirūpasyotpatter agnyādayaḥ kāṣṭhādīnāṃ vināśahetavaḥ prajñāyante na tu vināśasya karaṇāt |
analyzed: na ityādinā pratiṣedhati na agni ādayaḥ kāṣṭha ādeḥ vinā karaṇāt loke vināśa hetavaḥ pratīyante kin tu pūrva pūrvasya kāṣṭha ādi kṣaṇasya sva rasa nirodhe svayam eva nirodhe sati anyasya uttarasya kṣaṇasya nikṛtasya bhasma ādi rūpasya utpatteḥ agni ādayaḥ kāṣṭha ādīnām vināśa hetavaḥ prajñāyante na tu vināśasya karaṇāt

original: kutaḥ punastasya vikṛtasyotpattir ity āha – viśiṣṭetyādi | viśiṣṭaḥ pratyayo 'gnyādiḥ sahakārī tadāśrayeṇa |
analyzed: kutas punar tasya vikṛtasya utpattiḥ iti āha viśiṣṭa ityādi viśiṣṭaḥ pratyayaḥ gni ādiḥ sahakārī tad āśrayeṇa

original: abhyupagamyāpi brūmaḥ (|) astu vāgniḥ kāṣṭhavināśahetuḥ (|) sa nāśognijanmā | (p. 512) agner janma  yasyeti vigrahaḥ | kiṃ kāṣṭham vāhosvitkāṣṭhādarthāntarantatrāgner vināśakam (|)
analyzed: abhyupagamya api brūmaḥ astu vā agniḥ kāṣṭha vināśa hetuḥ sa nāśaḥ ugni janmā agneḥ janma yasya iti vigrahaḥ kim kāṣṭham vā āhosvit kāṣṭhāt artha antaram tatra agneḥ vināśakam

original: hetos sakāśānnāśasyārthāntarasyotpattau bhavet kāṣṭhasya darśanaṃ | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) avināśāt | kāṣṭhasya kim ity arthāntarāt kāṣṭhādarthantarasya nāśasyotpattau janmani sati kāṣṭamabhūtaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ nāma | vaivābhūtam iti yāvat |

original: yadi nāmāvinaṣṭantathāpy arthāntarotpatyā tasya darśanam iti ced āha – na dṛśyate veti (|) kim iti na dṛśyate | dṛśyata eva | yadi tv arthāntarotpatyārthāntaraṃ vinaṣṭaṃ na dṛśyate vā | tadātiprasaṅgo hy evaṃ syāt | arthāntarasya yasya kasyacid uttpatyā sarvam abhūtaṃ syāt | na vā dṛśyata | sa eva padārthognijanmā | na sarvaḥ |
analyzed: yadi nāma a vinaṣṭan tathā api artha antara utpatyā tasya darśanam iti ced āha na dṛśyate vā iti kim iti na dṛśyate dṛśyate eva yadi tu artha antara utpatya artha antaram vinaṣṭam na dṛśyate vā tadā atiprasaṅgaḥ hi evam syāt artha antarasya yasya kasyacid uttpatyā sarvam abhūtam syāt na vā dṛśyata saḥ eva padārthaḥ ugni janmā na sarvaḥ

original: asyakāṣṭhasya vināśo loke vināśarūpatayā pratīter iti yāvat |
analyzed: vināśaḥ loke vināśa rūpa tayā pratīteḥ iti yāvat

original: etad eva grahaṇakavākyaṃ yadītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | yadi sa evāgnijanmā kāṣṭhasyābhāvo vināśaḥ | tad iti  tasmād idaṃ kāṣṭhamabhūtatvād vināṣṭatvānnadṛśyata iti |
analyzed: etat eva grahaṇaka vākyam yadi ityādinā vyācaṣṭe yadi saḥ eva agni janmā kāṣṭhasya abhāvaḥ vināśaḥ tat iti tasmāt idam kāṣṭham abhūta tvāt vinā aṣṭa tvāt na dṛśyate iti

original: bhavatvityādinā pratiṣadhati | bhavatu tasyāgnijanmanorthasyedannāma saṃjñā yad idam abhāva iti | tathāpi nāmamātreṇa katham anyānyasya vināśaḥ | na hi kasyacid arthasyāgnijanmano vināśa iti nāmakaraṇamātrena kāṣṭhaṃ na dṛśyata iti yuktaṃ |
analyzed: bhavatu ityādinā pratiṣadhati bhavatu tasya agni janmanaḥ ṛthasya idam nāma saṃjñā yat idam abhāvaḥ iti tathā api nāma mātreṇa katham anya anyasya vināśaḥ na hi kasyacid arthasya agni janmanaḥ vināśaḥ iti nāma karaṇa mātrena kāṣṭham na dṛśyate iti yuktam

original: nanu likapratītatvād vināśa evāsau na tasya vināśa iti nāmakaranamātram ity ata āha –
analyzed: nanu lika pratīta tvāt vināśaḥ eva asau na tasya vināśaḥ iti nāma karana mātram iti atas āha

original: na cānyaḥ padārtho 'nyasya vināśo 'tiprasaṅgāt | sarve padārthāḥ kāṣṭhasya vināśaḥ syād (|) etac cānantaroktam eva smarayati |

original: (p. 513) evam manyate | yathā sarvapadārthānām arthāntaratvāt na kāṣṭhavināśarūpatayā pratītis tathā 'gnikṛtasyāpy arthāntaratvānna kāṣṭhavināśarūpatayā pratītiḥ syāt |

original: syād etad (|) yadyarthāntaratvād agnikṛtasyārthasya na vināśarūpatā | dhūmasyāpi tarhy agnikāryatā na syād arthāntaratvād ghaṭavat | bhavati ca tad arthāntaratvāviśeṣepyagnikṛtasya kāṣṭhavināśarūpatā bhaviṣyatīti (|)

original: ata āha – aviśeṣāt | tasyāgnikṛtasya vastubhūtasya kāṣṭhādarthāntaratvena tadanyebhyo ghaṭādibhyo viśeṣābhāvāt | kathām vināśarūpatā nivṛttirūpatvād vināśasyeti bhāvaḥ | ghūmasya tvārthāntaratvepy agnikāryatvaṃ yuktam eva | arthāntarasyāgnikāryatvena saha virodhābhāvād iti yatkiñcid etat |

analyzed: kāṣṭham āśrayaḥ āśrayaḥ usya asti iti āśrayī vināśaḥ tatas āśraya āśrayi sambandhaḥ usti iti ced

original: tadapekṣād agnyapekṣāt kāṣṭhānnāśasyotpatter adoṣaḥ | agnikṛto nāśo na syād iti yo doṣa uktaḥ sa nāstīti cet |

original: vahneḥ sakāśād (na) tiśayalābhinaḥ kāṣṭhasya vahnimprati kāpekṣā | naiva kācit | vahneḥ sakāśāt kāṣṭhasyātiśayalābhe vā 'parasya dvitīyasya kāṣṭhasyātiśayasamjñakasya janmasyāt | tathā ca pūrvakāṣṭhamapracyutikāraṇaṃ | nāsya pracyutikāraṇam astīti vigrahaḥ | tathaiva prāgvad dṛśyate |
analyzed: vahneḥ sakāśāt na tiśaya lābhinaḥ kāṣṭhasya vahnim prati kā apekṣā na eva kācid vahneḥ sakāśāt kāṣṭhasya atiśaya lābhe vā parasya dvitīyasya kāṣṭhasya atiśaya samjñakasya janma syāt tathā ca pūrva kāṣṭham apracyuti kāraṇam na asya pracyuti kāraṇam asti iti vigrahaḥ tathā eva prāgvat dṛśyate

original: kaḥ pūrveṇa kāṣṭhenāsya vahnikṛtasya vināśasya sambandha iti sa eva prasaṅgaḥ | kāṣṭha iti kaḥ sambandha ity anantaram evoktaḥ |
analyzed: kaḥ pūrveṇa kāṣṭhena asya vahni kṛtasya vināśasya sambandhaḥ iti saḥ eva prasaṅgaḥ kāṣṭhaḥ iti kaḥ sambandhaḥ iti anantaram eva uktaḥ

original: tad iti tasmād avaśyaṃ vināśasambandhasya yogyaḍ kāṣṭhasyottaramatiśayaṃ pratyupakurvāṇognirapūrvam eva kāṣṭhañjanayatīti pūrvaṃ kāṣṭhantadavasthandṛśyetetyupasaṅhāraḥ |
analyzed: tat iti tasmāt avaśyam vināśa sambandhasya kāṣṭhasya uttaram atiśayam pratyupakurvāṇa agniḥ apūrvam eva kāṣṭhan janayati iti pūrvam kāṣṭhan tad avasthan dṛśyeta iti upasaṅhāraḥ

original: kiñca | kāṣṭhavināśa iti kāṣṭhābhāva ucyate (|) na cābhāvaḥ kāryaḥ | vidhinā kāryatvopagame tasya bhāvatvaprasaṅgāt | tasmād abhāvaṃ karoti bhāvan na karotīti | kriyāpratiṣedhamātraṃ | tathā ca tatkārī cābhāvakārī vākāra eva kriyāpratiṣedhamātratvād iti kṛtvā kāṣṭhavināśena vahnyādiranapekṣanīya ityuktaṃ sāmānyatadvatorādhārādheyacintāsthāne |
analyzed: kiñca kāṣṭha vināśaḥ iti kāṣṭha abhāvaḥ ucyate na ca abhāvaḥ kāryaḥ vidhinā kārya tva upagame tasya bhāva tva prasaṅgāt tasmāt abhāvam karoti bhāvan na karoti iti kriyā pratiṣedha mātram tathā ca tad kārī ca abhāva kārī vākāraḥ eva kriyā pratiṣedha mātra tvāt iti kṛtvā kāṣṭha vināśena vahni ādiḥ an apekṣanīyaḥ iti uktam sāmānya tadvatoḥ ādhāra ādheya cintā sthāne

original: kiñca (|) svabhāvābhāvasya kāṣṭhādisvabhāvasya yo 'bhāvo nāśastasya tataḥ kāṣṭhādisvabhāvād bhedebhupagamyamāne | tatorthāntarādabhāvāt kāṣṭhādir bhāvo nivartate | tatstasmād bhāvannivartamānasya kāṣṭhādeḥ svabhāva eva samarthitaḥ syāt | asato nivartamānasya sattvameva samarthitaṃ syād iti kṛtvā kathamagnyādikṛtena vināśena kāṣṭhādirabhūto nāma |
analyzed: kiñca svabhāva abhāvasya kāṣṭha ādi svabhāvasya yaḥ bhāvaḥ nāśaḥ tasya tatas kāṣṭha ādi svabhāvāt bhedebhiḥ upagamyamāne tatas ṛtha antarāt abhāvāt kāṣṭha ādiḥ bhāvaḥ nivartate bhāvan nivartamānasya kāṣṭha ādeḥ svabhāvaḥ eva samarthitaḥ syāt asataḥ nivartamānasya sattvam eva samarthitam syāt iti kṛtvā katham agni ādi kṛtena vināśena kāṣṭha ādiḥ abhūtaḥ nāma

original: yata evantasmānna anyonyasya vināśaḥ | arthāntaramarthāntarasya na vināśa ity arthaḥ |

original: abhyupagamyāpi brūmaḥ (|) astvanyo vināśastasminnarthāntare vahnikṛte kāṣṭhantadavastham eveti kasmān na dṛśtate | etad eva sādhayannāha – koyamvirodhaḥ | (p.515) agnijanitasya vināśasyārthāntarasya yo bhāvaḥ | yacca kāṣṭhasya darśanantayoḥ | tathā ca kāṣṭhantadavasthaṃ dṛśyeta |
analyzed: abhyupagamya api brūmaḥ astu anyaḥ vināśaḥ tasmin artha antare vahni kṛte kāṣṭham tad avastham eva iti kasmāt na etat eva sādhayan āha kaḥ yam virodhaḥ agni janitasya vināśasya artha antarasya yaḥ bhāvaḥ yat ca kāṣṭhasya darśanam tayoḥ tathā ca kāṣṭham tad avastham dṛśyeta

original: nanu "yosāvarthāntaraṃ bhāvo vahnikṛtaḥ sa kāṣṭhavināśaḥ | vināśarūpatayā pratīteḥ | vināśaś cābhāvo yaś ca kāṣṭhābhāvaḥ | sa kāṣṭhavirodhirūpa eva kriyate | na cāyamarthāntaratvād ghaṭavad virodhirūpatayā karttumaśkyaḥ (|) na hi ghaṭavadarthāntaratvād ghūmognikāryo na bhavati |
analyzed: nanu yaḥ asau artha antaram bhāvaḥ vahni kṛtaḥ sa kāṣṭha vināśaḥ vināśa rūpatayā pratīteḥ vināśaḥ ca abhāvaḥ yaḥ ca kāṣṭha abhāvaḥ sa kāṣṭha virodhi rūpaḥ eva kriyate na ca ayam artha antara tvāt ghaṭa vat virodhi rūpatayā karttum aśkyaḥ na hi ghaṭa vat artha antara tvāt ghūma ugni kāryaḥ na bhavati

original: tasmād yathārthāntarabhūtopi ghūmogninā kriyate, tathā virodhirūpo vināśaḥ kriyate | yayoś ca parasparaparihāreṇa virodhastayor ekabhāva evāparasyādarśanam iti katham agnikṛtasyārthāntarasya vināśasaṃjñitasya virodhino bhāve kāṣṭhasya darśanaṃ syād ity ucyata" iti śaṅkraḥ | 1
analyzed: tasmāt yathā artha antara bhūtaḥ api ghūmaḥ agninā kriyate tathā virodhi rūpaḥ vināśaḥ kriyate yayoḥ ca paraspara parihāreṇa virodhaḥ tayoḥ eka bhāvaḥ eva aparasya adarśanam iti katham agni kṛtasya artha antarasya vināśa saṃjñitasya virodhinaḥ bhāve kāṣṭhasya darśanam syāt iti ucyate iti śaṅkraḥ 1

original: tad ayuktaṃ (|) yatorthāntarasyāgnikāryatvena saha virodhābhāvād (|) ghumasyārthāntaratvepyagnikāryatvam aviruddham eva | vahnikṛtasya tv arthāntarasya bhavanadharmatayā bhāvarūpatā | yaś ca bhāvaḥ sa kathamabhāvo vaḥ (|) virodhād vināśaś cābhāva iṣyate | tatorthāntarabhāvena viruddho vināśaḥ | na cārthāntarasyāpi vināśarūpatayā pratibhāsanāt |
analyzed: tat ayuktam yatas ṛtha antarasya agni kārya tvena saha virodha abhāvāt ghumasya artha antara tve pi agni kārya tvam aviruddham eva vahni kṛtasya tu artha antarasya bhavana dharma tayā bhāva rūpa tā yaḥ ca bhāvaḥ sa katham abhāvaḥ vaḥ virodhāt vināśaḥ ca abhāvaḥ iṣyate tatas ṛtha antara bhāvena viruddhaḥ vināśaḥ na ca artha antarasya api vināśa rūpa tayā pratibhāsanāt

original: kāṣṭhādivināśarūpatā | svarasanirodho hi nimittam vināśapratibhāse |

original: svarasanirodhānabhyupagame tu kathamarthāntarasyāpi vināśarūpatayā pratibhāso bhāvarūpatvādityādāvevoktaṃ | tatkathāmucyate (|) vināśākhyasyārthāntarasya virodhinaḥ kṛtakatvāt kāṣṭhasyādarśanam iti | nīrūpatve tu vināśasya syād bhāvena sahāyaṃ virodhaḥ (|) kintu tadāpy arthāntaratvaṃ hetujanyatvaṃ cāsya na syānnīrūpatvād eva |
analyzed: sva rasa nirodha anabhyupagame tu katham artha antarasya api vināśa rūpatayā pratibhāsaḥ bhāva rūpa tvāt ityādau eva uktam tad kathām ucyate vināśa ākhyasya artha antarasya virodhinaḥ kṛtaka tvāt kāṣṭhasya adarśanam iti nīrūpa tve tu vināśasya syāt bhāvena saha ayam virodhaḥ kintu tadā api artha antara tvam hetu janya tvam ca asya na syāt nīrūpa tvāt eva

original: tasmādagninārthāntarasya karaṇe kāṣṭhantadavasthaṃ dṛśyeta |

original: evaṃ sati tadarthāntaraṃ kāṣṭhasyāvaraṇam iti prāptaṃ | tacca na yuktaṃ (|) yato na tenārthāntaraṃ kāṣṭhasyāvaraṇam iti prāptaṃ | tac ca na yuktaṃ (|) yato na tenārthāntareṇa kāṣṭhasyāvaraṇaṃ sambhavati |

original: yadītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | tenārthāntareṇāgninā kṛtena | tadity agnikṛtamarthāntaraṃ | na caitadāvaraṇakalpitaṃ yuktaṃ | yasmādāvaraṇaṃ hi | āvriyamāṇerthadarśanam vibadhnīyāt | nābhighātādīni  dravyasāmarthyāni vibadhnīyāt | andhakārā(p.516)vṛtānāṃ ghaṭādīnām abhidhātādhidarśanāt | tatra svadeśe parasyotpattivibandhobhighātaḥ |
analyzed: yadi ityādinā vyācaṣṭe tena artha antareṇa agninā kṛtena tat iti agni kṛtam arthāntaram na ca etat āvaraṇa kalpitam yuktam yasmāt āvaraṇam hi āvriyamāṇa īrtha darśanam vibadhnīyāt na abhighāta ādīni dravya sāmarthyāni vibadhnīyāt andhakāra āpvṛtānām ghaṭa ādīnām abhidhātā adhi darśanāt tatra sva deśe parasya utpatti vibandhaḥ abhighātaḥ

original: ādiśabdād gandharasādiparigrahaḥ | athāvaranaṃ sarvasāmarthyaṃ kāṣṭhasya nibandhnīyāt | tadā sarvapratibandhe cābhyupagamyamāne | na tvanenaivāvaraṇena kāṣṭhannāśitaṃ syān na vahninā | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tenaivāsya kāṣṭhasya sarvaśaktipracyāvanāt | tathā ca sati punas tatrāpy agnikṛterthāntare nāśahetāvagnāviva prasaṃbāt |
