original: hantṛghātetyādinā paramāśaṃkate | caitrasya yo hantā tasya hantur ghate sati yathā | hatasya caitrasyāpunar bhāvaḥ (na) punar anutpattiḥ | atrāpi kāṣṭhanāśe vinaṣṭepyevaṃ kāṣṭhasyāpunar bhāva iti cet |
analyzed: hantṛ ghāta ityādinā param āśaṃkate caitrasya yaḥ hantā tasya hantuḥ sati yathā hatasya caitrasya apunar bhāvaḥ na punar anutpattiḥ atra api kāṣṭha nāśe vinaṣṭe api evam kāṣṭhasya apunar bhāvaḥ iti ced

original: (p.517) hantur ityādinā pratividhatte | nedaṃ samādhānaṃ yuktaṃ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) hanturamaraṇatvataḥ | na hi hantā caitrasya maraṇasvabhāvaḥ | kintarhi (|) mārayitā | tato yuktaṃ yat tannāśe caitrasyāpunarbhavanaṃ maraṇe tvanivṛtte 'vaśyaṃ punarbhavanaṃ syāt |
analyzed: hantuḥ ityādinā pratividhatte na idam samādhānam yuktam kim kāraṇam hantuḥ amaraṇa tvataḥ na hi hantā caitrasya maraṇa svabhāvaḥ kin tarhi mārayitā tatas yuktam yat tad nāśe caitrasya apunarbhavanam maraṇe tu anivṛtte vaśyam punarbhavanam syāt

original: vināśetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | vināśasya vināśepi na vastunaḥ pratyāpattir na pūrvarūpagamanaṃ | yasmānna hi hantari hatepi tadvatastena hantrā puruṣeṇa hataḥ pratyujjīvati | nāyamparihāro yuktaḥ | kasmād (|) hantuḥ puruṣasya tadghātahetutvāt | tasya caitrasya yanmaraṇantaddhetutvāt | na tv asau hantā maraṇasvabhāvaḥ |
analyzed: vināśa ityādinā vyācaṣṭe vināśasya vināśe api na vastunaḥ pratyāpattiḥ na pūrvarūpa gamanam yasmāt na hi hantari hate api tadvataḥ tena hantrā puruṣeṇa hataḥ pratyujjīvati na ayam parihāraḥ yuktaḥ kasmāt hantuḥ puruṣasya tad ghāta hetutvāt tasya caitrasya yat maraṇam tad hetutvāt na tu asau hantā maraṇa svabhāvaḥ

original: etad eva spaṣṭayannāha – netyādi | nāśahetoragnidaṇḍādernivṛttau satyāmivanaṣṭena bhāvena punarbhavativyam iti na brūmaḥ | evam abhidhāne bhavedeṣa parihāraḥ | kin tarhi (|) vah vyādinā kāṣṭhāderbhāvasyābhāvo yaḥ kriyate tasya | kimbhūtasya (|) atyantānupalabdhilakṣaṇasya | karmmasthā ca kriyātropalabdhiḥ |
analyzed: etat eva spaṣṭayan āha na ityādi nāśa hetoḥ agni daṇḍa ādeḥ nivṛttau satyām iva naṣṭena bhāvena punar bhavativyam iti na brūmaḥ evam abhidhāne bhavet eṣa parihāraḥ kin tarhi vyādinā kāṣṭha ādeḥ bhāvasya abhāvaḥ yaḥ kriyate tasya kimbhūtasya atyanta anupalabdhi lakṣaṇasya karmma sthā ca kriyā atra upalabdhiḥ

original: tatpratiṣedhenātyantānupalabdhiḥ sarvasāmārthyaviraha ucyate | tasyaivabhūtasyābhāvasya nivṛttau satyāṃ | svabhāvāvasthiteḥ sakāśād bhāvasya kānyā gatiḥ | svabhāvasthitir eva gatir iti yāvai |
analyzed: tad pratiṣedhena atyanta anupalabdhiḥ sarva sāmārthya virahaḥ ucyate tasya eva bhūtasya abhāvasya nivṛttau satyām svabhāva avasthiteḥ sakāśāt bhāvasya kā anyā gatiḥ svabhāva sthitiḥ eva gatiḥ iti

original: hantari tu vinaṣṭe na yuktaṃ punar bhavanaṃ | yasmād dhantā hi caitrasya na nāśakalpaḥ | kin tarhi (|) daṇḍādikalpaḥ daṇḍāditulyaḥ nāśahetutvāt | nāśaklpaṃ hy asya caitrasya maraṇam (|) tannivṛttau tasya nāśakalpasya maraṇasya nivṛttau syād evāsya caitrasya punar bhāvaḥ | evantāvat nāśasyārthāntaratve doṣa uktaḥ |
analyzed: hantari tu vinaṣṭe na yuktam punar bhavanam yasmāt hantā hi caitrasya na nāśa kalpaḥ kin tarhi daṇḍa ādi kalpaḥ daṇḍa ādi tulyaḥ nāśa hetu tvāt nāśa klpam hi asya caitrasya maraṇam tad nivṛttau tasya nāśa kalpasya maraṇasya nivṛttau syāt eva asya caitrasya punar bhāvaḥ evantāvat nāśasya artha antara tve doṣaḥ uktaḥ

original: anarthāntaratvamadhikṛtyāha – ananyatvepītyādi | vastuno nāśasyānanyatvepi syānnāśaḥ kāṣṭham eva tu | tasya ca kāṣṭhasya svahetor utpannasya satvāt | na (p. 518) vahnyādibhiḥ kiñcit karttavyam iti tatsvabhāvasya nāśasyāhetutvaṃ | nātastattvānyatvavikalpānnāśasya vastudharmasya vidyatenyā gatiḥ |
analyzed: anartha antara tvam adhikṛtya āha ananyatve pi ityādi vastunaḥ nāśasya ananyatve pi syāt nāśaḥ kāṣṭham eva tu tasya ca kāṣṭhasya sva hetoḥ utpannasya satvāt na vahni ādibhiḥ kiñcid karttavyam iti tad svabhāvasya nāśasya ahetu tvam na atas tattva anyatva vikalpāt nāśasya vastu dharmasya vidyate inyā gatiḥ

original: anarthāntara ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | kāṣṭhādanarthāntarabhūto yadā vināśastadā tadeva kāṣṭham eva tadvināśākhyamvastu bhavati | tac ca kāṣṭhādi | vahnyādisannidhānāt prāgevāstīti | kim atra kāṣṭhādau vināśye sāmarthyam vahnyāvīnām iti draṣṭavyaṃ | kvacid daṇḍādīnām iti pāṭhaḥ sa tu ghaṭādīn purodhāya vyākhyeya | tasmāt tadmukārāt |
analyzed: anartha antare ityādinā vyācaṣṭe kāṣṭhāt anartha antara bhūtaḥ yadā vināśaḥ tadā tat eva kāṣṭham eva tad vināśa ākhyam vastu bhavati tat ca kāṣṭha ādi vahni ādi sannidhānāt prāk eva asti iti kim atra kāṣṭha ādau vināśye sāmarthyam vahni āvīnām iti draṣṭavyam kvacid daṇḍa ādīnām iti pāṭhaḥ sa tu ghaṭa ādīn purodhāya vyākhyeya tasmāt tad mukārāt

original: tatra kāṣṭhādau vināśahetūnāmanupakārāt tena kāṣṭhādinā vināśahetavo nāpekṣyante kathaṃcit kenāpi rūpeṇa | nāpy asya kāṣṭāder idam vahnyādikaṃ vināśahetur iti sambandhamarhati | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tasyopakāranibandhanatvāt | anyathopakāram antareṇa sambandhakalpanāyāmatiprasaṅgāt | sarvaḥ sarvasya sambandhī syāt |
analyzed: tatra kāṣṭha ādau vināśa hetūnām anupakārāt tena kāṣṭha ādinā vināśa hetavaḥ na apekṣyante kathaṃcid kena api rūpeṇa na api asya kāṣṭa ādeḥ idam vahni ādikam vināśa hetuḥ iti sambandham arhati kim kāraṇam tasya upakāra nibandhana tvāt anyathā upakāram antareṇa sambandha kalpanāyām atiprasaṅgāt sarvaḥ sarvasya sambandhī syāt

original: syād etat (|) na sākṣād vanhyādiḥ kāṣṭhāderupakārakaḥ kintu tatsambandhibhūtopakārakaranād iti (|)
analyzed: syāt etat na sākṣāt vanhi ādiḥ kāṣṭha ādeḥ upakārakaḥ kintu tad sambandhi bhūta upakāra karanāt iti

original: ata āha – pāramparyeṇetyādi | vahnyādinā kāṣṭhādeḥ sambandhibhūta upakāraḥ kriyate na sākṣād iti (|) evaṃ pāramparyeṇopakārepi kalpyamāne 'vaśyam ayam vikalponvetyanugacchati | sa kimpāramparyeṇāpyupakārorthāntaramāhosvit tadeva kāṣṭhādikam iti | tatra tasmāt kāṣṭhāderarthāntaratvepyupakārasya | tasya kāṣṭhāder ayam upakāra iti kas sambandha iti |
analyzed: atas āha pāramparyeṇa ityādi vahni ādinā kāṣṭha ādeḥ sambandhi bhūtaḥ upakāraḥ kriyate na sākṣāt iti evam pāramparyeṇa upakāre api kalpyamāne vaśyam ayam vikalpaḥ nu iti anugacchati sa kim pāramparyeṇa api upakāra ūrtha antaram āhosvit tat eva kāṣṭha ādikam iti tatra tasmāt kāṣṭha ādeḥ artha antara tve pi upakārasya tasya kāṣṭha ādeḥ ayam upakāraḥ iti kaḥ sambandhaḥ iti

original: tatra kāṣṭhādau tasyāgnikṛtasyopakārasyopakārakatvaṃ paryanuyojyaṃ | tadantareṇa sambandhābhāvāt | ādiśabdāt tatrāpy aparopakārakalpanetyanavasthādoṣādiparigrahaḥ | tathānanyatvepy upakārasya tadavasthaḥ paryanuyogaḥ syānnāśaḥ kāṣṭhamevetyādinā ya uktaḥ tasmāt sato vidyamānasya rūpasya tattvānyattvāvyatikramāt kāraṇāt |
analyzed: tatra kāṣṭha ādau tasya agni kṛtasya upakārasya upakāraka tvam paryanuyojyam tad antareṇa sambandha abhāvāt ādi śabdāt tatra api apara upakāra kalpanā iti anavasthā doṣa ādi parigrahaḥ tathā ananyatve pi upakārasya tad avasthaḥ paryanuyogaḥ syāt nāśaḥ kāṣṭham eva ityādinā yaḥ uktaḥ tasmāt sataḥ vidyamānasya rūpasya tattva anyattva avyatikramāt kāraṇāt

original: syād etat (|) sato rūpasya tattvānyattvāvyatikramād vināśahetukṛtaṃ tūpakārotpādanam asad eveti |
analyzed: syāt etat sataḥ rūpasya tattva anyattva avyatikramāt vināśa hetu kṛtam tu upakāra utpādanam asat eva iti

original: (p. 519) ata āha – upakāretyādi | rūpaniṣpādanalakṣaṇatvāt | sadrūpaniṣpādanalakṣaṇatvāt | tataś ca tadvā vastu tena vināśakena karttavyam anyadvā | ubhayathā cokto doṣa iti | tadatatkriyāvikalo nāśahetur na karttaivaiti na kasyaciddhetuḥ | ahetuś ca daṇḍādi nāpikṣyate vinaśvareṇaghaṭādinā |
analyzed: atas āha upakāra ityādi rūpa niṣpādana lakṣaṇa tvāt sat rūpa niṣpādana lakṣaṇa tvāt tatas ca tat vā vastu tena vināśakena karttavyam anyat vā ubhayathā ca uktaḥ doṣaḥ iti tad atatkriyā vikalaḥ nāśa hetuḥ na karttā eva eti na kasyacid hetuḥ ahetuḥ ca daṇḍa ādi na apikṣyate vinaśvareṇa ghaṭa ādinā

original: tasmāt svayaṃ sattāmātreṇāyambhāvastattatsvabhāvo vinaśvarasvabhāva iti |
analyzed: tasmāt svayam sattā mātreṇa ayambhāvaḥ tad tad svabhāvaḥ vinaśvara svabhāvaḥ iti

original: pradhvaṃsābhāvannāśaṃ gṛhītvā parasya codyamāśaṃkate | ahetutvepītyādi ahetur hi bhavannityambhavet | nityatvāc ca bhāvakālepi nāśo bhavedityevambhāvanāśayoḥ sahabhāvaprasaṅgaścet |
analyzed: pradhvaṃsa abhāva nāśam gṛhītvā parasya codyam āśaṃkate ahetu tve pi ityādi ahetuḥ hi bhavan nityam bhavet nitya tvāt ca bhāva kāle api nāśaḥ bhavet iti evam bhāva nāśayoḥ sahabhāva prasaṅgaḥ ced

original: nāyandoṣaḥ (|) kiṃ kāraṇam (|) asataḥ pradhvaṃsalakṣaṇasya nāśasya nityatā kutaḥ |
analyzed: na ayan doṣaḥ kim kāraṇam asataḥ pradhvaṃsa lakṣaṇasya nāśasya nitya tā kutas

original: syād etad ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | yadyapi nāśaḥ kṣaṇikavādino 'hetukaḥ sovaśyaṃ nitya iti kṛtvā bhāvastadabhāvalakṣaṇo vināśanivṛttirūpaḥ | vināśaś ca tadabhāvalakṣaṇo bhāvanivṛttirūpaḥ | ekasya saha syātām iti |
analyzed: syāt etat ityādinā vyācaṣṭe yadi api nāśaḥ kṣaṇika vādinaḥ hetukaḥ saḥ uvaśyam nityaḥ iti kṛtvā bhāvaḥ tad abhāva lakṣaṇaḥ vināśa nivṛtti rūpaḥ vināśaḥ ca tad abhāva lakṣaṇaḥ bhāva nivṛtti rūpaḥ ekasya saha syātām iti

original: naitadevaṃ | kasmāt (|)  tasyābhāvasyāvastutvena nityādidharmāyogāt | na hyasatyayannityānityavikalpassambhavati | tayornityayor vastudharmatvāt | vināśasya ca bhāvanivṛttilakṣaṇasyākiñcittvāt |
analyzed: na etat evam kasmāt tasya abhāvasya avastu tvena nitya ādi dharma ayogāt na hi asatya yat nitya anitya vikalpaḥ sambhavati tayoḥ nityayoḥ vastu dharma tvāt vināśasya ca bhāva nivṛtti lakṣaṇasya akiñcittvāt

original: kiṃ ca (|) bhavati hy utpadyamānasya nityaṃ sattvāt kenacit sahabhāvaḥ syāt (|) na ca vināśo bhavati | kevalamekalakṣaṇasthitidharmā bhāvaḥ svayam eva na bhavatīti kriyāpratiṣedhamātrametat | tasmādadoṣonantaroktaḥ |
analyzed: kim ca bhavati hi utpadyamānasya nityam sattvāt kenacid sahabhāvaḥ syāt na ca vināśaḥ bhavati kevalam eka lakṣaṇa sthiti dharmā bhāvaḥ svayam eva na bhavati iti kriyā pratiṣedha mātram etat tasmāt adoṣaḥ anantara uktaḥ

original: punar api parābhiprāyamāśaṃkte | yadi vināśo sanniṣyate tadā vināśasyā(p. 520)sattve satyabhāvanāśitvaprasaṅgaḥ | bhāvasya nāśitvaṃ na syād ity ayam api prasaṅgo na yujyate | yasmād bhāvasya nāśenārthāntareṇa nāsmābhirvināśanamiṣyate |
analyzed: punar api para abhiprāyam āśaṃkte yadi san iṣyate tadā sattve satya bhāva nāśi tva prasaṅgaḥ bhāvasya nāśi tvam na syāt iti ayam api prasaṅgaḥ na yujyate yasmāt bhāvasya nāśena artha antareṇa na asmābhiḥ vināśanam iṣyate

original: katham ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | kathamasan vināśo bhāvaṃ nāśayedasato vyāpārāyogāt | ataḥ kāraṇādavināśī bhāvaḥ syād ity aprasaṅga eva | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) vināśādarthāntarabhūtād bhāvasya nāśānabhyupagamāt |
analyzed: katham ityādinā vyācaṣṭe katham asan vināśaḥ bhāvam nāśayet asataḥ vyāpāra ayogāt atas kāraṇāt avināśī bhāvaḥ syāt iti aprasaṅgaḥ eva kim kāraṇam vināśāt artha antara bhūtāt bhāvasya nāśa anabhyupagamāt

original: yo hītyādinaitadeva samarthayate | yo hi vādī nivāśa iti kiṃ cinnety āha – sa kathamtato niḥsvabhāvānnāśād bhāvasya nāśamicchet (|) necchet |
analyzed: yaḥ hi ityādinā etat eva samarthayate yaḥ hi vādī nivāśaḥ iti kim cit na iti āha sa katham tatas niḥsvabhāvāt nāśāt bhāvasya nāśam icchet na icchet

original: katham ityādi paraḥ | asatyavidyamāne vināśe kathambhāvo naṣṭo nāma | naiva vinaṣṭaḥ syāt | tathā hi pratyutpannāvasthāyāmasadvināśāḥ | asadvināśo yeṣām iti vigrahaḥ | te na hi naṣṭā gaṇyante | yadā ca bhāvasya nāśo nāsit tadā kathāntena sa vyapadiśyate nāśavāniti | na hi yo yena svabhāvenātadvān asambandhavān |
analyzed: katham ityādi paraḥ asati avidyamāne vināśe kathaṃbhāvaḥ naṣṭaḥ nāma na eva vinaṣṭaḥ syāt tathā hi pratyutpanna avasthāyām asat vināśāḥ asat vināśaḥ yeṣām iti vigrahaḥ te na hi naṣṭāḥ gaṇyante yadā ca bhāvasya nāśaḥ tadā kathā antena sa vyapadiśyate nāśavān iti na hi yaḥ yena svabhāvena atadvān asambandhavān

original: sa padārthastenāsambandhinā tathā vyapadiśyate | tadvāniti vyapadiśyate śabdena | pratīyate vā jñānena |
analyzed: sa padārthaḥ tena asambandhinā tathā vyapadiśyate tadvān iti vyapadiśyate śabdena pratīyate vā jñānena

original: netyādinā pariharati | na vai bhāvasya nāśo nāstyevāi tvastyeva nāśaḥ | kathan tarthi nāstītyucyate | sa tu nāsti nāśo yo bhāvasya bhavati | yadi vināśo na bhavati kathan tarhi vināśostītyucyata iti (|)
analyzed: na ityādinā pariharati na vai bhāvasya nāśaḥ na asti eva āi tu asti eva nāśaḥ katham nāsti iti ucyate sa tu nā asti nāśaḥ yaḥ bhāvasya bhavati yadi vināśaḥ na bhavati katham tarhi vināśaḥ usti iti ucyate iti

original: āha – bhāva eva tu kṣaṇasthitidharmā | ekakṣaṇasthāyī nāśaḥ |
analyzed: āha bhāvaḥ eva tu kṣaṇa sthiti dharmāḥ eka kṣaṇa sthāyī nāśaḥ

original: yadi bhāva eva nāśaḥ kathan tarhi bhāvasya nāśo bhūta iti loko vyapadiśatīti (|)
analyzed: yadi bhāvaḥ eva nāśaḥ kathan tarhi bhāvasya nāśaḥ bhūtaḥ iti lokaḥ vyapadiśati iti

original: ata āha – tamasyetyādi | asya bhāvasya tamekakṣaṇasthāyisvabhāvaṃ sadṛśāparotyattivipralambhādupalakṣitaṃ | uttarakālaṃ santānocchittāvanupalambhenāsthitipratipattyā | vibhāvayanto niścinvantaḥ | vināśosya bhāvasya bhūta iti yathā pratīti vyapadiśanti vyavahāriṇaḥ puruṣā ityuktaṃ prāk |
analyzed: atas āha tam asya ityādi asya bhāvasya tam eka kṣaṇa sthāyi svabhāvam sadṛśa apara utyatti vipralambhāt upalakṣitam uttarakālam santāna ucchittau anupalambhena asthiti pratipattyā vibhāvayantaḥ niścinvantaḥ vināśaḥ usya bhāvasya bhūtaḥ iti yathā prati iti vyapadiśanti vyavahāriṇaḥ puruṣāḥ iti uktam prāk

original: (p. 521) yasmānna hi bhāvasya niṣpannasya kiñcidrūpāntaramvināśākhyamanyadvā kadācid bhavati | sa eva bhāvaḥ kevalaṃ svahetubhyas tathābhūta ekakṣaṇasthāyī bhavati | tad iti tasmānna kenacidvināśākhyena bhavata | sa bhāvo nāṣṭo nāma | kintarhi (|) svabhāva evāsya bhāvasya sa ekakṣaṇāvasthānaśīlaḥ |
analyzed: yasmāt na hi bhāvasya niṣpannasya kiñcid rūpa antaram vināśa ākhyam anyat vā kadācid bhavati saḥ eva bhāvaḥ kevalam sva hetubhyaḥ tathābhūtaḥ eka kṣaṇa sthāyī bhavati tat iti tasmāt na kenacid vināśa ākhyena sa bhāvaḥ nāṣṭaḥ nāma kin tarhi svabhāvaḥ eva asya bhāvasya saḥ eka kṣaṇa avasthāna śīlaḥ

original: yena sa bhāvo naṣṭo nāma anyathā svayamatatsvabhāvatvenyasannidhānepyanāśāt |
analyzed: yena sa bhāvaḥ naṣṭaḥ nāma anyathā svayam a tatsvabhāva tvena asannidhāne ipi anāśāt

original: yadi nāśo nāma na kiñcit | kathantarhīdānīmahetuko nāśo bhavatīty ucyate bhavadbhiḥ | yasya hi svabhāva eva nāsti tasya kimahetukaḥ sahetuko veti cintayā | bhāvasya nāśa iti vyatireko vā kathaṃ |
analyzed: yadi nāśaḥ nāma na kiñcid katham tarhi idānīm ahetukaḥ nāśaḥ bhavati iti ucyate bhavadbhiḥ yasya hi svabhāvaḥ eva nā asti tasya kim ahetukaḥ sa hetukaḥ vā iti cintayā bhāvasya nāśaḥ iti vyatirekaḥ vā katham

original: naśyannityādinā pariharati | bhāvo naśyannaparāpekṣaḥ | paraṃ vināśahetuṃ nāpiekṣata iti kṛtvā | na jñāpanāyetyaparāpekṣatvajñāpanāya | sā nāśāvasthāsmābhirahetur uktā | tasyā nāśāvasthāyāś cetasā vikalpabuddhyā bhāvād bhedaṃ vyatirekamāropya (|)
analyzed: naśyan ityādinā pariharati bhāvaḥ naśyan apara apekṣaḥ param vināśa hetum na api īkṣate iti kṛtvā na jñāpanāya iti apara apekṣa tva jñāpanāya sā nāśa avasthā asmābhiḥ ahetuḥ uktā tasyāḥ nāśa avasthāyāḥ cetasā vikalpa buddhyā bhāvāt bhedam vyatirekam āropya

original: etad uktam bhavati (|) ahetuko bhāvasya vināśo bhavatīti sahetukosya vināśo na bhavatīty arthaḥ |
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati ahetukaḥ bhāvasya vināśaḥ bhavati iti sa hetukaḥ sya vināśaḥ na bhavati iti arthaḥ

original: netyādinā vyācaṣṭe | na bhāvo jātaḥ sannaparasmād vināśahetornāśaṃ pratilabhate | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tathābhūtasyaiva naśvarasvabhāvasyaiva svayaṃ sattāhetoreva jāter utpatteḥ | iti hetor aparamanyam vināśahetutven kalpitam apekṣata ityaparāpekṣaḥ | tathābhūtaś cāsau dharmaś ca vināśākhyaḥ | aparāpekṣadharmas tasya pratiṣedhārthaṃ |
analyzed: na ityādinā vyācaṣṭe na bhāvaḥ jātaḥ san aparasmāt vināśa hetoḥ nāśam pratilabhate kim kāraṇam tathābhūtasya eva naśvara svabhāvasya eva svayam sattā hetoḥ eva jāteḥ utpatteḥ iti hetoḥ aparam anyam vināśa hetu tven kalpitam apekṣate iti apara apekṣaḥ tathābhūtaḥ ca asau dharmaḥ ca vināśa ākhyaḥ apara apekṣa dharmaḥ tasya pratiṣedha artham

original: sahetukavināśapratiṣedhārtham iti yāvat | tatsvabhāvajñāpaneneti bhāvasya vinaśvarasvabhāvajñāpanena | svabhāva eva tathocyata ity anena sambandhaḥ | tathocyata ity ahetukosya vināśo bhavatītyucyate | kadācittanmātrajijñāsāyāṃ | bhāvasyānyasmāt kimvināśo bhavati na cityetāvanmātrajijñāsāyāṃ | kena prakāreṇocyate |
analyzed: sa hetuka vināśa pratiṣedha artham iti yāvat tad svabhāva jñāpanena iti bhāvasya vinaśvara svabhāva jñāpanena svabhāvaḥ eva tathā ucyate iti anena sambandhaḥ tathā ucyate iti ahetukaḥ sya vināśaḥ bhavati iti ucyate kadācid tanmātra jijñāsāyām bhāvasya anyasmāt kim vināśaḥ bhavati na citi etāvat mātra jijñāsāyām kena prakāreṇa ucyate

original: dharmiṇaḥ sakāśād arthāntaram iva vināśākhyaṃ dharmaṃ cetasā buddhyā vibhajyāsya bhāvasya vināś iti vibhāgaṃ kṛtvā | tadetad yathoktena prakāreṇābhāvād avyatirikta(p.522)nnāśitvantatvato vyavasthāpitam api mandamatayo nāśaṃ guṇaṃ dharmaṃ samāropyātmānamākulayantītyanena sambandhaḥ |
analyzed: dharmiṇaḥ sakāśāt artha antaram iva vināśa ākhyam dharmam cetasā buddhyā vibhajya asya bhāvasya vināś iti vibhāgam kṛtvā tat etat yathā uktena prakāreṇa abhāvāt vyavasthāpitam api manda matayaḥ nāśam guṇam dharmam samāropya ātmānam ākulayanti iti anena sambandhaḥ

original: kasmāt punasta evamākulayantīt ity āha – kvacid ityādi | rājñaḥ puruṣa ityādau vyatirekavibhaktiprayoge tathādarśanāt | sambandhinor vibhāgadarśanāt | ihā bhāva nāśo bhavatīty anena ghoṣaṇāmātreṇa vipralabdhāḥ | bhāvasya vyatiriktaṃ nāśaṃ guṇaṃ dharmāṃ samāropya | tasya ca yathā kalpitasya guṇasya bhāvaṃ sattāṃ samāropya |
analyzed: kasmāt punar te evam ākulayanti iti āha kvacid ityādi rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ ityādau vyatireka vibhakti prayoge tathā darśanāt sambandhinoḥ vibhāga darśanāt iha ā bhāva nāśaḥ bhavati iti anena ghoṣaṇā mātreṇa vipralabdhāḥ bhāvasya vyatiriktam nāśam guṇam samāropya tasya ca yathā kalpitasya guṇasya bhāvam sattām samāropya

original: taṃ nāśākhyaṃ guṇaṃ sahetukamahetukamvā darśanabhedena samāroya bhāvacintayā vastucintayā | kiṃbhūtayā (|) apratiṣṭhitatattvayā | apratiṣṭhitantattvaṃ yasyāṃ cintāyāṃ | tayātmānamākulayanti |
analyzed: tam nāśa ākhyam guṇam sa hetukam ahetukam vā darśana bhedena samāroya bhāva cintayā vastu cintayā kiṃbhūtayā apratiṣṭhita tattvayā apratiṣṭhitam tattvam yasyām cintāyām tayā ātmānam ākulayanti

original: svatopītyādiṇā parābhiprāyamāśaṃkate | yasyāpi svayamevāhetuko nāśo bhavati | tasyāpi svatopyabhāvasya vināśasya bhāveṅgīkriyamāṇe | ayantattvānyattvalakṣaṇo vikalpaścetasaḥ |
analyzed: svatas pi ityādiṇā para abhiprāyam āśaṃkate yasya api svayam eva ahetukaḥ nāśaḥ bhavati tasya api svatas api abhāvasya vināśasya bhāve aṅgīkriyamāṇe ayat tattva anyattva lakṣaṇaḥ vikalpaḥ cetasaḥ

original: nanvityādinā vyācaṣṭe | na parabhāvitvam aparabhāvitvam ahetukatvepīty arthaḥ | bhāvasya vastuno yo nāśastasya svata eva bhavataḥ | ayantattvānyattvavikalpastukyaḥ (|)
analyzed: nanu ityādinā vyācaṣṭe na para bhāvi tvam apara bhāvi tvam ahetuka tve api iti arthaḥ bhāvasya vastunaḥ yaḥ nāśaḥ tasya svatas eva bhavataḥ ayantattva anyattva vikalpaḥ tukyaḥ

original: kimarthāntarannāśo bhāvāduta bhāva eveti | tatra yadyarthāntarantadā kimarthāntarasya nāśasya bhāve sattāyāmbhāvo na dṛśyate | athānarthāntaraṃ vināśastadānarthāntaratvepi tadeva ghaṭādikameva tannāśakhyambhavati | tattsmānna kiñcid asya padārthasya jātam iti kathaṃ vinaṣṭo nāma |
analyzed: kim artha antarat nāśaḥ bhāvāt uta bhāvaḥ eva iti tatra yadi artha antarat tadā kim artha antarasya nāśasya bhāve sattāyām bhāvaḥ na dṛśyate atha anartha antaram vināśaḥ tadā anartha antara tve pi tat eva ghaṭa ādikam eva tad nāśa khyam bhavati tat tsmāt na kiñcid asya padārthasya jātam iti katham vinaṣṭaḥ nāma

original: nanvityādinā pariharati | atra prastāve | uktaṃ (|) kimuktaṃ (|) na tasya bhāvasya kiṃcid vyatiriktam vā nāśākhyam dharmarūpam bhavati | kathan tarhi vināśī bhāva ity āha – na bhavatyeva kevalam ity uktaṃ prāk |
analyzed: nanu ityādinā pariharati atra prastāve uktam kim uktam na tasya bhāvasya kiṃcid vyatiriktam vā nāśa ākhyam dharma rūpam bhavati kathan tarhi vināśī bhāvaḥ iti āha na bhavati eva kevalam iti uktam prāk

original: (p.523) etad eva sphuṭayannāha – na hītyādi | na hy ayam ahutukavināśavādī bhāvasya svahetorniṣpannasya kaścid bhāvarūpo 'bhāvarupo ka vināśonyo vā sthityānyathātvādiko dharmo bhavatityāha – kintarhi sa eva bhāvo na bhavatīti bhāvanivṛttimātramāha – tenāyam arthaḥ (|) prathame kṣaṇe bhāvo 'bhūto bhavati |
analyzed: etat eva sphuṭayan āha na hi ityādi na hi ayam ahutuka vināśa vādī bhāvasya sva hetoḥ niṣpannasya kaścid bhāva rūpaḥ vā sthityā anyathātva ādikaḥ dharmaḥ bhavati iti āha kim tarhi saḥ eva bhāvaḥ na bhavati iti bhāva nivṛtti mātram āha tena ayam arthaḥ prathame kṣaṇe bhāvaḥ bhūtaḥ bhavati

original: dvitīye kṣaṇe tasya na bhāvo bhavati nābhāvo vā | nāpi svarasahānirvā bhāvati | kevalaṃ svayam eva nivartate |
analyzed: dvitīye kṣaṇe tasya na bhāvaḥ bhavati nā abhāvaḥ vā nā api sva rasa hāniḥ vā bhāvati kevalam svayam eva nivartate

original: yadi punar nāśābhidhānena kasyacid dharmasya bhāvam utpādaṃ brūyānna bhāvonena vādinā vivartitaḥ syāt | bhāvanivṛttir na kathiteti yāvat | tathā ca bhāvanivṛtttau prastutāyāmarthāntarasyānyasya vidhānādaprastutamevoktaṃ syāt | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) na hi kasyacid vināśākhyasyābhāvasya bhāvanivṛttirūpasya vā bhāvenotupādena bhāvaḥ padārtho nabhūto nāma |
analyzed: yadi punar nāśa abhidhānena kasyacid dharmasya bhāvam utpādam brūyāt na bhāva ūnena vādinā vivartitaḥ syāt bhāva nivṛttiḥ na kathitā iti yāvat tathā ca bhāva nivṛttau prastutāyām artha antarasya anyasya vidhānāt aprastutam eva uktam syāt kim kāraṇam na hi kasyacid vināśa ākhyasya abhāvasya bhāva nivṛtti rūpasya vā bhāvena utu pādena bhāvaḥ padārthaḥ na bhūtaḥ nāma

original: yena tadvidhānena bhāvasya svanivṛttiḥ syāt |
analyzed: yena tad vidhānena bhāvasya sva nivṛttiḥ syāt

original: etaduktam bhavati | yathā bhāvasya vijñānabhāve bhāvo na vivarttate kevalantadvijñānantatsambandhi syāt | tathā bhāvasya nivṛttir bhavatīty abhyupagame sa eva nivṛttyākhyo dharmas tatsambandhī syān na tu bhāvo nivarteteti katham asya nivṛttiḥ syāt | tasmāttadā sa bhāvo na bhūto nivṛtto yadi svayaṃ na bhavet |
analyzed: etat uktam bhavati yathā bhāvasya vijñāna bhāve bhāvaḥ na vivarttate kevalam tat vijñānan tad sambandhi syāt tathā bhāvasya nivṛttiḥ bhavati iti abhyupagame saḥ eva nivṛtti ākhyaḥ dharmaḥ tad sambandhī syāt na tu bhāvaḥ nivarteta iti katham asya nivṛttiḥ syāt tasmāt tadā sa bhāvaḥ na bhūtaḥ nivṛttaḥ yadi svayam na bhavet

original: tena yad ucyate | nanv abhavanam api yadi bhāvasya na bhavati | tadā 'vināśitvaṃ | atha bhavati | tadbhinnamvā syād abhinnamvā 'nayoś ca pakṣayorbhāvasya sarvadā darśanaṃ syādavināśāt | tasmānnābhāvasya vināśaḥ (|) kathantarhi bhāvaḥ sarvadā na pratīyate pramāṇābhāvād iti (|)
analyzed: tena yat ucyate nanu abhavanam api yadi bhāvasya na bhavati tadā vināśi tvam atha bhavati tat bhinnam vā syāt abhinnam vā nayoḥ ca pakṣayoḥ bhāvasya sarvadā darśanam syāt avināśāt tasmāt na abhāvasya vināśaḥ katham tarhi bhāvaḥ sarvadā na pratīyate pramāṇa abhāvāt iti

original: tadapāstam | dṛśyasya hi sattāyāḥ pramāṇaviṣayatvena vyāptatvāt | tadabhāvādabhāvaḥ | bhāve vāvaśyaṃ pramāṇaviṣayatvam iti kathamapratipattiḥ | athādṛśyarupatayāsya bhāvastadā tarhi dṛśyarūpatāyā nivṛttiḥ | sā ca bhāvād bhinnā 'bhinnā vā (|) anayoś ca pakṣayor bhāvasya darśanaṃ syād iti doṣastadavastha eva |
analyzed: tat apāstam dṛśyasya hi sattāyāḥ pramāṇa viṣaya tvena vyāpta tvāt tad abhāvāt abhāvaḥ bhāve vā avaśyam pramāṇa viṣaya tvam iti katham apratipattiḥ atha adṛśya rupa tayā asya bhāvaḥ tadā tarhi dṛśya rūpa tāyāḥ nivṛttiḥ sā ca bhāvāt bhinnā bhinnā vā anayoḥ ca pakṣayoḥ bhāvasya darśanam syāt iti doṣaḥ tad avasthaḥ eva

original: tasmād bhāvasyābhāvanamapi na bhavati nāpyavināśitvadoṣaḥ | svarūpeṇa nivṛtteḥ |
analyzed: tasmāt bhāvasya abhāvanam api na bhavati na api avināśi tva doṣaḥ svarūpeṇa nivṛtteḥ

original: nanu bhāvanivṛtter nīrūpatvenarūpiṇo bhāvādanyattvam iti cet |
analyzed: nanu bhāva nivṛtteḥ nīrūpa tvena rūpiṇaḥ bhāvāt anyat tvam iti ced

original: nanu yasya rūpam eva na vidyate tasya katham anyattvaṃ tatkim ekatvam astu | tadapi nāstyarūpatvāt | tasmād bhāvena sahāsyāstattvānyattvaniṣedhamātraṃ kriyate | śaśaviṣāṇavat |
analyzed: nanu yasya rūpam eva na vidyate tasya katham anyattvam tat kim ekatvam astu tat api nā asti arūpa tvāt tasmāt bhāvena saha asyāḥ tattva anyattva niṣedha mātram kriyate śaśaviṣāṇa vat

original: (p.524) natvevamapi kathaṃ dvitīyakṣaṇe bhāvo na bhavatītīṣyate (|) yato yadi dvitīyakṣaṇe bhāvastadā kathantatra nāstītīṣyate virodhāt | atha nāsti tadā kathaṃ bhāvo nāstīty ucyate 'sattvād iti |
analyzed: na tu evam api katham dvitīya kṣaṇe bhāvaḥ na bhavati iti iṣyate yatas yadi dvitīya kṣaṇe bhāvaḥ tadā katham tatra na asti iti iṣyate virodhāt atha na asti tadā katham bhāvaḥ na asti iti ucyate sattvāt iti

original: tadyuktaṃ | yataḥ prathamnepi kṣaṇe bhāvo bhavatīti lokebhidhīyate | tatra ca yadi bhāvaḥ kathambhavatītyucyate | tasmāt sarvatra buddhisthameva bhāvaṃ kṛtvā vidhipratiṣedhavyavahāra iti yat kiñcid etat |
analyzed: tat yuktam yatas kṣaṇe bhāvaḥ bhavati iti loke abhidhīyate tatra ca yadi bhāvaḥ katham bhavati iti ucyate tasmāt sarvatra buddhi stham eva bhāvam kṛtvā vidhi pratiṣedha vyavahāraḥ iti yat kiñcid etat

original: tasmāt sthitam etat (|) tadā sa bhāvo na bhūto yadi svayaṃ na bhved iti |
analyzed: tasmāt sthitam etat tadā sa bhāvaḥ na bhūtaḥ yadi svayam na iti

original: nanu svayambhāvo na bhavatītyanenāpi vākyena svayamevābhāvo bhāvasya bhavatīty ucyate | tadā ca sa eva doṣa ity ata āha – na bhavatīti cetyādi | caśabdo yasmād arthe | yasmād bhāvo na bhavatīti ca prasajyapratiṣedha eṣaḥ | na paryudāsaḥ | yatraprasaktasya nivṛttimātrameva kriyate na vastvaṃśasya saṃsparśaḥ sa prasajyapratiśedhaḥ |
analyzed: nanu svayambhāvaḥ na bhavati iti anena api vākyena svayam evā abhāvaḥ bhāvasya bhavati iti ucyate tadā ca saḥ eva doṣaḥ iti atas āha na bhavati iti ca ityādi caśabdaḥ yasmāt arthe yasmāt bhāvaḥ na bhavati iti ca prasajya pratiṣedhaḥ eṣaḥ na paryudāsaḥ yatra prasaktasya nivṛtti mātram eva kriyate na vastu aṃśasya saṃsparśaḥ sa prasajya pratiśedhaḥ

original: yatra tvekaniṣedhenānyavidhānaṃ sa paryudāsaḥ | anyathehāpi prasajyapratiṣedhepi kasyacid vastuno bhāve | vidhāne sati | na pratiṣedhaśabdenoktaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) ubhayatrāpi prasajye paryudāse ca | vidheḥ pradhānyāt |
analyzed: yatra tu eka niṣedhena anya vidhānam sa paryudāsaḥ anyathā iha api prasajya pratiṣedhe api kasyacid vastunaḥ bhāve vidhāne sati na pratiṣedha śabdena uktaḥ kim kāraṇam ubhayatra api prasajye paryudāse ca vidheḥ pradhānyāt

original: yadi ca prasajyapratiṣedhepi vidhistadā pratiṣedha eva nāsti | evaṃ cāpratiṣedhāt kasyacit paryudāsopi na syāt kvacit | kiṃ kāraṇam | yadi hi kiṃcid vastu kutaścinnivartteta | tadā tadvyatireki | nivartamānād vastuno vyatirekisaṃspṛśyeta | tatparyudāsena nivarttyamānaparyudāsena |
analyzed: yadi ca prasajya pratiṣedhe api vidhiḥ tadā pratiṣedhaḥ eva na asti evam ca apratiṣedhāt kasyacid paryudāsaḥ api na syāt kvacid kim kāraṇam yadi hi kiṃcid vastu kutaścid nivartteta tadā tad vyatireki nivartamānāt vastunaḥ vyatireki saṃspṛśyeta tad paryudāsena nivartyamāna paryudāsena

original: yathā 'brāhmaṇamānayeti brāhmaṇaparyudāsena kṣatriyādeḥ saṃsparśāt (|) tac ca kasyacinnivartanameva nāsti | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) sarvatra kasyacinnivṛttir bhavatīty uktepi na bhāvavyavacchedaḥ kasyacit pratīyate 'pi tu nivṛttiśabdenāpi kasyacid bhāvasyaiva pratīteḥ |
analyzed: yathā brāhmaṇam ānaya iti brāhmaṇa paryudāsena kṣatriya ādeḥ saṃsparśāt tat ca kasyacid nivartanam eva na asti kim kāraṇam sarvatra kasyacid nivṛttiḥ bhavati iti ukte api na bhāva vyavacchedaḥ kasyacid pratīyate tu nivṛtti śabdena api kasyacid bhāvasya eva pratīteḥ

original: na cānena vādīnā bhāvasya nivṛttiṃ bruvāṇenāpi nivṛttirvaivoktā kintvarthāntarabhāva evoktaḥ syāt | tathā ca yasya paryudāsena yadviviktam ucyate na tayoḥ parasparavivekah siddhḥ | asati ca viveke na paryudāsaḥ | tadanyavivekenānyopādanalakṣaṇatvāt paryudāsasya | tadevaṃ (p. 525) yathoktena prakāreṇa vyatirekābhāvādanvayopi na syāt |
analyzed: na ca anena bhāvasya nivṛttim bruvāṇena api nivṛttiḥ vā eva uktā kintu artha antara bhāvaḥ eva uktaḥ syāt tathā ca yasya paryudāsena yat viviktam ucyate na tayoḥ siddhḥ asati ca viveke na paryudāsaḥ tad anya vivekena anya upādana lakṣaṇa tvāt paryudāsasya tat evam yathā uktena prakāreṇa vyatireka abhāvāt anvayaḥ api na syāt

original: anvayaḥ kasyacid arthasyānugamo vidhānantanna syād ity arthaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tasyānvayasyaikasvabhāvasthitilakṣaṇatvāt | tatsthitiś caikasvabhāvasthitiś ca tasmād anyasya vyatireke parihāre sati syāt | sa ca tadanyavyatireko nāsti tvanmatena | iti evaṃ śabdād apravṛttinivṛttikaṃ jagat syāt | śābdasya vidhipratiṣedhavyavahārasyābhāvaḥ syāt |
analyzed: anvayaḥ kasyacid arthasya anugamaḥ vidhānam tat na syāt iti arthaḥ kim kāraṇam tasya anvayasya eka svabhāva sthiti lakṣaṇa tvāt tad sthitiḥ ca eka svabhāva sthitiḥ ca tasmāt anyasya vyatireke parihāre sati syāt sa ca tad anya vyatirekaḥ na asti tvad matena iti evam śabdāt apravṛtti nivṛttikam jagat syāt śābdasya vidhi pratiṣedha vyavahārasya abhāvaḥ syāt

original: na caivam ity avaśyaṃ kasyacid vyavacchedamātram śabdavācyamabhyupagantavyaṃ |
analyzed: na ca evam iti avaśyam kasyacid vyavaccheda mātram śabda vācyam abhyupagantavyam

original: yataścaivantasmād yasya bhāvasya nāśo bhavatītyucyate sa svayameva na bhavatītyuktaṃ syāt (|) na punar asya dharmāntaraṃ kiñcin nāśo nāma vidhīyate | caitrasya putra ity atra yathā vāstavo bhedas tathā bhāvasya nāśa ity atrāpi vyatirekavibhaktes tulyatvād ity ata āha – netyādi |
analyzed: yatas ca evam tasmāt yasya bhāvasya nāśaḥ bhavati iti ucyate sa svayam eva na bhavati iti uktam syāt na punar asya dharma antaram kiñcid nāśaḥ nāma vidhīyate caitrasya putraḥ iti atra yathā vāstavaḥ bhedaḥ tathā bhāvasya nāśaḥ iti atra api vyatireka vibhakteḥ tulya tvāt iti atas āha na ityādi

original: na vai ghoṣamātreṇa caitrasya putra ity anena śabdena sāmyād viṣayāntaradṛṣṭo vidhiḥ | caitrasya putra ity atra dṛṣṭovidhirvāstavo yaḥ sa sarvatra bhāvasya nāśa ity atrāpi yojanām arhati (|) śabdapravṛttimātreṇa vastuyojanāyā ayogāt |
analyzed: na vai ghoṣa mātreṇa caitrasya putraḥ iti anena śabdena sāmyāt viṣaya antara dṛṣṭaḥ vidhiḥ caitrasya putraḥ iti atra dṛṣṭaḥ vidhiḥ vāstavaḥ yaḥ sa sarvatra bhāvasya nāśaḥ iti atra api yojanām arhati śabda pravṛtti mātreṇa vastu yojanāyāḥ ayogāt

original: etadeva nahītyādinā prāha – kasyacit puruṣasya gardabha iti nāmakaraṇāt bāleyadharmā gardabhasya dharmā manuṣyepi na hi yojyāḥ | tathā na caitrasya putro bhavatītyatra vākye dṛṣṭo vidhirarthāntarasya putrasya vidhānaṃ dṛṣṭam iti nāśepi yojyaḥ | bhāvasya nāśo bhavatīty atrāpi bhāvād vyatireko nāśo vidheyaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) virodhāt |
analyzed: etat eva nahi ityādinā prāha kasyacid puruṣasya gardabhaḥ iti nāmakaraṇāt bāleya dharmāḥ gardabhasya dharmāḥ manuṣye pi na hi yojyāḥ tathā na caitrasya putraḥ bhavati iti atra vākye dṛṣṭaḥ vidhiḥ artha antarasya putrasya vidhānam dṛṣṭam iti nāśe api yojyaḥ bhāvasya nāśaḥ bhavati iti atra api bhāvāt vyatirekaḥ nāśaḥ vidheyaḥ kim kāraṇam virodhāt

original: nāśasyābhāvarūparvādabhāvasya bhavanavirodhādityuktaṃ |
analyzed: nāśasya abhāva rūpa rvāt abhāvasya bhavana virodhāt iti uktam

original: yadi nāśo nārthāntaraṃ kasmād bhāvasya nāśo bhavatītyevam abhidhīyata iti (|)
analyzed: yadi nāśaḥ na artha antaram kasmāt bhāvasya nāśaḥ bhavati iti evam abhidhīyate iti

original: ata āha – evaṃ cetyādi | bhāvasya nāśa ityabhidhānepi prayojanamāveditameva | "arthāntaram iva dharmiṇo dharmaṃ cetasāvibhajya tanmātrajijñāsāyāṃ svabhāva eva tathocyata"1 ityādinā niveditatvāt |
analyzed: atas āha evam ca ityādi bhāvasya nāśaḥ iti abhidhāne api prayojanam āveditam eva artha antaram iva dharmiṇaḥ dharmam cetasā vibhajya tanmātra jijñāsāyām svabhāvaḥ eva tathā ucyate ityādinā nivedita tvāt

original: tasmādabhāvasyākiṃcittvāt tattvānyattvavikalpo na tulyaḥ | ato bhāve (p.526) vastuno bhavane eṣa tattvānyattvavikalpaḥ syāt | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) bhavanasya vidher vastvanurodhataḥ |
analyzed: tasmāt abhāvasya akiṃcittvāt tattva anyattva vikalpaḥ na tulyaḥ atas bhāve vastunaḥ bhavane eṣa tattva anyattva vikalpaḥ syāt kim kāraṇam bhavanasya vidheḥ vastu anurodhataḥ

original: nanv atiśayotpattāv api sa eva tasyātiśaya utpanna iti kathaṃ naṣṭo nāma (|) tena nāyaṃ tadavastho naṣṭo nāma | yena svayaṃ na bhavati | tena naṣṭo nārthāntarotpādādityuktaṃ | na hyatiśayotpattyā svayaṃ na bhūto nāma (|) abhāvasya sarvātiśayopākhyā nivṛttyā sarvabhāvadharmavivekalakṣaṇatvāt | bhāvasya cotpattisamāviśalakṣaṇatvāt |
analyzed: nanu atiśaya utpattau api saḥ eva tasya atiśayaḥ utpannaḥ iti katham naṣṭaḥ nāma tena na ayam tad avasthaḥ naṣṭaḥ nāma yena svayam na bhavati tena naṣṭaḥ na artha antara utpādāt iti uktam na hi atiśaya utpattyā svayam na bhūtaḥ nāma abhāvasya sarva atiśaya upākhyā nivṛttyā sarva bhāva dharma viveka lakṣaṇa tvāt bhāvasya ca utpatti samāviśa lakṣaṇa tvāt

original: bhāva ityādinā byācaṣṭe | bhāvo bhavanam utpāda iti yāvat | sovaśyambhavantamapekṣate | bhavitāramapekṣate (|) bhavitāramantareṇa bhavansyābhāvāt | sa ca bhāvaḥ vyāpāre svabhāva eva vastveva | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) niḥsvabhāvasya kvacid bhavatītyādike samāveśābhāvāt | sambandhābhāvāt | na ca vyāpāro nāmārthāntaraṃ |
analyzed: bhāvaḥ ityādinā byācaṣṭe bhāvaḥ bhavanam utpādaḥ iti yāvat saḥ uvaśyam bhavantam apekṣate bhavitāram apekṣate bhavitāram antareṇa bhavan sya abhāvāt sa ca bhāvaḥ vyāpāre svabhāvaḥ eva vastu eva kim kāraṇam niḥsvabhāvasya kvacid bhavati iti ādike samāveśa abhāvāt sambandha abhāvāt na ca vyāpāraḥ nāma artha antaram

original: kintu vyāpāra iti hi yathābhūtasvabhāvotpattirviśiṣṭasvabhāvotpattiḥ (|) sā cotpattir niḥsvabhāvasya nāśasya kathaṃ syāt |
analyzed: kintu vyāpāraḥ iti hi yathā bhūta svabhāva utpattiḥ viśiṣṭa svabhāva utpattiḥ sā ca utpattiḥ niḥsvabhāvasya nāśasya katham syāt

original: yadi niḥsvabhāvasya nāsti vyāpārasamāveśaḥ katham idānīm bhavaty abhāvaḥ śaśa viṣāṇam ityādivyavahāraḥ śaśaviṣāṇamabhāvo bhavatīti bhavanalakṣaṇena vyāpāreṇa vyavahāra ityarthaḥ | ādiśabdād vandhyāsuto 'bhāvo bhavatīti parigrahaḥ |
analyzed: yadi niḥsvabhāvasya na asti vyāpāra samāveśaḥ katham idānīm bhavati abhāvaḥ śaśa viṣāṇam ityādi vyavahāraḥ śaśa viṣāṇam abhāvaḥ bhavati iti bhavana lakṣaṇena vyāpāreṇa vyavahāraḥ iti arthaḥ ādi śabdāt vandhyā sutaḥ bhāvaḥ bhavati iti parigrahaḥ

original: netyādinā pariharati | na vai śaśaviṣāṇaṃ kiṃcid abhāvonyadvā bhavatīti vidhinocyate | api tvevam iti śaśaviṣāṇamabhāvo bhavatīty anena vākyenāsyeti śaśaviṣāṇasyābhāvo bhavati (|) bhāvo na bhavatīti bhāvapratiṣedhaeva kriyate | api ca vyavaharttāraḥ puruṣāḥ | etacchaśaviṣāṇādikamevamabhāvo bhavatīti vyāpāravadiva samāropyādarśayanti |
analyzed: na ityādinā pariharati na vai śaśa viṣāṇam kiṃcid abhāvaḥ nyat vā bhavati iti vidhinā ucyate api tu evam iti śaśa viṣāṇam abhāvaḥ bhavati iti anena vākyena asya iti śaśa viṣāṇasya abhāvaḥ bhavati bhāvaḥ na bhavati iti bhāva pratiṣedhaḥ eva kriyate api ca vyavaharttāraḥ puruṣāḥ etat śaśa viṣāṇa ādikam evam abhāvaḥ bhavati iti vyāpāra vat iva samāropya ādarśayanti

original: kenacit prakaraṇena | kiṃ śaśaviṣāṇādikamabhāvo bhavati na bhavatīti prastāvasamāśrayeṇa | na tu tacchaśaviṣāṇādikamabhāvo bhavati na bhavatīti prastāvasamāśrayeṇa | na tu tacchaśaviṣāṇādikaṃ vyavahāramātreṇatathā vyāpārayuktambhavati | yasmāt sarvārthavivecanaṃ sarvorthasvabhāvavirahastatra śaśaviṣāṇādau tattvaṃ |
analyzed: kenacid prakaraṇena kim śaśa viṣāṇa ādikam abhāvaḥ bhavati na bhavati iti prastāva samāśrayeṇa na tu tat śaśa viṣāṇa ādikam abhāvaḥ bhavati na bhavati iti prastāva samāśrayeṇa na tu tat śaśa viṣāṇa ādikam vyavahāra mātreṇa tathā vyāpāra yuktam bhavati yasmāt sarva artha vivecanam sarva ūrtha svabhāva virahaḥ tatra śaśa viṣāṇa ādau tattvam

original: na tvasataḥ kasyacid bhavanādeḥ samāveśaḥ |
analyzed: na tu asataḥ kasyacid bhavana ādeḥ samāveśaḥ

original: (p. 527) sahetukopi vināśa evam bhaviṣyatīti cedāha – netyādi | evaṃ śaśaviṣāṇavat sarvārthavirahalakṣaṇo vināśah pareṣṭaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) vastuni tasya vināśasya bhāvād utpatteḥ | yaś ca bhavati sa kathamabhāvo virodhāt |
analyzed: sa hetukaḥ api vināśaḥ evam bhaviṣyati iti ced āha na ityādi evam śaśa viṣāṇa vat sarva artha viraha lakṣaṇaḥ para iṣṭaḥ kim kāraṇam vastuni tasya vināśasya bhāvāt utpatteḥ yaḥ ca bhavati sa katham abhāvaḥ virodhāt

original: yadi punarasāvai vināśo niḥsvabhāva eva kevalaṃ vaktṛbhirevambhavatīti vyāpāravāniva khyāpyate | na tu svayantathābhavanadharmā nīrūparvād asya | tadaivam iṣyamāṇe 'bhāvo bhavatīty api bruvāṇena | na kiñcid bhavatītīṣṭameva | kriyāpratiṣedhamātratvād asya vākyasya |
analyzed: yadi punar asau vai vināśaḥ niḥsvabhāvaḥ eva kevalam vaktṛbhiḥ evam bhavati iti vyāpāravān iva khyāpyate na tu svayam tathābhavana dharmā nīrūpa rvāt asya tadā evam iṣyamāṇe bhāvaḥ bhavati iti api bruvāṇena na kiñcid bhavati iti iṣṭam eva kriyā pratiṣedha mātra tvāt asya vākyasya

original: tasmāt svayamanadhyāropitenākāreṇa kvacid vastuni bhavan svabhāvo vikalpadvayaṃ nātivarttete tattvamanyattvaṃ ceti prakārāntarābhāvāt °|| (280)
analyzed: tasmāt svayam anadhyāropitena ākāreṇa kvacid vastuni bhavan svabhāvaḥ vikalpa dvayam na ativarttete tattvam anyat tvam ca iti prakāra antara abhāvāt

original: rūpādiskandhasvabhāvaḥ pudgalo na bhavatyahta ca rūpādibhyo nānyaḥ | tasma tattvānyattvam ativarttata eva svabhāva iti cet |
analyzed: rūpa ādi skandha svabhāvaḥ pudgalaḥ na ca rūpa ādibhyaḥ na anyaḥ tattva anyattvam ativarttate eva svabhāvaḥ iti ced

original: tanna (|) yasmādatattvamevātatsvabhāvatvameva svabhāvasyānyattvam iti |
analyzed: tat na yasmāt atattvam eva a tad svabhāva tvam eva svabhāvasya anya tvam iti

original: yadi pudgalopi na skandhasvabhāvastadā skandhebhyonya eva | yato na hi prasiddhānyattvayo rūparasayorapy anyad eva parasparamanyattvaṃ (|) kintvatatsvabhāvatvam evānyattvantac ca pudgalepy astīti sopi skandhebhyonya eveṣṭavyaḥ |
analyzed: yadi pudgalaḥ api na skandha svabhāvaḥ tadā skandhebhyaḥ nyaḥ eva yatas na hi prasiddha anyattvayoḥ rūpa rasayoḥ api anyat eva parasparam anyattvam kintu atatsvabhāvatvam eva anyattvam tat ca pudgala ipi asti iti saḥ api skandhebhyaḥ nyaḥ eva iṣṭavyaḥ

original: nanvatatsvabhāvatvepi parasparaṃ svabhāvāpratibandhonyattvam iti cet | sa capratibandhaḥ pudgalasya skandheṣvasti tato tatsvabhāvatvepi nānyattvaṃ skandhebhyaḥ pudgalasyeti |
analyzed: nanu atatsvabhāva tve pi parasparam svabhāva apratibandhaḥ nyattvam iti ced sa ca pratibandhaḥ pudgalasya skandheṣu asti tad svabhāva tve pi na anyattvam skandhebhyaḥ pudgalasya iti

original: koyamityādinā pratiṣedhati | koyaṃ pratibandho nāma pudgalasya skandheṣu yena pratibandhena | sa ca nasyād iti skandhasvabhāś capudgalo na syāt | nānyasvabhāvaś ca skandhebhyaḥ | anyaḥ svabhāvosyeti | vigrahaḥ |
analyzed: kaḥ yam ityādinā pratiṣedhati kaḥ yam pratibandhaḥ nāma pudgalasya skandheṣu yena pratibandhena sa ca na syāt iti skandha svabhāḥ ca pudgalaḥ na syāt na anya svabhāvaḥ ca skandhebhyaḥ anyaḥ svabhāvaḥ asya iti vigrahaḥ

original: skandhebhyaḥ pudgalasya janma tad eva janma pratibandha iti cet |
analyzed: skandhebhyaḥ pudgalasya janma tat eva janma pratibandhaḥ iti ced

original: (p.528) evaṃ sati kāryatvāt skandhebhyaḥ pudgalasya tattvānyattvenāvācyatvam iṣṭaṃ | tathā ca sati sarvakāraṇānāmparasparamavācyatā syāt | tathā ceti kāryatvādavācyatve | sarvaḥ sarvasya kathaṃcid iti sākṣāt pāramparyeṇa copayogīti sarvatra kāryakāraṇabhāvānna ca kaścit  kutaścid anyaḥ syāt |
analyzed: evam sati kārya tvāt skandhebhyaḥ pudgalasya tattva anya tvena avācya tvam iṣṭam tathā ca sati sarva kāraṇānām parasparam avācya tā syāt tathā ca iti kārya tvāt avācya tve sarvaḥ sarvasya kathaṃcid iti sākṣāt pāramparyeṇa ca upayogī iti sarvatra kārya kāraṇa bhāvāt na ca kaścid kutaścid anyaḥ syāt

original: evaṃ cānantaroktenāvācyatālakṣaṇenāvācyatetyapi bruvatā kāryakāraṇabhāva eva śabdāntareṇoktaḥ syānnārthabhedaḥ kaścit | anyattvantu na niṣiddhan eva | yasmāt svabhāvayoḥ parasparamananugamanamamiśrībhavanamanyattvambrūmaḥ | sa ca svabhāvānanugamaḥ svabhāvavatāṃ sarvapadārthānāmastyeveti parasparamanyattvam eva |
analyzed: evam ca anantara uktena avācyatā lakṣaṇena avācyatā iti api bruvatā kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ eva śabda antareṇa uktaḥ syāt na artha bhedaḥ kaścid anyattvam tu na eva yasmāt svabhāvayoḥ parasparam ananugamanam amiśrībhavanam anyattvam brūmaḥ sa ca svabhāva ananugamaḥ svabhāvavatām sarva padārthānām asti eva iti parasparam anyattvam eva

original: na cānyaḥ pratibandhaḥ pudgalasya skandheṣu | yasmānna hi janmalakṣaṇājjanmasvabhāvāt svabhāvapratibandhādanyaḥ pratibando nāma | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) anāyattasya tadutpattyā tatrāpratibanddhasya | tena saha yo vyabhicārastasyāvirodhāt | tatopratibandhāt pudgalsyaskandhebhyonyattvaṃ | dharmabhedāc cānyattvaṃ |
analyzed: na ca anyaḥ pratibandhaḥ pudgalasya skandheṣu yasmāt na hi janma lakṣaṇāt janma svabhāvāt svabhāva pratibandhāt anyaḥ pratibandaḥ nāma kim kāraṇam anāyattasya tad utpattyā tatra apratibanddhasya tena saha yaḥ vyabhicāraḥ tasya avirodhāt dharma bhedāt ca anya tvam

original: tathā hy avācyatvam pudgalasya dharmaḥ skandhānāntu parasparamvācyatvam iti dharmabhedaḥ |
analyzed: tathā hi avācya tvam pudgalasya dharmaḥ skandhānām tu parasparam vācya tvam iti dharma bhedaḥ

original: yadyapi na janmakṛtaḥ pratibandhastathāpi pudgalasya skandheṣu jñānakṛtaḥ pratibandha iti cet |
analyzed: yadi api na janma kṛtaḥ pratibandhaḥ tathā api pudgalasya skandheṣu jñāna kṛtaḥ pratibandhaḥ iti ced

original: syād ityādinaitad eva yajjñānaṃ yasya pudgalasya jñānaṃ | tadgatāv iti rūpādigatau niyamena tasya pudgalasya pratibhāsanāt | jñānakṛtaḥ pratibandhastathā hi rūpaśabdādigrahaṇenaiva pudlagrahaṇam iṣyate | cakṣurādivijñānavijñeyatvāt pudgalasyeti | tena jñānakṛtāt pratibandhāt |
analyzed: syāt ityādinā etat eva yat jñānam yasya pudgalasya jñānam tad gatau iti rūpa ādi gatau niyamena tasya pudgalasya pratibhāsanāt jñāna kṛtaḥ pratibandhaḥ tathā hi rūpa śabda ādi grahaṇena eva pudla grahaṇam iṣyate cakṣuḥ ādi vijñāna vijñeya tvāt pudgalasya iti tena jñāna kṛtāt pratibandhāt

original: tatpudgalākhyamvastu skandhebhyonyattvenāvācyamatadrūpam apy askandhasvabhāvam api |
analyzed: tat pudgala ākhyam vastu api a skandha svabhāvam api

original: netyādinā pratiṣedhati | na pudgalasya rūpādipratipattināntarīyakaṃ jñānaṃ | kiṃ (p. 529) kāraṇaṃ (|) tasya pudgalasya rūpādisvabhāvamapahāya niḥsvabhāvatvāt svayaṃ | yasmāt sa eva hi tasya svabhāvo yo rūpādirūpaḥ pratibhāti |
analyzed: na ityādinā pratiṣedhati na pudgalasya rūpa ādi pratipatti nāntarīyakam jñānam kim p 529 kāraṇam tasya pudgalasya rūpa ādi svabhāvam apahāya niḥsvabhāva tvāt svayam yasmāt saḥ eva hi tasya svabhāvaḥ yaḥ rūpa ādi rūpaḥ pratibhāti

original: athārūpādisvabhāvaḥ pudgalaḥ | tadā'rūpādisvabhāvatve 7sya pudgalasyātadvadrūpādivat pṛthakpratibhāvaprasaṅgāt | na ca pratibhāsate tato nāstyeva pudgalaḥ | yato dṛśyasyāpratibhāsamānasya cābhāvāt | athādṛśyaḥ pudgala iṣṭate (|) tadā adṛśyatvepi pudgalasyeṣyamāṇe na tadrūpaṃ jñānanna pudgalākāraṃ jñānam iti kasya kimāyattā pratītiḥ |
analyzed: atha arūpa ādi svabhāvaḥ pudgalaḥ tadā arūpa ādi svabhāva tve pudgalasya a tadvat rūpa ādi vat pṛthak pratibhāva prasaṅgāt na ca pratibhāsate tatas na asti eva pudgalaḥ yatas dṛśyasya a pratibhāsamānasya ca abhāvāt atha adṛśyaḥ pudgalaḥ iṣṭate tadā adṛśya tve pi pudgalasya iṣyamāṇe na tad rūpam jñānam na pudgala ākāram jñānam iti kasya kim āyattā pratītiḥ

original: na rūpādijñānanāntarīyakaṃ pudgalajñānam ity arthaḥ | tathā ca na jñānakṛtaḥ pratibandha iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: na rūpa ādi jñāna nāntarīyakam pudgala jñānam iti arthaḥ tathā ca na jñāna kṛtaḥ pratibandhaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: rūpadyāyattapratītitvād eva pṛthak pudgalo na pratibhāsata iti ced (|)

original: nanv ityādi paraḥ | sarvākārebhyo hetubhyo janma yeṣāmbhāvānānte naśyantītīdamapyaniśceyameva | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) tāsāṃ hetusāmagrīṇāmarvāgdarśanairaniḥśeṣadarśanāt sākalyenādarśanāt | kasyāścit sāmagrayā naśvarajanikāyā darśanādadṛṣṭā api tajjātīyatayā tathā bhūtā niścīyanta iti ced (|)
analyzed: nanu ityādi paraḥ sarva ākārebhyaḥ hetubhyaḥ janma yeṣām bhāvānām ante naśyanti iti idam api aniśceyam eva kim kāraṇam tāsām hetu sāmagrīṇām arvāk darśanaiḥ aniḥśeṣa darśanāt sākalyena adarśanāt kasyāścid sāmagrayāḥ naśvara janikāyāḥ darśanāt adṛṣṭāḥ api tad jātīya tayā tathā bhūtāḥ niścīyante iti ced

original: (p. 5.34) āha vicitretyādi | vicitrā śaktiryāsāmiti vigrahaḥ | sāmāgryo dṛśyante | tatra vicitraśaktiṣu sāmagrīṣu madhye kācit sāmagrī syādapi yā bhāvamanaśvarātmānaṃ janyet |
analyzed: āha vicitra ityādi vicitrā śaktiḥ yāsām iti vigrahaḥ sāmāgryaḥ dṛśyante tatra vicitra śaktiṣu sāmagrīṣu madhye kācid sāmagrī syāt api yā bhāvam anaśvara ātmānam janyet

original: netyādinā pariharati | ayaṃ ca parihāro nāśasvabhāvo bhāvānāṃ nānutpattimatāṃ | yadītyatrapicodye draṣṭavyaḥ sādhāraṇatvāt | nāyandoṣaḥ (|) kasmāt (|) jñeyādhikārāt |
analyzed: na ityādinā pariharati ayam ca parihāraḥ nāśa svabhāvaḥ bhāvānām na anutpattimatām yadi iti atra api codye draṣṭavyaḥ sādhāraṇa tvāt na ayan doṣaḥ kasmāt jñeya adhikārāt

original: etadeva spaṣṭayannāha – ye kadācit kāle kvacid deśe kenacit puruṣeṇārthā jñātāḥ santaḥ punarna jñāyante teṣāṃ santānānubandhī nāśa iti brūmaḥ | ye cājñātāḥ santo jñāyante jñātā vā unar na jñāyante (| ) ta eva kṛtakā anityāssādhyante | anena cakṛtakatvasya kṣaṇikatvena vyāptiḥ sattvādityanena viścīyata ity uktam bhavati |
analyzed: etat eva spaṣṭayan āha ye kadācid kāle kvacid deśe kenacid puruṣeṇa arthāḥ jñātāḥ santaḥ punar na jñāyante teṣām santāna anubandhī nāśaḥ iti brūmaḥ ye ca ajñātāḥ santaḥ jñāyante jñātāḥ vā unar na jñāyante te eva kṛtakāḥ anityāḥ sādhyante anena ca kṛtaka tvasya kṣaṇika tvena vyāptiḥ sattvāt iti anena viścīyate iti uktam bhavati

original: nanu ca yadyapi te jñātāssanto na jñāyante tathāpi kathanteṣāmanityatvam iti (|)
analyzed: nanu ca yadi api te jñātāḥ santaḥ na jñāyante tathā api katham teṣām anitya tvam iti

original: ata āha – yasmānna hy asti sambhavo yat te jñānajananasvabhāvāḥ pūrvampunaranaṣṭāstasminneva svabhāve sthitā na janayeyuḥ |
analyzed: atas āha yasmāt na hi asti sambhavaḥ yat te jñāna janana svabhāvāḥ pūrvam punar anaṣṭāḥ tasmin eva svabhāve sthitāḥ na janayeyuḥ

original: sahakāryabhāvānnajanayantīti ced (|)
analyzed: sahakāri abhāvāt na janayanti iti ced

original: āha – apekṣerannāparaṃ | na hyasya sambhavostīti sambandhaḥ | kiṃkāraṇaṃ (|) tajjananasvabhāvasya niṣpannatvāt |
analyzed: āha apekṣeran na aparam na hi asya sambhavaḥ asti iti sambandhaḥ kiṃkāraṇam tad janana svabhāvasya niṣpanna tvāt

original: atha syāt (|) teṣvanapekṣeṣv api kasyacit kadācijjñānaṃ nivartteta | sarvasyasarvadā svaviṣayāṇi jñānāni janayeyuḥ | na caivam | kadācit jñānadarśanāt | tataś ca jñānamajanayanto janakasvabhāvāt pracyutā iti gamyate |
analyzed: atha syāt teṣu anapekṣeṣu api kasyacid kadācid jñānam nivartteta sarvasya sarvadā sva viṣayāṇi jñānāni janayeyuḥ na ca evam kadācid jñāna darśanāt tatas ca jñānam a janayantaḥ janaka svabhāvāt pracyutāḥ iti gamyate

original: yattarhyajñeyaṃ kṛtakamakṛtakamvā tannaivambhaviṣyatīti (|)
analyzed: yat tarhi ajñeyam kṛtakam akṛtakam vā tat na evam bhaviṣyati iti

original: ata āha – naityādi | na caivaṃbhūtamajñeyaṃ kiṃcidasti | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) sarvasyārthasya kenacit puruṣeṇa kadāciñjñānāt | atha tajjñānam api na janayet | tadā (p.535) jñānamātrārthakriyāyām apu asāmarthye tatsāmarthyarahitambastveva na syāt | tathā hi tallakṣaṇamarthakriyāsāmarthyalakṣaṇamvastv iti vakṣyāmaḥ |
analyzed: atas āha na etyādi na ca evaṃbhūtam ajñeyam kiṃcid asti kim kāraṇam sarvasya arthasya kenacid puruṣeṇa kadācid jñānāt atha tat jñānam api na janayet tadā asāmarthye tad sāmarthya rahitam bastu eva na syāt tathā hi tad lakṣaṇam arthakriyā sāmarthya lakṣaṇam vastu iti vakṣyāmaḥ

original: tasya cārthaktiyāsamarthasya vastunaḥ krameṇārthkriyāṃ kurvato vināśāvyabhicārādahetutvācca vināśasyasattānubandhī vināśaḥ siddhaḥ | ata evānantaroktāt sarvabhāvānāṃ kṣaṇikatvasādhanācchabdārthayossambandhasyāpi nityatā pratyākhyeyā | dūṣyā |
analyzed: tasya ca artha ktiyā samarthasya vastunaḥ krameṇa arthkriyām kurvataḥ vināśa avyabhicārāt ahetu tvāt ca vināśasya sattā anubandhī vināśaḥ siddhaḥ atas eva anantara uktāt sarva bhāvānām kṣaṇika tva sādhanāt śabda arthayoḥ sambandhasya api nitya tā pratyākhyeyā dūṣyā

original: (ne)tyādinā vyācaṣṭe | ata eva yathoktād vināśasya vastumātrānubandhāt | śabdavad (|) yathā śabdasya nityatā pratikṣiptā tadvat sambandhasyāpi nityatā pratyākhyeyā | evantāvat sambandhaṃ vyatiriktamabhyupagamya doṣa ukto 'dhunā 'vyatirikta eva sambandho na yujyata iti (|)
analyzed: na ityādinā vyācaṣṭe atas eva yathā uktāt vināśasya vastu mātra anubandhāt śabda vat yathā śabdasya nitya tā pratikṣiptā tadvat sambandhasya api nitya tā pratyākhyeyā evantāvat sambandham vyatiriktam abhyupagamya doṣaḥ uktaḥ dhunā vyatiriktaḥ eva sambandhaḥ na yujyate iti

original: āha – yā ca śabdaktiryogyatākhyā yogyatāsaṃjñitārthapratipattyāśrayo jaiminīyairvarṇṇyate | sā yogyatāśabdārthāntaram eva na bhavati | tathā hi bhāvānāṃsvabhāvātiśaya eva vivakṣitārthakriyāsamartho yogyatetyāveditaṃ prāk | "samarthaṃ hi rūpaṃ śabdasya yogyate" tyādinā |
analyzed: āha yā ca śabda ktiḥ yogyatā ākhyā yogyatā saṃjñita artha pratipatti āśrayaḥ jaiminīyaiḥ varṇṇyate sā yogyatā śabda artha antaram eva na bhavati tathā hi bhāvānām svabhāva atiśayaḥ eva vivakṣita artha kriyā samarthaḥ yogyatā iti āveditam prāk samartham hi rūpam śabdasya yogyatā tyādinā

original: tena śabdasyānityatve yogyatāyā apy anityatvam avyatirekād iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: tena śabdasya anitya tve yogyatāyāḥ api anitya tvam avyatirekāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: (p.536) astu vā śabdād arthāntaraṃ yogyatā | tathāpi śabdaśaktiś ca dūṣitā veditavyā | kaiḥ (|) sambandhadoṣaiḥ prāguktaiḥ |
analyzed: astu vā śabdāt artha antaram yogyatā tathā api śabda śaktiḥ ca dūṣitā veditavyā kaiḥ sambandha doṣaiḥ prāguktaiḥ

original: ukto hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | sambandhaḥ sambandhibhyorthantaram ity evamvāde 'nekaprakāro doṣa uktaḥ |
analyzed: uktaḥ hi ityādinā vyācaṣṭe sambandhaḥ iti evam vāde neka prakāraḥ doṣaḥ uktaḥ

original: "sambandhināmanityatvānna sambandhesti nityatā" ityādinā | tenaiva prāguktena doṣeṇa śabdaśaktir api sambandharūpeṇa kalpitā dūṣiteti kṛtvā na punaḥ pṛthagucyate doṣaḥ |
analyzed: sambandhinām anitya tvāt na sambandheḥ ati nitya tā ityādinā tena eva prāguktena doṣeṇa śabda śaktiḥ api sambandha rūpeṇa kalpitā dūṣitā iti kṛtvā na punar pṛthak ucyate doṣaḥ

original: tadevaṃ nāpauruṣeyo vedaḥ |
analyzed: tat evam na apauruṣeyaḥ vedaḥ

original: bhavatu nāmāpauruṣeyastathāpi na tasya satyārthatā niścetuṃ śakyā | yasmādapauruṣeyamityeva kṛtvā na vaidikamvacanaṃ yathārthajñānasādhanaṃ | aviparītārthajñānahetuḥ | yasmāt puruṣāgasā puruṣadoṣeṇāduṣṭo vahnyādinā (|) ādiśabdājjyotsnādiḥ (|) anyathāpi dṛṣṭo vitathājñānaheturdṛṣṭa ity arthaḥ |
analyzed: bhavatu nāma apauruṣeyaḥ tathā api na tasya satya artha tā niścetum śakyā yasmāt apauruṣeyam iti eva kṛtvā na vaidikam vacanam yathārtha jñāna sādhanam aviparīta artha jñāna hetuḥ yasmāt puruṣa āgasā puruṣa doṣeṇa aduṣṭaḥ vahni ādinā ādi śabdāt jyotsnā ādiḥ anyathā api dṛṣṭaḥ vitatha ajñāna hetuḥ dṛṣṭaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: bhavatvityādinā vyācaṣṭe | bhavantu nāmāpauruṣeyā vaidikāḥ śabdāstathāpi sambhāvyamevaiṣāṃ vaidikānāṃ śabdānāmayathārthajñānahetutvam | yato na hi puruṣadoṣopadhānādeva | puruṣadoṣe rāgādibhirupadhānāt | saṃskārādeva | artheṣu jñāpyeṣu jñāpakānāṃ śabdānāṃ jñānavibhramo jñānaviparyāsaḥ | prakṛtyāpi mithyājñājajananasyasambhāvyatvāt |
analyzed: bhavatu ityādinā vyācaṣṭe bhavantu nāma apauruṣeyāḥ vaidikāḥ śabdāḥ tathā api sambhāvyam eva eṣām vaidikānām śabdānām ayathārtha jñāna hetutvam yatas na hi puruṣa doṣa upadhānāt eva puruṣa doṣe rāga ādibhiḥ upadhānāt saṃskārāt eva artheṣu jñāpyeṣu jñāpakānām śabdānām jñāna vibhramaḥ jñāna viparyāsaḥ prakṛtyā api mithyā jñā ja jananasya asambhāvya tvāt

original: yasmāt tadrahitānāmapi puruṣadoṣopadhānarahitānāmapi pradīpādīnāmvitathārthajñānjananāt | ādiśabdājjyotsnādīnāṃ (|) kutra (|) nīlo tpalādiṣu | tathā hi ratrau pratīpo nīlotpale raktapratibhāsajñānahetuḥ | jyotsnāpīte vastre śuklajñānahetuḥ |
analyzed: yasmāt tad rahitānām api puruṣa doṣa upadhāna rahitānām api pradīpa ādīnām vitatha artha jñān jananāt ādi śabdāt jyotsnā ādīnām kutra nīlo tpala ādiṣu tathā hi ratrau pratīpaḥ nīlotpale rakta pratibhāsa jñāna hetuḥ jyotsnā pīte vastre śukla jñāna hetuḥ

original: taditi tasmād ime vaidikāḥ śabdāḥ puruṣasaṃskāranirapekṣāḥ syuriti sambandhaḥ prakṛtyā ca svabhāvena cārtheṣu pratītihetavo jñānahetavaḥ syuḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) svabhāvaviśeṣāt svarūpaviśeṣāt | kimiva (|) vahnyādivat | (p. 537) vitathavyaktayaś ca syurniyamena | vitathā vyaktayorthapratipattayo yebhyaḥ śabdebhya iti vigrahaḥ |
analyzed: tat iti tasmāt ime vaidikāḥ śabdāḥ puruṣa saṃskāra nirapekṣāḥ syuḥ iti sambandhaḥ prakṛtyā ca svabhāvena ca artheṣu pratīti hetavaḥ jñāna hetavaḥ syuḥ kim kāraṇam svabhāva viśeṣāt svarūpa viśeṣāt kim iva vahni ādi vat p 537 vitatha vyaktayaḥ ca syuḥ niyamena vitathāḥ vyaktayaḥ artha pratipattayaḥ yebhyaḥ śabdebhyaḥ iti vigrahaḥ

original: vitathavyaktaya eva sadā vaidikāḥ śabdā ity asyaviyamasya kāraṇaṃ nāsi (|) tato niyamakāraṇābhāvād vitathavyaktaya eva vaidikāḥ śabdā ityetat kalpanamayuktam iti cet | tavāpimīmāṃsakasyāvitathajñānahetavo vaidikāḥ śabdā ity asminnavitathavyaktiniyame kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) naiva kiñcit |
analyzed: vitatha vyaktayaḥ eva sadā vaidikāḥ śabdāḥ iti asya a viyamasya kāraṇam na asi tatas niyama kāraṇa abhāvāt vitatha vyaktayaḥ eva vaidikāḥ śabdāḥ iti etat kalpanam ayuktam iti ced tava api mīmāṃsakasya avitatha jñāna hetavaḥ vaidikāḥ śabdāḥ iti asmin avitatha vyakti niyame kim kāraṇam na eva kiñcid

original: tasmāt tvanmatena yathārthavyaktiniyamatvāt prakṛtyā svabhāvenāyathārthavyakriniyamaḥ kinnakalpyate |
analyzed: tasmāt tvad matena yathārtha vyakti niyama tvāt prakṛtyā svabhāvena ayathārtha vyakri niyamaḥ

original: athavā yathā vahnyādayo ghaṭādiṣu nīlotpalādiṣu cārtheṣu yathāyogaṃ satyāsatyajñājahetavastathā vaidikānāṃ śabdānāmartheṣu mithyetarajñānaheturvenobhayajñānahetutvaṃ syāt | yasmānnahyapauruṣeyā api vahnyādayo vanadavacandrālokādirūpāḥ |
analyzed: athavā yathā vahni ādayaḥ ghaṭa ādiṣu nīlotpala ādiṣu ca artheṣu yathāyogam satya asatya jñāja hetavaḥ tathā vaidikānām śabdānām artheṣu mithyā itara jñāna hetuḥ vena ubhaya jñāna hetu tvam syāt yasmāt na hi apauruṣeyāḥ api vahni ādayaḥ vana dava candrāloka ādi rūpāḥ

original: ekatra ghaṭādau divā yathārthajñānahetavopi santaḥ sarvatra nīlotpalādāvapi rātrautathā bhavanti yathārthajñānahetavo bhavanti | tathā vaidikānāṃ śabdānāmapyapuruṣeyatvepyubhayaṃ syāt | yathārthāyathārthajñānahetutvaṃ syāt |
analyzed: ekatra ghaṭa ādau divā yathārtha jñāna hetavaḥ api santaḥ sarvatra nīlotpala ādau api rātrau tathā bhavanti yathārtha jñāna hetavaḥ bhavanti tathā vaidikānām śabdānām api apuruṣeya tve pi ubhayam syāt yathārtha ayathārtha jñāna hetu tvam syāt

original: bhavatvityādi paraḥ | vahnyādīnāṃ kṛtakatvāt kāraṇād yathāpratyayaṃ yasya na punarnityeṣu śabdeṣvetat sahakāripratyayabalena mithyājñānahetutvamasti | nityānāṃ sahakāribalenānyathā pravṛttyasambhavāt |
analyzed: bhavatu ityādi paraḥ vahni ādīnām kṛtaka tvāt kāraṇāt yathāpratyayam yasya na punar nityeṣu śabdeṣu etat sahakāri pratyaya balena mithyājñāna hetu tvam asti nityānām sahakāri balena anyathā pravṛtti asambhavāt

original: nanvityādi siddhāntavādī | evaṃvidha iti sahakāribalenārtheṣyanyathā parivṛttilakṣaṇostyeva dharmmaḥ (|) tatrāpīti vaidikeṣv api śabdeṣu | kiṃkāraṇaṃ (|) teṣām api vaidikānāṃ saṃdetabalādanyathāvṛtteḥ puruṣecchānuvidhāyisaṃketabalenānyathā pratītijananād ity arthaḥ |
analyzed: nanu ityādi siddhāntavādī evaṃvidhaḥ iti sahakāri balena artheṣu anyathā parivṛtti lakṣaṇaḥ usti eva dharmmaḥ tatra api iti vaidikeṣu api śabdeṣu kiṃkāraṇam teṣām api vaidikānām puruṣa icchā anuvidhāyi saṃketa balena anyathā pratīti jananāt iti arthaḥ

original: atha saṃketabalānna teṣāmartheṣu parāvṛttiriṣyate | kintu nityatvāt svabhāvata eva svaviṣayajñānajananasvabhāvā vaidikāḥ śabdāḥ | tadā kāryasya svaviṣayajñānasya (p.538) yo jananasvabhāvastatra sthitau caiṣāṃ vaidikānāṃ śabdānāṃ samayādeḥ (|) ādiśabdād anyasyāpi karaṇavyāpārāder apekṣaṇīyasyābhāvāt kāraṇāt |
analyzed: atha saṃketa balāt na teṣām artheṣu parāvṛttiḥ iṣyate kintu nitya tvāt svabhāvataḥ eva sva viṣaya jñāna janana svabhāvāḥ vaidikāḥ śabdāḥ tadā kāryasya sva viṣaya jñānasya yaḥ janana svabhāvaḥ tatra sthitau ca eṣām vaidikānām śabdānām samaya ādeḥ ādi śabdāt anyasya api karaṇa vyāpāra ādeḥ apekṣaṇīyasya abhāvāt kāraṇāt

original: tato vaidikāccabdāt pratītir jñānam artheṣu sarvasya puṃsaḥ sarvadā syāt | na cāsti sarvasya sarvadārthapratītiḥ | tasmānna vaidikāḥ śabdā arthapratītipratiṣṭhitasvabhāvāḥ kintu samayādikamapekṣyanta eveti | tepi mithyājñānasya hetava iti tadavastho doṣaḥ |
analyzed: tatas vaidikāt śabdāt pratītiḥ jñānam artheṣu sarvasya puṃsaḥ sarvadā syāt na ca asti sarvasya sarvadā artha pratītiḥ tasmāt na vaidikāḥ śabdāḥ artha pratīti pratiṣṭhita svabhāvāḥ kintu samaya ādikam apekṣyante eva iti te api mithyājñānasya hetavaḥ iti tad avasthaḥ doṣaḥ

original: api ca (|) tasmin śabde 'kṛtake mate iṣṭe sati na jñānahetutaiva syāt | yasmānna hi nityebhyo vastusāmarthyāt svarūpopadhānasāmarthyena janmāsti kasyacit | jñānasyānyasya vā (|)
analyzed: api ca tasmin śabde kṛtake mate iṣṭe sati na jñāna hetu tā eva syāt yasmāt na hi nityebhyaḥ vastu sāmarthyāt sva rūpa upadhāna sāmarthyena janma asti kasyacid jñānasya anyasya vā

original: yadyakṛtaka ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | yadyakṛtakaśśabdo vaidikastatortheṣu pratītir eva na syāt | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) pratītīryādi | itaradajanmājanma ca itaracceti vigrahaḥ | tayoḥ kālo pratīter janmetarakālayos tukyarūpasya nityatvādekarūpasya pratītir janmani sāmarthyasambhāvanā 'yogāt |
analyzed: yadi akṛtakaḥ ityādinā vyācaṣṭe yadi akṛtakaḥ śabdaḥ vaidikaḥ tatas ṛtheṣu pratītiḥ eva na syāt kim kāraṇam pratītīrya ādi itarat ajanma ajanma ca itarat ca iti vigrahaḥ tayoḥ pratīteḥ janma itara kālayoḥ nitya tvāt eka rūpasya pratītiḥ janmani sāmarthya sambhāvanā yogāt

original: pratīterajanmakāle yattasya janakaṃ rūpantasminneva svabhāve sthitasya janakatvavirodhāt | kiṃ kāranam (|) evam anena rūpeṇāyaṃ nityābhimato janako naivamanena rūpeṇājanaka ityevam vivecanīyasya pṛthag vyavasthāpy asya rūpabhedasya svabhāvabhedasyābhāvāt | nityasya sarvadaikarūpatvāt |
analyzed: pratīteḥ a janma kāle yat tasya janakam rūpam tasmin eva svabhāve sthitasya janaka tva virodhāt kim evam anena rūpeṇa ayam nitya abhimataḥ janakaḥ na evam anena rūpeṇa ajanakaḥ iti evam vivecanīyasya pṛthak asya rūpa bhedasya svabhāva bhedasya abhāvāt nityasya sarvadā eka rūpa tvāt

original: ekasvabhāvopi pūrvajanakaḥ paścājjanako bhaviṣyatīti ced (|)
analyzed: eka svabhāvaḥ api pūrva janakaḥ paścāt janakaḥ bhaviṣyati iti ced

original: āha netyādi | asya nityasyājanako yādṛśaḥ svabhāvastādṛśa eva janako na yuktaḥ | ekarūpatvāt | sahakāriṇamadhikaṃ prāpya paścājjanayatītyādi mithyā | yatonyāpekṣāpi sahakāryapekṣāpi nityasya niṣiddhaiva prāk |
analyzed: āha na ityādi asya nityasya ajanakaḥ yādṛśaḥ svabhāvaḥ tādṛśaḥ eva janakaḥ na yuktaḥ eka rūpa tvāt sahakāriṇam adhikam prāpya paścāt janayati ityādi mithyā yatas nya apekṣā api sahakāri apekṣā api nityasya niṣiddhā eva prāk

original: yata evantasmānnityānāṃ śabdānāṃ kvacid artheṣu puruṣe jñānajananasāmarthyaṃ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) kadācijjñānasyājanane sati paścādai tatsvabhāvatvānnityamajananaprasaṅgāt |
analyzed: yatas evam tasmāt nityānām śabdānām kvacid artheṣu puruṣe jñāna janana sāmarthyam kim kāraṇam kadācid jñānasya ajanane sati tad svabhāva tvāt nityam ajanana prasaṅgāt

original: atha mābhūdeṣa doṣa iti nityaṃ svakāryaṃ kurvantyevetīṣyate |
analyzed: atha mā abhūt eṣa doṣaḥ iti nityam sva kāryam kurvanti eva iti iṣyate

original: (p. 539) tadapi nāsti | svaviṣayajñānakāryasya sātatyādarśanāc ca | na te śabdāḥ kathaṃcit kenacit prakāreṇa karttāra ityetac coktaṃ prak |
analyzed: tat api na asti sva viṣaya jñāna kāryasya sātatya adarśanāt ca na te śabdāḥ kathaṃcid kenacid prakāreṇa karttāraḥ iti etat ca uktam prak

original: syād etat (|) nityebhyopyākāśādibhyo buddhayo bhavantyeva kasyacit kadācid iti (|)
analyzed: syāt etat nityebhyaḥ api ākāśa ādibhyaḥ buddhayaḥ bhavanti eva kasyacid kadācid iti

original: ata āha – yā apyetā nityābhimateṣv ākāśādeṣu pratipattayo buddhayo bhaviṣyantītīṣyate | tā api na tatsvabhāvabhāvinyo nākāśādisvabhāvāyattajanmānaḥ | nityānāṃ kramayaugapadyābhyāmarthkriyāvirodhāt |
analyzed: atas āha yāḥ api etāḥ nitya abhimateṣu ākāśa ādeṣu pratipattayaḥ buddhayaḥ bhaviṣyanti iti iṣyate tāḥ api na tad svabhāva bhāvinyaḥ na ākāśa ādi svabhāva āyatta janmānaḥ nityānām krama yaugapadyābhyām arth kriyā virodhāt

original: kim punarutpattau tāsāṃ nimittam iti (|)
analyzed: kim punarutpattau tāsām nimittam iti

original: āha – na hītyādi | anādiḥ samānajātīyo yo vikalpastenāhitā yā vāsanā śaktistata udbhūtā utpannā | yathāgamaṃ samāropito ya ākāśādyākārastadgocarāstatpratibhāsinya eva kevalaṃ gatāḥ | tatra bāhyatvena kalpiteṣv ākāśādiṣu jāyante | na tu tā buddhayor thagocarā nākāśādisvalakṣaṇaviṣayāḥ |
analyzed: āha na hi ityādi anādiḥ samāna jātīyaḥ yaḥ vikalpaḥ tena āhitā yā vāsanā śaktiḥ tatas udbhūtā utpannā yathāgamam samāropitaḥ yaḥ ākāśa ādi ākāraḥ tad gocarāḥ tad pratibhāsinyaḥ eva kevalam gatāḥ tatra bāhya tvena kalpiteṣu ākāśa ādiṣu jāyante na tu tāḥ buddhayoḥ tha gocarāḥ na ākāśa ādi sva lakṣaṇa viṣayāḥ

original: svalakṣaṇetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | svalakṣaṇaviṣayā hi buddhir niyamena tasya svalakṣaṇasya yogyatā sāmarthyantasyopasthānaṃ sannidhānantadanuvidhāyinī tadbhāva eva bhāvinīti kṛtvā | asyā buddher yat kāraṇaṃ svalakṣaṇaṃ yogyaṃ samarthantasmin kāraṇeyogye sati sābuddhirbhavatyeva |
analyzed: sva lakṣaṇa ityādinā vyācaṣṭe sva lakṣaṇa viṣayā hi buddhiḥ niyamena tasya sva lakṣaṇasya yogyatā sāmarthyam tasya upasthānam sannidhānam tad anuvidhāyinī tad bhāvaḥ eva bhāvinī iti kṛtvā asyāḥ buddheḥ yat kāraṇam sva lakṣaṇam yogyam samarthan tasmin kāraṇe yogye sati sā abuddhiḥ bhavati eva

original: tadevaṃ nyāye sthite yadi nityānāṃ padārthānāṃ svalakṣaṇe kasyacit puṃso jñānaṃ syāt | tadā nityaṃ kāraṇasya sannidhāt sarvasya puṃsaḥ sarvadā syāt |
analyzed: tat evam nyāye sthite yadi nityānām padārthānām sva lakṣaṇe kasyacid puṃsaḥ jñānam syāt tadā nityam kāraṇasya sannidhāt sarvasya puṃsaḥ sarvadā syāt

original: nāpi sahakāryapekṣayā nityānāṃ kasyacit kadācijjñānajananantathā hi kāryo janayaḥ sahakāribhir viśeṣo yāsāṃ vyaktīnāntā hi vyaktayaḥ kathaṃciddeśakālāvasthāniyamena kvacit kārye upayujyamānā hetutvam pratipadyamānāstasya kāryasyopajanane (p. 540) yogyo yotiśaya ātmabhūtastasya pralambhe hetumbastuviśeṣaṃ sahakāriṇam iti yāvat |
analyzed: nā api sahakāri apekṣayā nityānām kasyacid kadācid jñāna jananam tathā hi kāryaḥ janayaḥ sahakāribhiḥ viśeṣaḥ yāsām vyaktīnām tāḥ hi vyaktayaḥ kathaṃcid deśa kāla avasthā niyamena kvacid kārye upayujyamānāḥ hetu tvam pratipadyamānāḥ tasya kāryasya upajanane yogyaḥ ātma bhūtaḥ tasya pralambhe hetum bastu viśeṣam sahakāriṇam iti yāvat

original: tathetyanityatvavat | nityo bhāvo kāryaviśeṣonādheyātiśayaḥ kenacit puṃsā gṛhyamāṇastatkāraṇāpekṣaḥ grahaṇasahakārikāraṇāpikṣo yadi grahaṇam asya puṃso janayet | yuktaṃ yatenaiva puṃsā gṛhyeta nānyena sahakāripratiniyamāt | tac ca sahakāryapekṣayā  jananaṃ nityasya na sambhavati | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) sthitasvabhāvatvād |
analyzed: tathā iti anitya tva vat nityaḥ kārya viśeṣaḥ na ādheya atiśayaḥ kenacid puṃsā gṛhyamāṇaḥ tad kāraṇa apekṣaḥ grahaṇa sahakāri kāraṇa apikṣaḥ yadi grahaṇam asya puṃsaḥ janayet yuktam yatena eva puṃsā gṛhyeta na anyena sahakāri pratiniyamāt tat ca sahakāri apekṣayā jananam nityasya na sambhavati kim kāraṇam sthita svabhāva tvāt

original: niytasya sahakāriṇā nādheyātiśayatvād iti yāvat |
analyzed: niytasya sahakāriṇā na ādheya atiśaya tvāt iti yāvat

original: tataś ca nityaṃ jananasvabhāve sthitatvāt sarveṇa puṃsā samamekakālaṃ gṛhyetātha sarveṇājanakatvānna gṛhyeta | tadā sa evāsya svabhāva iti na vā kenacit puruṣeṇa kadācid gṛhyeta | iti hetos san nidyamāno nityo bhāvo yadi kenacit yogināpi dṛṣṭastadā na kaścinnityo 'tīndriyaḥ syāt sarveṣāmavaśyaṃ kenacid darśanāt |
analyzed: tatas ca nityam janana svabhāve sthita tvāt sarveṇa puṃsā samam eka kālam gṛhyeta atha sarveṇa ajanaka tvāt na gṛhyeta tadā saḥ eva asya svabhāvaḥ iti na vā kenacid puruṣeṇa kadācid gṛhyeta iti hetoḥ san nidyamānaḥ nityaḥ bhāvaḥ yadi kenacid yoginā api dṛṣṭaḥ tadā na kaścid nityaḥ atīndriyaḥ syāt sarveṣām avaśyam kenacid darśanāt

original: tathā cāsu nityaṃ sarvapuruṣāṇām indriyagrāhya eva syāt sarvapuruṣamprati jñānajananasāmarthyāviśeṣāt | na cedaṃ sarvapuruṣagrāhyatvannityasyāsti | tasmādarthasāmarthyānapekṣā ākāśādisvalakṣaṇasāmarthyānapekṣakāḥ samāropitagocarāḥ | yathāgamamadhyāropitā 'kāśādyākārapratibhāsinya ity arthaḥ |
analyzed: tathā ca āsu nityam sarva puruṣāṇām indriya grāhyaḥ eva syāt sarva puruṣam prati jñāna janana sāmarthya aviśeṣāt na ca idam sarva puruṣa grāhya tvat nityasya asti tasmāt artha sāmarthya anapekṣāḥ ākāśa ādi sva lakṣaṇa sāmarthya anapekṣakāḥ samāropita gocarāḥ yathāgamam adhyāropitā kāśa ādi ākāra pratibhāsinyaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: āntaramevopādānakāraṇamāśityadīdṛśaṃ vikalpavāsanāprabodhaṃ | ākāśādivikalpanānāditā | yā āhitā vāsanā tasyāḥ prabodhaḥ kāryotpādanaṃ pratyābhimukhyaṃ | yata evārthasāmarthyānapekṣā ata eva bāhyārthśūnyā bhrāntaya evākāśādiṣu sarvasya puṃso bhavnti |
analyzed: āntaram eva upādānakāraṇam āśityat īdṛśam vikalpa vāsanā prabodham ākāśa ādi vikalpanā nāditā yā āhitā vāsanā tasyāḥ prabodhaḥ kārya utpādanam prati ābhimukhyam yatas eva artha sāmarthya anapekṣā atas eva bāhya artha śūnyāḥ bhrāntayaḥ eva ākāśa ādiṣu sarvasya puṃsaḥ bhavnti

original: sthitam etat (|) nāsti nityebhyaḥ kāryotpāda iti | śabdāttu dṛśyate kadācijjñānakāryantasmānnāparāvṛttidharmāṇaḥ śabdāḥ | ekarūpatāyāṃ aparāvṛttireva dharmo yeṣām iti vigrahaḥ | kintu jñānaṃ jñānaṃ pratyarthā bhinnavṛttya eva |
analyzed: sthitam etat na asti nityebhyaḥ kārya utpādaḥ iti śabdāt tu dṛśyate kadācid jñāna kāryam tasmāt na aparāvṛtti dharmāṇaḥ śabdāḥ eka rūpa tāyām aparāvṛttiḥ eva dharmaḥ yeṣām iti vigrahaḥ kintu jñānam jñānam prati arthāḥ bhinna vṛttyaḥ eva

original: atha nityam ekarūpā eva tadā ttatve vā | ekarūpatve vā'bhyupagamyamāne 'vitathārthapratītaya eva vaidikāḥ śabdā iti kuta etat | avitathā arthapratītir yebhya iti vigrahaḥ |
analyzed: atha nityam eka rūpāḥ eva tadā tta tve vā eka rūpa tve vā abhyupagamyamāne vitatha artha pratītayaḥ eva vaidikāḥ śabdāḥ iti kutas etat avitathā artha pratītiḥ yebhyaḥ iti vigrahaḥ

original: (p. 541) syānmatam (|) "agnirhimasya bheṣajam" ityādivaidikavākyasyāvitathatvāt sarvasyāvitathatvam iti (|)
analyzed: syāt matam agniḥ himasya bheṣajam ityādi vaidika vākyasya avitatha tvāt sarvasya avitatha tvam iti

original: ata āha – na hītyādi | na hyagnirhim asya bheṣajaṃ pratipakṣa ityevamādiṣu vedavākyeṣvagneḥ śītapratighātasāmarthyamvedavākyāt | prāgapi yathāsaṃketam lokaprasiddhaṃ khyāpyata iti kṛtvā sarvam adṛṣṭārtham api vedavākyantathā bhavati | avitathambhavati | lokaprasiddhe hyarthe lokasya samketānusāreṇa vyavahāro dṛṣṭaḥ |
analyzed: atas āha na hi ityādi na hi agniḥ him asya bheṣajam pratipakṣe iti evamādiṣu veda vākyeṣu agneḥ śīta pratighāta sāmarthyam veda vākyāt prāk api yathāsaṃketam loka prasiddham khyāpyate iti kṛtvā sarvam adṛṣṭa artham api veda vākyam tathā bhavati avitatham bhavati loka prasiddhe hi arthe lokasya samketa anusāreṇa vyavahāraḥ dṛṣṭaḥ

original: tatolokasya svecchākṛto yah saṃketastenānu paścād vyavahārakāle vyavahārakāle vyavahārāt | sandeha eva kimayaṃ lekaḥ svasaṃketamanuvidadhat | anusaran |
analyzed: sva icchā kṛtaḥ saṃketaḥ tena anu paścāt vyavahāra kāle vyavahāra kāle vyavahārāt sandehaḥ eva kim ayam lekaḥ sva saṃketam anuvidadhat anusaran

original: agnirhimasya bheṣajamityādivākyādevampratyetyagneḥ śītāpanodasāmarthyam iti niścinotyāhosvicchabdasvabhāvasthiteḥ śabdasya svabhāvena prakṛtyā sāmarthyaniyamādevaṃ pratyetīti | yadā ca dṛṣṭa evārthe vaidikasya śabdasya svatorthapratipādanaśktissandigdhā tadātyantaparokṣepyarthe nitarāṃ sambhāvyata iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: agniḥ himasya bheṣajam ityādi vākyāt evam pratyā iti agneḥ śīta apanoda sāmarthyam iti niścinoti āhosvit śabda svabhāva sthiteḥ śabdasya svabhāvena prakṛtyā sāmarthya niyamāt evam pratyeti iti yadā ca dṛṣṭe eva arthe vaidikasya śabdasya svatas ṛtha pratipādana śktiḥ sandigdhā tadā atyanta parokṣe api arthe nitarām sambhāvyate iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanvanādilokaprasiddhyanuvidhānevaiva vaidikānāṃ śabdānāmarthavattā na ca tatra sandehaḥ pratibhāsata iti (|)
analyzed: nanu anādi loka prasiddhi anuvidhānā iva eva vaidikānām śabdānām arthavat tā na ca tatra sandehaḥ pratibhāsate iti

original: ata āha – lokecchayā parāvarttyamānā yathāsamayamartheṣu niveśyamānāḥ punar anyatra deśādiparāvṛttāvanyathetyarthāntaraniveśena parāvartyamānāḥ śabdā dṛśyante | iti hetor lokaprasiddhyānuvidhānepyaṅgīkriyamāṇe sambhavatyevaiṣāṃ vaidikānāṃ śabdānāmanyathābhāvo mithyātvaṃ | prasiddherevāniyatatvāt |
analyzed: atas āha loka icchayā parāvarttyamānāḥ yathāsamayam artheṣu niveśyamānāḥ punar anyatra deśa ādi parāvṛttau anyathā iti artha antara niveśena parāvartyamānāḥ śabdāḥ dṛśyante iti hetoḥ loka prasiddhyā anuvidhāne api aṅgīkriyamāṇe sambhavati eva eṣām vaidikānām śabdānām anyathābhāvaḥ mithyātvam prasiddheḥ eva aniyata tvāt
