original: akṛtakatvādeva satyārthatvam iti ced (|)
analyzed: akṛtaka tvāt eva satya artha tvam iti ced

original: (p. 542) āha – akṛtakasvabhāvatvehyeṣāṃ vaidikānāṃ śabdānāṃ mithyārthaniyatopi kaścicchabdaḥ syāt | iti hetoḥ svabhāvaparijñānadayaṃ  satyārtho yaṃ mithyārtha ityevaṃ vivekena śabdasvabhāvāniścayāt sarvatra śabde saṃśayaḥ syāt | satyārthm vaidikamvākyam akṛtakatvāditi prayoge kriyamāṇenvayābhāvāt |
analyzed: āha akṛtaka svabhāva tve hi eṣām vaidikānām śabdānām mithyā artha niyataḥ api kaścid śabdaḥ syāt iti hetoḥ svabhāva parijñāna dayam satya arthaḥ yam mithyā arthaḥ iti evam vivekena śabda svabhāva aniścayāt sarvatra śabde saṃśayaḥ syāt satya artham vaidikam vākyam akṛtaka tvāt iti prayoge kriyamāṇe nvaya abhāvāt

original: vyatirekiprayogamāha – mithyātvam ityādinā | mithyātvaṃkṛtakeṣveva dṛṣṭam iti hetor akṛtakamvacaḥ satyārthaṃ yadīti sambandhaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) vyatirekesya virodhivyāpanāt | akṛtakasya hetoryo vyatirekaḥ kṛtakatvantena satyārthatvaṃ yatsādhyantasya vidodhimithyātvantasya vyāpanāt | vyatirekasyeti karttari ṣaṣṭhī |
analyzed: vyatireki prayogam āha mithyātvam ityādinā mithyātvam kṛtakeṣu eva dṛṣṭam iti hetoḥ akṛtakam vacaḥ satya artham yadi iti sambandhaḥ kim kāraṇam vyatireka isya virodhi vyāpanāt akṛtakasya hetoḥ yaḥ vyatirekaḥ kṛtaka tva antena satya artha tvam yat sādhya antasya vidodhi mithyātva antasya vyāpanāt vyatirekasya iti karttari ṣaṣṭhī

original: hetuvyatirekeṇa kṛtakatvena satyārthavirodhino mithyārthatvasya vyāptatvāt | vaidike śabdo 'kṛtakatvāt kṛtakatvanivṛttau mithyārthtvanivṛtteḥ satyārthatvaṃ sidhyatveva |
analyzed: hetu vyatirekeṇa kṛtaka tvena satya artha virodhinaḥ mithyārtha tvasya vyāpta tvāt vaidike śabdo kṛtaka tvāt kṛtaka tva nivṛttau mithyārth tva nivṛtteḥ satya artha tvam sidhyatu eva

original: yathetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | yatkiñcinmithyārthamvacaḥ tadakhilanniḥśeṣaṃ kṛtakam iti kṛtvā | hetorakṛtakatvasya vyatirekeṇa kṛtakatvena sādhyavyatirekasya | sādhyaṃ satyārthatvaṃ tasya vyatireko mithyātvantasya vyāpteranyatrākṛtake mithyārthatvasyāsambhavāt kāraṇād akṛtakaṃ satyārtham iti syād vināpyanvayena |
analyzed: yathā ityādinā vyācaṣṭe yat kiñcid mithyārtham vacaḥ tat akhilat niḥśeṣam kṛtakam iti kṛtvā hetoḥ akṛtaka tvasya vyatirekeṇa kṛtaka tvena sādhya vyatirekasya sādhyam satyārtha tvam tasya vyatirekaḥ mithyātvam tasya vyāpteḥ anyatra akṛtake mithyārtha tvasya asambhavāt kāraṇāt akṛtakam satya artham iti syāt vinā api anvayena

original: satyārtham vaidikamvaco kṛtakatvād ity atra prayoge yadyapyanvayo nāsti | tathāpyanvayena vinā sidhyaty evety arthaḥ | yasmād yo hy artho mithyātvalakṣaṇo yena kṛtakatvenāvyāptastatra mithyātve tadvyatirekastasyāvyāpakasya kṛtakatvasya vyatireko kṛtakatvena mithyārthatāyā vyāpyteḥ |
analyzed: satya artham kṛtaka tvāt iti atra prayoge yadi api anvayaḥ na asti tathā api anvayena vinā sidhyati eva iti arthaḥ yasmāt yaḥ hi arthaḥ mithyātva lakṣaṇaḥ yena kṛtaka tvena avyāptaḥ tatra mithyātve tad vyatirekaḥ tasya avyāpakasya kṛtaka tvasya vyatirekaḥ kṛtaka tvena mithyārtha tāyāḥ vyāpyteḥ

original: na ca viruddhasya sambhavo yato na ca viruddhayoḥ kṛtakatvākṛtakatvayorekatra mithyātve sambhavosti | tenākṛtake satyārthatvaṃ vijātīyasya mithyārthatvasyāsambhave | satyārthamithyārthatvābhyāṃ nānyā gatirastīta gatyantarābhāvādakṛtakatvena satyārtha eva bhavitavyam ity akṛtakatvād iṣṭā(p. 543)rthasya satyārthatvalakṣaṇasya siddheḥ kimanvayena |
analyzed: na ca viruddhasya sambhavaḥ yatas na ca viruddhayoḥ kṛtaka tva akṛtaka tvayoḥ ekatra mithyātve sambhavaḥ usti tena akṛtake satya artha tvam vijātīyasya mithyārtha tvasya asambhave satyārtha mithyārtha tvābhyām na anyā gatiḥ asti ita gati antara abhāvāt akṛtaka tvena satya arthe eva bhavitavyam iti akṛtaka tvāt satya artha tva lakṣaṇasya siddheḥ kimanvayena

original: tatsādhanatvāc ca liṅgasya iṣṭārthasādhanatvāc ca liṅgasya vyarthamanvayadarśanaṃ | kasmād (|) yathoktavidhinā vyatirekamātreṇaiva sādhyasiddher iti |
analyzed: tad sādhana tvāt ca liṅgasya iṣṭārtha sādhana tvāt ca liṅgasya vyartham anvaya darśanam kasmāt yathā ukta vidhinā vyatireka mātreṇa eva sādhya siddheḥ iti

original: sattyametadityā cāryaḥ |
analyzed: sattyam etat iti ā cāryaḥ

original: vipakṣāddhetor vyatireke siddhe sati sādhyaṃ sidhyediti sattyametat | yadi sattyārthatā 'kṛtakatvavipakṣayor mithyātvakṛtakatvayor vyāpyavyāpakabhāvaḥ sidhyet | tadā kṛtakatvena vyāptān mithyārthatvādakṛtakannivartate | sa tu vyāpyavyāpakabhāvo vipakṣayor na siddhaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ |
analyzed: vipakṣāt hetoḥ vyatireke siddhe sati sādhyam sidhyet iti sattyam etat yadi sattyārthatā kṛtaka tva vipakṣayoḥ mithyātva kṛtaka tvayoḥ vyāpya vyāpaka bhāvaḥ sidhyet tadā kṛtaka tvena vyāptāt mithyārtha tvāt akṛtakat nivartate sa tu vyāpya vyāpaka bhāvaḥ vipakṣayoḥ na siddhaḥ kim kāraṇam

original: yasmāt mithyātve 'kṛtakatvasyāsambhave 'sambhavanimittaṃ bādhake hetāvanukte sati | bhāvassattvantasyāpyakṛtakatvasya mithyātve śakyate | akṛtakaṃ ca syānmithyārthaṃ ceti | (290 ab)
analyzed: yasmāt mithyātve kṛtaka tvasya asambhave sambhava nimittam bādhake hetau anukte sati bhāvaḥ sattu antasya api akṛtaka tvasya mithyātve śakyate akṛtakam ca syāt mithyārtham ca iti

original: nanu ca mithyātve kṛtakatvaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ (|) yatra ca kṛtakatvantatra kathamakṛtakatvam iti (|)
analyzed: nanu ca mithyātve kṛtaka tvam dṛṣṭam yatra ca kṛtaka tvam tatra katham akṛtaka tvam iti

original: ata āha – viruddhānāmityādi | viruddhānām api padārthānām ekavyāpakadarsanāt | yathā prayatnāprayatnanāntarīyakāṇāmanityānāmekena kṛtakatvena vyāptiḥ |
analyzed: atas āha viruddhānām ityādi viruddhānām api padārthānām eka vyāpaka darsanāt yathā prayatna aprayatna nāntarīyakāṇām anityānām ekena kṛtaka tvena vyāptiḥ

original: yadītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | yadyakṛtakatvākhyāsya hetossādhyavipakṣe mithyārthatve 'bhāvaḥ sidhyettadā sādhyasya satyārthatvasya vyatirekaṃ mithyātvaṃ hetuvyatirekaḥ hetorakṛtakatvasya vyatirekaḥ kṛtakatvākhyo vyāpnuyāt | na ca tasyākṛtakatvasya tatra mithyārthatāyāmasambhave bādhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ paśyāmaḥ |
analyzed: yadi ityādinā vyācaṣṭe yadi akṛtaka tva ākhyā asya hetoḥ sādhya vipakṣe mithyārthatve bhāvaḥ sidhyet tadā sādhyasya satya artha tvasya vyatirekam mithyātvam hetu vyatirekaḥ hetoḥ akṛtaka tvasya vyatirekaḥ kṛtaka tva ākhyaḥ vyāpnuyāt na ca tasya akṛtaka tvasya tatra mithyārthatāyām asambhave bādhakam pramāṇam paśyāmaḥ

original: akṛtakatvād eva vedasya mithyārthatāyāmavṛttir iti ced (|)
analyzed: akṛtaka tvāt eva vedasya mithyārtha tāyām avṛttiḥ iti ced

original: āha na cetyādi | mithyārthatvenāviruddhasyākṛtatvasya vidhirmithyārthatā pratiṣedhasya sādhano yuktaḥ | kasmād (|) atiprasaṅgāt | evaṃ hi yasya kasyacid vidhānena yasya kasyacidabhāvaḥ pratīyeta |
analyzed: āha na ca ityādi mithyārtha tvena aviruddhasya akṛta tvasya vidhiḥ mithyārthatā pratiṣedhasya sādhanaḥ yuktaḥ kasmāt atiprasaṅgāt evam hi yasya kasyacid vidhānena yasya kasyacid abhāvaḥ pratīyeta

original: kṛtake dṛṣṭasya mithyātvasyākṛtake kathaṃ vṛttir iti ced (|)
analyzed: kṛtake dṛṣṭasya mithyātvasya akṛtake katham vṛttiḥ iti ced

original: āha – na caikatra kṛtake dṛṣṭasya mithyātvasya punar anyatrākṛtake 'sambhava eva (|) kintu sambhava eva | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) pṛthagviruddhasahabhāvināmpṛthag iti (p. 544) vyaktibhedena viruddhasahabhāvināmviruddhairarthair ekatra bhāvinām api darśanāt | anityatvavat prayatnānantarīyaketarayoritaradaprayatnānantarīyakaṃ |
analyzed: āha na ca ekatra kṛtake dṛṣṭasya mithyātvasya punar anyatra akṛtake sambhavaḥ eva kintu sambhavaḥ eva kim kāraṇam pṛthak viruddha sahabhāvinām pṛthak iti vyakti bhedena viruddha sahabhāvinām viruddhaiḥ arthaiḥ ekatra bhāvinām api darśanāt anitya tva vat prayatna ānantarīyaka itarayoḥ itarat aprayatna ānantarīyakam

original: anityatvaṃ prayatnānantarīyakatvena saha dṛṣṭamaprayatnānarīyakatvena saha dṛśyate |
analyzed: anitya tvam prayatna ānantarīyaka tvena saha dṛṣṭam aprayatna ānarīyaka tvena saha dṛśyate

original: yadyevamakṛtake mithyātvasyādarśanādabhāvaḥ sayād iti (|)
analyzed: yadi evam akṛtake mithyātvasya adarśanāt abhāvaḥ iti

original: ata āha – na ca tathāvidhasyetyakṛtakasya sato mithyātvasyādarśanādasatvameva |
analyzed: atas āha na ca tathāvidhasya iti akṛtakasya sataḥ mithyātvasya adarśanāt asatvam eva

original: yasmānna vipakṣe hetorasattāsiddhiḥ sarvatonupalambhanādity uktaṃ prāk | tataś cāsiddhāyāṃ vipakṣāddhetor asattāyāṃ sandigdhavipakṣād vyatirekitā |
analyzed: yasmāt na vipakṣe hetoḥ asattā siddhiḥ sarvatas nupalambhanāt iti uktam prāk tatas ca asiddhāyām vipakṣāt hetoḥ asattāyām sandigdha vipakṣāt vyatireki tā

original: na hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | ayam yuruṣamātraka ityarvāgdarśī sarvamvastu draṣṭuṃ samartho yenāsya puṃso darśananivṛttyā na tathā syāt | adṛṣṭo na syāt | yasmād (|) yasya hi puṃso jñānaṃ jñeyasattāṃ na vyabhicarati |
analyzed: na hi ityādinā vyācaṣṭe ayam iti arvāc darśī sarvam vastu draṣṭum samarthaḥ yena asya puṃsaḥ darśana nivṛttyā na tathā syāt adṛṣṭaḥ na syāt yasmāt yasya hi puṃsaḥ jñānam jñeya sattām na vyabhicarati

original: sad ity eva kṛtva yasya sarvasmin jñ(jñe?)ye jñānaṃ pravartate tasya jñānaṃ jñeyavyāpakaṃ nivartamānaṃ jñeyam api nivartamānaṃ jñeyamapi nivartayati | atosāvadarśanānnāstītyevaṃ vruvāṇaḥ śobheta | na sarvam (|) tad iti | tasmād (|) ime bhāvāḥ santopyanupalakṣyāḥ apohyāḥ syuḥ | kathaṃ (|) svabhāvadeśakālaviprakarṣeṇa |
analyzed: sat iti eva kṛtvā yasya sarvasmin jñjñeye jñānam pravartate tasya jñānam jñeya vyāpakam nivartamānam jñeyam api nivartamānam jñeyam api nivartayati atas asau adarśanāt na asti iti evam vruvāṇaḥ śobheta na sarvam tat iti tasmāt ime bhāvāḥ santaḥ api anupalakṣyāḥ apohyāḥ syuḥ katham svabhāva deśa kāla viprakarṣeṇa

original: svabhāvaś ca deśaś ca kālaś ca tairviprakarṣo vyavadhānam iti vigrahaḥ | sannapi kaściddeśakālābhyāṃ svabhāvena ca viprakaṛṣṭaḥ piśācādivat | (291)
analyzed: svabhāvaḥ ca deśaḥ ca kālaḥ ca taiḥ viprakarṣaḥ vyavadhānam iti vigrahaḥ san api kaścid deśa kālābhyām svabhāvena ca viprakaṛṣṭaḥ piśāca ādi vat

original: nanu kālavyavahitānāmatitānāgatānāmanupalambhādasatvaṃ yuktamabhāvādeva | satyaṃ (|) kevalamatītānāgatānāmedānīmanupalambhepi kadācit sattvaṃ bhūtaṃ kadācid bhaviṣṭatīty anupalambhābhāva iti |
analyzed: nanu kāla vyavahitānām atitānām anāgatānām anupalambhāt asatvam yuktam abhāvāt eva satyam kevalam atīta anāgatānām edānīm anupalambhe pi kadācid sattvam bhūtam kadācid bhaviṣṭati iti anupalambha abhāvaḥ iti

original: tathā hītyādinaitadeva bodhayati | ko hyasarvadarśī | atyantaparokṣerthe vacanasyākṛtakasya samvādanaṃ itarasya kṛtakasya vacanasyātyantaparokṣerthe | itaradvetyasambādanaṃ bhāvayituṃ niścetuṃ samarthaḥ (|) naiva | pareṇa kṛtakasyāsamvādanam iṣṭam iti dvayam uktaṃ |
analyzed: tathā hi ityādinā etat eva bodhayati kaḥ hi asarva darśī atyanta parokṣa irthe vacanasya akṛtakasya samvādanam itarasya kṛtakasya vacanasya atyanta parokṣa irthe itarat vā iti asambādanam bhāvayitum niścetum samarthaḥ na eva pareṇa kṛtakasya asamvādanam iṣṭam iti dvayam uktam

original: (p. 545) syād etad (|) ekasya vedavākyasya samvādadarśanāt sarvatra vede samvādanam iti (|)
analyzed: syāt etat ekasya veda vākyasya samvāda darśanāt sarvatra vede samvādanam iti

original: ata āha – pratipāditaṃ caitaccheṣavadanumānacintāyāṃ pūrvam eva | kiṃ pratipāditam ity āha – kvacid ityādi | kvacid deśakāle vā | tathetyetena prakāreṇa dṛṣṭānāmarthānāṃ punar anyathābhāvaḥ | pūrvadṛṣṭākārād vaiparītyaṃ | etadevāḥ | yathetyādi saṃskāraviśeṣāt kṣīramadhvādipariṣkā(rā)dilakṣaṇāt |
analyzed: atas āha pratipāditam ca etat śeṣavat anumāna cintāyām pūrvam eva kim pratipāditam iti āha kvacid ityādi kvacid deśa kāle vā tathā iti etena prakāreṇa dṛṣṭānām arthānām punar anyathābhāvaḥ pūrva dṛṣṭa ākārāt vaiparītyam etat evāḥ yathā ityādi saṃskāra viśeṣāt kṣīra madhu ādi pariṣkāra ādi lakṣaṇāt

original: āmalakīphalāni ca kvaciddeśe madhurāṇīti sambandhaḥ | na cedanīmataddarśinā | madhuranimbaphalādyadarśinā | tāni madhurāṇi nimbaphalāni pratikṣeptavyānyeva | tathā vedavākyānāmmithyātvaṃ yadi nāma dṛṣṭantathāpi na śakyampratikṣeptuṃ | tasmādakṛtakaṃ ca syānmithyārthaṃ cetyakṛtakamithyārthatvayorna virodhampaśyāmaḥ |
analyzed: āmalakī phalāni ca kvacid deśe madhurāṇi iti sambandhaḥ na madhura nimba phala ādi adarśinā tāni madhurāṇi nimba phalāni pratikṣeptavyāni eva tathā veda vākyānām mithyātvam yadi nāma dṛṣṭan tathā api na śakyam pratikṣeptum tasmāt akṛtakam ca syāt mithyā artham ca iti akṛtaka mithyā artha tvayoḥ na virodham paśyāmaḥ

original: nanu mithyārthatāyāmakṛtakatvasyānupalambhādabhāva ity ata āha – na hīyam anupalabdhiradṛśyātmasvadṛśyasvabhāvertheṣvabhāvasya sādhiketyuktaṃ prāk | yataś cākṛtakatvasya na mithyātve 'bhāvaḥ siddhaḥ | tena yat kiṃcinmithyātvantatsarvaṃ pauruṣeyaṃ | iti evammithyārthatvasya kṛtakatvenāvyāptiḥ | kiṅkāraṇamaniścayāt |
analyzed: nanu mithyārthatāyām akṛtaka tvasya anupalambhāt abhāvaḥ iti atas āha na hi iyam anupalabdhiḥ adṛśya ātma sva dṛśya svabhāveḥ ṛtheṣu abhāvasya sādhikā iti uktam prāk yatas ca akṛtaka tvasya na mithyātve bhāvaḥ siddhaḥ tena yat kiṃcid mithyātvam tat sarvam pauruṣeyam iti evam mithyārtha tvasya kṛtaka tvena avyāptiḥ kiṅkāraṇam aniścayāt

original: akṛtakatvasya mithyārthatve vyatirekāniścayādityarthaḥ | na cāniścitavyatirekāddheto ssakāśāt sādhyasiddhiḥ |
analyzed: akṛtaka tvasya mithyārtha tve vyatireka aniścayāt iti arthaḥ na ca aniścita vyatirekāt hetoḥ sakāśāt sādhya siddhiḥ

original: tathā hi svasādhyena hetoranvayo vyāptiḥ | vyatireko vā vipakṣād vyāvṛttir vā | satvaṃ vā hetoḥ sādhyadharmiṇi | pakṣadharmmam ity arthaḥ | etāni ca trīṇi rūpāṇi jñānaiḥ pramāṇair yadi saidhyanti kīdṛśaistanniścayaphalaustasya rūpatrayasya niścayaḥ phalaṃ yeṣām iti vighraḥ | tadā tāni trīṇi rūpāṇi vavakṣitasya sādhyasya sādhanambhavanti |
analyzed: tathā hi sva sādhyena hetoḥ anvayaḥ vyāptiḥ vyatirekaḥ vā vipakṣāt vyāvṛttiḥ vā satvam vā hetoḥ sādhya dharmiṇi pakṣa dharmmam iti arthaḥ etāni ca trīṇi rūpāṇi jñānaiḥ pramāṇaiḥ yadi saidhyanti kīdṛśaiḥ tad niścaya phalauḥ tasya rūpa trayasya niścayaḥ phalam yeṣām iti vighraḥ tadā tāni trīṇi rūpāṇi sādhanam bhavanti

original: yathoktamācārya dignāgena | ya eva hyubhayaniścitavācī | vādiprativādibhyāṃ niścitasya hetulakṣaṇayuktasyārthasya vācakaḥ sa sādhanandūṣaṇam vā ashiddhatvādilakṣaṇayuktasyārthasya vācakaḥ śabdaḥ prativādinā dūṣaṇābhiprāyeṇa prayuktaḥ |
analyzed: yathā uktam ācārya dignāgena yaḥ eva hi ubhaya niścita vācī vādi prativādibhyām niścitasya hetu lakṣaṇa yuktasya arthasya vācakaḥ sa vā ashiddha tva ādi lakṣaṇa yuktasya arthasya vācakaḥ śabdaḥ prativādinā dūṣaṇa abhiprāyeṇa prayuktaḥ

original: nānyataraprasiddhaḥ sandigdhavādo vādiprativādibhyāmanyataraprasiddhasya sandigdhasya cobhayoranyatarasya ca yo vācakaḥ śabdaḥ sa na sādhanaṃ (p. 546) nāpi dūṣaṇaṃ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) punaḥ sādhanāpikṣatvāt | aniścitasya niścayārthaṃ punaḥ pramāṇāpekṣatvāt |
analyzed: na anyatara prasiddhaḥ sandigdha vādaḥ vādi prativādibhyām anyatara prasiddhasya sandigdhasya ca ubhayoḥ anyatarasya ca yaḥ vācakaḥ śabdaḥ sa na sādhanam na api dūṣaṇam kim kāraṇam punar aniścitasya niścaya artham punar pramāṇa apekṣa tvāt

original: na cākṛtakatvena saha mithyārthatvasya virodho niścito yenākṛtake mithyātvasya vyatirekaḥ siddhaḥ syāt |
analyzed: na ca akṛtaka tvena saha mithyārtha tvasya virodhaḥ niścitaḥ yena akṛtake mithyātvasya vyatirekaḥ siddhaḥ syāt

original: atha syād (|) akṛtakatvādeva vede mithyātvaṃ na bhavatīti ced (|)
analyzed: atha syāt akṛtaka tvāt eva vede mithyātvam na bhavati iti ced

original: āha – ko hītyādi | yasmāt ko hi sacetā akṛtakatvena sahādṛṣṭavirodhasya mithyātvasya sambhavamvedavākyeṣu pratyācakṣīta | taditi tasmādayamakṛtakatvasya hetor yatho kto vyatireko na sādhanaṃ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) saṃśayāt | itaś ca vyatirekī hetor nāstīti darśayannāha –
analyzed: āha kaḥ hi ityādi yasmāt kaḥ hi sa cetāḥ akṛtaka tvena saha adṛṣṭa virodhasya mithyātvasya sambhavam veda vākyeṣu pratyācakṣīta tat iti tasmāt ayam akṛtaka tvasya hetoḥ yathā u ktaḥ vyatirekaḥ na sādhanam kim kāraṇam saṃśayāt itas ca vyatirekī hetoḥ na asti iti darśayan āha

original: tat kim ayaṃ sahakāryatiśayotpādanaṃ pratyasamartho mantrairapekṣyata iti kṛtvānapekṣā mantrāḥ sadā kāryaṃ kuryuḥ | yadi1 kārakasvabhāvā(ḥ) no cennavā kadācit kāryaṃ kuryuranati(p. 556)śayāt svabhāsya sarvadā tulyatvāt |

original: kiṃ ca (|) sarvasya puṃsaḥ pātakādiyuktasyāpi sādhanaṃ phalahetavaste na mantrāḥ syuḥ | samayanirapekṣā yadīdṛśī mantrāṇāmbhāvaśaktiḥ | atha syād yajamānenaiva prayuktāḥ phaladā iti (|)

original: ata āha – prayokturbhedo viśeṣo yajamānatvantadapekṣā ca | nāsaṃskāryasya mantrasya yujyate | yadi bhāvaśaktyaiva samayānapekṣayā mantrāḥ phaladā na te mantrāḥ phaladānam prati kañcit puruṣaṃ parihareyuḥ | anyaṃ vā śūdrādikaṃ | yasmānna hyanyamayajamānaṃ prati svabhāvo mantrāṇāṃ kāryakaranasvabhāvo 'tadbhāvo bhavatyajanakasvabhāvo bhavati |
analyzed: atas āha prayoktuḥ bhedaḥ viśeṣaḥ yajamāna tvam tad apekṣā ca na a saṃskāryasya mantrasya yujyate yadi bhāva śaktyā eva samaya anapekṣayā mantrāḥ phala dāḥ na te mantrāḥ phala dānam prati kañcid puruṣam parihareyuḥ anyam vā śūdra ādikam yasmāt na hi anyam ayajamānam prati svabhāvaḥ mantrāṇām tad bhāvaḥ bhavati ajanaka svabhāvaḥ bhavati

original: kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tasya janakasvabhāvasya tenābrāhmaṇena cānapakarṣaṇāt | akhaṇḍanāt | anyena ca yajamānādinānutkarṣaṇāt | ataś ca kāraṇāt kenacit puruṣeṇa saha mantrāṇāṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvayogaḥ | tadayogāc ca yathākramaṃ brāhmaṇenānyena ca mantrāṇāṃ pratyāsattiviprakarṣābhāvāt sarvasya sādhanaṃ syuriti |

original: ata eva na niryātvād evāsya mantrasyāsaṃskāryatvāt prayoktā | kārye niyoktā kaścid btāhmaṇonyo vā nāsti yataḥ prayoktā mantrasādhyam phalam aśnuvīta labheta brāhmaṇa eva nānyaḥ | tathā hi yathā śūdrādirapāṭhako na kiṃcit karotīti na prayoktā tathā brāhmaṇopi (|) tataḥ saṃskārāpratipatter iti |

original: kiñca saṃskāryasyāpyādheyātiśayasyāpi bhāvasya vastubhedo hi kāraṇabhedo hi bhedako na a brāhmaṇaśudrādīnāṃ svabhāvabhedaḥ paramārthatosti | kevalaṃ lokavyavahārakṛto vipraśūdrādibhedaḥ | tena lokavyavahārabhinnānāṃ brāhmaṇādīnāṃ prayoktaṇāmbhedānniyamo mantraśktau na sambhavati | yena brāhmaṇa eva phalamāsādayenna śūdraḥ |
analyzed: kiñca saṃskāryasya api ādheya atiśayasya api bhāvasya vastu bhedaḥ hi kāraṇa bhedaḥ hi bhedakaḥ na brāhmaṇa śudra ādīnām svabhāva bhedaḥ paramārthataḥ asti kevalam loka vyavahāra kṛtaḥ vipra śūdra ādi bhedaḥ tena loka vyavahāra bhinnānām brāhmaṇa ādīnām prayoktṇām bhedāt niyamaḥ mantra śktau na sambhavati yena brāhmaṇaḥ eva phalam āsādayet na śūdraḥ

original: anye tvanyathā (|) padoccāraṇe | ekaivavivakṣā kāraṇam iti (|)
analyzed: anye tu anyathā pada uccāraṇe ekā eva vivakṣā kāraṇam iti

original: satyam etat | kevalaṃ sakāroccāraṇakāle 'vaśyaṃ cittaṃ vidyate 'nyathā maraṇaprasaṅgāt | tad eva ca cittaṃ sakārasamutthāpakam ucyate tadanantaraṃ sakārasyotpatteḥ | evam uttarottaravarṇneṣu cittasamutthāpakatvaṃ draṣṭavyam iti |
analyzed: satyam etat kevalam sakāra uccāraṇa kāle vaśyam cittam vidyate nyathā maraṇa prasaṅgāt tat eva ca cittam sakāra samutthāpakam ucyate tad anantaram sakārasya utpatteḥ evam uttara uttara varṇneṣu citta samutthāpaka tvam draṣṭavyam iti

original: atra ca "sakārasamutthāpakacetasā samanantarapratyayenetyā"dinā granthenaikakarttṛka eva varṇṇakramorthapratītihetur na bhinnnakarttṛka ity uktam bhavati | tena yad ucyate ma ṇḍa ne na |
analyzed: atra ca sakāra samutthāpaka cetasā samanantara pratyayena ityādinā granthena eka karttṛkaḥ eva varṇṇa krama ūrtha pratīti hetuḥ na bhinna karttṛkaḥ iti uktam bhavati tena yat ucyate na

original: "kāryakāraṇbhāvaś cet kramastadgrāhicetasāṃ |
analyzed: kārya kāraṇ bhāvaḥ ced kramaḥ tad grāhi cetasām

original: taddhetur ātmabhedo vā vakttṛbhedepi dhīrbhave"d iti (sphoṭasiddhiḥ 31)
analyzed: tad hetuḥ ātma bhedaḥ vā vakttṛ bhede pi dhīḥ bhavet iti sphoṭasiddhiḥ 31

original: tadapāstaṃ | bhinnakarttṛkavarṇnagrāhicetasām ātmabhāvasyārthapratītihetutvān abhyupagamāt |
analyzed: tat apāstam bhinna karttṛka varṇna grāhi cetasām ātma bhāvasya artha pratīti hetu tvān abhyupagamāt

original: yaccāpy ukta mma ṇḍa ne na (|) "atha samutthāpakacittakrameṇa varṇnakramādarthapratītis tathāpi sa ca kramo jñāpakatvāj jñānam apekṣate | dṛśyate ca tirohitavyavahitavaktṛprayuktāc chabdādarthajñānaṃ (|) na ca tatra samutthāpakacittakāryakāraṇatāṃ kaścana niścetum arhati | cakṣur ekatve hi sā niścīyetāntareṇa śabdajñānāt |
analyzed: atha samutthāpaka citta krameṇa atha samutthāpaka citta krameṇa tathā api sa ca kramaḥ jñāpaka tvāt jñānam apekṣate dṛśyate ca tirohita vyavahita vaktṛ prayuktāt śabdāt artha jñānam na ca tatra samutthāpaka citta kārya kāraṇatām kaścana niścetum arhati cakṣuḥ ekatve hi sā niścīyeta antareṇa śabda jñānāt

original: na ca tirohitavyavahitayor (p. 570) vaktur ekatve pramāṇam astī"ti |
analyzed: na ca tirohita vyavahitayoḥ vaktuḥ eka tve pramāṇam asti iti

original: tad yuktaṃ | yatas tirohitavyavahitāvasthāyām vaktur ekatvaṃ kaiścid avadhāryata eva | tathā hi (|) devadatto māṃ śabdayati na yajñadatta iti loke pratītipūrvikaiva pravṛttir dṛśyate | yatra nāvadhāraṇaṃ na tatra pravṛttir itīṣṭasiddhir eva |
analyzed: tat yuktam yatas tirohita vyavahita avasthāyām vaktuḥ eka tvam kaiścid avadhāryate eva tathā hi devadattaḥ mām śabdayati na yajñadattaḥ iti loke pratīti pūrvikā eva pravṛttiḥ dṛśyate yatra na avadhāraṇam na tatra pravṛttiḥ iti iṣṭa siddhiḥ eva

original: api ca spoh ṭa vā dinopi tirohitāvasthādau kathaṃ sphoṭābhivyaktir vyañjakānāṃ varṇṇānām ekakarttṛkatvān avadhāraṇāt | avaśyaṃ ca tatra sphoṭābhivyakti[reṣṭavyā | anyathārthāvagatir na syā]1*d iti kaiścid avadhāryata eva (|) yat kiñcid etat |
analyzed: api ca tirohita avasthā ādau katham sphoṭa abhivyaktiḥ vyañjakānām varṇṇānām eka karttṛka tvāt avadhāraṇāt avaśyam ca tatra sphoṭa abhivyaktiḥ eṣṭavyā anyathā artha avagatiḥ na syāt iti kaiścid avadhāryate eva yat kiñcid etat

original: fn. 1: In the margin.
analyzed: in the margin

original: yad iti tasmād ime varṇṇā anyānyahetava iti | anyadanyatsamutthāpakaṃ cittaṃ hetur yeṣām ity arthaḥ | svakāraṇāni samutthāpakāny eva jñānāni teṣām ānupūrvī kramastasyā janma yeṣānte tathoktāḥ | kāraṇkramāt kramabhāvino varṇṇā ity arthaḥ | iyatā ca (|)
analyzed: yat iti tasmāt ime varṇṇāḥ anya anya hetavaḥ iti anyat anyat samutthāpakam cittam hetuḥ yeṣām iti arthaḥ sva kāraṇāni samutthāpakāni eva jñānāni teṣām ānupūrvī kramaḥ tasyāḥ janma yeṣām te tathā uktāḥ kāraṇ kramāt krama bhāvinaḥ varṇṇāḥ iti arthaḥ iyatā ca

original: yo yadvarṇnasamutthānajñānajājjñāto dhvaniḥ (|) ity etad vyākhyātaṃ |
analyzed: yaḥ yad varṇ na samutthāna jñāna jāt jñātaḥ dhvaniḥ iti etat vyākhyātam

original: [sa śrutyā samavasīyata]2* ity etad vivṛṇvann āha – śrutītyādi | śrutikālepi śravaṇakālepi yadā mandacāriṇa iti yadā nātidrutamuccāryanta ity arthaḥ | pūrvavarṇṇālambanaṃ jñānantad eva sahakāripratyayastam apekṣante ye varṇnāste tathoktāḥ |
analyzed: sa śrutyā samavasīyate iti etat vivṛṇvan āha śruti ityādi śruti kāle api śravaṇa kāle api yadā manda cāriṇaḥ iti yadā na ati drutam uccāryante iti arthaḥ pūrva varṇṇa ālambanam jñānan tat eva sahakāri pratyayaḥ tam apekṣante ye varṇnāḥ te tathā uktāḥ

original: ta evaṃbhūtāḥ kiṃ kurvanti (|) svajñānaṃ svaviṣayaṃ śrotravijñānaṃ janayanti | tathā hi (|) sakārāmbanaṃ śrotravijñānaṃ yasminn eva kāle tathaivākāropy akārasamutthāpanacetasā janitastenākāraḥ sakārālambanaṃ ca jñānam ekakālantasmād akāraḥ sakārālambanajñānena sahakāriṇā svaviṣayaṃ jñānaṃ janayati (|) evamanyeṣv api varṇṇeṣvayaṃ nyāyo yojyaḥ |
analyzed: te evaṃbhūtāḥ kim kurvanti sva jñānam sva viṣayam śrotra vijñānam janayanti tathā hi sakāra āmbanam śrotra vijñānam yasmin eva kāle tathā eva ākāraḥ api akāra samutthāpana cetasā janitaḥ tena ākāraḥ sakāra ālambanam ca jñānam eka kālam tasmāt akāraḥ sakāra ālambana jñānena sahakāriṇā sva viṣayam jñānam janayati evam anyeṣu api varṇṇeṣu ayam nyāyaḥ yojyaḥ

original: tadeti yadā svaviṣayamanubhavajñānaṃ janitavantas tadā pūrvavarṇṇaviṣayaṃ yat smaraṇantadapekṣā eva smṛtim upalīyante smṛtāvārohanti | yenaiva krameṇānubhūtāstenaiva krameṇa smaryanta ity arthaḥ | sa eṣo yugapadabhāvalakṣaṇo varṇṇānāṃ svabhāva iti sambandhaḥ | kīdṛśa ity āha – bhinnetyādi | pūrvapūrvavijñānajanyatvād bhinnaḥ kāryabhāvaḥ |
analyzed: tadā iti yadā sva viṣayam anubhava jñānam janitavantaḥ tadā pūrva varṇṇa viṣayam yat smaraṇam tad apekṣāḥ eva smṛtim upalīyante smṛtau ārohanti yena eva krameṇa anubhūtāḥ tena eva krameṇa smaryante iti arthaḥ saḥ eṣaḥ yugapad abhāva lakṣaṇaḥ varṇṇānām svabhāvaḥ iti sambandhaḥ kīdṛśaḥ iti āha bhinna ityādi pūrva pūrva vijñāna janya tvāt bhinnaḥ kārya bhāvaḥ

original: uttarottarajñānasya hetutvād bhinnaḥ kāraṇabhāvaś ca yeṣāṃ sakārādisamutthāpakajñānānāntānibhinnakāryakāraṇabhāvāni | tāny eva pratyayā hetavaḥ | tebhyo nirvṛttir (p. 571) utpattiḥ saiva dharmo lakṣaṇaṃ yasya svabhāvasyeti vigrahaḥ | etena taddhetucetāṃsyapekṣya varṇānāṃ kāryatvam uktaṃ |
analyzed: uttarottara jñānasya hetu tvāt bhinnaḥ kāraṇa bhāvaḥ ca yeṣām sakāra ādi samutthāpaka jñāna anā anta anibhinna kārya kāraṇa bhāvāni tāni eva pratyayāḥ hetavaḥ tebhyaḥ nirvṛttiḥ utpattiḥ sā eva dharmaḥ lakṣaṇam yasya svabhāvasya iti vigrahaḥ etena tad hetu cetāṃsi apekṣya varṇānām kārya tvam uktam

original: tadgrāhicetāṃsyapekṣya kāraṇatvam āha – bhinnasya vijñānakāryasya nirvarttanaṃ jananaṃ sa eva dharmo lakṣaṇaṃ yasya svabhāvasyeti vigrahaḥ | sa evaṃbhūto varṇṇasvabhāvaḥ puruṣasaṃskārabhedabhinnaḥ puruṣaprayatnabhedabhinnaḥ krama ity ucyate |
analyzed: tad grāhi cetāṃsi apekṣya kāraṇa tvam āha bhinnasya vijñāna kāryasya nirvarttanam jananam saḥ eva dharmaḥ lakṣaṇam yasya svabhāvasya iti vigrahaḥ saḥ evaṃbhūtaḥ varṇṇa svabhāvaḥ puruṣa saṃskāra bheda bhinnaḥ puruṣa prayatna bheda bhinnaḥ kramaḥ iti ucyate

original: nanu kramo varṇṇānāṃ dharmastena kathaṃ sa evaṃbhūto varṇṇasvabhāvaḥ krama ity ucyate |
analyzed: nanu kramaḥ varṇṇānām dharmaḥ tena katham saḥ evaṃbhūtaḥ varṇṇa svabhāvaḥ kramaḥ iti ucyate

original: evam manyate (|) na yugapadutpannānāṃ kramostyapratīteḥ | tasnād yugapadutpannānām eva varṇṇānāṃ kramaḥ | ayugapadutpannāś ced varṇṇā iṣyante ta eva loke kramo na varṇṇebhyorthānarabhūtosāvapratīteḥ | nāpi teṣāṃ karama eko dharmo 'sahabhāvāt | nāpi pratyekaṃ dharmaḥ kramopratīteḥ | tasmādayugapadutpannā eva varṇṇāḥ krama ity ucyate ity uktaṃ |
analyzed: evam manyate na yugapad utpannānām kramaḥ usti apratīteḥ tasnāt yugapad utpannānām eva varṇṇānām kramaḥ ayugapad utpannāḥ ced varṇṇāḥ iṣyante te eva loke kramaḥ na na apratīteḥ na api teṣām ekaḥ sahabhāvāt na api pratyekam dharmaḥ krama upratīteḥ tasmāt ayugapad utpannāḥ eva varṇṇāḥ kramaḥ iti ucyate iti uktam

original: kevalam eṣāṃ krama iti kalpitoyaṃ vyavahāraḥ | na ca ya eva sara iti pade kramo loke pratīyate sa eva rasa iti pade | nāpi kramavyatiriktaṃ pūrvāparavarṇṇānāṃ svarūpaṃ | tasmāt pratipadaṃ varṇṇānām anyad eva svarūpaṃ | lokaś ca sara iti padād rasapadasyānyatvamavadhārayaty eva |
analyzed: kevalam eṣām kramaḥ iti kalpitaḥ yam vyavahāraḥ na ca yaḥ eva saraḥ iti pade kramaḥ loke pratīyate saḥ eva rasaḥ iti pade nā api krama vyatiriktam pūrva apara varṇṇānām sva rūpam tasmāt pratipadam varṇṇānām anyat eva sva rūpam lokaḥ ca saraḥ iti padāt rasa padasya anya tvam avadhārayati eva

original: tena yad ucyate ma ṇḍa ne na |
analyzed: tena yat ucyate ma ṇḍa ne na

original: "utpattivādino varṇṇāḥ kāmante santu bhedinaḥ |
analyzed: utpatti vādinaḥ varṇṇāḥ santu bhedinaḥ

original: na tvasādhāraṇas teṣām bhedorthajñānakāraṇaṃ |" (sphoṭasiddhiḥ 30)
analyzed: na tu asādhāraṇaḥ teṣām bheda ūrtha jñāna kāraṇam sphoṭa siddhiḥ

original: tasyānavadhāraṇāt saṃketakāle cādṛṣṭatvād iti (|)
analyzed: tasya an avadhāraṇāt saṃketa kāle ca a dṛṣṭa tvāt iti

original: tadapāstaṃ yatassara iti varṇṇakramād rasa iti varṇṇakramo bhinna evāvadhāryate | nāpikramavyatirekeṇa varṇṇāḥ pratibhāsante |
analyzed: tat apāstam yatas saraḥ iti varṇṇa kramāt rasaḥ iti varṇṇa kramaḥ bhinnaḥ eva avadhāryate na api krama vyatirekeṇa varṇṇāḥ pratibhāsante

original: tasmāt kramabhedāvadhāraṇam eva varṇṇabhedāvadhāraṇaṃ (|) kevalaṃ rasapadād rasapadānatarasya bhedaḥ sādṛśyānnāvadhāryate (|) ata eva saṃketakāle dṛṣṭatvāt rasapadārthapratipādakaṃ yuktam (|) evamanyasyāpi padasyeti yatkiñcid etat |
analyzed: tasmāt krama bheda avadhāraṇam eva varṇṇa bheda avadhāraṇam kevalam rasa padāt rasa padāt anatarasya bhedaḥ sādṛśyāt na avadhāryate atas eva saṃketa kāle dṛṣṭa tvāt rasa pada artha pratipādakam yuktam evam anyasya api padasya iti yat kiñcid etat

original: etad eva darśayann āha – anyad evetyādi | yato varṇṇānāṃ svabhāvo yathoktaḥ krama ity ucyate tataḥ kāraṇāt | tad iti sādṛśyād ekatve nādhyavasitam api rūpambarṇṇānām anyad eva padaṃ padaṃ pratipadaṃ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) karttṛsaṃskārato bhinnaṃ yataḥ (|) samutthāpakavittam eva karttṛ tasya śaktibhedād bhinnaṃ |
analyzed: etat eva darśayan āha anyat eva ityādi yatas varṇṇānām svabhāvaḥ yathā uktaḥ kramaḥ iti ucyate tatas kāraṇāt tat iti sādṛśyāt ekatve na adhyavasitam api rūpam barṇṇānām anyat eva padam padam pratipadam kim kāraṇam karttṛ saṃskārataḥ bhinnam yatas samutthāpaka vittam eva karttṛ tasya śakti bhedāt bhinnam

original: sahitam iti pūrvottarakrameṇoccārutaṃ (p. 572) | kāryabhedakṛd iti | buddhibhedaṃ karoti (|)
analyzed: sahitam iti pūrva uttara krameṇa uccārutam kārya bheda kṛt iti buddhi bhedam karoti

original: na ca "varṇnā nirarthakās santa" iti (1|241) pūrvam eva pratipāditaṃ (|) tat katham varṇṇasvarūpaṃ sahitaṃ kāryabhedakṛd ity ucyate |
analyzed: na ca nirarthakāḥ santaḥ iti pūrvam eva pratipāditam tat katham varṇṇa sva rūpam sahitam kārya bheda kṛt iti ucyate

original: atraike manyante (|) pratipadam varṇṇānāṃ svarūpam bhinnaṃ pauruṣeyam vācakaṃ | nāpauruṣeyam iti (|) yad āha (|) satyam (|) asti sā kintu puruṣāśrayeti (   ) |
analyzed: atra eke manyante pratipadam varṇṇānām sva rūpam bhinnam pauruṣeyam vācakam na apauruṣeyam iti yat āha satyam asti sā kintu puruṣa āśrayā iti

original: tad ayuktam (|) varṇṇānāṃ sahitāsahitānām arthāpratipādakatvāt | tasmād ayam abhiprāyaḥ (|) yadi paramārthato varṇṇakramaḥ syāt tadāsāv ekapadādirūpatayā kalpitorthasya pratipādakaḥ syāt | yataś caikena vikalpena viṣayīkṛtāḥ kramiṇo varṇṇāḥ pratipādakā ata evaikavikalpāvabhāsitvāt |
analyzed: tat ayuktam varṇṇānām sahita asahitānām artha apratipādaka tvāt tasmāt ayam abhiprāyaḥ yadi paramārthataḥ varṇṇa kramaḥ syāt tadā asau eka pada ādi rūpa tayā kalpita ūrthasya pratipādakaḥ syāt yatas ca ekena vikalpena viṣayīkṛtāḥ kramiṇaḥ varṇṇāḥ pratipādakāḥ atas eva eka vikalpa avabhāsi tvāt

original: kramiṇām varṇṇānāṃ rūpaṃ sahitaṃ kāryabhedakṛd ity ucyate ity adoṣaḥ | yataś ca samutthā[pakabhedād bhedaḥ] | tasmān na khalv eka eva svabhāvo varṇṇānāṃ saro rasa ityādipadeṣu | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) karttṛcittasaṃskārabhedena bhedāt | karttṛ ca taccittajñātasya saṃskārabhedaḥ samanantarapratyayabhedena śaktibhedas tena varṇṇānāṃ svabhāvasya bhedāt |
analyzed: kramiṇām varṇṇānām rūpam sahitam kārya bheda kṛt iti ucyate iti adoṣaḥ yatas ca samutthāpaka bhedāt bhedaḥ tasmāt na khalu ekaḥ eva svabhāvaḥ varṇṇānām saraḥ rasaḥ ityādi padeṣu kim kāraṇam karttṛ citta saṃskāra bhedena bhedāt karttṛ ca tad citta jñātasya saṃskāra bhedaḥ samanantara pratyaya bhedena śakti bhedaḥ tena varṇṇānām svabhāvasya bhedāt

original: sa ca varṇṇānām pratipadam bhinnaḥ svabhāvaḥ kramarūpa ekavikalpārūḍhatvāt | parasparasahitaḥ kāryabhedasyārthaviṣayabuddhibhedasya hetuḥ |
analyzed: sa ca varṇṇānām pratipadam bhinnaḥ svabhāvaḥ krama rūpaḥ eka vikalpa ārūḍha tvāt paraspara sahitaḥ kārya bhedasya artha viṣaya buddhi bhedasya hetuḥ

original: yā caivaṃ kāryakāraṇatā lakṣaṇānupūrvī varṇṇānāṃ pravṛttetyutpannā racanākṛtaḥ puruṣāt | racanāṃ karotīti racanākṛt tasmāt | kasmād ity āha – icchetyādi | puruṣecchayā yeṣāṃ varṇṇānām aviruddhā siddhis teṣāṃ sthitasya kramasya virodhataḥ |

original: anyasya puruṣasya mantrāt phalaniṣpattau vratacaryādyapekṣaṇān na  svabhāvato mantraḥ kārakaḥ | vrataṃ mantrakalpavihito niyamas tasya caraṇam anuṣṭhānaṃ | apiśabdād dhomādiparigrahaḥ | svabhāvato hi phaladāne | kiṃ vratacaryādyanuṣṭhānenāpekṣitena | tatotiśayānutpatteḥ |
analyzed: anyasya puruṣasya mantrāt phala niṣpattau vrata caryā ādi apekṣaṇāt na svabhāvataḥ mantraḥ kārakaḥ vratam mantra kalpa vihitaḥ niyamaḥ tasya caraṇam anuṣṭhānam api śabdāt homa ādi parigrahaḥ svabhāvataḥ hi phala dāne kim vrata caryā ādi anuṣṭhānena apekṣitena tatas utiśaya anutpatteḥ

original: tathaikasmād api mantraviṣayāj japahomādikarmmaṇaḥ sakaśāt kayościt puruṣayos tulyaṃ vidhimanutiṣṭhator apy ekasyārthadarśanād anyasyānarthadarśanān na svabhāvataḥ phalaṃ | svabhāvatas tu phaladāne tulyorthayogaḥ syāt | vahatām apīti (|) |
analyzed: tathā ekasmāt api mantra viṣayāt japa homa ādi karmmaṇaḥ sakaśāt kayościd puruṣayoḥ tulyam vidhim anutiṣṭhatoḥ api ekasya artha darśanāt anyasya anartha darśanāt na svabhāvataḥ phalam svabhāvataḥ tu phala dāne tulyaḥ ūrtha yogaḥ syāt vahatām api iti

original: viṣādyapanayanaṃ kurvatām api mantrāṇāṃ punaḥ kālāntare tenaiva puruṣeṇa prayuktānāṃ kasyacit kāryasya visamvādādakaraṇāt | na hy ayaṃ prakāro vastusvabhave yuktaḥ (|) kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) svabhāvasya sarvatra puruṣādau tulyatvāt | yo hi yasya svabhāvo na sa kañcid apekṣya svabhāvo bhavati | yadā tu puruṣakṛtāt samayāt phalam iṣyate tadāyamadoṣaḥ |
analyzed: viṣa ādi apanayanam kurvatām api mantrāṇām punar kāla antare tena eva puruṣeṇa prayuktānām kasyacid kāryasya visamvādāt akaraṇāt na hi ayam prakāraḥ vastu svabhave yuktaḥ kim kāraṇam svabhāvasya sarvatra puruṣa ādau tulya tvāt yaḥ hi yasya svabhāvaḥ na sa kañcid apekṣya svabhāvaḥ bhavati yadā tu puruṣa kṛtāt samayāt phalam iṣyate tadā ayam adoṣaḥ

original: tathā hi (|) puruṣas tu mantrasamayasya karttā | svecchāvṛttir iti kṛtvā kaṃcit puruṣam anugṛhṇāti nāparam iti yuktaṃ | kena kāraṇena | sattvasabhāgatāviśeṣāt | mantrakriyānuṣṭhātuḥ sattvasya mantrapraṇetrā saha sabhāgatā tulyaśīlācārādinā | ādiśabdād upapradānādiparigrahaḥ | tadvaśāttadanurāgāt | sevāviśeṣād vā |
analyzed: tathā hi puruṣaḥ tu mantra samayasya karttā sva icchā vṛttiḥ iti kṛtvā kaṃcid puruṣam anugṛhṇāti na aparam iti yuktam kena kāraṇena sattva sabhā gatā viśeṣāt mantra kriyā anuṣṭhātuḥ sattvasya mantra praṇetrā saha sabhā gatā tulya śīla ācāra ādinā ādi śabdāt upapradāna ādi parigrahaḥ tad vaśāt tad anurāgāt sevā viśeṣāt vā

original: japahomādinād eva tārādhanaṃ sevāviśeṣas tasmād vā | kañcid anugṛhṇāti puruṣaṃ | nāparaṃ sattvasabhāgatādirahitaṃ |
analyzed: japa homa ādināt eva tārā dhanam sevā viśeṣaḥ tasmāt vā kañcid anugṛhṇāti puruṣam na aparam sattva sabhā gata ādi rahitam

original: vratetyādinā paramāśaṃkate | niyamasyānuṣṭhānaṃ vratacaryā | vratacaryā ca vratacaryābhraṃśaś ceti virūpaikaśeṣaḥ | ādiśabdaḥ praty ekam abhisambadhyate | vratacaryādinā vratacaryābhraṃśādinā cety arthaḥ | vratacaryādinā dharmopacaye sati siddhir iti sambandhaḥ | tathā prakṛtyā svabhāvena dhamrātmano vā puṃsaḥ siddhiḥ |
analyzed: vrata ityādinā param āśaṃkate niyamasya anuṣṭhānam vrata caryā vrata caryā ca vrata caryā bhraṃśaḥ ca iti virūpa ekaśeṣaḥ ādi śabdaḥ prati ekam abhisambadhyate vrata caryā ādinā vrata caryā bhraṃśa ādinā ca iti arthaḥ vrata caryā ādinā dharma upacaye sati siddhiḥ iti sambandhaḥ tathā prakṛtyā svabhāvena dhamra ātmanaḥ vā puṃsaḥ siddhiḥ

original: vratacaryābhraṅśādinā tvadharmopacaye sati | adharmātmano cā prākṛtyā puruṣasyāsiddhir iti vākyārtho yojyaḥ | svabhāvatopi mantrāt phalaniṣpattau yathoktena prakāreṇa siddhyasiddhibhedo bhaviṣyatīti paro manyate |
analyzed: vrata caryā bhraṅśa ādinā tu adharma upacaye sati prākṛtyā puruṣasya asiddhiḥ iti vākya arthaḥ yojyaḥ svabhāvataḥ api mantrāt phala niṣpattau yathā uktena prakāreṇa siddhi asiddhi bhedaḥ bhaviṣyati iti paraḥ manyate

original: (p. 578) netyādinā pratiṣedhati | na dharmāpekṣāt mantrāt phalasiddhiḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) dharmaviruddhānam api mantrasiddhihetūnāṃ vratānāṃ ḍā ki nī bha gi nī tantrādiṣu darśanāt | ḍā ki nī tantre | caturbhaginītantre | ādiśabdāt | cairyahetuṣu kambuki nī tantrādiṣu darśanāt | kāni punas tāni dharmaviruddhānīty āha – krauryetyādi |
analyzed: na ityādinā pratiṣedhati na dharma apekṣāt mantrāt phala siddhiḥ kim kāraṇam api mantra siddhi hetūnām vratānām ḍā ki nī bha gi nī tantra ādiṣu darśanāt ḍā ki nī tantre caturbhaginī tantre ādi śabdāt cairya hetuṣu kambuki nī tantra ādiṣu darśanāt kāni punar tāni dharma viruddhāni iti āha kraurya ityādi

original: krauryaṃ prāṇibadhaḥ | steyaṃ cauryaṃ | dviṃ(?dvīṃ)driyasamāpattir maithunaṃ | hīnakarma mārjārāśucidhūmapradānādi | ādiśabdād anyasyāpi dharmaviruddhasya grahaṇaṃ | tāni krauryādīni bahulāni bhūyāṃsi yeṣāṃ bratānāntāni tathoktāni | taiś ca tathoktair vratair mantrasiddhiviśeṣāt | tathā hi (|) ḍā ki nī tantre samayavyavasthā |
analyzed: krauryam prāṇi badhaḥ steyam cauryam dviṃdvi iṃdriya samāpattiḥ maithunam hīna karma mārjāra aśuci dhūma pradāna ādi ādi śabdāt anyasya api dharma viruddhasya grahaṇam tāni kraurya ādīni bahulāni bhūyāṃsi yeṣām tathā uktāni taiḥ ca tathā uktaiḥ vrataiḥ mantra siddhi viśeṣāt tathā hi tantre samaya vyavasthā

original: yadā prāṇinaṃ hatvā khādati tadā mantrasiddhimāsādayati | tathā kambu ki nī tantre steyācaraṇāt siddhir uktā | tathā maithunācaraṇāt siddhipradā kācid eveti bhaginītantrāntare kvacit samayaḥ |
analyzed: yadā prāṇinam hatvā khādati tadā mantra siddhim āsādayati tathā steya ācaraṇāt siddhiḥ uktā tathā maithuna ācaraṇāt siddhi pradā kācid eva iti bhaginītantra antare kvacid samayaḥ

original: kauryādy eva dharmā bhaviṣyatīti ced (|)
analyzed: kaurya ādi eva dharmāḥ bhaviṣyati iti ced

original: āha – na cetyādi | evamvidho krauryādilakṣaṇo dharmasvabhāva iti yathāvasaraṃ paścānnivvedayiṣyāmaḥ | evantāvad adharmād api siddhir dṛṣṭā |
analyzed: āha na ca ityādi evamvidhaḥ kraurya ādi lakṣaṇaḥ dharma svabhāvaḥ iti yathāvasaram evantāvat adharmāt api siddhiḥ dṛṣṭā

original: darmād api siddhir na dṛṣṭety āha – maitrītyādi | satvānāṃ hitasukhacintanammai trī | śau caṃ dvividhaṃ | bāhyamāntarañ ca | bāhyaṃ snānādi | āntaraṃ steyādinivṛttiḥ | dānādinā parānugraho dharmaḥ | maitrīśaucadharmāḥ pare pradānāni yeṣānte tathoktāḥ | tathābhūtānāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ |
analyzed: darmāt api siddhiḥ na dṛṣṭā iti āha maitrī ityādi satvānām hita sukha cintanam ca bāhyam snāna ādi āntaram steya ādi nivṛttiḥ dāna ādinā para anugrahaḥ dharmaḥ maitrī śauca dharmāḥ pare pradānāni yeṣām te tathā uktāḥ tathābhūtānām puruṣāṇām

original: tannimittam eva maitryādikam eva nimittaṃ kṛtvā kasyāśit siddher iti maitrīviparyayeṇa yā labhyā tasyā asihheḥ | viparyayeṇa ca dveṣādinā punaḥ siddheḥ | na dharmopacayāpekṣāt mantrāt phalasiddhir iti | dveṣādisamutthitopi krauryādir mantravidhānenānuṣṭhitas san dharma eveti (|)
analyzed: tad nimittam eva maitrī ādikam eva nimittam kṛtvā kasyāśid siddheḥ iti maitrī viparyayeṇa yā labhyā tasyāḥ viparyayeṇa ca dveṣa ādinā punar siddheḥ na dharma upacaya apekṣāt mantrāt phala siddhiḥ iti dveṣa ādi samutthitaḥ api kraurya ādiḥ mantra vidhānena anuṣṭhitaḥ san dharmaḥ eva iti

original: ata āha – na cetyādi | ekarūpāddhi sādilakṣaṇāt karmaṇaḥ sakāśāt sa tadvirodhyadharmavirodhī dharmo yuktaḥ | adharmaś ceti mantravidhānād anyatra tata eva hiṃsādeḥ sakāśād adharmaś ca na yuktaḥ | na hy adharmahetor dharmo bhvati virodhāt | tathā hi (|) yenaiva dveṣādyāśayena mantravidhānād anyatra hiṃsādikurvato 'dharmo bhavati |
analyzed: atas āha na ca ityādi eka rūpāt hi sa ādi lakṣaṇāt karmaṇaḥ sakāśāt sa tad virodhi adharma virodhī dharmaḥ yuktaḥ adharmaḥ ca iti mantra vidhānāt anyatra tatas eva hiṃsā ādeḥ sakāśāt adharmaḥ ca na yuktaḥ na hi adharma hetoḥ dharmaḥ virodhāt tathā hi yena eva dveṣa ādi āśayena mantra vidhānāt anyatra hiṃsā ādi kurvataḥ dharmaḥ bhavati

original: tenaivāśayena mantravidhānānuṣṭhānepi hiṃsādikaṃ triyata iti kathan tasya dharmāṅgatvam iti |
analyzed: tena eva āśayena mantra vidhāna anuṣṭhāne api hiṃsā ādikam triyate iti kathan tasya dharma aṅga tvam iti

original: (p. 579) yadi dveṣādikṛtatvān mantravidhānenānuṣṭhitopi krauryādir adharma eva katham idānīm adharmātmano vratāder iti pūrvoktāt | krauryādilakṣaṇād vratāt | ādiśabdād anyasmān nihīnād aśucidhūpadānādilakṣaṇāt | dharmasya phalam iṣṭasambhogādilakṣaṇaṃ katham aśnute bhajate jāpī |
analyzed: yadi dveṣa ādi kṛta tvāt mantra vidhānena anuṣṭhitaḥ api kraurya ādiḥ adharmaḥ eva katham idānīm adharma ātmanaḥ vrata ādeḥ iti pūrva uktāt kraurya ādi lakṣaṇāt vratāt ādi śabdāt anyasmāt nihīnāt aśuci dhūpa dāna ādi lakṣaṇāt dharmasya phalam iṣṭa sambhoga ādi lakṣaṇam katham aśnute bhajate jāpī

original: netyādi si ddhā nta vā dī | na caitas yādharmātmano vratādes tadiṣṭaṃ phalamvipākaḥ karmaphalaṃ | kin tu pūrvakṛtasya śubhasya karmaṇo vipākaḥ (|) kimvad iti (|) āha  brahmahatyāyā ādeśastasyānuṣṭhānāt sampādanāt | grāmapratilambhavat | yathā kaścit kañcit puruṣaṃ niyuṃkte | mārayemaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ ahante grāmandāsyāmīti |
analyzed: na ityādi vrata ādeḥ tat iṣṭam phalam vipākaḥ karma phalam kin tu pūrva kṛtasya śubhasya karmaṇaḥ vipākaḥ kimvat iti āha brahmahatyāyāḥ ādeśaḥ tasya anuṣṭhānāt sampādanāt grāma pratilambha vat yathā kaścid kañcid puruṣam niyuṃkte māraya imam brāhmaṇam ahante grāman dāsyāmi iti

original: sa tasyādeśasyānuṣṭhānād grāmaṃ pratilabhate | na ca tad brahmahatyāyā phalaṃ | kintu tadbra(hma)hatyācaraṇenārādhitaṃ puruṣaṃ sahakāriṇaṃ prāpya pūrvakaṃ śubham eva karma tathā phalati |
analyzed: sa tasya ādeśasya anuṣṭhānāt grāmam pratilabhate na ca tat brahmahatyāyāḥ phalam kintu tad brahmahatyā caraṇena ārādhitam puruṣam sahakāriṇam prāpya pūrvakam śubham eva karma tathā phalati

original: adharmātmanas tarhi tasya vratasya kiṃphalam ityāha – tasya tu krauryādilakṣaṇasyādharmātmano vratasyāgāmi bhaviṣṭajjanbhabhāvi phalam iṣṭaṃ narakādi |
analyzed: adharma ātmanaḥ tarhi tasya vratasya kiṃphalam iti āha tasya tu kraurya ādi lakṣaṇasya adharma ātmanaḥ vratasya āgāmi phalam iṣṭam naraka ādi

original: yadi śubhasya karmaṇa iṣṭaṃ phalaṃ kaintenādharmātmanā mantrādiprayogeṇāpekṣiteneti ced (|)
analyzed: yadi śubhasya karmaṇaḥ iṣṭam phalam kaintena adharma ātmanā mantra ādi prayogeṇa apekṣitena iti ced

original: āha – sa tvadharmātmā | ḍā ki nī mantrādiprayogaḥ | ādiśabdāt krauryādivrataprayogaḥ | tasyeṣṭaphalasya śubhasya karmaṇaḥ | iṣṭam phalaṃ yasya karmaṇa iti vigrahaḥ | kathañcit kenacit prakāreṇopakārāt pācakaḥ phalasya dāyakaḥ |  kathaṃ punaḥ kuśalasyākuśalam upakārakam bhavatīti (|)
analyzed: āha sa tu adharma ātmā mantra ādi prayogaḥ ādi śabdāt kraurya ādi vrata prayogaḥ tasya iṣṭa phalasya śubhasya karmaṇaḥ iṣṭam phalam yasya karmaṇaḥ iti vigrahaḥ kathañcid kenacid prakāreṇa upakārāt pācakaḥ phalasya dāyakaḥ katham punar kuśalasya akuśalam upakārakam bhavati iti

original: āha – citratvād upakāraśakteḥ | sahakāribhāvo hi citraḥ | kadācit kuśalasyākuśalaṃ sahakāri | akuśalasyāpi kuśalaṃ | yathātyartham udārakuśalakāriṇo na narakādiduḥkhaphalam aśubhaṃ karma kuśalaṃ sahakāri prāpyehaiva janmani | vyādhyādiduḥkhamātraṃ datvā kṣīyate | adharmātmako mantrādiprayogaḥ | kathaṃ cid iṣṭaphalasya karmaṇa upakāraka ity uktaṃ |
analyzed: āha citra tvāt upakāra śakteḥ sahakāri bhāvaḥ hi citraḥ kadācid kuśalasya akuśalam sahakāri akuśalasya api kuśalam yathā atyartham udāra kuśala kāriṇaḥ na naraka ādi duḥkha phalam aśubham karma kuśalam sahakāri prāpya iha eva janmani vyādhi ādi duḥkha mātram da tvā kṣīyate adharma ātmakaḥ mantra ādi prayogaḥ katham cit iṣṭa phalasya karmaṇaḥ upakārakaḥ iti uktam

original: yatra yena prakāreṇopakāras tandarśayan nāha – puruṣaviśeṣo mantrasya praṇetā sa (p. 580) evāśrayas tena vipākaḥ phaladānaṃ sa eva dharmaḥ svabhāvo yasya sa puruṣāśrayavipākadharmā | dharma iti puṇyaviśeṣaḥ | teneti puruṣeṇa kṛtaḥ pūrvajanmani | sa tathā tadārādhaneneti | sa dharmas tathā krauryādyācaraṇāt |
analyzed: yatra yena prakāreṇa upakāraḥ tat darśayan na āha puruṣa viśeṣaḥ mantrasya praṇetā sa eva āśrayaḥ tena vipākaḥ phala dānam saḥ eva dharmaḥ svabhāvaḥ yasya sa puruṣa āśraya vipāka dharmāḥ dharmaḥ iti puṇya viśeṣaḥ tena iti puruṣeṇa kṛtaḥ pūrva janmani sa tathā tad ārādhanena iti sa dharmaḥ tathā kraurya ādi ācaraṇāt

original: tadārādhanena mantrapraṇetṛpuruṣārādhanena phalatīti |
analyzed: tad ārādhanena mantra praṇetṛ puruṣa ārādhanena phalati iti

original: etad eva spaṣṭayannāha – tadityādi | tena mantrapraṇetrā puruṣeṇa vihitā krauryayuktavratādiprayogastenopakāraḥ | karmaṇaḥ paripoṣaḥ | tena vipākaḥ phaladānaṃ dharmaḥ svabhāvo yasya tasyaivaṃ dharmaṇaḥ | tatphalasyeti | iṣṭaphalasya karmaṇaḥ kṛtatvāt kāraṇāt | tadārādhanena phalatīti |
analyzed: etat eva spaṣṭayan āha tat ityādi tena mantra praṇetrā puruṣeṇa vihitā kraurya yukta vrata ādi prayogaḥ tena upakāraḥ karmaṇaḥ paripoṣaḥ tena vipākaḥ phala dānam dharmaḥ svabhāvaḥ yasya tasya evam dharmaṇaḥ tad phalasya iti iṣṭa phalasya karmaṇaḥ kṛta tvāt kāraṇāt tad ārādhanena phalati iti

original: vināpi mantrapraṇetrā puruveṇa tadupakārāt | tasyaiva yantrasya kevalasya japādinā vyāpāreṇopakārānmantrātphalam iti vet | tataś ca puruṣārādhanena phalatīti yaduktan tadayuktam iti paro manyate |
analyzed: vinā api mantra praṇetrā puruveṇa tad upakārāt tasya eva yantrasya kevalasya japa ādinā vyāpāreṇa upakārāt mantrāt phalam iti vet tatas ca puruṣa ārādhanena phalati iti yat uktan tat ayuktam iti paraḥ manyate

original: netyādi si ddhā nta vā dī | naitad evaṃ | kiṅkāraṇaṃ (|) puruṣetyādi | mantrapraṇetuḥ puruṣasyākāro varṇṇasaṃsthānādiḥ | svabhāvaḥ śāntaraudrādiḥ | caryā kāyavāgvyāpāralakṣaṇā ceṣṭā | teṣām ākārādīnām adhimokṣo 'dhimuktis tasyā vaiyarthyaprasaṅgāt | mantrasyādhiṣṭhātā puruṣaś cen nāsti | kim arthasyākārādīn adhimucyet |
analyzed: na ityādi na etat evam kiṅkāraṇam puruṣa ityādi mantra praṇetuḥ puruṣasya ākāraḥ varṇṇa saṃsthāna ādiḥ svabhāvaḥ śānta raudra ādiḥ caryā kāya vāc vyāpāra lakṣaṇā ceṣṭā teṣām ākāra ādīnām adhimokṣaḥ dhimuktiḥ tasyāḥ vaiyarthya prasaṅgāt mantrasya adhiṣṭhātā puruṣaḥ ced na asti kim arthasya ākāra ādīn adhimucyet

original: atheṣyate tasyāpi puruṣasyopakārakatvan tadā tasyāpi mantrapraṇetuḥ puruṣasya mantrāt phalasiddhiṃ pratyupakārakatve 'ṅgīkriyamāṇe siddhaḥ puruṣaviśeṣosādhāraṇaguṇaḥ | asādhāraṇā guṇā asyeti vigrahaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tadadhimukter eva puruṣaviśeṣākārasvabhāvacaryādhimukter eva viṣakarmādikaraṇāt |

original: yady asādhāraṇaguṇa eva puruṣo mantrasya praṇetā | kathaṃ prabhāvādiviśeṣarahitā api tantravido mantrān bhāṣanta iti (|)

original: (p. 581) ata āha – yepītyādi | mantrapratibaddhāni śāstrāṇi tantrāṇi tāni vidantīti te tantravidaḥ kecidadyatvepi mantrānapūrvān kāṃścana kurvate | tan na teṣāṃ kevalānām asāmarthyaṃ | kin tu yat tantramāśritās te tasya tantrasya praṇetā yaḥ puruṣātiśayas tasya prabhoḥ svāminaḥ sa prabhāvaḥ sāmarthyaṃ | kasmāt (|) taduktanyāyavṛttitaḥ |
analyzed: atas āha ye pi ityādi mantra pratibaddhāni śāstrāṇi tantrāṇi tāni vidanti iti te tantra vidaḥ kecid adya tve pi mantrān apūrvān kāṃścana kurvate tat na teṣām kevalānām asāmarthyam kim tu yat tantram āśritāḥ te tasya tantrasya praṇetā yaḥ puruṣa atiśayaḥ tasya prabhoḥ svāminaḥ sa prabhāvaḥ sāmarthyam kasmāt tad ukta nyāya vṛttitaḥ

original: tasmāt prabhuṇā yastebhyas samayādiko nyāya upadiṣṭastasyānuvarttanāt | prabhustuṣṭastatpraṇītān api mantrānadhitiṣṭhatīti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: tasmāt prabhuṇā yaḥ tebhyaḥ samaya ādikaḥ nyāyaḥ upadiṣṭaḥ tasya anuvarttanāt prabhuḥ tuṣṭaḥ tad praṇītān api mantrān adhitiṣṭhati iti bhāvaḥ

original: rathyāpuruṣetyādinā pūrvapakṣopanyāsapūrvakaṃ kārikārthaṃ vyācaṣṭe | rathyāpuruṣā apīti sāmānyapuruṣā api kecena gāruḍikaprabhṛtayo mantralakṣaṇatantrajñāḥ kiñcid viṣādiśamanalakṣaṇaṃ karma kurvanti | na ca te viśiṣṭāḥ surāpānādyanyṣṭhānāt | tahānyopīti prabhāvavattvenābhimato mantrasya praṇetā 'natiśayaś ca syāt |
analyzed: rathyā puruṣa ityādinā pūrvapakṣa upanyāsa pūrvakam kārikā artham vyācaṣṭe rathyā puruṣāḥ api iti sāmānya puruṣāḥ api gāruḍika prabhṛtayaḥ mantra lakṣaṇa tantra jñāḥ kiñcid viṣa ādi śamana lakṣaṇam karma kurvanti na ca te viśiṣṭāḥ surā pāna ādi anyṣṭhānāt prabhāvavat tvena abhimataḥ mantrasya praṇetā ca syāt

original: rathyāpuruṣavadatuśatarahitaś ca syāt mantrāṇāṃ ca kartteti | tathā ca prabhāvavān puruṣo na sidhyatīti manyate |

original: netyādinā pariharati | na prabhāvarahitānāṃ mantrakaraṇaṃ (|) ye tu rathyāpuruṣā api mantrān kurvanti teṣāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ prabhāvavataiva tantrasya praṇetrādhiṣṭhānāt mantrakaraṇasāmarthyaṃ |
analyzed: na ityādinā pariharati na prabhāva rahitānām mantra karaṇam ye tu rathyā puruṣāḥ api mantrān kurvanti teṣām puruṣāṇām prabhāvavatā eva tantrasya praṇetrā adhiṣṭhānāt mantra karaṇa sāmarthyam

original: etad eva darśayannāha – tatkṛtaṃ hītyādi | tena prabhāvātiśayavatā puruṣeṇa kṛtasamayamanupālayanto rakṣantaḥ | tadupadeśena ceti prabhāvayuktapuruṣopadeśena ca vartamānā mantrakriyāsamarthāḥ kuta etat |
analyzed: etat eva darśayan āha tat kṛtam hi ityādi tena prabhāva atiśayavatā puruṣeṇa kṛta samayam anupālayantaḥ rakṣantaḥ tad upadeśena ca iti prabhāva yukta puruṣa upadeśena ca vartamānāḥ mantra kriyā samarthāḥ kutas etat

original: tad ityādi tasya prabhāvato yassamayaḥ | yaścopadeśas tatra nirapekṣāṇāṃ puṃsāṃ mantraracanāyām asāmarthyāt | tatra samayo yasyātikramāt punar maṇḍalapraveśādiḥ karttavyo  jāyate | tatonyadvidhānām upadeśa ityanayor bhedaḥ | tatrāpīti rathyāpuruṣakṛteṣv api mantreṣu tadākāradhyānād eva | prabhāvavataḥ |
analyzed: tat ityādi tasya prabhāvataḥ yaḥ samayaḥ yaḥ ca upadeśaḥ tatra nirapekṣāṇām puṃsām mantra racanāyām asāmarthyāt tatra samayaḥ yasya atikramāt punar maṇḍala praveśa ādiḥ karttavyaḥ jāyate tatonyadvidhānām upadeśaḥ iti anayoḥ bhedaḥ tatra api iti rathyā puruṣa kṛteṣu api mantreṣu tad ākāra dhyānāt eva prabhāvavataḥ

original: puṃsaś cākāradhyānāde(re)va (|) ādiśabdāt svabhāvacaryādhyānasya parigrahaḥ | tena mantrasya prayogāt pravarttanāt | yata evantasmāttadadhiṣṭhānam eva prabhāvavatpuruṣādhiṣṭhānam eva tattādṛśam unneyaṃ boddhavyaṃ | yatte svayaṃ kṛtair mantraiḥ karma kurvantīti |
analyzed: puṃsaḥ ca ākāra dhyāna ādeḥ eva ādi śabdāt svabhāva caryā dhyānasya parigrahaḥ tena mantrasya prayogāt pravarttanāt yatas evam tasmāt tat adhiṣṭhānam eva prabhāvavat puruṣa adhiṣṭhānam eva tat tādṛśam unneyam boddhavyam yat te svayam kṛtaiḥ mantraiḥ karma kurvanti iti

original: (p. 582) api ca (|) kecit tantrajñā mantraṃ kurvantītyabhidadhatā puruṣātiśaya eva samarthitaḥ syāt | yasmāt sopi tādṛśastantrajño mantrasya karttā prabhāvavān eva | tadanyair atantrajñaiḥ puruṣair asādhāraṇaśaktitvād iti kṛtvā | yataś ca puruṣādhiṣṭhitānām eva mantrāṇāṃ phalaṃ |
analyzed: api ca kecid tantra jñāḥ mantram kurvanti iti abhidadhatā puruṣa atiśayaḥ eva samarthitaḥ syāt yasmāt saḥ api tādṛśaḥ tantra jñaḥ mantrasya karttā prabhāvavān eva tad anyaiḥ atantra jñaiḥ puruṣaiḥ asādhāraṇa śakti tvāt iti kṛtvā yatas ca puruṣa dhiṣṭhitānām eva mantrāṇām phalam

original: tasmāt kṛtakāḥ pauruṣeyāś ca phaladā ityevammantrā vācyāḥ phalepsunā | mantrād phalamicchatā na nityā mantrāḥ kintu kṛtakāḥ kṛtakatvepi na phaladāne puruṣanirapekṣā ity arthadvayam ādarśayituṃ kṛtakāḥ pauruṣeyāś ceti dvayopādānaṃ |
analyzed: tasmāt kṛtakāḥ pauruṣeyāḥ ca phala dāḥ iti evam mantrāḥ vācyāḥ phala īpsunā mantrāt phalam icchatā na nityāḥ mantrāḥ kintu kṛtakāḥ kṛtaka tve pi na phala dāne puruṣa nirapekṣāḥ iti artha dvayam ādarśayitum kṛtakāḥ pauruṣeyāḥ ca iti dvaya upādānam

original: na hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | na hi nityānāmvaidikānāṃ mantrāṇāṃ prayoga uccāraṇaṃ sambhavatyanādheyātiśayatvāt | na cāprayuktebhyo mantrebhyaḥ phalam iti kṛtvā prayogāt phalamicchatā kṛtakā mantr vācyāḥ | pauruṣeyāś ca | puruṣādhiṣṭhitāś ca phaladā vācyāḥ |
analyzed: na hi ityādinā vyācaṣṭe na hi nityānām vaidikānām mantrāṇām prayogaḥ uccāraṇam sambhavati anādheya atiśaya tvāt na ca a prayuktebhyaḥ mantrebhyaḥ phalam iti kṛtvā prayogāt phalam icchatā kṛtakāḥ mantr vācyāḥ pauruṣeyāḥ ca puruṣa dhiṣṭhitāḥ ca phala dāḥ vācyāḥ

original: kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) puruṣādhiṣṭhānamantreṇa vinānyato  bhāvaśaktyāder asambhavatphalānām mantrāṇāṃ puruṣādhiṣṭhānād eva phaladarśanāt | yathā ca na bhāvaśaktyā mantrebhyaḥ phalotpattis tathā pratipāditaṃ (|)
analyzed: kim kāraṇam puruṣa adhiṣṭhāna mantreṇa vinā anyatas bhāva śakti ādeḥ asambhavat phalānām mantrāṇām puruṣa adhiṣṭhānāt eva phala darśanāt yathā ca na bhāva śaktyā mantrebhyaḥ phala utpattiḥ tathā pratipāditam

original: "sarvasya sādhanante syur bhāvaśaktir yadīdṛśī"tyādinā (1|267)
analyzed: sarvasya sādhana ante syuḥ bhāva śaktiḥ yadi īdṛśī ityādinā

original: nidarśanaṃ cāha – yo madīyaṃ kāvyāday evaṃ paṭhiṣyati tasya mayāyam arthaḥ sampādanīya ity evaṃ kṛtaḥ samayo yasmin kāvyādau ādiśabdāc chilpasthānādau | sa kṛtasamayaḥ kāvyādiḥ tasminn iva tadvat | yathā tatra kāvyādipāṭhakānāṃ puruṣādhiṣṭhānāt phalantadvanmantreṣv apīty arthaḥ |
analyzed: nidarśanam ca āha yaḥ madīyam evam paṭhiṣyati tasya mayā ayam arthaḥ sampādanīyaḥ iti evam kṛtaḥ samayaḥ yasmin kāvya ādau ādi śabdāt śilpasthāna ādau sa kṛta samayaḥ kāvya ādiḥ tasmin iva tadvat yathā tatra kāvya ādi pāṭhakānām puruṣa adhiṣṭhānāt phalam tadvat mantreṣu api iti arthaḥ

original: puṃsāmatīndriyārthadarśanaṃ prati śaktir nāstīty evam aśaktisādhanam asāmarthyasya sādhanaṃ yannāma kiñcit mī māṃ sa kai r ucyate tatsarvamanenaiva mantrakāriṇāṃ jñānaprabhāvātiśayasādhanena nirākṛtaṃ |
analyzed: puṃsām atīndriya artha darśanam prati śaktiḥ na asti iti evam aśakti sādhanam asāmarthyasya sādhanam yat nāma kiñcid mī mām sa ucyate tat sarvam anena eva mantra kāriṇām jñāna prabhāva atiśaya sādhanena nirākṛtam

original: pratipāditā hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | pratipāditā hi puruṣakṛtā mantrāstaedadhiṣṭhānāc ca phaladā mantrā ity etad api pratipāditaṃ |
analyzed: pratipāditāḥ hi ityādinā vyācaṣṭe pratipāditāḥ hi puruṣa kṛtāḥ mantrāḥ taed adhiṣṭhānāt ca phala dāḥ mantrāḥ iti etat api pratipāditam

original: na ca sarve puruṣā mantrān karttum adhiṣṭhātuṃ vā śaktāḥ | tad iti tasmād asti kaścid atiśayavān puruṣo mantrasya kartteti | tasyātiśayavataḥ puṃsaḥ pratikṣepasādhanāny api (p. 583) prativyūḍhāni pratikṣiptāni |
analyzed: na ca sarve puruṣāḥ mantrān karttum adhiṣṭhātum vā śaktāḥ tat iti tasmāt asti kaścid atiśayavān puruṣaḥ mantrasya karttā iti tasya atiśayavataḥ puṃsaḥ pratikṣepa sādhanāni api prativyūḍhāni pratikṣiptāni

original: etena ca paroktasyātiśayapratikṣepashādhanasya na viyuddhāvyabhicāritvam udbhāvyate (|) kin tarhi puruṣātiśayapratikṣepasādhanāni vastubalāyātāni na santy evety anena vyājena kathyate | na hi vastubalāyātaṃ puruṣātiśayaṃ nirākarttṛ kiṃcit sādhanam asti |
analyzed: etena ca para uktasya atiśaya pratikṣepa shādhanasya na viyuddha avyabhicāri tvam udbhāvyate kin tarhi puruṣa atiśaya pratikṣepa sādhanāni vastu bala āyātāni na santi eva iti anena vyājena kathyate na hi vastu bala āyātam puruṣa atiśayam nirākarttṛ kiṃcid sādhanam asti

original: nanu cedam asti vivakṣitaḥ puruṣo nātiśayavān buddhimattvāt | indriyavatvāt | vacanāt puṃstvāt | rathyāpuruṣavad iti (|)
analyzed: nanu ca idam asti vivakṣitaḥ puruṣaḥ na atiśayavān buddhimat tvāt indriyavat tvāt vacanāt puṃstvāt rathyā puruṣa vat iti

original: ata āha – buddhīndriyetyādi | buddhiś cendriyaṃ ca uktiś ca puṃstvaṃ ceti dvandvaḥ | ādiśabdāt prānādimattvādi | puruṣātiśayanirākaraṇasādhanaṃ yat tu varṇṇyate (|) tatsarvaṃ pramāṇābhaṃ pramāṇābhāsam anaikāntikam iti yāvat | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) vipakṣavṛtteḥ sandehena sarvasya śeṣavattvāt | na hi śeṣavat ity anaikāntikatvāt |
analyzed: atas āha buddhīndriya ityādi buddhiḥ ca indriyam ca uktiḥ ca puṃstvam ca iti dvandvaḥ ādi śabdāt prānādimattva ādi puruṣa atiśaya nirākaraṇa sādhanam yat tu varṇṇyate tat sarvam pramāṇa ābham pramāṇa ābhāsam anaikāntikam iti yāvat kim kāraṇam vipakṣa vṛtteḥ sandehena sarvasya śeṣavat tvāt na hi śeṣavat iti anaikāntika tvāt

original: yathārthety aviparītā gatir anumeyapratipattir asti |
analyzed: yathārthā iti aviparītā gatiḥ anumeya pratipattiḥ asti

original: yat tv ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | yat tu puruṣātiśayapratikṣepasādhanantattvagamakam eveti sambandhaḥ | tat punaḥ sādhanaṃ | buddhīndriyayogād ityādi | kasmād agamakam ity āha – pratikṣepetyādi | pratikṣepaś ca sāmānyaṃ ca pratikṣepasāmānye | tayoḥ sādhane tayor ayogāt |
analyzed: yat tu ityādinā vyācaṣṭe yat tu puruṣa atiśaya pratikṣepa sādhanam tattva gamakam eva iti sambandhaḥ tat punar sādhanam buddhīndriya yogāt ityādi kasmāt agamakam iti āha pratikṣepa ityādi pratikṣepaḥ ca sāmānyam ca pratikṣepa sāmānye tayoḥ sādhane tayoḥ ayogāt

original: tathā hi (|) buddhimattvādinā sādhanena nāsti puruṣātiśaya iti pratikṣepo vā sādhyeta | yad vā yosau puruṣātiśayaḥ sa rathyāpuruṣaiḥ samāna itītarapuruṣasāmānyaṃ sādhyeta |
analyzed: tathā hi buddhimat tva ādinā sādhanena na asti puruṣa atiśayaḥ iti pratikṣepaḥ vā sādhyeta yat vā yaḥ asau puruṣa atiśayaḥ sa rathyā puruṣaiḥ samānaḥ iti itara puruṣa sāmānyam sādhyeta

original: tatra na hītyādinā pratikṣepasādhanasyābhāvam āha – na hy atīndriyeṣv artheṣv ataddarśinotīndriyārthādarśinaḥ pratikṣepaḥ sambhavati | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) satām apy eṣām tīndriyāṇām arthānām arvāgdarśanasyājñānāt | tasmān nādarśanamātrātpratikṣepa iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: tatra na hi ityādinā pratikṣepa sādhanasya abhāvam āha na hi atīndriyeṣu artheṣu atad darśinā utīndriya artha adarśinaḥ pratikṣepaḥ sambhavati kim kāraṇam satām api eṣām tīndriyāṇām arthānām arvāk darśanasya ajñānāt tasmāt na adarśana mātrāt pratikṣepaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: nāpi viruddhavidhānāt puruṣātiśayasya pratikṣepaḥ yasmād ata evātindriyatvād eva puruṣātiśayasya buddhitvādinā hetunā | dvividhasyāpi virodhasyāsiddheḥ | avirodhinā ca vaktṛtvādinā puruṣātiśayasyaikatra sambhavāvirodhād ity uktaṃ prāk |
analyzed: nā api viruddha vidhānāt puruṣa atiśayasya pratikṣepaḥ yasmāt atas eva atindriya tvāt eva puruṣa atiśayasya buddhi tva ādinā hetunā dvividhasya api virodhasya asiddheḥ avirodhinā ca vaktṛ tva ādinā puruṣa atiśayasya ekatra sambhava avirodhāt iti uktam prāk

original: (p. 584) nāpītyādinā sāmānyasādhanasyābhāvam āha – nāpītareṇārvāgdarśinā puruṣeṇa tasyātiśayavataḥ sāmānyasiddhis tulyatāsiddhiḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) atīndriyadarśanādilakṣaṇasya viśeṣasya yo sambhavas tasya jñātum aśakyatvāt | īdṛśeṣu ca parasantānavarttiṣu puruṣamātrāpratyakṣeṣv atīndriyārthadarśanādiṣu |
analyzed: na api ityādinā sāmānya sādhanasya abhāvam āha na api itareṇa arvāk darśiṇā puruṣeṇa tasya atiśayavataḥ sāmānya siddhiḥ tulya tā siddhiḥ kim kāraṇam atīndriya darśana ādi lakṣaṇasya viśeṣasya yaḥ sambhavaḥ tasya jñātum aśakya tvāt īdṛśeṣu ca para santāna vartiṣu puruṣa mātra pratyakṣeṣu atīndriya artha darśana ādiṣu

original: yā kācid asambhavaprasādhanyanupalabdhir upādīyate | tasyā anupalabdheḥ prāg eva hetutvapratikṣepāt |
analyzed: yā kācid asambhava prasādhanī anupalabdhiḥ upādīyate tasyāḥ anupalabdheḥ prāk eva hetu tva pratikṣepāt

analyzed: idānīn tarhi katham pracura adhyetṛkāṇi tāni iti atas āha punar ityādi punar kāla antareṇa āpta tvena sambhāvitasya puruṣasya pratyayāt prāmāṇyāt tad anya asambhāvita puruṣa adhyayana vaiparītyena sambhavāt aniścayaḥ

original: kiñca | ye te puruṣā viralībhūtāḥ śākhāntarāṇāṃ pratānayitāras teṣāṃ pratānayitṛṇāmanyathopadeśasambhavād iti sambandhaḥ | tathā cānāśvāsa ity abhiprāyaḥ | kīdṛśānāṃ pratānayitṝṇāṃ kadācid adhītavismṛtādhyayanānāṃ | adhītaṃ sad vismṛtamadhyayanaṃ yais te tathoktāḥ | yathādhītaṃ vismṛtās santaste 'nyathāpi pratānayeyur ity arthaḥ |
analyzed: kiñca ye te puruṣāḥ viralībhūtāḥ śākhā antarāṇām pratānayitāraḥ teṣām pratānayitṛṇām anyathā upadeśa sambhavāt iti sambandhaḥ tathā ca anāśvāsaḥ iti abhiprāyaḥ kīdṛśānām pratānayitṝṇām kadācid adhīta vismṛta adhyayanānām adhītam sat vismṛtam adhyayanam yaiḥ te tathā uktāḥ yathā adhītam vismṛtāḥ santaḥ te nyathā api pratānayeyuḥ iti arthaḥ

original: kena kāraṇenety āha – anyeṣān tad abhiprasannānāmadhyetṝṇān tasmin nadhyāpayitari | yā mahatvasambhāvanā | tasyā bhraṃśabhayāt | yady aham anyathāpi nopadiśeyaṃ | nūnametemayyāptasambhāvanāṃ jahā (?jaha) tīti | ādi śabdād āhopuruṣādikāt anyathopadeśasambhavaḥ |

analyzed: upacaya hetum āha kiṃca ityādi parimitāḥ ca te vyākhyātṛ puruṣāḥ ca teṣām paramparām eva atra veda vyākhyāne bhavatām mī mām sa kāḥ nām śrṛṇumaḥ tatra teṣu madhye kaścid vedasya vyākhyātā dviṣṭa ādīnām anyatamaḥ syāt kaścid veda darśane vidviṣṭaḥ saḥ anyathā api upadiśet tathā kaścid ajñaḥ dhūrttāḥ vā tathā ca veda vyākhyāyām anāśvāsaḥ

original: yata evaṃ tasmān nāpauruṣeyād vedavyākhyānād vedārthasiddhiḥ | nāpi sāmayikāt sāṃketikāl lokavyavahārādvedārthasiddhiḥ | lokasya rāgād upaplutatvāt |
analyzed: yatas evam tasmāt na apauruṣeyāt veda vyākhyānāt veda artha siddhiḥ na api sāmayikāt sāṃketikāt lokavyavahārāt veda artha siddhiḥ lokasya rāgāt upapluta tvāt

original: bhavantu vā nisargasiddhā vaidikāḥ śabdās samayanirapekṣāḥ | evam apy asāmayikatvebhyupagamyamāne | vyavahāre nānārthānāṃ gavādiśabdānāndarśanāt | sarvatra vaidikepi śabde na tadāśaṃkā 'nivṛtter iti sambandhaḥ | nānārthaśaṃkāyā anivṛtter ity arthaḥ | laukikānām eva nānārthatvan na vaidikānām iti ced āha – kasyacid ityādi |
analyzed: bhavantu vā nisarga siddhāḥ vaidikāḥ śabdāḥ samaya nirapekṣāḥ evam api a sāmayika tva abhyupagamyamāne vyavahāre nānā arthānām sarvatra vaidike api śabde na tad āśaṃkā nivṛtteḥ iti sambandhaḥ nānā artha śaṃkāyāḥ anivṛtteḥ iti arthaḥ laukikānām eva nānā artha tvat na vaidikānām iti ced āha kasyacid ityādi

original: tasyāpi vaidikasya kasyacid prasiddhārthasyeti yatra śabdaḥ prasiddho nārthastasyāprasiddhasya vā svarūpeṇa śabdasya | punar vyutpattipradarśanenārthaḥ kalpanīyaḥ puruṣaiḥ | tathā ca sati punaḥ kiṃ yathā sthitam evārthaṃ puruṣo vaidikānāṃ śabdānām upadiśati kimvāviparītam iti sarvatra nānārthā śaṅkāyā anivṛtteḥ |
analyzed: tasya api vaidikasya kasyacid prasiddha arthasya iti yatra śabdaḥ prasiddhaḥ na arthaḥ tasya aprasiddhasya vā svarūpeṇa śabdasya punar vyutpatti pradarśanena arthaḥ kalpanīyaḥ puruṣaiḥ tathā ca sati punar kim yathā sthitam eva artham puruṣaḥ vaidikānām śabdānām upadiśati kim vā aviparītam iti sarvatra nānārthā śaṅkāyāḥ anivṛtteḥ

original: aniṣṭerthe prayuktā api vaidikāś śabdā na tatra pratītiṃ janayantīty apy ayuktaṃ | (p. 598) yataḥ sarveṣāṃ śabdānāṃ laukikānāṃ vaidikānāṃ ca yathārthan niyogepi | vīpsāyām avyayībhāvaḥ | yasmin yasminn arthe niyogassaṃketas tasmin saty apy avaiguṇyena tatra tatrārthe yathāsamayaṃ yathāsaṃketaṃ pratītijananāt | na cāniṣṭenyathāpratītijananaṃ |
analyzed: aniṣṭa ṛthe prayuktāḥ api vaidikāḥ śabdāḥ na tatra pratītim janayanti iti api ayuktam yatas sarveṣām śabdānām laukikānām vaidikānām ca niyoge api vīpsāyām avyayībhāvaḥ yasmin yasmin arthe niyogaḥ saṃketaḥ tasmin sati api a vaiguṇyena tatra tatra arthe yathāsamayam yathāsaṃketam pratīti jananāt na ca aniṣṭa inyathā pratīti jananam

original: yata iṣṭāniṣṭayor arthayoḥ pratyāsattiviprakarṣābhāvena pratītajananasyāviśeṣāt | tataś cāviśiṣṭānāṃ sarvartheṣu vaidikānāṃ śabdānām ekam arthaṃ kim viśiṣṭm atyakṣasaṃyogaṃ  (|) śabdena saha sambandho yasya sa tathoktaḥ | anatyakṣadarśini | arvāgdarśini puruṣasāmānye ko vivecayet (|) naiva kaścid vivecayet | yato lokāt pratītiḥ syāt |
analyzed: yatas iṣṭa aniṣṭayoḥ arthayoḥ pratyāsatti viprakarṣa abhāvena pratīta jananasya aviśeṣāt tatas ca aviśiṣṭānām sarva artheṣu vaidikānām śabdānām ekam artham kim viśiṣṭam atyakṣa saṃyogam śabdena saha sambandhaḥ yasya sa tathā uktaḥ an atyakṣa darśini arvāk darśini puruṣa sāmānye kaḥ vivecayet na eva kaścid vivecayet yatas lokāt pratītiḥ syāt

original: api ca (|) ayaṃ mī māṃ sa kaḥ svayam api na sarvatra vede prasiddhimanusarati | yena prasiddhāl lokapravādād vedārthagatiḥ syāt | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ | yasmāt svargorvaśyādiśabdaś ca | svargaśabda urvarśī śabdaḥ | ādiśabdān na nda na va nā di śabdaś cārūḍhārthasyāprasiddhārthasya vācako 'nena vedavādinā nirvarṇṇyamāno vyākhyāyamāno dṛṣṭaḥ |
analyzed: api ca ayam mī mām sa kaḥ svayam api na sarvatra vede prasiddhim anusarati yena prasiddhāt loka pravādāt veda artha gatiḥ syāt kim kāraṇam yasmāt svarga urvaśī ādi śabdaḥ ca svarga śabdaḥ urvarśī śabdaḥ ādi śabdāt na śabdaḥ ca ārūḍha arthasya aprasiddha arthasya vācakaḥ nena veda vādinā nirvarṇṇyamānaḥ vyākhyāyamānaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ

original: tathā hi prākṛtapuruṣātiśāyino ye puruṣaṃ viśeṣās teṣāṃ niketaḥ sthānaṃ | mānuṣātikrāntaṃ sukham atimānuṣaṃ tasyātimānuṣasya sukhasyādhiṣṭhānam āśrayaḥ | nānāprakārāṇyupakaraṇānyupabhigavastūni yasmin | sa nānopakaraṇaḥ svarga iti lokapravādaḥ tannivāsinī svarganivāsinyapsarā urvarśī nāmeti lokapravādaḥ |
analyzed: tathā hi prākṛta puruṣa atiśāyinaḥ ye puruṣam viśeṣāḥ teṣām niketaḥ sthānam mānuṣa atikrāntam sukham ati mānuṣam tasya ati mānuṣasya sukhasya adhiṣṭhānam āśrayaḥ nānā prakārāṇi upakaraṇāni upabhiga vastūni yasmin sa nānā upakaraṇaḥ svargaḥ iti loka pravādaḥ tad nivāsinī svarga nivāsinī apsarāḥ urvarśī nāma iti loka pravādaḥ

original: taṃ lokapravādamanādṛtya manuṣyeṣv eva niratiśayā prītiḥ svargaḥ | urvaśī cāraṇiḥ | pātrīvetyādinā | lokaprasiddhād arthād anyām evārthakalpanām ayaṃ jai mi nyādiḥ kurvāṇognihotrādiśabdāntareṣv arthanirṇṇaye | kathaṃ prasiddhiṃ pramāṇayet | naiva pramāṇayed iti yāvat |
analyzed: tam loka pravādam an ādṛtya manuṣyeṣu eva niratiśayā prītiḥ svargaḥ urvaśī ca araṇiḥ pātrī iva ityādinā loka prasiddhāt arthāt anyām eva artha kalpanām ayam nyādiḥ kurvāṇa ugnihotra ādi śabda antareṣu artha nirṇṇaye katham prasiddhim pramāṇayet na eva pramāṇayet iti yāvat

original: tatrāgnihotrādiśabdeṣu lokaprasiddhārthakalpanāyā avirodhāt pratītasyaivārthasyābhyupagama iti cet | svargorvaśyādiśabdeṣu tu prasiddhārthabhyupagame pramāṇavirodhād anabhyupagama iti paro manyate |
analyzed: tatra agnihotra ādi śabdeṣu loka prasiddha artha kalpanāyāḥ avirodhāt pratītasya eva arthasya abhyupagamaḥ iti ced svarga urvaśī ādi śabdeṣu tu prasiddha artha abhyupagame pramāṇa virodhāt anabhyupagamaḥ iti paraḥ manyate

original: (p. 599) netyādinā si ddhā nta vā dī | bhedam anantaroktaṃ yujyate | yasmād atrāpi svargārvaśyādiśabdeṣu lokaprasiddhetīndriyerthebhyupagamyamāne | pramāṇena virodhāsiddheḥ | na hy atra pratyakṣam anumānaṃ vā bādhakaṃ pramāṇam asti | anyatrāpīty agnihotrādiśabdeṣv api lokaprasiddhārthakalpanāyām avirodhasya duranvayatvāt |
analyzed: na ityādinā bhedam anantara uktam yujyate yasmāt atra api svarga arvaśī ādi śabdeṣu loka prasiddhā iti indriya īrtha abhyupagamyamāne pramāṇena virodha asiddhyāḥ na hi atra pratyakṣam anumānam vā bādhakam pramāṇam asti anyatra api iti agnihotra ādi śabdeṣu api loka prasiddha artha kalpanāyām avirodhasya duranvaya tvāt

original: sādhakapramāṇābhāvena durbodhatvāt |
analyzed: sādhaka pramāṇa abhāvena durbodha tvāt

original: etad eva sādhayannāha – viruddhām api yathāprasiddhām agnihotrāt svargāvāptimāndyādayaṃ jai mi nyā dirna lakṣayed api kadācid iti saṃśayaḥ | kiṃ ca (|) virodhāvirodhau ca nānyāv eva (|) kin tarhi (|) bādhakasādhakapramāṇavṛttī | yathoktasyānupalambhākhyasya bādhakasya pramāṇasya vṛttir virodhaḥ |
analyzed: etat eva sādhayan āha viruddhām api yathā prasiddhām agnihotrāt svarga avāpti māndyāt ayam lakṣayet api kadācid iti saṃśayaḥ kim ca virodha avirodhau ca na anyau eva kin tarhi bādhaka sādhaka pramāṇa vṛttī yathā uktasya anupalambha ākhyasya bādhakasya pramāṇasya vṛttiḥ virodhaḥ

original: sādhakasya pratyayānumānasya pramāṇasya vṛttir avirodhaḥ | te ca virodhavirodhasvabhāve | bādhakasādhakapramāṇavṛttī | atyakṣw 'tīndriye vastuni nābhimate | na hi deśādiviprakṛṣṭeṣu svargādisādhaneṣu bādhakaṃ sādhakaṃ ca pramāṇaṃ pravartate | yadā caivan tat kathaṃ naiva tadvaśād iti virodhāvirodhavaśāt |
analyzed: sādhakasya pratyaya anumānasya pramāṇasya vṛttiḥ avirodhaḥ te ca virodha virodha svabhāve bādhaka sādhaka pramāṇa vṛttī tīndriye vastuni na abhimate na hi deśa ādi viprakṛṣṭeṣu svarga ādi sādhaneṣu bādhakam sādhakam ca pramāṇam pravartate yadā ca evam tat katham na eva tad vaśāt iti virodha avirodha vaśāt

original: virodhavaśāt svargādiśabdeṣu prasiddhārthapratītir avirodhavaśāc cāgnihotrādiśabdeṣu prasiddhārthapratītiḥ |
analyzed: virodha vaśāt svarga ādi śabdeṣu prasiddha artha pratītiḥ avirodha vaśāt ca agnihotra ādi śabdeṣu prasiddha artha pratītiḥ

original: atha mataṃ (|) na sādhakapramāṇavṛttir avirodhotīndriyerthe kiṃ tvāgamasaṃjñitasyāgnihotrādivacanasya lokaprasiddhārthavācakatvena pravṛttir evāvirodha iti (|)
analyzed: atha matam na sādhaka pramāṇa vṛttiḥ kim tu āgama saṃjñitasya agnihotra ādi vacanasya loka prasiddha artha vācaka tvena pravṛttiḥ eva avirodhaḥ iti

original: ata āha – na cetyādi | lokaprasiddhārthavācakatvenāgnihotrādivacanasya pravṛttir evāvirodho na ca | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) anyatrāpi svargorvaśyādiśabdāḥsthānāpsaroviśeṣādiṣv eva pravṛttā loke dṛśyante | tataś cāviśeṣād ubhayatra prasiddhārthaparigrahos tu | na caikatrāpi |
analyzed: atas āha na ca ityādi loka prasiddha artha vācaka tvena agnihotra ādi vacanasya pravṛttiḥ eva avirodhaḥ na ca kim kāraṇam anyatra api svarga urvaśī ādi śabdāḥ sthāna apsaraḥ viśeṣa ādiṣu eva pravṛttāḥ loke dṛśyante tatas ca aviśeṣāt ubhayatra prasiddha artha parigrahoḥ tu na ca ekatra api

original: kiṃ ca (|) apauruṣeyo vedākhya āgamaḥ sa ca svam arthaṃ svayaṃ na prakāśayati kin tu tasyāgamasya lokapravādād arthasiddhir abhyupagamyate | tatra punar lokaprasiddhyaṅgīkaraṇepi virodhacintāyāṃ kriyamāṇāyāṃ sarvatrāgame 'nāśvāsaḥ syād atīndriye virodhāvirodhayor niścetum aśakyatvāt |
analyzed: kim ca apauruṣeyaḥ veda ākhyaḥ āgamaḥ sa ca svam artham svayam na prakāśayati kin tu tasya āgamasya loka pravādāt artha siddhiḥ abhyupagamyate tatra punar loka prasiddhi aṅgīkaraṇe api virodha cintāyām kriyamāṇāyām sarvatra āgame na āśvāsaḥ syāt atīndriye virodha avirodhayoḥ niścetum aśakya tvāt

original: anāśvāsam eva sādhayannāha – satyapītyādi | saty api tasminn apauruṣeya (p. 600) āgame | svargādiśabdavācyasya svargādyarthasyātathābhāvāt | tathābhāvas tathātvaṃ (|) yathā loke prasiddhasvargārthagrahaṇam atathābhāvād aprasiddhārthagrahaṇād anyasyāpy agnihotrādiśabdasya śaṃkanīyatvāt |
analyzed: anāśvāsam eva sādhayan āha sati api ityādi sati api tasmin apauruṣeya āgame svarga ādi śabda vācyasya svarga ādi arthasya atathābhāvāt tathābhāvaḥ tathātvam yathā loke prasiddha svarga artha grahaṇam atathābhāvāt aprasiddha artha grahaṇāt anyasya api agnihotra ādi śabdasya śaṃkanīya tvāt

original: kim asya lokaprasiddha evārthaḥ kim vā svargādiśabdavadanya eveti | etad eva kutaḥ (|) pramāṇavṛtteḥ | na hy atra lokaprasiddhārthagrahaṇe pramāṇaṃ pravarttata iti |

original: yad uktam ityādi paraḥ | yad uktam (|) "agnihotraṃ juhuyādi"ty atra vākyeśvamāṃsabhakṣaṇasya codanābhidhānantasya vikalpaḥ kalpanā bhavatv iti | sa doṣo na bhavati | kiṃ kāraṇam (|) vedasyaiva pradeśāntare tatheti bhūtaviśeṣe ghṛtādikaṃ prakṣiped ity evam asyāgnihotrādivākyāsyārthacarccanāt | vyākhyānāt |

analyzed: yadi ityādi asya eva samarthanam yadi hi ayam apauruṣeyaḥ veda ākhyaḥ śabdarāśiḥ kvacid pradeśa antare vidita arthaḥ syāt tadā tatas vidita arthāt pradeśa antarāt pariśiṣṭasya artha pratītiḥ syāt yāvatā te tu vaidikāḥ śabdāḥ bāhulye pi a parijñāna artha tvāt andhāḥ eva sarve iti kṛtvā puruṣeṇa yatheṣṭam praṇīyante vyākhyāyante

original: yata evaṃ tasmāc chabdāntareṣu tādṛkṣivati | agnihotraṃ juhuyād ityādi vākyānām vyākhyābhūteṣu tādṛśy evāstu kalpanā | kīdṛśī (|) ity āha – yādṛśy agnihotrañjuhuyātsvargakāma ity asya kalpanā kṛtā pradeśāntarepi śvamāṃsabhakṣaṇakalpanāstitvati yāvat |
