original: api ca prasiddhiś ca nānyad eva kiṃcit | kin tarhi (|) nṛṇāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ vadaḥ (p. 601) sa ca vādaḥ pramāṇanneṣyate bhavatā | sarvapuruṣāṇāṃ rāgādyupaplutatvāt | bhūya iti punaḥ | tataś ca lokapravādād apramāṇatvena pūrvaṃ vyavasthāpitāt punar vedārthagatir iti yugapat kim etad viṣṭakāmitaṃ | yad eva vastv apramāṇatvena dviṣṭaṃ |
analyzed: api ca prasiddhiḥ ca na anyat eva kiṃcid kin tarhi nṛṇām puruṣāṇām vadaḥ sa ca vādaḥ pramāṇam na iṣyate bhavatā sarva puruṣāṇām rāga ādi upapluta tvāt bhūyas iti punar tatas ca loka pravādāt apramāṇa tvena pūrvam vyavasthāpitāt punar veda artha gatiḥ iti yugapad kim etat viṣṭa kāmitam yat eva vastu apramāṇa tvena dviṣṭam

original: tad eva punaḥ pratipattihetutvena kāmitam abhilaṣitam iti parasparavirodhaḥ |
analyzed: tat eva punar pratipatti hetu tvena kāmitam abhilaṣitam iti paraspara virodhaḥ

original: na prasiddhir nāmānyā janapravādāt | kin tu janapravāda eva prasiddhiḥ | te ca sarve janā asambhāvanīyayāthātathyavacanā asambhāvanīyaṃ yāthātathyamaviparītatvaṃ yamin vacane | tadasambhāvanīyayāthātathyaṃ vacanaṃ yeṣām iti vigrahaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) rāgāvidyāparītatvāt | rāgāvidyābhyāṃ vyāptatvāt | tad iti tasmād eṣāṃ janānāṃ pravādo na pramāṇaṃ |
analyzed: na prasiddhiḥ nāma anyā jana pravādāt kin tu jana pravādaḥ eva prasiddhiḥ te ca sarve janāḥ asambhāvanīya yāthātathya vacanāḥ asambhāvanīyam yāthātathyam aviparīta tvam yamin vacane tat asambhāvanīya yāthātathyam vacanam yeṣām iti vigrahaḥ kim kāraṇam rāga avidyā parīta tvāt rāga avidyābhyām vyāpta tvāt tat iti tasmāt eṣām janānām pravādaḥ na pramāṇam

original: bāhulyāj janasya tatpravādaḥ pramāṇam ity api mithyā | yataḥ (|) na hi bahunāṃ janānāmmadhye kasyacid ekasyāpi puruṣasya samyakpratipatter abhāve sati lokasya bāhulyam arthavad bhavati prayojanavad bhavati | kim iva (|) pārasī ketyādi | yathā bahubhiḥ pārasīkairmātari maithunācaraṇān na tannyāyyam bhavati |
analyzed: bāhulyāt janasya tad pravādaḥ pramāṇam iti api mithyā yatas na hi bahunām janānām madhye kasyacid ekasya api puruṣasya samyak pratipatteḥ abhāve sati lokasya bāhulyam arthavat bhavati prayojanavat bhavati kim iva pārasī ka ityādi yathā bahubhiḥ pārasīkaiḥ mātari maithuna ācaraṇāt na tat nyāyyam bhavati

original: evaṃ bāhulyepi rāgādimatāmatīndriyerthe vacanam apramāṇam eveti |
analyzed: evam bāhulye api rāga ādimatām atīndriya irthe vacanam apramāṇam eva iti

original: atha teṣām eva rāgādimatāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ vacanāt punaḥ parokṣasyāgnihotrādiśabdavācyasyārthasya pratipattir iti | kathan tad eva yugapad ekasminn eva kāle dveṣyaṃ kāmyaṃ ca yujyate |
analyzed: atha teṣām eva rāga ādimatām puruṣāṇām vacanāt punar parokṣasya agnihotra ādi śabda vācyasya arthasya pratipattiḥ iti kathan tat eva yugapad ekasmin eva kāle dveṣyam kāmyam ca yujyate

original: agnihotrādiśabdasya yasminn arthe lokaprasiddhistāmullaṃdhya tyaktvā | tatorthāntarasya śvamāṃsabhakṣaṇādeḥ kalpane na nibandhanaṃ kāraṇam iti | tasmāt prasiddhir eva gṛhyata ity etad apy ayuktaṃ | yataḥ prasiddher apramāṇatvāt tadgrahe prasiddhigrahe kinnibandhanaṃ (|) naiva kiñcid iti prasiddher api graho mābhūd iti |
analyzed: agnihotra ādi śabdasya yasmin arthe loka prasiddhiḥ tām ullaṃdhya tyaktvā tatas ṛtha antarasya śva māṃsa bhakṣaṇa ādeḥ kalpane na nibandhanam kāraṇam iti tasmāt prasiddhiḥ eva gṛhyate iti etat api ayuktam yatas prasiddheḥ apramāṇa tvāt tad grahe prasiddhi grahe kinnibandhanam na eva kiñcid iti prasiddheḥ api grahaḥ mā abhūt iti

original: (p. 602) prāptyetyādinā pūrvārddhantāvad vyācaṣṭe | prasiddhyā prāptasyārthasya pratilomanena tyāgenānyatrāprasiddherthe pravṛttir guṇadoṣadarśane sati yuktā | yadi prāpterthe doṣadarśanaṃ syād aprāpte ca guṇadarśanaṃ | na cāgnihotrādiśabdānāṃ prasiddherthe doṣadarśanam asty aprasiddhe vā guṇadarśanan tataḥ prasiddhe evānvayonugamanam iti cet |
analyzed: prāptyā ityādinā vyācaṣṭe prasiddhyā prāptasya arthasya pratilomanena tyāgena anyatra aprasiddha ṛthe pravṛttiḥ guṇa doṣa darśane sati yuktā yadi prāpta arthe doṣa darśanam syāt aprāpte ca guṇa darśanam na ca agnihotra ādi śabdānām prasiddha arthe doṣa darśanam asti aprasiddhe vā tatas prasiddhe eva anvaya anugamanam iti ced

original: netyādinā pratiṣedhati | etac ca paścārddhasya vivaraṇaṃ | naitad evaṃ (|) kiṃṅkāraṇaṃ (|) prāpteḥ pramāṇavṛttilakṣaṇatvāt | sādhakena hi pramāṇenārthasya prāptir niścīyata iti prāpteḥ pramāṇavṛttilakṣĪṇatvam ucyate | na ca prasiddhiḥ pramāṇaṃ yena siddhortho nyāyaprāptaḥ syāt |
analyzed: na ityādinā pratiṣedhati etat ca paśca arddhasya vivaraṇam na etat evam kiṃkāraṇam prāpteḥ pramāṇa vṛtti lakṣaṇa tvāt sādhakena hi pramāṇena arthasya prāptiḥ niścīyate iti prāpteḥ pramāṇa vṛtti lakṣīṇa tvam ucyate na ca prasiddhiḥ pramāṇam yena siddhaḥ ūrthaḥ nyāya prāptaḥ syāt

original: tataś ca tām enāṃ prasiddhim apramāṇayato mī māṃ sa ka sya tanmukhena prasiddhidvāreṇāgnihotrādiśabdavācyasyārthasya yā pratītiḥ sā yatkiñcana grahaṇam apramāṇakatvāt | yathā kathañcit tadgrahaṇam ity arthaḥ |
analyzed: tatas ca tām enām prasiddhim a pramāṇayataḥ mī mām sa tad mukhena prasiddhi dvāreṇa agnihotra ādi śabda vācyasya arthasya yā pratītiḥ sā yat kiñcana grahaṇam apramāṇaka tvāt yathā kathañcid tat grahaṇam iti arthaḥ

original: tataś cāgnihotrādiśabdasya lokaprasiddhortho nyāyaprāpto na bhavatīty evaṃ nyāyāllokaprasiddhasyārthasya prāptipratiṣedhāt kāraṇādagnihotrādiśabdānām icchayārthaḥ parikalpanīyaḥ |
analyzed: tatas ca agnihotra ādi śabdasya loka prasiddhaḥ ūrthaḥ nyāya prāptaḥ na bhavati iti evam nyāyāt loka prasiddhasya arthasya prāpti pratiṣedhāt kāraṇāt agnihotra ādi śabdānām icchayā arthaḥ parikalpanīyaḥ

original: tatra mī māṃ sa kair agnihotrādiśabdānāṃ yorthaḥ parikalpyate dahanadravyādilakṣaṇo yaś ca pareṇa śvamāṃsabhakṣaṇalkṣaṇastayoḥ svaparavikalpayor ubhayathāpīti yadi prasiddhyanupālanam atha nānupālanan tathāpi pramāṇābhāvādicchayā parigrahe tulyā vṛttir iti kṛtvā kaḥ prasiddhānurodho yena prasiddher arthakalpanā kriyate |
analyzed: tatra mī mām sa kaiḥ agnihotra ādi śabdānām yaḥ ṛthaḥ parikalpyate dahana dravya ādi lakṣaṇaḥ yaḥ ca pareṇa śva māṃsa bhakṣaṇa lkṣaṇaḥ tayoḥ sva para vikalpayoḥ ubhayathā api iti yadi prasiddhi anupālanam atha na anupālanan tathā api pramāṇa abhāvāt icchayā parigrahe tulyā vṛttiḥ iti kṛtvā kaḥ prasiddha anurodhaḥ yena prasiddheḥ artha kalpanā kriyate

original: api ca (|) prasiddhyaiva sarvaśabdānām arthaniścaye | iyannānārthatvena śaṃkotpāditā | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) yasmānnā(nā)rth vṛttitvam agnyādiśabdānān tatra prasiddhau dṛśyate |
analyzed: api ca prasiddhyā eva sarva śabdānām artha niścaye iyat nānārthatvena śaṃkā utpāditā kim kāraṇam yasmāt nānā arth vṛtti tvam tatra prasiddhau dṛśyate

original: netyādinā vyācaṣṭe | na prasiddhes sakāśādekārthaniścayaḥ śabdānām vaidikānāṃ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) tata eva prasiddher eva śaṃkotpatteḥ | tathā hi nānārthā agnyādiśabdā loke dṛśyante | tac ca nānārthadarśanaṃ lokavādo lokapravādaś ca pratītir ata eva (p. 603) lokavādānnā(nā)rthateti kṛtvā tato lokavādād vaidikānāṃ śabdānām ekārthaniyamo na yuktaḥ |
analyzed: na ityādinā vyācaṣṭe na prasiddheḥ sakāśāt eka artha niścayaḥ śabdānām vaidikānām kim kāraṇam tatas eva prasiddheḥ eva śaṃkā utpatteḥ tathā hi nānā arthāḥ agni ādi śabdāḥ loke dṛśyante tat ca nānā artha darśanam lokavādaḥ loka pravādaḥ ca pratītiḥ atas eva lokavādāt nānā artha tā iti kṛtvā tatas lokavādāt vaidikānām śabdānām eka artha niyamaḥ na yuktaḥ

original: aniyatārthatvam eva draḍhayannāha – anyathetyādi | svayaṃ svabhāvato nānāśakter anekārthapratipādanayogyasya dhvaneḥ śabdasyānyathāsambhadābhāvāt | abhimatādarthādarthāntare vṛttir anyathā | tasyā arthāntaravṛtter asambhavonyathā 'sambhavas tasyābhāvāt | pratiṣedhadvayena vidher abhyupagamādanyathāpi sambhavasya bhāvād iti yāvat |
analyzed: aniyata artha tvam eva draḍhayan āha anyathā ityādi svayam svabhāvataḥ nānā śakteḥ aneka artha pratipādana yogyasya dhvaneḥ śabdasya anyathā sambhada abhāvāt abhimatāt arthāt artha antare vṛttiḥ anyathā tasyāḥ artha antara vṛtteḥ asambhavaḥ nyathā sambhavaḥ tasya abhāvāt pratiṣedha dvayena vidheḥ abhyupagamāt anyathā api sambhavasya bhāvāt iti yāvat

original: tataś cātīndriyārthavṛttiṣu vaidikeṣu śabdeṣv avaśyam anekārthavṛttitvena śaṃkayā bhāvyaṃ | keṣāṃ niyāmakam apaśyatā puṃsāṃ pratiniyataviṣayasādhakaṃ pramāãm apaśyatāṃ | (326)
analyzed: tatas ca atīndriya artha vṛttiṣu vaidikeṣu śabdeṣu avaśyam aneka artha vṛtti tvena śaṃkayā bhāvyam keṣām niyāmakam apaśyatā puṃsām pratiniyata viṣaya sādhakam pramāãm apaśyatām

original: yata evaṃ tasmād (|) aviditaḥ arthavibhāgo yeṣām iti vigrahaḥ | teṣv aviditārthavibhāgeṣu śabdeṣv ekam artham abhimataṃ (|) kiṃ bhūtam (|) atyakṣasaṃyogaṃ | atyakṣotīvibhāgeṣu śabdena saha sambandho yasyeti vigrahaḥ | ālambanaṃ pramāṇantad abhāvādanālambano niḥpramāṇakassamāropo yasya sa tathoktaḥ |
analyzed: yatas evam tasmāt aviditaḥ artha vibhāgaḥ yeṣām iti vigrahaḥ teṣu avidita artha vibhāgeṣu śabdeṣu ekam artham abhimatam kim bhūtam atyakṣa saṃyogam śabdena saha sambandhaḥ yasya iti vigrahaḥ ālambanam pramāṇam tat abhāvāt anālambanaḥ niḥpramāṇakaḥ samāropaḥ yasya sa tathā uktaḥ

original: tam evaṃ bhūtam artham iva niścatya vyācakṣāṇo jai mi niḥ | tadvyājeneti veda evaṃ prāheti vedopakṣepeṇa svam eva matamāheti kṛtvā yastīrthya(?rtha)karo nirvyājam evam āha – aham eva svayamvadāmīti | tasmāt tīrya(?tha)kārāntarādasya jai mi ner na viśeṣaṃ paśyāmaḥ |
analyzed: tam evam bhūtam artham iva niścatya vyācakṣāṇaḥ jai mi niḥ tad vyājena iti vedaḥ evam prāha iti veda upakṣepeṇa svam eva matam āha iti kṛtvā yaḥ tīrthi arthakaraḥ nirvyājam evam āha aham eva svayam vadāmi iti tasmāt na viśeṣam paśyāmaḥ

original: aviśeṣam eva sādhayannāha – tathā hītyādi | sa cāsāvarthaś ceti tadarthas tasya prakāśanam vacanaṃ | tatra vyāpāras sāmarthyan tena śūnyasya rahitasya vedasya | tatsamāropeṇety arthaprakāśanavyāpārasamāropeṇa……………………evamvaktīti yadabhidhānanta (……………………) svavacanam eva tasya tad iti yāvat |
analyzed: aviśeṣam eva sādhayan āha tathā hi ityādi sa ca asau arthaḥ ca iti tad arthaḥ tasya prakāśanam vacanam tatra vyāpāraḥ sāmarthyan tena śūnyasya rahitasya vedasya tad samāropeṇa iti artha prakāśana vyāpāra samāropeṇa evam vakti iti sva vacanam eva tasya tat iti yāvat

original: tatkāriṇā vacanavyāpāraśūnye vederthaprakāśanavyāpārasamāropakāriṇā jai mi ni nā kevalam mithyāvinī tataivātmanaḥ samuddyotitā syāt | na tu pauruṣeyād vacanādasya viśeṣaḥ |
analyzed: tad kāriṇā vacana vyāpāra śūnye kevalam mithyā vinī tatā eva ātmanaḥ samuddyotitā syāt na tu pauruṣeyāt vacanāt asya viśeṣaḥ

original: (p. 604) etad eva sphuṭayannāha – tathā hītyādi | kaḥ panthā pā ṭa li pu traṃ gacchatīti pṛṣṭaḥ kaścana puruṣa āha – na jāne svayam ahaṃ kevalam eṣa sthāṇur ayaṃ mārga iti vaktīty evam eko mārgopadeśasāmarthyaśūnyasthāṇuvyājena mārgam ācaṣṭe | anyas tv āha – na sthāṇor vacanasāmarthyam asty aham eva svayaṃ jñātvāyaṃ mārga iti brabīmīti |
analyzed: etat eva sphuṭayan āha tathā hi ityādi kaḥ panthā gacchati iti pṛṣṭaḥ kaścana puruṣaḥ āha na jāne svayam aham kevalam eṣa sthāṇuḥ ayam mārgaḥ iti vakti iti evam ekaḥ mārga upadeśa sāmarthya śūnya sthāṇu vyājena mārgam ācaṣṭe anyaḥ tu āha na sthāṇoḥ vacana sāmarthyam asti aham eva svayam jñātvā ayam mārgaḥ iti brabīmi iti

original: tayor evam abhidadhatoḥ svayam vacanabhedaḥ parīkṣyatāṃ yady asti naivāstīty abhiprāyaḥ |
analyzed: tayoḥ evam abhidadhatoḥ svayam vacana bhedaḥ parīkṣyatām yadi asti na eva asti iti abhiprāyaḥ

original: nirabhiprāya ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | abhiprāya idaṃ cedaṃ ca kariṣyāmīti cetanā | tatpūrvakaḥ prayatno vyāpāraḥ | abhiprāyaś ca vyāpāraś ca vacanaṃ ca | tāni na vidyante yasminsa tathoktaḥ | tasminn evam bhūte sthāṇau mārgaprakāśaktvaṃ samāropyopadiśat ekasya puṃsaḥ svatantrasya vā sthāṇunirapekṣasyāparasya mārgam upadiśata iti sambandhaḥ |

original: evaṃ vidhipratiṣedhasiddhau satyām pariśeṣṭeṣv atyantaparokṣeṣv artheṣu śabdānāṃ nāntaratīyakatābhāve sambandhābhāve saty api varamagatyā saṃśayitasya puruṣasya pravṛttis tatreti sarvasmin vastunyadṛṣṭavyabhicāra āgame kadācid avisamvādasambhavāt |

original: dṛṣṭāntatvenopadarśya sarvaṃ satyārthamvedalakṣaṇaṃ śāstram ity āha – kimbhūtaṃ śāstraṃ śakyaparicchede pramāṇagamye 'pi viṣaye pramāṇavirodhād bahutaram ayuktam api tad evaṃbhūtaṃ śāstraṃ pratijānāno mīmāṃsakādir jayed dhāṣrṭyena bandhakīm iti vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ |

original: vahutaram ayuktam apīty uktantaddarśayann āha – nityasyetyādi | badad ity etatpadaṃ sarvatra sambandha(nīyaṃ |) nityaḥ karttā puruṣostīty evan nityasya puṃsaḥ karttṛtvam vadacchāstraṃ | tathā nityān bhāvān vadat | atīndriyānapratyakṣānarthānaidriyān pratyakṣān vadat | tathā viṣamam ayuktaṃ hetuṃ bhāvānāṃ vadat | tathā bhāvānām viṣamāṃ sthitiṃ |

original: apracyuter ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | apracyutaṃ pūrvaṃ rūpaṃ | anutpannaṃ cāparaṃ rūpaṃ (p. 611) yasyeti vigrahaḥ | īdṛśaḥ kila pumān sukṛtaduṣkṛtānāṃ karmaṇāṃ krameṇa karttā | karmaphalānāṃ ca bhoktā | kena prakāreṇa bhiktā karttā cety āha – pūrvakarmajanitasukhaduḥkhādisamvittiṃ prati samavāyikāraṇabhāvenātmā karma phalānāmbhiktāḥ | tad uktaṃ |

original: arthakriyāsamarthaṃ hi vastu | tac cārthakriyāsāmarthyam akṣaṇikasya na sambhavatīty asad eva (|) tatkutas tasya vastudharmaḥ | apratyakṣāṇyeva sāmānyādīnīti (|) ādiśabdāt kriyāguṇādīni pratyakṣāṇīty āha vedaḥ | janma ca sthitiś ca ni(vṛ)ttiś ca tāś ca bhāvānām viṣamāḥ prāha vedaḥ | janmano vaiṣamyeṇa viṣayo hetur bhāvānām uktaḥ sūtre |

original: tam eva viṣamaṃ hetum āha – anādheyasyetyādi | nityatvādanādheyātiśayasya prāg ity arthakriyākālāvasthāyāḥ pūrvam akarttuḥ paścāt parāpekṣayā sahakāryapekṣayā | janakatvam āha vedaḥ | tac caitad yuktam iti vistareṇa pratipāditaṃ |

original: evam manyate (|) pratyakṣānumānaviṣaye viśuddham upadarśya kadācid anyatra sambandhādirahite brū [……………] darthaṃ śāstradharmāpradarśanam uktaṃ |
analyzed: evam manyate pratyakṣa anumāna viṣaye viśuddham upadarśya kadācid anyatra sambandha ādi rahite śāstra dharma a pradarśanam uktam

original: evaṃ sambandhādyabhidhānāni ca śāstradharmānapradarśyātyantaprasiddhaviṣayasatyārthatābhidhānamātreṇety atyantaprasiddho viṣayo vahneḥ śītāpanodasāmarthyaṃ tasyābhidhānaṃ saty antena satyābhidhānamātreṇa | prajñāprakarṣeṇāpi duḥkhenāvagāhyata iti prajñāprakarṣaduravagrāha – tata eva gahanan tasmiṃs tathābhūtepi (viṣa)ye 'tyantaparokṣepīti yāvat |
analyzed: evam sambandha ādi abhidhānāni ca śāstra dharmān a pradarśya atyanta prasiddha viṣaya satya arthatā abhidhāna mātreṇa iti atyanta prasiddhaḥ viṣayaḥ vahneḥ śīta apanoda sāmarthyam tasya abhidhānam satī antena satya abhidhāna mātreṇa prajñā prakarṣeṇa api duḥkhena avagāhyate iti prajñā prakarṣa duravagrāha tatas eva tasmin tathābhūte api viṣaye tyanta parokṣe api iti yāvat

original: (p. 613) niratyayatāṃ satyārthatāṃ sādhayitukāmo mī māṃ sa ko bandhakīm api prāg albhyema dhārṣṭyena vijayate (|) yādṛśīñ ca bandhakīm vijyate tāṃ kañcid ityādinā darśayati | bandhako duścāriṇī | svayaṃ svāminā vipratipattisthāne dṛṣṭeti vipratipattyavasthāyān dṛṣṭvā parapuruṣeṇa saṇgatā tvam tiy upālabdhā satī | sā taṃ svāminaṃ pratyuvāca |
analyzed: niratyaya tām satya artha tām sādhayitu kāmaḥ mī mām sa kaḥ bandhakīm api prāk dhārṣṭyena vijayate yādṛśīn ca bandhakīm vijyate tām kañcid ityādinā darśayati bandhakaḥ duścāriṇī svayam svāminā vipratipatti sthāne dṛṣṭā iti vipratipatti avasthāyān dṛṣṭvā para puruṣeṇa upālabdhā satī sā tam svāminam pratyuvāca

original: pratyu[ta………………|] kathaṃ pratyuvācety āha – paśyata ityādi | pārśvasthāḥ striyo māta ity anena nāmantryante (|) mātaḥ paśyata puruṣasya madīyasya svāmino vaiparītyaṃ | nanu paśyateti loḍmadhyamapuruṣabahuvacanāntam etat |
analyzed: pratyuta katham pratyuvāca iti āha paśyata ityādi pārśva sthāḥ striyaḥ mātar iti anena na āmantryante mātar paśyata puruṣasya madīyasya svāminaḥ vaiparītyam nanu paśyata iti loṭ madhyamapuruṣa bahuvacana antam etat

original: tataś ca mātṛśabdād api bahubavacanam eva yuktammātara iti (|) tatraike pratipannā mātṛśabdenāmantritaikavacanān tena samānārtho mātaḥ śabdosti | vi[……………] svarapratirūpakāś ca nipātā ity anena nyāyena | sa cāvyayatvāt sarveṣu vacaneṣu tulyarūpa iti bahubacanenāpi paśyata śabdena sambadhyamano mātar ity eva prayukta iti |
analyzed: tatas ca mātṛ śabdāt api bahubacanam eva yuktam mātaraḥ iti tatra eke pratipannāḥ mātṛ śabdena āmantrita ekavacanān tena samāna arthaḥ mātar śabdaḥ asti svara pratirūpakāḥ ca nipātāḥ iti anena nyāyena sa ca avyaya tvāt sarveṣu vacaneṣu tulya rūpaḥ iti bahubacanena api paśyata śabdena sambadhya manaḥ mātar iti eva prayuktaḥ iti

original: anye tu paśyata mātaraḥ puruṣasyeti paṭhanti | dharmasya sādhanabhūtā patnī dharmapatnīti madhyapadalopī samāsaḥ | yayi dharmapatnyāṃ pratyayam akṛtvā ātmīyayor jalabu[dbuda……]) ddhāñjalabudbudyor dvayor netrābhidhānayoḥ karoti pratyayam iti prakṛtaṃ | netram ity abhidhānaṃ yayor iti vigrahaḥ | parapuruṣeṇāsaṅgateḥ kāraṇam āha – tenetyādi |
analyzed: anye tu paśyata mātaraḥ puruṣasya iti paṭhanti dharmasya sādhana bhūtā patnī dharma patnī iti madhya pada lopī samāsaḥ yayi dharma patnyām pratyayam a kṛtvā ātmīyayoḥ dvayoḥ netra abhidhānayoḥ karoti pratyayam iti prakṛtam netram iti abhidhānam yayoḥ iti vigrahaḥ para puruṣeṇa asaṅgateḥ kāraṇam āha tena ityādi

original: jaraṃś cāsau kāṇaś ceti jaratkāṇaḥ | vṛddhakāṇenety arthaḥ | tatra jaradgrahaṇena vayovaikalyam uktaṃ | paraṃ rūpasthānaṃ cakṣur iti tadvaikalyāt kāṇagrahaṇena vairūpyaṃ | grāmyagrahaṇena vaidagdhyādiguṇavaikalyaṃ | kāṣṭhahārakagrahaṇena kṛcchrajīvitvāt dāridryam uktaṃ | tad evaṃ vṛddhatvādiguṇayuktena puruṣeṇa saṅgaty arthaṃ prārthitāpi satī |
analyzed: jaran ca asau kāṇaḥ ca iti jarat kāṇaḥ vṛddha kāṇena iti arthaḥ tatra jarat grahaṇena vayaḥ vaikalyam uktam param rūpa sthānam cakṣuḥ iti tad vaikalyāt kāṇa grahaṇena vairūpyam grāmya grahaṇena vaidagdhya ādi guṇa vaikalyam kāṣṭha hāraka grahaṇena kṛcchra jīvi tvāt dāridryam uktam tat evam vṛddha tva ādi guṇa yuktena puruṣeṇa saṅgatī artham prārthitā api satī

original: nāhan tena saha saṅgatā prāk | rūpaguṇānurāgeṇa | rūpaṃ prāsādikatā | guṇo vaidagdhyādiko dharmaḥ | rūpaguṇayor anurāgobhilāṣas tena hetunā | maṃtrimukhyadārakaṃ mantripradhānadārakaṃ yuvānaṃ putraṃ | [mantrimu]khyaś cāsau dārakaś ceti vigrahaḥ | tam evaṃbhūtaṃ dārakaṃ kāmayeham iti katham idaṃ sambhāvyate |
analyzed: na ahan tena saha saṅga tā prāk rūpa guṇa anurāgeṇa rūpam prāsādika tā guṇaḥ vaidagdhya ādikaḥ dharmaḥ rūpa guṇayoḥ anurāgaḥ ubhilāṣaḥ tena hetunā maṃtri mukhya dārakam mantri pradhāna dārakam yuvānam putram mantri mukhyaḥ ca asau dārakaḥ ca iti vigrahaḥ tam evaṃbhūtam dārakam kāmaya iham iti katham idam sambhāvyate

original: tatra vṛddhādidoṣacaruṣṭayavaiparīty enamantrimukhyadārake guṇacatuṣṭayam uktaṃ | rūpagrahaṇena prāsādikatvaṃ guṇagrahaṇena vaigdhyādiḥ | mantrimukhyagrahaṇenaiśvaryaṃ | dārakagrahaṇena vayoguṇaḥ | etac ca bamdhakyā dhārṣṭyāt preritam eva kevalasvam vaca[naṃ na] tu yuktiyuktaṃ | rūpādīnām eva kāmahetutvān (p. 614) na tu vārddhakyādīnāṃ |
analyzed: tatra vṛddha ādi doṣa caruṣṭaya vaiparītī enam antri mukhya dārake guṇa catuṣṭayam uktam rūpa grahaṇena prāsādika tvam guṇa grahaṇena vaigdhya ādiḥ mantri mukhya grahaṇena aiśvaryam dāraka grahaṇena vayaḥ guṇaḥ etat ca bamdhakyā dhārṣṭyāt preritam eva kevala svam vacanam na tu yukti yuktam rūpa ādīnām eva na tu vārddhakya ādīnām

original: evaṃjātīyakam ityādinā dṛṣṭāntārthaṃ dārṣṭāntike yojayati | evaṃjātīyakam iti bandhakīprativacanatulyaṃ | etadatyantaparokṣerthe vedasyāvisamvādānumānaṃ (|) kim bhūtasya vedasya śakyavicāre vastuni dṛṣṭapramāṇavirodhasya | dṛṣṭaḥ pramāṇavirodhosyeti vigrahaḥ | [vahniśītanodana]dṛṣṭāntenānumānaṃ | bahneḥ śītapratīkāravacanena |
analyzed: evaṃjātīyakam ityādinā dṛṣṭānta artham dārṣṭāntike yojayati evaṃjātīyakam iti bandhakī prativacana tulyam etat atyanta parokṣa irthe vedasya avisamvāda anumānam kim bhūtasya vedasya śakya vicāre vastuni dṛṣṭa pramāṇa virodhasya dṛṣṭaḥ pramāṇa virodhaḥ usya iti vigrahaḥ vahni śīta nodana dṛṣṭāntena anumānam bahneḥ śīta pratīkāra vacanena

original: yathāgnir himasya bheṣajam iti vākyam avisamvādi | tathānyad api vedavākyam avisamvādīti |
analyzed: yathā agniḥ himasya bheṣajam iti vākyam avisamvādi tathā anyat api veda vākyam avisamvādi iti

original: tatra dharmapatnīsthānīyo vedaḥ | vipratipattitulyannityasya puṃsaḥ karttṛtvādyabhidhānaṃ | netratulye pratyakṣānumāne | na ca dṛṣṭavyabhicārāyāḥ patnyā vacanaṃ garīyas tasya puruṣasya yena [………………] yamvipratipattiṃ dṛṣṭvāpi svadarśanam apramāṇīkṛtya tasyā vacanaṃ yathārthaṃ kuryāt |
analyzed: tatra dharma patnī sthānīyaḥ vedaḥ vipratipatti tulya nityasya puṃsaḥ karttṛ tva ādi abhidhānam netra tulye pratyakṣa anumāne na ca dṛṣṭa vyabhicārāyāḥ patnyāḥ vacanam garīyaḥ tasya puruṣasya yena yam vipratipattim dṛṣṭvā api sva darśanam a pramāṇīkṛtya tasyāḥ vacanam yathārtham kuryāt

original: evam vedoktārthabādhakayoḥ pramāṇayor apramāṇyaṃ kṛtvā na vedasya patnīsthānīyasya dṛṣṭavyabhicārasya vacanādatyantaparokṣaṃ pratipadyemahīti | (336)
analyzed: evam veda ukta artha bādhakayoḥ pramāṇayoḥ apramāṇyam kṛtvā na vedasya patnī sthānīyasya dṛṣṭa vyabhicārasya vacanāt atyanta parokṣam pratipadyemahi iti

original: atraiva doṣāntaram āha – sidhyedityādi |evam iti yathā dṛṣṭaikasatyābhidhānamātreṇa yadi sarvo vedaḥ | […………pra] māṇaṃ sidhyet tadā sarvaḥ puruṣas sarvatrātha pramāṇam syāt | yasmān na hi puruṣe bahubhāṣiṇyekaṃ vacanaṃ satyārthaṃ nāsti (|) kintv asty eva |
analyzed: atra eva doṣa antaram āha sidhyet ityādi evam iti yathā dṛṣṭa eka satya abhidhāna mātreṇa yadi sarvaḥ vedaḥ māṇam sidhyet tadā sarvaḥ puruṣaḥ sarvatra atha pramāṇam syāt yasmāt na hi puruṣe bahu bhāṣiṇi ekam vacanam satya artham na asti kintu asti eva

original: yathetyādinā vyācaṣṭe | yathedam atyantam abhidhāyitvaṃ | ekāntena satyavāditvam atiduṣkaraṃ | atyantaduḥkhena triyata iti kṛtvā | tathātyantaṃ | satyābhidhānam atiduṣkarantatraivaṃsthite nyāye | ekasya […………vaca] nasya kathaṃcid iti kā ka tā lī ya nyāyenāpi yassamvādassatyārthatvan tena hetunā |
analyzed: yathā ityādinā vyācaṣṭe yathā idam atyantam abhidhāyi tvam ekāntena satya vādi tvam ati duṣkaram atyanta duḥkhena triyate iti kṛtvā tathā atyantam satya abhidhānam ati duṣkaram tatra evam sthite nyāye ekasya vaca nasya kathaṃcid iti nyāyena api yaḥ samvādaḥ satya artha tvan tena hetunā

original: tasmād avisamvādakād vacanād aviśiṣṭasya tadvacanarāśer iti yasya tadekamvacanam avisamvādi dṛṣṭantasya puruṣasya vacanarāśeḥ | tathābhāve 'visamvāditve 'bhyupagamyamāne | na kaścit puruṣo nāptaḥ syāt | kin tu sarva evāptaḥ syāt | na caivaṃ | tasmān naikadeśāvisamvā[dāt………prāmā]ṇyam iti |
analyzed: tasmāt avisamvādakāt vacanāt aviśiṣṭasya tad vacana rāśeḥ iti yasya tat ekam vacanam avisamvādi dṛṣṭa antasya puruṣasya vacana rāśeḥ tathā bhāve visamvādi tve bhyupagamyamāne na kaścid puruṣaḥ na āptaḥ syāt kin tu sarvaḥ eva āptaḥ syāt na ca evam tasmāt na eka deśa avisamvādāt prāmāṇyam iti

original: (p. 615) api ca yo nāma kaścit kasyacid gamakaḥ sa tatsvabhāvastajjanyo vā san gamayennānyathā | na cāyaṃ dhvanirvācyatvenābhimatānāṃ castūnāṃ svabhāvaḥ (|) kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) yasmād vaktari dhvaniḥ sthito na hy anyasvabhāvonyatra varttate | vastanāṃ kārya vā (|) nāyaṃ dhvaniḥ (|) kiṃ kāraṇaṃ (|) yasmād vaktari matidhvanir bhavati | tenāyam arthaḥ |
analyzed: api ca yaḥ nāma kaścid kasyacid gamakaḥ sa tad svabhāvaḥ tad janyaḥ vā san gamayet na anyathā na ca ayam dhvaniḥ vācyatvena abhimatānām castūnām svabhāvaḥ kim kāraṇam yasmāt vaktari dhvaniḥ sthitaḥ na hi anya svabhāvaḥ anyatra vartate vā na ayam dhvaniḥ kim kāraṇam yasmāt vaktri mati dhvaniḥ bhavati tena ayam arthaḥ

original: (|) yasmād vaktur icchāmātrapratibaddho na vāhyavastu […………] ity arthaḥ | na ca tadvyatiriktasyeti svabhāvakāryavyatiriktasyārthasyāvyabhicāritā vidyate |
analyzed: yasmāt vaktuḥ icchā mātra pratibaddhaḥ na vāhya vastu iti arthaḥ na ca tad vyatiriktasya iti svabhāva kārya vyatiriktasya arthasya avyabhicāri tā vidyate

original: netyādinā vyācaṣṭe | tāvacchabdaḥ krame | etad vaktṛstham vacanaṃ na tāvad vācyānām arthānāṃ svabhāvaḥ | nāpy eṣāṃ vācyānāṃ kāryaṃ | ki(ṅ) kāraṇaṃ (|) tadabhāvepi | vastūnām abhāvepi vivakṣāmātreṇa bhāvād utpatter na ca kāryasvabhāvābhyām anyaḥ kaścit kasyacid avyabhicārī hetur asti | vā[……………] vyabhicāre ca sati śabdasya tatonyathāpīti |
analyzed: na ityādinā vyācaṣṭe tāvat śabdaḥ krame etat vaktṛ stham vacanam na tāvat vācyānām arthānām svabhāvaḥ nā api eṣām vācyānām kāryam kim kāraṇam tad abhāve pi vastūnām abhāve pi vivakṣā mātreṇa bhāvāt utpatteḥ na ca kārya svabhāvābhyām anyaḥ kaścid kasyacid avyabhicārī hetuḥ asti vā vyabhicāre ca sati śabdasya tatonyathā api iti

original: tasmād bāhyārthād anyathāpi vāhyārthabhāvepīty arthaḥ | tatsambhavāt tasya śabdasya sambhavāt kāraṇāt | tasya śabdasya bhāvāt tatpratītir vāhyārthapratītir ayuktā |
analyzed: tasmāt bāhya arthāt anyathā api vāhya artha bhāve pi iti arthaḥ tad sambhavāt tasya śabdasya sambhavāt kāraṇāt tasya śabdasya bhāvāt tad pratītiḥ vāhya artha pratītiḥ ayuktā

original: syād etad (|) yady api vācyād vastunorthāntaraṃ vacanantathāpi tasya vācyasya kāryam eveti gamakam eva | yasmād vācakānāṃ śabdānāṃ yā pravṛttir utpattir abhivyaktir vā sā vā[cya dṛ]ṣṭikṛtā | vācyasyārthasya yaddarśanantatkṛtā | vācye hi sati taddarśanantaddarśanaṃ (|) taddarśanāt tadvivakṣā |
analyzed: syāt etat yadi api vācyāt vastunā ṛtha antaram vacanan tathā api tasya vācyasya kāryam eva iti gamakam eva yasmāt vācakānām śabdānām yā pravṛttiḥ utpattiḥ abhivyaktiḥ vā sā vācya dṛṣṭi kṛtā vācyasya arthasya yat darśanam tad kṛtā vācye hi sati tat darśanam tat darśanam tad darśanāt tad vivakṣā

original: vivakṣāto vacanam iti pāramparyeṇa vacanam arthakāryam iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
analyzed: vivakṣātaḥ vacanam iti pāramparyeṇa vacanam artha kāryam iti pūrvapakṣaḥ

original: syād etad ityādinā vyācaṣṭe | tasmād vācakasya śabdasya vācyadarśanena pravṛtteḥ |
analyzed: syāt etat ityādinā vyācaṣṭe tasmāt vācakasya śabdasya vācya darśanena pravṛtteḥ

original: (p. 616) evam ityādinā pratividhatte | evaṃ satīti yady arthavaśenaiva vacanapravṛttes sarvā vacanapravṛttiḥ satyārthā……daikatrābhidheye āgamabhedena parasparaṃ viruddhārthā sā vacanavṛttiḥ katham bhavet | naiva bhavet | sarvapravādeṣv ekārtheva bhaved iti yāvat |
analyzed: evam ityādinā pratividhatte evam sati iti yadi artha vaśena eva vacana pravṛttyāḥ sarvā vacana pravṛttiḥ satya arthāt aikatra abhidheye āgama bhedena parasparam viruddha arthā sā vacana vṛttiḥ katham bhavet na eva bhavet sarva pravādeṣu ekārthā iva bhavet iti yāvat

original: yadītyādinā vyācaṣṭe | yady eṣa niyamo vācyam vastvantareṇa vācyena vastunā vinā śabdo na pravarttata iti tadā paraspara viruddhārthābhidhānād bhinneṣu pravādeṣu siddhānteṣc ekatra vastuni | nityānityā [de………vi]ruddhasya svabhāvasyopasaṃhāreṇa samāropeṇa vacanavṛtir na syāt |
